zaytunazs/accnomos.summary: AI bookkeeping and MTD VAT for UK small firms from OneDrive files
zaytunazs/accnomos.readme_summary: Accnomos does receipt-to-VAT bookkeeping where books stay as files in user OneDrive. Python services + web app with code-calculated VAT and HMRC sandbox. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 with Glimmer 30B fallback to read receipts.

gino6178/serve-meta-hackathon.summary: Agent-to-agent platform where personal agents negotiate and settle group plans
gino6178/serve-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Serve removes group-chat coordination by letting personal AI agents negotiate times, prices, and venues with each other. Sport scheduling is the first use case with live demo and technical report. Built solo on Meta open models with self-evolving agents.

martinmw13/LectorIA-meta.summary: E-reader with emotion-matched orchestral music and book companion chat
martinmw13/LectorIA-meta.readme_summary: Plays scene-matched orchestral music with rain ambience for 10 public-domain books. Includes images and spoiler-free Ask the book. Built with Meta Muse models for emotion and chat.

oneiron-dev/muse-glimmer-afterglow.summary: Local Muse Glimmer that trains nightly QLoRA adapters from daily notes
oneiron-dev/muse-glimmer-afterglow.readme_summary: Afterglow runs Muse Glimmer 30B on local GPU as daytime agent with notes. A nightly job turns the day into training data, trains QLoRA on same GPU, tests against held-out and general skills, keeping updates only without forgetting.

Bridgett50/second-seat-hackathon.summary: AI meeting twin that attends, masks sensitive details, and drafts follow-ups
Bridgett50/second-seat-hackathon.readme_summary: Second Seat is a scripted meeting room where an AI twin participates with live guidance and takeover. It masks sensitive data, keeps evidence records and drafts follow-ups for review. Solo-founder privacy safety layer.

lutic1/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Turns a room photo into a playable escape room hosted by AI wizards
lutic1/meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Keyframe generates an escape room from your own objects in about three minutes. Four wizard agents narrate and run puzzles via web app. Uses Meta models for vision, story, and game hosting on Modal.

QuintinBotes/stint.summary: Local-first task control plane where work persists beyond agent chats
QuintinBotes/stint.readme_summary: Stint makes the task the unit of work with planner, agent, and reviewer loops. Local-first control plane with live scorecards. Uses Muse Spark Open and Muse Glimmer 30B via Baseten, Fireworks, Modal, and Ollama.

gamamou/TerraCouncil-Meta-Hackathon-2026.summary: Evidence-first sustainability debate platform for Africa with FAITH and FSDC data
gamamou/TerraCouncil-Meta-Hackathon-2026.readme_summary: TerraCouncil presents jury demo guide, development ledger and scientific evidence docs for SustainAfrica. Stack is Python src with config, data, tests and UI. Uses Meta AI for multi-perspective debate with provenance and no-claim boundaries.

KevinKbyte/MemriPal.summary: Memory-palace coach that turns familiar places into speech recall routes
KevinKbyte/MemriPal.readme_summary: MemriPal turns a photo of a familiar space into an ordered loci route for speeches and study lists. SAM 3.1 segments objects while Muse Spark creates multisensory associations. Stack is Capacitor Android, Docker, and cloud deploy.

keylorpineda/ColonQuest.summary: Costa Rica minimum-wage finance simulator where an AI directs life events
keylorpineda/ColonQuest.readme_summary: Survive three months on minimum wage with deterministic colon engine and hidden fees. AI director creates situational events. Runs locally with your own Meta API key, Windows build available.

edward321416-maker/fieldless.summary: Surveys street assets from public street photos into evidence-linked review lists
edward321416-maker/fieldless.readme_summary: Automates first-pass street surveys from Mapillary photos to produce a Record Update List for human review. Stack includes Docker deploy, pipeline/server with eval; Ballard pilot reports 10.3 min and $5.63 Meta API cost. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation with Muse Spark and Muse Glimmer for records.

sushant-me/only-you.summary: Provenance gate that decides which voices a wearable agent must obey.
sushant-me/only-you.readme_summary: Authority layer for glasses agents that filters audio commands by speaker provenance. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for scene reading, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 grounding. Includes playground demo and audit docs.

asjames18/sightwork-hackathon.summary: Converts narrated phone walkthrough videos into structured work plans
asjames18/sightwork-hackathon.readme_summary: SightWork generates work plans from walkthrough video. Built with Next.js, Playwright and CI. Every model used is a Meta model, processing narrated walkthroughs into viewable plans with example sanctuary project.

summitsingh/launchcrew.summary: Trust layer turning solo founder ideas into owner-approved launch packs.
summitsingh/launchcrew.readme_summary: LaunchCrew runs Scout, Maker and Checker agents to gather, draft and audit launch content with Ready-gated publishing. Every verdict and approval is logged as receipts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for research and drafting.

watt-mind/pii-guard.summary: Privacy gateway that replaces PII with reversible placeholders for AI agents.
watt-mind/pii-guard.readme_summary: Privacy gateway: PII becomes reversible placeholders before leaving network and restores on return. Python Docker self-hosted Apache-2.0. Built on Meta open models, runs locally with hosted demo.

mrfentmen/meta-sentinel.summary: Agent operating system with Rust kernel and model-driven watch floor
mrfentmen/meta-sentinel.readme_summary: Meta OS pairs a custom Rust kernel booted in QEMU with an agent platform for labs and workshops. Platform makes real model calls with records and budget guardrails. Carrier is a remastered Xubuntu demo image.

sidonsoft/muse-recall.summary: Local-first studio for building apps with inspectable, correctable project memory
sidonsoft/muse-recall.readme_summary: Local-first studio for building small browser apps with persistent correctable memory. Records decisions, imports images, generates with Muse and stages changes for review. Includes Muse Forge game-studio workspace demo.

rehaancubess/muselaunch.summary: AI growth studio helping indie apps get discovered and marketed
rehaancubess/muselaunch.readme_summary: MuseLaunch turns an app into listings, studio assets, and growth experiments for indie developers. Monorepo with web, API, and e2e infra on Cloud Run. Uses Muse models, SAM 3.1, and HyperFrames.

PatriaAWijaya/Minime-Hackathon.summary: Multi-agent orchestrator that routes briefs to agents with approval and evals
PatriaAWijaya/Minime-Hackathon.readme_summary: A Meta-native agent orchestrator turns a brief into scheduled content via Intake to Postiz drafts. Muse models via Meta Model API route work across agents with human approval gates. Includes live harness reporting routing quality, latency, and cost.

smellak/gifford.summary: Communication network connecting coding agents across terminals and machines
smellak/gifford.readme_summary: Gifford connects interactive coding agents across harnesses, terminals, users and machines with human-in-loop control. It is built in Go with CI, releases, and security policy. It uses Muse Glimmer 30B plus trained LoRA as analyst.

bgaravelos/montivo.summary: Agent video editor that plans, renders, reviews its cut and re-cuts automatically
bgaravelos/montivo.readme_summary: Montivo edits talking-head and interview footage via a plan-render-review-recut loop that watches its own cut. Built on Meta Muse Spark, Muse Voice, and SAM 3.1 with Docker deployment. Includes blind scoring and hosted read-only demo cuts.

hackall360/Secure-Mitigation-System.summary: Purple-team pipeline that attacks code, patches it, and verifies fixes
hackall360/Secure-Mitigation-System.readme_summary: Autonomous purple-team CI/CD pipeline that finds weaknesses, writes patches, and re-runs attacks in air-gapped Docker. Built with FastAPI, Python 3.12, and Docker verification. Uses Meta Muse Spark/Wonder to generate security patches.

gokhunyayla/muse-servicedesk.summary: Multi-tier IT service desk agents acting over WhatsApp and email
gokhunyayla/muse-servicedesk.readme_summary: Four L1-L4 agents fix IT issues via tool calls to Microsoft 365, Azure VM and VPN plus proactive monitoring. Uses Meta Model API with FastAPI app, agent framework and tests for approvals and identity checks.

taidang26/hoi-sau-studio.summary: Daily AI office-comedy comic where audience comments decide the next episode
taidang26/hoi-sau-studio.readme_summary: Pipeline that produces daily comic episodes and two 9:16 clips for Facebook, Instagram, Threads and TikTok. Audience comments drive the next storyline for recurring characters. Uses Muse models for writing, image generation and quality checks.

felixgabriel94/hireMarco.summary: WhatsApp-based AI operator that runs recording sessions, email, calls and proofs.
felixgabriel94/hireMarco.readme_summary: hireMarco is a text-and-voice operator for an artist that handles studio control, email, booking and delivery. Built with Python app/src layout, it uses Muse Spark on Meta Model API with a Muse Wonder critic gated by RULES.md.

Nandish3010/categoryos.summary: Agentic category manager that vets vendors and proves every number
Nandish3010/categoryos.readme_summary: Screens new vendors for documents and injection, decides SKU bets and terms, then monitors category. Deterministic verifiers prove numbers on synthetic data. Backend plus frontend stack recorded live against Muse Spark, Muse Image and SAM 3.1.

EdwinSotto123/blindaje.summary: Disguised notebook app that links extortion evidence across cases without exposing victims.
EdwinSotto123/blindaje.readme_summary: Blindaje lets users store WhatsApp voice notes, photos and messages in an app disguised as a business notebook. It transcribes evidence into comparable signals to link cases from the same network for human review. District-level maps are public while victim identity stays private.

lleoparden/naqsh.summary: Arabic-first localizer turning images into editable translated RTL layers
lleoparden/naqsh.readme_summary: Uploads comics, posters or menus, segments text, translates to Arabic, inpaints originals and re-typesets RTL in matching style. Includes layer editor with SVG/PNG export and replay mode. Uses vision segmentation plus translation models.

medomohamed22/admorph-ai.summary: Turns one phone photo into a dialect-localized Instagram ad in a minute.
medomohamed22/admorph-ai.readme_summary: AdMorph AI cuts out products with SAM 3.1, writes Arabic/English copy with Muse Spark and paints final creative with Muse Image. It is a Vercel web studio with fixed model roles and layout verification.

mohiddin7/indexreel.summary: Counts distinct recordings behind viral clips to expose reused footage
mohiddin7/indexreel.readme_summary: IndexReel links video posts that share the same source footage despite crops, mirrors or re-uploads. It fetches X posts, matches frames and shows side-by-side evidence via bot and site. Built for news verification with video matching.

PearlLeeStudio/TheArtist-DAW.summary: Turns scores into editable DAW chords and accompaniment with AI harmony.
PearlLeeStudio/TheArtist-DAW.readme_summary: Extracts chords from scores and explores harmony to build accompaniment parts. Combines Muse Spark 1.3 with Music Transformer plus Muse Spark Open on Baseten. Full DAW backend with live demo and YouTube walkthrough.

iggykimi/bidlab.summary: Turns Spanish tender PDFs into defensible bid prices with citations
iggykimi/bidlab.readme_summary: Local-first assistant where Muse Spark extracts requirements with page citations for human approval. Deterministic Python engine computes price, points and low-offer rules with accessible Spanish voice UI.

hrminator/night-shift.summary: Overnight manager agent that acts on permission and reports evidence by morning
hrminator/night-shift.readme_summary: Night Shift is an overnight manager on Muse Spark that works simulated jobs, acts within permissions and wakes owner only on evidence. Recorded replays plus live answers, Docker/Fly deploy.

rockyru/regov.summary: Autonomous agent rebuilding legacy PH government sites into accessible experiences.
rockyru/regov.readme_summary: Paste a legacy URL; it crawls pages, understands content and rebuilds on BetterGov Kapwa design system with migration report. Cloudflare plus open-source design system stack. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API and Muse Image.

bawanallahbilyaminu/kasafi-agent.summary: Hausa voice-first WhatsApp bot answering Sokoto budget questions with sources.
bawanallahbilyaminu/kasafi-agent.readme_summary: Kasafi answers public budget and policy questions by Hausa voice note or text on WhatsApp with source-page checks. Built with FastAPI, Postgres, Alembic and Docker with live smoke tests. Uses Meta AI models for transcription, retrieval and grounded answers.

Gruya13/codeproof.summary: Code reviewer where every finding carries machine-checked proof or failing test.
Gruya13/codeproof.readme_summary: CodeProof verifies code findings with citations, adversarial confirmation or failing tests. Zero-runtime-dependency tool with Docker demo and 268 deterministic tests. Built from scratch for Push the Frontier Indie track.

ArgeTheGamer/PsycheEngine.summary: Multi-agent runtime keeps long documents consistent from one canon
ArgeTheGamer/PsycheEngine.readme_summary: Writes operations manuals and agreements from shared company facts and propagates fact changes to every page. Prevents contradictions like approval roles or zone changes. Runtime plus web UI built on Muse Spark.

jckjjcckk/folio-pad.summary: Scans scores, splits parts to iPads, and syncs conductor markings live.
jckjjcckk/folio-pad.readme_summary: Folio is an AI librarian for ensembles on iPad and web. It detects systems and bars, cuts parts, converts scans to notation, and turns spoken notes into marks with playback for practice.

imthi16/proofmerge.summary: Verifies AI pull requests by reproducing tests in isolated Docker runs
imthi16/proofmerge.readme_summary: Muse Spark writes tests that must pass on base code, runs them 3x on base and patch in no-network Docker, Muse Wonder cross-checks, then code emits PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK. GitHub Action with replayable evidence.

kryterea/kryterea-lifecycle-copilot.summary: Reviews coding-agent changes as analyst, architect, QA and compliance officer
kryterea/kryterea-lifecycle-copilot.readme_summary: Lifecycle Copilot runs non-coding duties for each code change without writing code or touching repos. Produces signed acceptance record. Built on Meta Muse Spark, pnpm monorepo.

alined-labs/vitrina.summary: Turns one product photo into a WhatsApp storefront ad that learns from sales chats.
alined-labs/vitrina.readme_summary: Closed-loop storefront for Colombian WhatsApp sellers where photos become shareable showcases and chats improve next ads. Built with Python backend, apps frontend, Alembic + Docker stack. Uses Meta AI models for image-to-ad generation and conversation feedback.

dudhasch/contextpane.summary: Operator-guided workbench to diagnose and fix Entra ID, Intune and Azure issues
dudhasch/contextpane.readme_summary: Routes MSP tickets and builds remediation views with typed actions and human approval. Uses Glimmer 30B for hover explanations, Spark 1.3 for routing, Wonder 1.0 for scoping and fixes, Voice Transcribe for commands. MCP + web app stack.

NayilRArana/primordial-paradox.summary: NES-style RPG where Greek gods in modern England are won over by talk
NayilRArana/primordial-paradox.readme_summary: Primordial Paradox is an 8-bit GameMaker RPG set in storm-hit Southampton with dialogue plus combat. Hackathon repo adds content built by directing AI agents. Pre-existing engine with 292 commits plus new game logic.

Farshadmhd/beampilot.summary: Agentic laser M2 measurement to ISO 11146 that rejects bad data honestly
Farshadmhd/beampilot.readme_summary: Agent drives simulated camera and stage, judges exposure quality, fits caustics until ISO 11146 coverage is met. Python stack with tests and scripts. Uses Muse Spark for agency and SAM 3.1 for vision checks.

meta-ai-hackathon/meta-hack.summary: Guided voice helper that prepares Medicaid and SNAP applications for review.
meta-ai-hackathon/meta-hack.readme_summary: Tenet conducts spoken or typed interview, asks each question once, and fills NC DHB-5200 and DSS-8207 drafts. Answers stay on device, numbers use deterministic rules, output is review-only. Built for Meta hackathon Oct 26-Nov 4.

Humank1nd/life-itself-manhattan.summary: Browser life sim grounded on real Manhattan building data from NYC Open Data.
Humank1nd/life-itself-manhattan.readme_summary: Life Itself Manhattan streams 45k+ NYC building footprints and attributes into a browser simulation. Built with web 3D Cesium plus data pipelines on Firebase. Uses Meta models to reason and act on the real grounded place.

NDilanka/acan.summary: Scope approval gate and live map for fleets of coding agents
NDilanka/acan.readme_summary: Acan is a scope-first gate where developers approve agent change-scopes before code. It runs old and merged apps side-by-side to catch out-of-scope diffs with reproducers. Built in Rust with plant view UI, using Muse Spark for planning and Muse Spark Open workers.

furqaannabi/siteproof.summary: Verifies builder payment claims by counting windows and doors in site videos
furqaannabi/siteproof.readme_summary: SiteProof parses demand letters and bills of quantities, then detects and counts installed windows and doors in WhatsApp progress clips. Each claim is marked Verified, Short or Not seen yet with frames and outlines. Stack is Python backend, Next.js web frontend with vision models.

abelxmendoza/RobotForge-Hackathon.summary: Words or photo to validated robot digital twin driving in simulation
abelxmendoza/RobotForge-Hackathon.readme_summary: RobotForge converts text, photo or parts list into an engineering spec, checks it, and simulates the twin in Gazebo against ground truth. Next.js garage app with catalog. Uses Muse Spark for spec generation and diagnosis.

GuillermoSiaira/dora-farm-agent.summary: Crop-season planning agent for Argentine farmers with LP optimizer and verifier
GuillermoSiaira/dora-farm-agent.readme_summary: DORA plans Argentine grain seasons from text, voice, invoice photos and map sketches. Gradio app combines LP engine with shadow prices and a Meta-model agent plus verifier. Includes eval suite, observatory and Spanish-English Modal demo.

uwazzi/hoolala.summary: Anonymous local invitations that turn shared places into in-person talks
uwazzi/hoolala.readme_summary: Hoolala! lets people in the same cafe or coworking space post meetup signals, staying anonymous until mutual opt-in. Web app with evals and docs. Uses Muse Spark for profiling, topic suggestions, screening, translation and venue ideas.

Jaycee871/FrontierLab-Meta-Hackathon-202.summary: Turns biomedical questions into cited hypotheses and human-gated plans
Jaycee871/FrontierLab-Meta-Hackathon-202.readme_summary: Multi-agent system that turns research questions into falsifiable hypotheses and reviewable plans. Every claim must cite and quote sources with human approval gates. Built with Muse models and Streamlit app deployed to Hugging Face Spaces.

NotPellew/Thalvi.summary: Hands-free voice assistant that dictates prompts to coding agents and apps.
NotPellew/Thalvi.readme_summary: Thalvi listens for Hey Thalvi and types dictated prompts into the active window for Muse Code and other agents. Desktop app for Hyprland and Windows with cooking and on-road modes. Built with Muse Spark Open for transcription and dialog.

Dominic-Pi-Sunyer/munix.summary: Deterministic runtime that blocks prompt-injection tool calls by enforcing pre-signed plans
Dominic-Pi-Sunyer/munix.readme_summary: Gate-enforced runtime in Rust where agents act only through code-checked tool calls. Includes crates, demo, docs and evals with 48-run attack tests. Built on Muse Spark with support for Muse Wonder as agent model.

NadyKor15/billradar.summary: Tool tracking legislative bills with samples and evaluations.

starsmash29/fr-os-ai-perimeter.summary: Natural-language firewall changes turned into validated patches that an admin must approve.
starsmash29/fr-os-ai-perimeter.readme_summary: FR_OS AI-Perimeter adds a natural-language AI layer to the FR_OS router OS running on real router hardware. It turns requests into validated config patches requiring admin approval and explains anomalies, using local Muse Glimmer by default with cloud opt-in.

soilrist/muse-playtester.summary: AI agent watches game screens, presses keys, and writes reproducible bug reports with screenshots.
soilrist/muse-playtester.readme_summary: PlayTester perceives screenshots with SAM 3.1 to locate player and objects, then Muse Spark 1.3 picks press, click, wait and report actions. Rule checks complement model reports for reproducible bugs with captures. Product code in src/, with loop-starter-kit process template and viewer.

F0rger123/vault-hackathon-2026.summary: Local-first document intelligence that redlines conflicts across files privately
F0rger123/vault-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: VAULT is private multimodal document intelligence that runs locally and finds contradictions. Backend plus CLI with Docker, CI and local inference setup. Uses Meta Llama 3 locally for reading, keeping documents on-machine.

sensei-hq/snap-to-make.summary: Snap a sketch to get measured cut-ready designs and laser G-code
sensei-hq/snap-to-make.readme_summary: Katachi is a voice-first workshop buddy that turns phone photos and speech into measured parts, photoreal preview and laser G-code. Built with Supabase and mobile app stack, it uses Meta Muse vision-language and SAM for measuring and tracing.

JAEHUN-AN/claimlens.summary: Converts foreign hospital bill photos into checked English insurance claim packs
JAEHUN-AN/claimlens.readme_summary: Reads bill photos and produces checked claim with deductible, eligibility and codes in seconds. Python backend with static frontend, samples and traceable calculations. Uses Muse Spark for reading and reasoning while code counts and people decide.

alsopgroup/lanemint-meta-hackathon.summary: Synthetic market-data benchmark testing Muse on messy quant finance cleaning.
alsopgroup/lanemint-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Procedurally generated benchmark that tests Muse models on quant-finance data-cleaning and exact numeric work. Uses deterministic scorer, not model grading, with Docker demo. Reports Muse Spark 1.3 turn efficiency on tools_frontier tier.

CipherPRG/onboardiq.summary: Onboards network devices to monitoring by reading manuals and live-testing
CipherPRG/onboardiq.readme_summary: Agent that reads device MIB files to select metrics for CPU, memory, disk and sensors. Verifies each pick with live SNMP tests on the device via Docker stack. Uses Muse Spark to parse MIBs and map health metrics to monitored objects.

nathandavidgreene/ancientos-hackathon.summary: Rust gate letting AI agents act only via approval, privacy router and audit log
nathandavidgreene/ancientos-hackathon.readme_summary: Small Rust core enforces fail-closed approvals, privacy routing and hash-chained decision log for agent actions. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark/Wonder on sanitized text, local Llama for sensitive data, Spark Open on Baseten for images.

BoMa-AI-Cloud/aria-home.summary: Monitors older adult homes for heat readiness and overnight faults
BoMa-AI-Cloud/aria-home.readme_summary: Checks if home will be warm by morning and flags overnight anomalies to get right responder moving. Synthetic data demo, no control or medical function. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for explanations at story times.

buildwithdesi/vibeaudit-2.summary: Security audit that proves AI-code risks and patches them
buildwithdesi/vibeaudit-2.readme_summary: Vibe Audit 2.0 scans GitHub repos with 104 rules then reasons exploitability and outputs proof-of-risk with fixes. Second command patches on sandbox branch and re-scans. Uses Muse Spark reasoning over routes and auth boundaries.

rasali535/ralion-meta-hackathon.summary: Growth autopilot turning business context into approved video campaigns.
rasali535/ralion-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Pipeline from business input to reasoning, image and 9:16 reel plus voiceover with human approval. TS apps with API and Modal jobs, 225 tests. Uses Meta models for reasoning and creative synthesis.

heynomads/elynd-worlds.summary: Creates a living painted world for every guided meditation session
heynomads/elynd-worlds.readme_summary: Generates calm animated paintings tailored to each guided meditation, with rippling water and drifting clouds. Uses Meta models to design, paint, check and animate 1,101 library worlds plus live personal ones. Stack includes Python, Flutter and web frontend.

Eswereddy/krishi-mitra-agent.summary: Voice-first Telugu farming agent for crop diagnosis, prices and schemes
Eswereddy/krishi-mitra-agent.readme_summary: Krishi Mitra lets farmers speak, type or send crop photos in Telugu, Hindi or English to get diagnosis, weather-timed action plan, mandi prices and scheme eligibility. Same vision+tool agent handles image and voice with TTS readout. Backend, frontend and evals built during hackathon.

ngoldbla/cv-meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Calm car-buying app ranking new cars by 5-year true monthly cost
ngoldbla/cv-meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Low Key ranks new cars by resale from sold-vehicle data and shows 5-year monthly cost with tax, interest and gas. Finds cheapest nearby in-stock unit with out-the-door estimate. Python stack with headless-glimmer and skills; live at lowkey.autos.

meschinidino/repo-city.summary: Renders repos as isometric city to dispatch and watch coding agents
meschinidino/repo-city.readme_summary: Maps modules to islands and files to buildings, imports to bridges, with CRUD agent quests and plain-English reports. Client + server prototype architecture. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for agent orchestration.

AariaSec/witness.summary: Out-of-process recorder verifying what coding agents actually did
AariaSec/witness.readme_summary: Captures file writes, network and processes outside agent sandbox to compare against self-reports. Includes Python recorder, static console, Muse plugin and recorded bundles. Built during hackathon for agent verification.

StefanRohringer/muse-qc-cell.summary: Muse agent drives robot arm for visual injection-molding inspection
StefanRohringer/muse-qc-cell.readme_summary: Muse Spark agent controls reBot Arm B601-DM to pick parts, SAM 3.1 counts levers in close-up to sort good and bad boxes. Real hardware with coded safety rules, evals and replay demo. MIT licensed solo build.

depapranata26/mejabahasa.summary: Multilingual table-QR chat agent for restaurant ordering and staff coordination.
depapranata26/mejabahasa.readme_summary: Guest web chat via table QR with cart and checkout synced to staff, kitchen and owner dashboards on one SQLite backend. Python FastAPI backend with static frontend. Uses Muse models for multilingual menu and order dialogue.

IamAmasai/hazina-agent.summary: Tax agent turning M-Pesa and receipts into Kenya eTIMS-ready books
IamAmasai/hazina-agent.readme_summary: Hazi gathers M-Pesa, bank statements, receipt photos and voice notes, then Muse Spark vision structures them. Deterministic matcher reconciles every shilling and flags unmatched for month-end compliance. Python agent with UI, evals and fixtures.

Raul99Alejandro/coresight.summary: Automated geological logging that turns drill core box photos into depth-aligned data
Raul99Alejandro/coresight.readme_summary: Automates drill-core logging from core box photos for mining teams. Stack is Python Docker app with web demo and agent pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation masks and Muse models for mineral / structure interpretation.

masontmorris/unity-playtest-agent.summary: Autonomous agent that plays Unity games and files bug reports with evidence.
masontmorris/unity-playtest-agent.readme_summary: Reads Unity project code to learn controls and state, then plays in real time, investigates anomalies and exports reproduced bug reports. Python harness with game bridge plus benchmarks. Uses Muse models for play decisions and escalation.

raahimnawaz/workbench-copilot.summary: Voice-controlled bench assistant that writes firmware and drives an SO-101 arm.
raahimnawaz/workbench-copilot.readme_summary: Hands-free electronics partner where Muse Spark routes requests to Muse Wonder for firmware, SAM 3.1 for breadboard vision, and Voice Transcribe for input. Local Llama 3.2 fast path for arm commands with HUD. Python stack with firmware, hardware and tests.

akilanpl/worldspeak.summary: Offline bilingual English-Tamil board with exact preview then speech
akilanpl/worldspeak.readme_summary: WorldSpeak turns intent into exact English/Tamil preview and speaks only on explicit action with offline support. Monorepo with apps/packages, Supabase JSONB persistence and pixel-mask renderer. Uses Spark/SAM pipeline for scene generation.

eeshsingh123/Rewind.summary: Asks any photo or video questions by chat or voice with video clip proof
eeshsingh123/Rewind.readme_summary: Web, Telegram and WhatsApp bot that answers plain-language questions over user footage. Plans with Muse Spark, tracks with SAM 3.1, transcribes with Muse Voice, verifies with code. Python service with ffmpeg, evals and sim harness.

phaladamou/employee-platform.summary: Platform to recruit and manage autonomous AI workers with verifiable identities.
phaladamou/employee-platform.readme_summary: Employee lets creators publish versioned agents with locked tools and employers assign missions in natural language. Agents execute sandboxed, accumulate history under persistent emp_ identity with verifiable reports. Built for Meta hackathon Indie Track with Muse models.

MatiDegli/oversight.summary: Web IDE to supervise coding agents with approval gates and impact analysis
MatiDegli/oversight.readme_summary: Oversight is a web IDE for supervising coding agents on Python repos using chat-led plans and git worktrees. It visualizes reads/edits, impact cones, diffs, and test evidence before merge to main. It uses Meta models for lead planning and coding agents.

seanudeke/Nightshift.summary: Verifies AI bug fixes by replaying gameplay and watching frames
seanudeke/Nightshift.readme_summary: Repo mirrors Expectrail harness that replays game fixes and judges with recorded frames. Same Docker harness, agents, and bench structure. Uses Muse Code and visual replay review to catch fixes that pass logs but fail visually.

guillemolero10/dockclerk.summary: AI clerk that prepares warehouse work inside existing 3PL software
guillemolero10/dockclerk.readme_summary: Reads emails, WhatsApp and portal requests to prepare work in existing warehouse software for one-click approval. Counts boxes from delivery-note photos and supports English/Spanish. Built with Next.js, Prisma, Vercel and Modal with Meta Muse models.

prashanth-ds-ml/anubhav.summary: Agents learn unwritten business rules from records to make safer verified plans.
prashanth-ds-ml/anubhav.readme_summary: Learns business rules from own records, verifies them in code with human approval. Streamlit and Docker app on Hugging Face built on Meta Muse with preregistered experiments.

judescripts/emberscan.summary: Phone walkaround video turned into measured wildfire defensible-space report
judescripts/emberscan.readme_summary: Films a home/HOA walkaround to track hazards with SAM 3.1, measure wall distance in feet, and check California rules via deterministic engine with citations. Muse Spark Open agent builds prioritized fix plan with cost and tracked rescan verification.

paulmalik431-ctrl/proof-of-planet.summary: WhatsApp climate action earns tradable ECOIN after Meta AI verification
paulmalik431-ctrl/proof-of-planet.readme_summary: ECO mints ECOIN for verified climate action via WhatsApp in any language. Meta AI checks evidence, deterministic rules decide, public ledger enables audit. Web atlas, ledger, Ghost Audit evals, Supabase backend.

tamzid2001/frontiersight-ai.summary: Turns video into verifiable physical-world safety intelligence
tamzid2001/frontiersight-ai.readme_summary: Converts video into measured physical-world events with verifiable evidence instead of vague captions. Python pipeline with edge Docker, coverage and evaluation. Uses Meta vision models including SAM-style segmentation for forklift safety.

fir3storm/cybergenesis.summary: Self-defending digital twin that attacks itself to prove resilience

brennandec/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Hackathon harness with contracts, fixtures and launcher for judging runs

DhabtPlatform/souk-lens-indie.summary: Turns souk stall photos into grounded listings tied to numbered boxes.

Teddy41682/coach.summary: Hands-free cooking coach that watches via Ray-Ban Meta glasses
Teddy41682/coach.readme_summary: iOS app + worker backend watches camera stream from glasses/phone to guide cooking steps. Answers questions from observed video history, with recipe box and hands-free voice interaction.

Techfrontiers/snapsell-ww.summary: Product photo turned into studio listing card for global sellers

pablopriefert/gilmend.summary: Agent that turns damaged parcel photos into carrier claims
pablopriefert/gilmend.readme_summary: Customer reports damage with photo, agent finds order and decides reship or refund. Builds carrier claim PDF and email plus customer draft. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

AUsernameForYou/agenthand.summary: MCP server turning messy product photos into listing-ready images with proof

euphoriawolf/forewarn.summary: Street-level flood risk forecasts for Africa up to 14 days ahead
euphoriawolf/forewarn.readme_summary: Agent answers will it flood here with green-amber-red level and actions. Uses 51 rain forecasts plus ground wetness data. Built with Muse Spark Open and Muse Voice Transcribe in English, French, Swahili.

hkdebendo/autolab.summary: Autonomous agent proposes battery crystal substitutions and validates them with simulation
hkdebendo/autolab.readme_summary: AutoLab takes a plain-language battery goal and proposes chemical substitutions in known crystals. It builds structures, simulates them with Meta FAIR UMA, applies scientific filters, and feeds failures back to Muse Spark to explain and improve next proposals.

Dongckim/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hackat.summary: Hands-free lab assistant using smart glasses, voice and a robot to log runs
Dongckim/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hackat.readme_summary: iOS client plus server that connects Meta AI glasses vision, voice transcription and lab logging. Glass view verifies bench steps while voice drives the record and robot replay. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Voice Transcribe 1.0 for perception and dialogue.

dembenski/star-sprite.summary: Prompt-to-playable game engine that generates browser games instantly
dembenski/star-sprite.readme_summary: AI game-making engine where prompt in yields playable game out in browser. Single index.html frontend architecture. Uses Muse Wonder muse-wonder-1.0 with Groq backup for generation.

ultraxav/jamesian-layer.summary: Middleware that audits foundation-model agency across 18 models and 36 arms
ultraxav/jamesian-layer.readme_summary: Python middleware and controllers for auditing model autonomy and interoception. Batch runs tasks locally, on Meta and Baseten with logged reports. Evaluates Meta open-weight models for agentic behavior and failure modes.

creativeheadz/wegweiser-eyewitness.summary: Phone camera diagnoses PCs when monitoring agent goes offline
creativeheadz/wegweiser-eyewitness.readme_summary: Helpdesk tool where phone films PC lights and screens for offline diagnosis. Interprets blink codes like memory failure for technicians. Integrates with existing helpdesk workflows and migrations.

Josezx18/muselearn.summary: AI study companion that plans weeks, tutors without doing homework, checks learning
Josezx18/muselearn.readme_summary: MuseLearn for secondary school plans study weeks, tutors with guardrails, and verifies understanding. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase Postgres with RLS. Uses Muse Spark for tutoring and Muse Voice for speech.

Sahaj1207/mothertongue-books.summary: Creates illustrated children's books natively in mother-tongue languages
Sahaj1207/mothertongue-books.readme_summary: Parent/teacher prompt or folk tale becomes illustrated picture book written first in Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Swahili and others. Multi-agent pipeline writes, checks reading level, illustrates. Frontend + backend + Supabase.

Divyesh-Thirukonda/cruise.summary: Talk to a Raspberry Pi to generate, verify and run apps for connected hardware
Divyesh-Thirukonda/cruise.readme_summary: Modulate lets users describe device behavior in speech; a Muse Spark agent detects components, writes code, sandboxes and repairs it, then activates locally with rollback. Runs on Raspberry Pi with web UI for browser demo and device connect.

BoxLogoDev/argus-counts.summary: Warehouse bin counter using SAM 3.1 to reconcile counts with ledger records
BoxLogoDev/argus-counts.readme_summary: Argus photographs warehouse bins on terminal, counts boxes with SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API, reconciles with ledger and reports variances. Pi 5 target, web console, mock adapters for dev.

hanish-8880/zavero.summary: Voice-guided helper that shows what to click in Telugu, Hindi or English

fatguylilcoat98/lylo-mechanic-hackathon.summary: Phone app that explains car problems in plain English and safety guidance.
fatguylilcoat98/lylo-mechanic-hackathon.readme_summary: Android and web app takes symptom text, codes, dash photos and OBD data to give safety verdict and cost estimate. Safety rules set minimum caution with evidence display. Uses Meta AI / Muse for diagnosis and explanation.

seegongsik/whatif-camera.summary: One street photo shows the next 5km of places, landmarks and signs on map
seegongsik/whatif-camera.readme_summary: What's Ahead maps a street photo to the next 5km using Overture Maps. Muse Spark Open names visitor-known landmarks, SAM 3.1 finds signs in the photo and projects them onto the map. Web app with camera and map fly-through deployed on Vercel.

8-BitRhyon/settleye.summary: Auditor that verifies AI agent refund promises against Stripe/Shopify ledgers

sylwesterdigital/cv-meta-hackathon-solvi.summary: Interactive troubleshooting guides for everyday devices like laptops and printers
sylwesterdigital/cv-meta-hackathon-solvi.readme_summary: SOLVI.help provides procedural tools and interactive equipment guides with persistent states. Built as static JS/CSS/HTML with Node tests, it uses Meta AI to generate steps and device assistance.

bAIwor/bakpao-agent.summary: Autonomous micro-bakery ops agent for QRIS, sizing, and food costs

phsuroviec/gravit.summary: 3D puzzle game where gravity follows foldable space regions you carry and place

Izaansherif/page-ledger.summary: Photo of a paper shop notebook becomes a searchable mini-CRM with one-tap WhatsApp

vikashsaravanann/groundline-hackathon-20.summary: Turns product photo plus typed goal into reviewable structured assistance

moruku36/meta-global-ai-hackathon-trifec.summary: Pre-flight safety checker for risky AI agent capability combos

Fluffy-SHIBAINU/biscuit.summary: Voice helper on a senior's phone that reads mail aloud quoting only what it sees.
Fluffy-SHIBAINU/biscuit.readme_summary: Biscuit watches the mailbox, chimes on arrival, reads letters aloud and asks follow-ups. Quote-grounded answers, family page and 911 escalation. Built as Kindred AI product for Build for Your World.

gusdom87/comfi-autopilot.summary: Autonomous ops system that runs short-term rental guest, cleaner and issue work
gusdom87/comfi-autopilot.readme_summary: Coordinates hosting operations end-to-end on a staged Hospitable-model fixture world with reservations and cleanings. Uses Meta AI models with graduated autonomy gating where low-risk acts auto-run and guest messaging or charges require earned rights.

mackmind/piccompare-aec-agent.summary: Floor-plan checker that measures rooms across revisions with replayable proof

DivDev93/OfficeOfOtherwise-MetaHackathon.summary: Worldbuilding workbench that weaves alternate histories by date

annatchijova/krakadyl.summary: Active-investigation agent that organizes DFIR evidence and next verifiable steps.

AhmetGokcimen/tender-copilot.summary: Finds matching public tenders for SMEs and drafts eligibility and bid documents.

swopno1/vivereply-concierge.summary: AI front-of-house for resorts with live booking, pricing and staff handoff

josephbolus/devops-as-a-service.summary: Multi-agent system turning GitHub issues into tested pull requests

danrave1234/oddhound-claude.summary: Autonomous web testing agent that finds bugs you did not write tests for

sanggusti/automatic-octo-meme.summary: Benchmarks LLM drone navigators in simulated disaster zones for rescue tasks.

poferraz/vibe-fence.summary: Local safety checks for AI coding-agent actions and Git changes

AnnieQian1212/BoardDream.summary: Generates playable board games from a one-sentence description.

patelsaureen/clarity-room-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns tough decisions into testable small experiments with grounded briefs.

thibaudcathala/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Crowd of synthetic shoppers tests real websites for usability issues

markobonna/bottega.summary: Turns plain-language needs into working apps or hardware order packs.

genda-benjamin/verifiable-evidence-agent.summary: Answers security questionnaires only with cryptographically proven evidence

Ekos-Cyber-Labs/Project-Corvus.summary: On-prem AI SOC that turns Wazuh alerts into explained attack chains

GlamgarOnDiscord/parity-agent.summary: Records legacy app behavior and verifies modern rebuilds match it.
GlamgarOnDiscord/parity-agent.readme_summary: Captures legacy app flows then rebuilds as modern web app with field-by-field parity proof. TypeScript Bun tool using Meta Muse models for codegen, mapping and verification.

minasami/pharmacy-stock-agent.summary: Scans pharmacy shelf photos to read packs, flag expiry, and draft restock orders

maxime-mularz/live-cargo-witness.summary: Investigator agent audits live-animal air cargo paperwork and flight deviations
maxime-mularz/live-cargo-witness.readme_summary: Black-box agent checks IATA paperwork pre-flight, reconstructs flight post-landing, and queries crew on deviations. Deterministic core with evaluation benches, agent loop, and journal handover record. Runs on Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 and Voice Transcribe.

jerovasgo/evidence-workbench.summary: Agent harness that answers genetics questions with verified literature evidence
jerovasgo/evidence-workbench.readme_summary: Retrieves genetics literature, extracts atomic findings, and checks claims against verbatim source text with experimental context. Liamostudio/Pathfinder.summary: Table-mounted SO-101 arm that sees, decides and picks safely near people
Liamostudio/Pathfinder.readme_summary: Look-and-pick SO-101 robot where Meta models see and decide while a checkable safety layer drives motors. Includes Gaussian splat studio, simulation and calibration tools. Uses Meta vision and reasoning models, Python control stack.

butchewing/itemized.summary: Checks funeral price lists against FTC Funeral Rule disclosures
butchewing/itemized.readme_summary: Uploads funeral home GPLs as PDF or photos and flags missing prices and disclosures with citations. Built for the hackathon and live at itemized.mortuary.ai on Cloudflare Workers. Uses Muse models for document parsing and rule checking.

BROCKUGANDA/permitzero.summary: Zero-trust firewall that authorizes every consequential AI agent action
BROCKUGANDA/permitzero.readme_summary: Runtime authorization plane intercepts agent tool calls and binds them to tenant, identity, and argument hash. Allows, denies, or queues for human approval before execution with tamper-evident log. Finance execution simulated for hackathon demo.

Mister-Coolman/wardrobe-stylist.summary: Texts one daily outfit from your closet, calendar and weather
Mister-Coolman/wardrobe-stylist.readme_summary: Wardrobe Stylist digitizes a closet from video and recommends one outfit daily using calendar, weather and laundry state. Next.js app with WhatsApp integration and packing lists. Uses Meta Muse models for vision cataloging and outfit reasoning.

jeshwanthsingh/muse-guard.summary: Spec clash detector with independent verification of AI code fixes
jeshwanthsingh/muse-guard.readme_summary: Resolves conflicting requirements by exhaustively finding disagreements, letting user decide winner, then having Meta coding agent implement. Independent checker verifies fix with measured 160-run study. Live Modal web demo.

hrodge107/JustMaya.summary: Turns PDFs and notes into anime-style lessons with a 3D study companion
hrodge107/JustMaya.readme_summary: Meet Mita converts uploaded PDFs or note photos into interactive presentations with dialogue. Expressive 3D companion guides lessons. Web app with backend agent pipeline, runtime uses Meta AI only.

umdis/glosa.summary: Searches long lecture videos and answers with verified quote timestamps
umdis/glosa.readme_summary: Glosa converts sermons, lectures and talks into searchable citable text with exact timestamps. It uses transcription plus vision-language checks to verify answers against what was said. Built with Meta models to prevent hallucinations in study notes.

1jsjs/sourcenote.summary: Lecture notes agent that cites and verifies every claim from sources

pepemxl/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Phone camera that tracks players and maps them in meters on pitch

peteroraz/naijaledger.summary: Reconciliation copilot turning SME sales fragments into reviewable books
peteroraz/naijaledger.readme_summary: NaijaLedger ingests notebooks, invoices, PDFs, voice notes, and CSVs into deterministic match proposals for Nigerian retailers. Keeps AI from approving money or tax decisions, requiring human review. Built with Firebase, Cloud Run, and Meta AI models.

hosbe1/Proof-Carrying-Code-Meta-AI-Hacka.summary: Converts Python functions to verified Dafny code or returns a failing test case.

Dextheking1/by-eye.summary: Turns unmeasured cooking videos into written recipe cards with estimated amounts
Dextheking1/by-eye.readme_summary: Expo app plus FastAPI server with plate, measure and client pipeline for video analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for recipes and Muse Voice Transcribe for narration.

techafreshh/qed.summary: Independent agent re-analyzes papers to deliver replicated or not verdicts

jeejak/proofmuse.summary: Packing photo checker that flags weak evidence for Indonesian sellers
