bhoot-biswas/listsnap.summary: Turns one product photo into bilingual store listings, studio photos and reels.
bhoot-biswas/listsnap.readme_summary: ListSnap for Bangladesh sellers converts photos, voice notes and videos into Shopify/WooCommerce drafts with cutouts and social posts. Uses Muse Spark for listings, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Image for studio photos. Next.js with shop chat.

henryweimd/cozy-clinic.summary: Cozy clinic game where persistent patients remember you and teach clinical reasoning
henryweimd/cozy-clinic.readme_summary: Browser portrait game where encounters change persistent patients across clinicians. Built with web frontend plus Supabase backend on Vercel. Uses Meta AI / Muse models to drive patient dialogue, memory, and clinical teaching.

miravena/worksheet-coach.summary: Photo of a math worksheet becomes a 5-problem practice sheet targeting one habit
miravena/worksheet-coach.readme_summary: Agent grades a worksheet photo, identifies the single error habit, and generates a short practice set with self-checked answer key. For adult learners and tutors only with saved replayable sample runs. Uses Meta AI vision and reasoning models.

finaspirant/lucky-passes.summary: Tests if LLM judges can detect coding-agent lucky passes missed by visible tests
finaspirant/lucky-passes.readme_summary: Preregistered study on 16 coding tasks comparing process vs outcome judges for detecting lucky passes. Uses Python analysis pipeline with LLM judges over agent traces and final code. Finds code-only judge reaches AUROC 0.93 vs 0.51 for process.

tokyosini573/META-Global-AI-Developer-Ha.summary: Simulates 90-day app launch with thousands of virtual users to compare strategies
tokyosini573/META-Global-AI-Developer-Ha.readme_summary: Rehearsal simulates ad views, installs, usage and payments over 90 days for two launch plans. Shows funnel and reasons for churn to pick a winner before spending. Built with Muse Wonder, Spark, Glimmer and Voice Transcribe.

Looming41/pocketllm.summary: Runs 30B-100B+ MoE models offline from USB by streaming only active experts
Looming41/pocketllm.readme_summary: Portable runtime that runs large MoE models on low-RAM laptops fully offline from USB drives. Patches llama.cpp CPU MoE kernel for concurrent expert streaming plus striping and planner. Reports fit and placement before download with measured tuning.

Cole-Z/harbor-muse.summary: Live ship map where you can ask Muse about nearby vessels
Cole-Z/harbor-muse.readme_summary: One-page live tracker for US waters centered on user location. Uses aisstream.io AIS feed with MapLibre GL and OpenFreeMap. Muse models answer typed or dictated questions about visible ships.

Bignesh14/glimmer-m5-selftune.summary: Self-tuning loop making Muse Glimmer 30B faster on M5 Max via Metal kernels
Bignesh14/glimmer-m5-selftune.readme_summary: Measures Muse Glimmer 30B 4-bit on Mac Studio M5 Max via MLX and adds exact prompt-lookup decoding. Implements H8 sliding-window fix and H9 attention-kernel fix with replicated benchmarks. Reports +17% coding and 1.15x Spec-Bench gains.

yethikrishna/meta-handoff-studio-2026.summary: Checks if proposed agent handoffs fit explicitly declared permission scopes
yethikrishna/meta-handoff-studio-2026.readme_summary: Browser prototype with synthetic invoice scenarios and deterministic scope checks. Uses server-side Cloudflare Workers AI Llama binding for proposals, with mock D1, hashed sessions and tests.

imogikk7/sayso.summary: iOS keyboard that rewrites messages and emails in your personal writing style
imogikk7/sayso.readme_summary: SaySo learns a user's messaging and formal voice per contact using personal LoRA training. It runs in an iOS keyboard with rewrite key, Back Tap screenshot replies, and in-app chat. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer for on-device inference and a server pipeline for training.

Wauguzi/tabibu.summary: AI pathology pre-reads for Kenya with human approval and outbreak alerts.
Wauguzi/tabibu.readme_summary: Tabibu is a Flutter + Firebase app for patients, doctors and pathologists providing AI draft pathology reads that require qualified approval. Aggregates confirmed results for outbreak alerts. Pilot build using Meta, Baseten, Modal and Fireworks models.

Thomas-Jerard/cozzo-canary-caller.summary: Adversarial caller that stress-tests voice agents with difficult scenarios
Thomas-Jerard/cozzo-canary-caller.readme_summary: AI mystery shopper sends difficult callers at voice agents before launch and grades pass-fail in re-runnable grid. Muse Wonder generates adversarial scenarios from business URL. Text transcripts plus browser-voice playback for review.

pauljump/producer.summary: AI session musicians that arrange and play parts under your song
pauljump/producer.readme_summary: Takes unfinished recordings, has AI musicians listen and generate in-time, in-key parts you keep or reject with plain words. Parked Oct 28 2026 to pivot to social story creator. Built during hackathon for Build for Your World theme with ledger and web UI.

aungsan-portfolio/meta-quant-auditor.summary: Synthetic auditor showing why risk checks block trades with evidence comparison
aungsan-portfolio/meta-quant-auditor.readme_summary: Streamlit demo that reconstructs fictional trade timelines and audits quote-gate decisions. Local code validates actions while Muse Spark Open proposes claims for evidence comparison. Includes synthetic cases, tests and provenance docs.

RussCTGL/hiddenlot.summary: Finds surplus steel lots across consenting trade networks
RussCTGL/hiddenlot.readme_summary: Evidence-backed steel sourcing app with map search, quoting, and doc checks. Built with Next.js + Docker/Postgres. Uses Muse Spark with quoted evidence and prompt-injection filtering.

varunchari/homeTwin.summary: Turns room photos into automatable smart-home controls and routines
varunchari/homeTwin.readme_summary: Spatial studio converts a room photo into masked devices via SAM and authors automations with Muse Spark for Home Assistant execution. Dockerized FastAPI backend, frontend, Caddy and HA setup.

arxideon-dotcom/ARHeroes-Spellbook-Demo.summary: Interactive AR spellbook with animated ice magic for fantasy strategy game
arxideon-dotcom/ARHeroes-Spellbook-Demo.readme_summary: Unity demo of a living grimoire on a wooden table with four ice spells as medallions. Book art and spell animations were generated with Meta Muse models, looping on selection with titles and stats.

RohanJosephGeorge/Spatial_Memory_Geogues.summary: Uploads a photo and returns location with step-by-step visual deduction
RohanJosephGeorge/Spatial_Memory_Geogues.readme_summary: ReTracer AI segments photos with SAM 3.1, analyzes spatial cues and reasons to city and coordinates with confidence and deduction trail. Streamlit Python app with backend, face screening and file sanitizer for privacy gates. Uses Muse Wonder for reasoning.

bborel-dev/drawlab.summary: Multi-agent studio that redraws images stroke-by-stroke into named-layer SVG
bborel-dev/drawlab.readme_summary: Drawlab converts raster inputs into clean editable SVG with semantic layer names via five cooperating agents. Frontend plus Python backend for live stroke rendering and text edits. Uses Muse Spark for planning/edits and Muse Image for visual refinement.

The-Nexus-system/blind-creator-preflight.summary: Pre-publish vision check that tells blind creators if a photo or video is post-ready
The-Nexus-system/blind-creator-preflight.readme_summary: Simulated Instagram composer running six checks: framing, crop safety, sharpness, text, impression and privacy. Reports pass/fix/uncertain in screen-reader and braille-readable text. Client-server app with Docker, tests and documented model choices.

suryafk/scenefork.summary: Pauses video to extract objects as physics bodies you can throw and command
suryafk/scenefork.readme_summary: Pauses any clip, segments clicked objects into physical bodies with mass and inpainted background. Converts voice commands like moon gravity into tested simulation programs. Built on Meta Model API with backend/frontend and evals.

arifiarber-sYn/halim-fatura-agent.summary: Agent that proves every action with immutable hash-chained receipts and verification.
arifiarber-sYn/halim-fatura-agent.readme_summary: Halimi turns requests into tool actions and returns a receipt with understanding, tool used, timing and refusals. Receipts are hash-chained with a verification endpoint. Built with Python server plus tests and docs using Meta Model API.

metahackAI/a-commerce.summary: Talk-run online store with approval-based AI back office
metahackAI/a-commerce.readme_summary: A-Commerce is a conversational storefront and back office where owners approve agent work. Rust monorepo with crates, agents and Makefile, live demo Ailism Commerce. Runs on Meta Muse Glimmer 30B open weights on one GPU.

Majki1/BLE-Jarvis.summary: Presence-aware Mac agent that briefs you on arrival and watches while away
Majki1/BLE-Jarvis.readme_summary: BLE-Jarvis uses iPhone as BLE beacon; Mac detects arrival, plays music and speaks calendar, Jira and news brief. Native Mac plus mobile apps with tool-calling agent. Uses Muse Spark Open for briefing composition and ElevenLabs for speech with Apple Music playback.

scoobydoobydrew/meta_ai_hackathon.summary: LLM proposes cell-model fixes, exact solvers verify them for lab testing
scoobydoobydrew/meta_ai_hackathon.readme_summary: Repairs 30-node DNA-damage Boolean model by having Muse Spark propose rules from papers. Verifies with clingo, mpbn and PhysiBoSS simulation, prioritizing hypotheses for labs.

ztdgtll/musez-home.summary: Voice-controlled Raspberry Pi room speaker and ambient wall display
ztdgtll/musez-home.readme_summary: Voice bridge where Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 streaming with function calls turns speech into spoken answers and wall scenes. Raspberry Pi bridge with timed logging in experiments/results. Filmed in-room demo Nov 2.

phantom007xy/photo-authenticity-checker.summary: Checks if a photo is real, AI-generated, or AI-edited and shows where evidence is.
phantom007xy/photo-authenticity-checker.readme_summary: ImageDETECTIVE classifies one photo with calibrated thresholds, face boxes, contribution maps, and investigator step. Built with DINOv3, Perception Encoder, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark. Python app with notebooks, scripts, and deployment configs.

phantom007xy/ImageDETECTIVE.summary: Checks if a photo is real, AI-generated, or AI-edited and shows where evidence is.
phantom007xy/ImageDETECTIVE.readme_summary: ImageDETECTIVE classifies one photo with calibrated thresholds, face boxes, contribution maps, and investigator step. Built with DINOv3, Perception Encoder, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark. Python app with notebooks, scripts, and deployment configs.

Leonitex/hack-the-world.summary: Evidence-driven multimodal agent that diagnoses tech issues via observe-verify loop
Leonitex/hack-the-world.readme_summary: Multimodal troubleshooting agent built around Observe-Hypothesize-Ask-Verify-Recommend loop. Collects symptoms, images and evidence to test hypotheses before recommending fixes. Python diagnostic_core with docs, examples and tests.

msalihk/anyone-hear-me.summary: Disaster agent turning voice notes and posts into deduplicated rescue tasks
msalihk/anyone-hear-me.readme_summary: Earthquake-response agent that transcribes voice notes with Muse Voice Transcribe biased to district place-names. Muse Spark reads Turkish/Arabic messages to extract and deduplicate rescue tasks for coordinators. Dockerized Python service with tests.

quanticomp/living-record.summary: Query owned meeting recordings with computed or gated answers that cite evidence
quanticomp/living-record.readme_summary: Lets owners query recording estates with answers marked Computed, Reasoned, or Refused. Deterministic counts bypass the model; synthesis by Muse goes through a fabrication gate. Built as verifiable RAG alternative for auditable answers.

hearthacker003366/sentinel-v4.summary: AI SOC copilot pairing fast triage with reasoning to defend a simulated lab network
hearthacker003366/sentinel-v4.readme_summary: Sentinel V4 defends a simulated RFC1918 lab where scripted red-team bots attack while Laya triages and Muse Spark reasons. Orchestrator, replay harness and dashboard with human approval. Uses Muse Spark and Laya models.

ta-amps/hackathon-context.summary: Cloneable kit with guides and notes for hackathon teams.

big14way/wireproof.summary: Hands-free copilot that verifies home wiring before walls are plastered
big14way/wireproof.readme_summary: WireProof assists electricians with cable checks, copper verification, and in-wall cable mapping. Web app with panel reader at /panel, probe and relay services, Railway deploy. Uses Meta models for vision inspection and voice copilot guidance.

NoBanks/nightride.summary: Voice-first night dispatcher that guides stranded cyclists and walkers to safety
NoBanks/nightride.readme_summary: Offline-capable PWA with Node server and playbook logic for night breakdowns and safety. Uses Meta AI voice interaction to give one spoken next step with cited sources and test receipts.

QasimAbbas-Finance/commontape-muse-agent.summary: Chat, voice or photo booking agent for local cleaning services
QasimAbbas-Finance/commontape-muse-agent.readme_summary: Parses cleaning jobs, finds local businesses, verifies exact pricing and books slots with transparent tool-call trace. Vercel app with api/lib/fixtures and tests. Powered by Muse via Meta AI for understanding and orchestration.

DenizYunus/athena.summary: Marketplace turning expert repair videos into camera-guided skills
DenizYunus/athena.readme_summary: Muse Spark watches expert repair video plus manual to create checkable steps with safety gates and reference photos. Guides users via phone or Ray-Ban Meta glasses with photo verification.

GoldSpur/ccc-learning-lab-hackathon.summary: Guided homework resilience prototype with safety stops and provenance labels.
GoldSpur/ccc-learning-lab-hackathon.readme_summary: Childhood Confidence Learning Lab runs locally via Node server with no live API calls. Web prototype with recorded Muse Spark 1.3 responses and mocked tests. Enforces provenance labels, fallback presets and parent override.

Iussyan/ExitLab.summary: 3D tabletop evacuation simulator for stress-testing building disruptions.
Iussyan/ExitLab.readme_summary: ExitLab is a React Three Fiber and Vite app with Express server for evacuation simulation. Renders architectural scenes and runs disruption scenarios. Uses TypeScript, Tailwind and Vitest with AI-assisted stress testing.

krishsah01/blackbox.summary: Local project memory that answers why-chains and as-of questions with citations.
krishsah01/blackbox.readme_summary: Blackbox stores decisions, commits, document versions, recordings and agent sessions in SQLite. Node TypeScript CLI answers why and as-of queries with supported labels. Uses retrieval over local project history rather than live model claims.

Taleyvital/DevisVocal.summary: WhatsApp voice-note to professional PDF quote assistant for artisans.
Taleyvital/DevisVocal.readme_summary: DevisVocal converts artisan voice notes into priced PDF quotes via WhatsApp. Built with Next.js, Supabase and TypeScript. Uses Meta Muse models for transcription and quote generation.

bolouvipf/tessercore.summary: Tiny kernel that drafts, verifies and caches WASM modules generated by Muse models
bolouvipf/tessercore.readme_summary: Runtime that loads verified pure-function modules on demand, drafting missing ones via Meta Muse under strict contract. Multi-model verification, WebAssembly sandbox, signing and cache reuse. Built for agents needing safe runtime codegen.

agmonp/muse-life-graph.summary: Turns family photo libraries into searchable graph and auto-cut films
agmonp/muse-life-graph.readme_summary: Ingests 20k photos into reasoned life graph for search and Q&A, then crew of Muse agents writes, cuts and re-cuts personal film. Python app with graph DB, Modal deploy and Windows packaging.

Redaelm47/meta-motion-ads.summary: Finds natural breaks in videos and builds motion bridges into mid-roll ads.
Redaelm47/meta-motion-ads.readme_summary: Analyzes video to find natural ad moments and generates a motion-design bridge with tailored copy. Built solo with Meta models for scene understanding, script writing and self-review of renders.

roeku/wardens.summary: Voice-commanded real-time strategy game with LLM captains and enemy.
roeku/wardens.readme_summary: THE WARDENS is a voice-controlled RTS built in Rust with TypeScript tooling. Local Muse Glimmer converts speech plus fog-of-war context into orders. Enemy broodlord runs as LLM agent with persistent commander history.

frmquant/signaldesk.summary: Daily risk briefing agent that turns market signals into focus list.
frmquant/signaldesk.readme_summary: SignalDesk is a single-page app where traders track signals and get a daily brief. Static HTML frontend with Muse Spark synthesis. Produces risk temperature, movers and watchlist as decision support only.

0xmeowmeow/patchmate.summary: Double-blind introductions through shared questions, not profiles.
0xmeowmeow/patchmate.readme_summary: Patchmate matches people when both mark the same collaborative question, with opt-in sharing. Python backend with deploy scripts and tests. Built for live social field test with consent-off defaults.

jaac1966/yourwine.summary: Glasses app tells you if you will like a wine before you buy it
jaac1966/yourwine.readme_summary: YourWine is an Android companion for smart glasses plus web demo that predicts personal wine taste. API backend with taste profile matching and voice output. Built with Muse Code, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

somossoftgrama/mi-cultivo-me-habla.summary: Spanish-first app that photos a plant and replies as the plant with a voice note
somossoftgrama/mi-cultivo-me-habla.readme_summary: Spanish-first web app where users name a plant and send photos for health checks. Uses SAM 3.1 for streaming leaf/spot segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 to answer as the plant, with ElevenLabs TTS and SQLite journal.

ekumahost/TraceX.summary: AI blockchain forensics that traces crypto flows and builds evidence-backed reports
ekumahost/TraceX.readme_summary: Traces cryptocurrency flows across seven EVM chains with deterministic laundering detectors. Turns on-chain data into briefs and recovery drafts with Muse Spark citing transaction hashes for every claim.

TheKingOfMoney09/Photo-CAD.summary: Converts photos of broken parts into measured editable printable CAD models
TheKingOfMoney09/Photo-CAD.readme_summary: Takes top/side/front photos on a calibration card through segmentation, deterministic OpenCV measurement and parametric CAD to STL/STEP. Plans SAM 3.1 for segmentation. Python app with partforge package and scripts.

deshanFdo/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hacka.summary: Turns floor-plan images into interactive 3D homes you can walk and remodel
deshanFdo/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hacka.readme_summary: BlueprintTo3D extracts walls, doors, rooms and roof as strict JSON with Muse Spark 1.3 and rebuilds in Three.js. Supports editing, first-person walk, SAM 3.1 symbol check, restyle and GLB/DXF export.

QiaoyuYang/questory.summary: Walking mystery game that turns street photos into solvable cases
QiaoyuYang/questory.readme_summary: Questory is a phone-first walk-to-play game where AI agent Wren builds cases from player photos. Built on Meta Model API with Muse and SAM 3.1 for story and vision. Stack is Next.js 16 with mobile play and Meta Glasses support planned.

asub927/meta-ai-hackathon.summary: Planned iPad-first Socratic math app where mascots act out story consequences.
asub927/meta-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: Planning-only repo for an open-source grade-2 math app with hint ladder and on-device progress, no backend. Defines web-first then native SwiftUI iPad build covering NCDPI curriculum. No implementation or Meta model integration yet.

mdmahadyhasanruju-byte/alive-bangladesh-.summary: Evidence-linked coordinator agent prototype for Bangladesh community help tasks
mdmahadyhasanruju-byte/alive-bangladesh-.readme_summary: Startup-track coordinator agent proof of meUus Human OS vision with evidence linking. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 for multilingual coordination. Spec-driven docs cover architecture, API contracts, privacy and i18n.

mgoblimar/Ephemera.summary: Mobile junk-journal planner to arrange scraps digitally before gluing physically
mgoblimar/Ephemera.readme_summary: Flutter mobile app for designing junk-journal compositions on the go. Uses proxy backend for Meta AI calls. Uses SAM 3.1 for cutouts, Muse Spark for planning, Muse Wonder and Muse Image for layout and assets.

lbwrong/escucha.summary: Full-duplex face-to-face translator for 17 languages that listens while speaking
lbwrong/escucha.readme_summary: Live conversation translator defaulting Chinese-Spanish that keeps listening while displaying translations. Uses Soniox for streaming ASR/TTS and Meta Model API muse-spark and muse-voice-transcribe for summaries. Python server with static UI and demo mode.

thecodekaizen/context.summary: Local workstation that reveals what a tech video edit cut out
thecodekaizen/context.readme_summary: Local video evidence workstation aligning published edits to source with dual-player view. Deterministic 4Hz spatial-color aligner plus timestamped Meta AI interpretation. Dockerized backend traces omissions in tutorials and demos.

ndipto/house-planner.summary: Turns plain-word plot briefs into three checked concept floor plans with dimensions
ndipto/house-planner.readme_summary: Muse Spark parses client brief into structured room program, sizes and adjacencies. Deterministic Python placer creates three typology layouts with walls, doors, windows and north arrow. Checks livability rules and area budget.

TheWayOfCoding/TWOC-Studio-Manager.summary: LAN hub that automates studio lights, OBS scenes and backdrops with AI.
TheWayOfCoding/TWOC-Studio-Manager.readme_summary: TWOC Studio Hub controls lights, DMX/BLE fixtures, OBS, and backdrop screens from one LAN UI. Python backend on Raspberry Pi/Windows host with watchdog and health API. Uses Muse for voice-prompted AI lighting looks and scene direction.

Foxcrack/viaguard.summary: Converts street photos into geolocated inspection reports for city teams
Foxcrack/viaguard.readme_summary: Turns phone photos of roads and construction sites into severity-scored civic reports. TypeScript pnpm monorepo with apps and packages. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark via Meta Model API for analysis.

anhafdev/Krishok-Bondhu.summary: Field agent for rice disease segmentation and micro-dosage guidance
anhafdev/Krishok-Bondhu.readme_summary: Krishok-Bondhu helps Bangladeshi smallholders with spatial crop pathology and agronomic reasoning. It uses SAM 3.1 for leaf and lesion segmentation plus Muse Spark 1.3 and Glimmer 30B for IRRI-scale dosing, weather and inventory.

aitrailblazer/atlas7-filing-sentinel.summary: Evaluates SEC filings for signal while grading models against locked answers
aitrailblazer/atlas7-filing-sentinel.readme_summary: ATLAS-7 grades filings for material signal and benchmarks model readers against a frozen key. Built as an eval harness with demo-set, freeze commit and grading cards. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 as reference grading arm.

quartz246/adflank.summary: Reads your website to profile competitor fans and design Meta, TikTok, Google campaigns
quartz246/adflank.readme_summary: Paste a website to find competitors via Qloo taste graph, profile their fans and generate segmented campaigns. Daily run refreshes audiences with cited Qloo calls. Next.js app with Docker, scripts and tests, built for Qloo hackathon.

Atikum-AI/latent-judge.summary: Self-evaluating video generation orchestrator that predicts failure and guides retraining
Atikum-AI/latent-judge.readme_summary: Orchestrator agent that classifies, plans, runs, verifies and reports video generations with per-item measurement and evals. Built on Latent Raw format with LTX-2.5 LoRAs and Meterless H-MEM memory. Adds failure prediction and training guidance during hackathon, with SAM 3 planned.

neehanthreddym/bugcapsule.summary: Turns HAR captures into shareable mock capsules with synthetic data replacing PII
neehanthreddym/bugcapsule.readme_summary: FastAPI backend plus frontend that ingests HAR files, strips auth locally and substitutes consistent synthetic data. Verifies reproduction of API failures against a local mock server. Built for debugging without production accounts or AI keys.

eswargutlapalli/refi_assist.summary: Educational auto-loan refinance comparator with source-verified numbers
eswargutlapalli/refi_assist.readme_summary: Streamlit app compares keep, refinance now, or wait scenarios for auto loans with explicit rate assumptions. Model extracts terms with exact source quotes verified by code before computation. Uses LLM extraction plus deterministic engine, no data stored.

sunwen1983/fixlens.summary: Photo of home fault segmented and diagnosed into repair checklist and draft ticket
sunwen1983/fixlens.readme_summary: Uploads a home fault photo, highlights faulty area with SAM 3.1 segmentation, then diagnoses type, severity and cause. Generates ordered checklist, parts list and DRAFT landlord-tenant ticket. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning with safety-first warnings.

fahad3235/sightguide.summary: Phone-first live vision and audio guidance to help blind users navigate surroundings
fahad3235/sightguide.readme_summary: Captures continuous rear-camera frames for spatial vision analysis and audio navigation cues. Phone-first web app with Node.js server and Netlify serverless deployment. Built for assistive navigation with test-covered codebase.

vovnit/Jig.summary: Prompts turn into native iOS and web mini-apps from declarative specs
vovnit/Jig.readme_summary: Lets users describe small tools; Muse Spark generates declarative spec for screens, schema and actions. Shared JS runtime renders native components on iOS and web with storage and reminders. Includes core runtime, specs and demos.

vumoz/convoplex-retention-agent.summary: WhatsApp win-back agent helping Nigerian shops re-engage quiet customers
vumoz/convoplex-retention-agent.readme_summary: WhatsApp retention agent for Nigerian retailers to send naira-priced offers. Customers reply by text or voice note in their language. Built with Muse Spark for text, Muse Image for pictures and voice transcription.

silambarasan-sh/kadai-khata.summary: Tanglish voice and photo ledger that digitizes small-shop udhaar credit
silambarasan-sh/kadai-khata.readme_summary: Kadai Khata helps Tamil Nadu kirana stores track credit via Tanglish text, voice and notebook photos. Digitizes shorthand khata entries to a searchable ledger. Django app deployed on Render with live demo.

BU1lDR/ArthNiti.summary: Hyper-local loan and business planning for rural entrepreneurs in 8 languages
BU1lDR/ArthNiti.readme_summary: ArthNiti asks 19 plain questions on cheap Android phones and returns profitability, loan risk and rule-verified plan. Rule engine computes figures, optional voice intake, Meta Muse generates the written plan. Stack spans backend, frontend and data sources.

Mariavmyers/linguacheck.summary: Audits if Meta models give the same facts in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
Mariavmyers/linguacheck.readme_summary: Asks same medical, legal and finance questions in two languages, compares answers and flags factual drift. Gradio app with audit, judge and reporting pipeline. Uses Meta AI models as systems under test for cross-lingual evaluation.

samirrhashimov/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Web app with frontend and backend built for hackathon.

ashrafi/MetaMuse.summary: Bio-responsive Android companion linking health, calendar and finance data
ashrafi/MetaMuse.readme_summary: LifeSOS Android app connects Health Connect, calendar, outflows and social ties into an empathetic companion. Jetpack Compose UI powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with prompt-level safety guidance.

Demperor20/naija-ai-team.summary: WhatsApp AI team handling books, pricing, flyers and paperwork with approval
Demperor20/naija-ai-team.readme_summary: Small sellers chat on WhatsApp while agents draft accounting, pricing, marketing and documents, waiting for approval. Built with Next.js, Supabase, Twilio Sandbox. Uses Meta Muse models for multi-agent team orchestration and WhatsApp replies.

starlord20/bucketwise.summary: Turns bank CSVs and Gmail into 3-bucket household plan with shock tests
starlord20/bucketwise.readme_summary: Bucketwise parses transactions into Emergency, College and Life Event buckets with crisis testing. Built with Next.js app router and CSV/Gmail ingestion. Uses Meta AI models to find leaks and recommend actions.

labaccessnow/pausebird.summary: Detects scam texts and fake checks to protect older parents and alerts family
labaccessnow/pausebird.readme_summary: Scam Shield reads screenshots and transcribes voicemails, checks links safely and scores scam risk in Korean and English. Check verification compares images to history. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe, with Android app and Python backend.

mkhan48-debug/protocolsmith-meta-hackath.summary: Discovers API version differences and builds a verified compatibility bridge
mkhan48-debug/protocolsmith-meta-hackath.readme_summary: Active API-archaeology agent that probes v1 vs v2 APIs to find behavioral breaks and compiles a constrained bridge. Python stack with src/templates/scripts/tests and CI. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for analysis and bridge synthesis.

Erlansoo/Lunes.summary: Spanish-speaking bench assistant that diagnoses faulty circuit boards.
Erlansoo/Lunes.readme_summary: Lunes combines USB microscope vision, instrument readings, and circuit simulation to guide probing. Python stack with firmware tools, local open-weights, and offline support. Uses Muse Glimmer for vision reasoning and measurement planning.

bigse0u1/ReActSim.summary: Closed-loop robot agent that imagines, acts, and replans after failures
bigse0u1/ReActSim.readme_summary: Franka Panda in ManiSkill 3 uses SAM 3.1 for detection and Muse Spark for skill planning on YCB objects. Detects disturbances like knocked objects from physics state and replans. Evaluated with 120 runs and Fisher exact tests.

alonsinhoiu/faro-rayosx-meta-hackathon-2.summary: Audits rental listings with vision and voice to protect tenants
alonsinhoiu/faro-rayosx-meta-hackathon-2.readme_summary: Multimodal forensic auditor for Chilean rentals that combines SAM 3.1 segmentation, voice transcription, and Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning with a TypeScript verification engine and contradiction graph for listing analysis.

fandomgames/crop-scout.summary: Quest 3 grow HUD that scans microgreen trays and tracks health.
fandomgames/crop-scout.readme_summary: Crop Scout is a Meta Quest 3 passthrough HUD assistant for microgreens growers. It scans trays with headset cameras using SAM 3.1 segmentation and Muse Spark via Meta Model API. Room and DataStore provide shared tray storage and history.

Mukeshreddy3/phantom-inventory-hunter.summary: Explains ERP vs WMS inventory gaps and queues fixes for approval
Mukeshreddy3/phantom-inventory-hunter.readme_summary: Long-running agent for food manufacturing that reconciles synthetic ERP and WMS records, investigates drift causes, proposes fixes, and holds them in human approval queue. Dashboard demo with Python backend.

Anthony-Sin/inkbench.summary: Turns plain words into CAD parts with real geometry checks
Anthony-Sin/inkbench.readme_summary: Agentic CAD that drafts parametric specs with muse-spark-1.3, builds geometry in isometric viewport, then verifies collision, stability, assembly order and clearance with real math, iterating on failure.

Mvdodiya001/Meta-global-ai-developer-hac.summary: Version-aware engine that re-checks legal findings when cited law versions change.
Mvdodiya001/Meta-global-ai-developer-hac.readme_summary: ClauseTrace builds a dependency graph of clauses to DPDP Act provisions and re-checks only affected conclusions. Demo covers a fictional data-processing agreement. Uses Muse models for clause review with source-version tracking.

Esteban9427/climapp-lite.summary: Daily heavy-rain forecast for Rio Pance with citizen photo and text confirmations
Esteban9427/climapp-lite.readme_summary: Publishes daily probability of 20mm+ rain and 3-day landslide signal for Cali, Colombia. Citizens submit text/photo reports structured by Muse Spark with plain-language explanations. Python stack with verifiable code-based trust scoring, not model-judged.

belleflykids/bellefly-kids-story-builder.summary: Parent-led bedtime story generator with characters, themes and age bands
belleflykids/bellefly-kids-story-builder.readme_summary: Static web app where parents pick character, theme and age to preview read-aloud stories. Built with HTML and AI agent folder, using Meta AI for age-adapted short tales with audio readout.

rankallstartup-cell/rankall-video-report.summary: Turns an AI-visibility scan into a personalized video report for businesses
rankallstartup-cell/rankall-video-report.readme_summary: Scans a business for AI search visibility then generates a presenter-led video report from real scan numbers with one-click written report. Built with Next.js, app/components/lib structure and e2e tests. Uses Meta AI models for report narration and video generation pipeline.

laxmanshah45/chalk-talk.summary: Animated chalk tutor that narrates lessons and answers speech
laxmanshah45/chalk-talk.readme_summary: Interactive tutor that generates chalk-style visuals per lesson scene with synced narration. Built on Meta Model API with SAM 3.1 for textbook photo tracing, Muse Spark for lessons, voice Q&A and tap-to-find quizzes.

thenguyentrong/skill-translator.summary: Turns a short task video into a robot skill card tested in simulation.
thenguyentrong/skill-translator.readme_summary: Films a task once to generate a skill card describing required outcome. SAM 3.1 tracks objects and Muse Spark writes the card; robots check fit. Validated in MuJoCo simulation with browser demo.

samaranez1/Meta-hackathon-.summary: Vertical space shooter with AI briefings, live difficulty tuning, and spoken coach
samaranez1/Meta-hackathon-.readme_summary: Godot 4.7 5-sector shooter with bosses. Muse Spark via Meta Model API generates briefings, taunts, adaptive AI Director tuning, post-run coach, and Muse Image emblems. Stdlib Python server with same-origin Vercel API, offline fallback.

Johan-de-Beer/vouch-audit-evidence-agent.summary: Audits purchase ledgers against invoices with cropped evidence working papers
Johan-de-Beer/vouch-audit-evidence-agent.readme_summary: Vouch matches ledger samples to invoices, POs and GRNs, linking findings to source crops. Uses stateless Muse Spark calls for extraction and separate verification. Runs offline synthetic demo; live mode needs Meta API key.

seyfelislam/ECHKILI-Meta-Hackathon-2026.summary: Fictional vehicle-cabin diagnostics demo with evidence tracing
seyfelislam/ECHKILI-Meta-Hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Offline-first fictional diagnostics demo showing observation selection, evidence graph, contradiction detection and human review. Three-step judge flow with before/after trace. No real diagnosis or Meta calls in demo.

tang-vu/liveworld.summary: Tabletop studio that turns objects into playable logistics games and tests fixes
tang-vu/liveworld.readme_summary: LiveWorld converts tabletop objects and design intent into a playable logistics game, simulates outcomes, and measures repairs. Includes Kept checkout experiment for visual contrast checks. Uses Muse Spark for rules reasoning and SAM for object segmentation.

wildanlsfs/traction-radar.summary: Finds first-user channels and runs measurable growth experiments that learn
wildanlsfs/traction-radar.readme_summary: Agent analyzes a product, proposes traction channels, runs small Threads and web experiments, and banks outcomes. TypeScript + web frontend with serverless backend and live read-only demo. Uses Meta AI to plan experiments and judge needs-more-data.

LouisLanganay/fynex-copilot.summary: Explains what changed in your stocks with links to source passages
LouisLanganay/fynex-copilot.readme_summary: Fynex Copilot ingests portfolio CSV then fetches SEC EDGAR, AMF and earnings call transcripts. Built with Next.js and Meta Model API integration. Uses Muse Spark to summarize changes and Muse Voice Transcribe for calls.

coder-RT/recall.summary: Voice assistant that maps rooms in 3D to find misplaced items.
coder-RT/recall.readme_summary: Voice-first 3D home memory built for blind users: scan once with iPhone LiDAR, then ask where items are. Uses MapAnything for mapping, SAM 3.1 for object finding, Muse Voice Transcribe plus Muse Spark Open for QA.

abyaz16/spatialsight.summary: Compiles fixed-camera video into SQL tables queryable in plain English
abyaz16/spatialsight.readme_summary: SpatialSight segments long video with SAM 3.1, resolves stable entities, logs zone entries to SQL, and answers English questions with SQL and frame jumps. Python pipeline with web UI. Uses SAM 3.1 parser and Muse models, with offline fixture mode.

youcefbedrani/meta-ai-developer-cerebral.summary: Founder platform taking ideas from discovery to validation and launch plan
youcefbedrani/meta-ai-developer-cerebral.readme_summary: Startum AI SaaS platform with Discover, Research, Validate, Plan flow on shared project data. Uses Validation Autopilot agent, voice interviews and pitches, plus Muse Image + SAM 3.1 brand visuals.

rrhoopes3/causeway.summary: Tags where each agent action value came from for phone approval
rrhoopes3/causeway.readme_summary: Deterministic provenance tracker with no model that labels each value in Muse-proposed tool calls. Mobile approve/deny UI surfaces when values come from untrusted reads. Tested with Muse Spark 1.3.

FAHMYZAR/dapurstudio.summary: Turns messy kitchen food photos into catalog photos with cost and caption
FAHMYZAR/dapurstudio.readme_summary: Uploads dish photo, SAM 3.1 segments plated food with parallel prompts, generates clean catalog image plus ingredient cost estimate and sales caption. End-to-end flow for small sellers with human review before save.

cabetan/camtoshop.summary: Turns WhatsApp product photos into ready-to-publish Reels and shop posts
cabetan/camtoshop.readme_summary: Merchant sends 1-8 photos or voice note via WhatsApp, agent returns Reel with Publish/Change/Discard to post to Instagram. Portal links Instagram, Facebook Page and Shopify. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

SaintSinC/pocket-muse.summary: Pocket voice gadget that answers aloud with cards and images on display
SaintSinC/pocket-muse.readme_summary: Pocket Muse is a round-display device: press button, speak, get voice plus visuals. Brain service handles weather, gold prices and image generation. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Indie Build for Your World entry.

manueljpconde/meta-ai-developer-hackatho.summary: Voice-updated cash-flow forecast for Portuguese real-estate agents
manueljpconde/meta-ai-developer-hackatho.readme_summary: Agentimo forecasts net commission for independent agents after IVA, IRS and expenses. Agents update deals by talking instead of spreadsheets. Built by PropWare with Meta Muse models for voice and forecasting with web app deployment.

Huskyauto/pause-and-nourish.summary: Voice-first PWA that guides a 30s check-in and 90s pause for eating urges
Huskyauto/pause-and-nourish.readme_summary: Voice-first local-first PWA with Notice->Pause->Choose flow using personalized spoken dialogue. Built with Next.js PWA stack and Meta Model API for live response generation. Uses Muse Spark/Wonder for conversation and Muse Voice/Image plus SAM 3.1 per modalities doc.

TurabDevs/localdub.summary: Hindi-Urdu to English video dubbing with cloned voices and preserved audio
TurabDevs/localdub.readme_summary: Offline Python pipeline that dubs Hindi/Urdu video to English. Stages for ASR, translation, voice cloning and Demucs audio separation. Runs on Meta open-weight models including Muse Glimmer and Omnilingual ASR.

gws-builds/show-me-the-problem.summary: Live video repair call that outlines parts, prices jobs, and books visits
gws-builds/show-me-the-problem.readme_summary: Homeowner points phone at fault while agent grounds parts, asks pricing question, quotes from owner price list, and requests approval-gated booking. Agent loop with tools, SAM grounding and voice relay; uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe.

abuz8studios-ship-it/showfront.summary: Turns car photos into 360 spin, 3D walkaround, video ad, and ready listing
abuz8studios-ship-it/showfront.readme_summary: Showfront is a Windows desktop app that converts walk-around photos into 360 spin, Gaussian-splat 3D, commercial video and listing. Built with SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark running locally.

Chaitya02/dex-ai.summary: Splits group restaurant bills item-by-item from photo and voice
Chaitya02/dex-ai.readme_summary: Dex reads receipt photos for items, tax, tip and totals and checks math. Users state who had what by voice or text for exact to-the-cent splits saved to an expense log. Built in Python on Meta models with receipt OCR and agentic splitting.

Mashrokit-AI/offer-guard.summary: Agent that checks ad promises against approved offer and landing page, then repairs
Mashrokit-AI/offer-guard.readme_summary: Offer Guard validates every ad claim against the approved offer and landing page. Uses Meta Muse models for checking and safe repair workflow, built with TypeScript, tests and fixtures.

tugrulNet/xanthos-residential-ai.summary: Enter a Calgary address to see a livability score explained plus listing photo checks.
tugrulNet/xanthos-residential-ai.readme_summary: Calgary home-buyer flow showing a read-only residential livability and investment score. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for plain-language explanations and Python plus SAM 3.1 for listing photo triage and segmentation.

mrfentmen/meta-os.summary: Rust kernel plus agent platform with watch floor, lab, and budget guardrails
mrfentmen/meta-os.readme_summary: Meta OS combines a from-scratch Rust kernel that boots in QEMU with an agent platform for monitoring and building. The platform runs daily with real model calls, records, and budget controls. It uses Meta models for agent tasks across its watch floor and workshop.

seegongsik/whats-ahead.summary: One street photo shows the next 5km of places, landmarks and signs on map
seegongsik/whats-ahead.readme_summary: What's Ahead maps a street photo to the next 5km using Overture Maps. Muse Spark Open names visitor-known landmarks, SAM 3.1 finds signs in the photo and projects them onto the map. Web app with camera and map fly-through deployed on Vercel.

imhcode/harga-tetangga.summary: Android app reads grocery receipts to compare store prices and plan cash
imhcode/harga-tetangga.readme_summary: Android app for Indonesian households that reads receipt photos and remembers prices per store. Answers cash-to-bring and cheapest-store for a list, then compares plan vs receipt. Built solo on Meta Model API with Indonesian PRD and field tests.

Mishallic/Afterimage.summary: Painting videos become the artwork's replayable visual memory
Mishallic/Afterimage.readme_summary: Piece of Mind aligns painting-session frames to remove the painter and let viewers replay creation or tap strokes. Python pipeline with samples, scripts, tests and eval; no generative pixels. Uses Meta vision and language models only to locate the painter.

dkssudgo112/coevo-meta-hackathon.summary: Phone coach that watches your screen and asks one question when you are stuck
dkssudgo112/coevo-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Caddie observes work from phone while user stays in usual AI tool and nudges only when stuck. Leaves minimal lessons and practice scenes with session replays. Cloudflare Workers app with demo, practice-preview and sample flows.

newmachinesph/hoopscliniq-demo.summary: Phone basketball video turned into tagged plays with citations
newmachinesph/hoopscliniq-demo.readme_summary: Next.js web app proxying to FastAPI backend hoopscliniq-ai. Core loop Record Tag Ask Study with consent-based player hiding. Uses SAM 3.1 for player detection and Muse models for tagging and Q&A.

lechador/nodesnap.summary: Chat-driven home design workspace with traceable 3D model and review exports
lechador/nodesnap.readme_summary: Homeowner workspace built around an authoritative Python building model with studio, walls, stairs and dimensioned plans. FastAPI + Next.js with SQLite/Postgres and Docker Compose deploy. Uses Meta AI for conversational edits and revision-specific review drafts.

trivnvdev-41/SEO-UGC-Meta-Hackathon-2026.summary: Turns creator video uploads into SEO articles with embeds and forum discussion
trivnvdev-41/SEO-UGC-Meta-Hackathon-2026.readme_summary: SABA converts direct video uploads into SEO-ready articles with JSON-LD schema and official embeds. Stack is Flutter forum app, Next.js SSR/ISR web site, and workers for transcoding. Uses Meta AI models for transcription and article generation.

KhalidBakroun/nara-application-agent.summary: Arabic-first agent turning answers and certificate photos into university application packs
KhalidBakroun/nara-application-agent.readme_summary: Turns student answers and certificate photos into a checkable university application pack for counsellor review. Built with Next.js, Meta models for Arabic extraction and eligibility checks. Live product with class mode and fictional demo data.

satojandro/meta-hackathon.summary: Neuron atlas mapping Muse Glimmer identity neurons into tunable persona dials
satojandro/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Exploratory project that probes Muse Glimmer 30B open weights to find persona-related neurons. Python with PyTorch MPS/CUDA, uv, and scripted evals. Uses Muse Spark agent for analysis and a mixer UI instead of prompting.

hadxits/frontierbase-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns support FAQs into tested voice menus that staff can review and repair
hadxits/frontierbase-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: FrontierBase ARS converts spreadsheets and policy FAQs into voice menus, checks routes and repairs drafts before staff review. Stack is Vue 3 console, Vite widget, Node.js 22 and Firebase, using Meta Muse Spark 1.3 and ElevenLabs for voice.

lightgo-la/symphony-meta2026-agent.summary: Rust-native canvas to run and compare 12+ AI prompt pipelines side by side
lightgo-la/symphony-meta2026-agent.readme_summary: Native Rust egui/eframe no-code canvas for orchestrating multi-step prompt pipelines concurrently. Invokes Meta muse-spark-1.3 with non-blocking async execution and live progress. Ships as Windows executable with Cargo build.

newmachinesph/hoopscliniq-ai.summary: Tracks basketball film and answers coaching questions with cited video claims
newmachinesph/hoopscliniq-ai.readme_summary: FastAPI backend on Modal that ingests phone video of a possession and outputs tracked players plus play names. Proxies to a Next.js frontend with offline fallback. Uses SAM 3.1 for player/ball tracking and Muse Spark for play naming and cited Q&A.

rajkumar-prog/who-judges-the-judge.summary: Benchmarks AI code judges against an adaptive cheater with hidden tests
rajkumar-prog/who-judges-the-judge.readme_summary: Pits an AI judge against a cheater agent that hardcodes tests and adapts to feedback. Uses real-library seeds, patches, and hidden tests as ground truth with a dashboard. Python/pytest harness built during hackathon to probe judge blind spots.

georgethetaco44-bit/Pulsar-VST.summary: Text-to-sound synth plugin that generates and hot-swaps DSP code live
georgethetaco44-bit/Pulsar-VST.readme_summary: AI-native VST3 synth that turns English prompts into per-sample DSP code, compiles to native instructions and hot-swaps it. Built in C++ with JUCE/CMake for Windows/macOS/Linux. Uses Meta API for code generation with offline safety and stress testing.

JuanMontreuil08/confio.summary: Push-to-talk gadget giving older adults voice access to AI help
JuanMontreuil08/confio.readme_summary: ESP32 push-to-talk device plus web backend letting seniors ask questions, call family, take/share photos via SMS in own language. ESP32 firmware, prompts, scripts and deploy tooling for digital inclusion.

ngweibin050-dev/aether.summary: Converts old 2D machine drawings into editable 3D CAD and holograms
ngweibin050-dev/aether.readme_summary: Workbench reconstructs interactive 3D CAD assemblies from patent figures and sketches. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, Image and SAM 3.1 with wave-optics simulation for holographic displays.

Cengkudu800mdpl/catat-panen-ai-2026.summary: Log farm harvests in Banyumas by voice in Indonesian or Javanese plus crop photos.
Cengkudu800mdpl/catat-panen-ai-2026.readme_summary: Simple app for Banyumas farmers to record harvests via voice and auto-detect crop photos with daily recaps. Built with Next.js and WhatsApp API using Meta Llama 4 for Indonesian and Banyumasan language input.

jacob222222/welcome-fillseats-ai.summary: Multilingual night-time enrollment agent to fill empty childcare seats.
jacob222222/welcome-fillseats-ai.readme_summary: Agent workflow for Minnesota childcare providers handling after-hours inquiries, tour booking and enrollment forms. Built with Next.js using Muse Code, with Somali and Spanish support and privacy-safe flyer flow.

waleedmustafa971/forge-0-hackathon.summary: Verification layer that proves AI code fixes in sandbox before any PR

wd809/noa-guardian.summary: Smart-glasses safety assistant with official alerts, legal answers and vision awareness
wd809/noa-guardian.readme_summary: NOA Guardian provides official-source alerts from NWS, USGS and NASA EONET with verified all-clear logic. dl88jing/seefix.summary: Camera-first repair copilot that identifies parts and verifies each fix step.
dl88jing/seefix.readme_summary: Next.js app where users photograph a fixture to get model ID, overlaid next steps and safety checks. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for visual identification on /lab, Modal backend, narrated Playwright demo.

MoriaCrew/Pinned.summary: Friends pin cut-out objects on shared board and remix into new scenes
MoriaCrew/Pinned.readme_summary: Pinneds lets friends share photos on a board, cuts out objects, and remixes pins into credited scenes. Firebase App Hosting web app. Uses Meta Model API: Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image, Muse Voice Transcribe.

arimilgram-create/unboring.summary: Browser AI video editor that auto-plans cuts, captions, and motion graphics

rightaboutnothing/handoff-meta-hackathon.summary: Local-first app that analyzes private files locally before ever calling cloud AI
rightaboutnothing/handoff-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Handoff is a local-first Windows app where local Llama analyzes files behind Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard 2 and PII masking. Only masked text can reach Muse Spark, blocking prompt injections hidden in business files. Includes pre-registered Meta vs Google local-cloud evaluation.

Quantumhurst/visual-vocal-builder.summary: Hands-free voice app to form a fictional company and build a colony world
Quantumhurst/visual-vocal-builder.readme_summary: Next.js app with unified Next and ASR WebSocket server where spoken commands select base, name company, split equity and raise structures. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark and Voice Transcribe for dialogue and speech-to-text; demo data only, no real filing.

AIVONIC/second-hand.summary: Hands-free glasses coworker for technicians that sees parts and drafts reports
AIVONIC/second-hand.readme_summary: Second Hand streams Ray-Ban Meta camera via Wearables Device Access Toolkit to Android plus server backend. Answers hands-free, segments parts, and enforces safety. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for part segmentation.

jd-chiles/meta-inspector.summary: Guides housing navigators through unit walkthroughs with AI-assisted documentation.
jd-chiles/meta-inspector.readme_summary: Walkthrough Kit is a mobile-first prototype for staged housing-unit walkthroughs, organizing video evidence into inspection packets. It assists case managers while leaving decisions to humans. Uses Meta AI companion with video-grounded suggestions.

felixbennet/before-the-tape.summary: Packing-bench camera that verifies parcel contents against barcode scans
felixbennet/before-the-tape.readme_summary: BeforeTheTape watches bench clips to reconcile packed items with scans and writes custody receipts for disputes. SAM 3.1 tracks parcel/items, Muse Spark 1.3 matches catalogue photos, code decides verdict. Runs on recorded clips and live.

AntonNovozhilov-roof/hotelapp-liveops.summary: Hotel ops app routing guest voice requests to staff tasks with photo checks
AntonNovozhilov-roof/hotelapp-liveops.readme_summary: Readybell unifies guests, staff, rooms and reports in one Next.js app. Guest chat/voice becomes routed tasks, staff prove work with AI photo check, owners get daily briefs. Built for hotel live operations.

jerrydjin/backtothefuture.summary: Simulated shared road record where cars propose and confirm edits
jerrydjin/backtothefuture.readme_summary: Rust simulation for AVs sharing a live road record using commit, review, and merge semantics. Road edits merge only after second-car confirmation, spoofed edits rejected in scored gates. Defines protocol spec with scenarios and recordings.

MHSantonu/spatialshelf.summary: Turns a 10-second shelf video into a WhatsApp shop with voice and photo ordering.
MHSantonu/spatialshelf.readme_summary: SpatialShelf converts a phone video of a shop shelf into a catalog orderable via WhatsApp text, handwritten photo or Bangla/English voice note. Includes stock decrement and picking route. Merchant web app plus worker pipeline.

bgSunil/share-and-earn-ai.summary: WhatsApp referral layer that rewards trusted friend-to-friend recommendations.
bgSunil/share-and-earn-ai.readme_summary: Share & Earn AI adds AI features to Share & Earn Lite, a QR-based rating and named-friend referral system for local shops. Stack is React TypeScript with Firebase Firestore and Cloud Functions. Planned Meta AI use for review insights, fraud-safe recommendations and owner feedback.

Rexangels/ForgeBot.summary: Designs robot hardware and firmware from a sketch via simulation and CAD.
Rexangels/ForgeBot.readme_summary: Closed-loop Vision-to-Hardware studio using Muse Wonder 1.0, Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1 to reason over assemblies. Django backend, React Three.js frontend, MuJoCo physics and FreeCAD generation.

Blackleets/la-asistenta.summary: AI WhatsApp operator and booking platform for beauty salons with photo brow analysis
Blackleets/la-asistenta.readme_summary: Modular booking and commerce platform piloted at Ari Vivas Beauty in Madrid. Mobile web plus WhatsApp Hermes operator with real agenda, price list and AI brow photo analysis. Owner dashboard with funnel and waitlist.

MNKCrypto/watchmate.summary: Personal highlight reels cut from long livestreams for each viewer
MNKCrypto/watchmate.readme_summary: WatchMate watches full video with picture and sound via Muse Spark, matches moments to user preferences from text or voice. Cuts personal reels, self-checks edits, and delivers via bot and control UI.

Harsh-Gohel5/GhostTab.summary: Turns meetings and docs into cited task briefs that flag source changes.
Harsh-Gohel5/GhostTab.readme_summary: GhostTab builds workspaces from Calendar and Docs evidence with cited briefs, questions and drafts. Monorepo with Alembic backend and workspace review flow. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for brief generation and change detection.

RAWCoder123/groundwork-meta-hackathon.summary: Coordination workspace that links city review comments to drawings, owners and answers.
RAWCoder123/groundwork-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Source-linked workspace called Schema for commercial construction teams to manage review letters and revisions. Keeps original wording, files, owners and review status in one saved record. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to draft intake and coordination work for human approval.

kimdooo-a/callreader.summary: Grant-call reader that answers only with quotable clauses and verified citations
kimdooo-a/callreader.readme_summary: CallReader fetches pages and attachments, sniffs bytes to avoid silent unread-as-absent errors. Uses Muse Spark vision transcription and extraction with a citation verifier that abstains without quotes. Enforces invariants for AI rules and eligibility.

andrewliang13/handoff.summary: Turns leader exit interviews into cited day-one playbooks successors can query
andrewliang13/handoff.readme_summary: Handoff converts voice/text exit interviews into a claim-cited playbook using transcript turns. Built with Next.js with sample Northline Labs fixtures and no API call for demo load. Uses Meta API to generate playbook and abstain on uncovered topics.

manwithaneuralnetwork/dyad-meta-ai-hacka.summary: Social app that forms small groups to meet at real San Diego events.
manwithaneuralnetwork/dyad-meta-ai-hacka.readme_summary: Dyad is a Next.js Supabase PWA with onboarding, event catalog, matchmaking, invites and realtime chat. Deployed on Netlify with Playwright tests. Uses Muse to enrich events, match interests, and reconcile compatible group sizes.

duneon97/evidence-gated-repair.summary: Python repair agent that proves fixes with frozen tests and evidence
duneon97/evidence-gated-repair.readme_summary: Generates regression test before patching, freezes with SHA-256, reproduces failure and validates via subprocess pytest. Blocks test editing as fix. Uses deterministic mock models with real test runs for offline demo.

yhyh4420/saferoute.summary: Offline Android app giving hazard-aware evacuation directions in under a second
yhyh4420/saferoute.readme_summary: SafeRoute provides offline hazard-aware evacuation guidance for Android with no network. Routes depend on hazard type, e.g. earthquake to open space, flood away from underground. Built for Meta hackathon Build for Your World.

danielmedinac22/amanece-meta-hackathon.summary: Conversational builder that creates 24/7 WhatsApp agents for Latin American businesses
danielmedinac22/amanece-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Amanece lets owners chat to build WhatsApp customer agents with rules, sections and metrics. Stack is Next.js + Drizzle + Neon with Kapso WhatsApp integration. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Models API as owner and customer agents.

dylanHulin/multimodal-game-architect.summary: Agentic pipeline that turns one game idea into design doc, code, art and music.
dylanHulin/multimodal-game-architect.readme_summary: GDD Builder runs specialized agents for GDD, code, art, review and music with RAWG/IGDB/Steam grounding. Backend plus frontend with auditable outputs and fallbacks. Uses Meta AI models for generation and review in live demo path.

arnavjhajharia/meta-ai-hackathon.summary: Hackathon prototype with minimal metadata using Meta models.

mtri0407/mesocycle.summary: Voice-first planner that rebuilds your week around sleep, health and people.
mtri0407/mesocycle.readme_summary: Describe what broke and Mesocycle replans sleep, people and health priorities via chat and voice. Cloudflare Workers app with docs and evals for architecture. Uses Meta AI voice and LLM via Call AI for conversational week setup and recovery planning.

idrissa-gif/ObjectJEPA.summary: Predicts object motion in latent space to answer what-if physics questions on video.
