LincForge/nerve-muse-sam.summary: Gives Muse hands and eyes on phones and watches via MCP with bench tests
LincForge/nerve-muse-sam.readme_summary: Provides physical-device control of Android, Wear OS and iOS simulators via MCP linc-nerve server. Evaluated under pre-registered confinement on mobile-agent-bench. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for agency and SAM 3.1 for screen vision.

NextTyrCreator/100proof.summary: Phone walkthrough video turned into priced home inventory with sealed claim file
NextTyrCreator/100proof.readme_summary: Captures 30-second clips in browser, lists items per clip and tallies replacement prices with hashed record, JSON claim and CSV. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image with cost ledger tracking.

AmineYagoub/ittro.summary: Voice-first shopping aid that locates shelf items and verifies labels aloud
AmineYagoub/ittro.readme_summary: Ittro is a voice-first Android app that finds a requested product, guides the hand to it and checks the label. Native Android with modular app and relay components. Uses on-device vision and speech with Meta AI models for guidance.

vijayam1/mythree.summary: Video calls that translate family speech in each speaker's own voice
vijayam1/mythree.readme_summary: Real-time bilingual video calls where Telugu and English are translated while preserving speaker voice. Web app with Modal deployment for mobile Safari and Chrome, built for family calls.

gagashun7/feicai-ai-listing-assistant.summary: Turns room photos into priced selling plans before student move-out dates
gagashun7/feicai-ai-listing-assistant.readme_summary: Move-Out Agent identifies sellable items from room photos and outputs structured listings with deadline-aware pricing. Built during hackathon separate from Feicai codebase. Demo at move-out-agent.vercel.app uses Muse models.

martinmw13/lectoria.summary: E-reader with emotion-matched orchestral music and book companion chat
martinmw13/lectoria.readme_summary: Plays scene-matched orchestral music with rain ambience for 10 public-domain books. Includes images and spoiler-free Ask the book. Built with Meta models for emotion and chat.

lavenhill/baby-bust.summary: Bilingual story game about Taiwan family policy and photo framing
lavenhill/baby-bust.readme_summary: Baby Bust is a short bilingual browser story game where you run social media for a government office and publish only half a photo yearly 2018-2026. Static HTML/JS with Meta Muse models used in development, mobile-friendly with demo video.

seanudeke/Expectrail.summary: Verifies AI bug fixes by replaying gameplay and watching frames
seanudeke/Expectrail.readme_summary: Tests coding-agent fixes by playing the game and recording replays with frame evidence. Harness with Docker, agents, bench and bugs corpus. Uses Muse Code fixes with engine logs plus screenshot review to accept or reject patches.

JaylyDev/ChromaInvert.summary: Recovers a smooth 3D LUT to match footage to a reference grade
JaylyDev/ChromaInvert.readme_summary: Python differentiable color engine that optimizes a 3D LUT and exports portable .cube. C++ host with FFmpeg pipeline for preview and validation. Built with Meta proprietary and open-weights models for grade matching.

Vaydelux/TerraResponseAI_Meta_Hackathon_.summary: Community disaster photo reporting with AI observations plus human verification
Vaydelux/TerraResponseAI_Meta_Hackathon_.readme_summary: Next.js triage prototype where community submits disaster photos for AI-assisted observations and priority scores with human review. Shows report submission, evidence view and sharing flow. Uses Meta AI vision models for preliminary findings, not verified assessments.

tejasai1/Flowtrace.summary: Maps data flows across repos and shows attacker reach from vulnerable services
tejasai1/Flowtrace.readme_summary: Discovers cross-repo data flows with Meta Muse Spark with code evidence, scans images with Grype, and renders an interactive map with AI impact assessments. Stack is Python-based analyzer with YAML config and container scanning pipeline.

MarinaBeguin/PIVOT.summary: Films rooms to build verified 3D layouts for furniture-fit questions
MarinaBeguin/PIVOT.readme_summary: Films a room to rebuild it in 3D, detects objects with SAM 3.1 and answers fit and layout questions via Muse/Llama agent. Every claim is checked by geometric tools for collisions, clearance and paths. Achieved 0/36 false claims vs 15/36 baseline.

KrishVenky/MetaxCerebralValley.summary: Turns scanned P&ID drawings into verified, simulatable connectivity graphs.
KrishVenky/MetaxCerebralValley.readme_summary: Agent pipeline that finds symbols with Meta SAM 3.1 over overlapping tiles, builds connectivity and runs deterministic verifier with re-inspection loop. Flags uncertain parts for human review and enables valve isolation simulation.

Cubiczan/aegis-muse-spark.summary: Three-layer guardrail firewall that filters prompts, tools and model outputs.
Cubiczan/aegis-muse-spark.readme_summary: Aegis enforces policy rules, a safety classifier and a tighten-only LLM judge on every agent prompt, tool call and output. Python service with Vercel dashboard, policy.yaml and hash-chained audit log. Built on Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 with Llama-Guard style prompts.

gokunguru/netops-copilot.summary: Turns network requests into validated configs with dry-run and approval
gokunguru/netops-copilot.readme_summary: Python AI agent converting natural language changes to multi-vendor configs with safety gate, lab dry-run, and human approval. Ships Ansible playbooks, proven rollback, and tamper-evident journal via Muse Spark.

vonnue-akhil/SecondLife-AI.summary: Tells whether to repair, reuse, donate, resell or recycle old electronics.
vonnue-akhil/SecondLife-AI.readme_summary: SecondLife AI accepts photo, voice or text to classify e-waste and guide safe disposal. Client-server app with shared types and docs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 via Meta API.

Zeeohn/kudilens.summary: Turns photos of market sales books and voice notes into verified ledgers
Zeeohn/kudilens.readme_summary: Telegram/WhatsApp bookkeeping agent reads handwritten pages and voice notes in English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo. Models propose entries, code verifies numbers into hash-chained double-entry ledger. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image with one-tap confirm.

SMAJORG/smaj-verified-delegation.summary: Assistant for Pi Hub that proposes store and job actions for approval
SMAJORG/smaj-verified-delegation.readme_summary: Autonomous agent for SMAJ PI HUB to discover products, jobs and entertainment via natural language. Implements Verified Delegation where users approve actions before execution with transparent records. Uses Meta Model API with Next.js frontend and public demo workspace.

LuciferEvil1/neural-lab.summary: On-device 808-param learning brain living in a 3D terrarium with failure memory
LuciferEvil1/neural-lab.readme_summary: Android app runs 24-16-16-8 neural net sensing gravity and prediction error in 3D terrarium. Failures sealed locally as FNV-1a Ghosts with fire-and-forget judging. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for verdicts and blame.

DanielSensual/guestlist.summary: Event video system tracking every guest and building opt-out recaps
DanielSensual/guestlist.readme_summary: SAM 3.1 tracks every person across clips, Muse Spark selects moments and proposes roster matches for human confirm. Consent engine re-cuts recaps around opt-outs. Web app plus GhostCut pipeline for beat-sync cutting and FCPXML export.

caelum0x/menivor-meta-hackathon.summary: Provider adapters wiring Muse Image and SAM into video-ad platform
caelum0x/menivor-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Extraction from Menivor video-ad platform adding Meta Model API routing for script-to-publish pipeline. Python adapters for Muse Image generations/edits and SAM 3.1 segmentation. Uses Muse Image $0.01/image with real test suite.

Hisernberg/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Offline studio archiving elder low-resource language recordings
Hisernberg/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Bhasha records elders to create searchable archive with diarized transcripts, glossaries and cultural cards. Offline-first Next.js PWA with SQLite local storage running self-hosted Muse Glimmer. Community owns data, opt-in export.

zhang-systems/meta-hackathon2026-kg-clai.summary: Verifier checking AI claims against Wikidata triples with cited evidence
zhang-systems/meta-hackathon2026-kg-clai.readme_summary: Takes claims, splits into atomic facts, fetches Wikidata triples and verifies with evidence. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for splitting and first verification, Muse Wonder 1.0 for second review via Meta Model API. Built with Python scripts and tests.

Vaibhav-CD/SmartInk.summary: Infinite canvas notebook with inking, live math, PDF studio and AI research copilot.
Vaibhav-CD/SmartInk.readme_summary: Spatial infinite-canvas notebook with pen smoothing, zoom and minimap, living calculations, and multilingual PDF reading with voice. Built with React Vite Tailwind and powered by Meta multimodal models for research assistance.

Vaibhav-CD/SmartINK.summary: Infinite canvas notebook with inking, live math, PDF studio and AI research copilot.
Vaibhav-CD/SmartINK.readme_summary: Spatial infinite-canvas notebook with pen smoothing, zoom and minimap, living calculations, and multilingual PDF reading with voice. Built with React Vite Tailwind and powered by Meta multimodal models for research assistance.

rahulrao85/parda.summary: Privacy filter that redacts secrets in screen recordings and spoken audio
rahulrao85/parda.readme_summary: Finds private info on screen and in speech, redacts values, bleeps audio and verifies output. Built solo in Python with OCR, speech processing and a verify agent that writes a receipt.

Swayam13-exe/VoltProof.summary: AI operator that plans and verifies solar-battery dispatch from plain-language goals
Swayam13-exe/VoltProof.readme_summary: Natural-language operator for solar+battery sites that plans daily dispatch and validates before execution. Python service with Docker, tests and Hugging Face demo. Built on Muse Spark Open with replay on same-day weather data.

samuelbukumni/unhook.summary: AI assistant that extracts subscription terms from receipts and warns before trials renew.
samuelbukumni/unhook.readme_summary: Paste receipt to extract service, price and billing dates for review and reminders. Next.js app with localStorage and server extract route. Uses Meta Muse Spark model for receipt parsing.

NOOROWAISSI/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Student opportunity discovery and prep app starting with Palestine and global listings
NOOROWAISSI/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: NextStep helps students discover opportunities and prepare applications. Stack is React TypeScript Tailwind frontend, ASP.NET Core backend with MySQL, plus an ai/dotnet client. Uses Meta AI for eligibility checks, evaluation and preparation orchestration.

Safa675/meta-hackathon-project.summary: Chrome companion that notices drift and nudges you back to your task.
Safa675/meta-hackathon-project.readme_summary: MV3 extension Tuck with attention engine, drift budget, event log and on-page overlay. Pure JS engine plus background service worker and memory. Uses Muse LLM nodes for relevance, nudge, profile and tasks.

EmirCobanOfficial/courtsense.summary: Turns tennis training video into player movement data and coaching insights
EmirCobanOfficial/courtsense.readme_summary: CourtSense extracts player trajectories and movement metrics from a coach's training video. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and validation scripts using SAM 3.1 for tracking. It uses SAM 3.1 for player segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for analysis plus Muse Voice and Image.

seegongsik/anchor-orbit-risk.summary: Phone-photo workplace toppling risk assessment with measured fall energy
seegongsik/anchor-orbit-risk.readme_summary: Measures toppling distance and fall energy from one phone photo using gravity sensor and SAM 3.1 segmentation. Muse Spark Open drafts likelihood, severity and controls from tool-call numbers only. Supervisor confirms all grades; checker blocks model-typed numbers.

rajakumaranaap-rgb/makkal-agent-ai.summary: Vernacular multimodal citizen assistant for civic, farm, health, and education tasks
rajakumaranaap-rgb/makkal-agent-ai.readme_summary: SIA / Namma Ooru SuperApp is a WhatsApp and web assistant for rural India covering civic, agriculture, education, and health. Flask app uses Muse Spark/Wonder, SAM 3.1, and Muse Voice for multilingual text, vision, and speech.

phanidileep4/findit.summary: Glasses-linked visual memory to recall where everyday objects were seen
phanidileep4/findit.readme_summary: Planning scaffold for Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 and iPhone object recall. Proposes Meta multimodal model to extract object labels and scene context from intentional captures. No runnable app yet; iPhone storage, search and verification planned.

MichaelGrycz/MetaECU-Copilot.summary: Plans verifiable ECU calibrations with deterministic physics checks
MichaelGrycz/MetaECU-Copilot.readme_summary: MetaECU Copilot reads Bosch EDC16C39 flash and plans calibrations from a 774-symbol catalogue. Python backend with desktop and web apps plus deterministic safety gate where physics rejects unsafe edits. Uses Meta Muse for planning with verifiable execution.

smpark00/seismorescue.summary: Converts scanned seismogram films to miniSEED with human review
smpark00/seismorescue.readme_summary: SeismoRescue digitizes WWSSN seismogram film scans to miniSEED for archival rescue. Muse Spark reads printed borders while fine-tuned SAM 3 traces lines from both ends. Agreed spans export, disagreements go to human review.

Laingo12/kahie.summary: Malagasy voice notes converted to verified shop ledger and credit history
Laingo12/kahie.readme_summary: PWA where shopkeepers speak Malagasy/French notes to build a verified sales and debt ledger. Backend transcribes, extracts entries and compiles credit history for microcredit. Built with Python backend, frontend PWA and eval tests.

chidibede/sitesentinel.summary: Detects PPE violations from live video and verifies fixes with photo proof.
chidibede/sitesentinel.readme_summary: Agentic safety monitor for construction and factories using Ray-Ban glasses or phone video. SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark detect hazards via Lambda API with HUD and dashboard. Adds voice alerts and corrective-action tracking.

SebastianMejia1203/Dalo.summary: Translates between Colombian Sign Language and Spanish with 3D avatar and camera
SebastianMejia1203/Dalo.readme_summary: Dalo bridges LSC and Spanish: text/speech to animated signs via 3D avatar, and camera to Spanish. Uses Muse Spark for intent matching, local vision for 11 signs, web frontend plus backend-meta.

carloux89/governed-agent-bridge.summary: Governed desktop agent bridge with approval queue and audit log
carloux89/governed-agent-bridge.readme_summary: Lets an AI agent work on user PC via Muse Spark JSON plans with read-auto and sensitive-approval classification. Executor runs only allowed actions, records hash-chained audit log with viewer. Synthetic demo data and installer included.

Emmanuel-Onwuka-dev/Quote_Finder.summary: Finds YouTube videos from a half-remembered spoken line via text or voice
Emmanuel-Onwuka-dev/Quote_Finder.readme_summary: Quote Finder turns a fuzzy remembered quote into search queries with Meta Muse models and searches YouTube API titles and descriptions. It ranks verified links with embedded player and lets creators search their own caption archives. Built as a Vite + TypeScript web app.

ilGentEAcutoO/krai-a-beta.summary: AI receptionist that answers unknown Thai calls to screen scams live
ilGentEAcutoO/krai-a-beta.readme_summary: KRAI-A beta answers unknown calls, declares AI screening and triages scams in Thai. Solo Indie entry with Muse Spark, Wonder and Voice pipeline, training arena and measured results at beta.krai-a.com, MIT licensed.

nsirivolu27/try-my-future-meta-hackathon.summary: Personalized campus tour planner for prospective students by major and time
nsirivolu27/try-my-future-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Campus Compass plans personalized campus itineraries from major, interests, time and location across 52 mapped campuses. Stack is Node 22 web app with Docker, data guides, and experimental Android/Meta glasses integration. Uses local Ollama llama3.1:8b for inference with Meta-aligned mobile flow.

vivaxweb/zenvia-product-curation.summary: Fashion discovery engine classifying Gen Z vibes for product curation
vivaxweb/zenvia-product-curation.readme_summary: Zenvia is a production fashion platform at zenviashopping.in with AI pipeline to personalize discovery. Uses open-weights models and vibe classification with Streamlit demo. Includes tagger, app.py, scripts and storefront integration.

paul0610/traductor-meta-hackathon.summary: OS-level Spanish-English interpreter for any video call app on Windows
paul0610/traductor-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Runs beside Meet, Teams, and Zoom via virtual microphone for realtime ES-EN dubbing and subtitles. Stack uses Muse Voice Transcribe for ASR, Muse Spark for translation, and MMS-TTS for voice output in Python.

Jamespino20/helm-agent.summary: Agent API for HELM POS and inventory management system
Jamespino20/helm-agent.readme_summary: Next.js POS/inventory system with a dedicated agent API layer. TypeScript API with Vercel deployment exposing inventory operations to AI agents for the hackathon demo.

trivnvdev-41/voice-meta-ai-hackathon-202.summary: WhatsApp voice sous-chef that saves family recipes and cooks along hands-free
trivnvdev-41/voice-meta-ai-hackathon-202.readme_summary: WhatsApp voice notes transcribed then structured by Meta Llama into recipes with folk-to-metric measures. Docker setup with Asterisk gateway plus worker; calls back to guide cooking step-by-step by voice.

alihassan1437/helpious-hackathon-ai.summary: AI gateway for tradie marketplace with photo quotes, drafts and voice
alihassan1437/helpious-hackathon-ai.readme_summary: Hackathon-built /api/ai gateway adding Snap-to-Quote photo briefs, safety cards, lead briefs, quote drafts and voice. Built for Australian tradie-quote marketplace during Oct 26-Nov 4 window on Meta AI theme Build for Your World.

Kazi16/suite-fleet.summary: Personal agent fleet for mail, leads and notes with cost tracking
Kazi16/suite-fleet.readme_summary: Working fleet on one server triaging mail, scoring leads and checking notes under approval gates. Hackathon rebuild swaps model layer to Meta models to measure cost, latency and verdicts with public dashboard.

Clesic/META-Hackathon---TacitOS.summary: Rehearses a purchasing case so successors learn the missing expert condition
Clesic/META-Hackathon---TacitOS.readme_summary: Missing Monday demo runs a synthetic purchasing case where a successor rehearses and an expert adds the missing condition. Built with Python stdlib server on port 8766 with no dependencies. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via BASETEN_API_KEY when present, otherwise runs offline.

bolouvipf/medelor.summary: Dubbing tool giving each on-screen character its own translated voice
bolouvipf/medelor.readme_summary: Separates speakers in a short clip, translates each character's lines, and synthesizes a distinct voice per character. Built during the hackathon with no pre-existing code. Uses Meta open-weight models via Baseten compared on the same translation task.

CharlesDiovu/moldenovo-ai.summary: Medicinal chemistry copilot that extracts structures and plans optimizations.
CharlesDiovu/moldenovo-ai.readme_summary: Evidence-grounded copilot for early drug discovery with Next.js frontend and RDKit backend. SAM 3.1 segments structures in paper figures and Muse Wonder reads SMILES twice, while RDKit applies and verifies edits.

averagebonsai/hypothesis.summary: Turn-based simulator that tests market decisions before entering a real market
averagebonsai/hypothesis.readme_summary: Hypothesis builds custom turn-based microeconomic simulators for market entry, ads, and operations research. Python/Docker stack curated by Muse Code and powered by Muse Spark 1.3 agents. Users define a turn, the system constructs the simulation.

vmirchev/petsafe-plants.summary: Photo plant identifier that checks pet toxicity against veterinary database
vmirchev/petsafe-plants.readme_summary: PetSafe Plants identifies all plants in a photo and matches them to a curated toxicity reference. Muse Spark proposes identities with uncertainty, SAM 3.1 segments overlapping regions for re-check. Python backend with Docker, web UI, tests and notebooks.

nikocallas/unus.summary: Builds a user-owned health passport from messy PDFs and wearables
nikocallas/unus.readme_summary: Ingests lab PDFs, portal exports and wearable data into one structured passport where every fact cites source, page and line. Built with Next.js, Supabase and fixtures/scripts for parsing. Does not diagnose; it transcribes and aligns records with provenance.

nexusguardus/roadsense.summary: Decides junction priority from a photo checked against Spanish traffic law
nexusguardus/roadsense.readme_summary: Analyzes driver-seat photos in Spain to answer who goes first with verbatim Reglamento General de Circulacion citations. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for structured scene facts and SAM 3.1 for evidence overlays. Marks checked only when rule engine and AI agree.

constellation-works/orbit.summary: Local runtime that runs coding agents in sandboxes with audit logs.

vibhortayal/arya.summary: Grocery assistant that learns habits, maps stores and finds cheaper items
vibhortayal/arya.readme_summary: Arya maintains grocery lists, learns usage from purchases, maps stores and flags out-of-stock or cheaper nearby. Python stack with receipt arithmetic tests and privacy pixelation. Built with Meta Muse models.

denmarkamanodaya/meta-hackathon-nimbytes.summary: AI filesystem that streams zero-byte files and searches footage like text.
denmarkamanodaya/meta-hackathon-nimbytes.readme_summary: nimbytes is a virtual filesystem that plays files as if local with text search over footage plus iGuide and iRead helpers. Built with Rust Axum API, React TypeScript and Tauri desktop. Uses Meta AI models for semantic search and accessibility.

Ewrdad/Kainbain.summary: Kanban-style orchestrator to manage many AI agents with CI-like workflows
Ewrdad/Kainbain.readme_summary: Orchestrates multiple agents using agile and CI concepts with transparent boards. Stack includes Docker and web app with install wizard. Built for Meta hackathon 2026 using Meta AI models for orchestration.

paul8004-lee/besir_global.summary: iOS agent that turns finds in one app into plans in another app
paul8004-lee/besir_global.readme_summary: iOS planning agent between phone apps that connects partner apps via field cards and shared action log. Built with Swift app plus Worker proxy, using Muse Spark reasoning, Spark Open vision and Voice Transcribe.

ta-amps/agora-public-overview-architectu.summary: Shared infrastructure for agents to share work and reuse learned results
ta-amps/agora-public-overview-architectu.readme_summary: Agora holds public decks, evidence, and setup for Teleion Fabric, a durable task queue and storage for AI agents. Eranos marketplace on top directs spare AI capacity to nonprofits. It uses Meta models within Fabric agent workflows.

halo-sw/ithaca.summary: Simulates living 30 days in a home before you sign the lease
halo-sw/ithaca.readme_summary: Pre-living agent that builds household simulations from voice intake and room photos to produce evidence-checked reports. Uses Muse agent planning with vision and voice pipeline, validated by JS/Python tests.

MackentochKelly/koblip-book.summary: One-minute booking pages for local shops with voice owner assistant
MackentochKelly/koblip-book.readme_summary: Koblip Book creates booking pages from Google Maps search with shareable pages and day management by typing or talking. Stack is Next.js, Drizzle, Postgres with English/Spanish support. Uses voice-enabled assistant for owners to manage appointments.

OppaAI/Aidon.summary: Autonomous agent that builds, tests, and reuses its own tools safely
OppaAI/Aidon.readme_summary: Autonomous agent for verifiable goal execution that creates missing skills when blocked, tests them in Modal/Docker sandboxes, and reuses them as graph workflows. Python 3.12 stack with human approval gates for safe execution.

synchronic1/AIPSTER.summary: Deployed web app with control panel and review worker integration
synchronic1/AIPSTER.readme_summary: Live web app at aipster.net with control panel app.js and review workers. Verified production deploys via GitHub Actions. Uses Meta AI per hackathon build, Ubuntu desktop handoff documented.

Kunal-Shahi/shipcube.summary: MCP infrastructure to size, cap, and deploy coding-agent built apps on GCP.
Kunal-Shahi/shipcube.readme_summary: ShipCube is an MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor or Muse Code deploy generated apps. It estimates load, sets spend/rate caps, access control and deploys to Cloud Run or GKE Autopilot. Includes semantic data layer, evals and AI gateway for apps.

Diego-do-na/Exhibit-A.summary: PR security engine that only reports vulnerabilities proven by sandbox exploit tests
Diego-do-na/Exhibit-A.readme_summary: Python security-verification engine for pull requests. Runs baseline, suspect, exploit and fix checks in isolated resource-limited containers. Uses adversary and test-writer workflow to prove findings before reporting, with nothing auto-merging.

drawmeanelephant/content-upgrades.summary: Score-guided loop that upgrades Markdown using Muse and deterministic checks
drawmeanelephant/content-upgrades.readme_summary: Content Upgrades enriches Markdown with callouts, tables and citations via Knap engine. A Zig binary exposes MCP server and CLI, scores renders and keeps only improving model edits. Muse models supply content, templates control structure.

caudillsabastian6-png/card-cauldron-tcg.summary: Trading-card authenticity checker that shows evidence or says unsure
caudillsabastian6-png/card-cauldron-tcg.readme_summary: Static web app that reads structured card crops with Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for authenticity verdicts. Shows evidence UI with demo, bulk and grading modes, preferring Inconclusive over guessing.

athos-agent/athos.summary: Portable local memory that makes any AI agent follow your checklists and rules.
athos-agent/athos.readme_summary: Athos stores criteria, steps and checklists in user-owned files as living agent memory. Any agent loads it without re-explanation, with export as fine-tuning dataset. Uses Muse Spark Open via OpenRouter, self-hostable with local inference.

ta-amps/tessera-infrastructure-work-and-.summary: Work queue and storage engine for coordinating agent swarms

ExtraBinoss/MusArt.summary: Free browser creative studio for images, video, type, 3D and motion design.
ExtraBinoss/MusArt.readme_summary: Melt is an open-source in-browser studio for image, video, type, 3D and motion with local projects. Built as a Bun web app, it focuses on editable design workflows for social feeds.

IgnacioSearles/oqed.summary: LLM superoptimizer that beats clang -O3 on hot x86-64 functions
IgnacioSearles/oqed.readme_summary: Finds hot C/C++ functions, asks Muse for faster assembly, verifies correctness and keeps wins via CC=oqed-cc. Harness with benchmarks, sweeps and web UI. Uses Meta Muse models for assembly generation.

MesilimLLC/Trackdub-Director.summary: Dubbing workbench that verifies timing and translation per line.
MesilimLLC/Trackdub-Director.readme_summary: Dubbing verification workbench with gates for timing, meaning, scene and sign localisation. Records verdict, provenance and token cost per line and frame. Built on Meta Model API as standalone .NET app.

AIOHM/adisaan-hackathon.summary: Collects human and AI answers separately, reviews and publishes them as consented labeled data.
AIOHM/adisaan-hackathon.readme_summary: Open core of tbwim.adisaan.com asking one human question at a time. Laravel PHP app keeps human and agent answers apart for review, synthesis and publishing. Uses Meta Model API under a hard spending cap.

wayneherrington/veevee.summary: Browser voice companion that speaks answers and checks sources before responding
wayneherrington/veevee.readme_summary: PWA companion with no account that answers out loud and cites sources to avoid guessing. Calls Muse Wonder and five other Meta models directly via Meta API with user key.

Parithosh-Varma/snapclaim.summary: Phone photo plus voice to measured claim-ready damage report
Parithosh-Varma/snapclaim.readme_summary: SnapClaim builds an evidence-cited damage report where numbers link to machine-checkable receipts. Backend + CLI + bench with 4-model pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Spark Open and Muse Voice.

srcacahuate619/moldesign-molchat.summary: Tool-driven agent that turns molecule hypotheses into auditable lab notebooks
srcacahuate619/moldesign-molchat.readme_summary: MolChat orchestrates molecular docking and chemistry workflows from prompt to evidence notebook. Includes benchmarks, conformance tests, docs, and Docker setup. Uses Muse Spark Open for planning with auditable stops and reviewable runs.

M4SPIDER/spider-game-engine-open-source-.summary: AI-native 3D game engine where agents code, build and test games on canvas.
M4SPIDER/spider-game-engine-open-source-.readme_summary: Agentic 3D engine and simulation on React Three Fiber and WebGL with MCP server for agents. Adds Meta Llama and Muse hub, collision physics and transpilation to C++20.

sensei-hq/katachi.summary: Snap a sketch to get measured cut-ready designs and laser G-code
sensei-hq/katachi.readme_summary: Katachi is a voice-first workshop buddy that turns phone photos and speech into measured parts, photoreal preview and laser G-code. Built with Supabase and mobile app stack, it uses Meta Muse vision-language and SAM for measuring and tracing.

xAtomizerx/void-terminal-studios.summary: The Pass: recipes and daily prep manager for restaurant kitchens
xAtomizerx/void-terminal-studios.readme_summary: Monorepo portfolio whose hackathon entry is The Pass at thepass.site. Manages recipes and daily kitchen prep. Built with Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, shared Python packages and Cloudflare tunnel deploy.

Tways-study/Basa.summary: Photographs paper clinic charts for dual-AI reading and human verification
Tways-study/Basa.readme_summary: Basa converts photographed paper clinic charts into human-verified digital records with offline capture and review UI. Next.js + Supabase stack with evals and synthetic data only. Uses Meta Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for segmentation and two independent readings.

Rookweld/FieldRook.summary: Local-first Windows workstation for evidence-based field diagnostics and repair
Rookweld/FieldRook.readme_summary: Native Windows diagnostic workstation that guides technicians from symptom to verified evidence. Local-first architecture for real investigations with safety controls. Built open-source by Rookweld for field-kit workflows.

momoikura/The-Polisher.summary: Turns a GitHub issue into a tested pull request verified in an isolated sandbox
momoikura/The-Polisher.readme_summary: ThePolisher is a TypeScript + React 19 app on Cloudflare Pages that takes a GitHub issue, generates a fix, and validates it with pytest in a Modal sandbox. It uses Muse Spark to write/polish code and Muse Wonder as an adversarial reviewer to break it.

ta-amps/seed-packs-library-of-nouns-and-.summary: Library of reusable noun and verb seed packs with tested code for work agents.

samoxis/blinkflow.summary: Voice command loop that fixes robot faults in a simulator and proves the fix
samoxis/blinkflow.readme_summary: BlinkFlow is a say-fix-prove loop for robotics with a digital twin simulator. It takes voice commands, applies fixes, and replays before/after runs with contact metrics. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for language and reasoning.

benjaminkwilliams/beyond-the-five-finger.summary: Three-gate continuity checker for AI-generated frame sequences
benjaminkwilliams/beyond-the-five-finger.readme_summary: Spike testing static validity, transition and spec compliance across frame pairs using named pixel sets. CPU-only Python with numpy, scipy, PIL on synthetic and real cases. Validates consistency across images, not inside one.

octavebahoun/O-jarvis.summary: Ubuntu desktop voice assistant that remembers context and runs controlled actions
octavebahoun/O-jarvis.readme_summary: O-jarvis is a Tauri v2 React desktop app with Python FastAPI engine on 127.0.0.1. It offers chat, voice with wake-word, memory, and desktop actions. Uses Meta Muse models, SAM 3.1 and Meta voices.

Hedgeling/hedgeling-meta-hackathon.summary: Connects app source files to translation context and delivery for global launch.
Hedgeling/hedgeling-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Hedgeling links repository source to translation generation and file delivery for localization. Hackathon work adds Meta-powered agent integration, encrypted replay, and BYOK usage. Node.js workspace with contracts, scripts, and permission-checked actions.

WahahaYes/necronomicon.summary: Pre-commit house rules that teach coding agents repo conventions
WahahaYes/necronomicon.readme_summary: Organizes pre-commit hooks for progressive disclosure: agents see a rule only when they break it, with why and fix guidance. Rust + Python tool with necro --explain, examples and docs. Alternative to stuffing AGENTS.md.

madazz01/meta-betta.summary: VS Code chat companion for Muse Code that remembers you and your project across sessions
madazz01/meta-betta.readme_summary: VS Code extension providing Muse chat panel with persistent brain folder for memory of user and project. Handles Muse and Meta API key setup in-panel and continues work where last session left off. Packaged as VSIX 0.1.0 with sidebar chats and usage view.

Kylrix/kylrix.summary: Zero-knowledge vault and memory so agents never see plaintext secrets
Kylrix/kylrix.readme_summary: Client-side encrypted vault with Argon2id and AES-256-GCM plus sovereign SQLite memory for agents. Local-first, self-hostable with native MCP bridge for Claude Code and Cursor. Open source AGPL with web app and API docs.

prohle/schedulesolve-ai.summary: University timetabling where LLM proposals are CP-SAT verified
prohle/schedulesolve-ai.readme_summary: Generates university timetables with a native C++17 CP-SAT solver beating OR-Tools on 361 sections. FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend and Docker Compose. Uses Muse Spark and Voice for conversational scheduling.

zoukmar/burotu.summary: Fine-tuned LLM reads DNA methylation to find tumor signals in blood
zoukmar/burotu.readme_summary: Burotu fine-tunes open-weight Muse Glimmer 30B with methylation adapter + QLoRA. It detects tumour signals in blood samples and names tissue origin. Ships with live demo, six training runs, open weights and preprint.

aiseed-dev/fieldnotes.summary: Reads farm fields from walk photos into plain-text records at home
aiseed-dev/fieldnotes.readme_summary: Flet phone app plus CLI and MCP server where SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark read field photos and voice into local plain-text records. Built for indie farming with on-home processing. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for notes.

EvilMetaMonkey/doc-meta-hackathon.summary: Recovery loop for coding agents that bisects, fixes and remembers failures
EvilMetaMonkey/doc-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Doc records AI coding agent turns to bisect breaking changes, then plans fixes with Muse Wonder and parallel Muse Code agents. It stores approved lessons for future sessions, driving the pre-existing dmc rollback tool via six Meta models.

anshupriyan/enheduanna.summary: Autonomous author agent inspired by the world's first named writer
anshupriyan/enheduanna.readme_summary: Autonomous agent project named Enheduanna reimagining the ancient author as AI. App-based architecture with config, scripts and memory-vision components. Uses Meta AI models per hackathon setup.

akyourowngames/A.N.K.I.T.A.summary: Local-first desktop and terminal AI teammate with tools, plugins and scheduled jobs.
akyourowngames/A.N.K.I.T.A.readme_summary: Ankita is an Electron desktop app, floating companion, and CLI for file edits, commands, and research. Features plugin/skill system, scheduled tasks, and 4-tier approval gate for tool use. Supports OpenAI-compatible providers including Groq and Copilot.

ta-amps/eranos-public-marketplace-for-pu.summary: Marketplace donating spare AI capacity to build nonprofit agent kits.

JanRaets/global-meta-ai-tempo.summary: Calendar agent that computes real departure times and nudges you to leave on time
JanRaets/global-meta-ai-tempo.readme_summary: .NET system with Tempo.Api, Core, Agent, Jobs and Web plus Google, Maps, Meta and Push integrations. Learns recurring stops and adjusts plans from chat or invite photos. Uses Meta AI for conversational planning.

ta-amps/herma-infrastructure-shim-for-in.summary: Infrastructure shim connecting agents to shared context and models.

xKarimAm/halo.summary: Bilingual Arabic-English Google Meet copilot showing live meeting notes
xKarimAm/halo.readme_summary: Chrome MV3 extension plus Python backend for live Arabic/English meeting capture. Shows key points on speaker tiles. Uses Meta models only for transcription, translation and summarization.

Bhav-ikkk/spectra.summary: Visual referee that verifies AI coding agent UI work with calibrated checks
Bhav-ikkk/spectra.readme_summary: Spectra verifies front-end agent output by comparing before/after screenshots. It combines Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation with pixel NCC matching, calibrated to a 3-sigma noise floor. Exposes a CLI, MCP server, and web workbench with 164 offline tests.

labsbytir/harvy.summary: Tenant-scoped SaaS for source-grounded intelligence, BI, civic events and ops handoffs

degordonstech/mypaddy.summary: Telegram agent that sends reminders, follows up on skipped tasks and keeps goals
degordonstech/mypaddy.readme_summary: Proactive Telegram accountability agent that messages first with reminders and follow-ups via text, voice, photo, video or PDF. Node.js/TypeScript service with proactive scheduling and approval-gated actions. Uses Meta Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe.

EdwinSteve/FieldPilot.summary: Autonomous crop-cycle agent using soil and satellite data with farmer approvals
EdwinSteve/FieldPilot.readme_summary: AI agent that manages a crop cycle from soil sensors and satellite imagery within safe limits. Uses Muse Spark for operational decisions and plain-language explanations, asking farmers before economic actions. Supports live API mode and labeled replay mode.

kuya-kevin/lattice.summary: Mini-DAW that turns hummed voice notes into editable sessions via Muse tool calls.

lsegroup/mnemosyne.summary: Self-hosted team memory that turns GitLab project activity into an updated corporate wiki.

SalChicanoLoco/quetzal-aoi-briefing.summary: Turns live seismic telemetry into mapped areas of interest with AI briefings
SalChicanoLoco/quetzal-aoi-briefing.readme_summary: Takes live seismic telemetry, derives areas of interest polygons, visualizes with SAM, and generates Muse Spark briefings. Separates measured, calculated, and inferred values with sources. Viewer plus GIS pipeline built for testable geophysical analysis.

jcamiloaa/gridxray.summary: AI agents map hidden power-grid wiring by running experiments on a physics simulator
jcamiloaa/gridxray.readme_summary: GridXray reconstructs medium-voltage distribution topology from meter data and switch photos. It uses Muse agents for hypothesis and experiment design with a physics simulator and deterministic checker. Stack includes backend, frontend and docker-compose.

nikylogic/ivibe.summary: Show a bug or dictate and it pastes the prompt with edited screenshots.
nikylogic/ivibe.readme_summary: iVibe is a desktop helper to fix, prompt and dictate bug reports wherever you type. Captures and edits screenshots to attach the right words. Cross-platform releases with TypeScript codebase and AGPL-3.0 license.

scrooksjr/Print3DFlow.summary: 3D-print shop workflow from customer request to quote and printer reservation
scrooksjr/Print3DFlow.readme_summary: Manufacturing assistant for Print3DStore with Muse Spark intake, STL validation, mesh preview and Bambu Studio estimates. FastAPI backend plus frontend with approval-gated job creation and printer failover.

predsymod/memex.summary: Self-hosted shared memory layer for AI agents via MCP server and Supabase
predsymod/memex.readme_summary: Durable context store for preferences, decisions and plans shared across any MCP-compatible agent. Uses self-hosted Supabase backend with HTTP MCP server and incremental sync to avoid re-explaining context.

cristianuibar/learnquiz.summary: Turns real documents into adaptive quizzes for learning and team training.
cristianuibar/learnquiz.readme_summary: Learn Quiz converts SOPs and documents into adaptive quizzes via web app and Android APK. Monorepo with apps and packages using pnpm workspaces. Powered by Meta Muse models for question generation and personalization.

auravibes-apps/auravibes.summary: Flutter chat app for conversations, AI agents and workspace organization
auravibes-apps/auravibes.readme_summary: Cross-platform Flutter monorepo for chat, agents and workspaces with MCP connections. Uses configurable model providers, Melos packages and design system for mobile, desktop and web.

MohamedAfrasDev/living-diagram.summary: Agent tests backend fixes on a simulator and only reports verified metrics
MohamedAfrasDev/living-diagram.readme_summary: LivingDiagrams investigates backend failures like retries and circuit breakers. Next.js app with deterministic simulator engine and API; agent runs controlled experiments. Uses Muse Spark, blocked claims unless engine-recorded.

aeroxy/paper-bro.summary: Turns any arXiv paper into an interactive course with shared build and live progress
aeroxy/paper-bro.readme_summary: Rust axum server serving React Vite SPA with Neon Postgres and SSE progress. Takes arXiv URL, builds a course via Muse Spark Open through OpenAI-compatible llm.rs, with headless Chrome QA.

axiomnetworks/echovision.summary: Browser watcher that monitors camera or screen and speaks when it spots your ask

KryomLabs/kryomcode.summary: Desktop coding workspace linking research, planning, review and verified edits.

ultron513/pit-wall.summary: Local autonomous F1 race strategist that simulates pit stops from timing data
ultron513/pit-wall.readme_summary: Pulls F1 timing data, fits tyre and fuel pace model and searches one and two-stop plans for undercut threats. Planner runs on Muse Glimmer 30B locally via Ollama while hand-written engine does math. Python with tests and scripts.

KanishkNoir/SwitchBoard.summary: Shared control plane to keep parallel AI agents aligned and reviewable
KanishkNoir/SwitchBoard.readme_summary: Switchboard stores user decisions, limits and reviews for assistants to check. Architecture with frontend, harness, integrations and Modal sandbox playground. Supports multiple assistants to stay within bounds when plans change.

Mirai-Climbing/topo-agent.summary: Tap one hold in a gym photo to map the full boulder problem
Mirai-Climbing/topo-agent.readme_summary: Topo agent outlines every hold with SAM 3.1, then a Muse Spark agent inspects, compares and zooms to select holds of the same problem. Solves color-dependence for colorblind climbers and shares to Mirai Climbing app. Python plus mobile client.

ainovo/extbrain-meta.summary: Local organizer that cures AI chat amnesia without traditional RAG
ainovo/extbrain-meta.readme_summary: ExtBrain organizes tens of thousands of chats across AIs to recover decisions and insights. Web app with Docker and Cloud Run, takeout importer. Built with Meta Muse Code, local-first anti-RAG approach.

irull/SablonAI.summary: DTF print shop studio that turns stories into 3D shirt previews

qubitpage/carpathron-muse.summary: Talk to and drive an ESP32 robot via WhatsApp, PC agent and Quest

aauthier2385/dealer-social-ai-hackathon.summary: Memory agent that preserves dealership customer relationships across staff
aauthier2385/dealer-social-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: Relationship-memory agent for car dealerships keeps customer history when salespeople leave. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 with Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image. Includes 172 tests, ruff, gitleaks and CI with live demo.

surucuonur/meta-hackathon.summary: Swarm of Meta AI agents that rewrote vLLM GPU code for 21% faster Mac inference.
surucuonur/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: WeSolve agent swarm optimizes MobileMoE-S on vLLM Apple Silicon from 430 to 519 tokens/s with bit-identical output. Orchestrated via Muse Code with session-log observability and bench harness. Uses Muse Spark agents for code rewriting and verification.

SahinurDEV/PothChol.summary: Bangla sidewalk copilot that segments hazards and drafts ward council reports
SahinurDEV/PothChol.readme_summary: PothChol lets Dhaka pedestrians photo sidewalks for hazard masks and safe-walking guidance in Bangla/English. Built with Next.js calling Meta Responses API for segmentation and planning. Generates formal DNCC/DSCC ward letters.

duschino-source/pocketbench-windows.summary: Windows desktop agent that investigates, fixes, and verifies PC problems
duschino-source/pocketbench-windows.readme_summary: A Windows 11 Electron desktop repair agent powered by Meta Muse Spark. Investigates OS/app issues, researches version-specific fixes, and applies supported operations with verification. Distributed as installer and portable build.

rajagavaskargithub/ASG-AI-SQL-Guard.summary: Guardrail that allows, approves or denies AI-generated SQL before execution
rajagavaskargithub/ASG-AI-SQL-Guard.readme_summary: Parses LLM SQL with sqlglot, enforces single SELECT, allowlist and column policies with LIMIT and audit log. Streamlit demo on DuckDB with red-team corpus. Uses Muse check for query review alongside deterministic rules.

adamspencerbarnett-afk/Muse_Dashboard.summary: Local browser workspace to manage Muse Code chats and approvals
adamspencerbarnett-afk/Muse_Dashboard.readme_summary: Drives installed Muse Code via muse serve and @muse-code/sdk with shared sign-in and history. Provides project folders, action approvals, tool and subagent activity view, and token tracking. Runs locally as Node.js web app.

devinwarp/facade-mapper-intel.summary: Maps building facades from a photo to plan projection shows that fit architecture
devinwarp/facade-mapper-intel.readme_summary: Standalone Python service that segments facade elements with SAM 3.1, plans readable shows with Muse Spark, and generates per-element visuals with Muse Image. Custom code animates content along outlines; served via FastAPI on Render.

alper-tekin/trafik-ikizi.summary: Turns intersection video into calibrated SUMO simulation for signal plans
alper-tekin/trafik-ikizi.readme_summary: Fixed-camera video to SAM 3.1 vehicle detections with tracking, homography and queue analysis. Builds calibrated SUMO network replaying observed traffic. Muse Spark agent proposes tested signal plans with verifier.

sajjadbdai/ledgerlens.summary: Converts supplier invoices and statements into validated accounting ledgers
sajjadbdai/ledgerlens.readme_summary: Ingests PDF/photo invoices and extracts vendor, line items, VAT and totals using SAM 3.1 for regions and Muse for handwriting. Python validator checks arithmetic like discounts and advances before ledger export.

barnikbh/brahma.summary: Clinical decision support graph that shows only cited lines for synthetic cases
barnikbh/brahma.readme_summary: Walks synthetic cases through a cited clinical knowledge graph for decision support, not diagnosis. Local Python backend with web UI; uses Meta Model API with recorded-provider replay for tests.

amiraisse2-a11y/corelog.summary: Converts drill-core tray photos and voice notes into checkable lithology logs.
amiraisse2-a11y/corelog.readme_summary: CoreLog photographs core trays to propose structured lithology logs with label and depth reading. Plain-code cross-checks, abstention on weak evidence and human validation before export. Bilingual French/English PWA with Python server.

Techfrontiers/snapsell-ai.summary: Turns one messy phone photo into a ready-to-post product listing card
Techfrontiers/snapsell-ai.readme_summary: Pipeline locates product with SAM 3.1, cleans background with Muse Image edits, then writes listing copy with Muse Spark 1.3 from visible details only. Demo is bilingual TH/EN gallery with Python PIL server. Built for Thai small sellers in Indie track.

KingKharid/1Thing-Meta-AI.summary: Productivity app that shows only one physical next step from your chaos dump
KingKharid/1Thing-Meta-AI.readme_summary: Takes typed, spoken or photographed brain dump, files tasks to hidden reserve and reveals one next step at a time. Web/mobile with backend and live-model demo. Uses muse-spark-open on Baseten plus Muse Spark/Wonder for extraction and ordering.

Cubiczan/sale-ready.summary: Scores how sale-ready a trades business is and drafts buyer profile
Cubiczan/sale-ready.readme_summary: Assesses uploaded P&Ls, contracts and site photos into 0-100 score with six sub-scores, fix list and teaser/CIM-lite Markdown/PDF. Python backend with POST /api/upload and local UI via Make demo. Built for HVAC, plumbing and roofing owners.

Ayushichadha/meta-autonomous-lab.summary: Simulates factory failures to test persist-or-replan recovery decisions
Ayushichadha/meta-autonomous-lab.readme_summary: Simulation-grounded digital twin for manufacturing recovery. Meta model inspects shop state, proposes bounded experiments, and chooses PERSIST or REPLAN. Built in Python with configs, scripts, and hosted Modal web replay.

Lerdin09/bankao-meta-hackathon.summary: AI digital wallet for sending and receiving money for Angola
Lerdin09/bankao-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Smart digital wallet for Angola combining payments with banking AI assistance. FastAPI backend + frontend uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for chat, transactions and financial guidance.

vmbr068/netmedic.summary: AI on-call network engineer that detects, fixes and rolls back router incidents
vmbr068/netmedic.readme_summary: Detects network incidents, investigates with real router tools and auto-remediates with rollback. Python 3.12 backend with React Spectrum frontend and BIRD lab. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 to read rack cabling photos.

EonEmmanuel/meta-ai-hackathon.summary: Audits Cameroon land records to detect fake areas and boundary fraud in two languages.
EonEmmanuel/meta-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: Cadastra-Cameroon parses Plans de Bornage, recomputes geodetic areas in UTM 32N/33N, flags superficie fictive and zone errors. It uses Meta AI for document analysis and bilingual English-French audit reports. Backend plus frontend with test data.

EonEmmanuel/Cadastra.summary: Audits Cameroon land records to detect fake areas and boundary fraud in two languages.
EonEmmanuel/Cadastra.readme_summary: Cadastra performs cadastral forensics via document analysis and geospatial computation, detecting inflated surfaces and UTM errors. It generates bilingual PDF audits and WhatsApp verification. Same Meta AI backend and frontend architecture as CADASTRA CM.

rafael-sanchezf/hush-iq.summary: Scores NYC apartment noise from city data tailored to how you sleep.
rafael-sanchezf/hush-iq.readme_summary: Combines 311 complaints, permits, liquor licenses, and transit data into a quiet-to-loud verdict with citations. Monorepo with API, apps, and eval services on Vercel. Uses Meta models to parse listings and permits and write grounded explanations.

YasuruThilakshana/AnimalID.summary: Registers pets, identifies them by photo scan, and hosts lost-found alerts
YasuruThilakshana/AnimalID.readme_summary: React + Vite frontend with Express + Sequelize/MySQL backend for pet registration and lost-found subscriptions. Uses Meta AI SAM 3.1 via POST /api/animals/scan to match uploaded photos with stored uploads.

josephdeakin/im-at-the-races.summary: Agent that finds, reproduces and patches web race conditions with tests
josephdeakin/im-at-the-races.readme_summary: Local dev tool where Muse Spark agent analyzes repo and running app, then delays browser responses to expose race faults. pnpm monorepo with browser harness and isolated git checkout. Uses Muse Spark for experiment design and patching.

Kaushal1025/spatial-sense.summary: Live camera narration of nearby objects, distance and direction for blind users.
Kaushal1025/spatial-sense.readme_summary: Web app that samples camera frames about every 2 seconds and speaks guidance. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection and Muse Spark for short navigation prompts plus voice queries. Has mock mode, unit tests and Vercel deployment.

yusuffolufemi532-glitch/aone-bp.summary: WhatsApp copilot that drafts salon replies in owner tone for approval.
yusuffolufemi532-glitch/aone-bp.readme_summary: WhatsApp business partner for Nigerian salons and vendors. Drafts replies with meta-models/muse-spark-open on Baseten, enforces price floors and discounts in code, and requires owner approval via mobile page before sending.

meta-hackers/fairbuy.summary: AI shopping researcher that compares source-backed products and seller offers
meta-hackers/fairbuy.readme_summary: AI shopping research app where users describe needs, refine preferences and compare products. Built with React, TypeScript/Express, Zod contracts and PostgreSQL. Uses Meta Model API for chat and research with Brave search optional.

EvarestTechnologies/lipwad.summary: Turns photos and Swahili voice notes into verified Kenyan SHA claims
EvarestTechnologies/lipwad.readme_summary: Reads photographed claim documents, cites each field to source, checks SHA rules and repairs returns. Multimodal agent built on Meta Muse models with human confirmation gate. Backend plus frontend demo with synthetic data.

adityadixit07/insaaf.summary: Verifies gig workers' evidence photos and drafts ready-to-submit dispute appeals
adityadixit07/insaaf.readme_summary: Next.js app for penalized gig workers to contest pay cuts and strikes. Uses SAM 3.1 to verify evidence photos, Muse Spark to draft appeals, and Muse Voice Transcribe for input.

hombaez-guy/meta-hackathon.summary: Autonomous sysadmin agents monitor servers and propose reversible fixes
hombaez-guy/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Foreman collects server metrics and logs every 30 minutes, with Reviewer writing health reports and Fixer proposing reversible fixes for human approval. Docker Compose Python backend with dashboard and mobile approval. Built on muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API.

EldonL/CountertopRearrange.summary: AR app that places objects on countertops via vision model coordinates
EldonL/CountertopRearrange.readme_summary: Unity AR app that screenshots the view and asks muse-spark-1.3 where to place an object. Uses Meta Model API Responses API with file upload, JSON x/y output to drive placement.

dantermz/kora-scribe.summary: Hands-free glasses scribe turning consultations into verified SOAP notes
dantermz/kora-scribe.readme_summary: Ray-Ban Meta glasses capture consult, Muse Voice Transcribe produces transcript, Muse Glimmer drafts SOAP and verifier checks lines. Doctor reviews and signs. iOS plus Python stack for public-sector doctors in Mexico, documentation only.

compiler-aditya/groundtruth.summary: Agent that verifies construction photos against design package with evidence
compiler-aditya/groundtruth.readme_summary: Takes drone stills, nameplates and walkthroughs and checks them against quantities and drawings. Muse Wonder agent produces findings with evidence drafts. Next.js + Python app deployed on Vercel with recorded and live demo runs.

roszhan2684/Elsewhere.summary: Simulates two alternate life futures from one decision to explore and fact-check
roszhan2684/Elsewhere.readme_summary: Next.js + FastAPI monorepo that branches one decision into two talkable simulated futures. Uses Muse Wonder, Spark, Voice and Image with stress-test and verification.

Anxy/rouvr.summary: Autonomous colleague turning messy instructions into verified work with receipts
Anxy/rouvr.readme_summary: Python 3.12 agent framework that converts instructions into agreed contracts, executes with authority limits, then independently verifies. Model-agnostic, powered by Hyeve.

rankaar/commonground-ai.summary: Property management app with fund accounting, maintenance and governance tools
rankaar/commonground-ai.readme_summary: .NET 10 Blazor Web App with SQL Server 2025 and fund-separated double-entry accounting. Includes unit registry, vision-verified work orders, voting and AI assistant. Built for Meta hackathon with Muse models for operations assistance.

jakub-b29/commonground-ai.summary: Property management app with fund accounting, maintenance and governance tools
jakub-b29/commonground-ai.readme_summary: .NET 10 Blazor Web App with SQL Server, fund-separated accounting and meter registry. Adds vision-verified maintenance, voice transcription and governance. Uses muse-spark, muse-wonder, muse-voice-transcribe, sam-3.1 and muse-image.

AndyCG03/handful-recipes.summary: Turns cooking videos of loved ones into living recipes linked to video moments
AndyCG03/handful-recipes.readme_summary: Records family cooking video and generates steps linked to timestamps, preserving literal measures. Stack uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3 for schema-validated JSON, and SAM 3.1 to locate hands and containers.

AshuMaths1729/elasticshelf.summary: Headless dynamic pricing and replenishment for grocery electronic shelf labels.
AshuMaths1729/elasticshelf.readme_summary: Provides RL-based pricing decisions streamed to grocery ESLs via headless API. Uses Muse Spark for decision reasoning and PyTorch DQN for pricing policy. Backend is FastAPI with WebSockets and demo storefront.

khanzzirfan/pixitween-director.summary: Turns one product photo and sentence into a directed 3D ad video in minutes
khanzzirfan/pixitween-director.readme_summary: MuseReels plans board, camera, light and set then pre-renders sheets for Muse to check against the photo. Supports CSV catalog batches with MP4 export or video-model finishing. Custom 3D engine with Next.js frontend built for Startups track.

Lisovate/plomba.summary: Digital seal tracking shipping container damage with photos at handover
Lisovate/plomba.readme_summary: Tracks containers across handovers with SAM 3.1 masking and Muse Spark damage coding. Drafts claims as agent, blurs people, and takes spoken notes via Muse Voice Transcribe.

Hilta-dev/nawaflow.summary: Voice-first bookkeeping app that turns spoken sales into debt and stock records
Hilta-dev/nawaflow.readme_summary: Nawa lets Namibian vendors record sales by voice or text, then tracks debts, stock and reminders. Client-server app with Supabase backend and live demo on Render. Uses Meta AI to parse utterances like sale amount and customer into structured records.

AliMora83/PartFix.summary: Converts a photo of a broken part into parametric CAD and print-ready STL.
AliMora83/PartFix.readme_summary: Photo-to-CAD pipeline producing parametric models and STL for 3D printing. Python codebase in src with scripts and samples built during hackathon. Uses Meta Muse vision models for part recognition and geometry extraction.

kixorz/meta-hackathon-aipool.summary: Automates pool filter backwashing with pressure sensing, valves and pump control.
kixorz/meta-hackathon-aipool.readme_summary: ESP32-based controller reads filter pressure gauge, drives pump and backwash valve with HTTP server and Home Assistant integration. Includes mDNS, config manager and relay control. Plans physical hardware build with power and RS485 wiring.

henryokeke/-AttendAI-2.0-Meta-Hackathon.summary: Anti-proxy school attendance with liveness check, voice print and analytics.
henryokeke/-AttendAI-2.0-Meta-Hackathon.readme_summary: FastAPI attendance system for rural schools with liveness anti-spoofing and location check. Supports voice marking in Igbo, Pidgin, English offline. Uses Llama 3 via Muse for at-risk insights and analytics.

ashrafulislamse/renalradar.summary: Camera and voice meal companion helping kidney patients document dishes.
ashrafulislamse/renalradar.readme_summary: Next.js PWA that segments dishes with SAM 3.1 and identifies foods with Muse Spark. Provides cited nutrient literacy, documentation-only with no medical advice enforced. Focused on Southeast Asian diets for CKD patients.

YakubuYinusaT/Talk-for-Meta.summary: Phone-call AI that connects offline users to healthcare and emergency services.
YakubuYinusaT/Talk-for-Meta.readme_summary: Talk turns any basic phone call into access to care coordination without app or internet. Python stack with Docker, mocks and sofa modules plus tests. Uses Meta AI agents for speech understanding and orchestration to essential services in Nigeria.

tamzid2001/sceneproof.summary: Counterfactual verifier that tests if robot world models hold after edits.
tamzid2001/sceneproof.readme_summary: Loads object scenes or SAM 3.1 segmented images, then intervenes by moving or removing objects. Runs deterministic physics and support checks with human approval gate. Replayable proofs for embodied AI verification, Vercel demo.

arnoldbaraka/cloudbuild-guardian-meta-ha.summary: Verifiable AI engineer that investigates synthetic K8s incidents with audit logs
arnoldbaraka/cloudbuild-guardian-meta-ha.readme_summary: Investigates synthetic Kubernetes incidents, gathers evidence, requests operator approval, and verifies simulated remediation. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with hash-chained audit log; sandboxed, no real K8s or shell access.

Riaz9543/smart-fit-agent.summary: Virtual try-on store that measures your photo and visualizes fitted dresses
Riaz9543/smart-fit-agent.readme_summary: Upload full-body photo to estimate measurements, match 3 dresses from 30-item catalogue, and generate try-on image. Static frontend with server API using Meta API for measure and image generation.

mkinvest57/TWINFORGE.summary: Image-only tracker forecasting object positions 0.5-1s ahead from SAM masks
mkinvest57/TWINFORGE.readme_summary: TWINFORGE locks SAM 3.1 masks then tracks locally and forecasts image position. Static web interfaces for observation, camera and decision modes test prediction vs outcome without simulator data.

Darsh1222/tmrw-lens.summary: Photographs schedules and syllabi to build verified plans that auto-rebuild.
Darsh1222/tmrw-lens.readme_summary: Parses photos of schedules, syllabi and whiteboards into a dated study plan. Muse Spark reasons with tool calls to reschedule missed sessions with explanations. Built with Next.js frontend, evals and verifiable date checks.

iamsourabhraikwar/meta-global-ai-develop.summary: Autonomous CCTV control-room operator that watches feeds and sends alerts
iamsourabhraikwar/meta-global-ai-develop.readme_summary: Next.js 14 control room using Muse Spark Open 1026 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for vision detection. Baseten serverless inference with WhatsApp Cloud API alerts. Transforms cameras into autonomous operator.

vherediadepvops/prooflab-ai-meta-hackath.summary: Scientific evidence engine that tests hypotheses against physical measurements
vherediadepvops/prooflab-ai-meta-hackath.readme_summary: Experimental engine for researchers that makes testable predictions from measurements and explains agreement with hypotheses. Uses Meta models with offline calculations; SAM parsing and inference not yet verified.

damipineda/AdForge-AI.summary: Drafts ad creatives, copy and audiences from a single product photo.
damipineda/AdForge-AI.readme_summary: Turns product photographs into reviewable social campaigns with creative directions, image assets, copy and audience ideas. Built on Meta Model API with Next.js, MIT licensed. Includes visual auditing, feed-story artwork and catalog export.

remtekindo/milestone-guardian.summary: Milestone life planner that projects savings timelines with AI explanations
remtekindo/milestone-guardian.readme_summary: Households set milestones like wedding or home payment; deterministic engine projects dates from savings rate. Muse Spark via Meta Model API only explains numbers. Nuxt 4 + Drizzle standalone repo.

maikunari/physics-twin.summary: Converts a ball-and-ramp clip into a tuned 2D physics simulation
maikunari/physics-twin.readme_summary: Physics Twin films a tabletop clip and fits a 2D rigid-body simulation tuning friction and bounce to match footage, then predicts future motion with error in cm/px/ms. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for reasoning. Web app with API, server and docs.

Kittybri/reversesteps-visual-memory.summary: Visual memory that finds where a loose disassembly part belonged
Kittybri/reversesteps-visual-memory.readme_summary: Upload up to 12 disassembly photos, mark parts, then query with loose-part photo to suggest source steps with highlights. Local workspace with camera capture and Meta adapter; recognition not yet evaluated.

parabellumlux/tidyquest.summary: One messy-room photo becomes a guided cleanup quest with a companion
parabellumlux/tidyquest.readme_summary: Analyzes one photo to create quest map stops, boss area and step guidance. Built on Meta Model API for vision and generation with rigged companions, app client, app-server and validation pipeline.

jemankalita/opurnos.summary: Watches hackathons and jobs, matches them to your resume with cited evidence
jemankalita/opurnos.readme_summary: Agent that parses resume PDFs into profiles, checks opportunities for eligibility and scam risk, and emails digests. Built with Next.js, Drizzle and Docker, Pro billing via Razorpay, AI runs on OpenAI models.

cybersheik/souls-of-muse.summary: Bilingual AI-assisted platform for teacher-led music lessons
cybersheik/souls-of-muse.readme_summary: Service and test bench for instrument and singing instruction with a Muse AI mediator, rehearsal room and Ray-Ban Meta integrations. Stack spans site, runtime, service API and harness-bench for model evaluation.

Clean-earthw/tellmemore.summary: Photographs heirlooms and records family voice stories into linked living pages
Clean-earthw/tellmemore.readme_summary: Family storytelling app where an object photo plus relative voice creates an explorable page with sentence-level attribution. Frontend plus backend with Supabase, built for Bringing People Closer Together track.

gino6178/meta_ai_hackathon.summary: Sports club agent that schedules games, courts and health-aware plans
gino6178/meta_ai_hackathon.readme_summary: Serve agent lines up games with compatible players, negotiates via agents, plans around health data, books courts and cuts highlights. Runs on Muse Glimmer with Sapiens2, SAM 2.1 and DETR for video.

rynclick/Pahami.summary: WhatsApp court agent explaining summons and tracking hearing dates
rynclick/Pahami.readme_summary: Indonesian court litigant assistant on WhatsApp that reads letters, verifies facts and sends hearing reminders. PHP CodeIgniter app with Docker using Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe, 186 tests passing.

todoforai/handsfree.summary: Voice-driven agent that controls your real Android phone via ADB taps
todoforai/handsfree.readme_summary: Computer-use agent driving a real Android phone instead of a sandbox, with push-to-talk and locate commands. Muse Voice Transcribe hears, Muse Spark/Wonder plans, SAM 3.1 grounds UI elements to ADB taps.

sukritghosh886-hub/Sales-Analysis.summary: Simple web app to track sales, costs and profit or loss
sukritghosh886-hub/Sales-Analysis.readme_summary: Basic sale analytics app for tracking sales, costs and business profit. Built with web frontend, Firebase/Firestore config and Node server, deployed as a live static page.

tanyageorge/curriculum-auditor.summary: Parses catalog prerequisites and audits degrees for defects.
tanyageorge/curriculum-auditor.readme_summary: Converts prerequisite text to AND/OR logic in CNF and audits catalogs for missing courses, loops, and long paths. Python pipeline with Mendeley/UIUC loaders, frozen eval split, and Vercel site.

Redaelm47/resurrection.summary: Rebuilds working web apps from a screen-recording video with a fidelity score
Redaelm47/resurrection.readme_summary: Reads video of legacy app use into a JSON spec, regenerates modern HTML/CSS/JS and redraws assets. Uses Muse Wonder for spec, Muse Code for rebuild, Muse Image for visuals, with bench and tests.

Fqrina/BenchTruth.summary: Hardware verifier that blocks impossible electronics builds and proves the fix
Fqrina/BenchTruth.readme_summary: BenchTruth validates DIY electronics builds with a deterministic solver for pins, power and mechanics. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for intent parsing to project_spec.json, then renderers emit BOM, wiring and firmware gated by compile and simulation.

loucasty-cell/PeteyPlant.summary: Gamified plant-pet app with HP, streaks and real plant-care models
loucasty-cell/PeteyPlant.readme_summary: PeteyPlant turns houseplants into expressive cartoon pets with HP, XP, streaks and a ReAct explainer. Backend computes VPD, soil moisture decay and light forecasting; provider layer is configurable but no live Muse call in this build.

bgrubbs1/lantern-room-meta-vr.summary: Seated hands-first WebXR VR puzzle about waking a sleeping lantern
bgrubbs1/lantern-room-meta-vr.readme_summary: The Lantern Room is a quiet WebXR puzzle built with Meta Immersive Web SDK for VR Start 2026. It offers a hands-first observatory table with lantern, orrery and dial puzzles and no menus or locomotion.

kuederleR/mgah-lane-line-auto-distillati.summary: Auto-labels driving video into vectorized 3D lane splines without LiDAR
kuederleR/mgah-lane-line-auto-distillati.readme_summary: Multi-foundation-model teacher auto-labels monocular driving video into 3D camera-frame lane splines. Pipeline combines SAM 3.1 Video, DINOv3 and Llama 3.2 Vision with distillation configs and scripts. Built for cheap mono-camera 3D lane perception.

KEYUR141/Oral-lens.summary: Source-linked literature review workspace for oral cancer researchers.
KEYUR141/Oral-lens.readme_summary: Oral-lens restricts retrieval to reviewer-selected papers and returns typed assessment with cited passage IDs. Python app with ingestion, embeddings, DB and frontend. Uses Meta models for assessment with Python checks for citations.

Dreadfulgamerkid/The-Cyber-Crew-Goes-Met.summary: Linux terminal adventure game with AI-generated storybooks
Dreadfulgamerkid/The-Cyber-Crew-Goes-Met.readme_summary: The Cyber Crew is a web game for learning Linux terminal via adventures. Built with Vite and TypeScript, it calls Meta Model API muse-spark-1.2 for book generation with fallback to a built-in procedural generator.

EmirCobanOfficial/courtsense-site.summary: Landing page for tennis video to movement data with SAM 3.1
EmirCobanOfficial/courtsense-site.readme_summary: Static landing site for CourtSense, which converts tennis training video into movement data. Built during the hackathon with HTML and hosted on GitHub Pages; core analysis uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 in main repo.

kevalhirani2003/streetops-ai.summary: Agentic assistant turning street-damage reports into audited work orders
kevalhirani2003/streetops-ai.readme_summary: StreetOps AI converts unstructured pothole and streetlight reports into verified maintenance work orders. Stack is React Vite plus Node Express with a Muse Spark agent loop for extraction, deduplication and auditable history.

Michael2540/CERES.summary: Autonomous crop-health monitor for Mars greenhouses that detects wilt and alerts offline
Michael2540/CERES.readme_summary: CERES is mission control for off-Earth farming that measures plants, raises evidence-backed alerts, and works without Earth link. Built for the Meta hackathon, it uses Meta models for detection and explanation with human-verified decisions and offline-first architecture.

bubblesdev/apprentice.summary: Turns expert video into step guides then watches beginners via camera
bubblesdev/apprentice.readme_summary: Apprentice converts expert video, PDF or docs into verified steps with checks and warnings. Muse Spark parses video with audio into ordered steps. SAM 3.1 watches live phone camera to catch mistakes. Monorepo with apps, docs and e2e tests.

rajakumaranaap-rgb/makkal-ai.summary: Tamil e-governance assistant bridging digital divide for 75M citizens
rajakumaranaap-rgb/makkal-ai.readme_summary: Helps Tamil Nadu citizens access e-Sevai services via conversational AI in Tamil and English. Python app with knowledge_base and meta_client using Meta Muse and SAM 2 for citizen queries.

Ronisky-coder/Nia.summary: Deterministic safety gate and black box for AI-driven vehicles and robots
Ronisky-coder/Nia.readme_summary: Turns Openwist vehicle/robot constitution into enforceable software. Muse models perceive and propose actions while an independent deterministic gate allows or blocks them with tamper-evident logging.

kelleydonaldson/lunch-board-reader.summary: Human-approved system turning food-truck photo posts into lunch schedules
kelleydonaldson/lunch-board-reader.readme_summary: Reads food-truck schedule images into structured stops for Owensboro Market. Uses a vision model for input with never-guess flags, programmatic guardrails, approval queue, and provenance tracking.

compiler-aditya/kepler.summary: Turns phone video of motion into verified physics simulation data
compiler-aditya/kepler.readme_summary: Phone clip in, metric trajectory out checked against gravity. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 ball tracking plus A4 homography for metres, outputting trajectory.json for theory agent, with 14 tests.

carlosfcosme/trust-proof-work.summary: Public trust record scoring AI agents on identity, delivery, and refusals
carlosfcosme/trust-proof-work.readme_summary: Verifies agent skills via corpus gate, gauntlet benchmarks, and escrow invariants I1-I6. Python rig with locked fixtures and demo scorecard proves install safety and burn detection.

unrealskill/sellerchat-ai.summary: Indonesian live-chat seller agent with real order tools and transfer checks
unrealskill/sellerchat-ai.readme_summary: Answers stock, price and order status in Indonesian via real SQLite tools. Verifies transfer screenshots, transcribes buyer voice notes, and escalates low-confidence cases for human approval.

niteash/hsain-agent.summary: Voice and shelf-photo back-office agent for small retail stock and reorder
niteash/hsain-agent.readme_summary: Owner sends voice note plus shelf photo/video or invoice, agent returns verified stock check and supplier reorder. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe, frontend plus backend.

josephbolus/daas-meta-demo-video.summary: Programmatic Remotion video showcasing real DevOps as a Service console
josephbolus/daas-meta-demo-video.readme_summary: 2:45 1080p captioned demo built with Remotion replaying real v3 console captures. Uses actual Mock Judge Mode run, guardrail verdict and console rendering code, no mocked UI.

0b10headedcalf/holomenu.summary: Turns real food photos into 3D previews with TruthScore for ordering
0b10headedcalf/holomenu.readme_summary: Creates rotatable true-scale 3D dishes from customer photos with evidence strip and TruthScore. Next.js frontend with Modal 3D backend, cached instant models and conversational spatial Q&A.

motdang/paid-from-anywhere.summary: WhatsApp money desk helping nonprofits track donations from anywhere
motdang/paid-from-anywhere.readme_summary: WhatsApp-based money desk for nonprofits, started Oct 27 2026 for the hackathon Startup track. Repo currently holds only README with prior work isolated in prior/. Intends to use Meta AI on WhatsApp for nonprofit finance workflows.

jeffrey840/QuickAisle.summary: Maps store aisles and builds shortest walking route for shopping list

ThakhinBo/dharmavera-hackathon.summary: Numerology app that draws 7-oracle scores, charts and AI guidance

pagyemang-dotcom/meaning-check.summary: Tests messages against 24 AI readers to find misreadings and fix wording

mattwatson7/reality-compiler-hackathon-2.summary: Compiles written procedures and verifies them against visual evidence
mattwatson7/reality-compiler-hackathon-2.readme_summary: Compiles procedures into typed requirements and checks timestamped visual evidence with deterministic PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evaluator. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 for semantic compilation and SAM 3.1 masks/tracks. FastAPI backend + frontend in Docker.

PruthviRajG25/MetaHackathon.summary: Autonomous grocery restocking app that predicts household needs
PruthviRajG25/MetaHackathon.readme_summary: RepeatLess AI is a Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind app with MongoDB Atlas for household restocking intelligence. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 per badges. Includes scripts and tests for autonomous grocery workflows.

aminamos/detector-audit-bench.summary: Audits AI-text detectors on civic and legal writing for false positives
aminamos/detector-audit-bench.readme_summary: Benchmarks AI detectors on legislation, filings, public comments and historical texts to expose false human-as-AI flags. Cloudflare Worker + TypeScript stack with data, migrations and docs. Configurable to run live with API keys.

sandeepvijayarao09/auren.summary: Cross-device voice assistant spanning watch, glasses, phone and web
sandeepvijayarao09/auren.readme_summary: One Muse agent holds a live session across Apple Watch, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, iPhone and Mac triggered by Hey Muse. Uses Muse Wonder, Spark, Spark Open and Voice Transcribe plus SAM 3.1; Dockerized with documented architecture.

himomohi/cutcopy.summary: Turns one product photo into cutout, staged scenes and SEO listing
himomohi/cutcopy.readme_summary: Vite React TypeScript app at cutcopy.pages.dev that turns a phone photo into cutout, scene variants, title and description. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, muse-image-1.0 for scenes, muse-spark-1.3 for copy via Meta Model API.

tejaspatel2255/ScreenGuard-Meta-AI-Hacka.summary: Watches browser work to stop SOP skips before compliance failures
tejaspatel2255/ScreenGuard-Meta-AI-Hacka.readme_summary: ScreenGuard is a supervisor agent that watches a shared browser tab and tracks SOP execution. It intervenes on skipped, out-of-order or invalid actions to prevent loss. Built with frontend replay on Vercel, Python backend and Meta models for vision and reasoning.

gevalinho/codearchaeologist-ai.summary: Maps legacy repos to architecture graphs and answers with cited proof
gevalinho/codearchaeologist-ai.readme_summary: CodeArchaeologist AI scans repos into structural architecture graphs and provides evidence-grounded answers with Docker-isolated GitHub scanning. Next.js plus isolated workers on AWS with Nginx. Uses Baseten-hosted Muse models for reasoning validated against cited evidence.

roldhaa/AgentFoundry.summary: Builds business agents and verifies them in simulated environments with checks
roldhaa/AgentFoundry.readme_summary: Platform to define missions, generate versioned agents, and run them in isolated business simulations. Verifies outcomes against deterministic business rules and analyzes failures. Uses Meta AI agent reasoning with execution feedback.

jscott3201/llm-tuning.summary: Serves and fine-tunes Gemma, Qwen and Muse Glimmer models on Modal GPUs
