Ps23102004/patch-cross-examiner.summary: Gates AI code fixes on counterexample tests to catch wrong-but-passing patches
Ps23102004/patch-cross-examiner.readme_summary: Runner copies candidate patch, runs existing tests, then runs spec-derived counterexample tests. Validates counterexamples against known-correct fix to ensure verdict reliability. Built for Meta hackathon as AI code verification gate.

albertojbravo-art/shift-copilot.summary: Warehouse ops copilot that forecasts on-time shipping and recommends staffing moves.
albertojbravo-art/shift-copilot.readme_summary: Operations copilot for fulfillment shift leads built on deterministic Python simulation engine. Projects OTS, detects stoppages from scan-gap signal, suggests staffing moves and drafts postings. Built with Muse tooling during hackathon window.

valon85/codren-one-sentence-app.summary: Turns one sentence into live software; built desktop video editor Framevik

mannasync/docarion-meta-multimodal.summary: Clinical vision copilot detecting counterfeit drugs and guiding antibiotic use in Nigeria
mannasync/docarion-meta-multimodal.readme_summary: Docarion is a multimodal clinical engine with symptom intake in English and Pidgin. It combines SAM 3.1 clinical vision for drug verification with Muse models for triage, frontend/backend/mobile stack.

TheMunene/pesa-recon-agent.summary: Reconciles M-Pesa, bank and paper records and explains mismatches plainly
TheMunene/pesa-recon-agent.readme_summary: Ingests M-Pesa PDF/CSV, bank exports and receipt photos for Kenyan small businesses. Matches payments, withdrawals and deposits to surface unpaid and unexplained items. Uses Meta AI to explain results in plain language.

kin2001/shofiliate-ai.summary: Guides affiliates from product research to content drafts and Facebook posts
kin2001/shofiliate-ai.readme_summary: Planned workflow for product analysis, AI-assisted campaign drafting, review and Facebook publishing. Keeps user approval in loop while linking decisions to performance tracking. Designed around Meta AI content assistance.

VivekChaurasiya95/Meridian-AI.summary: Evidence-backed debugging platform turning bug reports into verified patches.
VivekChaurasiya95/Meridian-AI.readme_summary: Meridian AI runs reproduce-evidence-hypotheses-tests-patch-verify workflow with human approval at each step and no unverified claims in UI. abhijeet4725/SiteCheck.summary: Phone-photo home screening that finds cracks and damp and rates severity
abhijeet4725/SiteCheck.readme_summary: Plans photo upload with A4 scale reference, SAM 3.1 segmentation for cracks/damp, OpenCV measurement, and Muse Spark classification to JSON defect report. thecurtisloucks/sitememory.summary: Spatial memory that records rooms and answers questions with visual evidence
thecurtisloucks/sitememory.readme_summary: Records physical environments, tracks observations over time with persistent object identities. Built with React Vite frontend and Fastify Prisma SQLite backend, using live Meta SAM segmentation and evidence-grounded Muse assistant.

tprsmail-cell/suzarchi-meta-hackathon-20.summary: AI reuse finder for surplus textile materials in Tiruppur hub
tprsmail-cell/suzarchi-meta-hackathon-20.readme_summary: Circular materials intelligence platform to discover compliant reuse for surplus textiles, yarn and offcuts. Uses Meta models plus transparent rule-based compatibility checks. Next.js app grounded in Tiruppur zero-discharge textile context.

Hyatus-Living/arosa-housing-modeling.summary: Zoning and home design tool with editable plans and walkthrough
Hyatus-Living/arosa-housing-modeling.readme_summary: Extracts housing research with SAM 3.1 photo selection, Muse Image illustration with provenance, editable floor-plan viewers and first-person walkthrough. jai-nayani/BinBuild.summary: Scans loose LEGO pieces to generate build guides from owned parts only

lovinta/asih.summary: Guided helper for older adults for appointments, groups, and scam checks
lovinta/asih.readme_summary: Next.js TypeScript app with three fixed guided flows ending in user-chosen actions. No open chat mode, uses plain-spoken persona with formal Spanish support. Uses Muse Spark for extraction and confirmation via Meta API.

ZubeidHendricks/verichainx-sol-muse.summary: Muse shopping agent that verifies offers on Solana before one-click USDC buy
ZubeidHendricks/verichainx-sol-muse.readme_summary: Next.js + Drizzle marketplace where Muse Spark shopper agent queries sales agents and verifies seller, ownership, and price on-chain. Single Solana transaction pays USDC, fee, moves Metaplex Core NFT, and records order.

Redaelm47/adistribution-system.summary: Finds natural breaks in videos and builds motion bridges into mid-roll ads.
Redaelm47/adistribution-system.readme_summary: Analyzes video to find natural ad moments and generates a motion-design bridge with tailored copy. Built solo with Meta models for scene understanding, script writing and self-review of renders.

karthikesu/karts-ai-enterprise-meta-hack.summary: Guarded trilingual shop assistant with deterministic dummy booking engine
karthikesu/karts-ai-enterprise-meta-hack.readme_summary: Static browser demo with Node prototype for English, Malay, and Tamil enquiries. Muse Spark Open via Baseten handles phrasing only; local engine owns availability and booking records. Includes replay evidence and tests.

nmheinrich/seeyable.summary: Voice-operated web controls that expose the same tools to AI agents via local MCP.
nmheinrich/seeyable.readme_summary: Seeyable is a Chrome extension that labels page controls as callable tools with human approval for submit/pay/delete. External agents connect via local MCP to one executor. Uses Docker setup with voice input and approval gating.

Heet-P/SAHARA_MetaAI.summary: Autonomous rescue drone that finds casualties and briefs responders
Heet-P/SAHARA_MetaAI.readme_summary: ROS 2 Humble + ArduPilot SITL + Gazebo stack with YOLOv8 RGB-thermal detection. Muse Spark 1.3 co-pilot for mission reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Voice for briefing. Command center visualizes search.

Yosubi-inc/yosubi-voice-companion.summary: Bilingual EN/ES voice companion for older adults with supervised evals
Yosubi-inc/yosubi-voice-companion.readme_summary: FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend proxying audio to /stt and chat turns. Dockerized stack with offline demo fakes and supervisor-run model evals with spend ledger. Focus on accessible voice interaction.

SANGRAMLEMBE/landproof.summary: Proof-carrying drone emergency landing verified by pixel evidence
SANGRAMLEMBE/landproof.readme_summary: Python safety system where Muse Spark proposes zones from vetted hazard vocabulary. SAM 3.1 must back every claim, with SAM-distilled student checking descent. Modal apps and tests for simulation.

dancaldera/saycut.summary: Edit Instagram Reels with voice commands into frame-accurate effects
dancaldera/saycut.readme_summary: SayCut turns typed or spoken commands into frame-accurate video edits like blur, glow and restyle. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for video understanding and edit plans, SAM 3.1 for segmentation tracking, plus Muse Image and Voice Transcribe. Stack includes FastAPI backend and web frontend with live demo.

princechoudhary16/veritas.summary: Verification engine that generates with Meta models and blocks unverified outputs
princechoudhary16/veritas.readme_summary: Veritas is a declarative policy engine that generates then adversarially cross-checks artifacts in a closed loop. Python CLI/app with tiered critics and cryptographic receipts. Uses Muse Spark for critics, Muse Image for generation/edits, SAM 3.1 for grounding.

djovany6389/MetAIDevHackathon2026.summary: Stations-first marketplace to discover, book, and commission live broadcast feeds
djovany6389/MetAIDevHackathon2026.readme_summary: Stations-first marketplace where stations discover and book live feeds, tower cams, and event production. Built with Python standard library only plus static public frontend, with server.py routing roles, bookings, and expenses. No explicit Meta AI integration described in README.

nav-tej/meta-smb-gtm.summary: AI growth copilot for Etsy/Shopify sellers for listings, images, and marketing.
nav-tej/meta-smb-gtm.readme_summary: Muse Growth Studio helps small sellers with copy, product imagery, and growth ops using Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and ComfyUI. FastAPI backend with Vercel frontend. Validated with 100 offline tests.

wujotung9627-svg/mutation-forge.summary: Browser horror walk through a generated Taiwanese school that mutates
wujotung9627-svg/mutation-forge.readme_summary: Last One Out is a 5-minute bilingual 3D horror walk generated entirely by Meta models. Photos, mutations and scares render in browser with no install. Voice input at finale via microphone.

Tryzeon/tryzeon-fashion-agent.summary: AI stylist that builds outfits from real stock and try-on photos.
Tryzeon/tryzeon-fashion-agent.readme_summary: Embeddable fashion agent that understands requests with Muse Spark vision, searches catalog, checks fit, and renders shoppable try-on images with self-inspection fixes. TypeScript stack with live Vercel demo.

jamal005csit/Rosseta.summary: Turns legacy app screen recording into React replacement with parity evidence.
jamal005csit/Rosseta.readme_summary: Records legacy desktop use into evidence-backed AppSpec, generated React app and Playwright replay. Muse-compatible vision model does observation and repair, FFmpeg and faster-whisper process video.

nikhil5562/LessonTrace-Hackathon.summary: Teaches Python via source-linked lessons, live execution and bounded tutoring.
nikhil5562/LessonTrace-Hackathon.readme_summary: Uses bounded teaching and research agents over RAG sources to guide Python lessons. Learners use editable workspace with real execution and step visualization. Backend rules constrain agent actions; no mastery claims.

samirjan791/bridgevoice-2.summary: Chat-first English, Pashto, and Dari interpreter co-pilot for mobile
samirjan791/bridgevoice-2.readme_summary: Mobile chat interpreter with compact composer, attachment cards, and looping video profile. Local web stack served on port 3002 via launcher script. Uses Meta API for translation and interpretation with credential-preserving launcher.

WillYeadon/meta_hackathon_blindspot.summary: Stress-test harness that probes AI science verifiers with physics variants
WillYeadon/meta_hackathon_blindspot.readme_summary: Harness that preserves physical predictions while changing representation to measure missed errors and false alarms. Python package with run.py, spectral-gap case study, and reproducibility docs. Tests Muse Spark and Wonder verifiers with checkpoints.

openkrill-labs/listing-agent.summary: Turns phone product photos into clean import-ready Shopify listings
openkrill-labs/listing-agent.readme_summary: Takes phone photos of a product and outputs a Shopify listing that imports cleanly. Architecture centers on vision cutouts and counting plus listing planning. Uses Llama 4 Scout for planning and SAM 3 for segmentation.

jrodsoto-builds/road-to-5k.summary: PT-to-5K running coach for Ray-Ban Display glasses with vision layer
jrodsoto-builds/road-to-5k.readme_summary: Plain-web lens-style app guides PT exercise plans, answers session questions, and adds SAM 3.1 people segmentation for distance estimates and crowd counts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via server proxy to keep keys server-side.

terrizoaguimor/hyphae-consensus.summary: Three AI roles debate code changes with verified proofs for human approval
terrizoaguimor/hyphae-consensus.readme_summary: Proposer, Critic and Evidence Evaluator agents argue a change on Meta Muse models. Runtime is Rust with hash-chained events and proof verification; only a person decides. Includes contracts, crates/apps workspace, Docker and CI.

ahk1542001-wq/PaCo.summary: Approval-gated agent team that runs a business page weekly content operation
ahk1542001-wq/PaCo.readme_summary: PaCo runs brief, trend research, content plan, drafts, approval, scheduling and reporting for FYF AI demo brand. Uses deterministic rules plus judge pass architecture. Uses Muse Wonder for plan, drafts and verdicts, Muse Spark for utilities.

iamdflame/untorn.summary: Reassembles torn documents from a single photo.
iamdflame/untorn.readme_summary: Untorn rebuilds torn pages from one phone photo by segmenting pieces and reading across tears like a crossword. Built as Next.js app with e2e tests, it uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for reassembly.

Master07/attest.summary: Verifies AI pull requests by reproducing bugs and sealing proof-of-fix receipts
Master07/attest.readme_summary: Attest reproduces a reported bug, verifies the fix in the running app, and checks it rejects a wrong fix. It seals results into verifiable receipts re-checked on CI across OSes. Uses SAM 3.1 for UI grounding and Muse models in the verifier workflow.

namduhus/Furniture-Moving-Rehearsal.summary: Simulated humanoid rehearses furniture moves from room photo in 3D.
namduhus/Furniture-Moving-Rehearsal.readme_summary: Builds an editable 3D room from an image and door size, then a Unitree G1 rehearses the move in Isaac Sim. Python stack with VLM guidance. Uses Muse Spark to explain results in English or Korean.

ashrafi/LifeSOS.summary: Bio-responsive Android companion linking health, calendar and finance data
ashrafi/LifeSOS.readme_summary: LifeSOS Android app connects Health Connect, calendar, outflows and social ties into an empathetic companion. Jetpack Compose UI powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with prompt-level safety guidance.

jccarrascov-sudo/edith.summary: Watches one desktop task then compiles it into a reusable verified recipe
jccarrascov-sudo/edith.readme_summary: Edith records screen and audio for a manual Word/Excel/desktop task, compiles it with Muse Spark to a minimal program, verifies on copies and replays after confirmation. Local-first Python app. Uses Muse Spark for program synthesis while screen data stays on device.

Binod-in/lifebridge-lens.summary: Translates Japanese letters, forms and machines into migrant languages.
Binod-in/lifebridge-lens.readme_summary: Photo-based explainer for Japanese letters, ATMs, and forms in Nepali, English, Vietnamese, or Burmese. Static HTML/JS frontend with Python server and offline chatbot. Uses muse-spark for translation and explanation.

Acidni-LLC/rackwatch.summary: Turns rack photos into CMDB and compresses alerts into verified incidents.
Acidni-LLC/rackwatch.readme_summary: Scans a server rack photo into a CMDB then triages 512 alerts into 3 verified incidents with tickets. Makefile-driven Python service. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1, and Voice Transcribe.

Malik1942/tearsheet.summary: Turns your photos into traceable design rules and product screens
Malik1942/tearsheet.readme_summary: Extracts design rules from user photos and generates product screens where every choice traces to a photo region. Built with Muse Spark on Meta Model API with web frontend. Includes live demo, video, and tear library UI.

Gengyveusa/bioreactor-cube.summary: Simulates oral biofilm diffusion to explore mouth-to-bloodstream dynamics
Gengyveusa/bioreactor-cube.readme_summary: Python dynamical simulation of oral biofilm diffusion on an abstracted SpatialGrid, designed 1D now and 4D-ready. Stack includes Python sim engine, configs and web-based Journey demo. Uses a live Meta guide and bounded Meta research agent for interpretation, inference only.

palashpawar/scoutiq.summary: Turns plain-English scouting briefs into ranked football shortlists with evidence
palashpawar/scoutiq.readme_summary: AI scouting assistant with Python backend and frontend. Plain-English requests are parsed to validated queries, then scored deterministically on percentile stats. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open only for interpretation and explanations, never for player selection.

Kend150212/mediclear.summary: Photographs medical bills and explains charges in plain language
Kend150212/mediclear.readme_summary: Elderly-first PWA built with HTML, CSS and JS, installable with offline app shell. Scans bills/EOBs, explains line items, flags suspicious charges and drafts dispute letters. Uses Meta AI models for multilingual text and voice explanations and Q&A.

hweller1/wayfinder.summary: Open search subagent that finds code for coding agents with grep and hybrid rerank
hweller1/wayfinder.readme_summary: Wayfinder is an open Qwen3.6-35B model post-trained with LoRA SFT on 1,383 search trajectories from Muse-Spark-Open-816B. Scout plugin hands search from Muse Code to Wayfinder, then refines with hybrid voyage-code-4 vectors plus BM25 in turbopuffer. Uses Muse Spark Open for training and inference.

emiiii09/SIGHTLINE.summary: Android app that scores website accessibility and suggests code fixes
emiiii09/SIGHTLINE.readme_summary: Native Android app that audits URLs for missing alt text, contrast and form labels, scoring 0-100 with marked-up preview. Built in Kotlin/Gradle during hackathon. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for plain-words verdicts and per-issue fixes.

Paktion/hazmat.summary: Local malware-analysis agent isolated against prompt injection.
Paktion/hazmat.readme_summary: Hazmat is a local malware analyst with an airlock between untrusted sample text and deciding agent. Tools run in isolated sandbox while agent steers analysis. It uses Meta open-weight models for verdicts.

ErickAmestegui/KINETICA-hackathon-2026.summary: Links video motion to an interactive equation-driven slider-crank model
ErickAmestegui/KINETICA-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Local engineering studio with React/Three.js frontend and FastAPI backend. Uses manual annotation, OpenCV tracking baseline and numerical fitting with held-out frames. Meta API adapters exist but are disabled by default; demo uses original synthetic clip.

iamaanahmad/BolSite.summary: Builds a live mobile website from a 60-second voice note.
iamaanahmad/BolSite.readme_summary: Voice-to-website builder for Indian small businesses in Hindi/English/Hinglish. Transcribes audio, extracts facts with confidence, builds verified mobile site, and publishes to public URL via Vercel.

Noahstark23/nortex-mcp.summary: Read-only MCP server linking Nicaraguan shop data to AI assistants
Noahstark23/nortex-mcp.readme_summary: TypeScript MCP server exposing 10 read-only tools for Nortex SaaS invoicing, inventory and payroll. Per-business revocable tokens, Spanish voseo voice-ready answers. Connects assistants to Nortex over HTTP; platform itself is proprietary.

linglingms/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hack.summary: Python-React app to fetch and explore EGFR bioactivity records
linglingms/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-Hack.readme_summary: Python + React research prototype with Uvicorn API backend and Vite frontend. Retrieves first 100 EGFR activity records from ChEMBL into local data/. README does not detail specific Meta Muse model integration or prompting.

chandrarup/spatialscout.summary: Agent that validates kidney spatial-transcriptomics findings against errors.
chandrarup/spatialscout.readme_summary: Delegated investigation plans controls, recomputes counts with deterministic code, reads literature via sub-agents to produce evidence-backed leads. Python configs and artifacts pipeline. Powered by Meta models for planning and claims.

joelindra/cosmos_seeker.summary: Autonomous agent fleet that finds and simulates rare anomalies in SDSS and DESI sky surveys
joelindra/cosmos_seeker.readme_summary: Multi-layer discovery engine over SDSS/DESI imaging for rare cosmic anomalies. Stack is Next.js 14 with Three.js frontend, FastAPI backend, Docker Compose and notebooks. Integrates 6 Meta Model APIs plus Spark open-weight models.

adkbbx/GTM_Shortlist.summary: Local-first tool that discovers B2B company candidates with dated evidence for seller review
adkbbx/GTM_Shortlist.readme_summary: Open-source discovery and research workflow for B2B sellers with accept/reject review and CSV/JSON export. Local app runs from source or Docker with sample data requiring no keys. Uses evidence-grounded pipeline with dated source passages.

cyyeong/mykx.summary: AI tutor that turns kids interests into lessons and updates parents
cyyeong/mykx.readme_summary: myKx provides Kix sidekicks that tutor children in worlds they love and report progress to parents. Built with Next.js app/components stack during the hackathon. Uses Meta Muse models for tutoring, personalization, and parent summaries.

haodaz/coco.summary: Pet AI twin built only from photo Memory Prints that cites sources
haodaz/coco.readme_summary: Cocoverse builds a pet AI twin from user photo Memory Print cards that answers in pet voice with citations. Stack is Next.js, Supabase, and Modal backend at cocoverse.app. Uses Muse models for chat and Muse Image for demo pet photos.

sadiadvertising-ship-it/testigos-del-bol.summary: Turns witness fireball videos into trajectory, speed and verdict
sadiadvertising-ship-it/testigos-del-bol.readme_summary: Agent orients phone/dashcam video against map landmarks then triangulates fireball trajectory with error bars and meteor vs reentry verdict. Python + web 3D viewer, validated on Chelyabinsk. Uses Muse Spark reasoning and SAM 3.1 vision.

AgentSafeLabs/safelabs-guard.summary: Runtime guardrail that verifies agent perception before action
AgentSafeLabs/safelabs-guard.readme_summary: SafeLabs Guard checks multimodal agent perception against a deterministic ledger to block spoofed vision/audio. Next.js 15 + TypeScript app with bench and docs. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

normantaipei/SnapPipe.summary: Sports photo ingest that picks decisive shots and drafts captions
normantaipei/SnapPipe.readme_summary: SnapPipe backs up camera photos in seconds, compares bursts, reads jersey numbers and writes IPTC captions. One LXC server per shoot with web review and ingest/worker pipeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for vision and JSON.

BrandonDucar/breakshift.summary: Simulated robotic workcell bench to challenge AI repair proposals.
BrandonDucar/breakshift.readme_summary: BREAKSHIFT is a simulated maintenance bay where users inspect components, replay recorded Meta-model repair proposals under changed conditions, and export replayable evidence. Hosted on Cloudflare Workers. Uses retained Meta-model outputs to test if plans still hold, withdrawing stale verdicts.

Misho205/Universal-Fiat-Crypto-Financial.summary: Merchant terminal for fiat orders and testnet crypto agreements
Misho205/Universal-Fiat-Crypto-Financial.readme_summary: HybridPay is a Next.js PWA terminal with dashboard, QR checkout, fiat sandbox, EVM Sepolia via viem, and conditional payment agreements. Backend sandbox on Modal with read-only AI assistant. Uses advisory AI with fallback-safe validation.

pranav-upd/Muse-MARKOV.summary: Reproducible GRPO loop that improves Muse Glimmer tool-calling from 0.63 to 0.725.
pranav-upd/Muse-MARKOV.readme_summary: MARKOV is a GRPO training loop that fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B for better tool calling. Evaluated on BFCL v4 with McNemar significance and Hugging Face demo. Starter and eval scripts with Modal RTX PRO 6000 FP4 training.

coldrazer/terraterm.summary: Oil terminal linking prices with satellite tank measurements
coldrazer/terraterm.readme_summary: TERRATERM pairs crude prices and news with satellite detection of Cushing tanks and EIA inventory. Keyboard-driven terminal with agent Q&A and sources. Uses Muse Wonder for models, SAM 3.1 for tank spotting, Muse Spark for checks.

mikkel/meta-glimmer-particle-slider.summary: LoRA slider controls for ParticleGAN generation via Muse Glimmer integration.
mikkel/meta-glimmer-particle-slider.readme_summary: Integrates upstream ParticleGAN with ridge LoRA distillation for slider controls. Modern glimmer_modern API reuses immutable upstream source for 0.9.4 training. Legacy glimmer_slider PG82 artifacts require separate legacy install.

wujotung9627-svg/last-one-out.summary: Browser horror walk through a generated Taiwanese school that mutates
wujotung9627-svg/last-one-out.readme_summary: Last One Out is a 5-minute bilingual 3D horror walk generated entirely by Meta models. Photos, mutations and scares render in browser with no install. Voice input at finale via microphone.

nicktwtw/psp-muse.summary: 2008 PSP-3000 homebrew that talks to Meta Muse via hold-to-talk voice
nicktwtw/psp-muse.readme_summary: Native PSP EBOOT client using Muse Gadgets Device SDK hatch-link BLE pairing. Linux host provisions identity, PSP sends encrypted mic audio to Muse and plays back TTS. Gives EOL hardware second life.

pianodiplomacy/casebrief.summary: Five-gate evidence control between AI output and human legal decisions
pianodiplomacy/casebrief.readme_summary: Evidence-control infrastructure enforcing bounded execution, artifact capture, deterministic contract validation, evidence review, and human authorization. Demoed on frozen synthetic fixture; human authority stays human.

LP167/carousel-agent.summary: Turns brand PDFs and voice briefs into quoted, human-approved IG carousels
LP167/carousel-agent.readme_summary: Read-plan-write-visuals-render pipeline where every sentence is source-quoted. Muse Spark reviews slide renders for cutoff before human sign-off. Python agent with config.yaml, replay and mocked publish.

gn00295120/rewear-studio.summary: Turns any outfit photo or video into a shoppable breakdown of similar items.
gn00295120/rewear-studio.readme_summary: Segments outfit photos into garment pieces and retrieves similar shoppable products. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for descriptions, Muse Image for previews. Includes web app and Shop this look Chrome extension.

EigenKai/lexvi.summary: Vietnamese tax assistant that cites the provision in force on the date asked.
EigenKai/lexvi.readme_summary: Answers Vietnamese tax questions with date-aware citations, amendment chains and new-regulation alerts. Web frontend plus Python backend with legal corpus retrieval. Uses Muse Spark via API to draft grounded Vietnamese answers with citations.

jaemin-jo/spark-muse.summary: Fast text-snapshot browser agent that batches actions per Muse call
jaemin-jo/spark-muse.readme_summary: Open-source Flow core running on Meta Muse via Model API or OpenRouter. Uses text control snapshots instead of screenshots, batching fill-click-press with look-on-demand. Desktop Spark AI browser loop.

adityaanilraut/cubicle-chaos.summary: Playable 3D Godot office sandbox with routines and physics chaos
adityaanilraut/cubicle-chaos.readme_summary: Godot 4.7 GDScript game where coworkers follow routines and objects are throwable. Developed with Meta Muse Code as coding assistant for implementation. No Meta API needed to play.

meschinidino/lobot.summary: Local workbench to inspect, steer, and verify behaviors inside open models.
meschinidino/lobot.readme_summary: lobot is a local neuron-steering workbench for open models like Llama 3.2 3B. It shows token-level neurons, applies steering doses with before/after forks, and creates behavior directions from text. A Muse Spark agent can run the read-steer-verify loop via the Meta API.

ssngurjar/marg-ai.summary: Voice-first WhatsApp guide for rural parents and teachers in Hindi and Braj
ssngurjar/marg-ai.readme_summary: Marg.ai delivers daily discovery activities for parents, curriculum-to-work links for teachers, and source-grounded answers for students via WhatsApp. Built with Python backend, Docker and Postgres/Alembic. Uses six Meta models with input/output safety checks including Muse voice and language models.

pfiecko/adsect.summary: Finds which ad elements drive purchases and sizes a controlled test to prove it.
pfiecko/adsect.readme_summary: Adsect decomposes Meta ads into visual, audio, text, and delivery elements linked to Shopify purchases. It generates single-element variants, verifies changes, and sizes controlled tests. Built on real spend data of $1.52M, 17,890 orders and 1,067 ads.

IndranilPalit24/AskFootage.summary: Ask plain-English questions about camera footage and get clips with proof.
IndranilPalit24/AskFootage.readme_summary: AskFootage indexes recorded camera footage and answers questions with matching clips on a timeline. It outlines objects with SAM 3.1 and shows measurements for each match. Muse Spark parses questions via the Meta Model API, with offline demo replays.

trivnvdev-41/saba-meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Turns creator video uploads into SEO articles with embeds and forum discussion
trivnvdev-41/saba-meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: SABA converts direct video uploads into SEO-ready articles with JSON-LD schema and official embeds. Stack is Flutter forum app, Next.js SSR/ISR web site, and workers for transcoding. Uses Meta AI models for transcription and article generation.

Mishallic/piece-of-mind.summary: Removes the painter from footage so the artwork's creation remains visible.
Mishallic/piece-of-mind.readme_summary: Piece of Mind films painting sessions and outputs clean artwork video using only aligned camera pixels. SAM 3.1 segments the painter and Muse Spark handles language interaction, with no generative image edits. Scripts verify every output pixel came from camera frames.

w7smycs778-creator/aibosspro-meta-brain.summary: AI front desk that answers, quotes, and drafts bookings for service shops.
w7smycs778-creator/aibosspro-meta-brain.readme_summary: AIBOSSPRO builds a structured business brain from owner voice or text using Muse Spark. Customers chat via panel or WhatsApp with verified replies, code-computed prices, and owner-approved bookings. SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Wonder support marketing content creation.

FX-DOVE/reelforge.summary: AI film studio turning one idea into screenplay, storyboard, voice track and MP4
FX-DOVE/reelforge.readme_summary: Next.js app with accounts and admin console that generates screenplay, cast bible, chained storyboard frames and continuity checks. Builds voice track and final MP4 for Shorts, TikTok, Reels and YouTube. Uses Meta Muse Wonder, Spark and Image models.

parvindd/aketud-verify.summary: Insurance Q&A that cites IRDAI rules or refuses when proof is missing.
parvindd/aketud-verify.readme_summary: Aketud Verify answers Indian insurance questions in Hindi, Hinglish and English. Muse Spark proposes answers and Muse Spark Open verifies them against 2024 IRDAI rule corpora. It refuses or flags fraud patterns when citations fail.

consultanything-tech/ProofPath.summary: Turns checkout criteria into human-approved browser tests with evidence.
consultanything-tech/ProofPath.readme_summary: ProofPath proposes semantic checks with muse-spark-1.3 for human review and snapshot approval. Playwright runs paired release comparisons with deterministic PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE verdicts. V2 adds evidence downloads, regression reuse, and bug packets.

rsaxena3011/cutline-studio.summary: Compares two video takes to flag continuity mismatches with frame evidence.
rsaxena3011/cutline-studio.readme_summary: Continuity checker for vertical video producers comparing two takes against a script brief. Ledger plus vision checks flag disagreements with exact frames for human accept/reject. Uses Muse Wonder for reasoning and Meta vision models, with evals and fixtures.

Hamna-Munir/FormFriend-AI.summary: Explains scholarship and internship forms with deadlines and checklists.
Hamna-Munir/FormFriend-AI.readme_summary: Upload a PDF or screenshot to get plain-language explanations, deadlines, eligibility and checklists. Answers cite quotes from the document to stay grounded. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Meta AI models.

mirzayasirabdullahbaig07/FormFriend-AI.summary: Explains scholarship and internship forms with deadlines and checklists.
mirzayasirabdullahbaig07/FormFriend-AI.readme_summary: Upload a PDF or screenshot to get plain-language explanations, deadlines, eligibility and checklists. Answers cite quotes from the document to stay grounded. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Meta AI models.

coded15/3D-architect.summary: Turns hand-drawn floor plans into shared interactive 3D home visualizations.
coded15/3D-architect.readme_summary: Homeowners upload a sketch plus plot size and style, Muse Spark interprets the plan and generates a 3D view. Gives family, architect and builder one picture to agree on before building. Next.js app built for Build for Your World with Muse Spark.

Surtsey19/movescope.summary: Turns a phone room video into moving inventory, volume and packing plan.
Surtsey19/movescope.readme_summary: Extracts frames from phone video, SAM 3.1 segments and tracks furniture, Muse Spark Vision names items and builds a room-by-room pack plan. Exports PDF and CSV customs inventory. Streamlit UI with Python deterministic volume tables.

theChrishna/Afterglow.summary: Voice cues and mood taps drive live stage lights, motion and lyric visuals.
theChrishna/Afterglow.readme_summary: Afterglow is a FastAPI stage engine where push-to-talk cues generate lighting and motion scenes. Supports camera silhouette and mock mode without API keys. Uses Meta Model API for transcription and scene refinement.

albertojbravo-art/Shift-Sight-Ops.summary: Warehouse copilot that forecasts shipping and recommends staffing moves.
albertojbravo-art/Shift-Sight-Ops.readme_summary: Copilot on warehouse data projecting on-time shipping and detecting stoppages from scan gaps. Deterministic Python engine computes numbers, recommends moves and drafts staffing posts. Built with Muse, web UI plus approval workflow.

kneblewskitomasz-sys/field-from-above.summary: Turns Polish parcel ID into NDVI maps, SAM masks, and field walk advice
kneblewskitomasz-sys/field-from-above.readme_summary: Local-first demo turning parcel boundary into dated cloud-masked Sentinel-2 NDVI/NDRE, orthophoto with SAM 3.1 masks, and fact-checked field note. Uses local Muse Glimmer 30B or Muse Spark 1.3 API.

dylancc5/dev-meta-ai-events-global-hacka.summary: Type a person description and get a beat-synced 9:16 edit that follows them
dylancc5/dev-meta-ai-events-global-hacka.readme_summary: FollowCut finds a described subject across clips with SAM 3.1, filters look-alikes and picks best moments with Muse Spark. Renderer cuts vertical video with subject in color and background gray. Web demo replays cached on-device runs.

pluto2060/neural-referee.summary: Verifier that locates first wrong step and faulty sublayer in weight-compiled computers
pluto2060/neural-referee.readme_summary: Targets silent corruption in Neural Computers compiled into transformer weights. Compares execution against expected steps to find first error and layer. Built with Muse Spark 1.3, Python referee package, demos and experiments.

Provokke/ghostlab.summary: Phone video becomes a tested physics twin for motion what-if play.
Provokke/ghostlab.readme_summary: Tracks moving objects from phone video, fits physics parameters, and validates on unseen footage to certify or refuse the twin. Python backend with web UI and synthetic sample clips. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for motion reasoning and verification.

raushan0007/awaaz-agent.summary: Voice civic complaints in Hindi/Hinglish with photo and tracking ID.

millZach/Sotto.summary: Desktop hub unifying Claude Code, Codex, Muse and more with dictation
millZach/Sotto.readme_summary: Sotto is a desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Muse and other coding clients in one sidebar with built-in dictation. Stack is desktop + multi-harness thread manager. It orchestrates Meta Muse and other agents.

BaptisteFaisy/vision.summary: Android app that sees surroundings and speaks descriptions for navigation
BaptisteFaisy/vision.readme_summary: iSee is a Kotlin/Compose Android app with CameraX, GPU backend, and FastAPI for visual assistance. It uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Depth Anything V2 for depth plus routing and Ray-Ban Meta SDK. Built during hackathon reusing open models and libraries.

ncchen99/pickfit.summary: Software advisor that installs and tests tools in sandbox before recommending
ncchen99/pickfit.readme_summary: Tests software in sandbox and returns verified install steps via web app and MCP for agents. Built with Muse Spark models for evaluation and recommendation. Python stack with pickfit.app, evals and replayable results.

pohunekd/means-of-compute.summary: Factory that runs coding agents on idle company hardware via work graph
pohunekd/means-of-compute.readme_summary: Coordinator turns goals into dependency graphs, dispatches to idle machines, audits with different model and merges on rules. Uses Muse Spark audit verdicts, MCP server, Rust crates and self-hosted loop.

I-am-Mr-Rookie/real2simulation.summary: Films physics experiments and replays them as editable 3D simulations
I-am-Mr-Rookie/real2simulation.readme_summary: Real2Simulation turns phone video of a room or experiment into an editable 3D lab with tracked motion and fitted models. Web 3D physics stack. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for measurement plus agent prompts.

r3dbars/shiptorio.summary: Pixel factory game over GitHub where issues become shipped pull requests
r3dbars/shiptorio.readme_summary: Shiptorio gamifies GitHub workflow as a pixel conveyor: issues move through Planner, Builder, Checks and Gate. Powered by Meta Muse Spark for planning and building. Human approves Ship it to merge real PRs.

gitgithan/conquercourse.summary: Ninja-warrior physics game turning real parks and streets into courses
gitgithan/conquercourse.readme_summary: ConquerCourse is a browser physics game where real parks and objects become ninja-warrior courses. Static web + shareable course JSON and ghost challenges. Uses Meta AI for course generation assistance.

Offline-Base/muse-muse.summary: Turns product notes into tested, filmed and deployed web apps automatically.
Offline-Base/muse-muse.readme_summary: Muse Muse uses Meta Muse models to build, test, film and deploy apps from notes plus inspiration. Includes lab that fine-tunes Muse Glimmer and publishes to Hugging Face. Next.js app with catalog, Docker and Vercel setup.

rwflan/framebound.summary: Checking layer that validates AI 2D animation consistency and guides repairs
rwflan/framebound.readme_summary: Framebound is the checking and evidence layer for an external animation agent. It measures shape, motion and appearance against bounds via MCP tools and returns repair instructions. Built with Python, MCP server, schemas and export pipelines using Muse models.

ruhu-inc/jana-meta.summary: Personal tutor that explains your own study materials with source links.
ruhu-inc/jana-meta.readme_summary: Helps adults study slides, notes, and docs with explanations, practice, and source checks. Coordinates agent roles with output checks and learner-controlled cloud/local memory routing. Uses Meta Muse models with Rust/Python components.

Yumstezy/aria.summary: Ableton co-producer that hears mix issues, fixes them and proves the result
Yumstezy/aria.readme_summary: Ableton Live device plus engine and ML backend that analyzes Main track for clashes. Muse Spark explains issues and applies fixes, then re-measures to confirm. Includes browser demo and install tooling for Live integration.

Athmeeya2006/Physicslens.summary: Turns phone video of motion into tested physics equations
Athmeeya2006/Physicslens.readme_summary: Converts phone video or machine logs into candidate equations then tests them by numerical simulation on held-out data. Python backend plus frontend with SAM 3.1 tracking; Meta open-weight reasoning model proposes equations.

jamesrosing/your-procedure-is-denied.summary: Public tracker of AI insurance denials with open appeal drafting tools
jamesrosing/your-procedure-is-denied.readme_summary: Documents AI-driven claim denials and defines the LITMUS standard for medical AI evaluation. Provides open-weight appeal letter drafting measured in public. Built as docs site with datasets, demo replay, and Meta AI for drafting.

anime-productions-love/ai-anime-generato.summary: Git-backed pipeline for anime characters, comics and storyboard generation
anime-productions-love/ai-anime-generato.readme_summary: Production system for reusable anime characters, environments, illustrations and comic pages via GitHub Actions workflows. Adds visual-reference conditioning and CPU LoRA training integration. Uses Meta image models with Python scripts and schemas.

bami-codes/BenchMate.summary: Muse Spark runs forecast-first fault diagnosis on real Arduino circuits with verified logs
bami-codes/BenchMate.readme_summary: BenchMate lets Muse Spark read schematics and choose multimeter experiments on real boards. Forecasts are frozen before measurement and checked by code, with sealed faults and offline-verifiable records. Python firmware plus web demo site document five planted-fault cases.

Meta-Project2026/Metamorph.summary: Migrates legacy PHP services to TypeScript with independent behavior verification.
Meta-Project2026/Metamorph.readme_summary: Generates TypeScript candidates from pinned PHP source using Muse Spark 1.3 on Meta Model API. Runs an independent Oracle with build, HTTP, and DB-state checks plus hash-pinned evidence. Monorepo with apps/packages using pnpm and TypeScript.

angaritamd/oncall-resident.summary: Mobile chat assistant that prepares radiology studies over DICOMweb
angaritamd/oncall-resident.readme_summary: On-call radiology resident as mobile chat app connected via DICOMweb for study preparation and discussion. Uses Muse Glimmer on Modal with RAD-QC v5 LoRA check and Muse Spark fallback. Workflow tool only; radiologist signs.

sivat241meta/marketmate.summary: Converts stall video or voice prices into shop page, bills and WhatsApp
sivat241meta/marketmate.readme_summary: MarketMate turns Tamil, Hindi or English stall video or voice into checked price list, shop page, WhatsApp messages and day close. Prices come only from seller voice. Built with Python, Modal hosting and Meta AI for transcription and extraction.

luis-heinriq13/opencat-new.summary: Local-first desktop workspace giving each AI coding agent its own chat and tools
luis-heinriq13/opencat-new.readme_summary: OpenBot is a local-first desktop app for persistent AI teammates with per-agent workspaces, queues, file transfer and messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode and others via ACP. Uses Meta AI models for orchestration inside the desktop workflow.

paat/ai-launchpad.summary: MCP gateway turning an SME owner's AI assistant into a business back-office helper
paat/ai-launchpad.readme_summary: AI Launchpad connects ChatGPT, Claude and Meta models to Estonian SME tools via an owner-only HTTPS MCP gateway. Focuses on next-best-action, time saved and reliable back-office automation. Pilot tested with Meta/Baseten path and synthetic data.

saikat344/HeroGen.summary: Sketch or sentence to game-ready Roblox R15 3D hero
saikat344/HeroGen.readme_summary: HeroGen converts a sketch or prompt into a textured, rigged Roblox hero with high/low LODs and rig gates. Python pipeline on Modal with tests and tools. Uses Muse Image, SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, SAM 3D Objects/Body and Sapiens 2.

LeventAksakal/talk-tracks.summary: Live talks with subscribable AI tracks for captions, translation and recaps
LeventAksakal/talk-tracks.readme_summary: Speaker broadcasts from browser, viewers watch in a player with AI publishers for captions, translations, slide descriptions and chapters. Built on Media over QUIC with WebSocket fallback, agents run only when watched. Same tracks power rewind and recordings.

IssueLab-Inc/ORCA.summary: AI coordinator that proposes proven geometry fixes for colliding 3D designs
IssueLab-Inc/ORCA.readme_summary: ORCA is an AI design coordinator where Muse models propose model edits for clashing building and machine designs. Each fix is proven with geometry checks before reaching the user. Observe, Resolve, Check, Apply workflow with spend-tracked prompts.

DrAhmed7887/anamnesis.summary: Voice note plus pill-pack photos in, one-page linked brief for clinicians out
DrAhmed7887/anamnesis.readme_summary: Anamnesis ingests patient voice notes and medicine-pack photos to generate a one-page clinician brief with audio-turn and image-region citations. Built with Muse Code and Meta open-weight models. Staged tests only, no medical advice or clinical use.

agustindiazcano/waggle-agents-meta-muse.summary: Safety control plane for LLM-coordinated warehouse robot fleets with 3D viewer.
agustindiazcano/waggle-agents-meta-muse.readme_summary: Combines seeded simulator, motion control layer, Postgres coordination and MCP tool boundary. Deterministic code retains motion and permission control with model review. Built with Muse Spark Open and 3D viewer.

damli40/atlas.summary: Visualizes what AI-written code does before you trust it, explained by AI
damli40/atlas.readme_summary: Atlas draws AI-written code as a per-function machine diagram with plain-English explanation from Muse Wonder. Web demo on Fly.io with judge-code budgets and sample files. Helps review untrusted generated code quickly.

btsouth/player-two.summary: Voice co-op partner that reads games aloud and presses buttons on request.
btsouth/player-two.readme_summary: Player Two helps blind and motor-impaired gamers by reading the game window, answering aloud and sending controller input. Uses local router with fast path and Muse Spark tool loop. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and SAM 3.1 for screen vision.

Antoinegtir/sparkflow.summary: Turns text or sketches into tested React Native apps with auto screenshots.
Antoinegtir/sparkflow.readme_summary: Agent plans a mobile app, builds it in React Native, screenshots screens and self-fixes mismatches. Runs cloud preview with Expo Go plus local iOS Simulator and Android emulator. Uses Meta Muse models for planning and codegen.

blind05/clearswath.summary: Drone weed maps plus label rules to spray only where both agree.
blind05/clearswath.readme_summary: ClearSwath combines weed detection maps with pesticide label constraints for spot-spray decisions. Click map spots to see quoted label sentences and application record. Replays saved real runs with FastAPI backend and synthetic voice narration.

QuantumGuy99/Meta-Hacks.summary: AI interviewer that watches live coding and scores how you engineer
QuantumGuy99/Meta-Hacks.readme_summary: Crucible offers Live Coding Interview and Project Defense modes with a live AI interviewer that tracks edits and voice. It provides replay with synced code, audio and nudges plus scored feedback and merge-gate verdicts. It uses Meta Muse models for interview dialogue, code audit and evaluation.

dorangao/explainbackapp.summary: Turns questions or sketches into bilingual interactive predict-test lessons
dorangao/explainbackapp.readme_summary: ExplainBack generates reviewable Chinese-English interactive lessons with predict, experiment and explain steps. Muse drafts and revises lessons while app code validates contracts and computes outputs. Deployed at explainback.app.

EdwardTarantulo/Yezatas.summary: Self-hosted assistant to optimize, translate, and caption YouTube channels
EdwardTarantulo/Yezatas.readme_summary: Self-hosted Python assistant that audits titles, descriptions, chapters, and translations for small channels. Uses 8 Meta models for optimization and captioning with local runs and human approval before publishing.

bonno-420/meta-hackathon-lab.summary: Loop-based platform for autonomous app generation and model verification runs.
bonno-420/meta-hackathon-lab.readme_summary: Loopwright runs recorded autonomous development loops for extraction, generation and checks. Pipeline runs on Meta Model API with muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-image-1.0. Each loop record states model and endpoint for verification.

havidaqoma/autosolar-researcher.summary: Generates checked solar-plus-battery pre-feasibility studies for diesel islands
havidaqoma/autosolar-researcher.readme_summary: AutoSolar Researcher simulates hourly PV, battery and diesel across designs to compute LCOE, fuel and CO2 savings. It fuses four weather sources, cited costs and a published-study check with second-model review. It uses Muse Spark, Glimmer, Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code.

byemir/PatchPilot.summary: Repairs Python breakage after upgrades only if visible and hidden gates pass
byemir/PatchPilot.readme_summary: PatchPilot finds Python functions that silently change results after pandas and NumPy upgrades and proposes repairs. A local browser app runs visible, hidden and differential gates before writing patches. It runs Meta Muse models including Glimmer locally and Spark Open via hosts.

mikheilkuzmidi/lumen.summary: Sentence-guided photo editor that plans, segments, redraws and self-checks
mikheilkuzmidi/lumen.readme_summary: Lumen Agent edits single photos or full libraries from text or voice instructions. Muse Spark plans and verifies, SAM 3.1 segments by name/box/points, Muse Image inpaints, Muse Voice transcribes. Swift package with undoable layers.

commit-to-Noma/Verityn.summary: STEM lab where students predict first, then test ideas in simulator
commit-to-Noma/Verityn.readme_summary: Interactive STEM lab that requires prediction before simulation and removes coaching for recall. React+Vite frontend with Flask backend and guided experiments. Uses Muse models to coach reasoning and assess understanding.

JamieT206/flashwatch.summary: Forecasts flash drought risk in 1-2 weeks and advises irrigation actions
JamieT206/flashwatch.readme_summary: FlashWatch forecasts soil drought probability for Corn Belt farms and recommends irrigation, chemical and feed actions. AI agents deliver text advice, find pivots from aerial photos and control pivots on approval. It uses Meta models with live feed site and saved agent runs.

usecorehq/tally.summary: Photo-to-inventory stock-taking app for small merchants to count stock
usecorehq/tally.readme_summary: Photo-to-inventory and stock-taking for Nigerian SMEs. Web portal and Flutter mobile app use Muse Spark for agent scan and SAM 3.1 for shelf crops, synced to shared Supabase with Qore Catalog feedback loop.

touchetpe/hardread.summary: Engine review for Pokemon Showdown replays that separates luck from decisions.
touchetpe/hardread.readme_summary: Analyzes Gen 9 OU Showdown replays with search over hidden sets to estimate luck vs skill per turn. A game engine produces luck meter and decisions; Muse Glimmer only explains results. Static web app with saved showcases.

seandmccue/proto-lab.summary: Turns plain-English prompts into testable 3D mechanical assemblies.
seandmccue/proto-lab.readme_summary: ProtoLab generates connected 3D assemblies from text, runs physics tests and lets Muse revise from measured results. Web app with gallery and replay links for engineering exploration. Uses Meta Muse models for generative design and repair loop.

ysant77/empiraxis.summary: Evidence-first science agent that proposes studies and verifies claims with code
ysant77/empiraxis.readme_summary: Human-supervised research prototype on environmental data using Meta open-weight models. Models propose methods, tools acquire data, independent code evaluates evidence. Python package and CLI with evals and replay examples.

jwbaba-ai/lantern-keep.summary: Roblox co-op castle defense with AI director that designs next wave
jwbaba-ai/lantern-keep.readme_summary: 1-4 player co-op castle defense on Roblox with Day and wave progression. AI director adapts waves from team play and NPC companions recall last match, built with Luau and schemas.

AyanBhardwaj1/Walk-Free.summary: Heat-aware 3D walking planner that finds the shadiest route in your city
AyanBhardwaj1/Walk-Free.readme_summary: React Three.js app visualizes street heat by hour and plans shady walks. TypeScript Express API with Capacitor mobile. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for optional walk planning.

itskshivam1318/muse-design-curator.summary: Design board that segments references part-by-part for targeted edits
itskshivam1318/muse-design-curator.readme_summary: FastAPI + React 19 board where Muse Spark reads designs, SAM 3.1 segments parts, and Muse Image redraws selected parts. MCP server, corpus and 1,913 tests. Lets users change one element while preserving rest.

slubbles/explanimate.summary: Converts repos, articles or topics into narrated whiteboard explainer videos.
slubbles/explanimate.readme_summary: Explanimate reads a GitHub repo or article and renders a short narrated whiteboard video with gallery and docs. Web architecture with automated pipeline and CI. Uses Meta Muse models for script, visuals and narration planning.

alekslime/Resona.summary: Voice tutor that photographs diagrams and explains them through spoken conversation.
alekslime/Resona.readme_summary: Flutter mobile app where users photograph or select images and hold voice conversations about them. Includes six lessons, offline quizzes, and spoken plus text answers for accessibility. Uses Meta AI vision and voice models for description and tutoring.

farhanjamal2002-blip/-evidencetrail.summary: CV evidence reviewer that checks who actually did quoted work
farhanjamal2002-blip/-evidencetrail.readme_summary: CV evidence reviewer that traces quotes to proof and flags unsupported claims. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 with saved replays, judge video and calibration, deployed as Python app on Render.

Yatsuiii/stillhere.summary: Plans story-listening fMRI studies and forecasts brain responses before scanning
Yatsuiii/stillhere.readme_summary: StillHere helps plan auditory story fMRI studies and validate stimulus designs pre-scan. It uses a Next.js app with API forecasting and public scan datasets. It uses Meta's TRIBE v2 to forecast hearing and language responses for new stories.

safwat-fathi/whiteboard-ai-companion.summary: Infinite whiteboard tutor that explains textbooks with diagrams and citations
safwat-fathi/whiteboard-ai-companion.readme_summary: Upload books and chat with AI tutor on shared infinite canvas with text, LaTeX, diagrams and page citations. Supports drawing, selection Q&A and navigation. Monorepo with apps, Docker Compose and e2e tests.

matthiasdruhl/ForeCode.summary: Researches software architecture with future requirements and verified hypotheses
matthiasdruhl/ForeCode.readme_summary: ForeCode guides architecture decisions through a six-chapter research journey and Time Machine inspection. It is a Next.js app with local import, workspaces, and tournament verification. It uses Meta-generated hypotheses with independent verification checks.

relux-works/hybrid-inference.summary: Splits LLM inference with server prefill and client decode for faster serving
relux-works/hybrid-inference.readme_summary: Hybrid-inference is a llama.cpp fork prototyping hybrid prefill/decode inference. It adds vLLM bridge tools, native CPU reader, node protocol and bench guides. It optimizes Llama model serving across GPU server and client devices.

rmanish2000-del/proofshot-hackathon.summary: Verifies image authenticity with gated pipeline, receipts, and try-on demo
rmanish2000-del/proofshot-hackathon.readme_summary: ProofShot is a verification pipeline with upload, gate checks, receipt chain, and verify page. It includes judge, shop, and virtual try-on pages deployed on Hugging Face Spaces. It uses Meta AI models to detect synthetic images and audit claims.

vvennela/samgo.summary: Turns a photo of any machine into a working buildable LEGO model
vvennela/samgo.readme_summary: SAMgo converts a photo of a machine into a functional LEGO model with moving parts. It uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SAM 3D for geometry, and Python BrickGPT pipeline. It uses Muse Spark and fine-tuned Muse Glimmer for LEGO assembly reasoning.

Pickleft/Bio-Computational.summary: Deterministic spiking neural network simulating a living brain with chemistry
Pickleft/Bio-Computational.readme_summary: Bio-Computational builds a deterministic Izhikevich spiking network with Dale's law and neurotransmitters. It wires 52 literature-based cognitive systems in C# .NET into one continuous life. It explores artificial life and emotion without LLM chat prompts.

Sanjeevlabs/Nearer.summary: Voice-first shared window keeping distant families connected without monitoring
Sanjeevlabs/Nearer.readme_summary: Nearer is a voice-first mobile app connecting parents and children across homes with lamps, doors, and memories. It uses Capacitor iOS/Android with Cloudflare Worker backend. It uses Muse for Hindi voice transcription, recipes, and family book search.

Lyquifyy/setecho.summary: iPhone coach app that logs workouts by voice and auto-fills weekly check-ins
Lyquifyy/setecho.readme_summary: Setecho removes coaching paperwork for athletes and human coaches. The iOS + watchOS app counts reps, syncs scale and food data, and fills check-ins by voice. It uses Meta AI models for speech logging, rep counting, and progress summaries.

Otd-llc/hex-agent.summary: Turns one sentence into a checked Hex Cluster planter build in live configurator
Otd-llc/hex-agent.readme_summary: Hex-agent converts briefs like strawberry tower for balcony into valid Hex Cluster builds. Muse models plan the configuration and drive the existing web configurator with constraint checking. Includes paper, share links and 5/5 demo suite evaluation.

koushikdatascience-netizen/SentinelX.summary: AI business twin that researches opportunities and runs approved actions
koushikdatascience-netizen/SentinelX.readme_summary: SentinelX builds a Visual Business Twin from owner brief and website, then runs Opportunity Hunter and Creative Studio. Stack is backend + frontend with docker-compose and supervised agents. Uses Meta text, vision, image and Voice-to-Action with approval-gated self-hosted delivery.

bhoot-biswas/listsnap-app.summary: Product photo to Shopify listing and studio photos in English and Bangla
bhoot-biswas/listsnap-app.readme_summary: ListSnap turns one photo, voice note or video into a Shopify/WooCommerce draft with listing, cutouts, studio photos and reel. Full-stack store app with DB. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 for cutouts and Muse Image for photos.

rnorlund/MetaLesionLab.summary: Picture-naming research kit with lesion experiments on image models
rnorlund/MetaLesionLab.readme_summary: Provides rights-free stimuli and automatic scoring for aphasia picture-naming research. Python web app with Docker deploy. Uses Muse Glimmer lesions and Muse Image to study model vs human concepts.

rouftom/sarkiai-policy-sandbox-meta.summary: Multi-agent engine for policy-grounded government data-incident response.
rouftom/sarkiai-policy-sandbox-meta.readme_summary: Mandated agents guide incident response under local laws with policy grounding. Built with Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API. Includes live demo, vercel deployment and audit trails.

Orbit-X-Online/orbit-x.summary: Personal health record hub with evidence-linked explanations and FHIR exchange.
Orbit-X-Online/orbit-x.readme_summary: Orbit-X keeps personal health data in one place, explains patterns with evidence links, and exchanges a limited FHIR R4 subset with caregiver alerts. Deterministic code handles safety, AI only rewords facts. Cloudflare Workers MVP for supervised pilot with synthetic data.

Serxav/fixscribe.summary: Films a phone repair once and turns it into a live step-by-step visual guide
Serxav/fixscribe.readme_summary: Turns repair video into step guides with SAM 3.1 object cutouts and live camera coaching. Python app with domains, prompts and evals. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Voice and Wonder via Meta Model API.

Ankit6149/second-source.summary: Rebuilds black-box behavior as evidence-tested substitute implementation
Ankit6149/second-source.readme_summary: Second Source observes a site behavior then separately re-implements it with comparative evidence reports and experiments. Vercel app + workspace with browser-slice harness. Uses Muse models for analysis and verification contrast.

Tokiarivelo/mitsinjo-grid.summary: 3D digital twin simulating rural solar microgrid flows with AI decision support.
Tokiarivelo/mitsinjo-grid.readme_summary: Mitsinjo Grid simulates 24-hour solar generation, battery storage and load-shedding for rural microgrids with Meta AI copilot advice. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, Three.js, TypeScript in Turborepo with Vitest and Playwright. Uses simulated data only.

KNIGHT-AI-AV/dandelist.summary: Wishlist app that finds real prices and plans when you can afford each goal
KNIGHT-AI-AV/dandelist.readme_summary: Dandelist turns wishlists into costed plans by finding live seller prices and monthly upkeep. Monorepo with apps, packages and infra running on iPhone, Android and web from one codebase. Uses an AI shopping agent for price lookup and affordability timing.

SiddharthManjul/Brier.summary: Predicts robot eval regressions to select costly simulations under risk policy
SiddharthManjul/Brier.readme_summary: Brier predicts post-policy-change regressions and selects simulations under calibrated risk. Rust + Python with 60k episodes, 5k Parquet keys, single-epoch Glimmer fine-tune for $2.18. Uses Muse Glimmer fine-tune with ECE calibration, deployment on hold.

toskaman/openbridge.summary: Local device fabric turning TVs, phones and sensors into one permission-aware AI system.
toskaman/openbridge.readme_summary: Multi-transport discovery fabric using mDNS, SSDP, ADB and BLE relays with transactional undo. Permission-aware orchestration across disconnected hardware. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B locally and Meta MMS-TTS for narration.

ak9381/wattnot.summary: Agent that trims LLM serving energy while enforcing quality gates
ak9381/wattnot.readme_summary: WattNot tries one serving change at a time like power caps, FP8, and caching, metering GPU joules and keeping only quality-passing changes. Each kept change yields signed hash-chained receipts. Runs Muse Glimmer 30B on vLLM and Muse Spark Open.

Walter102202/colabora-si.summary: Local-first Notion-style workspace where humans and MCP agents co-edit the same pages.
Walter102202/colabora-si.readme_summary: Block editor with page tree, databases, comments and real-time sync plus MCP server for agents. Tasks, permissions and history live in workspace with visible attribution. Built-in Trama agent runs on Meta Muse Wonder.

EricHoangNV/autobridge.summary: Engine that builds connectors from docs, monitors drift and auto-repairs with verification.
EricHoangNV/autobridge.readme_summary: Compiles declarative connectors from vendor docs and runs scheduled syncs with Complete/Degraded/Blocked status. Repairs drift via L0-L4 ladder from rules to frontier model behind trust boundary. Uses small and frontier models for repair with Decimal money handling.

mrcoven94/mano.summary: Text-message assistant that reads benefit letters and drafts renewals
mrcoven94/mano.readme_summary: Mano is a text line for public benefits renewal that reads letter photos and files only after user approval. Stack spans web app, agent engine, guardian checks, and sandbox agency portal. It is built on Meta Muse models with logged model calls.

SI-Thor/builder-ide.summary: Avatar-based game IDE where in-world agent builders generate worlds overnight.
SI-Thor/builder-ide.readme_summary: Runs Infinigen and Blender 4.2 on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor for procedural generation and Cycles rendering. Headless IDE lets avatar builders work overnight and learn user taste. Uses Meta AI models via ship computer for task extension.

FikriAlfaraby/openbot.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent multi-agent teammates
FikriAlfaraby/openbot.readme_summary: Gives each agent workspace, queues, file transfer, browser and messaging. Supports Codex, Claude Code, Grok, Gemini via ACP. Local-first TypeScript desktop app with agent-to-agent chat.

ernanhughes/alive.summary: Persistent workspace where Muse Spark keeps project memory across sessions
ernanhughes/alive.readme_summary: ALIVE stores approved sources, conversations, workflow runs and feedback for long-term projects. Backend in Python with Docker and Alembic, frontend workspace UI persists across restarts. Uses Meta Muse Spark as the acting model with research mode boundaries.

satisfymath/unbidden-ai.summary: Proactive agent that proves fixes in sandbox and opens PRs with evidence
satisfymath/unbidden-ai.readme_summary: Autonomous engineering agent monitors codebase, validates improvements in sandbox. Python 3.12 with bench, evals and architecture docs. Uses Meta models for code analysis and proposals.

rhys-looma/Usher.summary: Script tag and protocol that lets sites safely control AI agents on forms.
rhys-looma/Usher.readme_summary: Usher gives websites audited AI access to forms via one script tag, with owner-written rules and session visibility. Stack includes registry service, mock-site, Docker deploy and evals. Uses MCP to expose site assistants in Claude and ChatGPT without building APIs.

TriadStudios/owl.summary: Camera + switch monitor that verifies rack cables before you unplug the wrong one
TriadStudios/owl.readme_summary: Overwatch for Wiring and Links checks maintenance tickets against live switch state and camera vision. Go service with perception, policy and relay layers uses SAM 3.1 for cable segmentation and hands monitoring to warn before wrong pulls.

allansande74-design/cargolinx.summary: Offline-first freight desk for East Africa with landed cost and tracking
allansande74-design/cargolinx.readme_summary: CargoLinx provides itemized landed cost, offline quoting and tracking for East African corridors. Deterministic engine with tests plus Cloudflare Workers desk that works without connectivity. Built on Meta Muse models with static frontend.

Amaculis/AgentWarden.summary: Semantic firewall that allows, denies or asks before coding agents act
Amaculis/AgentWarden.readme_summary: AgentWarden sits between coding agent and machine with deterministic rules, local Llama 3.1 8B judge and Muse Spark escalation. Scans tool calls and file reads for prompt injection, fails closed, with evals and hooks.

loom-fun/loom-skills.summary: Claude Code skills to install, serve and port models on AMD Loom
loom-fun/loom-skills.readme_summary: Plugin of Claude Code skills for AMD Loom hrx-loom compiler, runtime and loom-serve. Covers SDK install, LLM/ASR/TTS serving, GGUF porting, optimization and benchmarking on Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo.

btokne-auth/suri.summary: Photo document checker that pre-validates paperwork before office visits
btokne-auth/suri.readme_summary: Suri reads document photos, cross-checks names and requirements against office rules, and asks for fixes. Next.js app on Vercel uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API, human always decides.

petar227p/npc-workshop.summary: Authoring tool for LLM NPCs where a ledger enforces game rules
petar227p/npc-workshop.readme_summary: NPC Workshop lets authors create Muse-based game characters where models propose dialogue and actions. A deterministic ledger decides outcomes with testing and eval harness. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Spark Open, Image and Voice Transcribe.

wellytg/meta-hackathon-shadowfenced.summary: Zero-trust proxy that redacts keys and PII before prompts reach any AI model
wellytg/meta-hackathon-shadowfenced.readme_summary: Shadowfenced is a Python guard between users and AI that blocks secrets and swaps PII for placeholders. It uses Muse Glimmer on GPU for local detection and Muse Spark/Code in cloud with eval corpus.

jamiedarville/covertlens.summary: Inline steganalysis gate that screens agent-shared images for hidden data channels
jamiedarville/covertlens.readme_summary: CovertLens intercepts inter-agent images at the artifact store and scores original bytes across LSB, JPEG DCT, metadata and geometric channels. A verdict ladder (log, flag, quarantine, fail-run) gates delivery and appends findings to the run trace. Built with Python service, Docker and evaluation harness integration.

harrison0725/Landfall.summary: Turns post-disaster aerial photos into draft FEMA damage assessments
harrison0725/Landfall.readme_summary: Landfall compares pre- and post-storm building imagery, estimates flood depth, and sorts structures into FEMA Preliminary Damage Assessment categories with evidence. Provides map UI, agent planner and county report. Built during hackathon with Python app, evals and Docker deploy.

jaydonnnk/backfill.summary: Lets buyer agents jointly unlock cafe off-peak offers within limits
jaydonnnk/backfill.readme_summary: Next.js buyer/merchant flow where cafes publish quiet-hour offers and agents propose constraints. Requires separate owner approval before synthetic checkout. Uses Muse Spark for extraction, Muse Wonder for terms and Glimmer for constraints.

NickArmstrong04/uncrumple.summary: Reconstructs crumpling forces from sheet shape and photos via inverse simulation
NickArmstrong04/uncrumple.readme_summary: Simulates cloth deformation, learns inverse shape-to-force mapping, and verifies by re-simulation. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, VGGT for 3D geometry, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, plus SAM 3 and DINOv2 ablations.

sahil1/bridge.summary: Runs Claude, Codex, Gemini and Copilot coding agents side-by-side in one window
sahil1/bridge.readme_summary: Local chief-of-staff router that orchestrates parallel coding agents via screen reading and auto-typing. Runs on-device across macOS, Windows, Linux and Android with Spaces for project organization.

joeykokinda/helpa.summary: Point phone at broken appliance to get 3D guided repair steps
joeykokinda/helpa.readme_summary: Identifies exact machine model from sticker photo, researches repair and shows steps on 3D model with voice and photo verification. Built solo during hackathon. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

utibe-ettebong/Persuna.summary: Trains a personal agent from before-after examples to draft in your style
utibe-ettebong/Persuna.readme_summary: Learns user writing style from corrections to turn raw meeting notes into finished minutes. Web app with Better Auth, desktop apps for Mac and Windows with auto-update, plus profile memory and coaching.

joshuakarthik2005/Walkdown.summary: Agent for plant walkdowns that reviews facility footage for safety and defects
joshuakarthik2005/Walkdown.readme_summary: Analyzes refinery and plant walkthrough footage to flag anomalies and summarize condition. Frontend on Vercel with Python backend, Modal apps and benchmark suite. Uses Meta Muse vision models for inspection reasoning.

Danny-WanKenobi/growUP.summary: Owner cockpit chat with retained-record library and human review hold
Danny-WanKenobi/growUP.readme_summary: Web app with responsive shell, server-side chat persistence, search and retained-record library. Includes hold-for-human-review, safeguards and synthetic viewer. Uses Meta AI models for dossier inspection workflow.

angelinadegay/meta-ai-simgate.summary: Plain-language gateway that builds and runs physics simulations in the browser.
angelinadegay/meta-ai-simgate.readme_summary: Agent team picks simulator, builds world, checks physics and runs live with explanation. Python server with MuJoCo and Docker using Muse models for planning and world generation.

aaron0eidt/paper-tour.summary: Narrated visual tours that teach any PDF by pointing at the exact text
aaron0eidt/paper-tour.readme_summary: Turns PDFs into grounded tutors with sentence-level highlights, figure zooms, and spoken Q&A anchored to document geometry. Pipeline: ingestion to doc.json, Muse Spark planning, visual plan rendering. Stack with Docker, player and ingest services.

GLDRoger/inkwell.summary: Diary notebook where Scout, Wren and Atlas agents read, write and organize
GLDRoger/inkwell.readme_summary: Agent notebook on Meta Muse Wonder where three agents research, draft and organize pages. Live map UI shows footprints and wet-ink edits, plus rearrangement for queries with widgets and pen selection.

sproutjeph/snapLabNg.summary: Snaps WAEC physics questions to auto-build interactive 3D lab benches
sproutjeph/snapLabNg.readme_summary: Converts WAEC physics practical photos into 3D experiments with Watch, Practise and Exam modes and WAEC-style marking. Built for Nigerian WASSCE prep with Firebase hosting, demo video and solo hackathon build.

DavidNichols1/TLDR.summary: Native iOS group chat that catches you up on 300 missed messages in seconds.
DavidNichols1/TLDR.readme_summary: Cetchup is a native iOS group chat with integrated summarization via Muse Spark. Tap Catch me up to get plans, money, open questions and mentions with links to source messages. Built with Swift, Supabase backend and Meta Muse Spark.

VKirill/muse-ai-connector.summary: Registers Muse web app as a chat provider with local tools and MCP
VKirill/muse-ai-connector.readme_summary: Connector exposes Muse (muse.ai) as a BB provider via ACP. It drives signed-in Chrome profiles, routes prompts to Muse side chats, runs local tools and MCP servers, and streams replies back. Requires Node 22+ and Chrome.

TCPCore/keel.summary: CI gate that scans fine-tuned checkpoints against base for drift and safety
TCPCore/keel.readme_summary: Keel is a checkpoint validity harness that compares derivatives to base models and returns a validity card with exit codes. Built with Docker, Python and Hugging Face demo. Uses Meta open-weight models for base comparison and structural signature analysis.

mikewhite1192-byte/ledgerline.summary: AI back office for trucking carriers handling advances, invoices, and payouts
mikewhite1192-byte/ledgerline.readme_summary: AI operator for a trucking money desk that processes advances, invoices, settlements and payouts. Built with Next.js, Postgres and QuickBooks Online sandbox integration. Uses Meta models to check requests, explain exceptions and propose actions for human approval.

AdilkhanEEAIR/dukon.summary: Shelf-monitoring app that spots empty shelves and refills via suppliers
AdilkhanEEAIR/dukon.readme_summary: Dukon makes empty shelves visible and refills them via WhatsApp suppliers. Uses SAM 3.1 for shelf vision, Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe for input. Live web app with demo video, built for Build for Your World indie track.

LaurenteEber/tupaqnin.summary: Co-writing harness where AI records decisions and humans approve key choices
LaurenteEber/tupaqnin.readme_summary: Go harness for writing defensible documents with an AI agent that logs tradeoffs and sources. Presents key choices as decision cards with a single approval gate. Uses Meta models for drafting, proposing and tracking decisions.

Rishi943/tessa.summary: Agent that searches TESS light curves for small planets and publishes predictions.
Rishi943/tessa.readme_summary: Tessa searches public NASA TESS data on nearby K/M dwarfs, explains dips, and outputs testable planet predictions with case files and 3D map. Pipeline includes agent, pipeline, finetune and serve components plus hosted site. It uses Muse Spark for Q&A and a fine-tuned Glimmer vetter v10 model.

Jack-261108/CLIProxyAPI.summary: Local proxy giving OpenAI-compatible API for CLI model accounts
Jack-261108/CLIProxyAPI.readme_summary: CLIProxyAPI is a Go proxy server exposing OpenAI, Gemini and Claude-compatible endpoints for CLI providers. It multiplexes multiple CLI accounts locally for use from any SDK or client. Ships with Docker and desktop client support.

Shaivpidadi/second-look.summary: Glasses read warehouse papers and block mismatched form entries
Shaivpidadi/second-look.readme_summary: Second Look pairs Ray-Ban Meta glasses via Android app to a receiving form. Device frames and typed values go to a server where Muse Spark reads the paper and blocks submit on mismatch with a fix. Monorepo with apps, packages, and eval.

aymenawel/Argus.summary: Webcam lab partner that measures experiments and judges hypotheses
aymenawel/Argus.readme_summary: Argus watches bench experiments via webcam or USB microscope through a Plan-Watch-Measure-Judge loop. It uses SAM for segmentation, extracts real-unit readings, fits curves, and suggests the next run. Web app with public read-only replay.

lightofbaldr/nomos-interp-kernel.summary: Local lab to watch and steer Muse-Glimmer internals while it acts as agent
lightofbaldr/nomos-interp-kernel.readme_summary: Glimmer Lab runs open-weights Muse-Glimmer-30B on a custom Mojo inference kernel with activation readouts and steering. Includes a durable Pi agent, web lab UI, and Harness adapter to improve frozen-weight agents without training.

esokullu/openbonsai.summary: Ternary compression toolkit shrinking Qwen models for efficient inference
esokullu/openbonsai.readme_summary: OpenBonsai implements ScaleQ-style ternary compression for Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-8B with calibration scripts and openbonsai run CLI. No Meta Muse dependency; evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval with results below official Bonsai.

AllenZheng-05/fitts.summary: Usability auditor that tests apps like a user then fixes code via PR
AllenZheng-05/fitts.readme_summary: Fitts walks websites and Android apps, audits against Nielsen heuristics, a11y and performance, then fixes code on branches and opens verified PRs. Chat/voice desktop agent built Oct-Nov 2026 with recorded runs and web reports.

TykhinBiriukov/ai-construction-inspector.summary: Multi-agent inspection for construction defects and progress tracking
TykhinBiriukov/ai-construction-inspector.readme_summary: Coordinates specialized agents to compare drawings, photos and scans for defects and progress. Services for geometry, localization and 4D progress with iOS and Supabase. Uses Muse Spark for evidence analysis and reporting.

aryagupta-tech/MultAI.summary: Shared live coding agent session for teams on macOS, Android and web
aryagupta-tech/MultAI.readme_summary: Hosts a single AI coding agent that multiple teammates join via invite link with catch-up brief. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker compose and mobile clients. Uses cloud AI coding agent backend for collaborative code generation.

QuentinL-eng/Tennis-Buddy-Smart-Racket.summary: Smart racket sensor with AI coach for swing analysis and drills
QuentinL-eng/Tennis-Buddy-Smart-Racket.readme_summary: Sensor insert in racket handle measures swing speed, spin, face angle and impact point, sent to iPhone, Watch and Ray-Ban Display. Muse Spark agent runs physics simulation and plans drills. Includes iOS app with simulated racket mode.

baibesh/fabulka.summary: Creates personalized illustrated picture books where your child is the hero
baibesh/fabulka.readme_summary: Fabulka turns parent voice notes and photos into illustrated picture books or comics in five languages. Monorepo TypeScript apps with generation pipeline. Uses Meta Muse models for story, voice and illustration generation.

Offline-Base/muse-privacy.summary: Muse connector giving Muse a private on-device workspace with tag redaction
Offline-Base/muse-privacy.readme_summary: Muse connector that runs document work on user-owned hardware with tag placeholders. Python relay architecture with separate reader model and leak check. Uses Muse for planning while private parsing stays local, only summaries return.

Chocolatine75/whynot.summary: AI ad agency that tests small business ads in simulated feeds then publishes.
Chocolatine75/whynot.readme_summary: Researches, writes and simulates ads against competitors, evolves winners within budget caps. Python + Next.js and Remotion stack using Muse Spark, Wonder, Image and SAM 3.1.
