endomorphosis/ipfs_accelerate_py.summary: Decentralized model server with hardware routing and P2P task management
endomorphosis/ipfs_accelerate_py.readme_summary: Capability-driven inference server with hardware and provider routing, content-addressed IPFS storage, and MCP services. Includes agent-supervisor automation for distributed model execution and scaling.

hiddingtrojans/earshot.summary: Per-person captions and speech bubbles for group videos, mapped to each face
hiddingtrojans/earshot.readme_summary: Takes a group video, tracks tapped faces with SAM 3.1 and binds diarized voices via mouth movement. Renders per-speaker bubbles, threads side conversations with Muse Spark, and answers locally with Muse Glimmer.

pnomokok/reversecad.summary: Converts one photo of a flat part into measured editable CAD program
pnomokok/reversecad.readme_summary: Generates candidate CAD programs with real millimeter dimensions from a part photo for laser and CNC use. Core generation runs on Muse Spark Open via Baseten with assembly fit checks.

PamAntonio/physical-mcp.summary: Lets AI operate button-only machines via camera, servos and approved MCP tools
PamAntonio/physical-mcp.readme_summary: Physical MCP watches machine panels with webcam, plans button presses with Muse Spark, checks plans in code against LCD readings, and requires human approval for risky actions. Servo fingers press buttons; demo uses 4-channel timer.

atty57/GUARD.summary: Privacy guard that blocks secret leaks in agent web searches.
atty57/GUARD.readme_summary: Fail-closed guard between deep-research agent docs and web search that passes, rewrites or blocks queries. Python API with Tier 0 exact, Tier 1 mosaic, Tier 2 model rewrite checks. Blocked queries never reach search.

moyocodes/Nudged.summary: Voice-first reminder app that organizes tasks and nudges until done
moyocodes/Nudged.readme_summary: Turns messy voice/text dumps into reminders with follow-ups using Muse Spark. Voice via Muse Voice Transcribe, photo proof via SAM 3.1, badges via Muse Image/Wonder. Node + Vite frontend with Baseten/Modal backend.

imperialvizz/rehearsal.summary: CI for AI agents that proves behavior by reading app databases
imperialvizz/rehearsal.readme_summary: Runs agents on copies of real apps with fictional data, deciding outcomes from DB state not LLM grades. Provides PyPI/npm kits, GitHub Action PR checks, agent generator and auto-fix rounds.

Kaiser0733/freeline.summary: Live verified directory of which free frontier AI routes work now
Kaiser0733/freeline.readme_summary: Static site tracking free model routes with live/expiring/dead status and last-verified timestamps. Built as HTML/JS + JSON data with graveyard history, no backend, hosted on GitHub Pages.

Longwashere/MetaHacks.summary: Browse, remix, auto-rig, and animate Spine 2D game characters
Longwashere/MetaHacks.readme_summary: RigForge web app for 2D game assets with prompt remix, single-image auto-rig, and text-to-animation. Every AI feature runs on Meta models including Muse Image repainting, with Supabase + frontend/backend stack.

Kamu2000/shortforge-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns long talking-head videos into captioned vertical Shorts
Kamu2000/shortforge-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: AI Spatial Director cuts long single-speaker videos into up to 3 vertical 1080x1920 Shorts with hooks and captions. Python pipeline adds framing and visual context. Uses Meta AI to select moments and verifies output with PASS/FAIL receipts.

pavlovfilmdirector/ComfyUI-VFX-Suite.summary: Local ComfyUI VFX studio for masks, 3D blocking, generation, and dubbing
pavlovfilmdirector/ComfyUI-VFX-Suite.readme_summary: KESHIKI runs fully local on open-weights LTX-2.5 and FLUX.3 Klein for backgrounds, characters, and compositing. Provides SAM 3.1 masks, depth/pose tracking, and AI director in ComfyUI nodes for 24GB VRAM.

TRock270/dreambike.summary: Visual motorcycle customizer that turns photo edits into parts build sheets
TRock270/dreambike.readme_summary: DreamBike lets a custom shop preview modifications on the customer's own bike photo. Every accepted change updates a parts, labor and paperwork build sheet. It exports an English EUR estimate with before/after images and 19% VAT using Meta AI image editing.

vivek656/mindstrip.summary: Turns racing thoughts and burnout into humorous comics plus action plans
vivek656/mindstrip.readme_summary: MindStrip converts mental overload and caregiving stress into episodic comic strips with 3-step blueprints. The live Next.js flow is landing to single-image episode page to studio dock. It uses Meta frontier models for strip synthesis and empathetic storytelling.

TruptiLone/cafepilot.summary: AI operations assistant for cafes that forecasts demand and plans stock, staff
TruptiLone/cafepilot.readme_summary: CafePilot is an owner-approved AI control center connecting sales, inventory and staffing. Backend with plan-graph DAG validator/executor and forecasting uses Muse models plus Meta glasses checks.

tmoody1973/then-and-there.summary: Real-time 1889 Nellie Bly world race game using historic newspaper scans
tmoody1973/then-and-there.readme_summary: Then & There replays Nellie Bly's 1889 trip day-by-day from Nov 14 2026 to Jan 2027 using Library of Congress clippings. Players read original scans and predict if she makes it. Built with Next.js, Convex and Vercel with an AI Editor for verification.

kennethmedes28/Flood-Gentic.summary: Bilingual flood anticipation assistant for Metro Manila with guidance and alerts
kennethmedes28/Flood-Gentic.readme_summary: Flood-Gentic provides flood anticipation and safety guidance for Metro Manila in English and Filipino. It combines backend risk data, RAG corpus and FAISS retrieval with a web frontend designed for VR and Meta glasses. Built with Meta models for conversational assistance.

kylegandhi-stack/metahack---contractrada.summary: Five-agent AI team that finds and qualifies federal contracts to bid
kylegandhi-stack/metahack---contractrada.readme_summary: Rauros Systems describes your company then five agents search real US federal procurement records. Muse Spark 1.3 qualifies matches against capabilities and red-teams recommendations. Every result links to source with APPROVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED or HOLD status.

Swotboysandy/anchorshot.summary: Voice-directed film studio for blind creators with pixel-checked continuity
Swotboysandy/anchorshot.readme_summary: Voice co-director turns spoken ideas into storyboards and video with audio readback. Enforces continuity rules by segmenting props with SAM 3.1 and speaking measured changes.

nihald2000/OpenHarness.summary: Durable long-horizon agent workspace for building and testing software
nihald2000/OpenHarness.readme_summary: OpenHarness pairs a durable run engine and tenant-scoped APIs with a Vite SPA and sandboxed runtimes. Hackathon work added browser-check loop, Modal live-browser takeover and MCP skill gating. Orchestrates Muse Spark 1.3, Wonder, Glimmer 30B, Image, Voice and SAM 3.1.

hoachauphuoc/MetaAIHackathon.summary: Role-based company assistants governed by rules and human approvals
hoachauphuoc/MetaAIHackathon.readme_summary: Role Assistant Foundry generates an org chart with a scoped assistant and handoff form per role using Meta Muse. Code checks drafts against company rules and issues HMAC receipts per human approval. Deployed on Cloud Run with 24-hour demo sandboxes.

RzanderR/KounOS.summary: AI OS helping small suppliers triage bids and track government orders
RzanderR/KounOS.readme_summary: KounOS reads federal solicitations, compares supplier quotes, recommends bid price and monitors awarded orders to delivery and payment. Built on Meta Muse models via Meta Model API with API backend and web frontend. Prototype built Oct 26-Nov 4 2026 for hackathon.

N-45div/cogdiv-light.summary: Schedules EV charging and compute jobs for windiest, cleanest power hours
N-45div/cogdiv-light.readme_summary: Wind Buddy agent on Muse Spark plans home EV charging and datacenter loads into clean wind hours with tool-verified fact checking. Plan goes to ESP32 board with mic, speaker, button and relay for human approval and switching. Includes web console, firmware and carbon planning.

ahmaddev-codex/tandrix.summary: Screen-and-camera assistant that points to controls and verifies each task step.
ahmaddev-codex/tandrix.readme_summary: Tandrix sees Mac screen and iPhone camera to guide, automate, and verify tasks with Show-me and Do-it modes. It uses Muse Spark for reasoning, vision and computer use, SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, and Muse Voice Transcribe with Kokoro TTS. Monorepo with Mac, iPhone, and web report apps.

efecavdar/merchant-action-agent.summary: WhatsApp voice agent that turns merchant messages into approved retail actions.
efecavdar/merchant-action-agent.readme_summary: Cirak Agent converts merchant voice notes and product photos into planned business actions executed in KEDD CRM. A merchant approves with one word before deterministic code runs reads and writes. Built with agent layer, WhatsApp-style demo on Modal, and KEDD integration.

h-a-forster/lastseen.summary: Drone search assistant that plans where to fly next and spots missing persons
h-a-forster/lastseen.readme_summary: LastSeen plans drone search areas from witness input and detects missing persons in photos. Stack is Python app with planning tools, tests and eval docs. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 for visual search, Muse Voice Transcribe.

maximilienmil/agencydiff.summary: CI regression tests that verify code changes preserve users' ability to opt out.
maximilienmil/agencydiff.readme_summary: AgencyDiff uses computer-use agents to explore baseline vs candidate UIs and converts verified behavior into repeatable opt-out checks. It runs as a GitHub Action with scripted replay gate and screenshot reviewer, evaluated on agent PRs and Circle benchmark. Built with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code.

CygnusA2/thal3s16-hackathon-public-submi.summary: Research demo assessing liquidity of illiquid property collateral
CygnusA2/thal3s16-hackathon-public-submi.readme_summary: Interactive static demo with 30 ATTOM California addresses, illustrative images and 7-stage synthetic assessment. Keeps calculations and lending logic outside the LLM. Uses Muse Spark for open financial-intelligence research and reporting.

himangga01/claimback-ai.summary: Organizes personal loan evidence and drafts Korean court filing text
himangga01/claimback-ai.readme_summary: ClaimBack-AI is a self-help tool that organizes user-provided evidence for unpaid personal loans and fills standard Korean court document text with user-confirmed facts. Backend and frontend with bilingual UI, built with Muse Spark 1.3 implementation and review workflow.

cyb3rr31a/TerraSat.summary: Answers place questions from satellite imagery and map layers
cyb3rr31a/TerraSat.readme_summary: Geospatial auditing engine pulls satellite imagery vs OSM/Google Maps to return metrics, verdict and memo with GeoJSON/CSV export. Backend plus web/mobile clients in English/Swahili. Uses Muse Spark memo with live web search grounding.

afuhflynn/ticlearn.summary: Study app that turns uploaded lecture notes into quizzes and tutoring.
afuhflynn/ticlearn.readme_summary: TiCLearn lets Cameroonian students upload PDF, Word or photo notes for extraction, summaries and topic detection. Tip tutor teaches from notes with adaptive quizzes and readiness tracking. Stack is Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma, Tailwind CSS.

yoav-zibin/course.summary: In-memory backend for building and playing multiplayer turn-based games
yoav-zibin/course.readme_summary: FastAPI REST backend for game-platform with games, matches, and moves; client code runs sandboxed in iframe. Uses Store interface with in-memory indexes and JsonFileStore persistence. Multiplayer turn-based game builder system.

aminredfield/nazar-agent.summary: AI agents review timesheets and give owners evidence-backed payroll advice
aminredfield/nazar-agent.readme_summary: Multi-agent team audits NAZAR time-and-attendance data and produces recommendations with evidence. Human must approve before changes. Built with Python backend, Docker deploy, and live demo; uses Muse models for analysis and fact-checking.

devoncline/orbit.summary: Adaptive tutor that teaches lessons, quizzes you, and plans what to learn next
devoncline/orbit.readme_summary: Adaptive learning companion with Learn-Practice-Evaluate-Adapt loop from courses or PDFs. Combines course context, practice results and feedback. Uses Meta Muse Spark for teaching and Muse Image for visuals.

heycodingkr/web-agentic-memory.summary: Shared verified memory that gives web agents task-specific hints via MCP
heycodingkr/web-agentic-memory.readme_summary: Centralized hint store for web workflows retrieved via MCP remote/stdio or CLI. Agents use existing browser tools with curated hints. Rust service with gatekeeper curation by Muse Spark 1.3.

alomepet3r/liv-story-companion.summary: Voice-first memoir app that turns spoken stories and photos into keepsake chapters
alomepet3r/liv-story-companion.readme_summary: Accessibility-first storytelling companion: talk, transcribe, then arrange into reviewable keepsake chapters. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for conversation, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image for photos.

50ur48h/Charie.summary: Ask plain-English questions about business data and get answers with shown queries and stated limits.
50ur48h/Charie.readme_summary: Charie answers plain-English business questions by investigating a connected database like an analyst, showing every query behind its numbers and flagging what it could not establish. It uses only Meta models for its analysis.

ikaymane/Meta_Hackathon.summary: Focus app that freezes unused apps to cut RAM use then thaws them
ikaymane/Meta_Hackathon.readme_summary: Windows focus tool that freezes background apps during a task to reduce RAM, then thaws them. Stack with Windows services, UI and planner. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and Muse Voice Transcribe for voice input.

bendervintimilla/bendrix-shield.summary: Gateway that gives each business AI agent a scoped, revocable token instead of the real key.
bendervintimilla/bendrix-shield.readme_summary: wAIrrior is a gateway between small-business AI agents and the models and tools they call, keeping real provider keys in its vault. Each agent gets a scoped, spend-capped, revocable token, and owners approve key rotation by voice.

EmadQureshiKhi/TryNimbus.summary: Mac screen buddy that points, guides tutorials, and turns bug videos to fixes
EmadQureshiKhi/TryNimbus.readme_summary: Cursor assistant that sees screen to explain or act, Shadow guides live from tutorials, Repro reproduces bugs from video. Python Mac app using Muse Spark 1.3/1.2 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for screen vision.

getan/golder.summary: Go terminal agent with split-pane shell and browser, sandboxed and secret-safe
getan/golder.readme_summary: Single-binary Go coding workspace: agent, shell and browser in split-pane TUI/CLI. Sandboxed tools with secret redaction and 19 model gateways. Supports codebase inspection, edits and test runs.

ansh1325/ORCHESTRATOR.summary: Hierarchical multi-agent OS with scheduler and 66 tools for tasks
ansh1325/ORCHESTRATOR.readme_summary: JARVIS LlamaOrchestrator is a hierarchical multi-agent OS and co-worker with FastAPI kernel and 24/7 daemon scheduler. Uses Meta Llama 3.2 open weights with MCP 66 tools and pytest-verified core. CLI plus workspaces for autonomous workflows.

wallicestene/Dapi.summary: Turns typed or spoken specs into web datasets with a receipt for every value
wallicestene/Dapi.readme_summary: Dapi lets non-scraper users request columns via text, upload or voice and returns counted datasets. Each value links to source evidence for compliance and research use. Live at dapi.fly.dev with runner, specs and verification pipeline.

Parth-Surve2007/Chimera.summary: Local-first desktop AI that turns prompts into documents, code and app actions.
Parth-Surve2007/Chimera.readme_summary: Windows Python desktop app that converts natural language into reviewable computer work across docs, sheets, 3D, code and browser. Local-first architecture for privacy. Uses Meta models for intent-to-action orchestration.

greeneryvilaofficial/guitarwiter.summary: Offline Android keyboard that converts guitar notes into text and tabs.
greeneryvilaofficial/guitarwiter.readme_summary: GuitarWiter uses on-device AudioRecord plus YIN pitch detection inside an InputMethodService WebView. It runs Llama 3.2 1B offline by default for low-signal areas and uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Sunda/Jawa. Capacitor-based with 193 Node tests.

RaksaOrg/sawit-ecosystem.summary: WhatsApp AI that turns palm farm daily chats into structured dashboard data.
RaksaOrg/sawit-ecosystem.readme_summary: Foremen send daily reports via Meta WhatsApp Cloud API webhook to an agent router for mandor, agronomi, and manajer roles. AI extracts JSON to PostgreSQL via Prisma/Supabase for SAP Fiori-style owner dashboard. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker Compose.

EVERRONE/MetaHackathon.summary: Talking iPhone helper that outlines the exact button to touch and checks the result.
EVERRONE/MetaHackathon.readme_summary: Pip looks through iPhone camera, segments target control with 3D-locked outline, gives voice steps and verifies outcome. Built with Muse Wonder, Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe plus EdgeTAM and DINOv2 on-device. iOS app with Python worker.

TaahirSuleman/parity.summary: Agent audits sites for screen-reader gaps missed by standard checkers
TaahirSuleman/parity.readme_summary: Parity walks key site flows comparing sighted view vs accessibility tree to find barriers axe-core misses. Proves each issue, proposes fix, re-checks and leaves decision to human. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe with Playwright + axe-core.

uppin/surmap.summary: Drone payload that builds GPS-anchored 3D maps for rescue teams
uppin/surmap.readme_summary: Civilian disaster-response mapping payload carried over affected areas to build GPS-anchored 3D semantic maps from stereo video for SAR teams. Python 3.11 payload with strict mypy, ruff, pytest CI and deployment tooling.

jdmunta/ai-agentmanager-core.summary: Web UI and CLI to run and track one background coding agent per intent
jdmunta/ai-agentmanager-core.readme_summary: Orchestrates one background Claude Code process per intent with web UI, agentmgr CLI, and conflict radar. Node/web stack with Jira integration and AI judge for collisions. Uses coding agents for autonomous implementation and review.

BowenX307/AVO.summary: Voice-driven Mac assistant that performs clicks and asks before risky actions.
BowenX307/AVO.readme_summary: Mac app converts spoken requests into UI actions with disambiguation and pre-send approval previews. Python avo core with overlay, remote and eval modules. Uses Muse models for intent resolution and safety checks.

jQwout/amuse-pocket.summary: Android app that teaches beginners to build AI agents on Muse models
jQwout/amuse-pocket.readme_summary: AI Open Pocket is a Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android app for learning and running AI agents on-device. Teaches agent concepts interactively and integrates Meta Muse Spark, Image and SAM models with over-the-air Ketoy screens.

vkavali/concourse.summary: WhatsApp voice agent guiding non-English parents through international flights
vkavali/concourse.readme_summary: WhatsApp agent that escorts an elderly parent through a flight by voice in her language with family in loop. Built in Java 21 with local H2, ffmpeg, and tape-mode replay for demo. Uses Meta Muse models for multilingual voice dialogue and travel orchestration.

aldot311/screen-time.summary: Verifies creator videos delivered promised brand screen time per contract
aldot311/screen-time.readme_summary: Screen-Time tracks products frame-by-frame, rejects look-alikes and checks audio and terms. Next.js on Vercel built with Claude Code during hackathon. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

Jyosnorkel/tabby.summary: Organizes Safari tabs into focused local workspaces with Meta AI
Jyosnorkel/tabby.readme_summary: Safari extension that finds tabs, organizes projects, and saves/restores workspaces locally. Native macOS app plus server and extension components. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for tab organization and search.

MetaHackathonProject/Solution.summary: Generates mock voice interviews and question banks from job posting URLs
MetaHackathonProject/Solution.readme_summary: Recruiter pastes offer URL, agents extract role, build question bank, and curate spoken interview plan. Angular frontend with .NET Lambda API, Cognito, S3 and DynamoDB on AWS. Uses Meta AI agents plus ElevenLabs voice agent.

WeStrideOrg/westride.summary: Platform that turns ideas into shipped products using teams of AI agents
WeStrideOrg/westride.readme_summary: WeStride.org uses Muse advisors for cited research, planning, and Muse Code sandboxes to open PRs and maintain products. Turborepo with apps and packages runs on Meta Model API using member or supporter keys.

Ravriely/smearlens.summary: Assists biologists with blood smear cell counts and review triage
Ravriely/smearlens.readme_summary: Finds every cell on smear images, proposes differential counts, and flags slides needing human review. Python + web stack with tiled inference experiments. Uses SAM 3 for cell proposals and Meta open-weights vision embeddings for typing.

fariha-nirjana/tellwater.summary: Checks if garment dye wastewater was treated using factory meter data
fariha-nirjana/tellwater.readme_summary: Traces a garment label to dye wastewater and verifies treatment claims from simulated meter records. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and a fine-tuned Muse Glimmer with FastAPI and Modal.

turinglabsorg/cora.summary: Always-on resident agents with memory, routines and their own Linux desktops
turinglabsorg/cora.readme_summary: Cora runs persistent agents with layered memory, scheduled routines and Docker + noVNC desktops. A web panel and Discord/Telegram bots orchestrate a brain (LLM + tools) for chat, reasoning traces and push notifications.

No6Name8/Project_WorldKit.summary: Turns a phone video into a scaled 3D model you can edit and print.
No6Name8/Project_WorldKit.readme_summary: Pipeline from phone video to scaled editable 3D via VGGT, SAM 3.1 parts and 3D objects with AI edit traces. Web viewer plus Vercel and Supabase stack. Uses Muse Spark verification and Muse Wonder tool calls.

vibhortayal/meta-hackathon-research.summary: Research notes exploring household agent and cooking guide ideas
vibhortayal/meta-hackathon-research.readme_summary: Private indie-track research notes with candidate write-ups and ranking rubric, no locked implementation. Markdown docs covering home brain, live cooking guide, and paper games. No direct Meta AI integration yet, planning stage only.

drawde-001/Dotta.summary: Personal browser agent for long-horizon web tasks with verifiable actions
drawde-001/Dotta.readme_summary: Long-horizon browser agent with dynamic turn budgeting and verifiable actions plus digital identity engine. Powered by muse-spark-open by default, deployed with Docker.

modstorm/MS_MetaAIContest2026.summary: Browser tool that repaints 3D model textures from a text theme and exports GLB.
modstorm/MS_MetaAIContest2026.readme_summary: Muse Reskin reads a glTF/GLB texture atlas and UV layout in the browser. It asks Meta Muse to repaint the atlas in the typed theme, keeps UVs fixed, and rebuilds normal and roughness maps. Exports as new .glb with offline fallback.

Steph125/FixLoop.summary: Phone repair guide that verifies bike chain fixes by measuring each step.
Steph125/FixLoop.readme_summary: Session-based voice guide validates framing, chain seating and spin test from video before advancing. Python probe with replay, eval benchmark and procedures. Uses SAM 3.1 masks for measurement and Muse Spark for explanations.

rushibhosalepro/sentinel.summary: Safety checker that vets LLM-planned robot arm actions before they move near people.
rushibhosalepro/sentinel.readme_summary: Sentinel sits between an LLM planner and a physical robot arm, checking proposed trajectories against safety rules before execution. Its Modal-hosted dashboard compares naive versus checked actions, including slowing and reorienting a knife hand-over near a person.

paureis/recourse.summary: Turns coverage denial letters into verified verdicts and cited appeals
paureis/recourse.readme_summary: Recourse ingests denial letters as photo, PDF or text, investigates governing policy and argues payer side first. Built on Muse Spark, it outputs a 3-way verdict and appeal draft with page-cited findings.

El-Moatasem/visionguard-ai.summary: Turns workplace video into explainable safety observations and evidence reports.
El-Moatasem/visionguard-ai.readme_summary: Analyzes short workplace video with SAM 3.1 tracking and Muse Spark rule drafting to match natural-language safety rules. Generates human-reviewable evidence with replay mode. Backend plus frontend MVP with synthetic scenarios.

fayerman-source/cross-border-fbar.summary: Finds peak foreign account balances with source-page links
fayerman-source/cross-border-fbar.readme_summary: Tool for CPAs reviewing foreign bank statements to find each account's highest balance with one-click source verification. Python pipeline with arithmetic checks and evidence linking. Uses Meta Muse to read pages in ~10s for ~2 cents.

kristopolous/snitchie.summary: Tests if AI models secretly report users via fake authority-reporting tools
kristopolous/snitchie.readme_summary: Evaluation harness that gives models contact_authorities and inform_therapist tools. Writes an HTML case file and opens it in browser when triggered. Compared snitching behavior across 11 open-weight models.

Light172006/issue-to-repro-agent.summary: Agent that converts GitHub issues into verified minimal pytest reproductions.
Light172006/issue-to-repro-agent.readme_summary: Parses untrusted GitHub issues with guarded deterministic hints then generates minimal pytest tests. Python 3.11 stack with bench, docs and proof artifacts. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for parsing and reproduction reasoning.

balasivagn/netsense.summary: Turns cricket coach voice notes into reviewed marked-up video lessons for students.
balasivagn/netsense.readme_summary: NetSense films net sessions while coach talks, transcribes with Muse Voice Transcribe. Muse Spark planner splits remarks and locates moments and selected player in video. Coach approves marks before sharing private lesson.

Netaasree/maudesignal-prototype.summary: Daily FDA MAUDE dashboard flagging spikes and severity for device types.
Netaasree/maudesignal-prototype.readme_summary: B2B postmarket-surveillance tool for regulatory teams using public openFDA MAUDE data. Streamlit + Docker app matches claims to FDA records with human-in-the-loop decisions. Uses Meta AI models for signal summarization over device adverse events.

GentzofGod/SmartMove.summary: Nigeria market price comparison and shopping assistant with voice and vision.
GentzofGod/SmartMove.readme_summary: Flutter + Riverpod mobile app with Supabase cloud backend for transparent everyday commerce. Compares local market prices across channels and assists shopping decisions. Uses Meta AI Voice, Vision and Spark models.

aroucadi/replay_fix.summary: Zero-shot video-to-code repair harness with cryptographic verification in Rust.
aroucadi/replay_fix.readme_summary: ReplayFix v3.0.0 converts failure videos into code fixes via a two-gate live Playwright CDP oracle. Built in Rust with forbid unsafe code, Ed25519 Merkle proofs, and isolated repos. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder 1.0, and SAM 3.1.

danny-hines/beatsheet.summary: Agent-assisted video editor where you direct and the AI builds playable cuts
danny-hines/beatsheet.readme_summary: Video editor where an AI coding agent logs footage, proposes directions and builds cuts. Time is anchored to words, beats and clip moments with auto re-timing. Uses Muse Code / Codex / Claude agents for editing via in-app tools.

marcfischer026/StudyHub.summary: Local-first desktop workspace turning lectures into exam practice.
marcfischer026/StudyHub.readme_summary: PySide6 Qt app that records and transcribes lectures and keeps slides and notes together. Local-first Python architecture for university courses. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 API to generate exam practice.

Lappsnet/tasklens.summary: Point camera at home issue, get job spec, price and booked pro.
Lappsnet/tasklens.readme_summary: Mobile-first marketplace for Latin America home services using phone or glasses camera plus voice. Generates AI job spec, price range and pro matching with escrow. Verifies finished work with AI before payment release.

Lodimup/vr-red-panda-sensei.summary: WebXR Japanese tutor with a red panda in Quest passthrough.
Lodimup/vr-red-panda-sensei.readme_summary: WebXR app for Meta Quest with no install, featuring passthrough companion and cardboard objects. AI game master adapts lessons, scenes and progress tracking. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and Video gen at runtime.

qlanfr/mata_Hackathon.summary: Rust harness verifies AI performance patches with data
qlanfr/mata_Hackathon.readme_summary: AIOps Experiment Engineer lets Muse Spark 1.3 propose perf patches from operational evidence. Isolated Rust harness builds, checks correctness, measures p95 latency. Verdicts VERIFIED, REJECTED or INCONCLUSIVE on Cloudflare Workers.

actions-marketplace-validations/ManasMeh.summary: CI overseer that pinpoints where coding agents cheated with evidence.
actions-marketplace-validations/ManasMeh.readme_summary: Agent-evaluation check that fails PRs when agents game tests and cites exact lines. Cross-checks verdicts against agent traces before display. Built solo for hackathon with live demo and full run logs.

deskcorvn/ChoZ-agent.summary: Turns 1-3 photos plus Vietnamese voice into a full market listing.
deskcorvn/ChoZ-agent.readme_summary: Seller assistant for Cho Z marketplace in Zalo that converts photos and speech to title, category and pricing. Parallel pipeline generates studio image and attributes in seconds. Uses four Meta models for image, voice and text.

newadays/heliodx.summary: Agentic chest X-ray workflow drafting reports for clinician review and sign-off
newadays/heliodx.readme_summary: Agentic radiology workflow for clinics without on-site radiologists, from intake to signed report. Meta Muse Wonder coordinates Glimmer agents, SAM 3.1 preps scans, with clinician review required. Runs on clinic GPU with auditable trace.

crazycatseven/littletake.summary: Builds editable low-poly 3D scenes to direct AI video generation
crazycatseven/littletake.readme_summary: Lets creators describe or upload a reference to get an animated low-poly scene with cameras and shots. Editable 3D proxy defines actions and camera moves to guide AI video models, powered by Muse.

MajjiR/muse-shield.summary: Local gateway that masks personal data before Muse requests.
MajjiR/muse-shield.readme_summary: Local privacy entity engine that builds entity graph with coreference, ownership and relations before data leaves device. Muse Spark reasons over placeholders, restored locally. Uses fine-tuned Muse Glimmer 30B for detection.

CHAMA18/quorum.summary: Agent-assisted tender review workspace with human award controls
CHAMA18/quorum.readme_summary: Quorum manages procurement from intake to award with evidence-linked findings and redlines. LangGraph agent stops at named-human gates with quorum checks. Built with Next.js, Bun, LangGraph.js and MCP.

weslyjohn1307/BlueTrace.summary: Evidence-grounded MEP takeoff from construction drawings for estimators
weslyjohn1307/BlueTrace.readme_summary: BlueTrace extracts deterministic vector linework locally from PDFs and pairs it with Meta foundation models for AI-assisted reading. A human-in-the-loop takeoff store keeps every quantity grounded in the sheet.

ay23-byte/meta_hackathon.summary: Streamlit tool that turns delimited datasets into checked statistical analyses and reports.
ay23-byte/meta_hackathon.readme_summary: LabLens AI is a Streamlit prototype for delimited datasets: users choose columns, cleaning, and a model, then it computes statistics, diagnostics, and charts. Optional AI interpretation is grounded in computed-result IDs and exported in a validated report.

harrytwigg/marid.summary: Runs Claude, Codex and other CLIs as employees in a company
harrytwigg/marid.readme_summary: Marid, a fork of Jinn, turns existing agent CLIs into named employees with durable Todo ledger. Operated via chat and web dashboard with Docker support. It provides the org layer, not the models.

tridaai/blueprint-meta-muse-smb-commerce.summary: Operations agent watches orders, inventory and spend for retailers
tridaai/blueprint-meta-muse-smb-commerce.readme_summary: Blueprint agent computes operating picture in code from orders, refunds, inventory and ad spend. Built on Meta Muse Spark with guardian screens and named approvals. Includes evals, migrations and Docker compose.

cruzclaw/cruz-voice-meta.summary: Voice modules to talk to a virtual employee on Windows
cruzclaw/cruz-voice-meta.readme_summary: Provides reusable voice modules with synthetic demo and embeddable Windows host. Real gateway routes voice through Muse Spark for Q&A with speech output. Monorepo with apps, packages, docs and examples.

AuraAIInc/agentic-realtime-cv.summary: Edge cat tracker that escalates uncertain cases to a Muse supervisor for review
AuraAIInc/agentic-realtime-cv.readme_summary: Small YOLO on Raspberry Pi tracks two white cats with frame and visit correctors that escalate uncertainty. Muse Spark supervisor reviews escalations with crops and reference photos and updates memory. Scored against hand-validated ground truth.

KonetiBalaji/paper_trail_agent.summary: Duplicate-aware intake and historical checks for loan case reviews
KonetiBalaji/paper_trail_agent.readme_summary: Handles uploads and API submissions with duplicate-aware intake and version-bound JSON rules for bank movements and loan principal. Includes review panel and regression fixtures. Python worker with Docker and Vercel app.

drizzy765/sell-safe.summary: Verifies Nigerian seller receipts against bank evidence in Yoruba and Pidgin
drizzy765/sell-safe.readme_summary: Payment safety layer for Instagram/WhatsApp sellers that checks transfer screenshots. Uses deterministic rules for verdicts, Muse models for chat, with 20-case benchmark and sandbox demo.

evannivw/rai-os.summary: Rust AArch64 OS prototype that builds small tools from prompts
evannivw/rai-os.readme_summary: RAI-OS is an open-source Rust AArch64 OS where Meta proposes apps for human review, then validates and executes them locally. QEMU guest framebuffer with VNC relay demonstrates launcher and toolbox.

premanand8800/floodproof.summary: Traces viral flood videos to earlier copies with frame-by-frame evidence reports
premanand8800/floodproof.readme_summary: Takes a video and claim, finds earlier copies, proves match frame by frame and checks date. Python stack with src, bench, prototypes and evidence reports. Built with Meta Muse models for verification.

Musiac/Aegis.summary: AI security agent that finds weaknesses, fixes them and proves the fix
Musiac/Aegis.readme_summary: Aegis is Agentic Enterprise Guard for InfoSec built for the Meta hackathon. It autonomously finds vulnerabilities, applies fixes and verifies they hold. Containerized architecture with guardrails for enterprise security workflows.

metahackAI/a2api.summary: Protocol that lets LLMs find and call APIs with less context and token cost
metahackAI/a2api.readme_summary: Converts Python, Java/Spring, Go and Rust APIs to a unified contract for accurate function calling. Evaluated on 720-run holdout with Muse-Glimmer-30B for tokens and latency. Installable via pip as a2api library.

anbestephen/FirstLight.summary: Offline disaster mapper that shows which rescue vehicles can reach buildings.
anbestephen/FirstLight.readme_summary: FirstLight maps building damage and vehicle-specific physical access for fire, ambulance and ATV. Built on Hurricane Michael data for Mexico Beach, it runs offline without API keys. Stack includes Python routing engine with geometric clearance analysis and benchmarks.

vignesh2027/neermattam.summary: Measures street flood depth from one phone photo to route vehicles and protect sites
vignesh2027/neermattam.readme_summary: Two Meta open models, Muse Spark Open and SAM 2.1, cross-check to estimate depth with error. Rust engine fuses readings into live street map with routing and critical-site monitoring. Stack is Rust, Go, Python with MCP.

brewmaister/hermes-nim.summary: Hermes Agent plugin tracking NVIDIA NIM model health and latency
brewmaister/hermes-nim.readme_summary: Slash-command plugin for Hermes Agent that probes NVIDIA NIM models for liveness, latency and throughput. Reports alive, stalled, retired or new models and picks best chat model with fallbacks.

TheGoldenButton/SpeakEasy.summary: Browser WebXR space where you talk in emoji with AI fairy and avatar
TheGoldenButton/SpeakEasy.readme_summary: Safe-by-design VR/AR demo that replaces open-mic voice with universal emoji, AI Q&A, and a child avatar. Runs in browser/WebXR on Meta Quest with no setup. Uses Muse Spark for dialogue and Muse Voice Transcribe.

Hedgeling/hedgeling-agent-platform.summary: Platform API with MCP tools and chat console for localization workflows
Hedgeling/hedgeling-agent-platform.readme_summary: Pre-existing Hedgeling platform with API, auth, chat, approvals and localization jobs. Monorepo with web-console, api-contract, platform-client and platform-mcp packages. Uses Muse models via MCP actions for conversational localization during hackathon.

macayaven/ikigai-loop.summary: Daily assistant that surfaces two next steps from personal goals with verified numbers
macayaven/ikigai-loop.readme_summary: Personal loop that pulls signals from user commitments five times daily, proposes two actions with reasons, and checks numbers with plain code. Includes evals and voice correction. Uses Meta Muse models for step selection and reasoning over user records.

Cadenza-Builder/front-row.summary: Turns lecture board writing and speech into study notes with board work
Cadenza-Builder/front-row.readme_summary: Phone watches lecture-hall board to generate study notes minutes after class for students needing note-taking support. Plugs into hosted Cadenza service; includes app, iOS, Supabase backend and PDF export. Uses board vision and transcripts, not just audio.

Tibrahi/tixconneckt.summary: Collaboration workspaces connecting people, universities and funders
Tibrahi/tixconneckt.readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19 and Drizzle/Postgres platform for discovery, project workspaces, groups and realtime chat. Tracks requests, agreements, contributions and wallet activity. Uses Muse Spark for AI assistance.

CodeNeuron58/quiff.summary: Learns Windows and Chrome chores once, then replays them with zero AI calls
CodeNeuron58/quiff.readme_summary: Windows + Chrome automation that learns a task from one demonstration then replays deterministically. Python app with overlay and code verification. Uses Muse Spark for initial step inference, replay uses no AI calls.

matthewL687/trustline-merged.summary: Maps external trust in repos and sites to flag takeover risks
matthewL687/trustline-merged.readme_summary: Scans GitHub repos or websites for domains, scripts, buckets and Actions, classifies with Muse Spark and investigates via DNS, RDAP and GitHub lookups. Ranks expired domains and abandoned accounts. Detection only, live event-stream UI.

douglasparedes/traceLoop.summary: Converts a short work recording into guided visual instructions teams can follow
douglasparedes/traceLoop.readme_summary: Captures expertise by turning task video and narration into editable steps, approved versions and offline follow-mode with field feedback. Frontend plus backend architecture. Uses Meta AI models to transcribe, segment steps and generate visual guidance.

Arslan-95/Mia-AI.summary: Screen-free AI messenger that finds contacts and drafts messages by voice
Arslan-95/Mia-AI.readme_summary: Mobile iPhone app plus backend where Meta-powered agent handles contacts, reads conversations and drafts sends with approval. Built for users who cannot rely on visual navigation. Conversational intent and tool delegation.

danphillips-cloud/meta-benchmark.summary: Local harness measuring Muse Code time, cost and version regressions
danphillips-cloud/meta-benchmark.readme_summary: Runs prompts against Muse Code to record timing breakdown, plan-limit cost, model comparisons and replay with context growth. Fixed radar prompts track Muse versions. Local results page with frontend and golden prompts.

cpu-16/verified-asset.summary: Checks second-hand listing claims against photos for buyers
cpu-16/verified-asset.readme_summary: Seller claims plus photos go through blind Muse Spark observation and SAM 3.1 boxes, fixed rules produce supported/contradicted verdicts. Live site with app, browser extension and evals for furniture listings.

francoomichaeltech/sokoseal-point.summary: Mobile shop app that links finger-pointing and speech to catalogue items for basket review
francoomichaeltech/sokoseal-point.readme_summary: Mobile web app for Tanzanian shops that resolves pointed-at products and Kiswahili/English quantities into a review card. Built with Next.js and local catalogue matching. Uses Meta AI for multimodal grounding with explicit user confirmation.

abrahamebij/ranti.summary: Voice-first memory aid for people with Alzheimer’s and cognitive impairment
abrahamebij/ranti.readme_summary: Android mobile app acting as voice-first memory prosthetic for dementia care. Built with Expo/React Native. Uses Meta Model API on Android for conversational memory support.

QingLTC/autonomous-qe-agent.summary: AI test engineer that generates tests and separates faulty tests from faulty code
QingLTC/autonomous-qe-agent.readme_summary: Generates tests with Meta Muse Glimmer then builds an independent docstring-based oracle to triage failures. Built in Python with Streamlit UI and evaluation harness. Prevents self-healing by rewriting assertions to match code.

david3xu/ruloom.summary: Builds small shareable synthetic datasets from real records with clear provenance
david3xu/ruloom.readme_summary: Takes a real record like NVCL HyLogger export, checks suitability for a task and weaves a small synthetic set preserving task-relevant patterns. States plainly what is invented for safe sharing. Python engine with catalogue and profiles, Muse assists validation and docs.

franciscocordobaotalora/show-it-to-me.summary: Phone camera guide that outlines the spoken-about part and explains it aloud
franciscocordobaotalora/show-it-to-me.readme_summary: Talking camera guide that segments the asked-about part and answers by voice in seconds. Server plus static client with contracts and simulations. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 for grounding, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

dodolia907/mikawa-pbl-localllm-review.summary: CLI that reviews GitHub pull requests using a local LLM on university HPC GPUs
dodolia907/mikawa-pbl-localllm-review.readme_summary: CLI fetches PR diffs with gh then submits HPC jobs to review via Ollama on A100/MI210 nodes. Uses MCP servers for repo, docs and review logic. Keeps GitHub tokens off compute nodes.

McDumfly/engrammo.summary: Mobile memory gym teaching champion techniques like loci and peg systems
McDumfly/engrammo.readme_summary: Flutter memory-training app that teaches loci, pegs and spaced recall through interactive gyms and progress tracking. Uses Firebase and Muse models for personalized coaching, works offline without keys in local mode.

Isreal-Oparanti/Homing.summary: Memory app that reads saved links and notes and resurfaces them on time
Isreal-Oparanti/Homing.readme_summary: Homing ingests links, flyers, voice notes and videos, verifies against source, and brings them back when relevant. All model calls use Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and Muse Voice Transcribe via gateway.py. Dockerized server plus web frontend.

cheunglokkwan-design/METAhackathon.summary: Calculus notebook that checks ink steps and writes hints in handwriting
cheunglokkwan-design/METAhackathon.readme_summary: Pen-first notebook app where assistant reads page ink, verifies steps with computer algebra, and writes leveled red-pencil hints and ghost next-steps on page. Dockerized API plus client; uses Meta AI for page understanding and tutoring dialogue via voice and tap.

greeneryvilaofficial/Uji-coba.summary: Android keyboard that converts plucked guitar notes into keystrokes anywhere
greeneryvilaofficial/Uji-coba.readme_summary: GuitarWiter is an InputMethodService WebView keyboard using native AudioRecord plus YIN pitch detection. Llama 3.2 1B on-device adapter with Android bridge for offline help. Verified by 254 Node tests.

Br0kenByDes1gn/hold-that-cart.summary: PWA that builds a pantry from receipts and tells you to hold that cart.
Br0kenByDes1gn/hold-that-cart.readme_summary: PWA that builds a household pantry from receipt photos and purchase rhythm to give pre-shop BUY/SKIP/SWAP guidance. Stack is TypeScript Vite+React with TanStack Router/Query, Hono, Drizzle ORM and Postgres/PGlite. Uses Muse via Meta Model API for receipt extraction and AI enrichment.

shashanka300/Forgemind.summary: Workshop assistant that watches your bench and remembers tools and tasks.
shashanka300/Forgemind.readme_summary: Workshop assistant with bench camera and phone camera plus hands-free voice that teaches objects, finds them, and resumes unfinished work. Built with Python agent and persistent cross-day memory. Uses Meta Muse models for the conversational agent and look/highlight/read actions.

Oera2026/Backstop.summary: Safe email client that holds unclear mail for a trusted helper to review first
Oera2026/Backstop.readme_summary: Backstop is a .NET 10 Blazor Server safe email client for elderly and learning-disabled users. Every message passes Rules, Meta AI, link and policy checks with sender verification before release.

FastAnt/meta_hack.summary: Native Linux terminal that visualizes coding-agent activity as a project map
FastAnt/meta_hack.readme_summary: Native Linux terminal built for coding-agent workflows with activity indicator and repo content feed. Stack is native desktop app with content-tour mode. Uses Muse Spark for explanations and Muse Image for visuals, grounded in actual code.

johnroy007/citycenter.summary: Virtual city help desk that finds codes and prepares permits for staff review
johnroy007/citycenter.readme_summary: Virtual city help desk where residents describe needs and the agent pulls parcels, city code, and prepares paperwork. Staff review in a workspace with code citations; agent prepares, staff decide. Web app with live planner dialogue.

Pegasim/meta-hackathon-project.summary: Chrome companion that tracks focus, detects drift, and nudges you back on task.
Pegasim/meta-hackathon-project.readme_summary: Tuck is a Chrome MV3 extension with a service worker, pure attention engine, and memory store. LLM nodes handle relevance, nudges, profiles and tasks, with planned Muse Code session link. It logs events locally to model drift and replay context.

himanshumantri/ledger-eyes.summary: Turns phone stockroom video into an audit-ready count reconciled to books.
himanshumantri/ledger-eyes.readme_summary: React Vite PWA + FastAPI/Postgres backend that turns phone video into tracked counts, reconciled to ledger with evidence packs on S3. Uses SAM 3.1 for detection/tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for labels and damage checks, and Muse Voice Transcribe for narration.

itzmaniss/SettleNotes.summary: Telegram bot that turns Singlish chats and photos into a calm task list.
itzmaniss/SettleNotes.readme_summary: Settle forwards Telegram chats, slides and math photos into one prioritized student task list and starts the first step. Stack is Next.js 15 TypeScript, Bun, Supabase Postgres and Telegram Bot API. Uses Meta AI models to parse deadlines and generate plans.

mitra9917/HYPATIA.summary: Camera system that watches motion, tests physical laws and predicts future motion
mitra9917/HYPATIA.readme_summary: System that observes moving objects, proposes rival laws, validates on held-out data and suggests next experiments. FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend. Uses Meta Model API Muse models for reasoning.

ManasMehta1110/pinpoint.summary: Overseer that shows exactly where an AI agent cheated with trace evidence.
ManasMehta1110/pinpoint.readme_summary: AI overseer for coding-agent PRs that fails checks when agents game tests and cites exact lines verified against the trace. Includes verifier, benchmarks and raw run logs. Built solo for Push the Frontier using Meta Muse Spark Open for analysis.

rahulx2001/TraceX.summary: Turns multilingual car-owner complaints into cited defect investigations for quality teams.
rahulx2001/TraceX.readme_summary: TraceX converts multilingual owner reports into source-cited investigations for automotive quality engineers. It uses Muse Spark for extraction, bounded evidence lookup, and draft next steps. Stack includes Dockerized Python service with replayable public-model verification.

SanyaBoroda4/proof-of-turnover.summary: Verifies rental cleanings photo-by-photo with dual vision checks and SAM 3.1
SanyaBoroda4/proof-of-turnover.readme_summary: Hosts define room rules and reference photos; Muse Spark drafts checklists while dual vision checks plus SAM 3.1 verify cleaner photos. Spanish-first cleaner app sends voice re-photo requests for gaps.

retailbox-automation/rehearsal-twin.summary: Rehearses risky agent scripts on disposable server twins before production.
retailbox-automation/rehearsal-twin.readme_summary: Creates a disposable Vultr twin from golden snapshot to run risky scripts safely. Records every side-effect in an approvable ledger and blocks prod writes. Built for Vultr Agent Rush Blast Radius Zero with Python CLI, API, and web review UI.

NiceLeader/term-sheet-to-token.summary: Reads bond prospectus with Muse to configure and test bond tokens.
NiceLeader/term-sheet-to-token.readme_summary: Parses final terms plus base prospectus to resolve day-count, business-day and rounding rules. Fills ICMA-aligned schema with quotes and page cites. Deploys configured bond token and simulates full lifecycle on local chain using Muse models.

developic/atlas.summary: Voice-first accessible companion for blind, deaf and disabled users
developic/atlas.readme_summary: Voice-first companion that talks, listens, signs, captions, and uses camera to describe scenes and warn of obstacles. Built around disability access with adaptive UI. Next.js stack with video demo, focused on assistive multimodal interaction.

ArtyKourakin/Meta-Hacha_SH-01.summary: Desktop guide that points at the exact button to click for beginners.
ArtyKourakin/Meta-Hacha_SH-01.readme_summary: Watches the screen, plans multi-step tasks, and overlays a pointer with one instruction per step. Desktop app demoed in Godot 4 with discovery questions and confirm cards. Uses Meta vision models for screen grounding and step planning.

RemotingCoders/VisualForge-AI.summary: Turns any photo into playable spot-the-difference levels with verified masks.
RemotingCoders/VisualForge-AI.readme_summary: VisualForge forges realistic localized differences from any image with exact boxes and masks. Powers Diferia photo game, QC inspector trainer, and synthetic dataset mode. Uses Meta models for generation with Next.js browser play.

MellowVellow/byline.summary: Writer-controlled editor that suggests small fragments you accept or ignore
MellowVellow/byline.readme_summary: Minimal editor that offers cues, fragments and questions as opt-in options, never full drafts. Backend + frontend with Supabase and deterministic APA citations from verbatim sources. Uses LLM suggestions while keeping authorship with writer.

hehehehehee-dev/GuidingHand.summary: Floating Android guide that narrates phone tasks for older adults
hehehehehee-dev/GuidingHand.readme_summary: Android accessibility companion with floating Help bubble that gives spoken step-by-step UI guidance with visual rings. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe with backend observer loop.

RaghavMaheshwari2024/Sakshi.summary: Measures speed and timing from road video to check claims with honest ranges.
RaghavMaheshwari2024/Sakshi.readme_summary: Sakshi reads ordinary traffic video with SAM 3.1 and Muse for tracking, then deterministic physics computes speed and timing. Checks statements against measurements for expert review without assigning fault. Dockerized Python API with replay UI.

abdo0620/InfraSight.summary: AI dashboard that segments street damage from photos and builds repair cases for cities
abdo0620/InfraSight.readme_summary: InfraSight turns citizen photos of broken streets into triage-ready maintenance cases. FastAPI backend with web dashboard uses SAM 3.1 for pixel segmentation, Muse Spark for diagnosis and pricing, and Muse Image for visual reconstruction.

Andy-Barrett/carryforward.summary: Field assistant for solar crews that prepares visits and preserves closeout evidence
Andy-Barrett/carryforward.readme_summary: Conversational work-order companion for solar service teams to brief visits, capture voice reports, track missing evidence, and produce reviewable closeouts with owners. Local Node.js 24 prototype with briefing contracts and test suite.

Alicorn-Max-S/Anti-Procrastination.summary: Turns Canvas assignments into start-ready cards with reminders and practice
Alicorn-Max-S/Anti-Procrastination.readme_summary: Student starter tool that syncs Canvas assignments into prep cards with first step and risk warnings, sends start-time pings, and replans misses. Builds quiz practice from graded tests; FastAPI backend with browser and phone extensions.

BurgessTG/eddie.summary: Fast Rust desktop video editor that auto-finds shots and builds timelines
BurgessTG/eddie.readme_summary: Rust desktop video editor using egui + wgpu for UI and in-process FFmpeg for playback/export. AI clip curator segments shots and selects usable moments for timeline editing via chat or JS console.

prasan89/findit-si.summary: Ask questions over CCTV and get timestamped evidence timelines
prasan89/findit-si.readme_summary: Uploads multi-camera CCTV, asks natural language questions, returns chronological timeline with before/during/after frames. Python + Node + ffmpeg stack with evals and Guardian alerts. Uses Meta AI vision models via MODEL_API_KEY for scene analysis.

Sriharsan/clearwake.summary: Resolves PayPal disputes in-chat inside merchant limits with receipts
Sriharsan/clearwake.readme_summary: Buyer and merchant agents negotiate refunds within owner limits, verify via PayPal records and signed receipts. Python network-isolated system with web console and static verifier. Uses Muse models for negotiation and dispute triage.

MalithaBandara/relight.summary: AI outage agent locating grid faults and dispatching crews without smart meters
MalithaBandara/relight.readme_summary: Autonomous outage triage for utilities using complaints, crew reports and photos. Finds failed grid device, dispatches crews and drafts safe switching. Built on Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1.

DevendraDilliwar/ghost-agent-hackathon.summary: Vision-only desktop agent that clicks and types like a human
DevendraDilliwar/ghost-agent-hackathon.readme_summary: See-think-act-verify loop captures screenshots and drives mouse/keyboard with no APIs or MCPs. Electron + TypeScript app tested on Ubuntu voucher entry. Uses SAM 3 + Muse Spark + Glimmer for grounding and intent decisions.

aneudysamparo/postor-meta-demo.summary: Multi-agent team that turns public tenders into bid or no-bid decisions
aneudysamparo/postor-meta-demo.readme_summary: Reads Dominican DGCP tenders, amendments and scans to output bid, conditional, no-bid, plus draft proposal. Five-agent system with Docker/Modal backend. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1, Voice Transcribe, Llama Prompt Guard 2.

GiwinEdwin09/Ghostline-Meta-Hacks.summary: Phone physics lab that measures motion and tests physical laws
GiwinEdwin09/Ghostline-Meta-Hacks.readme_summary: Films motion, segments objects with SAM 3.1, converts pixels to meters and fits competing models in Modal Sandbox. Python backend + web frontend with evals. Uses Muse Wonder for measurement and Muse Spark for claim review.

baharb/ZAAL-Hackathon.summary: Farsi learning app for diaspora children aged 3-7 with a daily spoken-word quest game
baharb/ZAAL-Hackathon.readme_summary: ZAAL is a React Native/Expo Persian learning app for children aged 3-7 in diaspora families. Its Daily Quest lets children pick words, say them aloud with on-device playback, and collect them through mini-games on a quest map.

jpablo02/meta-sam-comics.summary: Turns a one-line idea into a four-panel comic with a collectible hidden gem object
jpablo02/meta-sam-comics.readme_summary: Tales is a Next.js app that generates a four-panel comic, cast, dialogue, cover and reel from a one-line prompt. A story object is hidden as a collectible gem whose inscription changes how the comic is read.

SebasTix02/civicpulse_meta.summary: Photo-based city issue reporter with AI verification of repairs
SebasTix02/civicpulse_meta.readme_summary: PWA where citizens report potholes and hazards by photo, verified by SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark with neighbor confirmation. Built on Supabase Postgres PostGIS, Storage and Auth, piloted in Ambato.

twfly104/delomu.summary: AI engineer that tests a customer's support AI against their policies before launch
twfly104/delomu.readme_summary: Grapim maps customer data, drafts integrations, and builds test sets from past cases with engineer approval at each step. Its risk scan uses Muse Spark 1.3 to extract policy rules and generate breaking customer messages.

stas-gatin/backstory.summary: Checks viral photos and videos against earlier online appearances to test their captions
stas-gatin/backstory.readme_summary: Backstory uses multi-agent Muse models to compare a viral photo or video with earlier online publications and judge if its caption fits context, time and place. It ships via Docker/Render with replay and evaluation examples.

ChinmayBitne/GoalFault-AI.summary: Stress-tests tool-using agents to find cases where they hit metrics but break policy rules
ChinmayBitne/GoalFault-AI.readme_summary: GoalFault puts a Muse Spark 1.3 support agent in a simulated support system and runs difficult requests against it. It checks executed tool calls against written policies to prove rule-breaking metric gaming and test guards.

BaraaSoft/ahe-ai-coworker.summary: Long-running Mac agent that plans, acts, and improves every round
BaraaSoft/ahe-ai-coworker.readme_summary: Goal-driven coworker that operates a real macOS computer over days via Docker Compose and Node.js. Implements plan-act-reflect loops with self-improvement. Built on Meta Muse for planning and computer-use actions.

mikhailmironenko84-dotcom/ratescheck.summary: Checks photographed English business rates bills against 2026/27 rules for errors in £/year
mikhailmironenko84-dotcom/ratescheck.readme_summary: RatesCheck uses Muse Spark 1.3 to extract photographed bill fields into strict-schema JSON, flagging unreadable fields as null. A deterministic TypeScript integer-arithmetic engine then recomputes the charge, using Deno and Supabase.

BrokkAi/muse-acp.summary: Rust bridge letting Zed and JetBrains IDEs use Muse Code via the Agent Client Protocol
BrokkAi/muse-acp.readme_summary: muse-acp is a dependency-free Rust binary bridging ACP-speaking editors to Muse Code over its native Muse Session Protocol. It preserves Muse's session engine, tools, authentication and approval flow.

javierdejesusda/nomouse-app.summary: Tests keyboard focus management on web pages against WCAG 2.4.3 using walkers and vision
javierdejesusda/nomouse-app.readme_summary: NoMouse walks web pages by keyboard only, letting deterministic DOM walkers settle what they can and Muse Spark 1.3 judge screenshots for focus landing and return. Frozen deterministic verdicts are shown beside each model verdict.

Chrisdouglas12/salmart-llama-voice-agent.summary: Voice-first marketplace letting users shop, register, and chat sellers hands-free.
Chrisdouglas12/salmart-llama-voice-agent.readme_summary: Voice layer over existing Salmart marketplace with guided voice registration, product search, cart/checkout, and seller chat. Backend on Render plus mobile client with photo capture. Uses Llama 4 voice agent to replace typing for low-literacy buyers.

witold-andelie/PulseGuard.summary: Governed SecOps pipeline that only remediates with deterministic evidence
witold-andelie/PulseGuard.readme_summary: Scan-to-remediation workflow with 16-node LangGraph, guardrails, z3 checks, PoC witness and sandbox re-scan. Muse Spark proposes fixes, deterministic verifiers must confirm. Deployed on Cloud Run with Render fallback.

Aadiverse07/MydrakAi.summary: Image-first crop health assistant for smallholder farmers with voice input
Aadiverse07/MydrakAi.readme_summary: Mydrak AI v3 is a crop health assistant that diagnoses plant disease from images and Hindi voice. Python stack with bot, audio, vision, SAM, decider and KB disease cards. Planned use of Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Glimmer, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

MozeyZvinas/guardian-book.summary: Student success platform that gives hints, tracks mastery, and aligns teacher and parent
MozeyZvinas/guardian-book.readme_summary: Guardian Book connects learner, parent, and teacher with teacher-approved marking and AI hints that never reveal answers. Monorepo web app uses Muse Spark for step-level diagnosis, guidance plans, and multilingual notes home.

abodacs/edu-canvas.summary: Generates structured bilingual lessons for grades 3-6 teachers
abodacs/edu-canvas.readme_summary: Lesson-prep workspace where teachers review four variants and publish one, starting with Grade 4 fractions. TanStack Start with PostgreSQL and server-side checks. Uses Meta AI to draft EN/AR lessons with curriculum validation.

Omni-Ouro/Eyd.summary: Verifiable audit trail proving what autonomous agents actually did
Omni-Ouro/Eyd.readme_summary: Agent accountability layer with demo agent, clearinghouse verifier, console and demo-site. Records agent actions in a provable log with live playground. Built from scratch for Push the Frontier Startup track during hackathon window.

fondoadam/duka-books.summary: WhatsApp bookkeeper for Kenyan dukas reading SMS, receipts and voice notes
fondoadam/duka-books.readme_summary: Owner forwards M-Pesa SMS, receipts and voice notes to WhatsApp; bot proposes Swahili entries for approval then posts to journal. Answers profit questions and generates P&L PDFs. Built on Meta models with Convex backend.

ru14/muse-growthpilot.summary: Generates Facebook and Instagram campaigns for shops with owner approval
ru14/muse-growthpilot.readme_summary: Product-in to campaign-out flow: Muse Spark plans copy, Muse Image creates product visuals, SAM 3.1 verifies. Owner approves then publish/export and measure. Python pipeline with synthetic demo business case.

arfabi/owly.summary: Browser extension that explains pages, guides form fills and flags errors
arfabi/owly.readme_summary: AI browser companion extension plus web app and form simulator that explains pages and assists form completion. Extension, web and Supabase backend. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open on Baseten as private inference for page understanding.

nguywnben/red2pr.summary: Self-hosted CI fixer that opens draft PRs only with proof and policy gates
nguywnben/red2pr.readme_summary: Self-hosted CI repair service turning red builds into human-reviewed draft PRs with deterministic checks and policy gates. Monorepo apps architecture. Powered by Meta Muse models for patch generation and review.

malakdecaen/RoboFactory-AI.summary: Autonomous Unity warehouse with packing cells, robots, and truck loading
malakdecaen/RoboFactory-AI.readme_summary: Unity simulation of packing inspection, carton transport, order planning, label creation, and voice-order handling. Unity Assets with robot controllers and camera feeds; uses Muse Spark, Muse Image, Muse Wonder, Muse Voice and SAM 3.1 for vision checks.

splashxmoon/friday.summary: Local-first harness to run multiple coding agents together on one repo.
splashxmoon/friday.readme_summary: Coordinates Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Copilot to split work and message each other. Local-first TypeScript app for macOS, Windows and Linux with handoff on usage limits.

moyososvbL/TrueTick.summary: Scam checker that rates risky messages, images, voice notes and QR codes
moyososvbL/TrueTick.readme_summary: Accepts text, screenshots, voice, QR and links and returns risk verdict with explanation and next steps. Backend plus frontend and mobile clients in Docker. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for image checks.

Amirtheshwaran/a11yforge.summary: Finds browser accessibility bugs and verifies fixes by deterministic replay
Amirtheshwaran/a11yforge.readme_summary: Monorepo with apps/packages that observes failures in a real browser and uses Meta models for bounded repairs. Rejects fixes until deterministic replay proves them. Key-less public deployment smoke-tested Nov 2026.

Mirak29/defendable-hackathon.summary: Generates coding tasks then voice-interviews candidates about their code
Mirak29/defendable-hackathon.readme_summary: Recruiter pastes job offer, generates practical task with sandbox-tested tests in TS/Python. Candidate builds with any AI tool, then voice AI interviewer defends code. Built with Meta models, separates verified facts from interpretation.

EeroEkebom/antinoise.summary: Simulates feedforward road-traffic noise cancellation across an open roadside zone
EeroEkebom/antinoise.readme_summary: Browser Vite sim of two-tower fiber-linked active noise control for 60-160Hz traffic rumble. Implements seeded propagation, delay model, and guarded FXLMS adaptive controller with honest wavelength-capped quiet zones. No Meta model dependency.

abinivesh-m/lifeline-ai-survival-agent.summary: Disaster logistics planner for flood-hit towns managing fuel and shelters
abinivesh-m/lifeline-ai-survival-agent.readme_summary: Python survival agent for Kottur flood scenario modeling fuel, hospital, pump and shelters as cascades. Includes A-star routing, allocator, counterfactual analysis and voice capture with benchmarks and artifacts.

skiredj-prog/hold.summary: Governance floor that only allows admissible agent tool calls with receipts
skiredj-prog/hold.readme_summary: HOLD separates intelligence, authority and evidence for autonomous agents. Every tool call passes an admissibility floor with uncertainty recovery. Integrates Meta Llama 3.2 3B with frozen protocol and replayable evidence journal.

rahilpatel0402/See-The-Germs.summary: Visualizes contamination chains on staged care videos for infection training
rahilpatel0402/See-The-Germs.readme_summary: Staff training and audit aid for staged post-acute care video. Segmentation is the sensor feeding a deterministic pathogen-specific propagation engine with Five Moments mapping and counterfactual replay. No diagnosis or clinical advice; client/server plus engine codebase.

DamirTukayev/meta-hack.summary: Delivery planner that builds verified routes from satellite photos
DamirTukayev/meta-hack.readme_summary: Takes satellite photo plus sentence, reads roads from OpenStreetMap and aerial evidence, then plans, validates and repairs delivery routes. Solo hackathon build with demo of 20 deliveries, verification and repair loop.

ashutoshrath1/vidmind.summary: Turns long videos into readable notes where every point links to its exact second.
ashutoshrath1/vidmind.readme_summary: Turns 2-hour videos into verified articles with timestamp citations checked against transcripts and keyframes. Web plus API architecture for ingest, transcription, and verification. Uses Meta Muse models for summarization and evidence grounding.

monigarr/asset-intelligence.summary: Turns field photos and crew notes into auditable infrastructure maintenance reports.
monigarr/asset-intelligence.readme_summary: Five-stage fail-closed pipeline that segments defects, fuses image and notes, reasons with citations, and drafts next steps with human review. FastAPI service with Docker deploy and 50-case eval. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 Vision and Muse Wonder 1.0.

snehatiwari029/AgentReceipt.summary: Helps merchants verify AI-agent orders match shopper intent to cut disputes.
snehatiwari029/AgentReceipt.readme_summary: Demo store reads products from Supabase, shopper agent chats, and merchant tools screen agent orders. Next.js storefront with verification flow and dispute playbook. Uses Muse models for agent shopping and intent-vs-action checks.

saqwild/meta-tube-factory.summary: Runs a multi-channel YouTube pipeline from idea to script, video, QA and metadata.
saqwild/meta-tube-factory.readme_summary: Documentary-grade film factory driven by channel profiles through ideation, research, script, visuals, QA and distribution. Python pipeline with adapters, validators gating each stage, and human approvals. Uses Meta Muse models plus LTX-2.5 for image-to-video.

surferkook/ponki.summary: Turns existing devices from Arduino to robot arms into cohabiting home robots.
surferkook/ponki.readme_summary: Platform that unifies heterogeneous devices into embodied agents with shared hub, firmware, and bodies. Docker and Compose deployment for amd64/arm64 with CI. Uses Muse Spark and Meta models for perception, planning and interaction.

stunrazor/GridFork.summary: Multi-agent engine that scores multimodal reroutes during disruptions.
stunrazor/GridFork.readme_summary: Four specialist agents report sea, air, road and rail options during a Rotterdam storm, ranked by cost and on-time odds. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice via Meta Model API with fallbacks.

MoAmrYehia/WorldLab.summary: Simulates a 3D desert farm where an AI scientist trials crops and irrigation.
MoAmrYehia/WorldLab.readme_summary: Green Frontier lets users pick crops while the AI plants trial plots, learns behavior, trains irrigation policy, and diagnoses faults on record. Web 3D app with backend simulation. Built for Push the Frontier on Meta AI models.

aleksandrahodzzik/musecell.summary: Blinded screening agent that predicts compound mechanism from cell images.
aleksandrahodzzik/musecell.readme_summary: Plans limited well imaging on BBBC021, reviews calls before unblinding, then checks against PubChem, ChEMBL and PubMed. Backend plus frontend with eval harness and live demo. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1.

a11-studio/Roomtake.summary: Photos of your room restyled in place with real shoppable furniture and decor
a11-studio/Roomtake.readme_summary: Snap 1-3 room photos, SAM 3.1 segments 24 object types into layout masks, and Meta models restyle the photo while preserving layout. Every rendered item links to a real product with price. Stack is Meta Model API with Fly.io API and Vercel web app.

wh1t3rbb1tz/pe-risk-key.summary: Produces evidence-cited cyber risk digests for private equity deals in minutes.
wh1t3rbb1tz/pe-risk-key.readme_summary: Cross-checks management claims against evidence, analyzes SOC 2 and passive outside-in signals, then scores via deterministic NIST CSF rules. Python CLI with YAML scoring and eval fixtures. Built on Meta Muse with quoted locators.

pham-tuan-binh/hey-muse.summary: Mac voice assistant that plans builds and guides welding step by step
pham-tuan-binh/hey-muse.readme_summary: Hey Muse is a macOS Electron app where users describe a project and get a guided voice-led build plan. Built with Electron Vite, TypeScript, 3D models and evals. Uses Muse API for planning, voice interaction, instruction highlighting and task checkoff.

ahamal/magic-table.summary: Two limited robots team up to play cards guided by AI that sees the table
ahamal/magic-table.readme_summary: Embodied card-game demo pairing CoreXY suction crane with wheeled Esper flipper robot under shared perception. Raspberry Pi hub exposes guide, cameras, speaker and API. Uses vision AI to see cards and coordinate complementary pick, place and flip actions.

Kunal-Shahi/shipcube-data.summary: Database semantic layer with versioned migrations compiling typed queries to SQL.
Kunal-Shahi/shipcube-data.readme_summary: Semantic layer where cubes, measures and joins live in Postgres via versioned migrations. Typed queries compile to guarded SQL on Postgres or BigQuery. Clean-room hackathon build inspired by Cube and MetricFlow.

DSKYZ-dev/DAFE-OakGuard.summary: Referee system that verifies AI-generated trading rules before they go live.
DSKYZ-dev/DAFE-OakGuard.readme_summary: Verification layer for the DAFE Charts terminal. Muse Wonder proposes trading rules, Muse Spark codes and advises, and a hidden referee scores them. Includes voice transcribe push-to-talk and cost tracking.

jamorett/FlowForge.summary: LLM agents propose turbulence closures for k-omega SST with deterministic scoring
jamorett/FlowForge.readme_summary: LLM research agents write candidate RANS closures in a checkable grammar with least-squares fitting. A deterministic evaluation ladder and OpenFOAM pipeline score proposals, with a live cockpit. Uses Muse models for proposal generation only, never for scoring.

ginoarez/Anyhand.summary: Hands-free voice agent that controls any Android app with step verification
ginoarez/Anyhand.readme_summary: Voice-controlled Android agent with wake-word listening and floating avatar. Plans with Muse Spark 1.3 computer tool over screenshots, acts via adb, verifies before/after and confirms irreversible actions. Supports Spanish, English, Portuguese.

Mohamedzh/offisio.summary: Turns office videos into bilingual listings, restaged photos and chat booking
Mohamedzh/offisio.readme_summary: Office listing agent where owners upload video to get structured specs, Arabic/English listing and restyled photos. Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 with WhatsApp-gated publishing. Uses Meta AI vision and chat models for extraction, staging and Egyptian Arabic booking.

luch91/minsk.summary: Tests declared workflow policy against what execution actually enforces
luch91/minsk.readme_summary: Turns workflow evidence into a reviewable model, evaluates declared policy, tests counterfactuals and verifies safeguards with a deterministic simulator as authority. Node.js app with live judge UI, CI and evaluation suites.

premspaw/zeroedits.summary: AI-assisted storyboards, talking-head editing and vertical video exports
premspaw/zeroedits.readme_summary: Paper Studio is a Next.js App Router app for storyboards and video editing with Remotion exports. It uses FFmpeg, Python faster-whisper transcription and ONNX/Transformers. External model APIs provide AI features via Docker deployment.

Lonny154/NationalTensor.summary: Muse-guided workflow that proposes, benchmarks, and evidences Triton GPU kernels.
Lonny154/NationalTensor.readme_summary: Connects Muse proposal and critique to reviewed Triton kernels with human approval and real GPU measurements. Uses paired benchmarking, evidence checks and portable bundles with dashboard replays.

abishek1303/DocSyde.summary: Keeps product docs in sync by detecting code changes and proposing updates.
abishek1303/DocSyde.readme_summary: Agentic docs platform that grounds source changes, captures Playwright screenshots with Meta vision, and proposes doc updates for human review. Stack is Next.js, Docker Compose, host SDK and read-only MCP. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for reasoning.

Sir-Olexander/Sirena.summary: Hands-free Mac voice assistant to control apps, click buttons, and dictate.
Sir-Olexander/Sirena.readme_summary: Native Swift macOS app for hands-free control: switch apps/tabs, click buttons via number overlays, dictate clean text, and read pages aloud. Voice-first command parsing with confirmation for actions. Built for Meta hackathon as on-device utility.

terhuhf/vamos_fire_fire.summary: Fine-tuned technical-writing model that turns engineering context into clear design docs.
terhuhf/vamos_fire_fire.readme_summary: Technical-writing specialist built on Muse Glimmer 30B to produce complete documents with mechanisms and tradeoffs. Cleaned 1,916 human technical documents and fine-tuned with LoRA SFT plus data and benchmark pipelines. Includes chatbot, classifier, doc pipeline and model benchmark tooling.

kimdaeheuk-hash/-AEGIRON.summary: Early-warning dashboard that fuses news, weather and mobility signals into outbreak alerts.
kimdaeheuk-hash/-AEGIRON.readme_summary: EPIWeather system with FastAPI inference engine and Next.js dashboard for infectious-disease alerts. Fuses news, weather, mobility, genomic and deforestation signals with provenance. Uses Meta Model API extraction path added during hackathon for event data.

orq0/near-circle-friend.summary: Messenger prototype that finds nearby friends and suggests real-world meetups.
orq0/near-circle-friend.readme_summary: Messenger-inspired prototype with proximity radar using real PostgreSQL/PostGIS distance math over simulated Manila data. Node.js apps with Docker Compose provide Reconnect Today and meetup advice inferred by Muse Spark 1.3. All identities simulated; routing and AI inference are real.

itsmar1/climateadapt-lab.summary: Drought adaptation reports from satellite data and cited science.
itsmar1/climateadapt-lab.readme_summary: ClimateAdapt Lab computes drought indicators from satellite and reanalysis archives. It retrieves cited evidence, ranks options with rules, and has Muse Spark draft reports validated by code. Numbers are computed, model only explains.

Caranea/carryover-labs.summary: Organizes years of lab reports into one timeline for doctor visits
Caranea/carryover-labs.readme_summary: Consolidates Polish, German and English lab reports into a single timeline for short appointments. Explicitly not medical advice, no diagnosis or interpretation. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 with Angular frontend and API plus Docker.

marcopatzelt/hey-pip.summary: On-screen personal assistant that handles refunds, forms, letters and reminders.
marcopatzelt/hey-pip.readme_summary: Rust-based Windows assistant that works on the user's screen and asks before sending anything. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 for grounding, plus Muse Voice, Muse Image and Muse Glimmer. Repo includes crates, fixtures, evals and design specs.

Gabyresina15/kinetix-ui.summary: Spatial ERP operator console with voice, vision grounding and pricing synthesis.
Gabyresina15/kinetix-ui.readme_summary: React 19 TypeScript Tailwind console for KINETIX OS spatial ERP, paired with backend orchestrator repo. Connects 5 Meta runtimes for voice transcribe, Muse Spark planning, SAM 3.1 boxes, image synthesis and Wonder pricing. Captures 24kHz audio and streams multimodal grounding.

BugHunterX2101/chronosight-mcp.summary: Visual timeline app that normalizes uploads and adds voice relay for review.
BugHunterX2101/chronosight-mcp.readme_summary: Next.js 16 / React 19 and Python app with BYO uploads, live resumed runs, and voice relay. TypeScript strict frontend with Vitest/Pytest coverage. Exposes MCP interface for visual search and time-based inspection workflows.
