123Anujyadav/AgentShield.summary: Local-first firewall that detects credentials and redacts evidence for AI agents
123Anujyadav/AgentShield.readme_summary: Local-first AI-agent security prototype with deterministic rule-based checks, simulated action handlers, and reproducible benchmarks. Stack is local loopback API with loopback-only labs. No Meta Muse model integration stated; focused on credential detection and redaction.

RafaelMarian/ChipLlama.summary: Generates PIC firmware C code verified by emulation, solving, and real compilation
RafaelMarian/ChipLlama.readme_summary: PIC firmware copilot that turns plain English into register-exact C for PIC18/24/32 and dsPIC33. Replays code in register emulator, checks with reference solver, compiles with MPLAB XC compilers, loops with Meta Muse Spark until VERIFIED.

ThivaV/OSMS.summary: News reader that groups articles, papers and videos into single evolving stories
ThivaV/OSMS.readme_summary: OSMS groups articles, papers, newsletters, podcasts and videos about the same event, showing what's new, disagreements and timelines. Built with Widgetbook UI, backend pipelines and arXiv semantic search. Meta AI usage not detailed in excerpt.

Oplo-Works/tuck-and-whisper.summary: Builds bedtime briefings and stories only from parent-confirmed facts
Oplo-Works/tuck-and-whisper.readme_summary: PWA bedtime handoff where parent memo plus optional photo/voice yields briefing, recall question and reading page. Only parent-selected details used; child answers saved as testimony, never fact. Vanilla JS, zero runtime deps, Playwright tested.

Buildebate/hackproof-ai.summary: Zero-trust engine that requires AI fixes to prove red-to-green test passage
Buildebate/hackproof-ai.readme_summary: Forces coding agents to prove fixes via immutability guard, baseline failure reproduction, and Muse Spark to Wonder debate for minimal patch. Emits TGRES SHA-256 receipt. Ships as pip package and GitHub Action with evidence dossier.

PabloEPereyra/Sing-Maker.summary: Singing game that adapts vocal exercises to your range and tracks pitch
PabloEPereyra/Sing-Maker.readme_summary: Web app where users sing to guide a character collecting stars, with adaptive exercises, pitch detection, piano guide and drums. AI composes exercises from text, voice, sheet-music photo or drawing and generates art using Meta models.

ConWan30/qortime.summary: Open referee that verifies signed HDMI match receipts and publishes verdicts
ConWan30/qortime.readme_summary: Verifies ed25519-signed capture receipts from QorCap Windows HDMI recorder that reads scorebug locally. Serves public match pages including FAIL verdicts. Python package qor_receipt with schema, spec, eval and site.

JeremyDoege89/master-mechanic-copilot.summary: Auto diagnostic copilot fusing OBD2, camera and voice into ranked next tests
JeremyDoege89/master-mechanic-copilot.readme_summary: Android CameraX/mic plus ELM OBD2 feed FastAPI backend with event store and deterministic Bayesian engine. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for reasoning/vision/PDF and SAM for segmentation. Produces hash-chained replayable report.

pprp/awesome-super-agent.summary: Curated link list documenting the DeepSeek Harness super-agent prototype
pprp/awesome-super-agent.readme_summary: Awesome-style README in Chinese catalogs what dsh-superagent is, setup, design articles and code diffs. It describes a proactive coding agent on DeepSeek Harness; no Meta or Muse model integration is present in this repo.

navee4/picture-guard.summary: Pre-filter that blacks out names, IDs and faces in images before AI upload
navee4/picture-guard.readme_summary: Detects names, addresses, account numbers, ID numbers and faces in pictures and blacks them out, failing closed to full blackout. Pipeline uses CPU Tesseract OCR plus classifiers. Startup track demo on Modal with docs and samples.

UDAYADITYA-2005/platecount.summary: Photographs agar plates to count colonies and estimate CFU/mL with verification.
UDAYADITYA-2005/platecount.readme_summary: Photographs agar plates to segment colonies, count them, and estimate CFU/mL. Built with FastAPI and mobile web UI, tiling and CFU math pipeline. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and a Muse Spark agent with verifier that rejects unsupported counts.

Quentintnrl/meta_hackaton.summary: Five agents handle product comms from research to writing.
Quentintnrl/meta_hackaton.readme_summary: Ripple_handoff assigns market analysis, proposal, writing and review to five agents. User approves or rejects outputs in the loop. It runs on Meta Model API with Node 24 monorepo and 156 tests.

mohgomaa-art/InkLoop.summary: Autonomous manga studio that keeps character identity and lettering consistent.
mohgomaa-art/InkLoop.readme_summary: Autonomous comic production engine that parses scripts, plans panels, locks character identity, and places lettering deterministically. Python backend with frontend studio and visual judge. Uses Meta AI models for generation with reference-sheet continuity.

ganjikrishna/fraction-compressor-v0.4.summary: Compresses fine-tune weight diffs to tiny swappable patch files for live use.
ganjikrishna/fraction-compressor-v0.4.readme_summary: Stores fine-tune deltas as 1-bit signs with scales to shrink patches from 1GB to ~19MB. Python tooling with examples, fixtures, and tests. Demonstrates live hot-swap of behavior patches on Qwen2.5-0.5B without compressing the base model.

tejaschaudhari131/rewind.summary: Verifies mechanical reassembly in 2 stages and regenerates missing CAD links.
tejaschaudhari131/rewind.readme_summary: Plane-aware 2.5D teardown system with fast local check plus Meta model confirmation. Backend plus frontend with STEP/STL regeneration from millimeter estimates. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 on Baseten for stage-2 vision gate and parametric CAD.

adaptabyte/autoharness.summary: Compiles desktop app workflows into checked tools for small local models
adaptabyte/autoharness.readme_summary: Autoharness has a frontier Meta model learn a GUI task once then exports it as an MCP tool. A small open model executes locally with code checks validating each step. Zero cloud cost after learning phase.

brunomarzyx/london-pipeline.summary: Maps London borough supply pipeline against prices with Q&A analyst
brunomarzyx/london-pipeline.readme_summary: London Pipeline unifies Land Registry, MHCLG and boundaries for 33 boroughs on one map. It shows cycle phases, EPC-matched prices and risk scores with verified memos. Uses Muse Spark analyst over source data via Next.js.

Shantanu-00/FAULTGLASS.summary: Industrial agent that fuses sensor data and photos to diagnose plant faults
Shantanu-00/FAULTGLASS.readme_summary: FAULTGLASS investigates production drift by linking telemetry, gauges, procedures and field evidence. Backend plus frontend with plant datasets and deployment configs. Uses Meta models to test hypotheses, request evidence and verify recovery.

wallacethomas538-glitch/VektorMind-2.0.summary: 15-agent store assistant drafts ads and ops tasks staged for owner approval.
wallacethomas538-glitch/VektorMind-2.0.readme_summary: Breaks solo-seller requests into subtasks across 15 specialists for ads and store ops. Python FastAPI with approval-gated drafts, mission receipts, and risk gate. Uses Muse Spark dynamic planning and Muse Image for ad creatives.

song2h/metacog.summary: Rechecks coding agent claims against logs to catch false reports and risks.
song2h/metacog.readme_summary: Verifies Claude Code, Muse Code, and Codex reports against commands, edits, and infra state. Python hooks and bench with post-run cluster checks. Uses Meta Muse Spark to judge claims false on hallucinations, risky actions, and waste.

MrRobotDumbazz/campdoc.summary: Diagnoses underperforming ad campaigns and verifies fixes in auction simulator
MrRobotDumbazz/campdoc.readme_summary: Verifiable agent that ingests delivery logs and bid requests to find root cause with evidence. FastAPI backend with contract-validated data tools and deterministic auction simulator for before/after proof. Uses Muse Spark tool-calling for diagnosis and fix proposal.

AnjanRaj777/InterVibe.summary: Real-time AI mock interview simulator with voice and performance diagnostics
AnjanRaj777/InterVibe.readme_summary: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript platform for verbal mock interviews with 3D avatar and diagnostics. Stack includes Tailwind, Three.js, Supabase, Framer Motion. Uses Meta AI for realtime speech interaction and interview scoring.

good-open-box/salomon-earnings-desk.summary: Earnings assistant with voice Q&A and tamper-proof pre-report predictions ledger
good-open-box/salomon-earnings-desk.readme_summary: Everyday investor desk answering typed or voice questions from live market data with sources. Frozen-calls ledger sha256-chains predictions before reports then auto-grades after. Uses Muse Spark Open for tool-calling and chart reading.

ENuel20/RmemFab.summary: Simulator for modeling remote-memory CXL and RDMA fabrics for AI workloads
ENuel20/RmemFab.readme_summary: Discrete-event simulator with scenario schemas, Python engine and dashboard for placement and prefetch policy. Helps test latency cliffs and failures without hardware. Built as Muse AI Hackathon infra copilot.

TusharTechs/rangrez.summary: Self-driving dye lab that matches cotton color from a phone photo iteratively
TusharTechs/rangrez.readme_summary: Shows a color, predicts dye recipe, dyes cotton strip, photographs and corrects until match. Hardware firmware plus Python app on Hugging Face Space. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder, Glimmer, Spark, Image and Voice.

Datellx/CloneFlow.summary: Captures expert know-how before exit and answers successors in Teams
Datellx/CloneFlow.readme_summary: Clone Flow captures retiring expert knowledge via guided conversation and serves it in Microsoft Teams. Stack spans Python backend, frontend, desktop, Docker and Render. Uses SAM 3.1 for visual tracking of tasks like robot-arm calibration and Muse models for Q&A with proof.

arthi-arumugam-git/redloop.summary: CI tests that fail PRs when agent prompt-injection attack success regresses
arthi-arumugam-git/redloop.readme_summary: GitHub Action injects frozen payloads into mock Gmail/Slack/GitHub tool outputs to test target agent in sandbox. Rule and LLM judges compute ASR per scenario with dashboard badge. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 as target and judge.

parvathinalla/Glint.summary: Hands-free voice guidance using recent camera frames as context
parvathinalla/Glint.readme_summary: Glint answers voice or text questions about hands-busy tasks like cooking using selected camera frames. Provides spoken guidance without typing. Built on Meta API with frontend/backend plus 355 unit tests.

vishuweb/pathable-ai.summary: Turns photos of public spaces into accessibility barrier reports by need
vishuweb/pathable-ai.readme_summary: Maps curb ramps, footpaths, entrances and signage issues filtered by mobility, vision and hearing needs. Next.js app scoped to IIT Dhanbad OSM boundary with community reports. Uses Meta vision AI for evidence-backed detection.

garrick15/climbIQ.summary: Browser bouldering coach giving move-by-move video analysis like chess.com
garrick15/climbIQ.readme_summary: Upload boulder attempt for in-browser skeleton detection, hold targeting and annotated playback. React TypeScript Vite frontend with coaching panel and metrics. Uses vision pose models plus Meta AI for coaching feedback.

Ron-Bee/EdgeFit-AI.summary: On-device benchmark system recommending optimal local LLM configs per phone
Ron-Bee/EdgeFit-AI.readme_summary: Hardware-aware Android system that recommends local LLM configs, validates against real on-device benchmarks, and improves via verified results DB. Uses Meta Muse Spark for recommendations. Includes APK, cloud sync, and eval tooling.

Lucky-Umoka/steplint-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns expert demos into procedures then checks learners step-by-step on video
Lucky-Umoka/steplint-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: StepLint transcribes expert demos, tracks objects in video and drafts ordered procedures for review. During practice it verifies each step against visual evidence and coaches. Built for workbench assembly and hands-on tasks with Next.js.

MainaKamau92/rush.summary: Evidence-backed code review grounded in team standards and task context
MainaKamau92/rush.readme_summary: Open-source PR review service with bounded investigation and evidence-backed findings plus human clarification flow. Built with Docker, Uvicorn and durable state, using Meta models via provider interface and ClickUp reads via MCP.

DhruvKaushik-IIIT/PATHFINDER.summary: Live AI-verified Himalayan road and trek conditions with crew updates
DhruvKaushik-IIIT/PATHFINDER.readme_summary: Platform unifying travellers, road department and crews on one map for Himachal Pradesh roads and treks. Built with Next.js using Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 for image analysis and Muse Voice for transcription.

ChaitanyaReddy01/daari-sentinel.summary: Detects road crashes from dashcam clips to advise stay, reroute or wait
ChaitanyaReddy01/daari-sentinel.readme_summary: Watches dashcam and traffic-camera clips to detect crashes, emergency vehicles, debris and road work. Cross-checks claims against tracked objects, predicts clearance time range, and scores stay, reroute or wait options.

pgodlews/RoadLens.summary: Reviews bike and dashcam footage to map potholes into human-approved council reports.
pgodlews/RoadLens.readme_summary: RoadLens is a post-ride workflow that turns bike and dashcam footage into reviewed hazard evidence. Python pipeline uses SAM 3.1 to segment candidates and Muse Glimmer to triage before human confirm. Exports GeoJSON and draft council reports with GPS mapping.

nik-schultz/agents-on-radar.summary: Searchable hub of real AI agent use cases with build-your-own blueprints
nik-schultz/agents-on-radar.readme_summary: Live hub at botsdothat.com showing real AI agent use cases for non-technical users with sources and bot blueprints. Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS site generated by a stdlib-only Python script and hosted on GitHub Pages.

Simple-With-Us/Clutch.summary: Local web UI and profiles for running coding agents via ACP bridges
Simple-With-Us/Clutch.readme_summary: Web interface, coding profiles and ACP bridges around upstream DeepSeek harness with DeepSeek, MiniMax and Muse Code configs. Engines are pluggable files under engines/, with Mac dock app and iPhone companion pairing.

nickthelegend/hasami.summary: Rover arm that fetches named objects using Spark and SAM segmentation
nickthelegend/hasami.readme_summary: Thenar Walker rover + Raspberry Pi + 6-servo arm + wrist webcam. Muse Spark parses fetch intent, SAM 3.1 segments object with SAM 2.1 fallback for grasp and release verified on hardware and MuJoCo.

Nanayatou4/andado_ai.summary: Voice-first photo assistant describing scenes for blind users
Nanayatou4/andado_ai.readme_summary: Voice-first web assistant for blind and low-vision users to photograph a scene and ask questions by voice or text. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for answers, object highlight, clock-face position and retake tips.

sumitjadhav1703/Lazarus_Sentinel.summary: Read-only app security analysis where every finding traces to code evidence.
sumitjadhav1703/Lazarus_Sentinel.readme_summary: Graph-first, read-only security analysis for a controlled FastAPI fixture. Builds deterministic Python code graphs with authorization context and renders them in React/Cytoscape. Uses Meta AI to generate reports constrained to cite only traced evidence IDs.

Akas333/TYSA.summary: Adaptive learning app that locates knowledge gaps and teaches from there
Akas333/TYSA.readme_summary: TYSA is an Electron learning harness that diagnoses understanding and generates personalized lessons. Built on Meta Muse models with monorepo apps, packages and skills. Distributed as desktop releases with docs and site.

coopersplayground/FuseBox.summary: Raspberry Pi home hub for scam protection and text-first PC help
coopersplayground/FuseBox.readme_summary: Always-on Raspberry Pi 5 appliance linking phones, cameras and smart devices via auditable Switch workflows. Built with Muse AI coding. Uses Muse Spark and Meta models for Guardian monitoring and assistance.

dukemawex/airhealth-engineer.summary: Indoor-air agent that senses, plans and controls purifiers with approval.
dukemawex/airhealth-engineer.readme_summary: Agent that fuses OpenAQ/CAMS data, forecast and room photos to size CADR and schedule ventilation. Requires user approval before controlling via Home Assistant, webhook or Bluetooth. Uses Muse Spark scene analysis plus SAM 3.1 for haze and vent outlines.

azdemir/sharkwatch.summary: Drone shark detection that sends confirmed alerts to lifeguards in seconds
azdemir/sharkwatch.readme_summary: SharkWatch analyzes aerial water video to detect sharks amid glare and kelp. It packages evidence and routes confirmed alerts to authorities. Next.js app with live and demo routes built for Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon 2026.

Sameer769dev/CrisisGrid.summary: Multimodal disaster triage with verified emergency dispatch workflow.
Sameer769dev/CrisisGrid.readme_summary: Autonomous triage agent combining spatial segmentation, radio transcription and multimodal assessment with deterministic Python verifier. FastAPI backend plus Next.js frontend for infrastructure damage and dispatch. Integrates sam-3.1, Muse voice, Spark, Wonder and Image.

madsloevbjerg/creative-intelligence-lab.summary: Maps Meta ad portfolios to reveal missing motivation and format ideas.
madsloevbjerg/creative-intelligence-lab.readme_summary: Web app for advertisers that maps coverage of creative ideas across a portfolio. Runs cached demo with no key, optional passcode-gated live mode. References Meta Andromeda retrieval for context on ad encoding.

soulsplit/wrenchmind.summary: Point camera at engine to get AR part outlines and grounded repair steps.
soulsplit/wrenchmind.readme_summary: Mobile web app where camera, voice or circle-to-search triggers part segmentation and repair cards. Stack is Vite, Tailwind and web UI with iFixit guide linking. Uses SAM 3.1 for AR outlines and Muse Spark 1.3 for steps.

krl886/endovascular-toolkit.summary: Decision support that turns case notes into compatibility-checked leg artery plans.
krl886/endovascular-toolkit.readme_summary: Streamlit app that parses typed, pasted or dictated cases into structured femoropopliteal plans. Applies clinician rules to output strategy, access, kit and rationale. Uses Meta Muse models for parsing and reasoning.

F1nnSBK/beeJEPA-metaai-hackathon.summary: Edge hive monitor that detects anomalies with video prediction and segmentation
F1nnSBK/beeJEPA-metaai-hackathon.readme_summary: Monitors hive entrances on Raspberry Pi 4 using V-JEPA 2.1 surprise detection, SAM 3.1 segmentation, and Muse Spark Open reasoning. Built on Java 25 with GraalVM Native Image, plus web console and Hugging Face dataset. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech.

EFTAKHAR-AMIN-SAKIB/mylaws-website.summary: Bangladesh legal assistant that answers law questions with cited sources and Bengali PDFs.
EFTAKHAR-AMIN-SAKIB/mylaws-website.readme_summary: Source-grounded legal information and document preparation platform for Bangladesh covering 255 provisions across 31 acts. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind and Cloudflare D1 with Vitest and an offline deterministic workflow plus Bengali PDF engine.

msonnendeck/sari-anatomy.summary: Research workbench linking scan slices, annotations and 3D anatomy views
msonnendeck/sari-anatomy.readme_summary: Node + web workbench for axial/coronal views, editable annotations and mask comparisons with 3D context. Single-user local prototype. Uses Meta AI for draft region proposals for expert review only.

Davesoul/Komaverse.summary: Turns manga pages into animated sequences in the browser with no GPU
Davesoul/Komaverse.readme_summary: Browser anime studio that scans pages, detects panels, cleans frames, interpolates and animates for export. Full-stack JS app with CI and docs; uses Muse Spark chat/vision, Muse Image, Muse Voice, SAM 3.1 plus open-weight Muse models.

Spandan-Mishra/codelit.summary: AI-proof coding assessment that grades how candidates direct agents
Spandan-Mishra/codelit.readme_summary: Next.js + connector platform with staged scenarios and prompt budgets. Captures prompts and file diffs for ranked runs. Built for agentic-hiring evaluation; uses Meta AI models for task staging and review.

CodeByVish/stylewise-hackathon.summary: Shows how each garment size fits your body shape on a proportional mannequin with reasons.
CodeByVish/stylewise-hackathon.readme_summary: Compares brand size charts against Meta MHR body presets or user measurements region by region. Next.js app renders faceless proportional mannequin and Nisha sizing assistant explains fit in plain words.

mostro3000/BoardPilot.summary: Android copilot that maps PCB photos and guides one-step multimeter fault isolation.
mostro3000/BoardPilot.readme_summary: Native Android app with no backend; technician photographs board and describes symptoms. Uses SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API for part mapping, Muse Spark for ranked faults and gated measurements, Muse Image for repair view.

krawal19/Frogless.summary: Checks written crochet patterns stitch-by-stitch to find breaks and suggest fixes.
krawal19/Frogless.readme_summary: Paste a pattern to validate stitch counts, detect where it breaks and preview what it makes. Python web app with stitch-by-stitch checker, fix suggestions and demo video, built to avoid frogging yarn.

Aastik0/Yaad.summary: Wearable memory companion for glasses that maps belongings and recalls people.
Aastik0/Yaad.readme_summary: Wearable-first assistant designed for Meta Smart Glasses with POV snapshots and voice commands. Grounds belongings to visual landmarks for dementia/MCI/ADHD users, with Next.js apps and Meta Muse integration.

ShaunakMoghe/Scylla.summary: Firewall between agents and world that screens inputs and blocks risky tool calls.
ShaunakMoghe/Scylla.readme_summary: Ingress screens emails, web, files and images with heuristics, guard model, Muse Spark vision and SAM 3.1. Egress enforces DLP and tool policies with Muse judge; red-team agent self-hardens rules.

Aaron-Kim33/MetaHackathon.summary: Mobile photo editor for AI cutouts, stickers, retouch, and 3D pop-out scenes.
Aaron-Kim33/MetaHackathon.readme_summary: Reel Talk is a mobile editor for lifting subjects, layering cutouts, generating stickers, and text or voice retouch. Supports 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 canvases with reusable asset library. Built with React Native/Expo using Meta AI vision models.

Nan0pk/model-hierarchy.summary: Daily tier ranking of frontier models with evidence and audit trail
Nan0pk/model-hierarchy.readme_summary: Model Atlas aggregates Arena, LiveBench, Terminal-Bench and others into source-native rankings. Static dashboard with JSON/CSV outputs and methodology docs. No Meta model dependency; evaluation infra project.

ShawnTheCreator/Chrono.summary: High-speed flight recorder that captures and audits autonomous agent actions.
ShawnTheCreator/Chrono.readme_summary: C++20 core with bridge/adapters for high-throughput agent event ingest and O(log n) seek. Provides SHA-256 Merkle tamper-evidence and forensic verification. Uses Meta muse-spark-1.3 API for causal instruction over recorded traces.

elthommy/privy-council.summary: Local-first council of AI personas that debate your questions
elthommy/privy-council.readme_summary: Terminal app `council` where Markdown-defined personas debate via blind first round then cross-examination and synthesis. Models run only via Claude Code CLI or local models, with session memory. Multi-agent orchestration for private deliberation.

KoxyG/Talk2Buy.summary: Chat in English or Pidgin to order food and essentials locally
KoxyG/Talk2Buy.readme_summary: Tool-calling agent on Meta models turns chat or voice into product search, cart and order with nearby shops via web and WhatsApp. Monorepo with agent service, apps and packages. Uses Meta models for dialogue, transcription and WhatsApp handling.

marco-torres-ai/brak.summary: One phone video becomes a priced catalog with studio photos
marco-torres-ai/brak.readme_summary: FastAPI backend + frontend takes a seller video, segments products with SAM 3.1 and generates studio photos with Muse Image 1.0. Human review before publishing with prices and stock. Built end-to-end on Meta Model API.

kashu94/crewops-meta-global-ai.summary: Airline crew recovery that finds rested, rated replacements in seconds
kashu94/crewops-meta-global-ai.readme_summary: Regional airline crew control that parses sick notes and finds rested, rated, current cover via deterministic rules engine. Python src, web UI, infra and TV display. Uses Muse models to read, plan and explain with verifier against engine results.

nikunjtrehan/remnant-x.summary: Turns sheet offcut photos into hole-aware CNC cutting plans
nikunjtrehan/remnant-x.readme_summary: Desktop prototype for reviewing photographed sheet remnants and planning parts across inventory with hole-aware nesting. React TypeScript frontend with FastAPI backend. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and software-verified CNC output.

sandeepkumareeri/teacherdox-muse.summary: Early teaching-record experiments moved to teacherdox-core
sandeepkumareeri/teacherdox-muse.readme_summary: Withdrawn early experiments for TeacherDox, not the final submission. Points to teacherdox-core for open .tdx 2.0 record engine. Intended stack was SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark and Spark Open for board detection.

SahanaGaneshvel/META.summary: AI operator fits more EV chargers on existing building grid connection
SahanaGaneshvel/META.readme_summary: Headroom optimizes EV charging against building load to avoid peak demand charges and overload. Streamlit operator with simulation, tariff logic and live demo. Built for energy control of a physical system.

0xcuy/statcam.summary: Broadcast-grade sports analytics from ordinary match footage
0xcuy/statcam.readme_summary: Three-stage pipeline: SAM 3.1 tracks players and ball, Muse Spark writes sport-specific analysis code, sandbox executes to KPIs and report cards. Upload video or link via web frontend. Every fallback explicitly labeled.

sc-frederick/moke-meta-hackathon.summary: Desktop workbench for QA review of engineering drawing packets
sc-frederick/moke-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Desktop app that imports PDF drawing sets and runs whole-set QA or discipline reviews. Reads source images, records findings with coverage and stable issue IDs, exports offline HTML. Uses Meta Muse for reasoning and SAM for image grounding with Auto routing.

gvm-agents/finance_bros.summary: Benchmark showing trained open model beats frontier model on SEC filing tasks
gvm-agents/finance_bros.readme_summary: Benchmarks open vs frontier models on 8-K sorting and Form D extraction from public SEC filings. Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B on Fireworks on few hundred examples. Reports accuracy and cost with significance tests.

watt-mind/pii-guard-video.summary: Private Remotion project that renders the 3-minute PII Guard hackathon video
watt-mind/pii-guard-video.readme_summary: Private companion repo holding screenplay, beats timing, claims evidence, and capture tooling for the PII Guard video. Remotion composition renders one scene per beat. All data fictional, not part of open-source product.

Naryadchikov/cogito-playtest-lens.summary: Godot COGITO fork adding Playtest Lens logging and telemetry for playtests
Naryadchikov/cogito-playtest-lens.readme_summary: Fork of COGITO immersive-sim template for Godot 4. Main branch is upstream unchanged; playtest-lens branch adds logging add-on, COGITO adapter, and telemetry volumes. Supports Playtest Lens playtest analyst.

JulianChaoul16/Swarm_Crisis_Command.summary: Agent swarm that triages incidents and drafts emergency response plans
JulianChaoul16/Swarm_Crisis_Command.readme_summary: Open-source human-led agent swarm for city emergency operations, demoed as Richmond VA flash flood. Uses Muse Spark for triage, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for inputs, and Muse Wonder with solver planning; person approves decisions.

Daddy-Ousen/RunBookPilot.summary: Grounded IT triage workbench that drafts safe runbooks from tickets and screenshots
Daddy-Ousen/RunBookPilot.readme_summary: Workbench for Windows MSPs that matches tickets and error screenshots to Markdown runbooks via BM25L. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for grounded diagnosis, classifies PowerShell risk, and supports re-triage and PSA writeback. Never executes commands.

ayandipe/Reunite.summary: Consent-first reconnection bridge for families separated by war and displacement
ayandipe/Reunite.readme_summary: Privacy-first blind-matching service to reconnect families without searchable directories. Backend parses memories, resolves matches, and redacts documents. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, and SAM 3.1 with consent-gated contact.

Shivam-sopho/infratwin-live.summary: Live 3D digital twin that monitors bridges and defects from sensors and video
Shivam-sopho/infratwin-live.readme_summary: InfraTwin-Live maps bridges, tunnels and dams in 3D with sensor health and AI video inspection. Stack is Dockerized backend/frontend with Modal workers, using SAM 3.1, Muse Spark/Wonder, Image and Voice.

Atilla888/ActCheck.summary: Checks renovation bills by measuring tiled walls from phone photos
Atilla888/ActCheck.readme_summary: Reads contractor work statements and measures tiled areas from ordinary photos using tile grid as scale. SAM 3.1 finds tiles to recover wall plane, returning findings with uncertainty.

serrebidev/BlindPilot.summary: Screen-reader-first desktop host that makes AI coding CLIs accessible
serrebidev/BlindPilot.readme_summary: Accessible desktop frontend that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and others in native windows. Exposes real buttons and edit boxes for NVDA, JAWS and VoiceOver. Cross-platform Windows, macOS and Linux app.

JaynouOliver/Meld.summary: Team chat with Atlas agent that creates and updates tickets from conversation
JaynouOliver/Meld.readme_summary: Team chat with channels, DMs, threads and tickets workspace. Atlas agent performs CRUD on tickets with user permissions via domain layer in src/lib. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Meta Model API, with evals in evals/.

Deeveshizm/uptodate-metahackathon.summary: Newsletter-to-posts reader app with private email alias to declutter inbox
Deeveshizm/uptodate-metahackathon.readme_summary: Gives newsletters a separate home outside main inbox. Creates account with private email alias, ingests subscriptions into readable posts. Stack includes Python backend, Docker/GCP deploy, mobile native client, web frontend.

ong6/lives-in-motion.summary: Illustrated Singaporean biography books with layered animated pages and sources
ong6/lives-in-motion.readme_summary: Interactive cloth-cover books with pen frontispiece, decade-style plates, short films per spread and footnoted captions. Next.js app with generation pipeline using Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1, Muse Wonder, Voice Transcribe.

kraisorna/phone-to-ledger.summary: Phone photo to ledger CSV pipeline for Thai tax invoices and receipts
kraisorna/phone-to-ledger.readme_summary: Ingest, PII scrub, segment, extract, validate and export Thai invoices to CSV/XLSX. Uses SAM 3.1 segmentation, Muse Spark extraction, satang/VAT math, R1-R14 rules, review queue, CLI. Python package with eval harness and gold labels.

Kasties/muse-body.summary: Embodied VRChat agent that sees, hears, finds objects and brings them to you
Kasties/muse-body.readme_summary: muse-body is a VRChat embodied agent controlled via virtual Xbox gamepad and OSC. Muse Spark picks intent from first-person view, SAM 3.1 localizes target. Muse Voice Transcribe handles speech input.

Shuba-Matam/ReLove.summary: Campus marketplace for buying, selling, and chatting about second-hand student items.
Shuba-Matam/ReLove.readme_summary: ReLove is a student marketplace for pre-loved items with listings, chat and reports. Next.js TypeScript Tailwind frontend with Supabase Auth Postgres Storage and RLS migrations. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for listing suggestions, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 cutouts.

HuynhBaHieuu/PRM393.summary: Offline Flutter wardrobe planner with outfits, calendar and wear tracking
HuynhBaHieuu/PRM393.readme_summary: Add clothes, build outfits, plan on calendar, track wears and view stats. All data stored on-device, no backend. Built with Flutter/Dart, Supabase folder present, sample wardrobe seeded on first launch.

celikender/vLock-AI-Vision.summary: Plain-English camera rules for SCADA that watches for people, animals and events
celikender/vLock-AI-Vision.readme_summary: Connects USB/HTTP/RTSP cameras to SCADA via fixed tags with freshness handling. Muse Spark drafts plain-language rules for approval while SAM 3.1 performs detection. Stack includes Docker, Ignition SCADA, Python playground and demo site.

BunquinTheodore/HumanPort.summary: Dispatches physical-world tasks from AI agents to vetted nearby humans
BunquinTheodore/HumanPort.readme_summary: When agents need physical action, routes task to nearby person who completes it with photo evidence. Live demo site and video, built for Meta hackathon. Cloudflare, Next.js, Drizzle stack with human-in-loop workflow.

atosaramis/trial-copilot.summary: Trial planning tool that benchmarks protocols against past registry data
atosaramis/trial-copilot.readme_summary: Reads protocol PDF text and images, searches 56k ClinicalTrials.gov trials via SQL tools, computes context and registry-only enrollment risk score. Agentic Python app with backtests, docs and tests, no patient data.

duman190/the-lynch-pin.summary: GARP stock screener using PEG deviation, ROI models and income grading
duman190/the-lynch-pin.readme_summary: Peter Lynch-inspired screener computing PEG, historical valuation stats, 5-year ROI and income statement grades. Python engine with Yahoo/FMP data, dark-mode charts and X thread publishing. Uses Gemini for optional AI narratives, not Meta models.

MarissaFamularo/Calibrate.summary: Surgical simulator teaching residents when to trust or override AI
MarissaFamularo/Calibrate.readme_summary: Simulation measuring how surgical residents rely on AI across cases, with faculty compare view for calibrated trust training. Python app with cases, docs and tests. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for clinical decision-support simulation.

bettvkb-glitch/crop-check.summary: Snap a sick crop leaf to get diagnosis, treatment plan and nearby outbreak map.
bettvkb-glitch/crop-check.readme_summary: Vite PWA + Cloudflare Worker + Supabase with scans and realtime outbreak signals. Worker calls Meta Model API so keys stay server-side. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment lesions and Muse Spark for diagnosis.

VirenChauhan19/WorldOS.summary: AR interior studio to build scenes from furniture pieces and preview in space
VirenChauhan19/WorldOS.readme_summary: WorldOS is an AR interior studio for building scenes from 36 furniture, lighting and wall pieces. Includes mobile AR preview, workspaces, and reliability improvements. Backend plus Capacitor Android/iOS mobile app.

msu/catatui.summary: Terminal coding agent for MSU students with teach-me and plan modes
msu/catatui.readme_summary: CLI agent harness built as extension on pi.dev harness for MSU CatChat AI models. Reads, runs and edits code in ask, plan and yolo modes with ta teaching mode. Includes skills, themes and desktop wrapper.

ahmedps520-svg/OMNIA.summary: Private offline LLM workstation for iPad Pro and iPhone with Metal GPU.
ahmedps520-svg/OMNIA.readme_summary: OMNIA is a native Swift/SwiftUI iOS workstation that downloads GGUF models once then chats offline. Inference via llama.cpp XCFramework with Metal backend, widgets and TestFlight builds. Uses local open-weight models, no cloud inference.

dptel22/sem-triage-agent.summary: Verifiable AI triage for semiconductor SEM defects with selective abstention.
dptel22/sem-triage-agent.readme_summary: Evaluates SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 on Carinthia-S SEM benchmark for rare defect classification. Framework measures IoU, calibration and abstention for manufacturing ADC. Python stack with reproducible results and tests.

RomeKai/mme.summary: Budget-safe harness to run coding agents on Meta Muse models without overspend.
RomeKai/mme.readme_summary: Layer over ECC plan-test-implement-review workflow enforcing meta-only/first policies. Uses LiteLLM + Postgres gateway budgets, loop breaker and burst watchdog. Adds fallback chains and AI-usage logs.

aranaskristoff2-ai/SMILE_PH.summary: Postal travel quest in the Philippines to collect stamps, mail postcards, shop local.
aranaskristoff2-ai/SMILE_PH.readme_summary: PWA with AI guide Isidro, QR stamp collection E to SSS ranks, spoken journal and Nano-Shops via PayMongo. Backend integrates Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe for guide, media and moderation.

vidyavids/fraudpause.summary: Scam-story checker that judges messages, screenshots and calls before you pay.
vidyavids/fraudpause.readme_summary: Bank-integration-free web app analyzing SMS, WhatsApp, email and QR context for red flags. Returns verdict card with next steps without seeing accounts or payments. Vite + Tailwind frontend with Vercel demo.

bravoshubham/crosscheck.summary: AI monitoring pilot that cross-checks radio calls against cockpit displays in simulator
bravoshubham/crosscheck.readme_summary: Crosscheck listens to ATC radio and reads flight displays via camera to flag said vs set vs doing mismatches. Python brain, bridge to X-Plane 12, debrief and eval harness. Uses Meta models for vision and speech, scored against simulator truth.

royanqodri/fms-ai-hackathon.summary: Fleet management for Lumajang truckers with breakdown alerts and hands-free voice commands
royanqodri/fms-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: FMS AI Lumajang is a Go-based fleet system for local truck drivers to prevent breakdowns and traffic delays. It uses Meta Muse Spark, Voice and Image via Telegram and web for hands-free diagnostics and dispatch.

ABDULWAHAB-dev7/CAIRN-AI.summary: Bench camera that tracks parts across teardown and verifies repair completion
ABDULWAHAB-dev7/CAIRN-AI.readme_summary: Cairn adds object permanence to repair work, tracking parts across frames to flag missing or out-of-order items. Stack is Python + Docker + Vercel replay with bench vision pipeline. Targets SAM 3.1 for segmentation with Muse Wonder/Glimmer/Voice for reasoning.

vamshikanderao2579-dbt/deja-vu-confirmed.summary: Pluggable memory layer that stores confirmed cards and retrieves only relevant context
vamshikanderao2579-dbt/deja-vu-confirmed.readme_summary: Deja Vu is an agentic memory layer that infers short cards from chats, verifies against user words, and injects ~150 tokens per request. Built on Meta Muse models, it plugs into Muse, Claude or ChatGPT without changing chat flow.

AnonyMap/gpu-yield.summary: Keeps local LLM loaded when idle and frees GPU automatically when a game starts.
AnonyMap/gpu-yield.readme_summary: gpu-yield is a single-file Python daemon for Bazzite Linux that manages Ollama around Steam games. It preloads the model when idle and stops it within seconds of gameplay. No dependencies, with cooldown and 503 placeholder.

joevidev/glance.summary: macOS app that moves the cursor with gaze and acts on short voice commands
joevidev/glance.readme_summary: Glance tracks eye gaze to move the real cursor with wink-click and nod-scroll, then combines gaze plus voice to pick UI elements. Agent runs on Fireworks models for one-step click grounding, with multi-step tasks in progress.

avencera/sam3rs.summary: Native Rust/CUDA runtime for SAM 3 that runs 24x faster than PyTorch
avencera/sam3rs.readme_summary: Rust/CUDA reimplementation of Meta SAM 3 loading official HF checkpoint with no PyTorch or ONNX. Supports text/box/point prompts and click-to-track video on one CUDA stream in BF16.

shankarr1503/Meta_Hackthon.summary: AI investigator diagnoses machine vibration with evidence-based experiments
shankarr1503/Meta_Hackthon.readme_summary: FailureLab AI runs vibration experiments for imbalance, misalignment, bearing faults, stating expectations before results. Explains diagnosis and answers from evidence. Python backend with Docker, local serve, captioned demo video.

anurag-devx/forward-court.summary: WhatsApp fact-checker where agents debate forwards and judge returns verdict card
anurag-devx/forward-court.readme_summary: Forward Court forwards suspicious text, photo or video to true-vs-false agents that cite only retrieved sources. A judge returns True/False/Misleading/Unverified or Dangerous verdict cards in user language for resharing.

JordanAryaLeksana/intentcut.summary: Local-first AI video editor that builds grounded first cuts and highlight reels
JordanAryaLeksana/intentcut.readme_summary: IntentCut offers AI First Cut and AI Highlights workflows with timestamp review and MP4 export. Backend uses Python with FFmpeg rendering and Meta Muse Spark for structured understanding of sampled video moments.

Narubyx/voxel-sam-ar.summary: Phone video to true-scale WebAR 3D model via SAM and mesh agent
Narubyx/voxel-sam-ar.readme_summary: Pipeline from 360 video to WebAR GLB/USDZ via SAM segmentation, geometry extraction and agentic watertight loop. Modal GPU + FastAPI, Baseten muse-spark-open-1026, Trimesh/Open3D agent, Vite model-viewer. Uses SAM and Muse Spark 1.3.

janhavitupe/kitsune.summary: Git-like version control, branching and region merge for digital paintings
janhavitupe/kitsune.readme_summary: Saves painting versions, branches ideas, diffs regions in plain words, and merges or restores regions pixel-for-pixel. Built with Muse Code with browser frontend, backend, CLI and Modal. Never generates pixels, only copies artist pixels.

DavidDiazMerino/compinche.summary: Watches cooks to capture unspoken techniques and teaches them back later.
DavidDiazMerino/compinche.readme_summary: Compinche watches cooking via phone or Ray-Ban Meta glasses, asks about unexplained decisions, and saves answers as video-linked cards. Later replays teaching in another kitchen. Built with LangGraph, Meta models, and local SAM 3.1.

Khagendra01/object-dynamics-vla.summary: Trains robot action policies on frozen Muse features with SAM object tracking
Khagendra01/object-dynamics-vla.readme_summary: Dataset-first kit trains vision-language-action policies conditioned on quantized Muse features and SAM tracking. Evaluated on LIBERO milk-placement with checkpoints and repro docs. Python configs and LIBERO integration included.

EcoPrism/whos-on-my-grid.summary: Type a US address to see data centers, builds, bills and hearings with cites
EcoPrism/whos-on-my-grid.readme_summary: Turns one address into a cited brief and card covering electric bill, noise, water, land and taxes. Uses four Meta models with verification and evals. Stack includes Docker, schemas, fixtures and docs with live demo at mygrid.ai.

mhtpsd/ChronoRig.summary: Converts video of mechanisms into verified Three.js and Blender physics rigs
mhtpsd/ChronoRig.readme_summary: Autonomous video-to-physics engine that segments with SAM 3.1, reasons with Muse Spark 1.3 and Open 1026, and self-verifies Three.js/Rapier and Blender rigs. Monorepo with apps, packages and infra, built for Push the Frontier.

roninram/retake-coach.summary: Checks fundus photos in a second and tells technicians keep or retake
roninram/retake-coach.readme_summary: On-device diabetic eye screening QA that flags blur, aim and coverage issues while patient is present. Python app with coach_core, experiments, notebooks and tests. Reduces ungradable rates and return visits.

othnielObasi/sovereign-autonomy.summary: Command and trust layer to govern mixed robot fleet missions
othnielObasi/sovereign-autonomy.readme_summary: Coordinates missions for mobile carriers and humanoids in pharma cleanrooms. Governs execution so only authorized movement proceeds and preserves evidence. Next.js 14 frontend with Python 3.11 backend built on Meta AI.

skywalker-gh/NOVA-META-Edition.summary: Multi-agent bus chat and workflow manager with human approval control
skywalker-gh/NOVA-META-Edition.readme_summary: Multi-model ecosystem where specialized agents share context via bus chat and workflows route tasks with human authority gates. Implements dashboard, agents, context store and Muse Spark bridge for META Edition.

fuentesbusco/agrocontrol-meta-ia-engine.summary: NestJS service reconciling farm dispatches to plant using multimodal AI OCR
fuentesbusco/agrocontrol-meta-ia-engine.readme_summary: Automates field-to-plant reconciliation with Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning and ERP RAG, Muse Glimmer OCR for handwritten guias, and Muse Spark Open failover via Modal and Fireworks. NestJS microservice built for Startup Build for Your World.

hailemichaeltesfsye-hue/-nexus-the-livin.summary: Multi-agent digital twin OS simulating Addis Ababa traffic, services and safety.
hailemichaeltesfsye-hue/-nexus-the-livin.readme_summary: Builds a city-scale digital twin and multi-agent metropolitan OS for Addis Ababa. Uses Next.js frontend with Modal GPU backend, Llama 3.3 70B as cognitive core, SAM for perception and Llama-Guard 3 for safety.

Rajoza8/servetune.summary: Self-healing LLM serving agent that detects and fixes GPU incidents
Rajoza8/servetune.readme_summary: ServeDoctor watches vLLM every 30s with local Muse Glimmer, escalating to Spark/Wonder to diagnose and apply whitelisted fixes. Includes ServeIncidents benchmark with sealed answers and replay site. Built Oct 29-Nov 3 2026 for Push the Frontier.

tochi-3000/SolveIt.summary: Neuro-symbolic math tutor with step verification and WAEC red-pen grading.
tochi-3000/SolveIt.readme_summary: SolvAm is a Next.js Turborepo math tutor combining Muse Spark with FastAPI/SymPy symbolic engine for zero-hallucination steps. Uses SAM, voice and image input to diagnose WAEC answers with red-pen feedback.

walterjrey/agrogenesis-muse-agent.summary: Autonomous farm manager agent that controls a simulator via HTTP API
walterjrey/agrogenesis-muse-agent.readme_summary: AgroGenesis agent adds autonomous observation, planning and tool-calling over a pre-existing farm simulator. Built in TypeScript with Meta Model API (Muse), persistence, and benchmarks via HTTP-only integration.

mira-takeda/continuum.summary: Local-first memory and web UI that gives Muse Code persistent project context.
mira-takeda/continuum.readme_summary: Local web frontend that streams Muse Code verbatim with persistent global and project memory. Stores identity, decisions and .continuum.md context with corrections and isolation via Python server.

Aravind-11/muse-moe-w4a16-kernels.summary: Custom NVFP4 MoE CUDA kernel beating SGLang Marlin top-8 routing on H200.
Aravind-11/muse-moe-w4a16-kernels.readme_summary: Implements a custom W4A16 routed-experts kernel for Muse MoE versus SGLang Marlin baseline. Iterates via PRs with TMA, split-K and fused SiLU optimizations, reaching 1.6x speedup on H200.

mousisite/grandma-buddy-hackathon.summary: Voice companion for lonely seniors with check-ins, pill reminders and family alerts.
mousisite/grandma-buddy-hackathon.readme_summary: Voice-first companion for older adults living alone with daily check-ins, medication reminders and symptom notes. Built on Muse models with no medical advice, family dashboard and safety escalation.

its-camilo/galileo-live.summary: Voice-guided phone physics lab that measures motion and writes LaTeX reports.
its-camilo/galileo-live.readme_summary: Records ramp and free-fall experiments, tracks objects with Meta vision models to compute acceleration and error plots. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark as lab partner with Next.js and API backend.

chainerprince/itara.summary: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway sharing one team codebase context for AI tools.
chainerprince/itara.readme_summary: Itara ingests team code and docs once and injects scoped context per request via Postgres row-level security. Works with vLLM or Ollama backends and Modal deployment. Uses Muse models alongside open models for memory and answers.

cromestant/Alumbra_.summary: Phone visual assistant giving blind users clock-face spatial descriptions.
cromestant/Alumbra_.readme_summary: Points phone camera to segment scene with SAM 3.1 into objects, directions, distances and OCR text. Muse Spark answers with grounded descriptions via FastAPI backend and escalates to volunteers.

jangholee92/geonos-nyc.summary: Compares NYC buildings using official records and imagery for retrofit planning
jangholee92/geonos-nyc.readme_summary: Workspace to explore NYC buildings, compare two candidates, and plan climate-resilient retrofits. Built on Cloudflare Worker with official lot records, aerial imagery and 3D display. Uses seven Meta model roles across hosted workflow and local inspection mode.

Kanompung1988/A-Note.summary: Turns one-line worksheets into interactive lessons with handwritten mistake review
Kanompung1988/A-Note.readme_summary: AI classroom platform where teachers generate worksheets and learners circle confusion and check handwriting. Co-pilot analyzes class mistakes to generate targeted practice with hints. Built with Next.js and Meta AI models for worksheet and vision tasks.

singhsahab555/lumina-ai.summary: Transfers files to air-gapped machines via screen-camera light channel
singhsahab555/lumina-ai.readme_summary: Verifiable optical bridge that encodes files and agent context into light patterns for isolated systems. Uses Muse Spark for semantic packing and Muse Glimmer for red-teaming, plus LT fountain codes. No network, RF, or USB required.

Siddhartha20242/upkeep.summary: Audits Python upgrades and behavior-tests AI-proposed fixes before trusting them
Siddhartha20242/upkeep.readme_summary: CLI that lists code lines broken by dependency upgrades and validates agent fixes against old library behavior. Agent runs on Muse Spark Open via Baseten with code deciding safety. Includes tests, eval results, and no-API-key audit mode.

rishikathakre/fireshift-ai.summary: Simulates wildfire spread from satellite perimeter to prioritize firefighting resources
rishikathakre/fireshift-ai.readme_summary: Wind- and terrain-aware spread simulation starting from early satellite perimeter to predict buildings and roads at risk. Reasoning model compares what-if wind-shift scenarios and explains response priorities. Validated against historical fire, built with Streamlit.

nanobpm/nano-coder.summary: 6MB Rust terminal coding agent for running large local agent fleets.
nanobpm/nano-coder.readme_summary: nano-coder is a Rust REPL coding CLI with bash tools and ACP JSON-RPC headless mode. Distributed via npm and cargo with evals and c8ctl-nano orchestration. Works with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic model endpoints per model.

Makabeez/falsify.summary: Converts trading claims into testable rules and backtests them on Binance data
Makabeez/falsify.readme_summary: Paste a tip, screenshot or clip to get whether it survives real market history. Muse Spark compiles claims into rules and audits results, tested against Binance data. Python backend with live web app and evaluation corpus.

vanta-jack/chadcode.summary: 10-turn branching game where you play an AI agent surviving security audits
vanta-jack/chadcode.readme_summary: Browser choose-your-own-adventure simulation roleplaying as CHAD, an autonomous coding agent shipping code under compliance pressure. Static web app with branching narrative and cybersecurity lessons. Deployed to GitHub Pages.

rick2x/hydrosight.summary: Turns street flood photos into 3D flood maps and rescue routes
rick2x/hydrosight.readme_summary: Converts street-level flood photos into DEM-based flood-extent shapefiles with depth profiles and rescue corridors for Rodriguez, Rizal. Uses Docker backend/frontend stack with DEM processing pipeline.

vinwalsh/textsous.summary: Converts recipe URLs, text or photos into guided Cook Along timelines
vinwalsh/textsous.readme_summary: TextSous Open converts URLs, pasted text or cookbook photos into canonical recipe JSON with timeline and variants. The Next.js web app and CLI use a Meta model API for parsing and variant generation. Outputs open in Cook Along view.

wpimedia1/A.R.C..summary: Multi-agent simulator planning robotic outpost preparation on Mars
wpimedia1/A.R.C..readme_summary: Persistent planning simulator where Meta-model agents propose Mars site preparation. Validator owns execution and balances, with CLI mission packages, council dashboard and Docker compose.

Ramkmm/meta-ai-logistics-copilot.summary: AI copilot explains delivery delays and prioritizes actions for Indian distributors
Ramkmm/meta-ai-logistics-copilot.readme_summary: Decision-support app for Indian distributors and MSMEs to track delays, shortages and costs. Built with React dashboard plus Python FastAPI backend integrated with Meta Model API. Uses Meta AI assistant to interpret logistics data and suggest next steps.

lakshya14-ds/RecoverFlow-AI.summary: Isolates disputed invoice amounts and drafts collection notices for MSMEs
lakshya14-ds/RecoverFlow-AI.readme_summary: AR dispute-resolution platform for Indian MSME distributors. Isolates disputed vs undisputed balances, verifies claims against evidence, drafts notices, and requires human approval. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for verification and drafting with FastAPI backend and web frontend.

josuecuguy1307/Multi-Auto-Setup.summary: Private LAN agent network letting your own computers work as a team
josuecuguy1307/Multi-Auto-Setup.readme_summary: Multi-Auto-Setup creates a private LAN network of agents across macOS, Windows and Linux. Connects Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, Muse and coding agents locally. Python 3.11+ with local-first data.

PRATHAMAHUJA001/fourthmatch.summary: Adds dock video as fourth match to hold payments when footage contradicts paperwork
PRATHAMAHUJA001/fourthmatch.readme_summary: Procurement verification that adds receiving-dock video to PO, GRN and invoice three-way match. Full-stack backend plus frontend with policy engine citing receiving policy clauses. Uses Meta AI agent vision reasoning over synthetic delivery videos.

AIchaliveret/batik-guard-8in1.summary: 20x110m autonomous batik factory prototype with ESP32 robotic controls
AIchaliveret/batik-guard-8in1.readme_summary: Autonomous batik production factory design with floor plans, ESP32-S3 mesh controls and thermal systems. Static HTML demos plus Python app.py and ESP32 firmware. Uses Muse Spark Open via Modal for factory automation logic.

VishwanathArchakMR/Sahaay.summary: Voice-first Windows agent for verified answers and privacy-aware computer actions
VishwanathArchakMR/Sahaay.readme_summary: FastAPI core with .NET Windows agent and Electron Aurora UI for voice input and verified actions. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for truthful retrieval with privacy-aware architecture.

surfiniaburger/barred-hackathon-clean.summary: Turns AI security opinions into deterministic evidence-gated fix decisions with receipts.
surfiniaburger/barred-hackathon-clean.readme_summary: Extracts bounds checks via AST and validates invariants with math receipt checker. Python CLI with fixtures and evidence packs. Uses Meta Muse-Glimmer-30B for agentic code review workflows.

mouhamedsylla/visionlayer.summary: Local-first visual map of systems built by AI agents with memory kept
mouhamedsylla/visionlayer.readme_summary: VisionLayer visualizes agent-built codebases and preserves agent knowledge locally. TypeScript strict stack with CLI, integrations and 317 tests, built with Meta Muse for system understanding.

LOGITHP/CCTV_Footage_Intelligence-.summary: Multi-camera video intelligence system for perimeter alerts and forensics
LOGITHP/CCTV_Footage_Intelligence-.readme_summary: VI Sentry is a VMS that ingests multi-stream CCTV for live detection, spatial-perimeter alerts and agentic forensic search. Architecture uses SAM 3.1/SAM 2, SigLIP 2, LangGraph, FastAPI, Supabase, Qdrant and MinIO with Telegram bot. Muse Spark powers reasoning.

setiani/framelab.summary: Phone videos of physics experiments become verified measurements with uncertainty
setiani/framelab.readme_summary: Turns pendulum or falling-ball videos into physics measurements with uncertainty and audit. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for analysis and Muse Wonder for next-step proposals with Dockerized Python backend.

stephenj-code/solomon.summary: Self-hosted 3-node Jetson Kubernetes cluster for local AI services
stephenj-code/solomon.readme_summary: 3-node NVIDIA Jetson ARM64 cluster running FastAPI microservices and LangGraph agents. Managed by Solomon skill with GitOps, ingress and auth patterns. LLM inference pinned to AGX Orin GPU node.

AmrEmad0/ProofFlow.summary: Verifies procedures from video with tracked visual evidence
AmrEmad0/ProofFlow.readme_summary: Turns procedures into Proof Plans then reviews videos with timestamped findings. Web app with frame inspector. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for events and SAM 3.1 for tracked object geometry.

0xtigerclaw/finguard.summary: Verifies every investment memo number against filings with plugins and approvals
0xtigerclaw/finguard.readme_summary: Finguard is a finance harness that checks investment memo numbers against filings. Plugins declare read/act permissions, approvals and verification. Runs on Meta Muse Spark 1.3 with Demo replay and Live modes.

D1349375/compute-mint.summary: Gateway routing agent traffic to discounted tier while blocking sensitive data
D1349375/compute-mint.readme_summary: Taint-aware proxy between coding agents and Muse API to safely use Contributor pricing. Includes gateway, dashboard, and bench analysis. Uses Muse Spark Contributor tier with taint tracking on context.

NMasters52/punchlens.summary: Mobile construction walkthroughs turn site photos into verified punch-list reports
NMasters52/punchlens.readme_summary: Mobile-first construction QA demo for capturing walkthroughs, photos, and observations. Optional Muse Spark photo analysis via POST /api/analyze, local verification, and offline HTML/PDF reports.

yashvantatk/visiopatch.summary: Visual-bug agent watches UI failures and ships verified fixes from one sentence
yashvantatk/visiopatch.readme_summary: Agent that watches visual bugs, proves them with failing tests, and ships verified fixes. Uses Muse Code plus SAM 3.1 perception, Muse Spark reasoning and Muse Wonder with 146 offline tests.

djhmateer/hackathon-auto-archiver.summary: Queued auto-archiver preserves human-rights video evidence for courts and UN use
djhmateer/hackathon-auto-archiver.readme_summary: Human-rights digital archiving fork adding Postgres queue and distributed workers to Bellingcat auto-archiver. Archives 60k+ URLs from VMs for war-crimes mobile-phone evidence preservation.

nguyenhuulong2222/smoke-or-vog.summary: Satellite haze maps become plain-language vog vs smoke alerts for Hawaii districts
nguyenhuulong2222/smoke-or-vog.readme_summary: Takes GOES-18 GeoColor haze detections and explains vog vs wildfire smoke for Hawaii. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for JSON interpretation, and Muse Image for alert cards.

michaelzoub/magic.summary: Intent-driven browser that groups tabs into recoverable workspaces for each activity.
michaelzoub/magic.readme_summary: Lightweight Electron browser that organizes tabs by activity with named goals and checkpoints. Agent watches browsing context, tidies workspaces and restores them from Memory. Built with Electron Vite, TypeScript and renderer UI plus browsing-context agent.

loveyadav1015/StepProof.summary: Turns expert videos into SOPs and verifies learner attempts with visual proof.
loveyadav1015/StepProof.readme_summary: StepProof generates structured SOPs with steps and visual end-states from expert video, then checks learner video for skipped or out-of-order steps. Runs offline with OpenCV mocks, swappable to SAM 3.1 and Muse models. Includes Streamlit app and eval report.

blackrossay/twinverse-ai.summary: Digital twin platform that debates decisions from parallel perspectives
blackrossay/twinverse-ai.readme_summary: Takes one versioned identity snapshot and runs parallel agents to compare decisions with evidence scores. Next.js UI + Python API with Twin Council, calendar voice agent, and local talking avatar pipeline. Uses Muse models for reasoning and voice interaction.

jsharonsweety28-ai/ARGUS-Lens.summary: Checks social images for AI-generation traces and harmful private content
jsharonsweety28-ai/ARGUS-Lens.readme_summary: Analyzes uploaded images for AI artifacts with outlined evidence regions and for harmful content like PII or gore. Web app plus browser extension with Vercel serverless API. Uses vision-language models to classify and explain findings.

Djebiswags/oja-ledger.summary: Voice-first sales ledger for market traders in Pidgin and English
Djebiswags/oja-ledger.readme_summary: Phone-first PWA where spoken sales, debts and stock updates become structured ledger entries with one-tap confirm. Static HTML/JS front-end with Python brain service. Uses Meta Muse Spark to parse Pidgin/English speech and product photos.

vincentzhangz/mist.summary: eBPF Kubernetes operator that scores pod network traffic for anomalies
vincentzhangz/mist.readme_summary: Captures per-node TC traffic with Aya eBPF sensors, enriches with pod IPs, and scores flows in a Tokio Axum API. Includes kube-rs operator for AnomalyAlert CRs and Leptos dashboard with Postgres and WebSockets. All-Rust observability stack.

esraderey/atisbo-spec.summary: Small speculative model that predicts agent actions to skip LLM calls
esraderey/atisbo-spec.readme_summary: Learns from agent traces to predict next actions, calling Muse Spark only on low confidence, with replayable eval harness. Python package with SAM 3.1 masks for state and published negative-result metrics. Cuts calls from 92 to 49 per episode at 0.96 success.

aryankhanna3600-svg/oocm-campaign-autopi.summary: Turns a website URL into creator briefs, fit scores and verified video checks for brands.
aryankhanna3600-svg/oocm-campaign-autopi.readme_summary: Plugs into OOCM creator-marketing platform to automate campaign creation from a pasted website. Builder writes campaigns, scores creator fit from recent content, and checks draft videos against brief with proof. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Image for creative generation.

Amoh-Ntim/bawabu.summary: Gatekeeper that blocks risky npm installs and investigates packages in a baited cloud sandbox.
Amoh-Ntim/bawabu.readme_summary: Intercepts AI agent installs, statically checks packages and detonates suspicious ones with fake secrets. Service + CLI + locked sandbox architecture. Uses Muse Spark as security engineer to decode and report evidence.

mohvin/worklens.summary: Turns screen recordings into process maps with timings and bottlenecks
mohvin/worklens.readme_summary: Converts screen recordings of ERP, mail and spreadsheet work into process maps with durations and fix recommendations. Monorepo with Python worker and apps/services packages. Uses Meta vision models to understand on-screen actions.

rathodpratham15/jarvis-mobile.summary: Voice assistant that operates Android apps step-by-step to complete tasks
rathodpratham15/jarvis-mobile.readme_summary: JARVIS Mobile takes plain speech goals and executes them via phone tools or vision-guided UI automation. Android app with backend uses Meta Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for verified steps. Speaks back a summary when done.

vladbars/allyfix.summary: Synthetic disabled personas test iOS apps and auto-fix accessibility code
vladbars/allyfix.readme_summary: Allyfix runs six synthetic users with different disabilities in iOS Simulator to complete tasks. Muse Wonder edits code on a git branch to fix blockers, then saves passing runs as deterministic replay tests. Built with Xcode, Swift, and Meta Muse models.

RaghavAror/TRACII_teamMOM_project.summary: Investigates risky npm dependencies and visualizes how they entered your app
RaghavAror/TRACII_teamMOM_project.readme_summary: TRACII combines deterministic npm analysis, static code review, and dependency impact graphs to explain supply-chain risks. Meta Muse models assist investigation and fixes. Stack includes Python backend, frontend dashboard, and GitHub Action.

Rimshaaaaaaa/Reel2Play.summary: Turns shop product videos into playable 20-second mini-game ads
Rimshaaaaaaa/Reel2Play.readme_summary: Reel2Play converts Reels into tested playable ads with win codes, gameplay Reel, and posters. Muse Spark Open directs game generation, Muse Glimmer play-tests, and SAM 3.1 segments products. Stack is Python API, game engine, and eval harness.

founder-sk-hub/ledgerline.summary: Checks invoices against deliveries and drafts payments for human approval
founder-sk-hub/ledgerline.readme_summary: Ledgerline links invoices, purchase orders, photos and voice memos to flag discrepancies and draft emails. Muse Spark reads invoices, Muse Voice transcribes memos, SAM 3.1 counts deliveries. Human reviews; it exports files without sending payments.

mouadelabbassi/realign.summary: Checks lab simulators against observations and freezes evidence-cited trust decisions.
mouadelabbassi/realign.readme_summary: Compares observations to executable pendulum models, requests experiments and cites evidence. Python physics engine with five-view replay UI. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for tool reasoning and SAM 3.1 for bob tracking.

elhadjenglish/sada-.summary: English listening companion for Arabic learners that explains tapped words in context.
elhadjenglish/sada-.readme_summary: Tap words or ask by voice to get CEFR-tuned Arabic explanations saved for review. Web app with Supabase and 16kHz transcribe API. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for explain and Muse Voice Transcribe.

manoprasad2006/fixCV.summary: Multilingual visual copilot that guides home repairs step by step
manoprasad2006/fixCV.readme_summary: FixCV lets users describe broken items by voice in Tamil, Hindi or English, then guides fixes with camera verification of each step. Uses Meta SAM parsing for visual checks and Muse models for dialogue. Node.js stack with multilingual UI.

Johnlocke0347/Navitas.summary: Turns plain-English factory constraints into verified energy-aware schedules
Johnlocke0347/Navitas.readme_summary: Factory energy optimization system where operators input text constraints or bill images. Muse Spark parses requests, a CP-SAT constraint engine generates schedules, and a verifier checks them. Python app with engine, LLM, and test layers.

rishi1700/incidentlab.summary: Diagnoses Docker outages with evidence and verifies the fix restores use
rishi1700/incidentlab.readme_summary: IncidentLab reproduces volume-full, permission, and database failures in a file-upload app with Postgres. Muse Spark on Meta Model API investigates via tools, proposes repairs, and verifies user flow. Includes Docker lab, evals, and web UI.

aancur2002/socialpilot-ai.summary: One dashboard to draft, approve, publish and answer social media for clients
aancur2002/socialpilot-ai.readme_summary: SocialPilot AI is multi-tenant SaaS for agencies to create brand-voiced posts, schedule publishing, and triage comments into leads. Muse Spark drafts content grounded in business facts with human approval. Docker Compose apps with CI.

amarsingh01/Meta-AI-decision-twin.summary: Gatekeeper that checks every AI agent action before it can run
amarsingh01/Meta-AI-decision-twin.readme_summary: Agent Guardian sits between agent and system with no keys given to agent. Intercepts tool calls and validates against hard rules and owner policy using guardian LLM and orchestrator.

k-sangili/claim-proof.summary: Verifies contractor repairs against insurer scope and before-after photos
k-sangili/claim-proof.readme_summary: ClaimProof compares insurer scope, contractor estimate and photos to give per-line Done / Not Evidenced verdicts. Simple Python server with static frontend and JSON sample data. Uses Meta API vision-language model to ground each verdict in attached evidence.

demigohu/auteur.summary: Talk-to-edit video editor that cuts timelines from natural language prompts
demigohu/auteur.readme_summary: Conversational video editor where Muse models watch footage, plan edits, and render an editable timeline. Stack includes API backend, motion code-gen, and web editor with verification before render. Uses Muse Wonder for video-from-code and Muse vision models for footage understanding.

omkydv/Seventy.summary: Phone-video survey tool that finds dogs missed by vaccine drives
omkydv/Seventy.readme_summary: Seventy analyzes phone video via a SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark + Muse Wonder pipeline with rules in tested code. Built for rabies teams with FastAPI services, Supabase, Docker and live Vercel app. Gives operational results, no medical advice.

predsymod/healthplan-compare.summary: Compares ACA plan total costs by household, ZIP and care scenario
predsymod/healthplan-compare.readme_summary: Educational ACA cost comparison tool starting with Colorado 2026 QHP data, ZIP-to-rating-area lookup and scenario ranking engine. Next.js TypeScript app with tested ranking logic. No direct Meta model inference described; built for hackathon as data + calculation app.

YashRaj1240/spatialsentry0.summary: Phone bodyguard that detects snatch and pocket theft with on-device vision
YashRaj1240/spatialsentry0.readme_summary: SpatialSentry provides continuous phone protection, snatch deterrence and ephemeral spatial memory with 10s RAM purge. FastAPI backend with React Tailwind PWA frontend for phones and Ray-Ban. Uses SAM 3.1 vision plus Muse and Llama 3 for threat reasoning.

YashRaj1240/spatialsentry.summary: Phone bodyguard that detects snatch and pocket theft with on-device vision
YashRaj1240/spatialsentry.readme_summary: SpatialSentry provides continuous phone protection, snatch deterrence and ephemeral spatial memory with 10s RAM purge. FastAPI backend with React Tailwind PWA frontend for phones and Ray-Ban. Uses SAM 3.1 vision plus Muse and Llama 3 for threat reasoning.

419to808-byte/the-podium.summary: Civic portal where weekly top-voted ideas get public briefing answers
419to808-byte/the-podium.readme_summary: The Podium is a dependency-free static site where verified citizens post ideas, upvote, and top plus random posts are addressed verbatim. Single index.html with CSS/JS and localStorage persistence. No Meta AI integration; client-only civic workflow demo.

arifiarber-sYn/vultr-agent-rush.summary: Runs AI-planned tasks in locked-down containers with verifiable records
arifiarber-sYn/vultr-agent-rush.readme_summary: Agent Rush plans tasks with a hosted model then executes steps in fresh networkless read-only non-root Docker containers. FastAPI control layer with hardened sandbox and pytest suite. Uses hosted LLM for planning with containment flags returned alongside exit codes.

aiiitsh/siwi.summary: Crowdfunded game ideas that AI agent crews build live for players
aiiitsh/siwi.readme_summary: Siwi lets users post game ideas, upvote, price by token counts, buy in and have AI agents build and test the game. Next.js app with prompts, examples and multi-agent pipeline. Uses Meta Muse Spark models for design, pricing, code generation and QA.

webTech75/ai-software-engineering-assist.summary: AI partner that understands your codebase, explains architecture and docs
webTech75/ai-software-engineering-assist.readme_summary: Neura is an AI software engineering agent powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3. FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy and JWT plus frontend analyzes projects and generates docs. Uses Clean Architecture.

Riftar/birds-eye-app.summary: Agent content factory for short-video posts with auditable human approval gates
Riftar/birds-eye-app.readme_summary: Birds Eye turns AI content production into a disciplined pipeline where agents write and review posts. Posts are files in git with explicit validated transitions. Built for Meta hackathon Theme 1 using Meta models with Docker and Modal app.

Israk-Arafat/Three-Feet.summary: Camera monitor that measures heater clearance and cuts power on hazards
Israk-Arafat/Three-Feet.readme_summary: AI clearance monitor for space heaters measuring object distance in inches with adjustable rules. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for hazard assessment with local tracking, and Muse Wonder for manual lookup and incident reports plus automatic plug control.

asgerami/ais-cart-pipeline.summary: Verifies checkout screenshots and returns BUY, TRIAL, WAIT or REJECT verdict
asgerami/ais-cart-pipeline.readme_summary: AI's Cart checks a checkout screenshot before paying and explains verdict with observed/inferred evidence. Pipeline extracts fields with Muse Spark 1.3 then checks terms. Vercel demo runs in sample mode, live pipeline on private deployment.

beenow/spark-voice-trader.summary: On-device voice trading assistant that calls tools and drives trading screens
beenow/spark-voice-trader.readme_summary: Leaps Voice Agent runs Llama 3.2 1B on Android for hands-free trading with tool calling. Fine-tuned on tool-call traces generated by Muse Spark. Synthetic market backend keeps 14 tools consistent for eval.

Eeverse19/clearfield.summary: Ranks bombed land for clearance using records, satellite and human geography
Eeverse19/clearfield.readme_summary: ClearField fuses declassified bombing records with satellite imagery and OSM exposure to rank survey zones. Provides plain-language explanations and offline field reporting. Tested with Laos/Cambodia profiles, Sentinel pipeline and local DB APIs.

ninadkale98/firework-hackathon.summary: Distills Claude technical interviewer into low-cost open 9B model
ninadkale98/firework-hackathon.readme_summary: CodePraxis runs AI technical interviews with one JSON-move LLM call over structured prompt and rubric. Goal is fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Muse Glimmer 30B on Fireworks to match Claude Opus at lower cost and latency. Includes demo and eval write-up.

jaya6400/nookshift.summary: Redesigns rooms from photo plus prompt with before/after comparison slider
jaya6400/nookshift.readme_summary: NookShift lets renters explore room redesigns from photo and text prompt. Next.js client calls /api/plan which uses Meta Spark, SAM 3.1 and image model with per-view filtering. Returns plan, SAM boxes/masks and proposal image URL.

raghadabuzainih/MissedBuild.summary: Validates project ideas by finding matching GitHub repos with gap analysis
raghadabuzainih/MissedBuild.readme_summary: MissedBuild finds closest public GitHub repos for a plain-language idea and sorts them. Uses Meta Muse Spark to list what each repo does, gaps, and buildable extensions. Every claim ties to README, issues or source evidence.

josedanielbal09-hue/Neurosynk-mvp.summary: Edge biometric focus coach that sustains deep work and prevents burnout
josedanielbal09-hue/Neurosynk-mvp.readme_summary: NeuroSynk is edge-first cognitive ergonomics agent pairing on-device MediaPipe/TensorFlow.js telemetry at 60FPS with Meta models. Uses Muse Spark streaming for interventions and Muse Wonder for task decomposition. No raw video leaves device.

Hellinferno/ClaimLab.summary: Verifies research paper claims with runnable experiments and tutoring
Hellinferno/ClaimLab.readme_summary: ClaimLab grounds paper claims in verifiable numerical experiments with an adaptive whiteboard tutor. Backend runs reproducible lab workflows with evidence tracking. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for claim extraction, tutoring and experiment guidance.

ravii-teja/bumblebee.summary: Points phone camera at engine to identify parts and guide repairs
ravii-teja/bumblebee.readme_summary: Bumblebee is a multimodal automotive repair assistant using live camera perception and deterministic repair state verification. It combines Muse Spark perception, SAM 3.1 segmentation and Llama Multimodal with FastAPI and frontend. Retrieves grounded procedures and verifies repair progress visually.

ChaitanyaMehta155/Noteing.summary: Turns lecture PDFs, whiteboards and voice memos into study notes
ChaitanyaMehta155/Noteing.readme_summary: Noteing organizes calculus PDFs, whiteboard images and voice memos into topic-structured, source-traceable notes. Python app uses SymPy for deterministic math checks and revision planning. Uses Meta AI for extraction, transcription and explanation while preserving sources.

anderj14/reprofy.summary: Turns vague bug reports into reviewed test-backed fixes via CLI
anderj14/reprofy.readme_summary: Reprofy is a Python CLI that classifies bug reports, writes regression tests, and proposes diffs. Pytest validates in disposable copies with explicit approval. Uses models for triage and fix generation.

omkar-ramesh/dissonance-router-meta.summary: Routes tasks across Muse tiers when intent and behavior differ
omkar-ramesh/dissonance-router-meta.readme_summary: The Dissonance Router detects intent-behavior gaps and routes to the right Muse model tier with logged reasons. Built on Meta Model API with models.toml tiers and evaluation harness. Measured on 200 live runs to cut cost and latency versus always-Ultra.

adoodevv/say-and-grasp.summary: Voice-controlled SO-101 arm that picks objects into your hand
adoodevv/say-and-grasp.readme_summary: Say-and-Grasp provides open-vocabulary pick-and-place on a low-cost SO-101 arm with zero task training. Uses Muse Spark for language-to-grasp planning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation. Records every handover as a Muse-labeled training episode.

nahidalam/whatiff.summary: Tests robot plans against adversarial scenarios before acting
nahidalam/whatiff.readme_summary: Whatiff evaluates robot reliability via adversary scenario planning, scene editing and deterministic scoring. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0, SAM 3.1 grounding and Muse Spark Open on Baseten for action selection. Built from scratch for agentic evaluation.

vkanaparthy/meta-ai-hack-2026.summary: Turns mountaintop cameras into wildfire detectors and locators
vkanaparthy/meta-ai-hack-2026.readme_summary: FireFinder detects wildfire smoke, calibrates camera pose from terrain and triangulates fire location with verification agent. Python pipeline with browser replay UI for six included fires. Uses Meta models for smoke detection and alert generation.

Winzmiau/eve-r1-cyberdeck.summary: Single-canvas cyberdeck for Rabbit R1 with voice and AI eye
Winzmiau/eve-r1-cyberdeck.readme_summary: EVE Deck v2 is a standalone 240x282 single-canvas Rabbit R1 creation with macro pad, PTT voice and 360 camera. Zero-dependency ES5 JS with local storage autosave. Uses meta/muse-glimmer for vision and Sovereign Ani/Jules backend for voice.

Raghava2004-cpu/hey_robot.summary: Turns one spoken sentence into checked plans for drone and arm robots
Raghava2004-cpu/hey_robot.readme_summary: Natural-language control for a home/warehouse robot team. Meta models plan tasks, verify visually before moves, and check results. Includes drone skills, landing experiments, benchmarks, and command center scripts.

sajalgoyal113/revcon.summary: Scores earnings-call guidance history to predict if management will deliver
sajalgoyal113/revcon.readme_summary: Concall tracks management guidance from Indian listed company earnings calls and predicts future delivery accuracy. Built as a Streamlit app with evaluation scripts and data pipelines. Uses LLMs to extract guidance, score track record, and forecast reliability for analysts.
