EG-Shiva/Uncharted.summary: Muse agents write and verify solvers to break open math packing records
EG-Shiva/Uncharted.readme_summary: Uncharted is an AI research lab where Muse Spark workers write sandboxed solver programs scored by exact verifiers. Workers review rendered solution images, while Muse Wonder acts as PI to diagnose stalls and assign directions. Achieved new verified spherical-code records.

goldPig888/muse-glimmer-ppo.summary: PPO fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B into a LIBERO robot manipulation policy
goldPig888/muse-glimmer-ppo.readme_summary: Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B with PPO LoRA adapters plus value head for LIBERO-10 task 0. Implements LLM-LIBERO tool-call protocol with move_to/done actions and held-out evaluation. Includes CaPtain baseline and viewer tooling.

Likhith-BlueLotus/TwinProof.summary: Turns a 10s phone video into a verified MuJoCo physics digital twin
Likhith-BlueLotus/TwinProof.readme_summary: TwinProof converts phone video with fiducial marker into a MuJoCo twin via SAM 3.1 perception and Muse Spark agents. Includes identifier, verifier, and self-test catching seeded bugs. Stack spans computer vision, physics simulation, and agent reasoning.

ewenliam/bara-peat-fire.summary: Daily peat-fire spread forecasts and crew routes for commanders
ewenliam/bara-peat-fire.readme_summary: Predicts next-day peat fire spread in Indonesia and assigns crew checks. Rangers reply via WhatsApp voice notes to update plans. Uses Meta AI for briefings, photo and voice reports.

Theophilus20/i-see.summary: Camera explainer that grounds every fact in what it sees and cites
Theophilus20/i-see.readme_summary: I SEE points a camera at objects to explain identity, workings, interiors, and care with cited sources. Uses Muse Spark for vision and search, SAM 3.1 for outlines, Muse Wonder for disambiguation, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe. Includes verifier and calculator.

davoax/FaceMesh.summary: Fits FLAME 3D head model to photos locally inside ComfyUI
davoax/FaceMesh.readme_summary: FaceMesh builds a faithful 3D head mesh from 1-10 photos by jointly fitting FLAME 2023. Pipeline combines SAM 3.1 masks, MoGe-2 normals, and FAN landmarks in ComfyUI nodes. Outputs neutral GLB mesh, cameras, and overlays locally.

debjyotikm/siliconshield.summary: Finds RTL design and security bugs in chips using contract skills for Muse.
debjyotikm/siliconshield.readme_summary: RTL bug investigation tool with contract skills for Muse Glimmer and measured evidence. Python-based analysis with configs, examples and docs for secure silicon before ship. Focus on design and security flaws.

bmdtouseefh/meta-hackathon.summary: Private desktop agent that learns tasks from one narrated screen demo
bmdtouseefh/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Rose runs on a private Ubuntu VM, sees XFCE desktop and acts with mouse/keyboard. Learns workflows from narrated screen recordings or via MCP handoff. Keeps video and credentials local, using Muse Spark Open and Glimmer.

unnatibshah/followalong.summary: Live step-by-step guide that verifies hands-on work from video via camera
unnatibshah/followalong.readme_summary: Converts videos, manuals or photos into live guides that check each step by voice. Muse Spark writes steps and judges, SAM 3.1 measures geometry, with Docker eval and CF-Bench paper.

ahmadwaliradhi/gameschooling.summary: Homeschool quests where parents set goals and kids prove learning
ahmadwaliradhi/gameschooling.readme_summary: Parent-authored curriculum compiler turns goals into quests with verifiable grading. Two Meta models check proofs via Muse and SAM 3.1. Built on TanStack Start, Cloudflare Workers, D1+R2 and shadcn/ui.

vatsShashwat07/omnigaze-agent.summary: Closed-loop SCADA node that detects pipeline faults and triggers mitigation.
vatsShashwat07/omnigaze-agent.readme_summary: OmniGaze is an autonomous SCADA resilience node for industrial pipelines. It combines SAM 2.1 zero-shot segmentation with Muse Spark spatial reasoning in a LangGraph FSM. FastAPI backend with live inference, mock telemetry and SHA-256 Merkle ledger.

Amad55a/abuurAI.summary: Somali-first JavaScript SDK to call twelve AI providers via one API.
Amad55a/abuurAI.readme_summary: Abuur AI provides Somali-named config and task methods for text generation across twelve providers. It runs on Node 22+ with browser and Node entries for Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and others. It standardizes requests without hiding provider billing and limits.

harshith16/meta-hackathon.summary: WhatsApp assistant that answers employee questions from company documents
harshith16/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: One WhatsApp number backed by ingestion of PDF/DOCX into a knowledge graph with role checks. Answers cite source and date and refuses when not in docs. Postgres schemas plus Python engine served via upload and query endpoints.

nikocallas/show-and-tell-robotics.summary: Turns one demo video plus one rule into a robot program tested on 20 simulations
nikocallas/show-and-tell-robotics.readme_summary: Test-driven robot programming from phone video plus sentence into checks and code. Python + MuJoCo simulation with bench and web replay demo. Uses Muse Wonder for code/diagnosis and SAM 3.1 for vision.

godragun/farming-app.summary: Mobile farming companion with weather, crop advice and marketplace.
godragun/farming-app.readme_summary: Agri Lanka is an Android farming app with weather forecasting, crop guidance and e-commerce checkout. Built with native Android Gradle stack and in-app navigation. Provides light mode, product pages and farmer-focused workflows for Sri Lanka.

anishchugh05/Free-Throw-Coach.summary: Analyzes side-on free-throw video to measure arc and coach form.
anishchugh05/Free-Throw-Coach.readme_summary: Upload a side-on clip to track ball, hoop and shooter with SAM 3.1 video segmentation. Plain Python measures arc peak, entry angle, makes and routine tempo. Muse Spark turns metrics into one strength, one fix and one drill with annotated replay.

yassmittal/samvaad.summary: Real-time two-way speech translator where each person hears their language.
yassmittal/samvaad.readme_summary: Samvaad enables table mode and two-phone rooms for cross-language conversation. It uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech-to-text and Muse Spark for context-aware translation. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, monorepo packages and hosted rooms.

cyber39glt/breachgraph-ai.summary: Maps cloud identity attack paths and simulates least-privilege fixes.
cyber39glt/breachgraph-ai.readme_summary: BreachGraph AI analyzes AWS IAM exports via deterministic engine to prove attack paths to sensitive data. Meta AI explains risk in plain language and simulator re-runs fixes. Never touches live accounts, uses synthetic demo with frontend plus backend.

DigitoBrain/Global-AI-Hackathon-Tribe.summary: Personal tribal-knowledge system that captures notes without filing and reuses them
DigitoBrain/Global-AI-Hackathon-Tribe.readme_summary: Tribe captures personal knowledge without filing, tracks age and past failures, and surfaces it across tools. Built as Indie Build for Your World app with docs, MCP server, and web client for reusable context.

16navigabraham/asap-everyday-agent.summary: Voice and text errand agent in Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Pidgin and English
16navigabraham/asap-everyday-agent.readme_summary: ASAP lets users send voice notes or text in Nigerian languages to complete errands like buying and booking. Built with Node 22 and zero dependencies, it uses Meta Muse Spark for multilingual understanding and agentic task execution.

SUMANRAUT-20/second-me.summary: Night-shift AI that researches suppliers and drafts shop listings for approval
SUMANRAUT-20/second-me.readme_summary: Second Me researches live CJ Dropshipping products, cleans supplier data and drafts listings overnight for solo sellers. Built with Vite and Node server.mjs, it uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API with human approve/reject gating.

Coachemmy/Voizgger.summary: Turns trader voice notes into structured ledgers, debts, and invoices
Coachemmy/Voizgger.readme_summary: Voizgger converts informal market voice notes into ledgers, debt SMS, shelf audits and invoices. Built with Python Flask and Docker, it uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark for extraction.

manya-singh7/SETU.summary: Measures bridge vibration frequencies from smartphone video for review
manya-singh7/SETU.readme_summary: SETU validates phone video then tracks subpixel displacement to compute PSD and modal peaks for infrastructure screening. Python pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for target segmentation and flags anomalies for engineer inspection.

Collistus-Kibe/STEM-Claw.summary: Terminal research agent with STEM loadouts and 29+ science APIs
Collistus-Kibe/STEM-Claw.readme_summary: STEM-Claw is a terminal IDE agent with 5 STEM loadouts, PRISMA workflows and multi-epoch discovery. Python package queries PubMed, arXiv and ChEMBL, reasoning via Meta Model API Muse Wonder.

BlueOceanStrategicPartners/meta_rfp_work.summary: Multimodal RFP and dynamic pricing platform for hospitality
BlueOceanStrategicPartners/meta_rfp_work.readme_summary: Hospitality RFP Engine automates PDF extraction, layout validation, negotiation and pricing with Django + React. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Spark for reasoning, omniASR for STT and SeamlessM4T v2 for TTS.

mukeshkbj/shadow.summary: Turns screen recordings into cited playbooks an agent can replay and verify
mukeshkbj/shadow.readme_summary: Shadow converts expert recording and narration into a reviewable playbook with source links. An agent then replays the task, asking where the recording is unclear. Backend and frontend on Modal, supports Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open.

Lhordnuel/vault-verify.summary: Turns git history and AI sessions into verifiable candidate evidence reports
Lhordnuel/vault-verify.readme_summary: Attest links git commits and imported AI session events into a SHA-256 chained report at attest.sh/v/handle. Scores use only Supported to Contradicted with quotes. Vite React frontend served by Cloudflare Worker with API package.

KunalShukla-Al/hearsay.summary: Turns class WhatsApp chats into verified source-linked calendar
KunalShukla-Al/hearsay.readme_summary: Hearsay extracts dated items from class chats with source quotes, ranks faculty over relays, and flags conflicts. Python pipeline uses open-weight Muse Glimmer for extraction and emits ICS and morning push.

mattvv/claude-brain.summary: Always-on personal server that runs Claude Code with multi-model routing
mattvv/claude-brain.readme_summary: claude-brain turns a Mac, Linux box or VM into an always-on agent server accessed from phone or web. Bash installer with model router delegates across Claude, GPT, Grok, Kimi and Meta Muse on GitHub repos.

shi1720/hearth-family-plan.summary: Private family care, inheritance and giving plans with evidence gates
shi1720/hearth-family-plan.readme_summary: Hearth provides persistent household workspaces for care, inheritance and giving with scoped access. Firebase auth and hosting with evaluation page. Uses source-grounded Meta AI with evidence gates.

sumerchoudhary78/jeevan-rekha.summary: Multilingual AI call-taker that triages flood helpline overflow into rescue queue
sumerchoudhary78/jeevan-rekha.readme_summary: Overflow agent for disaster helplines that listens in caller language, confirms numbers/places, dedupes against live case board. Server + dashboard with map-ranked rescue queue and photo analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for people counting and Muse Spark for water-level reading.

buddypia/trail-sentinel.summary: Phone HUD that segments trail hazards and speaks warnings
buddypia/trail-sentinel.readme_summary: Real-time optical HUD scanning camera frames for hazards, tracking and ranking by severity. Browser-based, no app install. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark/Wonder/Glimmer.

omerincialan/solo-books-agent.summary: Text-message bookkeeper that logs receipts, income and mileage to Sheets
omerincialan/solo-books-agent.readme_summary: SMS/voice-note bookkeeper for solo tradespeople that parses receipts, miles and questions into Google Sheets. Python service with tests and scripts for messaging pipeline. Uses Muse Spark for ledger reasoning, SAM 3.1 for receipt photos and Muse Voice Transcribe.

tsukiyomi-naoko/StandRiggerWorkflow.summary: ComfyUI workflows that turn one character image into a 2.5D rig-ready PSD
tsukiyomi-naoko/StandRiggerWorkflow.readme_summary: ComfyUI workflows and tools that split a single 2D character into parts-separated PSD with inpainted hidden areas, expressions and multi-angle targets. Batch setup with installer and tests for StandRig contract. Uses image segmentation and pose synthesis models for layer prep.

shaedis/GestureCue.summary: Gesture-controlled video overlay turning webcam feed into presentation canvas
shaedis/GestureCue.readme_summary: Native macOS Swift app that maps hand gestures to interactive cards inside Zoom and Teams video. Zero-dependency Camera Extension architecture. Uses Muse Spark for AI visual education studio features.

levisrabah/midusafe.summary: Turns multilingual disaster reports into structured responder intelligence.
levisrabah/midusafe.readme_summary: Sentinel ingests English, Swahili and Sheng text plus voice reports into incident intelligence. Muse Spark extracts structure, severity, duplicates and contradictions. Provides command-center dashboard for responders.

inlighten420/placelens.summary: Rebuilds photographed objects in 3D at real size placed on real map
inlighten420/placelens.readme_summary: Takes phone photos with GPS/compass/lens metadata and infers object type, size, floors and roof, then checks against geometry before placing 3D model on map. Python src/adapters with Open-Planet integration. Uses Meta vision models for measurement Q&A.

BishtNikhil/omnidirector-ai.summary: Autonomous director that switches multicam streams and cuts vertical reels
BishtNikhil/omnidirector-ai.readme_summary: Automates live multicam directing: camera switching, lower-thirds, audio fades and long-form to 9:16 reel slicing. Python/FastAPI pipeline with Docker Compose and showcase tooling. Uses Muse Spark for directing, SAM 3.1 for spatial tracking and Voice Transcribe.

RaveenDi/NullLab.summary: Reruns classifier code under checked controls to expose inflated evaluation metrics.
RaveenDi/NullLab.readme_summary: NullLab is a local Research Workdesk where users attach CSV plus train.py, confirm target and splits, then Muse Spark proposes typed interventions. It reruns fold-local fitting and leakage checks to report metric deltas. Includes agent, app, baselines, and docs.

AYHHamsuky/gridsense.summary: Hausa/English agent that clusters outage reports into faults and dispatches technicians
AYHHamsuky/gridsense.readme_summary: GridSense takes customer text and voice reports in Hausa and English, then uses Muse Spark to classify fault type, map to feeders, and merge or open faults. Stack includes backend, frontend, scripts and pytest suite for intake, triage and dispatch workflow.

Akileshwarakrishnan/satyahd.summary: Zero-trust guardrail that enforces policies on AI agent actions with vision checks
Akileshwarakrishnan/satyahd.readme_summary: Satyahd is a policy enforcement layer for AI agents powered by muse-spark-1.3 and SAM 3.1 vision. It validates actions with Python 3.12, Docker, and pytest coverage, blocking untrusted behavior before execution.

chitpoo/Custom-Upi-based-payment-Gateway.summary: Zero-fee UPI gateway that uses AI to verify direct merchant payments per order
chitpoo/Custom-Upi-based-payment-Gateway.readme_summary: Customers pay directly to merchant UPI accounts while Muse Spark 1.3 confirms payment and marks orders paid without holding funds. Built with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2 and MySQL 8 with Docker Compose deployment.

ajatshatru01/Leash.summary: Local safety gateway that approves or blocks coding agent file, shell and git actions
ajatshatru01/Leash.readme_summary: Intercepts proposed file edits, commands, HTTP and pushes, resolves impact, applies local rules and escalates to Muse Wonder judge. Python service with live action stream and LeashBench. Uses Muse Spark for proposals and Muse Wonder for safety decisions.

BuildRunnerFr/attest.summary: Tests bank systems read-only to audit DORA controls and write reports.
BuildRunnerFr/attest.readme_summary: AI agent that generates work programme, runs read-only tests, seals evidence and routes fixes for approval and re-test. Python controls library with sealed replayable reports. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and review, SAM 3.1 for masking.

HPHYSVN/ai-repository-investigator.summary: Agent that traces UI bug screenshots to code causes with test-verified evidence
HPHYSVN/ai-repository-investigator.readme_summary: Upload a broken UI screenshot, logs and repo path to rank code hypotheses with supporting and contradicting evidence. Verifies top hypothesis with real tests and proposes fix plus regression test, abstaining when inconclusive.

jakemanger/whatmodel.summary: Open leaderboard ranking runnable AI models by benchmarks, cost and memory needs
jakemanger/whatmodel.readme_summary: whatmodel.sh aggregates 37,490 benchmark results across 891 models into one score with price, memory and run commands. Static site generated from data and lib with bench.py and bench.sh for updating and benchmarking.

soufianeomari1/bonsafar.summary: Pocket travel agency that understands Moroccan darija voice notes
soufianeomari1/bonsafar.readme_summary: BonSafar lets users send voice notes in darija, French or Arabic to plan travel. It handles visas, payments and baggage rules for Moroccan travelers. Built with Next.js on Meta Muse models for multilingual voice understanding.

Kairopi/RopI.summary: Study and career coach that plans learning into 5-minute free slots
Kairopi/RopI.readme_summary: Coaching web app for shift workers and career changers. Plans study around real availability, offers micro-tasks and voice/chat coaching, replans when week changes. Uses Meta Muse models, Supabase, Vercel.

younes11-ch/DataAgent.summary: Upload messy CSVs to clean data, detect anomalies, and get verified answers
younes11-ch/DataAgent.readme_summary: Streamlit app that cleans CSVs, scans anomalies, answers questions with recomputed numbers, and exports PDF reports. Built with Python, Pandas and Streamlit. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Q&A, charting and report generation, with demo mode without key.

BruhWhosJoe/MetaFabricAI.summary: AI search that turns missions into public datasets and combinable data recipes.
BruhWhosJoe/MetaFabricAI.readme_summary: Metadata-first app replacing keyword search across government portals with meaning-based discovery. Turns natural-language missions into relevant datasets, relationships, and data recipes using AI-assisted semantic search.

omarkhy/HOLOFIX.summary: Diagnoses device faults from text input with interactive 3D exploded views.
omarkhy/HOLOFIX.readme_summary: Type a device to get fault diagnosis and repair guidance with interactive 3D views. Stack has backend plus frontend with data and eval scripts. Uses Meta AI models for diagnostics from device descriptions.

jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker.summary: Bangla-first tracker for Chattogram tempu routes with live GPS and AI help
jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker.readme_summary: Web app with 16 canonical Chattogram tempu routes, driver-shared browser GPS, trip planner and live map. Built with Vite frontend, Node server and MongoDB Atlas. Uses muse-spark-1.2-contributor route-grounded assistant with voice.

Juanpighelfi/cadverify-ai.summary: Turns plain language into printable OpenSCAD parts verified by measurements
Juanpighelfi/cadverify-ai.readme_summary: Design agent on Muse Wonder and Muse Spark that generates OpenSCAD parts from text. A deterministic harness measures meshes for fit, strength and printability and blocks done until all gates pass.

code-htech07/sina-meta.summary: Multimodal cocoa diagnosis for Ivory Coast using photo, weather, satellite
code-htech07/sina-meta.readme_summary: Maana Terra fuses symptom photo, NASA POWER weather, Sentinel-2 satellite, agronomy sources and plot history for traceable hypotheses. Python engine + frontend + notebooks. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for lesion segmentation.

ZektoxFx/funwiki.summary: Interactive knowledge map that turns Wikipedia topics into clickable learning graphs
ZektoxFx/funwiki.readme_summary: Turns a typed topic into an interactive knowledge map with clickable nodes, AI summaries, learning paths and quizzes. Stack is web frontend + API/server with Remotion for demo video generation. Uses Meta Muse models for summarization and guided learning.

nur1dd1n/synthetic-data-factory_Meta.summary: Generates synthetic CSV data with utility and privacy trust report
nur1dd1n/synthetic-data-factory_Meta.readme_summary: Upload a CSV to profile schema and generate synthetic rows with SDV Gaussian Copula. Reports statistical similarity, ML utility, and privacy risk from exact and neighbor matches. Streamlit frontend with Muse Spark 1.3 validation.

DAIRN-Universe/uki-game.summary: Hex-grid steppe adventure in Godot 4 with AI-proposed explorable worlds
DAIRN-Universe/uki-game.readme_summary: Top-down 16x16 hex exploration game as Uki the owl with walk/fly, fog reveal and deterministic validation. Built with Godot 4 plus Python server and tools. Optional Muse Spark proposes geography, offline generator keeps it playable.

ldbtech/KeplerV-Browser.summary: Goal-based macOS browser where AI agents act under permissioned AIP controls
ldbtech/KeplerV-Browser.readme_summary: KeplerV is a Tauri-based macOS browser giving agents a permissioned workspace. AIP allows, approves or blocks actions with Guard audit logs; built with TypeScript, Rust, Python and Playwright.

Riaz9543/MindTrace-AI.summary: Analyzes math step traces to diagnose thinking errors and guide next steps
Riaz9543/MindTrace-AI.readme_summary: Production diagnostic engine for math education that analyzes workflow traces. Uses deterministic JS equivalence referee plus Muse models via serverless proxy, with Firebase cognitive profiles and Netlify frontend.

ConWan30/qorcap.summary: Self-healing Windows USB capture recorder producing hash-chained match evidence
ConWan30/qorcap.readme_summary: Windows recorder for USB HDMI capture cards that auto-recovers from disconnects and freezes. Emits SHA-256 hash-chained fMP4 segments and QorTime checkpoints with referee co-signing. Built in Rust.

PhiBao/backstep.summary: Films teardowns once to replay guided reassembly and find lost parts
PhiBao/backstep.readme_summary: Rewind button for physical teardown and reassembly from own video with frame proof. Backend plus web frontend uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder for part tracking.

gugunyathi/metapase.summary: Autonomous agent that finds nearby deals, negotiates and checks out
gugunyathi/metapase.readme_summary: Proximity shopping engine that finds deals within 50 metres, negotiates price, and checks out with passkey. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, MongoDB and WebAuthn. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for autonomous shopping negotiation.

DravenDou/processlens.summary: Learns physical workflow from one video and verifies next execution
DravenDou/processlens.readme_summary: Turns one assembly video into structured steps and expected layouts, then checks second execution for missing or misplaced actions. Go backend with SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark pipeline track-structure-compare.

lildosnear/NYX.summary: Payment firewall for AI agents enforcing budgets and approvals
lildosnear/NYX.readme_summary: Security and payment control layer between AI agents and money. Owner sets caps, daily budgets and vendor allowlists; policy engine checks signed expiring quotes and approvals before execution.

Sathwik0623/CLIQ.summary: Offline-first network engineer IDE with RAG copilot grounded in Cisco docs
Sathwik0623/CLIQ.readme_summary: VS Code-inspired IDE with offline completions, multi-device terminal and CML simulation management. FastAPI plus React 18 with authoritative AI Copilot via Meta Model API and Cisco documentation RAG.

Thander21/FlutterGuard-AI.summary: Blocking quality harness turning AI code into senior-level Flutter
Thander21/FlutterGuard-AI.readme_summary: Closed-loop agentic harness for Flutter/Dart with spec-driven development. Implements 13 AST rules with grade, check, init and sandbox CLI, pre-commit hooks and heal dispatcher.

ritvik412/phystax.summary: Measures AI scientist discovery loss when measuring physics via camera vs numbers
ritvik412/phystax.readme_summary: LLM agent designs experiments in hidden-law universe observed only via SAM 3.1 camera segmentation. Tests perception tax using SAM confidence for system ID. Evaluation science study, no RL, graded on real outcomes.

ManasaK285/muse.summary: Verifies robot code policies against reward hacking and physical failures
ManasaK285/muse.readme_summary: Adversarial verification harness for code-as-policy embodied agents. Four-node LangGraph loop with domain-randomized sandbox telemetry, HMAC signing and SAM 3.1 counterfactual 3D checks.

essbony/eco-sentinel-africa.summary: Autonomous video pipeline detecting environmental hazards for Abidjan pilot
essbony/eco-sentinel-africa.readme_summary: Monitors video streams for environmental events using SAM 3.1 vision and Wonder router with Spark agents. Stack is FastAPI, Docker, real-time dashboard with audio alerts. Uses Meta API for vision detection and agent orchestration.

joshua0331/Closer.summary: Shared couples app with chat, live map, memories and playful Couple Court
joshua0331/Closer.readme_summary: Flutter mobile app for Android/iOS with paired shared space, chat, OpenStreetMap live location, and photo memories. Implements Couple Court with timed turns, evidence, and AI-guided remedies. Uses Meta AI for mediation flow and verdicts.

Daddymuphasa/PAPAGEDON-AEI.summary: AI director turning live music, lyrics and crowd into reactive concert visuals
Daddymuphasa/PAPAGEDON-AEI.readme_summary: Director agent fuses flyer, live audio, and crowd camera into real-time audio-reactive visualizer with custom shaders. Built with Next.js and WebGL shaders system. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Voice, SAM 3.1 and Glimmer.

FoulTrip/nomikos.summary: Account-scoped agent OS with verified actions and Solana x402 payments
FoulTrip/nomikos.readme_summary: Gives each account an isolated orchestrator, delegated Solana wallet, and audit trail for device actions. Enforces permission-checked Code Mode and x402 payment handshakes. Uses account-bound LLM credentials for reasoning.

Obed-Ojingwa/GreenWatch-AI.summary: Detects building and vegetation change between two site images with evidence report
Obed-Ojingwa/GreenWatch-AI.readme_summary: Validates image pairs, segments with Meta SAM 3.1, self-checks masks with Muse Spark vision, computes pixel change in code and writes PDF with inspection task. Backend plus frontend with Supabase. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark vision.

igorsaevets/ai-second-opinion.summary: CLI that sends one document to 10 AI models and merges dissenting report
igorsaevets/ai-second-opinion.readme_summary: Zero-dependency terminal tool that fans out a document to Gemini, GPT, Grok, Muse Spark and others, then builds a disagreement and citation-check report. No server, runs from any AI agent. Includes Muse Spark as one panel channel.

danh-dev/agentdek-releases.summary: Windows release changelog for AgentDek plugin runtime and automation toolkit
danh-dev/agentdek-releases.readme_summary: Repository contains only release notes for AgentDek Windows builds, no app source. Describes bundled Node, Python, uv, FFmpeg, Playwright + Chromium isolation. No direct Meta AI usage documented; supports agent plugin execution environment.

justoeu/ai-taskbar.summary: macOS menu-bar tracker for LLM usage across 8 providers including Muse
justoeu/ai-taskbar.readme_summary: Native Swift 6.2 universal app tracking sessions and spend for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Muse and others. Provides menu-bar UI with local tracking. Integrates Meta Muse provider alongside 8 LLM APIs.

sangtq-vn/muse-iot.summary: LLM-driven irrigation platform where Muse Spark reasons over sensor streams
sangtq-vn/muse-iot.readme_summary: Sensor nodes stream over MQTT to an orchestrator that prompts Muse Spark 1.3 with live readings, history and reflection. Safety engine validates decisions before firing actuators. Docker and YAML-configured IoT stack.

sruthyrb-create/hold-point.summary: Voice-first leaving-home checker proving stove safety for blind users
sruthyrb-create/hold-point.readme_summary: Hold Point is a voice agent that verifies stove knobs with two independent Meta models, saying all-clear only on proof. Python package with eval/tests, last-seen memory for keys and belongings.

Arjunprasaath/robot_task_firework.summary: Benchmarks VLM robot-arm policies on 5 held-out Meta-World tasks

GolixcoAI/lolixco-pilot.summary: AI video-editing workstation turning footage into stronger cuts via chat
GolixcoAI/lolixco-pilot.readme_summary: LolixCopilot understands footage, finds moments and turns instructions into timeline operations. Built with Next.js 16 frontend and FastAPI Python backend. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark with Supabase.

arvind-dataai/image_compare.summary: API that restyles product photos via custom prompt or presets

lehuubao2909/bug2pr.summary: Turns bug screen recordings into failing tests and fixed PRs

himanshu748/bugarcade.summary: Playable React bug challenges with replays and regression tests

AlejoColazurda/socio.summary: WhatsApp back-office agent that updates SME stock, sales and orders

sajalgoyal113/revcall.summary: Audits earnings guidance credibility for 50 US market stocks

HARIScyber/PatchPilot-.readme_summary: PatchPilot analyzes Python repos, plans repairs with Meta models, requires approval, generates regression tests and runs bounded repair loop. Frontend plus backend with static analysis, reports and CI deployment.

arturochs13-boop/Orunex.summary: Autonomous Windows desktop agent with mobile companion and memory
arturochs13-boop/Orunex.readme_summary: Orunex is a multimodal desktop agent with live runtime, remote control, Android companion and knowledge memory. Uses Meta Muse reasoning with BMD engine, bridges, config and paper-trading modules.

sma1692/warden.summary: Multi-agent command center with executive agent coordinating specialists

Mahak2432/quicklist-inventory-ai.summary: Photo-to-listing tool that publishes and syncs stock across marketplaces

silverfire32/inear-brief.summary: Generates in-ear spoken cues to keep lecturers on track and on time.

wemwem05/researchos.summary: Turns scientific PDFs plus a question into grounded structured claims

natthawat141/me-studio.summary: Thai-first local cartoon studio with agent-driven video chat and voice tools.

shurukon/universe-agent.summary: Local-first AI agent that plans, uses 132 tools, and remembers everything across restarts
shurukon/universe-agent.readme_summary: Local-first agent platform with Universe, Studio and Bots sharing memory and permissions. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Wonder and Muse Spark for planning, subagents and tool calls, persisting thoughts and artifacts to disk.

xuvivn/xuvi-harness.summary: Self-evolving agent harness first applied to Waldorf education in Vietnam

alfredowh/ANTS.summary: Synthesizes robot programs from one demo and hardens them via simulated attacks.

charles-odasie/sentinel-meta.summary: Turns error logs into failing test, verified fix, and privacy receipt

sougandhimanu/hearth-movein.summary: Helps renters check leases, document rooms, and dispute deductions

naormeit/argus.summary: 4-agent pipeline that audits Solidity contracts and signs tamper-evident reports

kamboj-sajan/Pocket-AOI.summary: Finds PCB assembly defects from a phone photo versus a golden reference board.

OpalBolt/github-copilot-pricing-calculat.summary: Static site comparing token costs across Copilot, routers and providers.
OpalBolt/github-copilot-pricing-calculat.readme_summary: Four calculators for GitHub Copilot credits, EU router pricing, model pricing and provider plans. Static HTML/JS site in docs/ with Python fetch scripts for pricing data. No Meta AI integration; cost-planning dev tool.

adindamochamad/serial-bridge.summary: Desktop serial gateway that decodes industrial devices and gates writes.

Ipsita-Mondal-30/Acorn.summary: Multimodal memory agent that captures notes and turns them into follow-through actions.

seankoji-com/frugalbar.summary: macOS menu bar app showing AI quota and API spend headroom.

aleksanderstevens191-sudo/Flatline.summary: Agent that writes power controllers to smooth AI cluster grid load

faithfulgodwinc/vist.summary: Agent that uses your product and auto-cuts a launch video ad.

rudra496/jolsetu.summary: Reads arsenic test kits by photo and maps safe tubewells offline.

selda-eren/motif.summary: Explorable idea landscape showing how a book's meaning evolves.

419to808-byte/the-podium-1-0.readme_summary: Empty starter template for The Podium civic forum with six static tabs. Built as plain HTML/CSS/JS with localStorage persistence, no backend. No AI data included; designed to be filled through real use.

naimishkathrani-web/BadaBhai.summary: Voice-first AI helpline on ordinary phone calls in Hindi or English with spoken answers
naimishkathrani-web/BadaBhai.readme_summary: Call-in voice assistant with no app needed, Hindi/English IVR, barge-in and live dashboard. Python app with Exotel telephony stack. Uses Meta Voice Transcribe for STT and Muse Spark 1.3 for answers with TTS.

yoodison/knovine.summary: Turns AI chats into learner-owned context maps and teacher-reviewed lessons
yoodison/knovine.readme_summary: Knovine captures learner questions via private MCP connector into a persistent evidence-backed concept map. Learners share selections with teachers who generate and review lessons with Meta models. Vite frontend with Node server and MCP integration.

DylanLIiii/magpie-muse-bridge.summary: Magpie provider plugin driving real Muse Code CLI with MCP tool bridging
DylanLIiii/magpie-muse-bridge.readme_summary: Provider for magpie built on official Muse Code SDK using muse serve host with empty preset and per-conversation MCP server for client tools. Handles auth and model calls, verified Nov 2026 with muse-wonder-1.0 on Macmini.

SRKRZ23/apprentice.summary: Learns physical tasks from video then executes them with a MuJoCo robot
SRKRZ23/apprentice.readme_summary: Video-to-robot system where SAM 3.1 tracks video, Muse models derive physics and procedures. MuJoCo executes tasks with vision self-check and coach mode. Python stack with spend ledger and physics validation.

automathing/graspt.summary: Visual map interface to steer AI agents proving Lean 4 theorems with kernel verification
automathing/graspt.readme_summary: Explores Lean Mathlib proofs as navigable map of goals and landmarks. User directs agent in plain language to draft Lean code, Lean kernel verifies every step. Node app with pre-indexed demo of 12 proofs.

Chippppy/llm-server.summary: Manager to run and swap multiple local llama.cpp servers and models
Chippppy/llm-server.readme_summary: Rust tooling to run multiple llama-server instances with per-model ports and flags. Provides CLI ctl, systemd template units, egui indicator and Waybar module. Ships Muse-Glimmer and Qwen templates.

blocky-dragon/SweepMap.summary: First-responder sweep tool drawing live floor plans with people detection
blocky-dragon/SweepMap.readme_summary: iOS sweep app combining RoomPlan LiDAR mapping with SAM 3.1 detections every 1.5s. Places pins via depth and camera pose with AR overlay and voice notes. Built for building search and solo drills.

Kore-Meta/NewWorld-AI.summary: Mixed-reality Quest places to focus and unwind with talking AI companions.
Kore-Meta/NewWorld-AI.readme_summary: NewWorld AI is a Meta Quest study and rest app with explorable places like Orbit, Seoul, and Seabreeze. Built in Unity with XR. Uses Muse via Meta Model API to power voiced companions that guide, chat, and animate the scenes.

Suman-Maitreya/nearmiss.summary: Detects pedestrian-vehicle near misses from traffic cameras for safety audits.
Suman-Maitreya/nearmiss.readme_summary: Turns traffic cameras into near-miss auditors measuring distance in metres and seconds. SAM 3.1 detects and tracks actors, Muse Spark reviews events against video. Routes ambiguous cases for human review for city engineers.

vmitchell/model-pulse.summary: Daily tracker comparing frontier models across LMArena, Epoch AI and OpenRouter.
vmitchell/model-pulse.readme_summary: GitHub Action runs pulse.py daily to pull LMArena rankings, Epoch AI capability scores and OpenRouter serving data. It generates SVG charts and a markdown snapshot tracking rank, price and precision changes. It monitors Meta models alongside others but does not call Muse models.

Tuf12/ContextTracker.summary: Zero-config VS Code extension that records prompts and profiles LLM context.
Tuf12/ContextTracker.readme_summary: TypeScript VS Code/Cursor extension that auto-records prompts, profiles context usage and acts as prompt co-pilot. Architecture is client extension + Meta Model API backend for analysis and suggestions. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 via Meta Model API.

Abhisek12378/sheettruth.summary: Auditor that finds wrong spreadsheet formulas and proves them by recalculation.
Abhisek12378/sheettruth.readme_summary: SheetTruth reads labels with a fine-tuned open-weights model to flag short totals, off-by-one refs and sign errors, then verifies each with code recalculation and a second-model opinion. Stack is Python + webapp with training/eval recipe. Writes confirmed fixes to a corrected workbook copy.

erikpt/local-ai-setup.summary: Scripts to run LLMs, images, video and voice on one RTX 4090 via llama-swap.
erikpt/local-ai-setup.readme_summary: Bash scripts and configs for single-GPU home server on RTX 4090 with Ubuntu. Routes OpenAI-compatible requests through keygate to llama-swap, llama.cpp, ComfyUI and Chatterbox. Uses local open models like FLUX.2 and Wan 2.2, no Muse API.

g-kolipak/TheMummy.summary: Fine-tuned open model that reads hieroglyph photos into sign codes and transliteration.
g-kolipak/TheMummy.readme_summary: Fine-tunes Muse Glimmer 30B with LoRA on Fireworks for two-step photo-to-Gardiner codes with boxes, then codes-to-transliteration. Includes bench, baseline and dedupe scripts with results and runs folders. Compares fine-tuned open model against frontier model baselines.

ahm3dwasim/partfidelity.summary: Turns a repair video into an illustrated step-by-step guide with safety stops.
ahm3dwasim/partfidelity.readme_summary: Upload filmed repair video and get illustrated beginner guide with outlined parts and danger hard-stops. Stack is Python app with Dockerfile and Modal deploy, web frontend and demo guides. Uses vision-language models for frame analysis and step generation.

sanskarllm/game-builder.summary: AI visual-novel maker with 2D branching stories and 3D sandbox play
sanskarllm/game-builder.readme_summary: Game Forge builds 2D branching visual novels and interactive 3D story worlds with AI copilot editing. Node server with SAM 3D service and web client. Uses Muse Spark for writing/music, Muse Image for 2D art, Muse Wonder and SAM 3D Body.

t20mutinda-create/DAKTARI.summary: Livestock triage app that grades cow photos by urgency and tracks disease clusters.
t20mutinda-create/DAKTARI.readme_summary: Next.js app where farmer uploads cow photo for Muse Spark 1.3 reading and SAM 3.1 lesion segmentation. Sets monitor/vet_visit/isolate urgency, writes vet note and maps county clusters. Gives no treatment advice; vet must examine animal.

brainer3220/viral-loop-meta-demo.summary: Offline synthetic demo of a short-video studio with gated Meta API adapters.
brainer3220/viral-loop-meta-demo.readme_summary: Isolated Python + HTML prototype with demo.py, server.py and studio.py using synthetic images and plans. Default run is offline with Pillow and FFmpeg; live Meta API is gated and disabled. Explicitly not a submitted entry or proof of integration.

ana-lan/thinkABR.summary: Measures when self-hosting Muse Glimmer on one GPU beats API costs
ana-lan/thinkABR.readme_summary: Serves Meta Muse Glimmer 30B on one NVIDIA L4 with vLLM INT4 and runs a triage agent. Compares cost-quality against Muse Spark 1.3 baseline across reasoning levels with cost model and dashboard.

Grey-matter47/agent-gate.summary: QA harness that tests AI agents and returns SHIP, BLOCK or CONDITIONAL verdict
Grey-matter47/agent-gate.readme_summary: Agent Gate generates test cases from an agent spec, proves checks can fail, runs them and triages failures. Includes support-ticket and refund-desk samples with seeded defects. LLM refund agent runs live on Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

thehun927/mabel-world.summary: ESP32-S3 sensor nodes and gateway giving a home assistant live light perception
thehun927/mabel-world.readme_summary: Physical sensing foundation with DFRobot ESP32-S3 node posting light observations every 10s. Includes LAN status page, gateway listener and systemd unit. MicroPython firmware plus gateway built during hackathon for embodied home perception.

Rasika020/ProofLens.summary: Converts flowchart images into interactive graphs with validated navigation and Q&A
Rasika020/ProofLens.readme_summary: Prototype that extracts nodes, labels and edges from flowchart images into structured graphs. Runs deterministic Python validation and renders interactive synchronized view. Plans Muse-powered grounded Q&A with keyboard and spoken access.

rishilifts/tracemint-ai.summary: Turns raw payment events into verified weekly revenue digests with deterministic KPIs
rishilifts/tracemint-ai.readme_summary: Ingests charge/refund/dispute events into D1, computes revenue deterministically in TypeScript. Muse Spark 1.2 via Meta Model API writes weekly digest, with every figure checked before display. Stack: Cloudflare Workers, D1, TypeScript.

maldial/-acute-oncology-helper.summary: Multilingual voice intake for oncology symptoms with nurse review
maldial/-acute-oncology-helper.readme_summary: Hybrid oncology intake and nurse-review prototype accepting natural-language multilingual voice and text. Links patient facts to evidence, uncertainty and human review. Synthetic data only, not for clinical use, delivery simulated.

MinhTriTM/hocbong-hunter.summary: Multi-agent scholarship finder with verification across 50 languages
MinhTriTM/hocbong-hunter.readme_summary: Hoc Bong Hunter v4.0 is a 12-node multi-agent web app that matches, verifies and tracks scholarships with triple-verification engine. Static HTML/CSS/JS front end with Node server, i18n, and CI/CD on GitHub Pages. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API.

poorvi0217/TraceTwin-AI.summary: Replays API requests on old and new versions to catch unintended behavior changes
poorvi0217/TraceTwin-AI.readme_summary: Autonomous loop replays test cases against reference and new APIs, triages diffs against changelog, fixes allowed rules and re-verifies. Guardrailed edits with backups. Full-stack with backend agent, frontend tester and AI verdicts.

woadi-vector/lima-listening-post.summary: Turns Bee transcripts into evidence-backed follow-ups with review queue to Notion
woadi-vector/lima-listening-post.readme_summary: Connects meeting transcripts to project memory using exact source evidence and editable review queue. Prepares daily background digests or single-meeting follow-ups. Python 3.11+ package with tests, Muse for drafting and Notion storage.

BarnabasNovak1/metastudy.summary: Study platform that turns notes, PDFs and handwriting into flashcards and tutoring
BarnabasNovak1/metastudy.readme_summary: AI study platform with Study Buddy, grounded chat, summarizer, flashcards, quizzes and lesson planner. Converts photos of handwriting to text. Built on Meta models via Meta Model API with Firebase hosting, Functions and Firestore.

simamkelejonas0-code/VUKA-PUBLIC.summary: Termux-built Android app using Muse Spark, SAM vision and Xhosa voice features
simamkelejonas0-code/VUKA-PUBLIC.readme_summary: Collection of 5 lightweight APKs built with javac, d8 and aapt2 in Termux, no Android Studio. Uses muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder, sam-3.1 and muse-voice for Xhosa/English speech. Java source and build proofs included.

Nana-Kojo801/cold-case.summary: Voice-interrogation detective game that trains cross-examination with AI suspects.
Nana-Kojo801/cold-case.readme_summary: Generates solvable crime cases with searchable scenes and voice-questionable AI suspects. Built with Next.js/TypeScript, it tracks contradictions and debriefs questioning technique. Uses Meta Muse models for case generation and suspect agents.

huuduong252600-ctrl/cung-hoc-tieng-trung.summary: Static Vietnamese web app for learning Chinese with flashcards and HSK quizzes.
huuduong252600-ctrl/cung-hoc-tieng-trung.readme_summary: Static HTML/JS site with dictionary, flashcards, writing, pinyin and quiz tabs. Progress stored in browser localStorage with no backend. No Meta AI / Muse integration evident in README or file tree.

Deepak3725/mira.summary: Network of personal AI twins that chat with each other to coordinate tasks.
Deepak3725/mira.readme_summary: Each twin holds profile, skills and per-field sharing rules and coordinates with other twins. Built in Python with approval-gated memory and owner-controlled activation. Opportunity matching is the first demo use case.

iloveitaly/aiautocommit.summary: CLI that generates conventional commit messages from staged changes.
iloveitaly/aiautocommit.readme_summary: Analyzes staged diffs and writes conventional commits with per-repo prompt customization. Built in Python on pydantic-ai with Google Gemini as default provider. Excludes lockfiles and supports multiple LLM providers.

AathilFelix/busdrop.summary: Agentic bus dispatcher that moves riders across buses mid-route when crowded.
AathilFelix/busdrop.readme_summary: Monitors Chennai corridor buses and proposes cross-bus transfers at shared stops. Uses Meta Muse Spark for dispatch decisions gated by a deterministic verifier. Stack includes Python API, simulator and Next.js dashboard.

ductran160393apple-ui/zook-si-assistant.summary: On-device screen-reading assistant that flags scams and summarizes content.
ductran160393apple-ui/zook-si-assistant.readme_summary: Shared Rust core serves macOS and Android apps to read screen content and warn on-device. Calls AI only for summarization, translation and problem-solving. Vietnamese UI with local scam detection.

ThePurpleOne855/ADACVA.summary: Voice-controlled piano tutor that helps blind learners practice independently.
ThePurpleOne855/ADACVA.readme_summary: Connects reviewed MusicXML scores, MIDI piano input and spoken feedback for guided practice. Built in Python with voice controls, MIDI handling and optional hand tracking. Exports sessions locally for review.

alrevion/underwrite.summary: Startup diligence tool that researches ideas and traces every number to sources.
alrevion/underwrite.readme_summary: Interviews founders, searches live web and returns verdict with TAM/SAM math done in code. Built on Meta models with Cloudflare Workers, Vite frontend and fact-vs-assumption checks. Outputs system design and prototype.

mahdimohmmed97-commits/wazifa-coach.summary: Bilingual Arabic-English AI career coach for Gulf graduates with CV matching.
mahdimohmmed97-commits/wazifa-coach.readme_summary: Matches CVs to job descriptions, identifies skill gaps and provides interview practice. Built with Python backend and web UI, localized for Saudization and Emiratization context. Powered by Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

waqarsaleem320/breadcrumbs.summary: Privacy tool that finds location leaks across photo feeds and suggests fixes.
waqarsaleem320/breadcrumbs.readme_summary: Attacker agent scans multi-photo feeds to find where user becomes findable, defender suggests minimal fixes. Built with Streamlit using Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 from Meta Model API. Includes browser extension and demo app.

OrionChocoPie/Autonomous-CV-scientist.summary: Evidence-driven copilot that links CV runs and image errors to suggest next test.
OrionChocoPie/Autonomous-CV-scientist.readme_summary: Imports training runs, compares metrics and configs, and inspects FP/FN images for object detectors. Uses a Meta Muse agent to investigate failures and propose hypotheses. Targets industrial inspection workflows with local evidence-linked workspace.

Shak0501/muse-evidence-review-core.summary: Verifies AI draft reviews against exact sources with quote checks and stale control.
Shak0501/muse-evidence-review-core.readme_summary: Reviews a saved draft against a source, validates quotations locally, and marks older revisions STALE. Uses Meta Muse Wonder via Model API for judgments with human approval separation. Python stdlib app with web UI and live demo.

uni100h-ops/ai_plus.summary: Adds GPU optimization layer to speed up Meta AI reasoning and image tasks.
uni100h-ops/ai_plus.readme_summary: Combines Meta AI models with Simulated Bifurcation on NVIDIA GPUs via Modal for faster, higher-quality outputs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 to clarify prompts before Muse Image generation. Private research prototype with Render + Modal stack.

GautamPatil1/Booklith.summary: Turns PDFs into structured AI-powered book reader sites you can deploy.
GautamPatil1/Booklith.readme_summary: Uploads PDF via OCR endpoint, converts to chapters with stable IDs, and exports a reader website. Uses Meta models for organizing and theming without rewriting text, plus integrity validator. You-control infra with Modal and speech services.

sol0invictus/FrontierLLMCatalog.summary: Static site comparing 32 open-weight LLMs at config and training depth.
sol0invictus/FrontierLLMCatalog.readme_summary: Documents layer layout, attention, MoE routing, token budgets, data mixes, RL and benchmarks. Includes Muse Spark Open and Glimmer 30B among 32 models. Standalone static site with no backend, built from data files and scripts.

KIRAkash/Nomi.summary: Restaurant plate-consistency checker using Golden Plate photos and SAM vision masks
KIRAkash/Nomi.readme_summary: Chef sets a Golden Plate once, Nomi checks every plate with SAM 3.1 segmentation. Expo SDK 58 web and Android app using six Meta models. Keeps restaurant dishes matching head chef standard.

tony1010-dev/earlybolt.summary: Tray app that pre-starts AI usage windows so limits reset before work.
tony1010-dev/earlybolt.readme_summary: Schedules warm-ups for Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, Muse and Kimi on macOS and Windows. Tauri tray app with install scripts and docs. No Meta model integration; manages subscription timing for developer workflows.

moshall/egloon_rule_hub.summary: Generates maintained proxy rules for Egern, Loon, Clash and others.
moshall/egloon_rule_hub.readme_summary: Maintains unified intermediate model to build per-client service rules and bundles. Syncs upstream sources via GitHub Actions with attribution and manifests. No Meta AI usage; networking infra and distribution tooling.

pramodthe/3d_gen_model.summary: Recovers editable CAD programs with parts and steps from one car photo.
pramodthe/3d_gen_model.readme_summary: Planner writes CAD operations from image while language world model predicts next solid state and failures. Kernel executes program for verification with overlay comparison. Python project with scripts, figures and results folders.

aideegarza/sofia-muse.summary: Bilingual voice receptionist that logs immigration calls to Sheets
aideegarza/sofia-muse.readme_summary: Answers Spanish/English calls via Retell, then sends transcripts to Muse Spark 1.3 for 18-field structured extraction, summary and urgency. Python server on Render writes one validated row per call to Google Sheets.

makemake-kbo/muse-pi-plugin.summary: Lets Pi harness run on Muse subscription credentials with native loop
makemake-kbo/muse-pi-plugin.readme_summary: Pi extension that routes Pi agent requests through Muse subscription auth from ~/.config/muse/auth.json. Preserves Pi's native agent loop and namespaced tools with no billing fallback. Supports model selection, usage reporting, and env overrides for key and user-agent.

AyodeleOA/floodlensai.summary: Community flood reports plus AI mapping for African risk awareness.
AyodeleOA/floodlensai.readme_summary: FloodLens AI combines community reports, image analysis and environmental data into explainable Flood Risk Index map. Amplify frontend with backend and infrastructure. Uses Meta AI for image analysis and decision-support.

ddewantaraq/iklim-pal.summary: Turns litter photo and location into a safety-bounded youth action plan
ddewantaraq/iklim-pal.readme_summary: Local climate action planner that converts photo, city and text into a pack-approved measurable plan. Monorepo with apps, packages/action-packs and Supabase. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for tool-loop, Wonder for synthesis, Image and Voice Transcribe.

CHARLS362/PaviLens.summary: Turns one road photo into measured distress map, PCI score, quantities and repair plan.
CHARLS362/PaviLens.readme_summary: PaveLens uses Meta SAM 3 to segment pavement distresses, converts geometry to metres, computes ASTM D6433 PCI and budgets. Meta Muse Wonder diagnoses and plans detours and crew routes. Stack is Python backend plus frontend with bilingual docs.

HafizAnas-101Dev/Mimaar-AI.summary: Analyzes site photos into segmented overlays with quantity and cost report
HafizAnas-101Dev/Mimaar-AI.readme_summary: Construction analyzer that turns one or six room photos into segmented overlay with quantity, cost and defects in English, Urdu or Arabic. Frontend plus backend perceive-measure-price pipeline with mock mode. Uses SAM 3 masks and Meta open weights for measurement and reporting.

HalachaBench/halacha-bench-results.summary: Benchmarks 24 AI models on real Israeli rabbinic ordination exam questions
HalachaBench/halacha-bench-results.readme_summary: Evaluation results bundle testing models on 60 closed-book Hebrew questions from five Cheshvan 5787 semicha papers. Each model answered three times with shared rubrics and judge scoring. Provisional report compares GPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude and others, not a Muse-powered app.

VISHALIN-rgm/TabTalk.summary: Turns spoken and handwritten shop credit notes into ledger and reminders
VISHALIN-rgm/TabTalk.readme_summary: Shopkeeper ledger app that transcribes voice and handwriting into reviewable credit records and respectful payment reminders. Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript and Drizzle. Uses Muse Spark for ledger parsing and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech input.

njugTumz/shelfsense-ai.summary: Agentic team that turns operation videos into tested apps via sandbox and audit
njugTumz/shelfsense-ai.readme_summary: FIELD analyzes uploaded operation video visual and audio, asks questions, generates spec and working app. React Vite plus FastAPI and SQLite MVP, runs in E2B sandbox with adversarial Muse Spark audit via Meta Model API.

AVL-cloud/ai-workflow.summary: Shared Atlas and playbooks for consistent work across VS Code AI agents
AVL-cloud/ai-workflow.readme_summary: VS Code folder giving Claude Code, Roo Code and opencode a shared chief-of-staff workflow with browser Atlas, digests and Jira integration. Includes MCP servers, skills, templates and toolbox scripts. Model-agnostic and works with Claude, GPT, Qwen and Muse Glimmer.

AviralDeshratna11/MetaAIHack.summary: Compiles video perception into robot motion with 3D and MuJoCo replay
AviralDeshratna11/MetaAIHack.readme_summary: Video2Robot pipeline for perception, interaction and robot plan compilation with queue-based geometry runtime. Includes Franka FK/IK, gripper inference, retiming and LeRobot v3 I/O with debugger. Uses VGGT and SAM 3D Body for live inference and MuJoCo for replay validation.

dawarepranav/VeriCell.summary: Microscopy QA that segments cells and answers with calibrated 90% ranges
dawarepranav/VeriCell.readme_summary: Asks questions on microscope images, segments every cell/organoid and reports honest uncertainty. Built with Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe and Glimmer 30B experiment. Dockerized FastAPI plus web UI with guided tour deployment.

amartya-k/clinic-front-desk-ai.summary: Missed-call text-back assistant that answers clinic FAQs and drafts bookings
amartya-k/clinic-front-desk-ai.readme_summary: Python SMS flow with guardrails.py and clinic_knowledge.json answers routine questions and creates staff-confirmable bookings. Uses Meta client for dialogue, with pre-model escalation for clinical or urgent messages.

bb8654838-lgtm/sentinelpulse.summary: Tier-0 rules gate that drops noisy alerts before LLM triage
bb8654838-lgtm/sentinelpulse.readme_summary: Webhook normalize and deterministic gate drops provable noise at zero tokens, escalating only signal to muse-spark-1.3 triage. Includes bench harness, frozen SHA256 evidence and tests for verifiable SRE triage.

Malu2555/FarbArchitect-AI.summary: Stateless simulator that places chip fab machines under heat limits
Malu2555/FarbArchitect-AI.readme_summary: Places semiconductor machines on 100x100 cleanroom grid under thermal and vibration constraints. In-memory verifier-gated loop converges in 20-80s with Meta Model API corrector and Fireworks AI fallback, no database.

Ksanskar-5/Meta_Hackathon_Countdown.summary: Single-file countdown page to the hackathon submission deadline
Ksanskar-5/Meta_Hackathon_Countdown.readme_summary: Zero-dependency index.html shows live countdown and progress bar to Nov 4 2026 deadline. No frameworks, build step or external requests; deployable via GitHub Pages.

SS03REAPER/Replicant-v2.summary: Mobile defensive scanner that detects and quarantines AI prompt attacks
SS03REAPER/Replicant-v2.readme_summary: Client-side index.html app detects hidden prompts, homoglyphs and jailbreaks before model execution. Creates sandboxed twin fingerprint and intel report; defensive-only with no offensive actions.

sagar-das01/AIsleEye.summary: Phone photo of warehouse aisle becomes damage tickets and inventory counts
sagar-das01/AIsleEye.readme_summary: AIsleEye segments boxes and floor markings from one photo, inspects damage, flags blocked walkways and files tickets after supervisor approval. Stack is Python backend, frontend app and infra scripts. Uses sam-3.1 for segmentation and muse-spark-1.3 for schema-constrained damage inspection.

official-pam/Meta_market_assistant.summary: Market app linking trader stock logging to nearby buyer search
official-pam/Meta_market_assistant.readme_summary: Next.js frontend and backend with PostgreSQL inventory for shops and location search, demoed on Kubwa shops. Uses Meta models for assisted stock logging and product discovery.

simss4241-cmyk/BenchMate.summary: Electronics salvage workbench for photo ID, parts inventory and builds
simss4241-cmyk/BenchMate.readme_summary: Node server plus web UI identifies donor devices from photos and maintains reusable inventory with reservations. Uses Meta Muse models for identification and build planning grounded in datasheets.

scottbegraft-art/sentra-frontier.summary: Visual operations auditor with multi-role review and human approval
scottbegraft-art/sentra-frontier.readme_summary: Uploads workstation photos for Muse Spark reasoning grounded by SAM 3.1 segmentation through a three-role council. Node server plus web app records audit history, metrics and downloadable reports.

amansinghhhhhhh/aicontentdetector.summary: Local app that scores text as AI or human with sentence-level highlighting.
amansinghhhhhhh/aicontentdetector.readme_summary: Paste text or upload PDF/DOCX/TXT for AI-likelihood score, verdict, and per-sentence highlighting plus AI-to-human rewriting. Built with FastAPI backend and React frontend with local ONNX model, running fully offline with no API keys.

vijayarapath/LearnMateAi.summary: Django learning platform with AI tutor, quizzes, voice questions, and study planner.
vijayarapath/LearnMateAi.readme_summary: Django 5 + Bootstrap 5 platform with AI tutor, textbook image reader, voice Q&A, quiz generator, and dashboards. Uses SQLite locally with PostgreSQL/Gunicorn for production and integrates Meta AI models for tutoring and generation.

icporcincula/localledger.summary: Offline document Q&A that loads 200 pages into local Muse Glimmer with verified quotes.
icporcincula/localledger.readme_summary: Loads up to 100K tokens into Meta Muse Glimmer 30B on a single 16GB GPU with no RAG or uploads. Answers with word-for-word verified quotes, page references, and honest abstention when info is missing.

Unrankedbandit/nanode-glimmer-hackathon-.summary: Evaluation handoff measuring Glimmer LoRA fine-tuning gains on formatting and tool use.
Unrankedbandit/nanode-glimmer-hackathon-.readme_summary: Sanitized presentation with slides, charts, and 100-case evaluation data for Glimmer SFT LoRA. Compares base vs LoRA on action formatting, tool agreement, and latency; documents missing 3D mesh export.

malexandersalazar/uyari.summary: Builds community-trained text and speech translation for Shawi languages.
malexandersalazar/uyari.readme_summary: Open toolkit turns community translations and recordings into Indigenous to official-language models for text and speech. First pair Shawi-Spanish/English on Muse Glimmer 30B QLoRA plus NLLB-200 1.3B. Includes methodology, labeled builds and Hugging Face models.

nav92061/ct-vlm-delivery-order.summary: Study showing delivery order of CT images and DICOM headers changes VLM QC decisions.
nav92061/ct-vlm-delivery-order.readme_summary: Code, prompts, images, and logs for IEEE ISBI 2027 paper on VLM quality control for CT pairs. Tests vision-language models on truncated/gapped scans with true and false DICOM metadata to measure order effects.

siddhi-lad/COSMOS.summary: Streamlit app extracting cosmetic labels into evidence-grounded ingredient insights.
siddhi-lad/COSMOS.readme_summary: Streamlit app that extracts cosmetic labels to 69-entry curated knowledge base with PubMed and PubChem evidence. API-only inference architecture with offline unit tests and modular core/UI codebase.

final-bench/vikernel-agent-guard.summary: Muse Spark agent where every action is gated by an OS and kill switch in model weights.
final-bench/vikernel-agent-guard.readme_summary: Embeds CPU/NPU/GPU circuits, Secure OS, and kill switch into Muse Glimmer 30B weights with live Agent Guard demo. Every Muse Spark agent action passes ViKernel policy checks via gate service and UI.

Mawego/truth-layer.summary: Browser extension flagging AI-generated videos on social feeds live
Mawego/truth-layer.readme_summary: Chrome extension that scores YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok video frames as real or AI. Backend uses Llama Vision forensic analysis via Baseten with per-frame varying confidence badges.

mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit.summary: Web platform for AI-powered code security audits and business plan evaluations.
mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit.readme_summary: Provides Code Auditor and Business Evaluator workflows powered server-side by Meta Model API. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, and server.ts backend requiring MODEL_API_KEY with no frontend key exposure.

yeshwanthnarige/bugarena.summary: AI browser tester that finds UI violations and exports Playwright tests
yeshwanthnarige/bugarena.readme_summary: BugArena explores a demo shop with Meta Responses API, reports rule violations, reproduces them in a fresh browser, and exports Playwright regression tests. Stack includes Node.js dashboard, Playwright, Docker with screenshots and run history.

rahul-jain-dev/Lauchbase.summary: Idea-to-build planner with scope checks and project map review
rahul-jain-dev/Lauchbase.readme_summary: LaunchBase guides idea analysis, scope confirmation, foundation filtering and build-plan review with an interactive project map. Built with Next.js, pnpm and Node 22; Meta integration is validated separately. App generation and ZIP export are planned.

iamuuid/20261104StoryDaw-mini.summary: Visual manga planner for tension curves and text storyboard briefs
iamuuid/20261104StoryDaw-mini.readme_summary: StoryDAW Mini is a DAW-style single-screen app for Ki-Sho-Ten-Ketsu plotting with tension sliders and World Lock. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Cloudflare Workers to generate text-only panel briefs with camera and dialogue. Stack is Vite + TypeScript.

frumi7040/proof-ai-back-office.summary: Back office that matches chat payment claims to merchant records
frumi7040/proof-ai-back-office.readme_summary: Proof extracts payment claims from chat messages and matches them against merchant feeds. Deterministic code handles clear cases with Muse Wonder as fallback for ambiguous ones to avoid wrong auto-confirms. Python prototype tested on synthetic benchmark.

ivorojas-netizen/kirkinx_rescue.summary: Swarm robotics command system for disaster search and rescue operations
ivorojas-netizen/kirkinx_rescue.readme_summary: KirkinX is a distributed C2 platform for humanitarian search and rescue swarm robotics. Central tactical reasoning uses Meta Llama 3, while YOLOv8 runs on edge hardware for casualty detection. Dispatches JSON directives from telemetry evaluation.

praveensaharan/RoleEdge.summary: Agent team turns reels and links into parent-friendly updates, tracks wellbeing
praveensaharan/RoleEdge.readme_summary: Family elder-care app where shared reels/links are converted by Meta-model agents into followable content, safety-checked before viewing, with wellbeing reports. Python 3.11 stack with Docker, Modal, scam-checker, and 175 tests.

Khanhslee/netsentinel-ai.summary: SOC copilot turning network evidence into defensible decisions
Khanhslee/netsentinel-ai.readme_summary: NetSentinel AI analyzes Suricata, YARA and traffic evidence with Muse Wonder and Spark, mapping to MITRE ATT&CK. Python + Chainlit SOC copilot outputs Suricata rules, YARA hunts and navigator layers with tests and example detections.

loliamserious/furiday.summary: Desktop pet that appears in live video while doing your computer tasks
loliamserious/furiday.readme_summary: Furiday turns one pet photo into a macOS live wallpaper that acts out tasks while Muse Wonder executes them with tools. Electron app handles wallpaper video, input bar and previews, with local file tools in main process. Uses Meta Muse API for research, documents and file work.

bryaan/araani-bridge.summary: Single launcher door to 51 live voice-built web apps
bryaan/araani-bridge.readme_summary: BRIDGE v1.12 is the umbrella launcher for a 51-app fleet built by one builder directing Muse Wonder by voice. Static web frontend with grid, radar and list layouts plus favorites. No hand-written code; each tile links to a live deployed app.

Dunnohten/shep.summary: Voice-first Mac menu-bar dog for accessible, approved-only control
Dunnohten/shep.readme_summary: Shep docks to the active window, finds unnamed controls and shows actions for user approval. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B on-device for control naming with on-device speech recognition and Hey Shep wake. Native macOS Swift app with privacy-first design.

renewed-git/Project-Checkpoint.summary: Webcam head-tracking cursor that replaces the mouse with hands-free control
renewed-git/Project-Checkpoint.readme_summary: Turns a standard webcam into a head-steered cursor with pointer acceleration and Alt-key click control on Windows. Built in Python with OpenCV/MediaPipe-style tracking plus an overlay UI. Optional Meta Muse Spark via Baseten labels the aimed-at UI target.

Atikelahi96/agentarena.summary: Benchmark and runtime guard that tests and blocks prompt-injection in agents
Atikelahi96/agentarena.readme_summary: AgentArena runs a Meta Muse tool-using agent in a synthetic sandbox with hidden injections to measure attack success and defense cost. AgentShield is a standalone guard between any agent and its tools. Full-stack with backend agentshield module and frontend.

casontek/meta-hackathon-roadreport.summary: Grades road defects from phone photos and dashcam clips with mapped tracking.
casontek/meta-hackathon-roadreport.readme_summary: RoadPulse converts phone photos or dashcam clips into graded, mapped road defect reports via React PWA and Fastify API. Uses Meta AI models for detection and grading with in-memory store and Swagger docs. Deployed split-origin with HTTPS camera and GPS.

ax0080/scope-pentest-agent.summary: Scoped pentest agent that only reports vulnerabilities with proven exploits
ax0080/scope-pentest-agent.readme_summary: Autonomous agent driven by muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API that hypothesizes and tests HTTP exploits. Deny-by-default scope.yaml allowlist enforced in code, findings require reproducible request/response. Python agent with core, demo and docs.

DevSecOps-Aditya/AlphaLens.summary: Market intelligence dashboard that turns business data into trend insights
DevSecOps-Aditya/AlphaLens.readme_summary: Flask web app with HTML/CSS/JS dashboard for trend analysis, opportunity detection and competitor insights. Uses TinyLlama via Ollama for AI recommendations. Built for Meta hackathon as startup and investor decision tool.

jcsancho/decideonce.summary: MCP server that caches agent decisions to skip repeat LLM calls
jcsancho/decideonce.readme_summary: Finds decision steps in agent workflows and records inputs and outcomes. Routes confident repeats to hosted Jev tier and private LoRA only when drift or coverage triggers training. Python MCP server.

manymoats/cleankpf.summary: Public receipted record mirror documenting ManyMoats and ICEBLOCK evidence
manymoats/cleankpf.readme_summary: Repository provides a reading-rules README for critical evidence review with observed/derived/claimed labels. Contains only docs under hackathon folder, no runnable app described. No Meta AI integration evident from files.

Muhammad-Ahmad-CO/hisab.summary: Voice money diary that parses spoken spending into daily savings stories
Muhammad-Ahmad-CO/hisab.readme_summary: Next.js + Tailwind app with mic input via Web Speech and localStorage diary. POSTs text to Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open with forced tool call to extract amount/category. Low-confidence parses ask back instead of guessing.

KryomLabs/kryomcode-v0.1.0.summary: Desktop AI environment to plan, edit, test and ship software projects
KryomLabs/kryomcode-v0.1.0.readme_summary: Electron desktop app with React, TypeScript, Vite frontend and Python backend for project understanding and code workflows. Supports editing, tool running, testing and Git shipping. Built for indie track as idea-to-software IDE.

snehasrikanth/ghostrep-meta-hackathon.summary: Workout coach that builds plans and compares squat videos to your best rep
snehasrikanth/ghostrep-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Next.js frontend with FastAPI backend for training plans, logging and evidence-grounded coaching. Uses Muse Spark for plans and coaching, SAM 3.1 for athlete outlines, MediaPipe for rep detection. Validates outputs before display.

123Anujyadav/MedAxis.summary: AI healthcare platform linking patients, doctors and admins with clinical help
123Anujyadav/MedAxis.readme_summary: MedAxis AI is a local-first healthcare platform for patients, doctors and admins. Backend plus frontend with Postgres and Redis provide records, prescriptions and workflows. It uses Meta Muse Spark for clinical assistance and healthcare automation.

Fabit77/Op-Radar.summary: Spanish tool turning cultural events into traceable commerce opportunities
Fabit77/Op-Radar.readme_summary: Opportunity Radar maps events to signals, opportunities and campaign proposals in Spanish. Next.js app with server HTTP integration to Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 using JSON Schema and Zod. Demo mode runs rule-based without credentials.

mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit-.summary: AI code auditor and structured business idea evaluator in one app
mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit-.readme_summary: CoreAudit provides Code Auditor for repo analysis and Business Evaluator for idea scoring. Vite frontend with Node server calls Meta Model API server-side via MODEL_API_KEY. Focus on secure key handling and structured AI workflows.

IXGeniusXI/synesthetic-palette.summary: AI design co-pilot that turns any inspiration into design systems
IXGeniusXI/synesthetic-palette.readme_summary: Synesthetic Palette is a personal design co-pilot delivering weekly palettes, typography and visual direction from reference images and web insights. Reasoned by Muse Wonder via Meta Model API with verification. Stack is backend plus frontend built during Oct 26-Nov 4 hackathon.

keval-doshi/galielo.summary: Tracks motion in video to find physics laws and make lab reports
keval-doshi/galielo.readme_summary: Galileo turns phone video plus one known length into a physics experiment. SAM 3.1 tracks motion, Muse Wonder fits the law with uncertainty, Muse Spark helps reporting. Python pipeline outputs numbers and PDF lab report.

shunkakinoki/dotagents.summary: Syncable agent rules, commands, skills and MCP config for dev machines
shunkakinoki/dotagents.readme_summary: dotagents manages reusable agent configuration with Ruler and skills CLI. Makefile sync generates CLAUDE.md files, installs locked external skills, and syncs commands and MCP config. No Meta model integration; developer productivity infra.

huangfe9/blackout-think.summary: Screen-black voice thinking tool that returns summary, map and sketch
huangfe9/blackout-think.readme_summary: Blackout lets users state a goal and think aloud with screen black. Python app listens, builds mind map, parks tangents, and returns cited summary, todos and image. Uses Meta Muse models via custom muse_client with speech I/O.

kaufmann-dev/web-terminal.summary: OIDC-secured browser terminal with persistent shells and AI tools
kaufmann-dev/web-terminal.readme_summary: Private browser terminal using xterm.js, node-pty and Express with OIDC auth. Provides persistent named shells, Node.js 24, GitHub and Chromium automation in Podman container. Focus on secure remote dev access, no stated Muse use.

MohamedAtiyah/relib.summary: Research workspace where agent finds papers and maps topics in bubbles
MohamedAtiyah/relib.readme_summary: Note workspace with / commands where agent suggests papers with fit, weaknesses, and full-text vs abstract judgement. Folders set Tutor/Analyst roles, Neurolib bubble map visualizes topics. Built for Indie Build for Your World.

Naresh2028/wander-muse.summary: Mood-based travel muse that suggests places as painted postcards
Naresh2028/wander-muse.readme_summary: Wander takes vague mood text and proposes distinct places with postcard images. Python app uses Meta Muse models via Meta Model API for text and image generation. Includes offline tests and smoke scripts for API verification.

howdycarter/glassbox.summary: Measures appropriate human reliance on AI advice with ground-truthed vignettes
howdycarter/glassbox.readme_summary: TRL 4 prototype scoring accept-when-right and reject-when-wrong reliance, plus over-reliance and latency. Uses deterministic transparent recommender with Glass-Box/Black-Box ablation and 87/87 verification assertions. React frontend for controlled trust experiments.

rick2x/hydrosight-meta.summary: Turns street flood photos into 3D DEM flood maps for Rizal, Philippines
rick2x/hydrosight-meta.readme_summary: Converts flood photos to DEM-based extent shapefiles, depth profiles and rescue corridors with multi-report merging. Backend uses SAM-3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for scene reasoning plus EXIF GPS. Dockerized FastAPI backend with frontend map UI.

i-niranjan/boxsense.summary: Phone scan builds live 3D object memory map for warehouse shelves
i-niranjan/boxsense.readme_summary: Streams phone camera, pose and depth over WebSocket at ~3fps to Node+Express server. SAM 3.1 detects boxes/masks, lifted to 3D via depth+pose and matched against persistent object memory. Browser 3D viewer shows remembered objects across occlusion.

eleeths/tesseract.summary: Simulated nested sandbox where attackers and defenders train a fleet playbook
eleeths/tesseract.readme_summary: Fully simulated red-team vs blue-team sandbox where outer monitor hardens and shares lessons globally. Fleet clones deploy on-demand defenders paid per hold. Python agent loop with marketplace and dashboard, Meta hackathon Push the Frontier entry.

qfuggett/SyncDigit.summary: Webcam-driven assistive finger simulation with AI-selected calibration
qfuggett/SyncDigit.readme_summary: SyncDigit is a webcam-controlled simulation of an assistive finger for limited finger function. It mirrors a chosen finger using Spark-selected calibration profiles locally. Prototype in Python explores assistance for congenital hand differences.

frommanbir/ADPilot.summary: Generates landing pages, ad creatives and Meta campaigns from products
frommanbir/ADPilot.readme_summary: SaaS workflow from product catalog to landing page, copy and multi-angle creatives to Meta Ads setup. Uses Meta Model API Studio for generation and targets Facebook/Instagram with CAPI tracking. Frontend plus backend guided automation flow.

DOOMSLAYERHEX/entity-zero-debugger.summary: Zero-context visual debugger that diagnoses and hot-patches UI from screen
DOOMSLAYERHEX/entity-zero-debugger.readme_summary: Multimodal runtime debugger that detects frontend anomalies and visual defects directly from interaction. Backend generative super-resolution prior with hot-patch output, live Netlify playground. Claims 5B-token vision telemetry checkpoint.

X7xenon/kaggle.summary: Runs 27B-31B LLMs on free Kaggle T4 GPUs tunneled to local PC
X7xenon/kaggle.readme_summary: Offloads Ollama inference to Kaggle Dual Tesla T4s with 30GB VRAM and 65K context, exposed via Ngrok HTTPS to local clients. Includes 9-hour session guard scripts and Open-WebUI/Jan integration. No local GPU required setup.

chanochrosenthal/invoicepilot.summary: AP agent that extracts invoices and audits them in sandbox for approval
chanochrosenthal/invoicepilot.readme_summary: Reads text, PDF and photo invoices natively with Muse models to structured fields without OCR. Model-written audit code runs in no-network sandbox to check totals, duplicates and fraud. Human approves queued payments, contained on Vultr.

stealthSA/replay.summary: Recaps your Facebook, Instagram and Threads posts for later listening
stealthSA/replay.readme_summary: PWA in plain PHP 8.1 with SQLite that organizes signed-in user's own posts, reels, stories and threads. Respects Meta API limits, no viewing history access. Dark-mode UI with save-for-listening and installable offline flow.

aprettymess/ustaad.summary: Turns trusted how-to videos into private offline step-by-step job lessons
aprettymess/ustaad.readme_summary: USTAAD converts a filmed household or vehicle job into step-by-step procedures and compares learner attempts side-by-side. It runs offline on one GPU with quantized Muse Glimmer 30B via llama.cpp and SAM 3.1 for text-prompted video segmentation and privacy masking.

mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit-12345.summary: Audits code repos and scores business plans using Meta Model API
mahamudulvisuals-debug/CoreAudit-12345.readme_summary: CoreAudit provides Code Auditor for repository analysis and Business Evaluator for structured plan evaluation. Built with Vite, TypeScript and server.ts backend, it calls the Meta Model API server-side using MODEL_API_KEY.
