GautamPatil1/test-book-site.summary: AI reading site from PDF with grounded chat, translation and practice tests
GautamPatil1/test-book-site.readme_summary: Booklith-generated Next.js site with search, KaTeX math, themes and AI sidebar for citation-grounded chat. Uses Muse Spark/Wonder for chat and quizzes, Muse Voice Transcribe for voice input and web_search for references via BYO keys.

mangeshraut712/fieldfix.summary: Photo of broken item becomes mapped repair steps grounded in manuals
mangeshraut712/fieldfix.readme_summary: FieldFix identifies objects and parts with Muse Spark 1.3, segments them with SAM 3.1 on Meta Model API, and retrieves BM25 manual excerpts. Next.js UI overlays masks and returns structured diagnosis, tools, safety notes and steps.

WANAONTOP/Buglens.summary: Reproduces UI bugs from screenshots and verifies fixes before opening PRs
WANAONTOP/Buglens.readme_summary: BugLens AI links screenshots and recordings to source at a pinned commit, proposes patches and verifies in Modal before creating GitHub PRs. Stack is Python FastAPI backend, npm frontend, with bearer-token auth for API endpoints.

RajaRishiKumar/bikesense.summary: Phone scans verify bike service changes with evidence in Tamil, Hindi, English
RajaRishiKumar/bikesense.readme_summary: BikeSense compares before and after photos and video to measure service changes against owner manual specs. Uses SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for vision judgments and reports, and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

whyitworks307/is-this-a-scam.summary: Simple scam verdicts with plain-language red flags for older adults
whyitworks307/is-this-a-scam.readme_summary: App accepts pasted text or screenshots and returns Likely Scam, Be Careful or Looks OK with red flags and next steps. Built with Python FastAPI and rules.py plus muse-spark via Meta API, with demo mode and AARP helpline info.

EmuCS/FlowTopo.summary: Auto places animation edge loops on raw 3D scans for Blender
EmuCS/FlowTopo.readme_summary: FlowTopo renders meshes to grey views, plans edge loops with Muse Spark 1.3 vision structured output, then locates eyes and mouth with SAM 3.1. A quad remesher builds deformable topology for Blender characters.

nk9seo/UIEvolutionEngine.summary: Turns app screenshots into running SwiftUI apps then iteratively improves them
nk9seo/UIEvolutionEngine.readme_summary: Engine segments screenshots with SAM 3.1 and understands UI with Muse Spark to write validated specs and SwiftUI code. Next.js and TypeScript agent compiles for macOS and iOS, optionally generating art with Muse Image.

haileydaysincanada-maker/font-preview-ma.summary: Mac font browser that sorts installed fonts by visual style
haileydaysincanada-maker/font-preview-ma.readme_summary: Native SwiftUI macOS app shows all installed and Adobe fonts with same sample text, sets and folder previews. v1.3 Typeface Scout ranks matches from text description or sign photo with English and Korean UI.

kpulagam/last-seen.summary: Phone walkthrough that remembers where home objects were last seen
kpulagam/last-seen.readme_summary: Home object-permanence memory: walk rooms with phone, then ask where items are. Uses Muse Spark for detection/naming, SAM 3.1 for segmentation/tracking, DINO embeddings for re-ID across days with a stationary/moved/new state machine.

flameangel93/n8n_muse_node.summary: n8n community nodes bringing Meta Muse models to workflows
flameangel93/n8n_muse_node.readme_summary: Community n8n package adding Meta Muse to automation workflows. Provides a Chat Model sub-node for Agents/Chains and a full Meta Model API action node for Muse Wonder/Spark via Responses and Chat APIs, usable as agent tool.

suitzero/anytime-world.summary: Budget slider that refines an SDF world from coarse to detailed
suitzero/anytime-world.readme_summary: Interactive demo where a canonical SDF scene in GFL renders under user-controlled compute budget. Dragging 1-100 refines the image with live budget-error graph, showing anytime rendering. Derived from suitzero/gfl project.

SanikaMhatre/pid-digitizer.summary: Turns scanned P&ID drawings into verified graphs, BOMs and rule violations.
SanikaMhatre/pid-digitizer.readme_summary: Reads scanned P&ID images into a machine-readable graph, BOM CSV, and annotated overlay with design-rule checks. Stack is Python with Docker and evals. Uses SAM 3.1 for symbol detection and Muse via Meta Model API for reading and verification.

rkottomt/sunseg.summary: Finds Fresno rooftop solar in aerial images and simulates output
rkottomt/sunseg.readme_summary: Detects rooftop solar arrays in Fresno aerial imagery with zero-shot SAM 3.1 prompting, simulates hourly production with pvlib, and visualizes city-wide output in a 3D map with film mode. No training data.

Nikasemo-Technologies/one-phone-classroo.summary: Single-phone TaRL classroom tool for levels, practice and quizzes
Nikasemo-Technologies/one-phone-classroo.readme_summary: Teaching at the Right Level prototype for Ghana: teacher photos math work, places learners on 4-level ladder, assigns group activities. Shared group phone for videos/practice/quizzes. Firebase web app with Firestore.

pavansharan007/DebugCode.summary: Practice debugging in realistic multi-file repos with tests
pavansharan007/DebugCode.readme_summary: LeetCode-style platform for codebase navigation and bug fixing, not blank-function algorithms. Multi-file problems with Monaco editor, read-only tests, static hints, and strict no-AI-assist policy during solving.

AeriesAgi/civicops-vision-meta-hackathon.summary: WhatsApp and web control room for municipal pothole and leak reports
AeriesAgi/civicops-vision-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Municipal ops control room for South African cities: residents report via WhatsApp/web, Muse Spark does triage and multilingual work orders, SAM 3.1 masks hazards. Human dispatcher approves; .NET with sandboxed demo.

kevi8hua/lunara-hackathon.summary: Turns private written memories into shareable star constellations
kevi8hua/lunara-hackathon.readme_summary: Calm private-by-default single-page prototype: typed memory becomes deterministic constellation. No build, no account, no network; localStorage only with clear-all. No Meta API call required to run.

ayushgawai/sentinel-ai.summary: Multi-camera weapon detection with tracking and auto 911 call
ayushgawai/sentinel-ai.readme_summary: Campus safety system watching cameras for weapons, tracking person across cameras, and placing automated 911 call with observed facts. Muse Spark Open on Baseten for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SignalWire+ElevenLabs voice.

foresighthouseai/wildlife-road-alert.summary: Dashcam system that detects deer, moose and bear to warn drivers
foresighthouseai/wildlife-road-alert.readme_summary: Watches dashcam video for deer, moose, elk, bear and bison. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment animals and road, geometry for risk levels, and Muse Spark to verify red alerts. Confirmed sightings are shared on a network map to warn following vehicles.

NullAITech/meta-dev-skills.summary: Reusable agent skills pack for building on Meta AI developer stack
NullAITech/meta-dev-skills.readme_summary: Public pack of modular SKILL.md instructions for Meta Model API, Muse models, open weights, Muse Code and Ray-Ban Meta wearables. Grounds coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Muse Code with workflows and constraints.

VamshiKrishnaBandari07/v7.summary: Reproducible evolution loop to optimize gripper designs in simulation
VamshiKrishnaBandari07/v7.readme_summary: Takes gripper objective, bounds and simulator budget to compare random search vs evolution vs evolution+adversary. Planner proposes regions, deterministic surrogate scores, results versioned with seeds and holdout fingerprint.

VishalNandy17/brick-ai.summary: Developer identity and audit ledger with AI security monitoring
VishalNandy17/brick-ai.readme_summary: AI-native auth and access management platform with cryptographic audit ledgers. Uses Meta AI muse-spark-1.1 as Security Sentinel for real-time intelligence. Stack is React 19, TanStack Start frontend and Go Gin backend.

iamsourabhraikwar/segmio-copilot-agent.summary: Browser video editing copilot that turns prompts into VFX edits
iamsourabhraikwar/segmio-copilot-agent.readme_summary: Browser-based multimodal video editing copilot for natural-language rotoscoping and composition. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark Open for scene understanding, with serverless inference on Modal, Baseten and Fireworks.

jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker-clean.summary: Bangla-first app with verified tempu routes and live driver GPS
jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker-clean.readme_summary: Web app with canonical dataset of 16 Chattogram tempu routes plus driver-shared browser GPS and live map. Includes route-grounded Meta AI travel assistant using muse-spark-1.2-contributor with voice, backed by MongoDB Atlas.

pranavnemani/apishift.summary: Finds breaking API changes and rewrites Python code into tested PRs
pranavnemani/apishift.readme_summary: Contract-driven API migration pipeline: Spec Diff to Scout, Analyst, Refactor and PR Writer. Uses Muse Spark for detection and Wonder for refactoring, with sandbox tests and self-heal loop. Opens reviewable pull requests.

jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker-client.summary: Bangla-first app with verified tempu routes and live driver GPS
jotika-meaw/tempu-tracker-client.readme_summary: Hackathon prototype frontend for 16 verified Chattogram tempu routes with outbound and return directions. Passenger trip planner, live map with intentional GPS sharing only, and Meta AI assistant. No fake movement or unverified docs.

micktomi/algorithm-forge-public.summary: Local lab that executes and verifies AI-proposed algorithms with proof
micktomi/algorithm-forge-public.readme_summary: Laboratory for testing mathematical algorithms proposed by Muse Spark. Preserves proposals, executes under OS isolation, scores against independent Python references, and stores evidence. Includes DAG scheduler verifier with exact rational arithmetic.

perambhargav123-lab/divi-ai-finance-team.summary: Five AI agents that close books, prove numbers and catch fraud
perambhargav123-lab/divi-ai-finance-team.readme_summary: AI finance team for fictional UAE SME Falcon Trading LLC. Five agents handle month-close, reconciliation, fraud detection and cash findings. Powered by muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API with replayable demo run.

codemarc/muse-code.summary: VS Code and Cursor sidebar chat UI that drives Meta Muse Code CLI agent.
codemarc/muse-code.readme_summary: Unofficial VS Code/Cursor extension providing sidebar chat for Meta Muse Code CLI. It shells out to muse exec --json while the Muse agent harness does the work. Requires macOS/Linux, Muse install and login or META_API_KEY.

haider213/loopwise.summary: Block-programming puzzle game teaching coding concepts with AI coaching.
haider213/loopwise.readme_summary: Puzzle game where Bolt the robot runs block programs plus Tracks for data structures, algorithms and full-stack. Uses Meta Muse models for levels, stories, coaching, Manim animations and voice/vision input. Playable in web and as MCP App.

Mrabbi3/f2j.summary: Agent translating legacy Fortran routines into verified JAX code.
Mrabbi3/f2j.readme_summary: Translates scientific Fortran to JAX one routine at a time using Muse Spark on Meta Model API. Verifies each translation by running compiled original Fortran. Enables GPU/TPU, vmap batching and differentiation for climate and aerospace models.

NayilRArana/primordial-paradox-engine.summary: Pre-existing game engine codebase for Primordial Paradox stored before hackathon start.
NayilRArana/primordial-paradox-engine.readme_summary: This repo stores the pre-hackathon engine history with 292 commits from Oct 19-26, 2026. It is kept separate as a dependency for the hackathon entry. No hackathon work was built in this repository.

sayeedalam/stvi-verification-evidence.summary: Tests whether executed tests and evidence justify confidence in software
sayeedalam/stvi-verification-evidence.readme_summary: Turns requirements into checkable claims via Meta Model API, generates and executes small tests, then two different Meta models rate persuasiveness. Fixed rule engine with no AI computes final confidence. Includes failures and synthetic data only.

coderyaz856/NOESIS-Autonomous-Informatio.summary: Autonomous information-driven agent system for scientific discovery workflows.
coderyaz856/NOESIS-Autonomous-Informatio.readme_summary: Noesis is an autonomous discovery platform with lab backend, frontend and Docker deployment. Provides experiment orchestration with tests and docs. Built to run lab workflows with Hugging Face Docker Space backend.

Mujeebroshan/counterfactual-lab.summary: Causal debugger that replays agent traces with interventions to isolate root causes
Mujeebroshan/counterfactual-lab.readme_summary: Counterfactual Lab debugs AI agents by generating hypotheses, compiling interventions, and replaying traces with and without fixes. Stack is FastAPI backend on 8010 and Next.js workbench on 3010. Uses Muse family via Meta Model API and Baseten open-weights.

Ghrit-igl/Noteer.summary: Security fabric scanning AI code at write-time and APIs at runtime.
Ghrit-igl/Noteer.readme_summary: Dual-pillar security system powered by Meta Llama 3.2 and 3.3. Guards AI-generated code pre-commit and defends APIs from autonomous scrapers at runtime. Includes CLI, dashboard, Docker compose and 283 automated tests.

kaushishvineet/easylaunchad.summary: Voice-first app turning shop photos into Click-to-WhatsApp ads.
kaushishvineet/easylaunchad.readme_summary: Hindi and English mobile app for small Indian shops. Vendor speaks and snaps a product photo, Meta-model marketing agent plans, designs and launches Facebook/Instagram Click-to-WhatsApp ads. Customers land in WhatsApp for follow-up offers.

prodbrandon/centurion.summary: Shopify analyst that traces AI-assistant sales and fixes catalog contradictions in one click.
prodbrandon/centurion.readme_summary: AI commerce analyst for Shopify showing revenue from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Meta AI with order-level evidence. Finds catalog contradictions and tests AI-agent checkout. Uses Muse Spark chat analyst with deterministic attribution and official APIs only.

GijungKim/unchained.summary: Local WHOOP 5 heart monitor with Muse Q&A over BLE, no cloud needed.
GijungKim/unchained.readme_summary: Reads WHOOP 5 heart data directly over BLE HRS into a local SQLite store with ingest and dashboard. Python stack with collectors, replay fixtures and LAN API. Uses Muse agent to fuse signals, report quality, and answer health questions.

Hiper-nexus/ai-launcher.summary: Interactive Bash launcher with preset flags for Claude, Codex, and Gemini CLIs
Hiper-nexus/ai-launcher.readme_summary: Bash launcher providing preconfigured commands for AI coding CLIs on macOS, Linux and Git Bash. Single ai script with install.sh, mcp and tests. No direct Muse call; developer workflow wrapper around external coding agents.

xtramo/ai-youtube-credibility-check.summary: Chrome extension that rates YouTube video credibility from transcripts.
xtramo/ai-youtube-credibility-check.readme_summary: Chrome extension that fetches video transcripts and returns Credible/Mixed/Red-flags verdict with reasons and confidence. Bring-your-own-key client-side design with token cost display. Supports Claude Haiku plus other providers, no server needed.

SachinGhumbre/autonomous-security-audito.summary: Autonomous agent that audits APIs against GDPR, HIPAA, OWASP and NIST.
SachinGhumbre/autonomous-security-audito.readme_summary: Ingests security policies once then auto-audits API estate against GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, OWASP Top 10 and SOC 2. Full-stack with backend, frontend, Redis and Postman collection. Powered by Meta muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for audit reasoning.

rivoj7/preflight.summary: Pre-checks Meta ads against 45 policies and visually fixes violations.
rivoj7/preflight.readme_summary: Next.js app that reviews ad image, copy and landing page against Meta Advertising Standards. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for structured policy verdicts and SAM 3.1 for pixel masks. Uses Muse Image to rewrite compliant copy and creatives.

brennandec/cleankpf.summary: Reusable state and traceable-change toolkit portfolio called manymoats
brennandec/cleankpf.readme_summary: Manymoats is a pre-revenue software and IP portfolio around reusable state and traceable changes. Repo contains overview docs and hackathon folder with evidence-focused reading rules. No clear Muse model integration is documented in the excerpt.

Slate-HQ-Ltd/claim-check.summary: Checks share-comment claims against story sources before Facebook share
Slate-HQ-Ltd/claim-check.readme_summary: Lets readers verify factual claims in share comments against cited sources using Muse Spark. Findings contract and Model API transport with stubbed tests are implemented. Minimal Muse Wonder CLI request returned READY, no live verdict yet.

Draylinp/dpm-agent.summary: WhatsApp receptionist for clinics that books and fills slots, no advice
Draylinp/dpm-agent.readme_summary: DPM Agent is a WhatsApp front desk for Dominican clinics handling booking, rescheduling and waitlist in Spanish, English and Haitian Creole. Built with Docker, Python and WhatsApp integration with privacy guardrails. Uses Meta Muse models for dialogue and strictly avoids medical advice.

nikhildas6/proactive-ai.summary: Personal agent foundation with profile, memory and dashboard
nikhildas6/proactive-ai.readme_summary: Phase 1 foundation for a proactive personal agent with user profile, persistent memory and suggestions. Stack is FastAPI plus Neon PostgreSQL with React dashboard. Proactive behavior is not yet implemented per roadmap.

NayilRArana/primordial-paradox-hackathon.summary: NES-style RPG with talk-or-fight bosses and live AI dialogue in a storm-hit town
NayilRArana/primordial-paradox-hackathon.readme_summary: Primordial Paradox is a GameMaker NES-style game skeleton extended during the hackathon. It uses Python gate for 2C02 limits and live Meta models for dialogue, plus original chiptune and kill/spare system.

yunoshev/physics-proof.summary: Drop in any video to measure physics claims with on-footage proof
yunoshev/physics-proof.readme_summary: General video physics verifier that plans checks from frames and overlays measurements on footage. Uses Muse Spark for planning plus SAM 3.1 for segmentation at ~$0.36 per clip. Fully rebuildable from text with web frontend and test fixtures.

jin-dalrae/climatico.summary: Interactive 3D landscape to explore clients, operations and growth flows
jin-dalrae/climatico.readme_summary: Full-screen Three.js scene where business entities are vessels and platforms with orbit, pan and route-follow interactions. Vite + TypeScript frontend with worker backend. Meta Muse Spark assisted development; optional server Meta endpoint.

scarySmart/insidetraders-meta-ai-integra.summary: Meta API layer explaining paper trades in plain words
scarySmart/insidetraders-meta-ai-integra.readme_summary: Integration layer connecting InsideTraders paper-trading education product to Meta hosted models API. Product runs four $30k paper lanes with fixed rules and plain-language explanations. Repo contains only the Meta Model API client, not trading engine.

nehabhagat999/easylaunch.summary: Voice-first app turning shop photos into WhatsApp ads
nehabhagat999/easylaunch.readme_summary: EasyLaunch lets Indian shopkeepers speak in Hindi or English, snap a photo, and launch Click-to-WhatsApp ads. AI agent built on Meta models plans, designs and explains the ad for Facebook and Instagram. Built solo during hackathon Oct 27-Nov 4 2026.

MoHDI/strongo.summary: Community-owned food delivery and neighborhood help network
MoHDI/strongo.readme_summary: Strongo replaces 30% commission platforms with community-run ordering, AI dispatcher, open books and need board. Middleware-based Next.js app with Docker Compose, docs and eval suite. Uses Meta AI models for plain-language ordering and dispatch.

StargazerX0/SpecPilot.summary: Autonomously discovers faster speculative-decoding draft strategies for LLMs
StargazerX0/SpecPilot.readme_summary: Research system for autonomous discovery and optimization of speculative decoding algorithms. Uses Python research codebase with overlays, scripts and analysis assets. Leverages Meta Muse models to propose and evaluate decoding strategies for inference speedup.

DevAni27/forkpoint.summary: Finds the first divergence frame when a physical assembly goes wrong
DevAni27/forkpoint.readme_summary: Debugger for physical tasks that aligns a user attempt with correct runs to find first meaningful divergence. Samples frames, detects objects with SAM 3 on Kaggle T4 GPU via transformers, reasons with Muse Glimmer 30B. Outputs frames, objects, and explanation.

Metropolia-ai/safety-mode.summary: Turns plain-language safety rules into live camera compliance checks
Metropolia-ai/safety-mode.readme_summary: Camera-based workplace safety monitor. Muse Spark compiles natural-language rules to strict JSON with objects, zone, and hold time. SAM 3.1 segments and tracks objects per frame for alerts. Stack includes Python safety_mode, API, web demo, and Jetson bench.

nnm2602/whiteout.summary: Balloons engineering drawings and auto-fills AS9102 inspection forms
nnm2602/whiteout.readme_summary: Automates aerospace AS9102 first article inspection by ballooning dimensions, tolerances, and notes on drawings and filling Form 3. Built with Meta Muse models, live Cloud Run app with sample drawings. Includes FastAPI backend, eval harness, and Docker deploy.

davidklett/lawnlens.summary: AR overlay showing sprinkler coverage and lawn stress zones
davidklett/lawnlens.readme_summary: Mobile AR app for yard sprinkler management and grass health monitoring. Captures yard view, segments lawn vs non-lawn, flags dry zones, and recommends watering actions. Designed for Meta models only at runtime for home and commercial yards.

Midknight56/playtest-agent.summary: Plays web games from screenshots and verifies bug reports by replay
Midknight56/playtest-agent.readme_summary: Automated playtesting agent that plays web games via screenshot-to-action function tools. Records expectations, replays reports twice on fresh copies, and judges with evidence-quoting model. Outputs HTML report page with filmstrips, verdicts, and cost.

dien2810/rad_mot.summary: Learns when to call SAM 3 to fix ID switches in dense tracking
dien2810/rad_mot.readme_summary: Risk-aware dispatch for multi-object tracking in dense motorbike traffic. Lightweight ByteTrack runs every frame, learned risk predictor triggers SAM 3 Selective Mask Propagation only at risky moments. Includes MOT utils, TrackEval, and CLEAR-MOT metrics.

johnarndt/portravo-glasses.summary: Turns hands-free Ray-Ban site walks into priced customer quotes
johnarndt/portravo-glasses.readme_summary: iPhone app plus reference server for Meta Ray-Ban Display contractor walks. Captures photos, transcribes speech, names rooms, and builds scoped quotes. Pipeline runs entirely on Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark, and SAM 3.1.

xk44/adrift.summary: Self-hosted ComfyUI studio to prompt, edit, animate, and score media
xk44/adrift.readme_summary: Open-source creative studio on self-hosted ComfyUI with 135 tools and 82 app templates. Each tool is an editable ComfyUI workflow for image, video, voice, and music on local GPU. MIT licensed, runs on 24GB GPU or Apple Silicon.

sittinonwo54-hue/CHAMP_SUPER_ANTELLIGENT.summary: Deterministic BOQ, soil, and site engine with AI explanation layer
sittinonwo54-hue/CHAMP_SUPER_ANTELLIGENT.readme_summary: Construction estimation app with six deterministic engines for BOQ, soil, and site results validated from Google Drive evidence. Python app.py serves verified results with audit logging. Meta or Gemini models used only as explanation layer, not calculation.

secure25/metshield.summary: Cross-app scam explanation layer that adds cited context under existing Meta warnings
secure25/metshield.readme_summary: Proposed safety layer for Facebook, Messenger and WhatsApp that correlates scam signals across products into one cited warning card. Frontend demo in Vite/TS renders under native alerts without reading chats or storing PII, using Meta AI models on correlation graphs and synthetic data.

Sahaj0312/remy.summary: Wi-Fi camera fall detector that checks in by voice and alerts family on WhatsApp
Sahaj0312/remy.readme_summary: Remy watches a room with a cheap Wi-Fi camera, confirms falls, asks Are you okay via speaker and reports replies on WhatsApp. Python pipeline with local pose model plus deterministic rules gating Meta calls. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe for notes and replies.

edmvidanes/zerosum-arena.summary: Dragon Ball-style live quiz battle game where answers charge attacks and damage rivals
edmvidanes/zerosum-arena.readme_summary: Multiplayer quiz game where hosts share a 6-letter code and players battle to 3 HP, plus Solo Arcade vs bots. Includes Meta Muse Spark AI Pack Forge that turns lesson notes into playable packs. Stack is Next.js/Docker with live web deployment for phones.

riteshyaaa/second-voice.summary: Assistive voice app that clarifies dysarthric speech after user confirms text
riteshyaaa/second-voice.readme_summary: Assistive communication platform for dysarthria that transcribes speech and proposes clearer sentences in Hindi/English/Hinglish. Stack spans backend, frontend, inference and Docker with workspace at /communicate. Uses Meta Muse Voice Transcribe as primary with opt-in local Whisper for comparison.

jaimebeng/market-arena.summary: Artificial stock exchange where Muse AI traders test rules against Nash/Pareto benchmarks
jaimebeng/market-arena.readme_summary: Simulation wind tunnel where Muse-based makers and takers quote, write code strategies, and must pass out-of-sample tests before trading. Includes Rule Lab for natural-language rule changes and browser replay dashboard. Built solo in Python for market research.

DavidZapataOh/mandate.summary: Issues cryptographic certificates to verify agent actions touching money
DavidZapataOh/mandate.readme_summary: Provides cryptographic authorization between AI agents and banks with per-payment certificates. Includes demo bank, console UI and bench suite to prove forged approvals are denied.

Siddharthprabhakar/Handover.summary: Turns lab check-ins and interviews into living research project memory
Siddharthprabhakar/Handover.readme_summary: Next.js + Supabase app that ingests weekly check-ins, interview recordings and plans to preserve knowledge across student turnover. Built solo for Build for Your World Indie track with Vercel demo and judge login.

Effzumdeh/ModelMuse.summary: Single-file browser app to view, create and revise 3D and 2D educational models offline
Effzumdeh/ModelMuse.readme_summary: Static single-page app shipped as one 430KB HTML file with no backend, using Three.js, Vue 3 and Tailwind via CDN. Runs generation and revision in-browser, likely calling Meta AI/Muse models for model creation for classroom 3D/2D visualization.

jeofomaja/Bizscore.summary: Dual-sided trust layer scoring human reviews and AI agent reliability for commerce APIs
jeofomaja/Bizscore.readme_summary: Reputation protocol for human + agent commerce combining verified reviews, 1-click scores, and machine telemetry like latency and schema drift. Next.js platform with AI sentiment analysis provides machine-readable consensus to prevent bots buying from fraudulent APIs.

ejay-detera/talaan.summary: Turns photos of sari-sari store credit notebooks into verified digital ledgers locally
ejay-detera/talaan.readme_summary: Notebook-to-ledger agent that keeps handwritten utang habit: photo -> sharp preprocessing -> local Muse Glimmer 30B Vision extract -> Zod validation with centavo math -> human review with gutter UI -> atomic Supabase commit. Stack is Next.js + Supabase.

Rasika-Deodhar/sketchbridge.summary: Turns hard questions into visual analogies with self-checked drawings
Rasika-Deodhar/sketchbridge.readme_summary: Lets users ask a concept, pick a familiar world, and get 3 analogies with generated explanation and image. Built with Python backend and web frontend. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark for analogies and image checking.

NIMICODER/tendaa-shop.summary: WhatsApp sales agent that takes orders, quotes delivery, and checks receipts.
NIMICODER/tendaa-shop.readme_summary: WhatsApp agent for Lagos sellers handling text, voice notes, and photos for ordering and receipt verification. Built with C#/.NET, Microsoft Agent Framework, REST API plus SignalR React dashboard. Uses Meta Muse models for conversation and vision.

isiomaC/warden-phoenix.summary: Guardrail that blocks unsafe actions but offers provably in-policy alternatives.
isiomaC/warden-phoenix.readme_summary: Policy enforcement layer that keeps hard boundaries while letting blocked agents finish tasks via alternatives. TypeScript monorepo with apps and packages, verifiable decision ledger, demos and evals. Built for agent ops on real infrastructure.

kevinalanrichards113-tech/classprep-auto.summary: Turns one class session into slides, reference card, podcast, and question bank.
kevinalanrichards113-tech/classprep-auto.readme_summary: Eight-stage multi-agent pipeline producing deck, one-pager, podcast, and question bank with verifier and instructor review gate. Python Flask app with Canvas and Kahoot exporters. Uses Meta models for generation and verification.

dranoid/streamatic-meta.summary: Turns existing cameras into plain-English rules and alerts with guided setup
dranoid/streamatic-meta.readme_summary: Hackathon layer calling Streamatic API for camera setup, SAM 3.1 outline rules and verification guide. Stack is service plus web demo with Telegram and chat built during event.

Qrytics/metaBridge.summary: Shares one keyboard, mouse, and live windows across macOS and Windows.
Qrytics/metaBridge.readme_summary: Cross-OS KVM fabric with bezel cursor handoff, drag-and-drop files, and 60fps live window streaming to phone. Node bridge plus backend, agent, and frontend workspaces. Uses Meta models for multimodal input handling.

agkomyint/argus.summary: Fuses cameras, files, and sensors into charts, alerts, and data products.
agkomyint/argus.readme_summary: Multimodal intelligence engine where everything becomes an Observation for fusion and reasoning. Bun/TypeScript stack with Drizzle, docs, and components. Powered by Meta AI models for vision and analysis.

d02ev/arxplain.summary: Explains research papers at your level with adaptive depth and quizzes.
d02ev/arxplain.readme_summary: CLI agentic system that ingests a paper, extracts concepts, compares required knowledge to user profile, and writes adaptive HTML explanation. Planner builds learning path with adaptive quiz. Uses Meta models for analysis.

irchriscott/reincore.summary: Session-aware gateway that predicts cost, caches tools, and resumes agents.
irchriscott/reincore.readme_summary: Sits between agent frameworks and LLM/MCP servers to optimize whole sessions, not single calls. Rust gateway with daemon, engine-core, and MCP gateway for budgets, loop redirect, and resumable state. Model-agnostic infra.

nodarik/GoldenFrameAI.summary: Compares new site photos against a baseline photo to flag differences
nodarik/GoldenFrameAI.readme_summary: TrueScene stores one reference photo per place then compares new photos or video frames to generate reviewable findings. Node 22 + TypeScript server and web client deployed on Fly.io. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for analysis.

masonleetompkins/creagent.summary: Local-first agent that learns your voice and drafts a two-week content queue
masonleetompkins/creagent.readme_summary: Local-first agentic content creation app with ingest, voice learning, and approval queue. Next.js + SQLite with embedded job queue, runs fully on-device. Uses Meta Model API for all LLM intelligence with locally encrypted keys.

Cmon3/LabVision.summary: Counts lab colonies from plate photos with auditable Python measurements
Cmon3/LabVision.readme_summary: LabVision Copilot counts colonies and cells from plate photo plus phrase using SAM 3.1. All measurements in Python, never from model. Solo hackathon build with agent streaming and audit visuals.

benweru/BedSense.summary: Photograph a crop to get practical growing advice in English and Kiswahili
benweru/BedSense.readme_summary: Photo-based crop advisor for farmers and extension officers; identifies plants and gives care advice with optional notes. Built with Next.js and English/Kiswahili UI. Uses Meta SAM for vision and Muse for diagnosis and advice.

Stonebanks-js/ShelfVoice-AI.summary: Voice-first grocery app that lets users shop local kirana stores by speaking
Stonebanks-js/ShelfVoice-AI.readme_summary: Voice commerce app for Indian kirana shopping with Next.js 16 frontend and Supabase Postgres + RLS backend. Supports multilingual voice input and conversational ordering flow. Uses Meta Muse models for speech understanding and product matching.

mhafeezajh/precept-ledger-meta.summary: Policy gate and tamper-evident ledger for finance agent actions
mhafeezajh/precept-ledger-meta.readme_summary: Gate checks every agent action against Cedar rules before tool execution and records to tamper-evident ledger. Modular Python/Docker architecture with docs per module. Targets regulated finance auditability on Meta hackathon stack.

istiaqfuad/legalbuddy-cv.summary: Grounded Bangladesh law assistant answering with act citations and sources
istiaqfuad/legalbuddy-cv.readme_summary: Legal research copilot for Bangladeshi law in Bangla and English. Answers with act, section text and source links, reads user documents. Tracks compliance deadlines and connects to verified lawyers.

Hankx-Studio/wish-weaver.summary: Cozy 3D meadow adventure with word-spells and star-apple quests
Hankx-Studio/wish-weaver.readme_summary: Third-person Godot 3D mini-adventure where players gather, cast typed spells, and wake Tree of Life. Web demo on Vercel plus macOS build. Uses /api/spell classifier on Meta models for free-text spell routing.

Bek1308/Sado.summary: Voice-first AI companion that speaks and acts in Tajik, Uzbek, and Russian.
Bek1308/Sado.readme_summary: Mobile plus server voice assistant that hears, remembers, and completes tasks in under-served languages. Adds custom speech pipeline around Muse models. Uses Muse models for dialogue with Voice Transcribe extensions for Tajik/Uzbek/Russian.

kx44/ghostguide.summary: Turns videos and docs into live on-screen step guidance in real apps
kx44/ghostguide.readme_summary: Compiles YouTube tutorials and articles into checkable steps, overlays next control and detects completion. Windows-only, tested on VS Code, SOLIDWORKS, Blender. Uses Meta models only when plain code cannot ground UI.

pawankarakala2022/squadroot-schedule-age.summary: Sports club scheduler from text, voice, or league schedule photos
pawankarakala2022/squadroot-schedule-age.readme_summary: Club ops agent drafts conflict-free schedules, proves checks, explains results, and drafts multilingual family notices for human approval. Python/FastAPI + Docker with evals. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta API with live eval proof.

svenniev/OpenStreetLightMapper.summary: Builds public lighting inventories from street-level photos with AI
svenniev/OpenStreetLightMapper.readme_summary: AI-assisted inventory of pole spacing, heights and layouts from street imagery for lighting audits. Monorepo with apps, packages and database infra, prototyped with Meta Muse coding agent.

harryson22102004/chronospace.summary: Turns a photo into explorable 3D with truth labels for real vs made
harryson22102004/chronospace.readme_summary: Uploads photo, estimates depth with Depth Anything V2, segments regions, renders clamped 3D with provenance. Next.js + local engine. Optionally calls SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe with live badge.

KLN-9999999/motion-ledger.summary: Audits factory video against work instructions with evidence links
KLN-9999999/motion-ledger.readme_summary: Compares manufacturing procedures to process video, producing typed discrepancies for human review. FastAPI + SQLite with versioned schema and append-only ledger. Models perceive, deterministic code decides verdicts including UNVERIFIABLE.

venkatsai2730/Community-Beacon.summary: Matches WhatsApp help requests to volunteers with AI brokering
venkatsai2730/Community-Beacon.readme_summary: Ingests WhatsApp messages via Meta Cloud API, dedupes and redacts PII, parses screenshots and PDFs. Llama tool-calling agent with budgets proposes matches; policy code and humans approve. Full trace logged.

noccommander/amuseworthy.summary: Scores startup ideas and builds coaching, research and landing pages
noccommander/amuseworthy.readme_summary: Static web app that scores ideas consistently, then generates coaching, live-web competition research, and published landing pages. Built on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 for tool calls, web search and reasoning.

kaushikm2706-tech/saatchi.summary: Verifies spoken work claims against video with dual evidence channels
kaushikm2706-tech/saatchi.readme_summary: Transcribes Tamil/English narration to claims, then checks via video reasoning and SAM 3.1 tracks to output SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/UNVERIFIABLE. Python CLI with mocks and 18 tests. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark 1.3.

BlockchainBear/MuseHackathon.summary: Turns a game idea into an editable world bible, map, art and quest kit
BlockchainBear/MuseHackathon.readme_summary: WorldForge Lite is a Next.js planning tool that generates world lore, 5 locations, NPCs, quests and concept art with interactive SVG map. Uses Meta AI for generation, chat/voice brainstorming, and location remix with full editing.

IrrhammCode/signalcut.summary: Turns product photos and a prompt into a captioned vertical video ad
IrrhammCode/signalcut.readme_summary: Next.js + Remotion pipeline that writes scripts from photos, voices them, scores music, and renders 720x1280 MP4. Built on Meta SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for script and direction.

flor-soriano/nelli.summary: Checks suspicious texts, screenshots and audio for fraud in Spanish
flor-soriano/nelli.readme_summary: Single-task verification agent for Mexico/LatAm that returns a 4-level label, 5-point evidence, action step and official source. Rules decide, AI explains. Built with Muse Spark 1.3; Python backend with eval and MX case packs.

lkim753951/Stockpot.summary: Daily checker for small restaurants that flags price, delivery and invoice issues
lkim753951/Stockpot.readme_summary: Stockpot helps independent restaurants track price changes, short deliveries and invoice mismatches with a daily attention list. Web app with Node API, server and shared frontend code deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse models to check documents and explain numbers behind alerts.

shubham91150/agentic-game-studio.summary: Prompt-to-playable 3D gothic horror games and PBR assets in browser
shubham91150/agentic-game-studio.readme_summary: Autonomous studio that turns one prompt or voice input into playable 3D worlds and procedural assets. Browser studio on serverless GPUs with sandbox; uses Meta Muse models and SAM 3.1 for generation and scene understanding.

nextlevelcommunity/buildersbot.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for running persistent multi-agent coding teammates
nextlevelcommunity/buildersbot.readme_summary: Desktop app giving each AI agent its own workspace, conversation, queues and file transfer. Integrates Codex App Server, Claude Code, Cursor CLI and others via ACP with embedded browser and agent messaging.

DeepakKTS/talking-tactile.summary: Tactile STEM diagrams that speak part names via phone camera.
DeepakKTS/talking-tactile.readme_summary: Turns printed STEM figures into raised sheets explored by touch with phone camera narration. Stack for teacher transcription and browser demo. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for answers, SAM 3.1 for part grounding, Muse Voice.

aashikvilla/harmonise.summary: Private AI reflection space with moderated peer support communities
aashikvilla/harmonise.readme_summary: Provides private conversations, reflection tools and story discovery plus Supabase-backed communities with moderation. Uses Meta AI via server-side routes for guidance, with Next.js frontend and human review flows.

ajnasa2285/hisaab-bridge.summary: WhatsApp agents for contractors and suppliers that agree on signed bills
ajnasa2285/hisaab-bridge.readme_summary: Each business gets a WhatsApp ledger agent that records bookings, deliveries and payments. Uses Muse models to read/explain documents with deterministic code checks, A2A sync and dual-signed records.

vihuynh72/zeno.summary: Turns goals into small timed steps with streaks to help you start.
vihuynh72/zeno.readme_summary: Takes a typed or spoken goal and uses Muse Spark to clarify, search, and plan backward from due date. Runs focus timer with Start/Done, Skip and Adjust in Next.js app. Deployed on Vercel with web search integration.

Woosiq92/stepcards.summary: Turns one demo video into checked picture step cards with live camera coaching
Woosiq92/stepcards.readme_summary: Films a task once to generate picture step cards with done-checks, then guides learners via camera. Built for Ray-Ban Meta glasses and Display with web app, using first-person video and vision checks for step verification.

HCHAPS404/SOVIR.summary: Local-first on-device shield that flags scams and impersonation.
HCHAPS404/SOVIR.readme_summary: Local-first anti-scam system with consented sensors, voter council, and explainable revocable decisions. Rust backend plus web apps; raw text and pixels stay on device. Uses Meta models for local risk reasoning.

IAMGODIAM/chancellor.summary: Governance harness for long-running agents with judge grading and receipts
IAMGODIAM/chancellor.readme_summary: Provides durable task graphs, independent judge-model grading, and human gates on spend and publishing. Emits hash-chained receipts per decision with measured drift and calibration evidence on Meta Model API.

kitavkdl/reefcensus.summary: Counts animals in underwater video with evidence frames for every number.
kitavkdl/reefcensus.readme_summary: Takes natural-language targets to compute MaxN and first arrival from survey video. Combines Muse Spark detection with SAM 3.1 tracking plus human review queue. Demo site hosts finished runs with evidence frames.

ashirandev/local-clip-studio.summary: Local desktop studio that cuts long recordings into captioned clips offline
ashirandev/local-clip-studio.readme_summary: Local Clip Studio edits recordings into short clips on one PC. Stack is Python, FFmpeg with libass, onnxruntime hearing model and llama.cpp. Uses local models via API for transcription and editing, no cloud GPU needed.

pe-hq-alpha/plusone-app.summary: Event planning app that normalizes vendor quotes for easy comparison
pe-hq-alpha/plusone-app.readme_summary: PlusOne Events centralizes event planning and puts vendor quotes on the same lines with missing-charge flags. Compares local price ranges and briefs vendors. Built with Meta Muse Spark at its core.

i4642i/shoestring-studios-meta-hackathon.summary: Agent team that turns textbook chapters into narrated explainer videos
i4642i/shoestring-studios-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Shoestring Studios converts dense source material into narrated explainer video with claim-to-source report. Uses LightRAG knowledge backend, Node slide rendering, Kokoro voice and ffmpeg. Uses LLM key for agents and narration planning.

ImageekCompany/nubi-mixed-reality-ai-com.summary: Quest 3 companion that walks your room, sees objects and talks you through
ImageekCompany/nubi-mixed-reality-ai-com.readme_summary: Nubi is an open-source mixed-reality companion for Quest 3 built with Unity 6.6 and OpenXR. It navigates room space, outlines held objects and converses. Uses Muse Spark for dialogue, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Voice and Wit.ai.

qzyu999/inference-exchange.summary: Decentralized marketplace routing LLM inference by price, speed or privacy
qzyu999/inference-exchange.readme_summary: Inference Exchange lets providers sell idle compute and gives OpenAI-compatible inference. Has coordinator, matching engine, Docker deploy and web UI. Built on OCIP protocol with configurable privacy routing across providers.

khalidstark/comimo.summary: Voice-note diary that turns daily stories into comics with your own cast
khalidstark/comimo.readme_summary: Comimo turns voice or text in Arabic and English into comic diary panels with consistent characters. Stack is Next.js 16 and React. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Image 1.0 and SAM 3.1 for story and art.

ikabeee/owl-hours.summary: WhatsApp agent for plumbers that triages leaks and drafts job tickets.
ikabeee/owl-hours.readme_summary: Takes urgent WhatsApp requests, gives damage-control help and builds quote from owner rules. Human confirms every job with owner app review. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 to read leak video frames.

jwiegley/agent-mail.summary: Shared file mailbox and MCP server for messaging between agent sessions
jwiegley/agent-mail.readme_summary: Agent-mail provides a shared ~/Mailbox directory synced via Syncthing with MCP server for agent-to-agent messages by topic. Python utility installed via nix across hosts. No direct Meta model use; infrastructure for multi-agent harnesses.

tobi-techy/MIMI-AGENT.summary: WhatsApp agents that receipt FMCG deliveries and track shop payments
tobi-techy/MIMI-AGENT.readme_summary: Mimi serves Nigerian FMCG distributors with WhatsApp receipts, multilingual confirmation and dispute flags. Reads payment screenshots and promise-to-pay with code verification. Stack is Docker, Postgres with Alembic, bridges to WhatsApp.

Pettybytes/fridgegraph.summary: Shared permissioned graph letting a child's care village coordinate plans
Pettybytes/fridgegraph.readme_summary: Connects family caregivers in one permissioned graph with Rosina proposal assistant. Node app with schema docs and provenance tracking. Uses Muse models for turning plan changes into parent-approved proposals.

PrathameshTawar/meta-hackthon-top-2000-a.summary: Family agent turns parents voice notes and bill photos into shared task board
PrathameshTawar/meta-hackthon-top-2000-a.readme_summary: Saath converts voice notes and document photos into a verified shared family task board. Stack is backend + frontend + Telegram bot + WhatsApp Cloud API with Docker. Uses Meta AI models to transcribe, extract tasks, and verify bills for coordinated care.

vinodvv2023/reel2AIcart.summary: Tags Reels with shoppable products and MCP tools for AI shopping agents
vinodvv2023/reel2AIcart.readme_summary: Shopify app that analyzes Reels and Shorts once into timeline-tagged products with cached serving. Stack is Remix on Vercel, Modal GPU, Neon Postgres pgvector, MCP server, built with Muse Spark Open.

ekatraone/ekatra-offline-hackathon.summary: Offline-first AI tutor with WhatsApp lessons and on-device Llama explanations
ekatraone/ekatra-offline-hackathon.readme_summary: Ekatra Offline provides WhatsApp courses and an Android app that works without signal. Stack includes backend, hub, and Android with on-device models. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Image in cloud to author lessons, Llama 3.2 on-device for tutoring.

tmoody1973/minutes.summary: Tracks Milwaukee City Hall meetings and explains decisions in minutes
tmoody1973/minutes.readme_summary: Civic tracker for Milwaukee Common Council, committees and commissions. Built with Next.js and Convex, it links agendas, votes, and video into followable files. Uses Meta AI Muse models to summarize meetings and surface hearing dates.

goodnasubi/kuma-agent.summary: Personal chat agent with editable persona, long-term memory and tool use
goodnasubi/kuma-agent.readme_summary: kuma-agent is a Japanese conversational agent with SOUL persona files, MEMORY long-term memory, threads and task nudges. Stack is Python + Docker with Web UI. Uses Muse as reasoning brain for dialogue, summarization, memory extraction and tool calls.

miracles2motion/Museware.summary: Visual studio where AI plans apps then writes them into editable component tree
miracles2motion/Museware.readme_summary: Museware lets users describe an app, approve a blueprint, then generates executable React components with verify gates. Stack is React + Vite frontend with Node API server. Uses Muse API for planning and codegen with local offline fallback engine.

avriyyy/musevibe.summary: Turns app ideas into workspaces with docs, task board and page previews
avriyyy/musevibe.readme_summary: MuseVibe converts a short idea via setup wizard into planning docs, tasks and generated HTML previews. Stack is Next.js with Neon database and owner-scoped sync. Uses Meta AI models for planning and design generation with local demo fallbacks.

knivesthao/3E.summary: Generates leveled webcomics from one scene idea for A1-B2 English learners
knivesthao/3E.readme_summary: 3E Studio writes level-checked stories, draws consistent-cast art, and publishes reader with TTS, tap dictionary and flashcards. Stack is Capacitor mobile + API + Baseten. Uses Meta AI for writing, level-checking, art and speech scoring.

ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric.summary: Shared infrastructure letting AI agents publish, verify, and reuse task results.
ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric.readme_summary: Provides Task Objects API for agents to share work and reuse learnings, with search, benchmarks and evals. Docker-compose services with docs and llms.txt integration. Uses Meta models with measured retrieval gains.

nekxxy/competition-ops-agent.summary: Review-first desk tracking rule changes with quotes, diffs and checklists
nekxxy/competition-ops-agent.readme_summary: Local evidence desk with immutable snapshots, exact-quote claims, rule diffs and readiness checklists. Stack is Python stdlib only with local server and fixtures. Uses one recorded MuseSpark 1.3 pilot output for synthetic review without live calls.

georgiosaliba227/Hydra-Ai.summary: Hydration tracker that predicts water needs from activity, weather, and habits.
georgiosaliba227/Hydra-Ai.readme_summary: iPhone wellness prototype with on-device DINOv2 Small beverage classifier and Apple Vision OCR for logging. User-confirmed goals and manual review; optional backend for forecasting. Built for Startup track hackathon.

naman-sharma12345/kimoapp.summary: Prompt-driven Windows video editor that plans edits and renders locally with timeline
naman-sharma12345/kimoapp.readme_summary: Windows AI video editor that turns prompts into an editable timeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 to plan and critique edits from transcript and footage, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, plus local Whisper and FFmpeg for transcription and rendering.

leonard1thecoder/king-sparkon-eye.summary: Verifies event attendees by face to approve entry without QR scans.
leonard1thecoder/king-sparkon-eye.readme_summary: Matches live face checks against enrolled attendees and shows ticket info for staff approval. Defers validity to existing Spring Boot backend with Rust service, PostgreSQL, and SQLx. Includes OAuth routes, OpenAPI, and migrations.

beerush-id/wedyan.summary: Browser desktop OS where you and a voice agent share the same apps
beerush-id/wedyan.readme_summary: Agentic browser OS where user and agent operate shared apps via structured state, not screenshots. Voice or text input produces timed text, speech, widgets and actions. Built with AirLib, AUI, and Meta Muse Spark 1.3 models.

rblalock/groundwork.summary: Agents that handle texts, quotes and scheduling for landscaping crews
rblalock/groundwork.readme_summary: Next.js field-service app with two agents that turn crew texts into office work like quotes and scheduling. Runs Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1 with tools, calculator and Postgres. Fake switches stub iMessage, email and Stripe locally.

superkoh/koloft.summary: Free Mac app to run and manage Claude Code and Codex sessions side by side
superkoh/koloft.readme_summary: Electron macOS manager for claude and codex CLI sessions, each in a folder with changed files, browser and shell. Organizes sessions in one window with follow-along views. No Meta Muse models; built for Claude Code and Codex workflows.

SharminSirajudeen/haptura.summary: Phone and desktop gate that blocks agents until they prove UI control.
SharminSirajudeen/haptura.readme_summary: Haptura is an owner gate for phone and desktop agents that requires proof of UI control via experiments before acting. Implementation is in phone/windows.py and rules.py with a measured arena and 72 scored runs. It uses Muse Spark and Muse Wonder behind the gate and evaluates SAM vs color tracker.

PandaGrdn/athlete2humanoid.summary: Turns phone video of a person into a Unitree G1 humanoid skill
PandaGrdn/athlete2humanoid.readme_summary: Pipeline converts phone video to 3D motion via SAM 3.1 and SAM 3D Body, retargets to G1 skeleton, labels phases with Muse Spark. Trains PPO policy in mjlab with V-JEPA 2 input and judging. Web demo visualizes stages in 3D.

joonselim/graspgrade.summary: Scores first-person hand clips for how well robots can copy the grasp
joonselim/graspgrade.readme_summary: Cuts egocentric video at touch moment and scores 0-100 for robot copyability. SAM 3.1 tracks hands/objects, Muse Spark grades checklist, logistic regression outputs score. Validated on 1426 clips with tactile and mocap ground truth.

jhuang-tw/mechanica.summary: Interactive 3D classroom where Muse teaches machine repair on phone or Quest
jhuang-tw/mechanica.readme_summary: Web and WebXR classroom to repair, X-ray and disassemble 8 machines in 3D. Muse Spark acts as teacher moving real model parts while answering why. Stack uses SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Three.js and Meta Quest support.

halim-eng1/persona-b2b-meta-hackathon.summary: Autonomous bilingual auto-reply for businesses handling text, voice notes, images
halim-eng1/persona-b2b-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Persona B2B is an Android Kotlin Jetpack Compose app for smart business auto-replies. It is multimodal bilingual Arabic/English and runs 100% on Meta Model API with 640+ unit tests.

David2024patton/itak-torch-rebuild.summary: Rust inference core plus Go serving stack to run large models on small GPUs
David2024patton/itak-torch-rebuild.readme_summary: Rust inference engine with Go serving platform optimized for small hardware like RX 7900 XTX. Benchmarks Muse Glimmer 30B and documents ROCm diagnosis driving design. Focus on model serving, performance tuning, and local infra.

iamarunbrahma/see-the-shake.summary: Phone slow-motion video that measures machine vibration and diagnoses faults
iamarunbrahma/see-the-shake.readme_summary: Python app that analyzes slow-motion phone video to segment parts and measure vibration per part. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for tracking and Muse Spark 1.3 for fault diagnosis with magnified visualization. Ships with Hugging Face demo and test samples.

openwork-africa/ai2.summary: Local security rating and vault that scores coding agent runs for risk
openwork-africa/ai2.readme_summary: Rust CLI + local dashboard that rates coding agent runs with Security Rating and Run Risk Factor. Provides on-machine vault for apps, agent work and keys with Touch ID / polkit auth. Built as privacy-preserving agent security gateway.

jimclydegm/ReScene.summary: Turns product photos into editable 3D shoppable rooms with AI stylist
jimclydegm/ReScene.readme_summary: Next.js commerce app converting product photos into interactive 3D showrooms. Shoppers inspect products, try finishes, and query a budget-aware stylist grounded in catalog. Uses Meta models for vision, 3D generation and styling.

UrsushoribilisMusic/ambient-field-lens.summary: Wearable field assistant that answers only from your manuals and refuses otherwise
UrsushoribilisMusic/ambient-field-lens.readme_summary: Ambient Field Lens captures technician questions and grounds answers in operator manuals with distance gating. Refusals become draft passages requiring human approval to improve docs. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B grounding checks with iOS, web and backend services.

xkazm04/athena-muse.summary: Local assistant that automates browser tasks and drafts replies in your voice.
xkazm04/athena-muse.readme_summary: Runs on Meta Muse on user computers to learn browser tasks, run projects across devices and Twin messaging. Node.js apps architecture with approval and cost controls for sensitive actions.

eka1357/caliper.summary: Measures size and speed in video with 90% intervals or explicit refusal
eka1357/caliper.readme_summary: Video measurement tool turning plain questions into measurement plans via Muse Spark. SAM 3.1 tracks objects and Python computes size/speed with 90% intervals. Validated on tape-measured clips and GPS scooter passes.

cryptoragency/missionzero.summary: Goal-driven research agent with verifier, contradictor and evidence folder
cryptoragency/missionzero.readme_summary: Autonomous research agent forming hypotheses, reading full PDFs, self-evaluating and citing only read sources. Verifier, contradictor and judge pipeline scores answers with quotes. Includes repair mode generating tested website patches.

scholtzap/gift-registry.summary: WhatsApp-native group gift registry with secret claims and pooled gifts
scholtzap/gift-registry.readme_summary: Gift Circles app where owner shares link and friends coordinate claims and pooled contributions. Owner sees wishlist only, no money held. Verified with 393 Vitest tests and Chromium flows, built for hackathon.

ehill-amera/listing-partner.summary: Merges bracketed property photos into HDR listings with descriptions for approval.
ehill-amera/listing-partner.readme_summary: Takes folders of bracketed RAW photos per room, merges to HDR, straightens and color-balances, then ranks, labels, and declutters. Python CLI plus approval web page pulls unit facts from AppFolio and uses Muse models to write listing copy and captions.

jamal005csit/Rosetta.summary: Records legacy desktop apps to generate React replacements with parity evidence.
jamal005csit/Rosetta.readme_summary: Captures screen recording with FFmpeg and faster-whisper, builds an AppSpec, then generates a React app. Uses Muse-compatible chat API for observation and repair, verifies with Playwright replay and weighted parity report.

dynatechdesigns-coder/Pocketoga.summary: Voice-first bookkeeping in English and Pidgin for Nigerian market traders.
dynatechdesigns-coder/Pocketoga.readme_summary: Voice assistant records sales, payments and debts only after spoken confirmation. Per-shop hash-chained ledger prevents silent edits. Uses speech-to-text for money talk like 15k with Node backend and mobile client.

BeomSeogKim/rehere.summary: Rebuilds lost places in 3D from old photos and spoken memories
BeomSeogKim/rehere.readme_summary: Turns old photographs into partial 3D scenes where unseen areas stay empty. Owner-approved single memory proposal creates versioned scenes with photo vs memory vs guess labeling. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse models for evidence checks.

mehmetyz/mixray.summary: Isolates an instrument from audio or video and teaches it on keyboard.
mehmetyz/mixray.readme_summary: Web app plus engine lets users type or draw over video to select a sound, isolate stems, transcribe notes and practice with coaching. Built with Muse Spark Open for separation, vision grounding and performance scoring.

BrockDawg/faultline.summary: Judges video against a rules pack and rules if each rule was followed or broken.
BrockDawg/faultline.readme_summary: Takes rules pack plus footage and outputs per-rule ruling with offender and evidence for forklifts under OSHA and sim-racing leagues. Scripts measure and decide while models perceive and describe. Python 3.12 system with 8 packs and 37 experiments.

ColinGPT9/clips-kitty-gameday.summary: Cuts basketball games to vertical clips with phone approval to post
ColinGPT9/clips-kitty-gameday.readme_summary: Picks highlights and tracks ball to cut vertical clips with ffmpeg for Instagram/Facebook, posting only after phone approval. Python service with meta-relay and tests. Uses Muse Voice, Muse Spark and SAM 3.1.

alkaika/ai-social-commercial-studio.summary: Creates 10-60s social commercials from a website with your own API key.
alkaika/ai-social-commercial-studio.readme_summary: Next.js BYOK studio turns URL into script then Meta.ai prompts and stitched video in under 10 minutes. Key stays in browser, pay provider directly. Supports Standard and Contributor modes for platforms and vibes.

amehta2025/TrajectoryGPT.summary: Turns molecular dynamics questions into executable, verifiable analyses.
amehta2025/TrajectoryGPT.readme_summary: Research copilot studies E. coli AdK trajectories, plans analyses and runs MDAnalysis NumPy SciPy code for inspection. Uses Muse Spark for planning and Muse Wonder verifier to check reports and figures.

Vizdumb2005/L.O.K.I.summary: Offline-first mentalism performance engine with plugin magic effects and state machine
Vizdumb2005/L.O.K.I.readme_summary: Consent-based performance engine for digital mentalism with domain-neutral inference and visible state machine. Offline-first platform with plugin effects including The Twelve, Ember Words, and Countdown. Web app with WebGL 3D stage and flat-stage fallback, no cloud AI dependency.

uchuuronin/preflight.summary: Simulates ML training and agent jobs to forecast cost and behavior before spending GPU
uchuuronin/preflight.readme_summary: Preflight profiles a few minutes of a real ML job and simulates full runs or campaigns. Stack is Python API plus web frontend with GPU probes and docs site. Uses Meta models to model job behavior and estimate cost.

vicentektek/showcompiler-hackathon-2026.summary: Browser rehearsal tool that links scripts to sound cues with operator-controlled GO
vicentektek/showcompiler-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: RUNQ is a browser-based rehearsal and sound-cue tool for theater. It connects scripts to cue suggestions, human review, and deterministic local audio. Uses Meta Muse Spark optionally for cue prep while operator retains control.

cslou/workprint.summary: Chat-first filmmaking workspace where assistant prepares work for creator review
cslou/workprint.readme_summary: Workprint provides React/React Aria frontend with review and export components. Backend is Mastra with Postgres and Supabase storage serving owned reads and uploads. Uses assistant chat to prepare filmmaking tasks for approval.

davidwilliam/proof_forge.summary: Verifies financial code against locked Lean 4 specs with counterexamples and proofs
davidwilliam/proof_forge.readme_summary: ProofForge states guarantees as Lean 4 requirements and checks fixes with six kernels. Muse Spark writes fixes via ProofForge MCP server with Muse Code harness. Every verdict is recorded in a reproducible Passport.

wxy26wxy/the-3rd-eye.summary: Helps disabled artists edit artwork and turn it into stickers, totes with NFC stories
wxy26wxy/the-3rd-eye.readme_summary: Artists frame drawings for SAM 3.1 segmentation, edit via voice or text with Muse Image 1.0, and hear descriptions via Muse Spark 1.3. Stack is web plus iOS with VoiceOver support. NFC tags link products to captioned artist videos.

Rish-it/stupid.summary: Small-business copilot for Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp replies, posts and ads.
Rish-it/stupid.readme_summary: Creator/business inbox unifying Messenger, Instagram DMs/comments and WhatsApp with live updates. Drafts replies, lead finder, Reel director and ad watcher with human approval. Uses Muse Spark Open and Muse Wonder plus Meta APIs.

goldisgold1/holebot.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates with agent messaging
goldisgold1/holebot.readme_summary: HoleBot is a HoleA.I fork of OpenBot providing workspaces, queues and embedded browser. Supports Codex, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode and others via ACP. Runs locally as a desktop app for agent-to-agent work.

0Pxyz/polydocks.summary: Agentic dock workspace where AI arranges and creates tool panels
0Pxyz/polydocks.readme_summary: PolyDocks is an operable workspace where agent Poly opens, arranges and generates tool panels via Ctrl+K. Dockerized web workspace with agent-home and architecture docs. Uses Meta AI agent models to create tools on demand.

peterradzisz/openbot-chief.summary: Local fork of OpenBot adding model failover and orchestration for agent teams
peterradzisz/openbot-chief.readme_summary: Personal noncommercial fork of OpenBot focused on model seats, failover rungs and workflow orchestration. Provides local queues and workspaces for agent teams. Independently maintained and not affiliated with upstream.

smalls257/ai-symbiont.summary: Learns from agent history to warn before repeat coding mistakes via MCP hooks.
smalls257/ai-symbiont.readme_summary: Mines coding-agent history for pain points and surfaces warnings via MCP/hooks. Stack uses Muse Spark 1.3 as coding agent and curator plus fine-tuned Llama 3.2 1B checker. Also demos ViZDoom Freedoom and Habitat robot control.

shuaib-mk/feather.summary: Private voice-first cycle companion that turns fuzzy recall into structured logs
shuaib-mk/feather.readme_summary: Voice-first menstrual companion that logs entries and estimates event overlaps on-device. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech input and Muse Spark tool-calling to resolve landmarks like holidays to dates.

EHIBE/DeskTop-Hanggang-Umaga.summary: Webcam tabletop tower defense turning desk objects into pixel heroes
EHIBE/DeskTop-Hanggang-Umaga.readme_summary: A Windows party game where a top-down webcam turns mugs and keys into 16-bit units battling Filipino folklore creatures for 8 turns. Uses four Meta models together for vision, sprites, and Taglish voice orders. Built solo with app, backend, evals and docs.

the-pushh/handy-man.summary: Point phone at broken appliance, describe issue by voice, get guided fix steps
the-pushh/handy-man.readme_summary: Handyman identifies appliances from phone photos, diagnoses faults and walks through safe fixes with camera checks. Frontend mobile web plus backend live inference. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for diagnosis, SAM 3.1 for part segmentation, Muse Image for overlays.

rifat-sarkar01/ProcessWatcher.summary: Checks recorded SOP procedures against video to flag missed or wrong steps
rifat-sarkar01/ProcessWatcher.readme_summary: ProcessWatcher aligns recorded physical work against written SOPs with timestamps and frame evidence. Deterministic DP aligner decides compliance over model perception. Uses SAM 3.1 for hand-tool tracking, Muse Wonder for scoring, Muse Image for diagrams.

Kaimaan/animundo-world.summary: Open content dataset of animals, places and translations for Animundo game
Kaimaan/animundo-world.readme_summary: This repo is Animundo game content, not the hackathon entry: data files for lands, animals, foods and locales. The separate Animundo Builder built with Muse Code reads this checkout and uses Meta models to research new species. First commit predates event.

coolvanish/Rudeus.summary: AR game where kids drawings become characters and tables become playable levels
coolvanish/Rudeus.readme_summary: Rudeus is an Android AR game in Kazakh and Russian for kids. It photographs drawings into characters and scans tables into obstacles and platforms via ARCore. Uses SAM for masking and Muse models for character generation in Kotlin Multiplatform.

1ewig/state-craft-meta-global-ai-hackath.summary: Visual React Flow studio for designing stateful AI agent workflows and logic
1ewig/state-craft-meta-global-ai-hackath.readme_summary: Provides a canvas-based StateCraft editor for modeling agent states and transitions. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, React Flow and Bun. Powered by Meta Muse Spark via Baseten inference for agent reasoning.

Naryadchikov/playtest-lens.summary: Analyzes playtest video and event logs into mapped friction report
Naryadchikov/playtest-lens.readme_summary: Playtest Lens feeds 2-minute video+audio windows to Muse Spark 1.2 with no frame sampling, then verifies moments against clips and Godot event logs. Outputs confusion and bug map with clips and quotes. 21-min test costs about $0.18.

jsamuelkamau-dot/lowisa-witness.summary: Turns failed exam questions into hands-on mastery plans, no answers given
jsamuelkamau-dot/lowisa-witness.readme_summary: Teacher photographs exams; Muse Spark marks and diagnoses handwriting, Muse Wonder pre-plays levels. Each unmastered question becomes a Mastery Plan level ending in a real task. Built in LoWisa with desk, host and phone apps.

jsamuelkamau-dot/lowisa-witness-private-.summary: Archive copy of exam-to-mastery tutor that builds thinking-first plans
jsamuelkamau-dot/lowisa-witness-private-.readme_summary: Private archive mirror of From Exam to Mastery: photographs exams, Muse Spark 1.3 marks and diagnoses, Muse Wonder validates levels. Learner does thinking, ending in real tasks. Same LoWisa structure with docs, evidence and scripts.

ta-amps/teleion-fabric-infrastructure-wo.summary: Durable task queue and versioned store for agent swarms with maker-checker
ta-amps/teleion-fabric-infrastructure-wo.readme_summary: Pull-based durable task queue and atomic Task Object store for agents over HTTP/MCP. Implements leased tasks with fencing tokens, versioned content-addressed storage, and maker-checker separation for auditability.

jaykay2000/semantic-auditor.summary: Turns user-journey discoveries into reusable release checks
jaykay2000/semantic-auditor.readme_summary: Python package semaudit converts validated UX findings into reusable checks with journey, rule, and evidence. Built during hackathon on Muse Spark and tested on an open-source store. Runs locally with Python 3.12, no key for demo.

jjresher/Meta-hackathon-bladesight.summary: Zero-shot drone inspection for wind turbine blades producing verified repair plans
jjresher/Meta-hackathon-bladesight.readme_summary: BladeSight turns drone photos of turbine blades into a prioritized repair plan. It uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark plus Muse Spark Open for verification and planning. Demo runs in replay mode without model calls.

didnteven/rotebot.summary: Turns demonstrated chores into reusable desktop tools
didnteven/rotebot.readme_summary: macOS desktop app that observes a chore and generates a reusable routine/tool. Stack is Rust + Tauri + React with contracts, crates, and evals. Powered by Meta Muse models for intent to tool generation.

ronniecutamora/hack.summary: Drafts typhoon damage assessments from photos and voice
ronniecutamora/hack.readme_summary: Ulat prototype for Binan, Philippines turns photos, video, and voice into draft damage assessments and insurance forms. Exposes Telegram bot and Modal dashboard for residents and disaster office. Uses Muse models for multimodal triage.

khattabi1/BacktestAI.summary: Builds and backtests trading strategies on market data with simulation.
khattabi1/BacktestAI.readme_summary: BacktestAI is a quantitative strategy engineering platform with backtesting, market simulation, and live trading support via MT5. Architecture is Python backend with Alembic, JS frontend in apps/packages, and benchmarks. It is powered by Meta Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder via Meta Model API and FastMCP.

gabrielantonyxaviour/dossierly-meta.summary: AI caseworker that organizes Polish immigration letters, deadlines, and calls.
gabrielantonyxaviour/dossierly-meta.readme_summary: Reads letters, emails, and screens into one case file with deadlines derived from law. Provides real-time interpretation and urgent phone alerts without filing or legal advice. Built on Meta Muse with Next.js mobile-first app.

lb2002/gatekeeper.summary: Npm malware detection that never runs package code
lb2002/gatekeeper.readme_summary: Open-source npm scanner with investigator agent, lockfile audit, and install guard for npm/npx. Muse agent analyzes files and diffs with code-verified claims. Served via Modal API with CLI and GitHub Action.

zachlatta/agent-factory.summary: Kanban board that plans, reviews, and ships coding agent work with gates
zachlatta/agent-factory.readme_summary: Go binary that watches Paseo agent files and orchestrates plan and code review workflow via Paseo API and CLI. Serves a Kanban board on 127.0.0.1:7478 with labels as state, deployed via Tailscale. Includes secret scanning with gitleaks for public repos.

samsonntruong/pam-pm.summary: Async AI project manager that replaces status meetings
samsonntruong/pam-pm.readme_summary: Pam checks in via Slack, challenges vague updates, syncs boards, and chases blockers. Needs Meta Model API key plus Slack and board backend like built-in Pam board or Azure DevOps. Ships with Docker Compose and console UI.

ygivenx/stevens.summary: Private chief-of-staff that links off-clock learning to work decisions with citations
ygivenx/stevens.readme_summary: Ingests Ray-Ban Meta captures, reading highlights and notes into a personal Postgres store separate from firm data. Connects learning to current work decisions with sourced drafts plus follow-up chat. Node.js app with three demo firm scenarios, human-decides workflow.

louji2308/kodiac.summary: Turns one robot demo into executable tests with PASS/FAIL and failure onset frame
louji2308/kodiac.readme_summary: Shows a task once, generates readable executable test via Meta models, grades attempts frame-by-frame. Returns PASS/FAIL/CAN'T TELL with physical cause and code blame. Built for Push the Frontier robotics testing.

MartinSWDev/inkling.summary: Card game that matches UK students to top 3 degree subjects and real courses
MartinSWDev/inkling.readme_summary: Four card rounds build a paper-craft room profile to recommend subjects, wildcard, UK courses and apprenticeships. Stack with web frontend, API, functions and DB. Uses Meta AI for matching and simulation.

Chozharajan2001/curtain.summary: Privacy gate that masks image PII then red-teams it to prove no leak
Chozharajan2001/curtain.readme_summary: Pipeline: locate PII, mask images, attack with second model, score leaks to release or refuse. Product code isolated from answer key with evidence commands. Uses vision locate, masking, and Baseten attack model.

IvanRomanteev/TrustFlow.summary: Auditable agent workflows with approved plans and ledger verification
IvanRomanteev/TrustFlow.readme_summary: TrustFlow prototypes verifiable synthetic financial workflows using Muse planning plus deterministic policy, hash-bound approval and idempotent execution. Ledger evidence verifies each operation after timeouts.

Git083104/trustline.summary: Scans repos and sites for hijackable domains, buckets and accounts with fixes
Git083104/trustline.readme_summary: Detects dangling CDN, S3 and repojacking risks from polyfill.io-style takeovers. Labels Proven/Likely with fix plan, issue and patch, runs on PRs. Live Render app with API, eval and docs.

manupawickramasinghe/kubesage.summary: AI SRE team that cuts Kubernetes waste and ships fixes as git commits
manupawickramasinghe/kubesage.readme_summary: Finds unused capacity, diagnoses incidents, does KEDA scaling and node SKU optimization. Multi-agent system with dashboard and GitOps behind cost-aware LLM router. Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs.

daviyondaniels/harvest-relay.summary: Reconciles grower messages against food-hub orders for staff approval
daviyondaniels/harvest-relay.readme_summary: Harvest Relay reads grower change messages, checks them against weekly orders and proposes reconciliations that require approval. Next.js prototype uses synthetic demo with recorded Muse Spark responses.

malmsteen8989/exitpoint.summary: SAP assistant from functional spec to verified ABAP code and handover docs
malmsteen8989/exitpoint.readme_summary: Reads FS Word/PDF/Excel, checks design against DDIC, reviews ABAP and web code with verified fixes. Built on Meta Muse Spark with masking and static analysis. Generates TS, UTP and handover docs.

Gw3nhael51/promiseGap.summary: Compares proposals vs specs to flag contract commitment gaps early
Gw3nhael51/promiseGap.readme_summary: Audits commercial documents to find mismatches like 99.99% vs 99.5% before signing. Built with Symfony PHP, PostgreSQL pgvector retrieval and Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for extraction.

JacobOuyang/muzip.summary: Agentic photo compression that sends a sketch and fetches only needed regions privately
JacobOuyang/muzip.readme_summary: Sends a tiny sketch instead of the full photo, then lets Muse Spark request needed close-ups outlined by SAM 3.1. Photo stays on phone, link carries under 1% as text. Python sim plus evals demonstrate VQA with Muse Image test photos via Meta Model API.

cveti69/ojo.summary: Voice call assistant that sees your iPhone screen and guides you where to tap
cveti69/ojo.readme_summary: OjO is a phone call with screen-share. It narrates apps by voice, zooms tap targets, and writes localized text to clipboard. iOS frontend with backend, site and docs for live call experience.

tahmidrafi/AccessWalk.summary: Turns a phone walk video into a wheelchair accessibility report with tracked barriers
tahmidrafi/AccessWalk.readme_summary: Film bus-stop to entrance, AccessWalk detects barriers tied to SAM 3.1 tracked objects and frames. Full-stack with backend, frontend, eval and deploy scripts for route accessibility reporting.

Sandgrouse/storyverse.summary: Story command center keeping characters and plots consistent across media.
Sandgrouse/storyverse.readme_summary: Holds master story world and generates per-channel sheets, scripts, art, voices and video, detecting ripple effects on edits. Next.js app with lib and data layers. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and Muse Code.

theloopsmith/Cadence.summary: Voice-first iPhone plus glasses companion supporting daily life with Parkinson's
theloopsmith/Cadence.readme_summary: Cadence offers guided routines, walking cues and caregiver dashboard via voice. Pairs iPhone with Meta glasses for camera/audio/motion. Protected backend with iOS app and web walkthrough.

ektasikka1989-cmyk/Pramaan.summary: Offline-first AI co-worker for ASHA workers doing home visits and SOP guidance
ektasikka1989-cmyk/Pramaan.readme_summary: Android offline-first app for India's ASHA workers. Converts voice notes to health records and answers SOP queries with source pages. Uses on-device Llama 3.2 plus Muse Spark, Muse Voice and SAM 3.1 via Meta APIs.

BonneyMantra/pactovio-meta-hackathon.summary: AI bid desk that turns RFQs into priced, cited B2B proposals
BonneyMantra/pactovio-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Pactovio learns win patterns from past proposals and CRM, then reads buyer RFQs to draft priced proposals with page citations in company voice. Uses Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1 with human approval.

Alesha234/Digna.summary: Prepaid bill cards with set limits that explain declines in plain language.
Alesha234/Digna.readme_summary: Digna offers one card per bill using your own money with user-set limits. Built solo with Next.js, it demos sample accounts, payments, and explained declines. Uses Meta AI for guidance on digna.dev practice-money flow.

kroonen-ai/glimmer-scope.summary: Interpretability atlas labeling and steering features across Glimmer 30B layers.
