kroonen-ai/glimmer-scope.readme_summary: Glimmer Scope trains sparse autoencoders on nine layers of Muse Glimmer 30B. Every firing feature is labeled, steering-tested 170k+ times, and tracked cross-layer in an atlas. Repo includes SAEs, paper, Hugging Face demo and Modal deployment.

chewonc/argus-watch.summary: Checks if new security advisories actually affect your repos with evidence
chewonc/argus-watch.readme_summary: Continuous threat intel that fact-checks advisories and maps them to connected GitHub repos down to file and line. Built with Next.js on Vercel, it runs a fact-check to fix pipeline and proposes fixes. Uses Meta AI models for analysis and reasoning over code and advisories.

iamvolshi/curator.summary: Append-only record layer that proves what AI agents believed and did.
iamvolshi/curator.readme_summary: Curator is a life content manager with a K-record accountability layer for agent calls. It uses a wrapper plus append-only record store with a Muse Spark 1.3 call path, deployed via Docker and Firebase hosting. Offline tests run with npm test; prove path does one real recorded call.

ChaninduImanjith/self-healing-cicd-agent.summary: Autonomous agent that diagnoses failed CI builds and opens fix pull requests
ChaninduImanjith/self-healing-cicd-agent.readme_summary: Intercepts failing CI/CD builds, runs Meta AI root-cause analysis, then fixes code on isolated branches and opens GitHub PRs. Built with FastAPI, PyGithub, and Docker Compose. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta LLM layer for analysis and patches.

AmitVaranasi/adplace.summary: Opt-in video ad system that tracks surfaces and composites brands per viewer
AmitVaranasi/adplace.readme_summary: Uploads short video once, detects stable posters and objects in longest shot, tracks them in 3D, then composites auction-winning brands in browser. Pipeline with auction, perspective and occlusion handling. Prototype for disclosed Reels-style placements.

munf/synteel-app.summary: Phone app helping Indonesian eel farmers keep glass eels alive in nursery stage
munf/synteel-app.readme_summary: Synteel guides 0-12 week glass-eel to elver care with water checks and mortality alerts. Stack is mobile web preview plus Android APK with Node server. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe, and SAM 3.1.

sasikiran1/rebound.summary: Study and recovery gate stopping agents booking what customers did not approve
sasikiran1/rebound.readme_summary: Measures Muse Spark agents rescheduling FieldDesk appointments under DB slowdown with SQL judging, then adds Resolve service for typed constraints and crash-safe booking. Harness, backend API, and oracle checks. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for constraint parsing.

Pallas-ads/agent-beans.summary: Always-on Meta ads team demo for small businesses with recorded live runs
Pallas-ads/agent-beans.readme_summary: Repository hosts homepage and replay-mode web demo of Agent Beans for Meta ads management. Static site on GitHub Pages with recorded runs for two advertisers. Uses Meta Muse models for the underlying growth-team agents.

AnhKhoaaaa/OptiPack.summary: 3D cartonization assistant that measures items and plans optimal box packing
AnhKhoaaaa/OptiPack.readme_summary: Detects items at packing bench, fits 3D cuboids with uncertainty, extracts handling semantics, and optimizes placement with OR-Tools. Frontend is React + Three.js with manual override. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for semantics plus deterministic validator.

zhakhongirk/DigitUP.summary: Agentic storefront builder that turns price lists into shoppable sites with chat
zhakhongirk/DigitUP.readme_summary: Owner uploads spreadsheets and PDFs to draft business model, reviews it, then launches storefront at /s/:slug with assistant chat and MCP ordering. Next.js with Drizzle and Docker. Uses LLM business agent with rule-based fallback importer.

henryrio08/braive.summary: iPhone VR practice app for situational skills starting with public speaking
henryrio08/braive.readme_summary: Native iOS VR practice with voice intake and pairing to a local backend for scene generation. Backend validates Spark author-editor output into playable experiences. Uses Meta Spark models for authoring, editing, and Wonder building.

mohamedbelhassen/meta-hackathon-socratix.summary: Socratic Java OOP mentor for labs with lecturer telemetry dashboard
mohamedbelhassen/meta-hackathon-socratix.readme_summary: Zero-install AI mentor that guides students through errors without giving raw code, plus realtime lecturer dashboard. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, and MCP IDE connection. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for Socratic tutoring.

Nosh-thee-techy/kili-vault-rebarcheck.summary: Map-first planning workspace linking parcels, satellite change and field evidence in Kilimani.
Nosh-thee-techy/kili-vault-rebarcheck.readme_summary: Kili-Vault is a planner workspace for Kilimani Ward connecting GIS parcels, satellite detections, geotagged evidence, and case records. Frontend map plus backend evidence chain generates descriptive briefs. Uses Meta AI models for factual verification summaries without autonomous compliance decisions.

whwan4570/driveAI.summary: Hands-free car-care companion that guides maintenance and logs history
whwan4570/driveAI.readme_summary: Carmori walks through tasks like on a 2014 Sonata with voice Q&A and vehicle-specific history. Rule-based workflow controller plus backend, web and voice-service. Combines Meta multimodal models for hands-free guidance.

quagmire02/Livesplat.summary: Turns phone video into interactive Gaussian splat with physics and lessons
quagmire02/Livesplat.readme_summary: Reconstructs tabletop phone video to Gaussian splat via external ThriftSplat, then detects table plane and segments objects with SAM 3.1. Supports physics sim, Q&A, how-to lessons and grasp tests.

newcase-ai/ExpertWitness.summary: Searches a name and builds a sourced expert-witness profile for litigation vetting.
newcase-ai/ExpertWitness.readme_summary: ExpertWitness is an AI research agent that searches court filings, publications, licensing and web sources. Backend agent plus frontend results page links every fact to its source. Uses Muse models for research synthesis and cited profile generation.

diya-18/phc-pulse.summary: Forecasts medicine stock-outs at health centres and suggests nearby redistribution moves.
diya-18/phc-pulse.readme_summary: PHC Pulse lets Punjab PHC staff report stock via register photo, voice note, or shelf photo. System forecasts shortages and proposes officer-approved transfers. Uses Meta AI for OCR counting, demand forecasting, and multilingual input.

ZOOGOM/stillvalid.summary: Compares notice photos against official sources to show what changed with evidence
ZOOGOM/stillvalid.readme_summary: Mobile-first Next.js web app that compares a notice photo or pasted text with current official sources. Shows changes, supporting quotes and what needs confirmation with country settings and multilingual output. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API.

joypeb/VintageRelay.summary: Event clothing-swap app linking exchange requests into two-way swaps and cycles.
joypeb/VintageRelay.readme_summary: Vintage Relay lets organizers share QR codes for flea-market events where users list garments with photos. Backend links requests into swaps and three-person cycles requiring consent. Uses Meta AI for garment search, matching, and descriptions.

judecutler/safezone.summary: Coastal earthquake prep app with maps and evacuation guidance
judecutler/safezone.readme_summary: Prepares households for coastal earthquakes with risk maps, routes to high ground, and go-bag checks. Python backend with Modal and web frontend. Uses Muse Spark vision models to analyze photos and personalize safety plans.

andreete/srija-business-hub.summary: Single screen showing daily cash vs verified takings for restaurant and sports courts.
andreete/srija-business-hub.readme_summary: Srija Business Hub provides guest booking, one-button cashier sale, and owner takings dashboard with day-close status. Built on Docker with synthetic POS data for 10 months. Uses Meta AI for sales summarization and anomaly notes.

adityarajrao/musemeet.summary: Privacy-first dating protocol where agents vet compatibility before human introductions.
adityarajrao/musemeet.readme_summary: MuseMeet replaces swiping with autonomous dyadic agents, candidate funnel, and vaulted profiles. Node agent_engine with egress guard plus connectors and frontend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for matching and Muse Image 1.0 with AirGap zero-leakage.

icebrkn-hq/meta-hackathon.summary: Relationship AI that remembers personal details to help follow up
icebrkn-hq/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Noa captures one-sentence memories like customer milestones and surfaces them when you meet someone. Built with Meta Muse Spark and Muse Spark Open on Baseten, plus Meta Muse Code. Web app with dorm-agent and feed-opener modules.

goweki/soko-pilot.summary: WhatsApp merchant workspace turning product questions into buying chats
goweki/soko-pilot.readme_summary: SokoPilot is a merchant workspace for catalogue management and WhatsApp inbox with human takeover. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL/Prisma, it answers text and image queries with a configured Meta model grounded against catalogue prices and stock.

cristianjos38-dot/rof12.summary: Secure agent runtime with atomic capabilities, policy gate and audit chain
cristianjos38-dot/rof12.readme_summary: ROF12 is a default-deny runtime for limited, revocable agents with atomic capabilities, taint tracking, policy engine and audit chain. Python/FastAPI with PostgreSQL, Alembic RLS and JWT auth. Uses Muse models in mock and live modes for gated refund and operational workflows.

lloyddsilva/famparty.summary: No-signup party games where phones control a shared TV screen
lloyddsilva/famparty.readme_summary: FamParty hosts short living-room bonding games where a host phone drives a shared screen and guests join by QR or room code. Built with Next.js and real-time rooms, content packs under /content support hosting, scoring and moderation without accounts.

Luh-Labs-LLC/muse-finetune-agents.summary: Two agents that design LoRA fine-tunes and judge results with second review
Luh-Labs-LLC/muse-finetune-agents.readme_summary: Job Architect turns a goal into LoRA dataset, base model and hyperparameters with safety screening. Quality Judge evaluates the tuned model with held-out prompts. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API, Muse Wonder and Muse Voice Transcribe.

Rafa-Innerchispa/inneros-meta-guardian-2.summary: Self-investigating infrastructure monitor that auto-heals failures
Rafa-Innerchispa/inneros-meta-guardian-2.readme_summary: Autonomous infrastructure guardian that detects, investigates and remediates incidents with verification and tests. Dockerized Python service with 87 passing tests, live self-heal demo, built for startup track with Meta Muse models.

Farhanisto/Mechanism-AI.summary: Constraint-driven agent designing planar four-bar linkages with checks
Farhanisto/Mechanism-AI.readme_summary: Mechanism AI proposes linkage candidates while an independent deterministic evaluator owns pass/fail. Built with FastAPI, Pydantic and SSE streaming, it runs reference kinematics and optional MuJoCo MJCF simulation for collision and path checks.

0319-2004/before-its-built.summary: Reads construction signs and previews future buildings and shadows in 3D
0319-2004/before-its-built.readme_summary: Agent reads a photo of a Japanese construction notice, verifies against city open data, and renders the planned building on PLATEAU 3D. Built as static web plus Python pipeline, it shows winter shadows and demolition status with precomputed sample mode.

vignesh19032005/CaseWeave.summary: Investigative tool where models propose timelines and code checks evidence
vignesh19032005/CaseWeave.readme_summary: CaseWeave helps investigators test conflicting accounts against evidence with propose-check-replay-review flow. Built with FastAPI backend, worker and frontend plus Docker, a Meta model drafts hypotheses while deterministic code validates possibility for human review.

jsuryacodes/PartSnap.summary: Guided phone photos of broken furniture become verified 3D-printable repair parts.
jsuryacodes/PartSnap.readme_summary: PartSnap guides capture, checks photos with Muse Spark, segments damage with SAM 3.1, then generates CadQuery models. Stack spans frontend, backend, and CAD verification scripts. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder.

ariandesu/MedBuddy.summary: Bangla/English app that digitizes prescriptions and explains health records plainly
ariandesu/MedBuddy.readme_summary: MediSathi digitizes prescriptions and lab reports with on-device Bangla/English OCR for review, timelines, trends and doctor reports. Built with Next.js and check-in tracking. Uses Muse Spark for plain-language explanations and grounded Q&A over user records.

eric2612115/LandSight-Meta.summary: Reviews landscape drawing packages against bills, prices and building code
eric2612115/LandSight-Meta.readme_summary: Landsight reads drawing files, counts objects, checks bill arithmetic and code compliance with sources shown. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1 to ground every number in drawings. Includes browser demo, frontend and sample packages.

shyampitamber/ChartCortex.summary: Turns live chart images into structured trade plans with entry, stops and targets
shyampitamber/ChartCortex.readme_summary: ChartCortex streams OANDA market data into candlestick charts and generates entry, stop and take-profit plans. Next.js app calling the Meta Model API directly with fetch. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for JSON-constrained plans.

8nite/lumina.summary: Local-first Rust agent harness with self-improving memory and hybrid RAG
8nite/lumina.readme_summary: Lumina is a local-first coding and open-world agent harness with daemon, CLI, TUI and embedded React SPA. Built in Rust with hybrid local RAG and plugin memory. Supports BYO-LLM via OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and Copilot protocols.

dfrasheri/SAMolar.summary: Demo dental CRM with tooth chart, billing and X-ray segmentation viewer
dfrasheri/SAMolar.readme_summary: Next.js clinic CRM demo with appointments, patients, treatments, invoices and recall lists. X-ray upload runs SAM 3.1 segmentation to overlay tooth masks for planning.

nikola0x0/VeeCut.summary: macOS video editor where AI plans cuts to music and edits by voice command
nikola0x0/VeeCut.readme_summary: VeeCut is an open-source macOS editor with Simple and Pro modes, beat-synced cut planning and undoable AI edits. Built with Swift and Metal. Uses Muse Spark for footage understanding, SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Image and Muse Voice.

ant10293/LearnLoop.summary: Learns a physical procedure from one demo video and checks new attempts against it
ant10293/LearnLoop.readme_summary: Teach-by-demo system that parses a correct recording with Muse Wonder into objects and steps for human review, then scores a new video with deterministic checks. Stack spans backend/frontend with video tracking. Uses Muse Wonder for procedure proposal and human-verified conditions.

ms-private-projects/HunchAPI.summary: Turns plain-language theses into researched, guard-railed stock portfolios.
ms-private-projects/HunchAPI.readme_summary: Hunch researches a thesis and builds a US-equity portfolio where weights and orders are decided by code. Muse Wonder 1.0 does research; Muse Spark 1.3 runs agent, daily check and critique. FastAPI backend on Main Sequence with simulated venue.

unrealdhanush/magneye.summary: Turns object photos into interactive 3D exploded views that explain how it works
unrealdhanush/magneye.readme_summary: Magneye builds a verified anatomy from photos to render an interactive 3D exploded view with fault diagnosis. Python plus web frontend with streamed agent trace. Uses Muse Wonder agents, SAM 3.1 segmentation and SAM 3D.

mauricealam/SmartCess.summary: Voice-first Android assistant that reads bills and manages daily tasks.
mauricealam/SmartCess.readme_summary: TalkBack-first Kotlin + Jetpack Compose app with FastAPI backend for bills, documents and briefings. All AI via Meta Model API using Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcribe for input.

57Ajay/teachOnce.summary: Record a browser task once and replay it over CSV rows with self-healing
57Ajay/teachOnce.readme_summary: Teach-Once records a narrated browser demo and compiles it to a deterministic parameterized workflow. Run executes rows with no model calls and triggers healing only on site change. Uses Meta models for compilation and repair with Python playback engine.

krishnaChandak044/Blackbox-meta-ai-globa.summary: Preserves road-incident media with traceable review of evidence and limits
krishnaChandak044/Blackbox-meta-ai-globa.readme_summary: Blackbox ingests dashcam media, hashes files at intake, and organizes footage for human review. It surfaces what footage supports, uncertainties, and missing evidence without fault findings. Prototype uses Meta AI for analysis assistance with traceability UI.

hyena0/BrickRobotProject.summary: Infers LEGO robot kinematics to drive EV3 bricks and train pointing policy
hyena0/BrickRobotProject.readme_summary: Just Bricks infers kinematic chain from LEGO part poses, generates FK/IK and EV3 programs, and drives the robot via web console. MuJoCo auto-generates demos to fine-tune SmolVLA for webcam pointing. Uses Meta AI for kinematics reasoning and VLA policy.

tandryukha/aidemo.summary: Generates narrated MP4 product demos from storyboard.json with CI replay
tandryukha/aidemo.readme_summary: aidemo lets MCP agents write storyboard.json, then headless Chrome records deterministic replay with voiceover, captions, and auto-zoom. Re-renders in CI with no API key at near-zero cost. Uses coding agents for authoring; engine is Dockerized open-source MIT.

ji-hun-git/Modus.summary: Connects scattered medical records into traceable timeline with sources
ji-hun-git/Modus.readme_summary: Unifies medical files from different institutions into one versioned history with source inspection. Built solo with Meta Muse Spark for extraction and linking, local-first backend with docs and offline checks.

jenksed/yourmove-realize-demo.summary: AI career coach that surfaces hidden strengths from past work stories
jenksed/yourmove-realize-demo.readme_summary: YourMove Realize guides conversational reflection to uncover strengths with evidence. Go backend with benchmarks and tests, live demo accepts experience text or sample resume. Built with Meta Muse Spark for hackathon.

boonhowchew/saksi.summary: Witnessed research runner with tamper-evident log of every analysis step
boonhowchew/saksi.readme_summary: Saksi executes protocol-specified analyses during research, assisting drafting and review while logging human and agent actions. Provides tamper-evident provenance instead of post-hoc checks. Uses Meta AI agents with Python workflow engine on Modal.

imkrish2107/Probetests.summary: WhatsApp shopping and construction agents with verified listings and BOQ
imkrish2107/Probetests.readme_summary: One dashboard with shared agent engine for shopping photo-to-verified-listings ordering and construction floor-plan to BOQ to vendor compare flows. Spotter/Finder/Checker/Ranker verifies price and stock. Payment stays user-seller COD, no card storage.

Yash-Satankar/sitesight.summary: Measures construction progress from drawings and phone photos per BOQ
Yash-Satankar/sitesight.readme_summary: SiteSight imports architect drawings to propose BOQ items, then SAM 3.1 segments phone photos to quantify built progress. Agent trace shows accepted and rejected detections for engineer review. Built on Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 with web review UI.

agamble33/coach-sidekick.summary: In-game voice sidekick that watches screen, coaches, and clips plays
agamble33/coach-sidekick.readme_summary: Coach watches gameplay, joins voice chat, gives live strategy, and acts via game tool calls. Studios add playbooks to onboard players without tutorials. Uses Meta Model API for reasoning and tool-calling with desktop capture and TTS stack.

Younkyum/wru.summary: Family agents split errands via negotiation without sharing location
Younkyum/wru.readme_summary: WRU is a negotiation layer over WhereCtx personal location servers. Each family member's Muse agent on Muse Spark reads only coarse status and negotiates tasks via offer-counter-commit. Outputs only assignment, preserving coordinate privacy.

aroble11/lecture-studio.summary: Turns lecture audio and video into transcripts, notes and whiteboard visuals
aroble11/lecture-studio.readme_summary: Lecture Studio records or uploads lectures to transcribe audio and extract whiteboard moments. It pairs board drawings with guided notes and generates teacher materials. Next.js app with browser persistence and sample lecture mode.

emmjayh/FittedPerfection.summary: Fits AI-generated 3D outfits onto fixed MPFB bodies deterministically
emmjayh/FittedPerfection.readme_summary: Fits Trellis/Pixal3D/Rodin outfits onto four MPFB bodies using local deterministic math. Uses SAM 3.1 for part labeling before fitting and Muse Wonder for post-fit review. Includes safe intake, canonical framing, and 72-frame turntable views.

Udayr777/agentshield-ai.summary: Tests invoice agents against prompt injection with approval controls
Udayr777/agentshield-ai.readme_summary: AgentShield AI inspects synthetic invoices and challenges agents with attacks like prompt injection and layout shifts. Models advise only; deterministic controls and human approval govern outcomes. No real money movement, with hosted demo and benchmark report.

my5757980/meta-global-hackathone.summary: Used-car export business run by eight AI employees from chat to delivery
my5757980/meta-global-hackathone.readme_summary: AutoFTE is a white-label platform with website, CRM, auction, chat and app for exporter Hikari Motors. Eight Muse Spark Open agents handle chat, auction sheets, pricing and invoices. Dockerized monorepo with evals, demo data only.

nshreyasvi/LifeLens.summary: Turns first-person camera video into 3D body intelligence and motion insight.
nshreyasvi/LifeLens.readme_summary: LifeLens processes egocentric vision into 3D human pose and body intelligence. It combines Meta MHR rig, Llama 3.2, and Muse Spark 1.3 with OmniEgoCap pipeline. Includes director, pipeline, and web demo with figures and examples.

RaYYeR220/kappa.summary: Measures animal behavior from video with frame-linked verification
RaYYeR220/kappa.readme_summary: Kappa takes experiment video and plain-English measures, tracks animals with SAM 3.1, and returns Verified, Locked or Refused values with uncertainty and frame links. Researcher confirms assay; integrity checks block identity swaps and impossible motion.

Debb1ie/Meta-AI.summary: Turns river and typhoon data into cited flood alerts in 5 languages
Debb1ie/Meta-AI.readme_summary: HydroSentinel is flood early warning for the Philippines. A verifiable Muse Spark agent fuses live river, rain and typhoon feeds into cited briefings and SMS alerts in five languages for barangay officers. Live demo with no login.

riznykst/fen-meta-synthesis.summary: Human-governed AI synthesis where claims need quotes and approval
riznykst/fen-meta-synthesis.readme_summary: FEN proposes claims with verbatim quotes from sources like EU AI Act and Sumerian lexicon. Deterministic checks verify quotes before a human approves. Python API on Vercel calls Meta Model API with Supabase storage for analyses and verdicts.

admin-gltrax/gltrax-hacks-healthcare-.summary: AI crew handles calls, forms and appeals for patients
admin-gltrax/gltrax-hacks-healthcare-.readme_summary: PJ Health puts a crew of AI agents on Muse Spark to do patient work like calling offices, finding benefits, contesting bills and booking rides. Patient only decides and signs. Built on Meta Model API for the hackathon startup track.

dekensruz/whybox.summary: Turns notebook photos or spoken questions into hands-on science experiments for kids
dekensruz/whybox.readme_summary: Turns a photo, typed or spoken lesson into prediction, drag-and-drop experiment and spoken tutoring. Web app with api/server/src/shared stack deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse models for lesson understanding and voice explanation.

BharanitharanR/wayfinder.summary: Family trip-planning chat agent that researches real flights and hotels with prices
BharanitharanR/wayfinder.readme_summary: Chat agent collects family size, dates and budget, then searches live flights and hotels for grounded links. Runs end-to-end from terminal in Python. All reasoning, tool choice and PDF extraction runs on Muse Spark via Meta Model API.

Viral-Ad-Media/Agently-Frontdesk.summary: AI front desk that turns a damage photo into assessed job, quote and booking
Viral-Ad-Media/Agently-Frontdesk.readme_summary: Six trade desks for roofing, med spa, plumbing, AC, salon use chat, assessment and reviews. Frontend with api and demo-sites stack. Uses Muse Spark for chat, Muse Image for pictures and Muse Voice Transcribe for calls.

Santiskss/VolScan.summary: Volcanic hazard twin that simulates lava flows and drafts emergency alerts
Santiskss/VolScan.readme_summary: Operations agent answers eruption questions by calling lava, impact, seismic and CAP 1.2 alert tools to write cited briefings. Python stack deployed on Modal. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B open-weights served on own GPU as the brain.

aadih88/proofrig.summary: Evaluates robot code patches in simulation and certifies fixes without regressions
aadih88/proofrig.readme_summary: Deterministic MuJoCo referee tests controllers on hidden cases, then Muse Spark rewrites failures and re-tests. Issues Verified and Certified verdicts. Python harness with controllers, experiments and recorded runs.

Pranavpaharia/krishna-ai.summary: Grounded counseling companion giving stress guidance from classical wisdom texts
Pranavpaharia/krishna-ai.readme_summary: Persona-driven agent for stress, grief and decisions grounded by RAG in authentic texts to avoid invented quotes. Python krsna_ai package with scripts and data. Uses Meta Muse/Llama open-weights via Baseten inference.

ernestpascual/aruga.summary: Camera-based home rehab companion for PT, OT and SLP with therapist approval.
ernestpascual/aruga.readme_summary: Aruga is a clinician-directed home-program companion turning prescriptions into tracked performance. Built with Next.js 16, React 19 and TypeScript, five agents handle activity, biomechanics, goals and guidance. Camera motion tracking provides feedback with therapist always approving.

goodboychan/edgeGate.summary: Policy gateway that screens AI actions and packages at the edge
goodboychan/edgeGate.readme_summary: EdgeGate enforces policies and evaluates package/action risk before execution, with reproducible results and tests. Python 3.12 codebase with policies, scripts and CI. Uses Meta AI models with hardening for secure agent ops.

KMaruthi2002/EIDOS.summary: Compiles one demo video into checkable steps to guide people and robots
KMaruthi2002/EIDOS.readme_summary: Python compiler turns task video into ordered steps with editable values and visual contracts checked on camera. Runs live for cooking and repair, on a simulated robot arm, and for screen agents; evaluated on CaptainCook4D.

Ololadestephen/Confam.summary: Verifies AI bug fixes by testing tests with decoy patches and dual-model review
Ololadestephen/Confam.readme_summary: Reproduces bugs, plants plausible wrong fixes and requires independent probes like DB reads. Muse Wonder writes fixes, Muse Spark reviews gaps. GitHub Action and JS package with Vercel deployment.

harthikrm/mylonite.summary: Finds Redis concurrency bugs by racing requests through a delay proxy
harthikrm/mylonite.readme_summary: Tests Redis/Valkey services for lost updates and check-then-act races. Muse Spark 1.3 plans strict-JSON race experiments from source code, a delay-only proxy controls command order, and a code oracle verifies bugs with 20x replay.

zootzootzoot/songbird.summary: Music journal that turns daily photos into a song and music video
zootzootzoot/songbird.readme_summary: Photo-to-music app that infers the day's genre, casts photo subjects as band, records song and cuts video. Full-stack web + server with studio UI and shareable keepsakes. Uses Meta AI models for vision understanding and music generation.

ogulcanzorba/comedically-online.summary: Live stand-up streaming with comedy-aware moderation on 12s delay
ogulcanzorba/comedically-online.readme_summary: Live platform for stand-up shows where each show runs under comedian-approved rulebooks. Uses only Meta models for live comedy-aware moderation to avoid false takedowns. Built with Next.js, Tailwind and custom server.ts.

alvarofuentes/donde-plantare-mi-arbol.summary: Maps urban heat and tree sites across 34 municipalities with satellite AI
alvarofuentes/donde-plantare-mi-arbol.readme_summary: Couples satellite thermal sensing with Meta SAM 2.1 to mitigate urban heat islands. Python app with data pipelines and docs recommends where to plant trees. Uses Meta AI vision segmentation over free Earth Engine data.

fobby-io/fobby-connect.summary: Reads freight shipping docs into one schema and learns each sender layout
fobby-io/fobby-connect.readme_summary: Reads Shipping Orders and Packing Lists in Chinese and English into a fixed schema with code checks and dual verification. Learns sender layouts via Muse Wonder from corrections to reduce review. TypeScript stack with Drizzle and live demo.

A1exZabr/curtain-tryon-meta.summary: Visualizes curtains on your window from a photo for try-before-buy
A1exZabr/curtain-tryon-meta.readme_summary: Curtain virtual try-on: SAM 3.1 finds the window, Muse Image renders fabric, Muse Spark checks result. Node.js + Docker app with CI, evals and ops. Showcases home-decor visualization using Meta vision and image models.

IceTea42/off-my-shelf.summary: Turns shelf photos into sell, donate or recycle listings with prices
IceTea42/off-my-shelf.readme_summary: Converts photos or video of unused items into per-item listings with condition, price, multilingual title and product shot. Goal-driven agent batches lots and drafts buyer replies for approval. Installable Android PWA via Hugging Face.

JasonMomanyi/ArdhiCheck.summary: Screens Kenyan land deed plans for fraud and survey errors in seconds
JasonMomanyi/ArdhiCheck.readme_summary: Photograph a Kenyan survey deed plan for automated verification audit against Survey Act Cap 299. Uses Meta Muse AI with Firebase/Vercel app, API backend, evals and 120 tests. Flags paperwork inconsistencies for review.

Pentexa/robowitness.summary: Independent PyBullet verification for AI-generated robotics policy fixes
Pentexa/robowitness.readme_summary: RoboWitness requires every AI-proposed robot fix to pass a hidden deterministic PyBullet exam. Meta AI proposes the fix, simulator executes, oracle decides with SHA-256 sealed evidence. Backend plus web with Docker compose.

Bhaskar422/resonance.summary: Phone slow-motion video measures machine vibration to diagnose faults
Bhaskar422/resonance.readme_summary: Pocket vibration analyzer that films machines at 240fps, measures frequency from pixels and magnifies motion. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for diagnosis, and Muse Image for localization with FastAPI backend and frontend.

benschiller/nom-nom-go.summary: Shared cross-continent kitchen game where kids feed monsters and build burgers
benschiller/nom-nom-go.readme_summary: Browser kitchen game for remote parent-child play with monsters, order memory and sequence practice. Uses Meta AI for characters, artwork and recorded voice callouts. Web stack deployed to CloudFront with video-call-friendly layout.

Deekshith9238/sightloop.summary: Tests mobile popups on 8 phones and auto-verifies CSS fixes with video
Deekshith9238/sightloop.readme_summary: Opens pages on 8 Indian phone viewports, records 12s and measures overlay coverage. SAM 3.1 tracks overlays frame-by-frame, Muse Spark classifies and writes CSS fix, then re-records to verify.

wenshen18643/candor.summary: Anonymous whistleblowing that turns redacted evidence into cited timelines
wenshen18643/candor.readme_summary: Twelve-stage pipeline on Muse Spark Open converts scattered redacted evidence into cited timelines with uncertainty shown. Showcase demo runs crypto steps in-browser with nothing sent remotely.

meenanoolu/continuum.summary: Multi-agent coding system that requires you to prove understanding to proceed
meenanoolu/continuum.readme_summary: Orchestrator plans tasks, Code/Test/Research workers implement in workspace with verification. Learning Gates quiz understanding before unlock, with local memory adapting future gates.

oll4com/paper-trail.summary: Turns phone photos of invoices and contracts into filed work per policy
oll4com/paper-trail.readme_summary: OpenCV finds and straightens documents, then Muse Spark Open / Glimmer extracts schema-constrained JSON fields. Written policy.yml decides what runs autonomously vs needs human approval.

iamGoldenOla/mindtrace.summary: Learning-support agent that tests interventions and checks if they worked
iamGoldenOla/mindtrace.readme_summary: Investigates why a learner struggles, tries a support strategy and measures outcome. Non-medical educational tool with PRD, architecture and child-safeguarding specs driving agent design.

aimenhamzi01-dot/mizan.summary: Self-hosted workbench that triages vulnerability reports into evidence-linked cases
aimenhamzi01-dot/mizan.readme_summary: Mizan reads reports and code to flag injection, verify claims by reasoning without execution, and propose human review. Python workbench with audit trail, benchmark engine and API docs. Uses Meta models for triage reasoning.

jafferrilwaan-png/sata.summary: Multi-agent planetary intelligence with 3D Earth digital twin viewer
jafferrilwaan-png/sata.readme_summary: SATA Sentinel combines multi-agent queries with 3D Earth visualization for planetary data. Built with React, Three.js and TypeScript on Next.js. Uses Llama 4, Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and Muse Code.

Gorden0413/spatial-copilot.summary: Six-agent aisle copilot that measures forklift clearance and issues verdicts
Gorden0413/spatial-copilot.readme_summary: Measurement-first safety copilot returning walkway, clearance and blockage percent with GO/NO-GO suggestion. Six-agent crew uses SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark with human final approval.

parth33320/sovereign-supply-chain-meta.summary: Multi-agent platform that detects supply disruptions and negotiates restocking
parth33320/sovereign-supply-chain-meta.readme_summary: Enterprise supply-chain orchestrator built with LangGraph, SQLite, Celery workers and HITL governance. Adds demand forecasting, disruption radar and voice warehouse commands. Powered by Meta Muse and SAM foundation models.

Arlantaan/clearfirst.summary: AI customs broker that turns shipping docs into proven SAD declarations
Arlantaan/clearfirst.readme_summary: AI customs-broker agent for West Africa that reads invoices, packing lists and bills of lading to produce SAD/IM4 declarations with page-level citations, cross-checks, HS codes and duty estimates. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for stamp checks via Meta Model API.

isaacoselukwue/SceneTrace.summary: Tracks one object in fixed video and answers with frame-linked evidence
isaacoselukwue/SceneTrace.readme_summary: Reconstructs an object's observed history in short fixed-camera video, answers questions and links claims to source frames, refusing when unseen. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation/tracking, Muse Spark 1.3 for investigation and Muse Wonder 1.0 for review via Meta Model API.

nmud/tailorapps.summary: Observes work patterns and auto-builds small helpful desktop apps
nmud/tailorapps.readme_summary: Tailor monitors desktop activity to detect friction and proposes and builds tiny apps from counted behavior using four Meta Muse agents. Desktop app for Windows/Mac with backend, browser extension and website for distribution.

Anjitha7575/night-sky-finder.summary: Checks sky-camera clips to find meteors and explain why
Anjitha7575/night-sky-finder.readme_summary: Measures night-sky clips in Python then classifies meteor vs planes/satellites. Frontend + Python backend hosted on Vercel. Uses Meta Muse Spark for detective-like reasoning and explanations.

timezyme/meta-hackathon-paper-tours.summary: Turns PDFs into quoted guided tours linked to source pages
timezyme/meta-hackathon-paper-tours.readme_summary: Generates verifiable reading guides where every quote must match source. TypeScript React + Mastra + Effect on Modal. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 exclusively with reviewer agents for validation.

chuatomoliver/self-healing-workflow-app.summary: Turns text or diagrams into runnable self-repairing visual workflows
chuatomoliver/self-healing-workflow-app.readme_summary: Metaflow generates visual workflows from descriptions or diagrams, fills steps and mappings, runs them on canvas and suggests repairs for failures. Full-stack app with Docker frontend/backend that uses Muse AI for building and healing.

chriskript/AbujaCityLife-Ai-City.summary: Simulates 16 Abuja residents living, working and trading daily
chriskript/AbujaCityLife-Ai-City.readme_summary: Miniature living society in fictional Unity Gardens Abuja with 16 agents who commute, work, shop and form relationships in a small economy. Built for hackathon Push the Frontier theme with client/server TypeScript, Vite and Vitest.

devinwarp/facademapper-meta.summary: Maps building facades from one photo to plan projection shows
devinwarp/facademapper-meta.readme_summary: Reads architecture from a single photo to produce element masks and timed show plans that align visuals to fins, glass and crowns. Uses SAM 3.1 for mapping, Muse Spark for planning and Muse Image for visuals with FastAPI backend.

Dalliso-banda/MvelaAI.summary: Website chat support that answers questions and escalates to humans
Dalliso-banda/MvelaAI.readme_summary: AI customer support for SMB websites with chat widget, dashboard, and human handoff for after-hours coverage. Monorepo with demo shop and docs. Uses Meta Muse Spark for chat and Muse Voice Transcribe for voice input handling.

nhocconan/proofframe.summary: Verifies AI videos for defects with frame-exact findings and fixes
nhocconan/proofframe.readme_summary: Provider-agnostic video verification engine that checks AI-generated videos for visual defects and caption mismatches, linking each issue to timestamp with repair plans and regression tests. Web workbench with Docker deploy and demo contracts.

Aryanban/aeoforge.summary: Open-source toolkit that audits websites for AI answer-engine visibility
Aryanban/aeoforge.readme_summary: AEOForge crawls sites with Playwright to audit answer-engine readiness and generate llms.txt. Built in Python with MCP-native tools, it uses Meta Llama 3.2 to score content and suggest fixes.

Sveder/mifgash.summary: Agent-to-agent meetup planner that finds mutual time, place and invites
Sveder/mifgash.readme_summary: Mifgash exposes an API where personal agents negotiate availability, location and booking. Random-order private asking with expiry and calendar links. Uses Muse Spark Open on Baseten for parsing and place picking.

MohamedHaarishSherieff/Ai_Judge.summary: AI-run digital courtroom that litigates cases and inspects evidence
MohamedHaarishSherieff/Ai_Judge.readme_summary: Autonomous multimodal courtroom presiding over disputes with adversarial agents. Built with Next.js + Modal backend. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for evidence inspection under BSA/CPC statutes.

Gastonchevarria/OceanEye-hackaton-meta.summary: Security and forensic prover for paid x402 API endpoints on Base Mainnet
Gastonchevarria/OceanEye-hackaton-meta.readme_summary: Verifies 16 x402 v2 USDC resources with OpenAPI discovery, Bazaar manifest and referral receipts. Provides formal security checks for DeFi agents. Docker backend with frontend and x402scan verified servers.

yamidnozu/perrito-talk.summary: Mobile app that interprets dog behavior from photo, video and audio
yamidnozu/perrito-talk.readme_summary: PerritoTalk analyzes uploads or live camera/mic clips for posture and sound cues with care guidance. Mobile-first Cloudflare Workers app uses Muse Spark multimodal with bilingual EN/ES UI.

jiangjiexiang/labelvla.summary: Robot data platform for labeling multi-camera episodes and actions
jiangjiexiang/labelvla.readme_summary: LabelVLA manages LeRobot v2/v3 datasets with multi-camera playback, action segmentation and review workflows. Dockerized frontend/backend integrates SAM service for assisted mask tracking.

Manthan-cpp/TRIAGE.summary: Review dashboard that triages drone video for rescue candidate signals
Manthan-cpp/TRIAGE.readme_summary: Project Triage ingests drone/body-cam batches and samples review units for human verification. Node backend + Vite dashboard uses SAM 3.1 for candidates and Muse Spark 1.3 for prioritization.

mizzleinetimi/paneller-open.summary: Comic editor that splits pages into panels and redraws art with AI
mizzleinetimi/paneller-open.readme_summary: Paneller Open vectorizes comic pages into editable panels, bubbles and SFX using SAM 3.1. Next.js app uses Muse Spark for panel planning and Muse Image for clean art without lettering.

DMANDAVIYA/SureEnough.summary: Brain-decoding layer that abstains when EEG signals are too noisy
DMANDAVIYA/SureEnough.readme_summary: SureEnough wraps brain decoders with sequential stopping and calibrated abstention to control error rates. Web demo uses Meta Perception Encoder with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Image.

limengdu/muse-gadget-challenge.summary: Gadget framework that turns Seeed screens into Muse voice devices
limengdu/muse-gadget-challenge.readme_summary: This repo provides SDK, protocols and firmware to run Muse gadgets on Seeed Studio ESP32, Android, iOS and Linux. It uses Muse Gadget SDK for on-device display, voice and interaction.

dinitheth/DNAFix.summary: Turns GitHub issues into tested draft pull requests after human approval
dinitheth/DNAFix.readme_summary: Architecture-aware autonomous coding system that analyzes repo structure to bound commit, plans and codes in isolated worktrees, then verifies with tests. Uses Muse Wonder for planning and Muse Spark for coding agents before publishing draft PRs.

nduy1234/DockTwin.summary: Generates 3D port digital twins from text or photos for stress testing
nduy1234/DockTwin.readme_summary: Converts plain-English descriptions or photos into programmable 3D terminal twins, then agents test conflicting signals. Built with Next.js. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for vision, and Muse Voice Transcribe.

Osteeen/sightpass.summary: Verifies what shopping agents saw on screen before approving payment
Osteeen/sightpass.readme_summary: Safety layer for shopping agents that enforces signed spending rules, then checks agent screenshots for price and quantity mismatches. Stack is Next.js + API with Drizzle. Uses Muse Spark for rules parsing and SAM 3.1 for screen checks.

IsraelViz/sabi-meta-hackathon.summary: WhatsApp bookkeeping assistant for traders using voice notes and photos.
IsraelViz/sabi-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: WhatsApp-native intelligence for Nigerian shops that keeps books from voice, receipts and chats. Python FastAPI + Postgres app where Muse Spark proposes business events and Python commits journal lines and COGS.

Purwantoro01/ecopulse-ai.summary: Vehicle carbon and lifecycle analytics dashboard for sustainability
Purwantoro01/ecopulse-ai.readme_summary: Next.js sustainability platform that audits vintage vehicle restoration carbon footprint and energy metrics. Frontend is Next.js with Tailwind and Vercel serverless APIs. Integrates Meta Muse Model API for diagnostics.

tanerochris/securita.summary: Self-hosted agent that finds, triages and fixes code vulnerabilities and secrets
tanerochris/securita.readme_summary: Self-hosted LangGraph and LangChain harness runnable locally or in Docker for any git repo. Uses Muse Spark as hosted brain for CVE triage, secret detection and auto-fix.

JuHyunAn/agent-office.summary: Desktop office that visualizes coding agents as working characters.
JuHyunAn/agent-office.readme_summary: Agent Office is an Electron desktop app showing main session and subagents as office characters, with tabs for Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Muse and Gemini CLIs. Stack is Electron + Node with engine hooks and renderer tests. No bundled models; uses users installed official AI CLIs.

AdityaVG13/Continuum.summary: Owner-gated Mac control plane that safely commissions and shapes home routers
AdityaVG13/Continuum.readme_summary: Single-binary Mac app that discovers, enrolls and commissions owned routers with reversible CAKE shaping. Every write is permission-gated with receipts and typed refusals. Uses Meta models sparingly for task-path reasoning, healthy operation needs no calls.

shaddy-pv/codnite-brain.summary: Memory and evidence-based verifier for AI coding tasks
shaddy-pv/codnite-brain.readme_summary: Stores project rationale in a .brain file and only marks tasks done on real verification evidence. TypeScript service with evals. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for planning, diagnosis and handoffs.

boopalanjayaraman/argus.summary: Continuous visual inspection AI checking one-off builds against CAD at every stage.
boopalanjayaraman/argus.readme_summary: Autonomous inspection for engineer-to-order manufacturing fusing camera video, photos and 3D scans against CAD and order rules. Built on Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1, demoed on 48-inch APCO valve with traceable dossier.

arunjyotisarmarsece24-jpg/neuro-spark-ac.summary: FPGA spiking and ternary LLM engine plus Hopper Triton kernels for AI acceleration
arunjyotisarmarsece24-jpg/neuro-spark-ac.readme_summary: End-to-end hardware-software stack spanning Spartan-7 FPGA BitNet b1.58, INT8 systolic array and LIF SNN to H200 Triton kernels. Verilog/SystemVerilog edge designs verified against NumPy with Python tooling and Colab flow. Targets Meta Muse Spark Open via Open Kernel Challenge benchmarks.

vishavmehra/Tracera.summary: Investigates bug reports, proposes patches, and verifies fixes in a sandbox.
vishavmehra/Tracera.readme_summary: Tracera indexes repos into a versioned code graph, investigates with cited hypotheses, and reproduces and verifies patches in Docker. Inference uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, and SAM 3.1 for screenshots. Web app with evidence-backed review UI.

Tuanvilla/ho-tro-quan-tri-idc.summary: Vietnamese IDC on-call agents for SOP lookup, shift reports and alert triage
Tuanvilla/ho-tro-quan-tri-idc.readme_summary: Team of specialized agents for cited SOP QA, shift handover synthesis and warning duty over a swappable LLM Gateway. Knowledge in Markdown wiki vault with FTS5 RAG and PII redaction, interaction via Telegram owner bot. Human approval required for external actions.

elcodabra/lego-build-inventory.summary: Builds LEGO models only from your photographed parts with instructions
elcodabra/lego-build-inventory.readme_summary: Skill plus MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT that inventories owned LEGO parts, designs buildable models, and renders booklet-style instructions. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for description with MCP server architecture.

nepython/reality-fork.summary: Turns phone video into measured physics experiments with editable gravity replays
nepython/reality-fork.readme_summary: Agent watches short clips, tracks motion with Meta SAM 3.1, estimates laws and parameters with error bars. Verifies measurements against footage, then re-renders same shot with Moon gravity or no air. Node server with MCP tools and web demo.

vt20-crypto/closet-ai.summary: Daily outfits from your closet photos, weather and plans
vt20-crypto/closet-ai.readme_summary: Photos your closet to suggest daily outfits for weather, mood and plans with dress-step camera checks. Next.js app with segment, outfits, transcribe APIs. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, muse-spark-1.3 for tagging and outfits, muse-voice-transcribe-1.0.

ASTA91-GIT/Dream2sim.summary: Turns text ideas into playable 2D physics simulations in the browser
ASTA91-GIT/Dream2sim.readme_summary: Takes natural-language prompts via Meta Muse and SAM 3.1 to configure deterministic Python physics backend. FastAPI plus Pydantic serves scenes to Next.js 16 with 60 FPS PixiJS WebGL visualization. Docker Compose full-stack with design docs.

zumayaaustin-creator/LineCheck-Vision-Ha.summary: Voice-driven kitchen HUD that watches pans for portions, prep and waste
zumayaaustin-creator/LineCheck-Vision-Ha.readme_summary: Renders 600x600 HUD with SAM 3.1 detection reticles colored by urgency for smart-glasses class hardware. Voice plus touch drive four ops actions with Muse Spark model tiering. Includes WebMCP tools, specs and sprint harness.

adityareddy-dev/walkout.summary: Twelve AI shoppers test real stores for accessibility and checkout bugs
adityareddy-dev/walkout.readme_summary: Muse Spark agents with distinct devices and needs walk OpenTelemetry Demo shop in a real browser one action at a time. Records walkout points, writes patches, rebuilds via Docker and re-runs same personas to prove fix. TypeScript harness with evidence logs.

ramikamel/metalmind.summary: Agent that generates and verifies fast Metal kernels for PyTorch ops
ramikamel/metalmind.readme_summary: MetalMind proposes Apple Silicon Metal kernels then numerically checks and benchmarks them vs PyTorch. Verified kernels cached for offline reuse with fallback. Uses Meta Muse Wonder via Model API.

kkaitlyn111/toka-inference.summary: High-throughput LLM inference engine with AMD ROCm and hybrid attention support
kkaitlyn111/toka-inference.readme_summary: Extends Tokasaurus inference engine with AMD ROCm AITER backend and hybrid GDN/SWA attention. Supports GLM, Qwen, Gemma, OLMo, Muse, gpt-oss with Cartridges and attention matching. Benchmarked against vLLM and Transformers.

daeungo1/visual-product-recognition.summary: Mobile camera guide that overlays troubleshooting targets on product photos
daeungo1/visual-product-recognition.readme_summary: Mobile browser PoC where users input model code and issue, then get overlay targets on camera images. Uses hybrid registered/unregistered product flow with evidence validation. Backend on Azure Container Apps with authenticated adapters.

orgenix-ai/ori-rooms.summary: AI software team that turns descriptions into live apps via agent rooms
orgenix-ai/ori-rooms.readme_summary: Ori runs Direction, Design Studio, build and QA agents to produce clickable prototypes and live apps. All agents run on Meta Muse models, accessed via web or Muse Code connector. Prompts and rules stay on Ori server.

Tilak1114/fluidfield-hackathon.summary: Construction audit thread linking drawings, decisions and site photo evidence
Tilak1114/fluidfield-hackathon.readme_summary: Keeps drawing marks, RFI decisions, and site photos as one auditable thread for MEP verification. Muse Spark models walls, doors and devices with geometry checks. Flags legend conflicts and cross-sheet mismatches.

xinogi/gravity-check.summary: Local video checker that flags floating objects and physics breaks
xinogi/gravity-check.readme_summary: Analyzes AI-generated clips on-device to find unsupported objects and count mismatches. Muse Glimmer 30B via Ollama names suspects, SAM 3.1 via ComfyUI segments hands and objects. Geometry tests support and motion, outputs fix prompt.

Xiling13/Locus.summary: Photo-based space memory that reports missing, new and moved items
Xiling13/Locus.readme_summary: Mobile-first Next.js app stores spaces and items in IndexedDB, vision via server route to keep keys private. Compares new photo to tracked items to report missing, new, moved. Uses Meta Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 for diffing.

aizkinwork-star/intentlens.summary: Local-first visual assistant grounding electronics questions on a grid
aizkinwork-star/intentlens.readme_summary: Points camera at board, asks by text or voice, returns short answer plus normalized overlay position. Has Electron desktop and phone PWA builds with Meta-published models prioritized. Grid up to 128x128, keys kept out of page.

rabadiyameet073/urbanflow-traffic-intell.summary: Adaptive traffic signals with safety kernel and AI copilot
rabadiyameet073/urbanflow-traffic-intell.readme_summary: Adaptive traffic-signal intelligence with formal safety kernel and emergency-vehicle preemption. TypeScript Node monorepo with MongoDB time-series, pipeline and evals. Uses advisory-only Meta AI copilot for operator assistance, not direct control.

GeekLord/aftershock.summary: Disaster triage queue from drone imagery and radio calls with evidence
GeekLord/aftershock.readme_summary: Turns drone images, video and multilingual radio calls into mission priority queue and draft team plan. Every perception, reasoning and speech step runs on Meta AI via Meta API. Includes private custom-data mode and live demo.

Divyendra-S/msa.summary: Software wind tunnel proving app fixes with real failure experiments
Divyendra-S/msa.readme_summary: Open-source tool runs double-clicks, lost responses, webhook duplicates and races against real backend and DB. Traces breakage and re-runs to prove fixes. CLI installs to Claude Code, Codex, Muse Code for Next.js Postgres apps.

samer-cyber/the-last-light.summary: Unity story game where an AI drone companion talks, sees, and remembers
samer-cyber/the-last-light.readme_summary: The Last Light is a third-person Unity game set in Shelter 7 where Spark, a caretaker drone, is played by Muse Spark. It supports voice/text dialogue, vision of the scene, memory, physics tasks and holograms. Built with Unity + Meta Muse Spark integration.

intramdev/offerflow-ai.summary: Turns messy supplier spreadsheets into checked, source-linked customer quotes.
intramdev/offerflow-ai.readme_summary: Preview-first pipeline for xlsx/csv import, mapping, interpretation and validation with human review. Backend plus frontend with Docker compose, credit-gated Muse features. Every value links to source cell with export.

bijumastc/VibeEduTwin.summary: Writing coach for vernacular-medium students practicing English academic paragraphs.
bijumastc/VibeEduTwin.readme_summary: Structured write-feedback-revise loop for topic sentences, tone and citation, not essay writing. Python backend with learner store, knowledge base and frontend. Uses Muse models with speech and photo input.

sajosam/sentinel.summary: Local-first security engineer that scans code, explains attack paths and proves fixes.
sajosam/sentinel.readme_summary: SentinelOS scans projects with security tools, uses Meta models to plan triage and draft fixes. Re-scans and re-tests to verify. FastAPI Python backend with React Vite frontend and AgentFence policy engine.

lhnminh/second-brain.summary: Visual daily dashboard that turns tasks and goals into an editable plan
lhnminh/second-brain.readme_summary: Daily planner with tasks, goals, urgency, bubble map, subtasks and per-browser workspaces plus chat with search and voice. FastAPI backend and frontend on Vercel. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and Muse Voice for transcription.

commonworld-one/raise.summary: Turns missing features into tracked RAISE requests
commonworld-one/raise.readme_summary: Muse RAISE app for capturing and tracking feature requests within Commonworld Atlas ecosystem. TypeScript stack with agents, migrations and public assets. Built on Meta Model API using Muse credits for hackathon.

TheNonFungibleHuman/Komi.summary: Socratic study companion that questions you instead of giving answers.
TheNonFungibleHuman/Komi.readme_summary: Learning app built to coach thinking through prompts and structured feedback. Web app with components and product docs. Uses Meta AI tooling for guided dialogue during the hackathon build.

ryder1018/Diorama.summary: Turns one photo into a playable 2.5D layered scene for a skateboarding game.
ryder1018/Diorama.readme_summary: Agentic pipeline extracts depth-ordered layers, distances and occlusion from a single image. Meta models reason over geometry with image-grounded checks. Unity client plus Python CV services.

dh8116/pitchside.summary: Text-based go-to-market coach for founders via WhatsApp, SMS and email
dh8116/pitchside.readme_summary: Pitchside is a messaging-based GTM coach with 30-day challenges, check-ins and outreach help. Built with Node.js server and messaging integrations, it uses Meta Muse models for coaching dialogue and drafting posts.

sebuh-infsol/purebill-hackathon.summary: Converts field repair photos into human-reviewed QuickBooks invoice lines
sebuh-infsol/purebill-hackathon.readme_summary: Pipeline photographs repair scene, runs SAM 3.1 detection with overlay verification, drafts lines via contributor VLM, and posts to QuickBooks sandbox after human review. Every step hashed with receipts; zero production writes.

rowellgutierrez/Bucketa.summary: Local-first workspace for bookkeeping, sales, inventory and staff payments.
rowellgutierrez/Bucketa.readme_summary: Bucketa is a local-first React + Vite frontend with Node.js backend for small-business operations. It manages books, savings, sales, inventory and payroll with document scanning. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for chat and receipt extraction and Muse Image 1.0 for Creative Studio.

OlsOls4/fair-wear.summary: Prototype that reviews rental deposit dispute evidence from property photos
OlsOls4/fair-wear.readme_summary: Offline prototype for UK renters that segments inventory items and suggests classifications from a precomputed sample. Built with Next.js frontend, offline still-image runner and cached results. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark for classification, Muse Image for demo scenes.

nt-neil/watch-once-teach-human-and-robot.summary: Converts how-to videos into human manuals and robot-ready JSON procedures.
nt-neil/watch-once-teach-human-and-robot.readme_summary: Upload-first tool that extracts keyframes and builds step manuals plus JSON with traceable frames. Evaluated with 3-run majority vote on held-out sets, up to 3 min / 100MB video. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Code for all demo AI, 100% local run.

NamiduHarshana/minutecanvas.summary: Listens to live meetings and draws an illustrated visual board in real time
NamiduHarshana/minutecanvas.readme_summary: MinuteCanvas transcribes live speech and uses a Muse Spark agent to draw a Flow Map step-by-step. It surfaces gaps, conflicts, and bugs while people talk. Built with Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Wonder.

ChetasLua/designarena-watch.summary: Polls Design Arena registry and posts stealth model alerts to Discord.
ChetasLua/designarena-watch.readme_summary: Python bot polls designarena.ai/api/registry every 2 minutes and diffs model slots. Detects new stealth codenames, reveals, removals and model changes. Posts formatted alerts to Discord webhook, runs via launchd.

Afnan-0206/AetherTwin.summary: Digital twin with optimal control linking neural perception to physical hardware.
Afnan-0206/AetherTwin.readme_summary: AetherTwin is Next.js 14 + TypeScript app for neural-to-physical twin with LQR control and edge synthesis. Includes Vitest suite and Cloudflare Pages deploy. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for perception and Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning with ROS 2.

apsariUdithara/elephant-early-warning-mu.summary: Tracks elephants to predict village arrival and sends multilingual SMS alerts
apsariUdithara/elephant-early-warning-mu.readme_summary: Early-warning multi-agent system for human-elephant conflict in Sri Lanka. SAM 3.1 tracks herd distance and speed, Muse Spark 1.3 judges behavior and drafts English, Sinhala and Tamil alerts. Predicts arrival time and decides response actions.

Shah-0-7/Temp-Meta.summary: Tries on clothes from any store link live in browser with your webcam
Shah-0-7/Temp-Meta.readme_summary: TryAnywhere fits garments to body live in browser from product links. Desktop-first pnpm monorepo with typed provider interface and offline defaults. Meta providers not wired, HF Leffa optional.

leninathikam/Foresight-AI.summary: Simulates industrial motor failures to predict, diagnose and prevent breakdowns.
leninathikam/Foresight-AI.readme_summary: Foresight AI is simulation-only Python platform with Observe to Monitor loop for motor digital twin. Uses ODE twin, Isolation Forest and XGBoost with bounded agent tools. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 or Muse Spark Open, else deterministic planner.

Eman2123/ClerkifyDx.summary: Bilingual clinical training with simulated patients and safe intake summaries for Nigeria.
Eman2123/ClerkifyDx.readme_summary: Combines AI simulated patient, structured clerking feedback and safety-first intake in English and Pidgin. Full-stack prototype with frontend, backend and API docs. Uses Meta AI models for simulation, feedback and clinician-review summaries.

malihakhan1512/PhyloLoom-AI.summary: Research workspace that analyzes FASTA sequences and builds phylogenetic trees
malihakhan1512/PhyloLoom-AI.readme_summary: PhyloLoom AI is a reproducible genomics workspace for FASTA validation, stats, alignment and tree export to JSON/Newick. Frontend plus backend with Docker/Caddy deployment. Uses Meta open-weights biological models for mutation analysis with an optional AI copilot.

devadsk/InfraSight.summary: Agentic investigator that diagnoses server failures with photos and logs
devadsk/InfraSight.readme_summary: InfraSight correlates technician photos, SMART telemetry, kernel logs and manuals in multi-step investigations. Backend deterministic engine plus frontend with eval and tests. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for vision and sam-3.1 for perception with audit trails.

mehmetsalihaltin-max/sez-dogrulama.summary: Flight-route evidence checker that verifies weather and airspace risks.
mehmetsalihaltin-max/sez-dogrulama.readme_summary: Answers if verified evidence exists for a route and date across weather, ash, strikes and airspace risk. TypeScript web app with browser voice input where Muse Voice transcribes and Muse models aggregate evidence strength.

prashma03/StillPoint.summary: Privacy-preserving check if an edited photo shares viewpoint geometry with a registered photo.
prashma03/StillPoint.readme_summary: Registers background geometry from a photo and compares viewpoint alignment without exposing people in images. Frontend plus Python backend with masking and geometry analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for person masking and Meta models for assisted mapping.

Biogod2020/pulse-watchword.summary: Always-on camera agent that watches for events you describe in words
Biogod2020/pulse-watchword.readme_summary: Pulse turns plain sentences into yes/no visual questions and scores live frames every second, saving matches as cards. Single Python app with eval scripts and docs. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer open-weights locally via token log-probs.

ammaskid/fingerpost.summary: Points phone at machines to guide fingertip to buttons with voice and sound
ammaskid/fingerpost.readme_summary: Accessibility web app that maps machine buttons with Meta models and steers fingertip via audio cues. Reads displays after presses to verify success. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Wonder.

muyiwah/truemed.summary: Scans medicine packs to detect counterfeits in English, Pidgin, Yoruba
muyiwah/truemed.readme_summary: TrueMed photographs medicine packs, extracts evidence and checks facts against NAFDAC data and custody ledger. Backend API plus web and admin control room. Uses Meta AI vision-language for pack reading and multilingual explanations.

VBDO6969/mcp-trust-check.summary: CLI gate that detects MCP tool poisoning and rug pulls before use
VBDO6969/mcp-trust-check.readme_summary: mcp-trust-check baselines MCP server tools and diffs changes with LLM review to approve or block trust in CI. Node TypeScript CLI with tests and eval-results. Uses Muse Spark via Baseten for new or changed tool review.

irizaonline-droid/IRIZA-RESCUE.summary: Imports projects to inspect code, review patches and verify changes
irizaonline-droid/IRIZA-RESCUE.readme_summary: IRIZA RESCUE is an engineering studio for project import, source inspection, evidence review and patch verification. Standalone Node.js backend with SQLite and editor build. Preserves existing IRIZA identity and separate TASTE store.

sunkencity999/wrench.summary: Local sysadmin agent that watches logs, diagnoses and fixes issues
sunkencity999/wrench.readme_summary: On-machine agent that patrols logs, remembers changes, explains in plain English and fixes with permission. Python service with evals and tests, supporting Ollama local mode plus OpenAI and Anthropic. Powered by muse-spark-1.3 for patrols and muse-wonder-1.0 for diagnosis.

eternal-drift/ai-incident-commander.summary: Multimodal incident workspace that turns reports, images and audio into verified action plans
eternal-drift/ai-incident-commander.readme_summary: Multimodal incident-response workspace that ingests operator text, images and voice notes to build timelines and confidence-scored hypotheses. Uses live Meta Model API for extraction and planning with deterministic verifier and human approval. Stack with backend, frontend, Docker Compose; no auto-execution.

Zyron-Org/zyron.summary: Dual-auditor AST code review with on-chain attestation for AI-generated smart contracts
Zyron-Org/zyron.readme_summary: Trust and attestation layer for AI agents on Monad Testnet and Base Sepolia that performs autonomous AST static analysis and dual-auditor review. Issues cryptographic on-chain attestation for protocol trust. Backend API with Swagger, contracts, frontend and agent workbench.

mson-wagz/Floatwise.summary: Swahili and English assistant advising mobile-money agents when to restock cash
mson-wagz/Floatwise.readme_summary: Assistant for Kenyan mobile money agents that parses M-Pesa SMS in Swahili or English to advise cash and e-float restocking. Numbers come from a deterministic solver, not the LLM, with plain-language risk advice. Backend plus frontend built for Meta hackathon indie track.

Mahesh-Paul/AutoPatch-Kernel-Autonomous-.summary: Autonomous agent that finds bugs and opens verified fixes via sandboxed patches
Mahesh-Paul/AutoPatch-Kernel-Autonomous-.readme_summary: AutoPatch-Kernel localizes faults via Tree-sitter AST call graphs and syscall tracing, then tests patches in parallel Git worktrees in Modal sandboxes. MCP server, Python engine and dashboard stream progress with Z3 verification. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning.

RjayBernales/FieldFix.summary: Troubleshooting tool that pinpoints station failures and verifies data recovery after repair.
RjayBernales/FieldFix.readme_summary: AI-assisted maintenance for environmental monitoring stations with evidence-before-action flow. FastAPI Python backend with React TypeScript frontend traces where delivery stops and proves fresh data returns. Uses Meta Muse for diagnosis and single-change approval.

RaksaOrg/sawit-eco.summary: WhatsApp AI that converts palm farm daily reports into owner dashboard data
RaksaOrg/sawit-eco.readme_summary: Palm plantation ops system where foremen send daily reports via WhatsApp Cloud API webhook to an agent router. AI extracts structured JSON to PostgreSQL via Prisma for owner dashboard in SAP Fiori style. Monorepo with apps, packages, Docker and Supabase.

TEJASKUMAR-REDDY-J/Kolmo.summary: Physics lab that segments objects with SAM 3.1 and benchmarks neural flow surrogates
TEJASKUMAR-REDDY-J/Kolmo.readme_summary: Takes object photo, segments with Meta SAM 3.1, simulates flow with exact numerical solver, then trains CNN, FNO and JEPA surrogates to measure error vs horizon and drift. Autonomous assistant uses Muse Spark on Groq with Llama Prompt Guard 2. Runs on laptop CPU.

SabhyataC/Demo_Market_Brain.summary: Shelf video to product catalog and ad drafts with owner approval and spend caps
SabhyataC/Demo_Market_Brain.readme_summary: Shop owner films shelf; ffmpeg samples frames, Muse Spark reads price tags and merges detections into editable catalog. Planner picks 3 products and generates copy and images from real photos with logging and backend caps. Python app with evals and samples.

astrobleem/86TO88.summary: DOS bridge running unmodified Win 3.1 Minesweeper on 8088-class Windows 3.0.
astrobleem/86TO88.readme_summary: Small DOS TSR plus 361-byte DLL shim translating unmodified WINMINE.EXE in memory for real-mode Windows 3.0. Verified on Tandy 1000 EX and browser emulator, built with Meta Muse Wonder with hash-pinned media.

KarthikPerepu/MetaAIHack.summary: Audits kirana shop WhatsApp bills, voice notes and schemes to find lost money
KarthikPerepu/MetaAIHack.readme_summary: Khata analyzes weeks of distributor WhatsApp chats, bill photos, rate lists and voice-note schemes for kirana shops. Reconciles bills and payments to produce owner report of leakages. Python pipeline with docs, evals, tests and Meta hackathon Build for Your World entry.

Kittybri/oddlings-meta-hackathon.summary: Photo-to-creature pixel sandbox that turns objects into companions
Kittybri/oddlings-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Cozy pixel game where photos of real objects become pixel companions with biomes and abilities. Players hatch creatures, chat, fuse and build habitats. Uses Muse Spark for understanding and Muse Image for pixel sprite generation.

gamamou/TerraCouncil-AI-Meta-Hackathon-2.summary: Bilingual multi-agent debate tool for mining, farming and climate decisions
gamamou/TerraCouncil-AI-Meta-Hackathon-2.readme_summary: TerraCouncil AI is a decision-support prototype that reconciles scientific evidence with staged agent reasoning. Pipeline runs evidence context, Spark position, Wonder critique and Spark revision with trace. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and muse-wonder-1.0 via Meta Model API.

nsirivolu27/campus-compass-meta-hackatho.summary: Personalized AI campus tour planner for prospective students
nsirivolu27/campus-compass-meta-hackatho.readme_summary: Campus Compass builds personalized itineraries from major, interests, time and location across 5,877 institutions. Node web app with mapped guides, landmarks and experimental Android/Meta glasses support. Uses Ollama llama3.1:8b locally with Meta integration path.

harymerdeka/SeamProof.summary: Photo-to-pattern garment workflow for small tailoring workshops
harymerdeka/SeamProof.readme_summary: SeamProof converts photos and text prompts into garment designs, verified patterns, toile corrections and cut plans. Python pipeline with deterministic verifier and tailor-language explanations. Uses Meta Muse models end-to-end for design, pattern and cut.

spotty21201/unbuilt.summary: Browser workspace for early residential master planning trade-offs
spotty21201/unbuilt.readme_summary: Unbuilt visualizes site constraints, streets, lots and open space with measured quantities and costs. Browser workspace with planning assistant for layout scenarios. Uses Muse AI by Meta for planning assistance.

ker2i/mendcue.summary: Turns appliance symptoms into technician-ready repair requests via chat
ker2i/mendcue.readme_summary: Tenant-aware intake platform with embeddable chat, hosted intake page, tech workspace and REST API. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for fact extraction and draft assessments with optional image-label transcription.

THossen/Quietlog.summary: Voice-first migraine diary that builds printable doctor summaries
THossen/Quietlog.readme_summary: Quietlog is an agentic diary where voice or text logs are extracted to structured fields and PDF summaries. FastAPI + SQLite backend with Expo React Native app and Open-Meteo snapshots. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

ingot-mlx/ingot.summary: Swift Metal LLM inference engine for Apple silicon with exact caching
ingot-mlx/ingot.readme_summary: Ingot serves MLX safetensors checkpoints via OpenAI-compatible chat API with no MLX/Python at runtime. Hand-written Metal kernels, DFlash2 speculative decoding and exact prefix cache. No Meta Muse dependency; infra for local model serving.

anhtiento1998/ai-content-agent.summary: Auto studio that builds vertical short videos and posts to TikTok and Shorts
anhtiento1998/ai-content-agent.readme_summary: Automated short-video studio pipeline: topic to scene script to image/voice to subtitled MP4 with music and logo. Uses Claude/GPT/Gemini/Muse Spark plus Imagen/Veo, assembled with FFmpeg. Includes web dashboard, scheduler, and history logs.

lamtungpham/valo-agent.summary: Vietnamese personal finance coach that tracks GROW commitments and nudges
lamtungpham/valo-agent.readme_summary: Valo Agent is a Vietnamese finance coaching agent with persistent profile, GROW framework and deadline commitments. Node/Express server with deterministic calculation engine and adapter for valo-financial-context. Uses Muse Spark only for narration.

andamagodwin/mtaasense.summary: Community tool that turns Uganda hazard photos and voice notes into incidents
andamagodwin/mtaasense.readme_summary: MtaaSense converts resident pothole, drainage and flood reports with photos and voice notes into structured records. Backend with PostGIS duplicate detection and reviewer workspace outlines hazards in photos. Uses Muse Spark JSON and SAM 3.1.

Manahil-Aamir/FixLens.summary: Photograph a broken appliance to get a safe step-by-step troubleshooting plan.
Manahil-Aamir/FixLens.readme_summary: FixLens identifies appliances and faults from photos or video, asks targeted questions, then generates prioritized fixes with safety stop rules. Built as mobile app plus backend API. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via Baseten OpenAI-compatible API for vision and reasoning.

Flyingrang2/workalike.summary: Learns unwritten work rules and distills them into a local Muse Glimmer model.
Flyingrang2/workalike.readme_summary: workalike observes how users work, asks only ambiguous cases, then trains the patterns into an open Muse Glimmer model for local GPU inference. Includes testbed, baselines and experiments. Uses fine-tuned Muse Glimmer for private on-device execution.

Pac1FF1zM/Instagram-Shop.summary: Verifies sellers and listings to block fraud and polish product photos.
Pac1FF1zM/Instagram-Shop.readme_summary: An agent for social commerce that scores risk from photo review, EXIF and perceptual-hash duplicates, verifies seller IDs, and creates studio cards. Full-stack app with FastAPI backend and frontend. Uses Muse Spark vision, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

Jullemyth122/meta-hackathon-sakaysight-a.summary: 3D jeepney twin for seat-aware trip planning with Taglish voice guidance
Jullemyth122/meta-hackathon-sakaysight-a.readme_summary: SakaySightAI simulates Metro Manila jeepney routes in 3D on OpenStreetMap for drivers and commuters. Web app with Firebase and Vercel API reroutes, waits and prices choices in pesos. Uses Meta Muse Wonder as voice/photo agent.

Jordan-programer/nonglink-agent.summary: Multilingual voice, text and vision farming assistant for Central Africa.
Jordan-programer/nonglink-agent.readme_summary: NongLink Agent helps small farmers and cooperatives in Angola, DRC and Congo with crop advice, prices, weight estimates and irrigation. Multimodal and trilingual PT/FR/EN with Docker demo. Uses Meta AI models for text, voice and vision assistance.

UjwalKandi/ember.summary: Agentic wildfire sensor mesh where tuned Muse interrogates and reprograms ESP32 nodes
UjwalKandi/ember.readme_summary: XIAO ESP32-S3 camera-mic nodes detect fire on-device and send 30-byte packets over Meshtastic-class LoRa mesh. Fine-tuned Muse Glimmer runs ALERT/WATCH/DISMISS loop, re-samples nodes and rewrites detectors plus reports.

gtavo95/open-market.summary: WhatsApp sales advisor that diagnoses crop issues and sells farm inputs.
gtavo95/open-market.readme_summary: Open Market lets farmers send text, voice or photos to get catalog-grounded product recommendations, datasheets and order calculation with human escalation. Chat and WhatsApp interface. Built with Meta Model API and Muse Wonder for retrieval and dialogue.

dawntownish/Bandwidth.summary: Chrome extension that cleans articles into focus text, cards and speech.
dawntownish/Bandwidth.readme_summary: Bandwidth is a Chrome extension with local backend that extracts article text for Clean, Cards, Listen and Simplify views. Simple unpacked install with paragraph navigation. Uses Meta model backend for cleaning, simplification and summarization.

tanakandove/meta_ai_global_hackathon_dar.summary: Turns meetings, emails and chats into tracked commitments synced to Notion
tanakandove/meta_ai_global_hackathon_dar.readme_summary: ProjectPulse extracts commitments, decisions and blockers from team conversations with human approval. Backend LangGraph workflow with frontend syncs to Notion and tracks follow-through. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for diarization and Muse Spark for extraction.

Aafia1223/FollowMathAI.summary: Sound-and-touch math tutor that reads whiteboards and checks work for blind students
Aafia1223/FollowMathAI.readme_summary: FollowMath AI helps visually impaired students follow whiteboard equations and verify work via audio and touch. Built with a custom real-time WebSocket backend and dual-device architecture, it uses SAM 3.1 for board capture, Muse Spark for reasoning, and Muse Transcribe for voice.

okizman09/PathwiseAI.summary: Turns build ideas into verified tool plans with paste-ready prompts and live runs
okizman09/PathwiseAI.readme_summary: Pathwise AI interviews users to lock a product brief, selects verified tools from a curated catalog, and generates sequenced plans. All LLM calls go through Meta Model API on muse-spark-1.3 with json_schema structured output, with live step execution in-app.

S-h-u-b-h-1/SecureForge.summary: VS Code assistant that proposes, reviews and safely applies code patches with verification.
S-h-u-b-h-1/SecureForge.readme_summary: Security-first VS Code extension powered by local TrueForge with live proposals, per-hunk review and guarded apply with Undo. Includes repair lab, Patch Passports and approved verification commands. Uses TrueForge sessions and deterministic local fixture for model verification.

altaga/MetaDesk.summary: Operator desk giving Muse models shell and browser control of NVIDIA Jetson fleet
altaga/MetaDesk.readme_summary: Embodied AI control plane for Jetson boards with operator desk, fleet jobs and relay. Apps monorepo with Cloudflare relay and Vercel frontend. Uses Muse Spark and Wonder for shell, files and browser ops.

SandeepSubbiah/incidentlens.summary: Evidence-checked AI team that diagnoses Kubernetes Spring Boot incidents.
SandeepSubbiah/incidentlens.readme_summary: IncidentLens uses cooperating Muse agents to read logs, traces, K8s state and code diffs. Node core with verification, isolated patch testing, and governance gate. Built on Muse models including muse-wonder-1.0 for root-cause analysis.

brainx888/BrainHiFi.summary: Maps brain dynamics to MRI anatomy for real-time brain-computer interfaces
brainx888/BrainHiFi.readme_summary: BrainHiFi fuses high-frequency neuro-source imaging with high-fidelity MRI to map deep brain dynamics with millimeter precision. Built in C#/.NET with sample MEG/MRI data, it uses Muse Wonder 1.0 and SAM 3.0 for decoding to drive BCI and robotic control.

RESMP-DEV/void-fusion-lab-hackathon-publ.summary: One-click video object removal with tracking, inpainting and auto checks
