RESMP-DEV/void-fusion-lab-hackathon-publ.readme_summary: VOID Auto-Edit removes a clicked object: SAM 3.1 tracks it, Muse adds a second view, background is rebuilt. Python pipeline with just/uv checks for review of flagged moments.

kdy1029/common-ground.summary: Real-time interpreter that resolves pointing words like this and there visually
kdy1029/common-ground.readme_summary: CommonGround grounds ambiguous speech in shared physical context using phone camera input. It combines Muse Voice for speech, Muse Spark for language, and SAM 3.1 for object highlighting to translate when confident and clarify when ambiguous.

BhavishyaMangalasary/lifeline.summary: Flood dispatch planner that finds cut-off buildings from satellite and road maps
BhavishyaMangalasary/lifeline.readme_summary: Lifeline compares before/after satellite photos with road networks to detect cut roads, isolated buildings, and ranked entry points. It writes cited dispatch briefs and provides an Ask-the-map assistant for typed or spoken questions over results.

akmalzufaaaf/runova.summary: Generates validated loop running routes matched to distance and vibe
akmalzufaaaf/runova.readme_summary: Runova creates loop routes starting and ending at GPS location matched to distance and vibe like nature or historic. Uses OpenStreetMap path validation, Node backend with draggable map UI, and live tracking with $0 map stack and no API keys.

vishalvermauts/Musegix.summary: Routes models, trims context and tracks impact for AI app builders.
vishalvermauts/Musegix.readme_summary: Orchestration layer between browser app builders and Meta models. Three engines decide model, project context and change impact. Includes gateway, MCP servers, benchmarks to cut tokens and cost.

Koushik-Salammagari/roomscape.summary: Turns a phone room scan into a story-driven treasure hunt leading to a hidden gift.
Koushik-Salammagari/roomscape.readme_summary: Next.js game that builds a treasure hunt from a 20-second room scan or 4-8 photos. Generates titled story, five object characters, riddles and final lock in about two minutes. Uses Meta AI vision and language models for clue and story generation.

MihirKolakaluri/paper-worlds.summary: Draw game levels on paper, photograph them and play instantly
MihirKolakaluri/paper-worlds.readme_summary: Web game that turns hand-drawn platforms, lava, hero and flag into playable levels via photo. Includes Asteroid Surf controlled by sticky note and voice-typed rules like lava rising on clap. Built with Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Voice Transcribe.

bymysidelabs/muse-talk-to-edit.summary: Agent that turns repeated payment chores into tap-based mini-apps
bymysidelabs/muse-talk-to-edit.readme_summary: The agent detects repeating chores from card texts and builds a fixed-renderer mini-app to handle repeats. It writes a checked spec instead of code, keeping repeats to 0 tokens or one short query. Built on Meta Muse models for spec generation and Q&A.

itskavyansh/Canary-Analyst.summary: Geotechnical monitoring agent that detects ground collapse risk from sensors.
itskavyansh/Canary-Analyst.readme_summary: Monitors subsidence above coal workings from surface sensor arrays to catch collapses early. Multi-tool autonomous agent with deterministic safety guard, eval harness and web demo for hazard alerts.

YAMMYHONEY/lost-and-frame.summary: Finds objects that vanish or appear in AI videos without cause
YAMMYHONEY/lost-and-frame.readme_summary: Lost & Frame scans AI-generated video frames to find continuity errors where objects vanish or appear. It runs locally in Node.js and sends only still frames to the model with user key. Each event returns frame pairs with a one-sentence reason.

FlorentRu/courio-hackathon.summary: Quest letter app where 3D companions read and translate letters
FlorentRu/courio-hackathon.readme_summary: Courio is a friends-only letter app for Meta Quest where 3D companions deliver letters in-room. Hackathon work adds Meta-model voice reading, translation, and voice reply with in-room keyboard. Headset web app uses Supabase backend and Netlify hosting.

tkimingi25-spec/vibe-debug.summary: Python tracing toolkit that exposes failures to AI assistants via MCP
tkimingi25-spec/vibe-debug.readme_summary: vibe-debug traces Python functions as OpenTelemetry spans, captures exceptions and silent empty returns, and exports to Arize Phoenix. Evidence is exposed via CLI and MCP tools for coding assistants. Optional Muse Spark integration explains failures in English or Swahili.

musharraf3/DataTrace.summary: Agent that proves if a metric jump is real with SQL evidence
musharraf3/DataTrace.readme_summary: DataTrace investigates business metric changes with executed SQL evidence down to individual claims. A Meta-powered agent separates real movement from reporting errors and an independent checker verifies fixes. Built with Streamlit, Docker, and Muse Spark 1.3 plus Wonder 1.0.

aljabrialam/accesspoint.summary: Photo a kiosk to get step-by-step help in your own language
aljabrialam/accesspoint.readme_summary: AccessPoint helps elderly, blind, low-vision, migrant and tourist users operate ticket and checkout machines via photo guidance. Telegram bot plus mobile app provide multilingual next-step instructions. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice and Muse Image.

ialim0/timalens-lab.summary: Upload a lesson to get a voice-guided interactive electric-circuits lab
ialim0/timalens-lab.readme_summary: Lesson-in, living physics lab-out for electric circuits on any device. Muse Spark designs labs while a deterministic engine runs physics, with voice guidance, teacher view, and full Docker/CI tests.

Sherifdeji/NetOps-Lens.summary: Checks network changes against intent before deployment, read-only and safe
Sherifdeji/NetOps-Lens.readme_summary: Declares must_reach intent for baseline vs proposed snapshots, runs Batfish checks via Python pipeline with CLI and Streamlit UI. Batfish decides facts, Muse Spark investigates, Python validates every verdict.

ahammadshawki8/Momentalk.summary: Turns everyday photos into outlined objects and spoken words for nonspeaking users
ahammadshawki8/Momentalk.readme_summary: Caregiver photo app that segments people/objects and generates tappable word buttons with speech. Built with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Wonder and Muse Image with mobile frontend.

Saaoud99/ParkSpot-AI.summary: Mobile parking app to find, book, and pay for spots in Moroccan cities.
Saaoud99/ParkSpot-AI.readme_summary: ParkSpot AI shows real parking facilities with live availability and MAD pricing, booking, wallet payment, and access codes. It includes AI assistant, live map, GPS near-me, and voice search plus operator and admin consoles. Built with mobile-first frontend, Drizzle, and Alembic backend.

bamiboy237/bud.summary: Self-hosted personal agent with durable execution and approval-gated actions
bamiboy237/bud.readme_summary: Python agent with append-only event log and DBOS durable execution for crash recovery. Model calls go through fallback gateway with usage tracking. Uses Gmail/Calendar via Composio SDK and MCP with simulate mode.

Lolopenza/stepproof-studio.summary: Authors visual SOPs linking each instruction to video frames and object evidence.
Lolopenza/stepproof-studio.readme_summary: StepProof Studio is an evidence-aware workspace where instructions link to source clips, frames, and object observations. Authors correct wording and evidence then export visual guides. Built with Muse Spark and SAM 3.1, Next.js, with saved demo film and review workflow.

TheYaminak/SignBridge-AI.summary: Browser prototype recognizing few Dominican Sign Language phrases as speech and text.
TheYaminak/SignBridge-AI.readme_summary: SignBridge AI is an experimental limited-vocabulary LSRD recognizer running in browser with webcam. MediaPipe extracts 21 hand landmarks per hand for a custom k-NN classifier, then outputs Spanish/English text and speech. Stack is browser vision lib plus backend/frontend.

Shahid22Gujar/intent-to-proof-compiler.summary: Turns screen recordings and intent into executable Playwright behavioral contracts
Shahid22Gujar/intent-to-proof-compiler.readme_summary: Converts recording plus plain-English intent to human-reviewed contract, then runs fixed Playwright checks against demo checkout including double-charge bug. API + apps with SQLite persistence. Uses Meta AI for intent parsing and rule generation.

kdjkdj1234567890-bit/EvidenceDesk.summary: Answers Korean small-business questions using only verbatim quotes from user documents.
kdjkdj1234567890-bit/EvidenceDesk.readme_summary: EvidenceDesk lets owners upload support notices and tax/lease docs then asks in Korean with sentence-level citations or refusal. TF-IDF retrieval selects passages, local Meta Llama 3.2 1B selects evidence, code quotes verbatim. Pure Python stdlib server, offline, 1 CPU/2GB.

Evandher/ai-change-inspector.summary: Independently checks AI coding-agent diffs by verifying model claims against evidence.
Evandher/ai-change-inspector.readme_summary: AI Change Inspector captures Git diffs into immutable snapshots, asks Muse Spark for risk hypotheses, then deterministically verifies each citation exists. Developers record decisions in a React diff explorer with inbox and export. Provides read-only feedback to agents.

nikiiigoyal/anxious-traveller.summary: Pre-trip briefing app where a pixel goose explains weather, budget, food and news
nikiiigoyal/anxious-traveller.readme_summary: Pre-trip briefing app where users enter a destination and get one calm brief covering weather, UV, budget, sights, food and news. Frontend in src with Node server in server. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for live city briefs.

faltunik/vocal-kaka.summary: Voice-first Hinglish inventory and profit tracker for Indian kirana shops
faltunik/vocal-kaka.readme_summary: Expo Router app where shopkeepers speak Hinglish to update stock and query profit from a Postgres event ledger. Includes auth, multi-store roles, barcode scan and server voice pipeline. Uses Muse Spark for parsing and answers.

Susant07-star/ClipCraft.summary: Turns creator ideas into reviewed scripts, scene prompts, thumbnails and metadata
Susant07-star/ClipCraft.readme_summary: Short-form video studio that turns a brief into researched story, reviewed script, character direction, scene video prompts and platform metadata. Has backend, frontend and Supabase. Uses Meta AI models for generation workflow.

shahaman098/find-my-dog.summary: Searches neighborhood cameras for a lost dog with owner consent.
shahaman098/find-my-dog.readme_summary: Find My Dog is an opt-in search over neighbourhood footage for lost pets. It tracks candidates with SAM 3.1 and matches with Muse Spark on Cloudflare Workers. Includes access checks, evals and evidence logs.

Ini-Amin/OoTD.summary: Fashion discovery platform with AI photo tagging and Indonesian AI stylist chat
Ini-Amin/OoTD.readme_summary: Creator fashion platform for sharing outfits with product links, 3D mannequin and closet. Go API with web frontend. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for Magic Tag photo analysis and AI Stylist chat.

AbhiroopVerma/Pitwall.summary: F1 strategy engine that predicts rival stops and recommends pit timing to engineers
AbhiroopVerma/Pitwall.readme_summary: Tracks one car vs rival from public timing, forecasts stop laps, Monte Carlo simulates options to flag for stable call and radio phrasing. Python package with fixtures and docs. Uses Muse Spark grounded only on Pitwall numbers for Q&A.

MinervaXTech/GeoScienceAI.summary: Local map lab that reproduces papers and grades how far results can be trusted
MinervaXTech/GeoScienceAI.readme_summary: Local web app in apps/lab with satellite maps, SAM 3.1 segmentation, CHMv2 canopy analysis and paper knowledge base. Muse via Meta Model API controls map and supports reproduction workflow.

chyokore/OrderThread.summary: Human-reviewed order intake that flags overlaps before updating seller orders
chyokore/OrderThread.readme_summary: Prototype for sewing-materials sellers that keeps source beside AI proposal and flags repeat vs addition vs replacement overlaps. Requires separate confirmations to save review and apply changes. Python app with demo and verification docs.

BryanChasko/amazon-sumerian-hosts-asl.summary: Open ASL clip lexicon and Blender scripts for signing avatar hosts
BryanChasko/amazon-sumerian-hosts-asl.readme_summary: Provides 58-gloss ASL lexicon, 23 reviewed clips and Blender authoring scripts for Fiona rig. Based on Amazon Sumerian Hosts SDK and Babylon.js, exported as .glb with Muse Code subagent workflow.

munikor/glimmer-b70-cookbook.summary: Reproducible port of Muse Glimmer 30B on dual Intel Arc Pro B70 GPUs
munikor/glimmer-b70-cookbook.readme_summary: Cookbook porting Muse Glimmer 30B BF16 with draft model to 2x Intel Arc Pro B70 using Intel llm-scaler vLLM image. Uses FP8 quantization, tensor parallelism and dflash speculative decoding. Includes BetterBench reports and scripts.

curiouscatcode/tenderLens_meta_global_ai.summary: Evidence-grounded assistant to investigate public procurement tenders
curiouscatcode/tenderLens_meta_global_ai.readme_summary: TenderLens is a public procurement investigation assistant that grounds answers in tender evidence. Built with FastAPI, Streamlit and LangGraph orchestration, it uses Meta Llama 3.3 70B for analysis over tender documents.

RiyanKothari/reality-diff.summary: Persistent 3D memory of home objects from glasses and phone views
RiyanKothari/reality-diff.readme_summary: Reality Diff turns looks at a space into a persistent 3D map of objects with identity, location and history. Built with SAM 3.1 for segmentation plus Muse Spark reasoning, with Streamlit app, YAML config and eval harness.

juanmanuelcanchala-ai/genesis.summary: Turns a WhatsApp voice note into a live tested WhatsApp storefront in minutes
juanmanuelcanchala-ai/genesis.readme_summary: Genesis converts informal vendor voice notes into business profile, catalog, order form and payments on WhatsApp. Python panel and fixtures with tests for low-device users. FunnelChat entry for informal commerce.

imzaibi28/niche-scout-ai.summary: Data-backed SEO niche finder that proves winnable website ideas
imzaibi28/niche-scout-ai.readme_summary: Niche Scout AI is a research agent that finds low-competition SEO niches with hard data and verdicts. Node.js ESM agent pipeline with caching and provenance, using Muse Spark to explain the call and plan the build.

thanushri37/visionpilot.summary: Browser agent that sees screen, plans clicks, and verifies work
thanushri37/visionpilot.readme_summary: VisionPilot takes plain-English tasks, perceives the browser screen, plans actions and verifies completion with user approval. Python CLI agent built with Muse Spark via Meta Model API and Muse Code.

rjcamandona123/opencode_v2-clinepass.summary: OpenCode V2 config adding ClinePass models as a provider
rjcamandona123/opencode_v2-clinepass.readme_summary: Drop-in OpenCode V2 body that adds ClinePass as provider via Cline OpenAI-compatible API. Merges subscription catalog and free-tier models including Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, with JSONC config and plugins.

avcs06/WeaveWithAIExamples.summary: Three full apps generated from prompts by Weave with Muse
avcs06/WeaveWithAIExamples.readme_summary: Three example apps generated by Weave from short prompts into flows, design, data contract and code. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open on Baseten, coded via Muse Code and OpenCode.

Jayaudaykmar26589/unscroll.summary: Traces Herculaneum scroll surfaces in CT with SAM 3.1 without sheet jumps
Jayaudaykmar26589/unscroll.readme_summary: Scholar-guided tracing for Herculaneum Scroll 1 CT. Measures SAM 3.1 traces against hand-traced sheets and fixes first-slice jumps to stay on sheet. Includes viewer and eval on real CT slices for Vesuvius Challenge research.

Ahmed-devL/chaos-hook.summary: Deterministic tester that finds webhook failures under retries and crashes
Ahmed-devL/chaos-hook.readme_summary: Verifies webhook handlers against 27 real-SQL chaotic schedules for reordering, duplicates and crashes versus golden state. Python engine with independent verification and cached mode. Uses Muse Wonder for repair candidates and Muse Spark 1.3 for divergence explanations.

NadyKor15/billradar-meta.summary: Finds hospital billing errors and missed aid from bill photos
NadyKor15/billradar-meta.readme_summary: BillRadar reads hospital bills and EOBs from photos or video to flag errors and financial assistance. Python Docker stack with docs, eval and samples, built on Meta models for document vision and reasoning.

Mavi-lab533/auramatrix-ai.summary: Multi-agent crypto risk scorer showing measured risk stats and counter-arguments
Mavi-lab533/auramatrix-ai.readme_summary: Multi-agent crypto risk intelligence Streamlit app with transparent score, backtesting and Devil's Advocate review. Built with Python, Streamlit and matrix_engine agents. Uses Muse Spark for risk reasoning in English and Turkish for education only.

palani-unison/bar-model-tutor.summary: Voice-led Singapore bar-model tutor that draws math with kids step by step
palani-unison/bar-model-tutor.readme_summary: Live voice and whiteboard tutor for P3-P6 Singapore math from photo problems. Stack includes Modal, FastAPI, renderer and coded answer verification. Uses Meta Muse for voice teaching and step checks, not direct solving.

harsh-paresha/fieldproof.summary: Turns road photos into repair work orders with damage measurement and checks
harsh-paresha/fieldproof.readme_summary: Upload road photo and pin to detect defects, measure severity, add location context and verify repair. Pipeline uses Muse Spark 1.3 for detection plus SAM 3.1 segmentation and tool calls. Built for Rajkot with human confirmation.

Jaisev-Sachdev/tracklab.summary: Measures physics videos with frame tracking, fits and honest error bars
Jaisev-Sachdev/tracklab.readme_summary: Turns phone video of pendulum or collisions into measurements with error bars. Uses Next.js frontend, custom physics fits and SAM 3.1 frame tracking. Muse Spark agent selects targets, recovers tracking and guides next experiment.

almona02/shield-os-hackathon.summary: Tamper-evident procurement approvals with hash-chained audit and risk AI
almona02/shield-os-hackathon.readme_summary: Governance core extracted from Vertical Reality OS. Records who, where, when and approver in append-only hash chain with Meta-powered risk intelligence. Next.js + Tailwind + Supabase dashboard with live Vercel demo.

Ramsi-K/vizdoom-agent-research.summary: Tests autonomous game QA agents in ViZDoom with richer inputs
Ramsi-K/vizdoom-agent-research.readme_summary: Research on agents completing unfamiliar ViZDoom levels using progressively richer information. Evaluates navigation, progression and gameplay issues for autonomous playtesting. Uses Meta AI models with configs and prompts.

TNS0510/followthrough-ai.summary: Triages customer enquiries and drafts ready-to-send follow-up replies
TNS0510/followthrough-ai.readme_summary: Helps small service businesses triage enquiries with next action and draft response. Node/Express backend with web UI and /api/analyze-enquiry returning structured JSON. Uses Meta AI for missing-info detection and human-review flagging.

joeledford77-max/harmony-thermal-offload.summary: Llama-guided thermal offload and relay across mesh of personal devices
joeledford77-max/harmony-thermal-offload.readme_summary: On-device Rust mesh that shifts work to cool devices and piggybacks propagation. Uses thermal rules with Llama 3.2 advice, ML-KEM and ML-DSA crypto. No cloud inference with device tests and dashboard demo.

Joy-Renee/Kenyan-Sign-Language-Interpret.summary: Webcam sign interpreter for Deaf customers at mobile-money agents
Joy-Renee/Kenyan-Sign-Language-Interpret.readme_summary: Web app that recognizes a small Kenyan Sign Language vocabulary from webcam, shows understanding for confirmation, then speaks in English/Kiswahili. Simulated transactions only. Built with web vision pipeline and Meta AI speech services.

prntcena/yaadsi.summary: Turns saved links you forget into a short daily lesson
prntcena/yaadsi.readme_summary: Yaadsi ingests saved links into a corpus and generates daily 15-minute lessons via Streamlit app. Built with Muse Spark Open and Meta Model API. Demo mode with 24 public saves, no keys needed.

guru-ship-it/fleet-doc-pipeline.summary: WhatsApp pipeline that reads fleet documents and replies in driver language
guru-ship-it/fleet-doc-pipeline.readme_summary: Drivers send photos/PDFs via WhatsApp webhook with signature check and SHA-256. Media is stored encrypted, read by Meta Muse via Model API, and checked by deterministic rules to update cab records. Stack is Python app with intake/bridge modules, dashboard and tests.

mdtasnimulhoque/si-orbit.summary: Browser debugger that proposes fixes and replays to verify them
mdtasnimulhoque/si-orbit.readme_summary: SI ORBIT investigates controlled web UI failures by collecting browser logs and source evidence. It asks Meta Muse Spark to propose a repair, applies a scoped patch to a temp copy, then replays the interaction for verification. Stack is Python backend, frontend, fixtures and browser replay tests.

edaminohb/muselancer.summary: Marketplace where specialized agents can be hired by other agents
edaminohb/muselancer.readme_summary: Internet of Agents where builders teach agents a trade and other agents discover and hire them. Next.js app with agent registry, hiring and payment flow for autonomous outsourcing.

dillonzq/cpa-opencode.summary: Go plugin proxying pay-as-you-go models into OpenCode with rotation
dillonzq/cpa-opencode.readme_summary: Native CLIProxyAPI plugin for OpenCode with model discovery, four-protocol support and shared API-key rotation. Handles streaming, reasoning output and quota queries for pay-as-you-go use. Implemented in Go with YAML config, internal proxy logic and tests.

quannv/proass.summary: Live meeting companion that transcribes and surfaces insight cards unprompted
quannv/proass.readme_summary: ProActive Assistant transcribes meetings live with Muse Voice Transcribe and diarization. Muse Wonder watches transcripts to explain jargon, flag claims and capture decisions. Exports summaries and action items as Markdown, built for web with demo mode.

supercli-site/awesome-coding-plan.summary: Compares AI coding plans and API pricing with official sources and value rankings.
supercli-site/awesome-coding-plan.readme_summary: Curates domestic and overseas Coding Plans plus API unit pricing in three tables with a benchmark-based value ranking. Built as a pnpm static site with versioned data/ and docs, every price links to official sources and dates. No direct Muse integration; it catalogs model plans including Meta-adjacent options.

vilvaathibanpb/apni-gati.summary: Generates level-matched homework in local languages with red-pen grading
vilvaathibanpb/apni-gati.readme_summary: Apni Gati creates personalized homework, grades with red-pen markup, and tracks progress for primary classes. FastAPI backend with agentic grading and safety evals plus web frontend. Uses Meta Model API for generation, grading and reading.

U4AR/VoiceFlow.summary: Voice-driven browser agent that saves repeat jobs as reusable one-step flows.
U4AR/VoiceFlow.readme_summary: VoiceFlow is an Edge/Chrome extension turning repeatable browser jobs into shareable flows via a Cloudflare Worker library. Built with JS extension plus MCP server. Uses voice input and exposes flows as MCP tools for Claude Code and other agents.

Okorodavid/sales-desk.summary: Answers shop chats across four channels and links orders to ad revenue.
Okorodavid/sales-desk.readme_summary: One inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and email remembers customers, quotes price-list prices, follows up and confirms bank-alert payments. Owner uses morning brief and order board. Muse Spark powers chat, receipt and voice-note understanding.

tanishqbaweja/TrebCode.summary: Desktop AI coding workspace with verified builds, Git, terminal and browser.
tanishqbaweja/TrebCode.readme_summary: Trebell Code is a desktop workspace for building software, running commands, reviewing diffs, and browser verification. Uses Electron-style desktop plus Node tooling. Uses Trebell Native model loop with optional Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode integrations.

Rahmat-Altamis/VII.summary: Checks video claims against web evidence with verdicts and cited sources
Rahmat-Altamis/VII.readme_summary: Video Integrity Intelligence ingests files or URLs, transcribes speech, extracts claims and searches live web for evidence. Outputs supported/contradicted verdicts with citations plus AI-frame and spam checks.

Terence-Sseremba/ClassBridge-AI.summary: Live captions and study notes to help deaf students follow class
Terence-Sseremba/ClassBridge-AI.readme_summary: Mobile-first React, TypeScript, Vite and IndexedDB app with Node server proxy. Streams mic audio to Meta Muse Voice Transcribe for live captions, then uses Muse Spark 1.3 for catch-up summaries and study notes. Saves transcripts, bookmarks and notes locally in the browser.

starvingartique/FirstDue.summary: First-person paramedic training sim from dispatch to handoff
starvingartique/FirstDue.readme_summary: Vite client plus Node server proxy that holds the API key on localhost. Single-patient femoral-bleed scenario guides MARCH assessment, treatment, transport and radio handoff with debrief. Uses Muse models for patient dialogue and FTO evaluation for training only.

Gastonchevarria/oceaneye-evaluation.summary: Detects dark fishing fleets from SAR with verifiable evidence chain
Gastonchevarria/oceaneye-evaluation.readme_summary: Fuses Sentinel-1 C-band VV+VH SAR with Meta SAM 3.1 segmentation and Muse Wonder 1.0 vs Spark 1.3 reasoning. ResNet-18 ONNX inference with WebCrypto Ed25519 chain of custody for maritime surveillance. Includes benchmark harness, verify script and tactical web console.

hsirigar/meta-hack.summary: Films pendulums and falling objects to fit and ghost physics equations over video
hsirigar/meta-hack.readme_summary: Ghostline tracks phone video into calibrated time-series then fits competing physics models on first 60% only. Push the Frontier agent runs scientific method and designs the next discriminating experiment.

shivansh-png-glacier/creatoros-ai.summary: Turns one idea into hooks, captions, CTA and thumbnails
shivansh-png-glacier/creatoros-ai.readme_summary: Creator workspace where users enter an idea, platform, audience and goal to generate a structured campaign. Reviews, edits and exports a PDF brief with snapshot, hooks and thumbnails. Vite frontend with Node server proxying Meta Muse models for text and image generation.

ArdiaNova/catatai.summary: WhatsApp agent that turns notas and voice notes into sales records
ArdiaNova/catatai.readme_summary: CatatAI receives photos of handwritten notas, voice notes or Bahasa text on WhatsApp and extracts structured sales records. Reads results back for confirmation before saving to support warung bookkeeping. Python agent using Meta AI models with correction and DB layers.

AIVIETNAM-AIO-felixdoit/leaf-doctor.summary: Diagnoses leaf disease from a photo with severity and treatment advice
AIVIETNAM-AIO-felixdoit/leaf-doctor.readme_summary: Next.js app where farmers upload a leaf photo and get disease diagnosis, damage percentage and treatment steps in Vietnamese or English. Built for smallholders facing rice blast, coffee rust and leaf blight. Uses Meta AI vision-language models with mobile camera input.

danci5/avatodo-hackathon.summary: Voice-driven iPhone and Watch to-do agent with custom avatar that runs locally.
danci5/avatodo-hackathon.readme_summary: Open-source iOS 26 and watchOS 26 companion for voice to-dos and checklists with personal avatar. Local task agent runs on-device with Swift App and packages. Uses Meta Muse models for language understanding while keeping data local for privacy.

Sampada-23-00/LockSmith.summary: Finds and verifies fixes for concurrency bugs in payment code
Sampada-23-00/LockSmith.readme_summary: AI agent diagnoses six PostgreSQL fintech concurrency bugs like deadlock, lost update and double-spend. Independent verifier proves each fix before acceptance rather than trusting test reruns. Python benchmark with Muse Spark via Meta Model API and reproducible seeds.

ohdoking/futurial.summary: Simulates both life choices five years ahead, then gives one action for today.
ohdoking/futurial.readme_summary: Futurial learns a user's life decision, generates two detailed 5-year futures, then suggests one real-world action. Built with Next.js/TypeScript, uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for validation and Muse Image for future visuals.

yahiaongh/image-unit-tests.summary: Self-correcting image generator that verifies counts and layout with code.
yahiaongh/image-unit-tests.readme_summary: Extracts JSON constraints with Muse Spark, generates with Muse Image, verifies with SAM 3.1 segmentation and Python checks. Loops to self-correct and compares verifier decisions against blinded human counts.

samnitmehandiratta/avataran.summary: Ask Earth and Moon imagery questions, get masks and real-unit measurements.
samnitmehandiratta/avataran.readme_summary: Orbital intelligence agent for solar change and lunar landing analysis. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B for planning and vision on Modal H100 with vLLM, and SAM 3.1 on L40S for text-prompted segmentation.

Hyatus-Living/arosa-hackathon-launch.summary: Property research with zoning, editable plans and underwriting walkthroughs
Hyatus-Living/arosa-hackathon-launch.readme_summary: Full app combining parcel records, zoning sources, modeling and interactive walkthroughs. Uses Meta AI models for research synthesis, valuation estimates and architectural exploration.

abolu2016/AfroHydro-AI-RoadWatch.summary: Flags African road corridors GREEN/AMBER/RED from rainfall and detour data.
abolu2016/AfroHydro-AI-RoadWatch.readme_summary: Combines AfroHydro rainfall and GRIP4 roads, samples rainfall along routes with detour-ratio heuristic. Muse Spark 1.3 explains JSON evidence and uncertainty in Streamlit/Python app.

kumanorihjkl/world_debugger.summary: Turns plain-language rules into live camera violation alerts with overlays.
kumanorihjkl/world_debugger.readme_summary: Compiles natural language rules to executable DSL with Muse Spark 1.3, segments frames with SAM 3.1 to scene graph. Deterministic engine checks violations and renders overlays.

Chetan-Tai/gateward.summary: Audits doorways from phone photos for ADA accessibility with measurements.
Chetan-Tai/gateward.readme_summary: Multi-stage pipeline measures door width and flags steps, ramps and hardware from smartphone photos. Provides calibrated ADA-referenced assessment for owners and professional auditors.

stephanochse/thalamus.summary: Ranks every AI model weekly for 35 jobs and routes tools to best fit.
stephanochse/thalamus.readme_summary: Reads open leaderboards weekly, ranks models for 35 routes, serves picks to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Python system with self-check brain, rival-lab council and taste learning.

rakshakmoorthy/threadline-discovery.summary: Turns patient clothing notes into evidence-checked adaptive fashion ideas.
rakshakmoorthy/threadline-discovery.readme_summary: Four-step agent reads post-mastectomy forum notes, proposes garments with Muse Spark, verifies with Muse Wonder against citations. Code scoring ranks evidence-backed product ideas.

kritikaun/Hai-hackathon.summary: One shared family agent with permissioned memory and approval for actions.
kritikaun/Hai-hackathon.readme_summary: One agent per family with 1:1 chats, private/shared/restricted memory enforced in code. Uses Meta Muse models for memory, planning and reminders with human approval and escalation rules.

Thompson-Ace-Daniel/simultwin.summary: Builds a digital twin from business documents to test decisions and risks
Thompson-Ace-Daniel/simultwin.readme_summary: Frontend and backend app that ingests company documents and public sources into an evidence-backed org twin. Uses Meta AI models to answer questions, surface risks, and simulate strategic futures.

mission-informatics-ca/pax-demo.summary: Voice-led website greeter that answers only from a locked business knowledge pack
mission-informatics-ca/pax-demo.readme_summary: PAX is a video-presence concierge for Mission Informatics with captions, recorded voice, and typed Ask box plus live talk mode. It answers strictly from 21 scripted answers about services and process. Single-page HTML demo with locked knowledge pack.

elghaly-dev/meta-ai-hack.summary: On-device app that explains privacy policies in three plain sections
elghaly-dev/meta-ai-hack.readme_summary: Plain Privacy pastes policies or permissions and outputs what is collected, who gets it, and what to turn off. Offline rule-based check runs first on-phone with no network; optional quantized Llama 3.2 1B refines wording. PWA with service worker, no accounts or analytics.

LeDigitalDF/DynamicKey.summary: Mac login combining master password with typing rhythm and device checks
LeDigitalDF/DynamicKey.readme_summary: DynamicKey is a Mac vault app plus Safari extension replacing password-only login with password, keystroke dynamics, trusted devices and networks. Includes credential vault, security score, and Gmail risk helper DynamicShield. Meta AI only explains verdicts; auth stays local.

TechLabID/AIRA-Companion.summary: Embodied AI prototype separating perception from permission with local checks
TechLabID/AIRA-Companion.readme_summary: AIRA is a privacy-aware embodied companion where Meta perception provides evidence, a local validator checks permission, and Unity performs bounded simulation. Source-only Unity project with docs, tools, and tests. Enforces perception is not permission principle.

Dhruv2020-code/Meta-AI-Hackthon.summary: Automates 3-way invoice-PO-receipt matching with explainable audit notes
Dhruv2020-code/Meta-AI-Hackthon.readme_summary: Autonomous CFO compares vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receipts to flag quantity, price, and bank-detail mismatches. Python app generates AI-written audit workpapers while keeping human approval for payments. Uses Meta AI models for extraction and exception explanation.

Kartik-99999/project-chimera.summary: Model-free referee that verifies browser agent claims with evidence bundles
Kartik-99999/project-chimera.readme_summary: Chimera lets Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API plan and act in a real browser, then verifies with deterministic snapshot re-reading and allowlist checks. Produces sealed trace, snapshot, and action logs and counts false successes. Python harness with adapters and benchmarks.

Rebell-Leader/quill.summary: Converts handwritten weather ledgers into arithmetically checked climate data
Rebell-Leader/quill.readme_summary: Quill digitizes scanned handwritten climate tables using Muse Spark 1.3 for reading and column grounding with zoomed re-reads. Muse Wonder 1.0 adjudicates disagreements; yearly totals must match monthly sums. Python package with web viewer and held-out benchmark.

Versannon/Forge-Artisan.summary: MCP copilot acting as 3D technical artist inside Unity and Unreal
Versannon/Forge-Artisan.readme_summary: ForgeArtisan connects to live game engines via Model Context Protocol to generate editable modular assets instead of blob meshes. Python agent with CLI, MCP server, and web UI targeting Unity Editor prototype. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API.

kenopahq/kenopa-kalkan.summary: Drop-in proxy blocking indirect prompt injection in English and Turkish
kenopahq/kenopa-kalkan.readme_summary: Kalkan sits before tool-using agents with fast screen plus intent-judge pass to block injections before tool calls. Includes self red-teaming sandbox and dashboard with detection rates. Dockerized proxy with evals and fixtures built for Meta hackathon.

Kevin-Phon/sidekick-meta-hackathon.summary: Compares approved updates to suggest priorities and draft school work.
Kevin-Phon/sidekick-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Sidekick compares saved source revisions and task progress to select preparation actions and create drafts. Python backend with frontend and verification workflow. Uses Muse Spark to select actions, verify inputs, and remember progress.

harmnot/trackfud.summary: Food delivery where runners and bikers earn money while working out.
harmnot/trackfud.readme_summary: Trackfud connects customers, merchants, couriers, and admins for workout-based delivery. Stack is Go backend, gateway, and multiple frontends for customer, courier, merchant, and admin. Uses Muse Image for marketing hero and AI rails in ordering flow.

rmjudicael/jyntra-ai---financial-market-.summary: Multimodal multi-agent platform turning market complexity into insight
rmjudicael/jyntra-ai---financial-market-.readme_summary: AI financial intelligence platform with multimodal analysis, multi-agent collaboration, risk management and simulation. Web app with live demo and video. Built for trading insight with Observe-Understand-Analyze-Validate flow.

papamagattediop/kairos.summary: Auditable food-supply monitor for Senegal rice decisions.
papamagattediop/kairos.readme_summary: KAIROS reads sources and satellite images with Meta models, while code verifies quotes and computes numbers or refuses. Stack is Next.js 16 TypeScript with strict tests. Uses Meta models for source reading and tool choice, never for displayed numbers.

victorkuldeep/gravenx-meta-hackathon.summary: Graph studio to design APIs, ERDs, and integrations on canvas.
victorkuldeep/gravenx-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: GRAVENX lets architects explore Salesforce metadata, design topologies, and decompose Apex logs. Stack is Next.js on Cloudflare Workers with MCP server and WebSocket bridge. Uses headless control for terminal coding agents.

Amitakshya333/maos-ind_.summary: Offline-first plant operations workspace with Ring agent for cited work orders
Amitakshya333/maos-ind_.readme_summary: MAOS Industrial turns plant telemetry, SOPs and inspection reports into cited auditable decisions. Ring is its hackathon agent that plans, uses tools and drafts work orders after human approval. It runs on Meta's Muse Spark with offline-first desktop and terminal.

Raul99Alejandro/coresight-hackathon.summary: Automated drill-core logging from a photo of the core box.
Raul99Alejandro/coresight-hackathon.readme_summary: CoreSight photographs core boxes to produce geological logs via agents and geometry code. Stack is Python with Docker deploy and install script applying hackathon patches. Uses Meta models live for vision agents with cached demo replay.

ngetichkipkirui/nyukilens.summary: Hive-health advisor that diagnoses bee photos in English or Swahili.
ngetichkipkirui/nyukilens.readme_summary: Nyuki Lens runs SAM 3.1 segmentation by photo type then asks muse-spark-1.1 for diagnosis and one action, stored in SQLite. Stack is FastAPI + Jinja2 with no frontend build. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark 1.1 for advice.

DeLucaEnterprises/ARGUS.summary: Ranks drone photo candidates against a case brief for human review.
DeLucaEnterprises/ARGUS.readme_summary: ARGUS finds objects with SAM 3.1, checks them against a brief with Muse Spark, and ranks them on a map for verification. Stack is Python plus web UI for review. Uses SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API with human-in-loop.

Abhisht2000/OpsPilot.summary: Agentic operations workspace for event planning with approvals.
Abhisht2000/OpsPilot.readme_summary: OpsPilot creates project workspaces, generates structured plans, and executes tasks via approval state machine and budget validator. Stack is Next.js with server API route. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for JSON plans.

hoytnix/Pico.summary: Local-first desktop app to write Markdown and build static sites visually
hoytnix/Pico.readme_summary: Tauri + React + TypeScript desktop SSG with TipTap editor, MiniJinja templates, and live preview. Uses AI SDK v7 for a full-conversation Vibe assistant and model-aware template guardrails to build and export sites locally.

amansharmaa/catch-a-match.summary: Dating app with AI interviews and evidence-grounded compatibility scoring
amansharmaa/catch-a-match.readme_summary: React+Vite + Express/PostgreSQL dating app where Muse Spark interviews users, builds profiles, and scores compatibility with quoted evidence. Backend enforces scoring rules and generates first-date ideas.

El-dorado01/brisky-meta-hackathon.summary: Offline demo that finds video moments and turns them into briefs and storylines
El-dorado01/brisky-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Brisky is an event video component with an offline walkthrough on localhost:3100. Node.js app uses mock data and synthetic citations to demo moment search, source selection, and brief/storyline creation. No login, API keys, or Meta models required in demo mode.

openwork-africa/ai2-muse-edition.summary: Security reviews for Muse agent runs with key vault and signed docs
openwork-africa/ai2-muse-edition.readme_summary: Rust CLI edition built on ai2 dependency, scoped to Muse harness on Linux. Handles setup, containers, master key, and daemon. Uses Muse reviewer to audit agent runs and produce signed HTML documents locally.

jacym/Metahackathon2026.summary: Web app that matches users to the best vehicle to purchase
jacym/Metahackathon2026.readme_summary: DriveMatch is a Node.js + SQLite web app with planner, vision, and marketplace modules. Frontend in HTML/CSS/JS, backend in server.js. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for personalized recommendations and vision-based vehicle analysis.

gty3310/zhengyin-dict.summary: Open classical Chinese pronunciation dictionary with citations
gty3310/zhengyin-dict.readme_summary: Data-only repo of JSONL + SQLite with 44k chars, 54k phrases, tongjia and heteronyms, all sourced. Companion to zhengyin toolchain. Supports Meta AI classical reading TTS to resolve polyphone pronunciation in context.

rgsuarez/uplink.summary: On-device agent that restores broken network connections without cloud.
rgsuarez/uplink.readme_summary: Uplink runs locally to diagnose and fix offline computers when cloud assistants fail. Built with an agent loop, typed tools, safety gates, and replay harness. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer 30B base open weights on-device via llama-server.

LuisCastelblanco/casefile.summary: Investigates payment incidents from alerts into cited escalations
LuisCastelblanco/casefile.readme_summary: Autonomous L2 investigator turning voice notes and screenshots into verified reports via SQL, logs and metrics. Python backend with web UI and sandbox. Uses Meta Muse models to correlate evidence and cite every claim.

nokhodian/monofilm.summary: AI film studio where AI proposes shots and a human directs every production step.
nokhodian/monofilm.readme_summary: Structures AI filmmaking like a real production with human approval for story, continuity, camera and shots. Built on Meta Muse models and deployed via Cloudflare Workers with src/ frontend and schema.sql persistence. Live studio demo enforces crew-like continuity before paid generation.

biomathcode/meta_blender_ai_plugin.summary: Blender add-on for AI textures, agents, splats and cloud render
biomathcode/meta_blender_ai_plugin.readme_summary: Blender Python add-on connecting Meta Model API for textures, chat, and splat segmentation plus Modal for cloud render. Builds product sites from Blender. Uses Muse Image generation and SAM 3.1 for Gaussian splat segmentation.

sethkrisha/CorroSense.summary: AI corrosion inspection platform for infrastructure maintenance
sethkrisha/CorroSense.readme_summary: CorroSense is an AI corrosion inspection and maintenance assistant built with Next.js. It uses Meta Model API with Muse models for analysis and image segmentation. API key is configured server-side via MODEL_API_KEY in .env.local.

chiraghs/Twin.summary: Simulates factory operations with digital twin and six investigating AI agents.
chiraghs/Twin.readme_summary: Industrial digital-twin MVP models factory topology, ingests simulated telemetry, and runs six specialist agents for incident analysis. Twin Copilot on Muse Spark Responses API uses function calling with deterministic tools. Human approval required before applying plans.

EdwinKestler/ereditas.summary: AI agents execute your digital will after trusted liveness confirmation.
EdwinKestler/ereditas.readme_summary: Ereditas is a liveness-gated estate companion that carries signals and tasks after death confirmation. Multi-app architecture with Caddy, Docker and Fly deployment. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3 live.

celopez3/chefsync-meta-hackathon.summary: Snap fridge photos to get ingredient lists and structured recipe plans
celopez3/chefsync-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: ChefSync AI takes up to 4 fridge photos and returns structured recipes for single meal, batch prep or snack. theharshyadhav/Sherlock-Orbit.summary: Multi-agent investigation squad that plans, gathers and reports in one trail
theharshyadhav/Sherlock-Orbit.readme_summary: Case-file driven multi-agent system with planning, authorized gathering, debate and unified Trail report. Python stdlib server with Docker and role-based access. Powered by Team of META AI models.

bindhusreereddy/Glint.summary: Hands-free voice and camera assistant for cooking and assembly tasks
bindhusreereddy/Glint.readme_summary: Lets users ask by voice or text with camera context while hands stay on task. Frontend plus backend guidance pipeline for live scenes. Built for Build for Your World with multimodal assistance focus.

himanshu37377/Yaad.summary: Local-first personal memory that answers files with cited proof

yuansshi/meta_hackthon.readme_summary: Earshot is a voice-first mobile assistant for walking commutes using Bluetooth glasses or earbuds. Stack is iOS app plus server and web client with low-latency speech pipeline. It uses Meta AI / Muse models for conversational Q&A and proactive suggestions.
