street-spinach/kitchenless-agent-platfor.readme_summary: Agentic food network with channels, agents, guardrails, MCP layer and data stores. Docker Compose Python 3.12 stack with Postgres, evals and smoke tests. Uses multimodal AI for food decisions and budgeting.

naffenuf/sotto.summary: Meeting listener that speaks only when it truly matters
naffenuf/sotto.readme_summary: Sotto is a local web app that listens to brainstorms and interjects rarely at pauses for errors or dropped threads. Node Fastify server uses Meta APIs with wake-phrase, React Vite UI and scripted fixtures.

Luxisoft/realityos-spatial-memory.summary: Spatial memory for smart glasses to record objects and find them by voice
Luxisoft/realityos-spatial-memory.readme_summary: RealityOS saves photos, videos and records in groups in PostgreSQL with visual search. Android app plus Dockerized API, Redis and worker. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for object grounding with voice queries.

yavuzhansarmaz/pairproof.summary: Rust CLI that runs AI-assisted coding interviews in a Docker sandbox
yavuzhansarmaz/pairproof.readme_summary: PairProof is a single Rust binary with expert and candidate roles for live LeetCode-style interviews. It uses a disposable Docker sandbox and scores approach, intervention, and token efficiency. It measures directing AI tools rather than memorized coding.

kimiyo/storyspine.summary: AI writing studio that keeps serialized fiction consistent episode to episode
kimiyo/storyspine.readme_summary: StorySpine is an AI-assisted studio for designing novels and writing episodes with author-approved story memory. It architectures top-down and verifies chapters bottom-up with quote-proven findings. Frontend plus server with evals and samples.

aneudysamparo/Postor-MetaAI-Hackathon.summary: Multi-agent team that turns Dominican tenders into GO/NO-GO bids with evidence
aneudysamparo/Postor-MetaAI-Hackathon.readme_summary: Postor reads DGCP tenders, amendments and scanned pages to give an evidence-backed bid verdict plus draft proposal. It uses Muse Spark for reading and drafting, Muse Wonder for audit, SAM 3.1 for localization, Voice and Prompt Guard 2.

adeyura/jaga-fall-verifier.summary: Fall-event verifier that confirms, escalates, or clears possible falls
adeyura/jaga-fall-verifier.readme_summary: Jaga is a research prototype fall verifier for home safety built for elderly parents. It reviews selected moments and routes them through a confirm-escalate-clear alert ladder. Performance is reported on public benchmark datasets only.

PROSTLE/Someday.summary: Turns saved Reels into actionable to-do lists so plans happen
PROSTLE/Someday.readme_summary: Someday converts useful Instagram Reels like recipes and travel plans into to-do lists via a bot and web app. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and video understanding. Live on Vercel with a 3-minute demo for the Meta hackathon.

dhairyasurana007/RoadScout.summary: Dashcam plus GPS inspector that finds road hazards and prefills DOT reports
dhairyasurana007/RoadScout.readme_summary: RoadScout preprocesses dashcam video with ffmpeg, detects hazards with SAM 3.1, verifies with Muse Spark, then geotags, dedups and blurs faces. Stack is Python FastAPI, React Vite, SQLite with pytest and Playwright.

Kasalite-Technologies/fashley.summary: Turns fabric photos into outfit, shoe and bag design concepts
Kasalite-Technologies/fashley.readme_summary: Web studio where users upload fabric, pick category and style, and generate comparable design sets to save to a wardrobe. Stack uses Cloudflare, Drizzle and Next-style components; uses Muse Image 1.0 for fabric-grounded generation.

viraloyster/VIBloom.summary: Chemistry research tool where AI predicts experiments then must explain failed predictions
viraloyster/VIBloom.readme_summary: Turns a chemistry question into an assumption tree where Muse Spark predicts Oregonator BZ-reaction outcomes in advance. Deterministic solver runs experiments, judges verdicts and enforces protocol. Records replays show predictions, contradictions and discriminating tests.

KameronChambers/Skapter.summary: DM agent for service shops that quotes prices, checks stock and books slots
KameronChambers/Skapter.readme_summary: Autonomous inbox agent for mobile detailing built by a shop owner to fix missed DMs. Reads text, photos in English/Spanish, calls pricing, inventory and calendar tools. Uses Muse Spark Open with human-escalation guardrails.

muze-ai-consulting/hackaton-meta.summary: WhatsApp scam detector that investigates links and returns tested verdicts
muze-ai-consulting/hackaton-meta.readme_summary: Second Look forwards chats to WhatsApp bot and website for scam verdicts with next steps. Uses Meta models with self-chosen investigative tools, validated on 945 cases. Includes verification script, docs and live demo with quota.

rizonetech/isitlegit.summary: Email forwarding service that grades phishing and invoice fraud with evidence
rizonetech/isitlegit.readme_summary: Small-business tool that analyzes forwarded emails for phishing, impersonation and invoice fraud. Provides verdict with cited evidence in a shared demo workspace. Built on Meta models with CI-tested TypeScript codebase.

andreseloysv/Tirith.summary: Autonomous manager that enforces plans and checks for coding agents on macOS.
andreseloysv/Tirith.readme_summary: macOS app + web UI that manages coding agents via plans, code-enforced rules, and gated merges. Chat only for human decisions with full visibility. Built with Muse Spark and Muse Code, Rust backend.

DammyCodes-all/echo.summary: Replays coding-agent sessions to explain diffs and quiz you before approval.
DammyCodes-all/echo.readme_summary: Reviews agent-written diffs to summarize what shipped, deviations, and risks. Requires comprehension check before approval to build trust. Built for hackathon Indie Build for Your World track.

randallvollen-boop/Meta-Global-AI-Develo.summary: Fictional city permit demo where Muse drafts and people approve decisions.
randallvollen-boop/Meta-Global-AI-Develo.readme_summary: Fictional municipal permitting app following one permit from form to decision. Muse proposes actions, humans decide, with public record. Track Indie Build for Your World, demo on Render.

RayanBn/Bean.summary: Mac notch agent that listens to calls and files tickets and opens PRs.
RayanBn/Bean.readme_summary: Swift/SwiftUI macOS 14+ app that listens to calls in Safari toolbar. Files tickets, writes code and opens pull requests automatically. Uses Muse Spark models and Muse Code.

stevmolina/openbot-custom.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent multi-agent coding teammates.
stevmolina/openbot-custom.readme_summary: Local-first desktop workspace giving each agent workspace, queues, file transfer and messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Gemini and others via ACP. Fix for WebRTC chunk order.

Ezio99/Hack_Agent_Readiness.summary: Usability testing that sends Muse browser agents to test websites.
Ezio99/Hack_Agent_Readiness.readme_summary: Sends Meta Muse Spark browser agents to perform customer tasks on sites. Checks answers against site records, shows friction points and re-measures fixes. Live app with paired eval reports.

alyssaaa11/expertery.summary: Turns small open models into private tool experts via verified answers.
alyssaaa11/expertery.readme_summary: Fine-tuning factory that trains small models only on referee-verified answers. Proven on CAD: Muse Glimmer 30B scored 83-92% on 30-part exam. Built with Muse Spark Open, live at expertery.com.

chisom-OOO/unbluffable.summary: Hands-free voice mock interviewer that checks numbers exactly and re-drills variants.
chisom-OOO/unbluffable.readme_summary: Unbluffable is a spoken mock interviewer that transcribes answers, quotes them back, verifies math exactly and asks same-puzzle-new-numbers follow-ups. Python 3.12 web app on Render. Built with open-weight Muse Spark models for Build for Your World.

paulinoliliptec-droid/HABITA-AI.summary: Property permitting answers verified against official jurisdiction sources
paulinoliliptec-droid/HABITA-AI.readme_summary: Resolves an address to jurisdiction and authority, then answers build-permit questions only when backed by retrieved official sources. Full-stack app with backend, frontend and infra; uses Meta models with snapshotted verification for HR-001 to HR-012 modules.

chanjoongx/realroom.summary: Place real catalog furniture into your room photo without changing other pixels.
chanjoongx/realroom.readme_summary: Stages real catalog furniture into user room photos while preserving background pixels. Stack spans web frontend, backend service, catalog pipeline and Modal deployment. Uses Meta vision/generative models for placement, masking and photorealistic compositing.

ebenbaruk/meta-global-hack-2026.summary: A scrollable feed of background agent work from inbox, calendar and sales.
ebenbaruk/meta-global-hack-2026.readme_summary: Feedforward turns background agent output into approvable cards from inbox, calendar and sales. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Vitest and Playwright. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for agents, Muse Image 1.0 for visuals and SAM 3.1 for physical-world cards.

Yamile26/meta_hackaton.summary: Verifies flood reports against satellite and photo evidence to prioritize relief zones.
Yamile26/meta_hackaton.readme_summary: Centinela turns community flood reports into verified decisions for responders. Backend plus frontend with evaluation harness fuses voice notes, photos, satellite and bulletins via deterministic code verdicts. Uses Meta AI for voice transcription, extraction, vision and segmentation explanations only.

tanakaseidy3103/AgentWorld.summary: Unity visual lab to build, test and evaluate collaborative Llama agents.
tanakaseidy3103/AgentWorld.readme_summary: Unity 6 pixel-art world where three agents plan, scout and build with shared memory and Mission Control UI. Validates every Llama decision against live world state. Uses Meta Llama 3.2 3B locally via Ollama for all decisions.

0dvsh0/morpho-kernel.summary: Local-first reflex plus cortex system for adaptive autonomous robotics.
0dvsh0/morpho-kernel.readme_summary: Dual-tier robotics kernel combining fast local reflexes with online system identification and cloud cortex. Python backend with dashboard and Foxglove layout. Uses live Meta Model API Cortex for adaptation over local control.

nurnquant/reprocam.summary: Turns bug recordings with narration into failing Playwright tests.
nurnquant/reprocam.readme_summary: Converts screen recording plus narration and keyframes into steps, bug claim and generated Playwright test. Python backend with Modal web and practice store. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark for extraction and test writing.

CharanNaidu16/kinwatch.summary: Turns old phones into family cameras programmed by text or voice note.
CharanNaidu16/kinwatch.readme_summary: Lets families define watch tasks in English, Hindi or Kannada with photo-grounded confirmation and shared alerts. Stack with backend, web, phone client and fixtures. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

discoverateagency-ops/hiaigen.summary: Browser guide that watches learner screen and points to the right element.
discoverateagency-ops/hiaigen.readme_summary: End-to-end lesson for first Muse Spark API call with screen-watching overlay guidance. Next.js 14 web plus Chrome MV3 extension, Python pipeline and Supabase. Uses real Muse Spark runtime prompts and step-anchor mapping.

ZiadKhedr/SheetPilot-AI.summary: Turns Excel workbooks into analytics and purchase orders
ZiadKhedr/SheetPilot-AI.readme_summary: Parses unfamiliar Excel files, proposes mappings, coordinates sales/inventory tools. React + FastAPI + SQLite with Docker. Uses Meta Model API for proposals, Python for deterministic math.

Manjeet-pandey/heimdall.summary: Checkpoint proxy that blocks AI agents from leaking keys to the internet.
Manjeet-pandey/heimdall.readme_summary: Runs agents sealed in Docker with decoy keys, proxying all egress through a checking gateway. Uses mitmproxy, Docker sandboxes and review UI. Built with Muse Spark for policy checks, recording and leak blocking.

srthorat/CoverPilot.summary: Voice AI that fills term-life forms and verifies policy before signing
srthorat/CoverPilot.readme_summary: Two voice agents for term-life insurance: OmniCB fills forms by voice, Integrity Guardian reviews policy. Stack is voice-agent-py + browser app with typed allow-listed actions, second-model checks and deterministic verification. Uses Meta Muse Spark models.

kevintsai1202/wordblade.summary: Edit lecture videos by editing words with AI effects and re-voicing
kevintsai1202/wordblade.readme_summary: Browser and desktop editor that transcribes video to word-level timing for ripple cuts, plus AI effects, director, masks and subtitles. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Meta models via gateway. Stack is web frontend with gateway service.

ship-it-mind/impasto.summary: Co-pilot for impasto painters: concepts, paint recipes and progress checks
ship-it-mind/impasto.readme_summary: Impasto Studio Co-pilot turns ideas into hanging concepts, paint recipes in grams, steps and photo check-ins. Python backend with Node frontend, ffmpeg dictation, powered by Meta Model API for vision and guidance.

RahulJanagouda/ai-price-matcher-hackatho.summary: Grocery list AI finds price-match proof from current flyers
RahulJanagouda/ai-price-matcher-hackatho.readme_summary: MooseCart takes list by voice, text or photo and hunts flyers for exact price-match candidates with proof. Prices come only from flyer data, no model invention. Demo covers Milton stores; engine is store-driven for Canada.

berkay123001/Reflex.summary: Cheap honest browser agent costing under 1 cent per task
berkay123001/Reflex.readme_summary: Python browser agent on Muse Spark scoring 70% reachable on Online-Mind2Web 300 at under 1c per task with zero hallucinations on blocked sites. Emphasizes honest reporting, evaluation reports and low-cost inference.

GiuseppePrbst/meta-global-ai-dev-hackath.summary: Grounded multimodal guide to explore Chile's national parks, starting with Puyehue
GiuseppePrbst/meta-global-ai-dev-hackath.readme_summary: Bosque Vivo Chile is a grounded park explorer web app with API backend. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for chat, Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 for speech, and SAM 3.1 for image segmentation of park flora/fauna.

tamago-labs/wayfind-cloud.summary: Always-on AI teammates working across 100+ business apps
tamago-labs/wayfind-cloud.readme_summary: Wayfind provides isolated cloud computers that run AI teammates inside business tools, pausing when idle. Combines cost-efficient Meta open-weight models with Firecracker microVMs on AWS. Next.js frontend with serverless backend.

dabidoe/renovagent.summary: AI renovation studio that visualizes remodels with 3D mockups and cost estimates.
dabidoe/renovagent.readme_summary: Open-source studio combining AI visualization, interactive 3D mockups, material estimates and workspaces in apps/web. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Image for renders via MCP-connected agents.

SyuraMoons/Marken.summary: Autonomous marketer making daily Instagram carousels from real product photos
SyuraMoons/Marken.readme_summary: Mobile-first PWA with daily background jobs that build 3-slide carousels without redrawing products. Next.js stack with agent pipeline and Instagram integration. Uses Muse Wonder for trends and Muse Spark Open for copy and layout.

Mayank-1024/Longtail.summary: Search driving logs in English with LiDAR-verified evidence
Mayank-1024/Longtail.readme_summary: Type rare scenarios to find moments in multi-camera logs, each checked against LiDAR before display. Model proposes, geometry decides with per-sweep predicates and BEV views. Python API with configs and docs.

83Gh0st/milo.summary: Offline-first Flutter companion that aids communication and daily independence
83Gh0st/milo.readme_summary: Milo is a Flutter mobile app for communication and comprehension support with offline-first accessibility features. Frontend in Flutter with Modal-hosted backend and multimodal input. Uses Meta Muse models for conversational and vision assistance.

Dhruv-Deku/inkubit.summary: Quantum lab where AI plans circuits and exact physics verifies every number
Dhruv-Deku/inkubit.readme_summary: Inkubit turns sketches, photos and speech into quantum experiment plans and circuits with 3D Earth visualization. Backend uses exact simulation and physics invariants to verify AI outputs. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice.

dnplus/pacafe-cart-showroom.summary: 3D room that visualizes Muse shopping cart notes on shelves in real time
dnplus/pacafe-cart-showroom.readme_summary: A 3D showroom web app that polls a cart API every 2s and renders items on shelves with totals. Built with Next.js frontend and Cloudflare Worker plus Durable Object backend. Uses Meta Model API with muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 as agent brain.

arnavmabrukar/Tandem.summary: Hosted mediator that coordinates independent coding agents on one repo without collisions.
arnavmabrukar/Tandem.readme_summary: Coordinates Codex, Claude Code and other agents on one GitHub repo via MCP tools for tasks and plans. Stack with apps dashboard, services and infra, deployed on Vercel with hosted mediation.

AkashB98/agent-reliability-cockpit.summary: Read-only AI auditor that checks analytics setups and proposes safe fixes
AkashB98/agent-reliability-cockpit.readme_summary: Cockpit audits synthetic GA4, GTM and tool-call traces for schema breaks, leaks and PII without auto-applying fixes. Python agent loop drives its own audit tools with holdout grading scripts. Uses Muse Spark 1.1 via Meta Model API for reasoning.

rafiimam/DocTrust.summary: Reviewer agent that cross-checks ID documents and links evidence for humans
rafiimam/DocTrust.readme_summary: DocTrust cross-examines NID, birth certificate and bank forms for inconsistencies in Bangla, English and Hindi. Pipeline uses planner plus deterministic comparator with perturbation re-reads. Runs on hosted Muse Spark or Muse Spark Open with SAM views.

FebrianDev/Nutrimind-AI.summary: Android nutrition tracker that logs meals and activity with Meta AI
FebrianDev/Nutrimind-AI.readme_summary: NutriMind AI is a Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android app for nutrition and activity tracking. Uses Firestore and on-device features with photo and activity inputs. Powered by Meta Model API for multimodal nutrition analysis.

kouddy/edu_project.summary: Printable kids practice sheets graded by AI from handwriting photos
kouddy/edu_project.readme_summary: Practice Sheets generates daily Grade 1-6 worksheets for paper printing and grades photo uploads. Next.js app with Supabase backend and Render deployment. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 vision to read handwriting and mark against answer keys.

danieloquelis/amanuensis-ai.summary: Turns voice, singing, or sheet images into edited music scores
danieloquelis/amanuensis-ai.readme_summary: Agentic notation editor with multi-agent Band Mode for parallel instrument parts. Next.js app with audio spectrum analysis. Uses Muse Spark for score agents and Muse Voice Transcribe for talk/sing input.

uzerkayat2004-gif/book-by-the-people.summary: Crowdsourced voices woven into a book, audiobook and video book
uzerkayat2004-gif/book-by-the-people.readme_summary: Book by the People aggregates thousands of submissions into a unified book with audiobook and video editions. Next.js TypeScript app with Docker and e2e tests. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for writing, Muse Image 1.0 for art and MMS-TTS for narration.

shamas92/kaution-guard.summary: Reviews leases for illegal clauses and documents deposits with photos.
shamas92/kaution-guard.readme_summary: Audits leases across DE, UK, US-NY, FR and JP with zero-hallucination checks and SAM 3.1 damage evidence. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Voice with SHA-256 tamper-evident storage and test suite.

varunchauhan12/fixproof-muse-hackathon.summary: Sports video reuse detector that builds integrity-checked evidence packages
varunchauhan12/fixproof-muse-hackathon.readme_summary: Helps rights holders find potential video reuse via computer vision and vector similarity. Combines Meta Muse models via Model API with cryptographic integrity checks. Full investigation workflow with frontend and backend.

iMartinDav/Attma-Chatbot.summary: Biology research agent that turns questions into cited, reproducible workflows
iMartinDav/Attma-Chatbot.readme_summary: Plain-language biology agent at chat.attma.bio. Plans work and runs real tools like HPO, Ensembl VEP, UniProt, PubMed, AlphaGenome with Python sandbox. Built on Muse models with trust-gate verification and human approval.

francorobles/Fritz.summary: Raspberry Pi desk robot that guards focus and filters interruptions
francorobles/Fritz.readme_summary: Fritz is a 3D-printed desk companion with eyes, presence detection and voice interaction. Runs on Raspberry Pi 4 using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Wonder. Holds emails, reminds context, reaches you on WhatsApp.

FulltimeMasha/pathcheck-cg.summary: Career insurance agent giving an AI-proof score and upskilling roadmap
FulltimeMasha/pathcheck-cg.readme_summary: Web product scores professions 0-100 from BLS labor data and job posts plus AI exposure. Weekly watchdog agent tracks AI tools, layoffs and rules and assigns next upskilling task.

Mokshu3242/lifespace.summary: Floor-plan tester where simulated AI residents live a day in old vs new design
Mokshu3242/lifespace.readme_summary: Upload home, office or street plan and redesign with real items. AI cast simulates a day in old vs new space with scorecard. Built for Build for Your World Indie track, design signals only.

AMAN-9608/home-co-inspector.summary: Turns narrated inspection videos into visual findings and signed reports
AMAN-9608/home-co-inspector.readme_summary: Converts narrated home-inspection videos into findings with visual evidence. Uses Muse Spark for narration, Muse Wonder for independent review, SAM 3.1 for localization. Human-in-loop approval before report.

tareq7/swarmguard-alignment-apart-2026.summary: Simulator studying unsafe instruction spread between agents and defenses
tareq7/swarmguard-alignment-apart-2026.readme_summary: Pre-sprint preparation for Apart swarm alignment hackathon Nov 6-8. Small simulator and test plan for bad-instruction propagation. Status states no event-period results yet, cloned from sellerpilot-ai.

martin-fabbri/lotfit.summary: Phone yard scan that checks if a backyard cottage fits zoning rules
martin-fabbri/lotfit.readme_summary: Homeowner tool that parses city zoning code into a Neo4j Aura rulebook graph and answers fit, placement and reasoning. Phone scan plus query agent with traced clause citations. Uses Muse Spark Open agent with Muse Spark reviewer, 1120 tests.

ssbrandsma/rev2square.summary: Turns scattered hardware evidence into community-executable revival plans
ssbrandsma/rev2square.readme_summary: Indie track project to revive abandoned hardware via transparent testable plans. Laravel 13, Livewire, Tailwind, MariaDB stack pinned in WP0. Docs include PRD, implementation and deployment specs.

homemailahmed-tech/parkview-ai.summary: AI-assisted booking enquiry, room allocation and quotation helper for guest houses
homemailahmed-tech/parkview-ai.readme_summary: AI-assisted operations for independent guest houses: reads enquiries, checks capacity and pricing deterministically, owner approves. Next.js + TypeScript stack with docs and tests. Uses Meta Muse Spark for enquiry understanding plus Smart Maps concierge.

nsankeeth/carebridge-ai.summary: Symptom triage that pages clinicians and escalates until someone responds
nsankeeth/carebridge-ai.readme_summary: Patient describes symptoms typed or spoken, rules plus Meta models set urgency, clinicians paged with escalation and audited handoff. Docker Python + Node stack with frontend/backend. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe and Meta models for triage and lab PDF explanation.

Arjun7114/airlock-agent-firewall.summary: Deterministic firewall that blocks indirect prompt injection in AI agents
Arjun7114/airlock-agent-firewall.readme_summary: Quarantine plus action-gating firewall stops hijacking from untrusted data without hurting clean work. Python package with benchmarks, demo agent and CI tests. Evaluated against Muse Spark, dropping attack success from 60% to 0%.

lizxdante/awawa.summary: Photo becomes a speaking touch communication board for non-speaking people
lizxdante/awawa.readme_summary: Take a room photo, AI finds objects and outlines them, each becomes offline touch-to-speak zone in EN/ES/ZH. Static web app with multilingual docs. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image.

Mashoge/Wyrd.summary: AI dungeon master constrained by a rule engine with verifiable secret commits
Mashoge/Wyrd.readme_summary: Fantasy adventure narrated by Muse Spark via tool-call proposals enforced by a TypeScript rule engine. Secrets sealed with SHA-256 and verifiable in browser. Supports click, text and English/Tagalog voice input.

0xE1G/sensei.summary: Robot studio where skills are auto-built, tested in physics and run on laptop CPU
0xE1G/sensei.readme_summary: Kintsugi auto-generates robot skills, verifies them in MuJoCo physics and stores proven skills in a library. Python server with web UI, Optuna tuning and no GPU needed. Uses Muse Spark for code, SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Image.

Evianta/evianta-mvp.summary: TypeScript monorepo web app, API and worker with pluggable Meta AI provider
Evianta/evianta-mvp.readme_summary: Next.js web app with Express API and background worker backed by MongoDB transactions. pnpm monorepo with mock provider for local dev. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Wonder models when EVIANTA_AI_PROVIDER=muse with enforced usage limits.

changshoufeng0609-cmd/nocap.summary: Verifies earnings draft numbers against SEC filings with filing receipts
changshoufeng0609-cmd/nocap.readme_summary: Checks financial claims in earnings drafts against S&P 500 SEC filings, each verdict linked to filing evidence. Vercel deploy with evals and examples. Built for Meta hackathon Indie Build for Your World with real NVIDIA draft demo.

ayushkhanal1/Echoed.summary: Private coincidence journal that matches shared anomalies only on mutual consent
ayushkhanal1/Echoed.readme_summary: Privacy-first platform to document unexplainable coincidences with deterministic trigram matching. Next.js + PostgreSQL on AWS Amplify. Uses open-weights Muse Spark Open muse-spark-open-1026 to discover matches without exposing content.

code4srikanth/Vibe-Doc.summary: Browser slit-lamp simulator that scores trainee eye examinations
code4srikanth/Vibe-Doc.readme_summary: Describe disease, examine rendered eye and fundus, get scored for ophthalmology training. Browser client plus server with eye-model rendering. Live demo site with patient conversation flow and cataract and fundus visuals.

barslg/sourcebound.summary: Turns one brief into a full course with lectures, images, and auto-graded exercises.
barslg/sourcebound.readme_summary: Generates a complete course from a short brief using a chain of Meta-model agents for planning, lectures, images, and exercises. Code-based validators check formatting and answers with model-based correction and no LLM grading. Tutor refuses to answer outside materials.

Kylne700/torpor-muse.summary: Turns spoken working states into auto-checks that catch AI regressions mid-turn.
Kylne700/torpor-muse.readme_summary: Hooks for Muse Code where Muse Spark generates checks from user words or audio. Torpor engine runs checks at turn end and notifies AI to fix failures immediately.

viperXBest/little-rhythm.summary: Shared baby tracker that logs feeds and sleep by tap, chat or voice.
viperXBest/little-rhythm.readme_summary: Android app with backend and Supabase for two-parent baby logging. Uses Muse Spark as tool-calling agent and Muse Voice Transcribe for voice entries with predictions.

Mikiyas-Meles-Assefa/bettervid.summary: Converts prompts and documents into narrated, sourced explainer videos.
Mikiyas-Meles-Assefa/bettervid.readme_summary: Agentic pipeline on Meta models that plans, scripts, directs and renders videos with review loops. Keeps plan, script, sources, credits and costs; supports PDFs, Office and images.

jhanvi0905/proofgraph.summary: Checks claims against document packets and opens deciding clause on page
jhanvi0905/proofgraph.readme_summary: Verifies a claim against every document in a packet and highlights supporting or opposing clauses on the source page. Streamlit plus Docker app with clause-level retrieval; uses Meta AI models for claim decomposition and evidence linking.

Morningstaaar36/nearmisslens.summary: Checks intersection safety proposals against city crash records before funding
Morningstaaar36/nearmisslens.readme_summary: NearMissLens evaluates one street-safety proposal against crash history in about minutes. Python backend with web copilot produces tasks, evidence and saved results for planners. Uses Meta models for analysis with deterministic code checks and full evidence log.

Ememzyvisuals/Jagora.summary: Voice-first browser that uses real websites in Nigerian languages.
Ememzyvisuals/Jagora.readme_summary: Desktop agentic browser speaking Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Pidgin and English. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 frontend and backend that searches, reads, fills forms and pauses for approval.

pabloagar/dictalibre-meta.summary: Experimental radiology dictation with streaming transcription and review.
pabloagar/dictalibre-meta.readme_summary: Spanish radiology pilot capturing audio with Muse streaming and local Whisper OpenVINO. Adds comparative lab, glossary, templates and experimental Meta reviewer for reports.

lNatxii/Seyra.summary: Mixed-reality Quest 3 assistant that sees space and places 3D content.
lNatxii/Seyra.readme_summary: Unity headset app with PC backend holding API keys for agent logic. Uses Meta XR All-in-One SDK, MR Utility Kit and Passthrough Camera for voice-driven scene interaction.

nicopriotto/orbit.summary: Virtual fitting room that shows catalogue outfits on mannequin and you.
nicopriotto/orbit.readme_summary: Fashion e-commerce app where shoppers style mannequins and preview outfits on own photo. Uses Muse Image for try-on, Muse Spark for logic and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

Sharvil2704/rhobound-mcp.summary: Predicts a code change's production latency before deploy with signed gate
Sharvil2704/rhobound-mcp.readme_summary: Deploy gate for coding agents and CI that A/B measures changed services off production and predicts mean latency. Built in Go with MCP server, Muse Code plugin, signed pass/block verdicts and AWS test bed. Extends rhobound-cli with batch queue models and variance tests.

nodarik/TrueScene.summary: Compares new site photos against a baseline photo to flag differences
nodarik/TrueScene.readme_summary: TrueScene stores one reference photo per place then compares new photos or video frames to generate reviewable findings. Node 22 + TypeScript server and web client deployed on Fly.io. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for analysis.

godfatherc08/Praxis.summary: Robot agent that writes its own skills and self-verifies from pixels
godfatherc08/Praxis.readme_summary: Embodied agent starting from one primitive, authoring reusable skills and judging success from pixels not simulator state. Python stack with MuJoCo and LIBERO-OBJECT evaluation. Solved 10/10 tasks with 94.1% verifier accuracy and zero false positives.

spatial-intelligence/microgeographies.summary: Maps small-scale features like entrances and bins from images and video.
spatial-intelligence/microgeographies.readme_summary: Tool ingests single images, collections or video, uses EXIF GNSS when present and falls back to visual localization. Built from scratch with JS backend, workers and Blender animations. Uses Meta Spark 1.3 API to identify location from sampled frames for emergency and delivery use.

Haruna2004/vega.summary: Turns dashcam video into mapped road repairs and tenders.
Haruna2004/vega.readme_summary: MEND segments potholes and cracks with SAM 3.1, measures area in m2 and ranks by risk. Muse Spark plans scans, explains rankings and drafts work orders. Voice Transcribe converts inspector notes to ranking changes.

NC01064E/FLSportsDesk.summary: Covers sports betting markets with models and a public win-loss ledger
NC01064E/FLSportsDesk.readme_summary: Sports betting journalism desk reporting model vs market disagreement with complete graded record. Repo holds analyst models, sims, podcasts, runbooks and mirror. Focus on line movement coverage and transparent tracking over picks selling.

linda1476/fireline.summary: Transcribes fireground radio into must-acknowledge alerts for commanders
linda1476/fireline.readme_summary: Earshot turns multi-channel crew radio into triaged queue and earpiece briefs. Python server with realtime ASR and routing agent plus replay mode and eval suite. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 for ASR and muse-spark-1.3 for JSON triage.

Rishikesh0117/agentledger.summary: Permission and audit layer tracing AI agent actions for approval
Rishikesh0117/agentledger.readme_summary: Accountability pipeline between agent and tools with tracing, role permissions, second-model review and human approval. Python package with config, dashboard and tamper-evident log. Built to block prompt-injected actions like exfiltration.

Cedric-Martz/EIDA.summary: Builds auditable 3D exploded views from repair docs and device photos
Cedric-Martz/EIDA.readme_summary: Local-first Next.js studio that researches iFixit and web, intakes 3-16 photos, then generates evidence-backed 3D exploded view. Local server proxies provider calls. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 over up to 48 visual inputs for reconstruction proposals.

k3shavgupta/tikdam-hackathon.summary: Helps freelancers check purchase bills and deductions before buying
k3shavgupta/tikdam-hackathon.readme_summary: Tax-prep checker on Cloudflare Workers with React/Vite frontend and D1 metadata, homepage plus app and admin dashboard. Manual bill review with consent-gated chat. Uses Meta Model API for optional text chat, invoice extraction paused.

aditi75432/meta-pactpay.summary: AI shopping agent that reads real checkout pages with spending guardrails.
aditi75432/meta-pactpay.readme_summary: PactPay is a shopping agent where Muse models perceive checkout pages and propose actions while fixed code authorizes payments. Built as a pnpm monorepo with apps, packages, Docker Compose and PayPal Sandbox test login for checkout.

TvichiElisabeth/Stepwise_MetaHackathon.summary: Turns a narrated task video into a step-by-step SOP with annotated photos
TvichiElisabeth/Stepwise_MetaHackathon.readme_summary: Films a hands-on task once and drafts an SOP with steps, checks, warnings and photos. Uses OpenCV for frame selection, Muse Voice Transcribe for narration, Muse Spark for naming and writing, and SAM 3.1 for object boxes. Built with Streamlit and Python.

jacksonnyabera/ProofPatchAI.summary: Reproduces Python bugs, proposes patches and verifies fixes with tests.
jacksonnyabera/ProofPatchAI.readme_summary: ProofPatch AI reproduces Python failures with pytest, requests a minimal unified-diff patch from a model and re-runs tests. FastAPI backend plus Next.js UI with mock-model mode, 71 backend tests and full-journey check.

monishkajha17/evalverse.summary: Multimodal evals and observability for agents that see, hear and act
monishkajha17/evalverse.readme_summary: EvalVerse records agent steps with media, checks answers against evidence, localizes failure stage, and scores judge trust. Python 3.11 package with 155 tests, docs and examples for vision-audio-video agents.

allanhanan/EdgeForce.summary: Benchmarks and optimizes vision models for edge hardware deployment.
allanhanan/EdgeForce.readme_summary: EdgeForge benchmarks models like YOLO across edge silicon for latency and optimization guidance. FastAPI backend with ONNX Runtime and Next.js frontend, Docker Compose, using Muse Spark and Llama 3 for analysis.

DrCOde920/blaize1.summary: Local-first desktop assistant for tasks, computer use and finance work
DrCOde920/blaize1.readme_summary: Cross-platform desktop companion with consent-gated execution and local persistence. Combines task execution, computer use and reconciliation in a security boundary. Powered by muse-spark-1.3, muse-wonder-1.0 and sam-3.1.

ShubhamPP04/careloop.summary: Converts prescription photos or voice notes into Hindi care plans.
ShubhamPP04/careloop.readme_summary: CareLoop photographs a prescription or records speech, then returns dose schedule in Hindi or English. Next.js app shrinks images in-browser, transcribes via Web Speech API, and calls Muse Spark on Baseten via /api/extract.

QidiLiu/VLM_Follower.summary: Language-guided pixel-level video tracking at real-time speed.
QidiLiu/VLM_Follower.readme_summary: VLM_Follower uses WeVisOne-VL-4B on keyframes to ground language queries to boxes and masks, then SAM 2.1 propagates masks at 30+ FPS. Python streaming pipeline supports live cameras with optional SAM 3.1 backend.

praneethhere/stateproof-meta-hackathon.summary: Browser crash-lab proving duplicate bookings from mis-scoped indexes and retries
praneethhere/stateproof-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: StateProof CrashLab with in-browser SQLite booking tests, index mutation, and intent-identity study. Compares Muse, DeBERTa NLI and rule baselines on Redis Streams/NATS. Reproducible regression bundle.

VidhanGupta-01/vichitra.summary: Predicts scene-by-scene audience reaction before release.
VidhanGupta-01/vichitra.readme_summary: ViChitra scores film cuts to surface weak scenes without test screenings. Python pipeline cuts clips, collects ratings and predicts reaction via Muse API, with app.py, score_clips.py and evaluation scripts.

garygeo-19/InCharacter.summary: Role-play lessons where you practice by teaching and speaking
garygeo-19/InCharacter.readme_summary: Mobile web app for experiential learning where users role-play teacher, coach or Spanish scenarios with grading. Built with Muse Code and Meta Model API on FlashFeed knowledge packs with web frontend.

sandeepkumareeri/teacherdox-core.summary: WhatsApp board photo plus voice note becomes verified teaching record
sandeepkumareeri/teacherdox-core.readme_summary: WhatsApp-first teaching diary infra that converts board photos and voice notes into signed .tdx records. Uses SAM 3.1 to crop board and Meta models for transcription with verifiable signature system.

vincentperezzz/escort.summary: Meeting copilot that checks live talk against your notes and flags contradictions.
vincentperezzz/escort.readme_summary: Desktop overlay plus panel that collects PDFs, Drive and Notion notes per project, then listens to meeting audio and screen. Built with Python and desktop overlay UI. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and Muse Voice Transcription for live speech.

Le-n-n-ox/movemate.summary: Record a rental once, then run cleaning turnovers from that visual record.
Le-n-n-ox/movemate.readme_summary: Host and cleaner app for vacation rentals with property records, turnover checklists, and phone web UI. Stack is Docker Compose with backend API and frontend. Uses vision models for room understanding from photos.

Nurenyx/causalfly.summary: Workbench that turns questions about simulated fly brains into measured experiments.
Nurenyx/causalfly.readme_summary: CausalFly is an AI-assisted workbench for simulated nervous systems with 3D visualization. Next.js frontend plus deterministic measurement engine compares control versus intervention trials. Uses Meta AI to convert language and visual observations into controlled experiments.

reenj01/Ketchup.summary: Pairs two calendar agents via tap to negotiate and book a shared meeting time.
reenj01/Ketchup.readme_summary: Ketchup uses two pocket Dots where each user's agent reads only their calendar. Agents pair on tap, negotiate a common slot and pencil it in, demoed via Modal simulator. Built on Meta open-weight models for agentic scheduling with calendar tools.

Deen8185/hearthguard.summary: Model-independent guard that blocks prompt-injection leaks in tool-using agents.
Deen8185/hearthguard.readme_summary: Security layer for tool-using agents that scans ingested text, images and PDFs and gates tool actions. Built in Python with dual gates and tamper-evident logging. Uses Meta Muse Spark as protected agent with model-independent checks.

whizztimmy/groundtruth.summary: Classifies screen time semantically to show what your hours actually were.
whizztimmy/groundtruth.readme_summary: Always-on activity agent that classifies screen content instead of app names, with loopback-only sync for privacy. Stack includes local agent, server and web viewer. Uses open-weights Meta models for semantic classification.

Chapet/triggersift.summary: Filters disliked ASMR triggers from videos and plays a personalized version.
Chapet/triggersift.readme_summary: TriggerSift analyzes ASMR videos across 15 sound types to let users keep loved sounds and skip or remove avoided ones. It shows detections on a timeline graph during playback. Built with Python using SAM Audio and Muse Wonder for audio understanding.

AnuragVerma777/MuseRoute.summary: Cheap-first router experiment that compares Muse tiers on held-out prompts.
AnuragVerma777/MuseRoute.readme_summary: Routing evaluation harness with tune and holdout sets, format and confidence guards, and saved outcomes. Built in Python with router, notebooks and results. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer 30B tiers to measure routing policy.

Azizomezine/ConformScope.summary: Upload a floor plan to measure rooms and check wheelchair accessibility rules.
Azizomezine/ConformScope.readme_summary: ConformScope parses building plans, measures rooms and doors in metres, and checks turning circle and WC rules. Built with FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend. Uses Muse Spark plus SAM 3.1 for plan understanding.

ahmedharib/meta-global-hack.summary: Closed-loop SRE agent that diagnoses bottlenecks and verifies fixes in sandboxes
ahmedharib/meta-global-hack.readme_summary: Aegis SRE detects performance bottlenecks and breaking API changes, then tests patches in Modal micro-VMs before delivery. Python CLI and vector runners with 23 passing tests. Uses Meta Muse Spark as reasoning core.

lai2570/world-overlay.summary: Phone-camera assistant that guides furniture and kit assembly step-by-step with visual checks.
lai2570/world-overlay.readme_summary: Points phone at parts, identifies them, generates stepwise guide and verifies each step from camera view. Python server with static web client for assembly use case like mic kit. Uses Meta Model API vision plus SAM for part segmentation.

ycc209/Chapp.summary: Voice-first lab companion that identifies kit vials and walks through protocols with timers.
ycc209/Chapp.readme_summary: Finds vendor manual, structures protocol, recognizes bottles from photo/video and guides run with volumes and timers. TypeScript Vite frontend with Node server. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice and Muse Image.

caudillsabastian6-png/Fake-check.summary: Multi-signal checker for trading-card authenticity that can answer inconclusive.
caudillsabastian6-png/Fake-check.readme_summary: Combines identity lookup, front/back pixel tells, set-symbol check and model reads in agent loop. Demo is SAMPLE-labelled after Oct 28 calibration gate fail. Uses Muse Spark/Wonder reads for verification with evidence ledgers.

Mustafa-Caliskan/Meta-Guardian.summary: Cyber-physical SOC agent correlating cameras with logs to contain threats at the edge.
Mustafa-Caliskan/Meta-Guardian.readme_summary: Fuses physical presence from cameras with cyber telemetry for live quarantine and self-healing. Dockerized backend plus frontend with edge processing to avoid cloud video. Uses Meta open and multimodal models for detection.

lukaesch/anypartmade-studio.summary: Designs replacement parts from a phone photo with scale reference and verifies fit.
lukaesch/anypartmade-studio.readme_summary: Takes photo with ruler/coin, measures with SAM 3.1, generates CAD via Muse Spark and verifies with deterministic checker. Rust mesher plus Cloudflare Workers studio. Uses SAM 3.1 for measurement and Muse Spark for CAD.

albertoZurini/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.summary: Ambient desk aquarium where a duck avatar delivers messages from distant friends
albertoZurini/meta-ai-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: A desk aquarium app where friends drop in asynchronously via a duck in a submarine. Uses local SAM 3.1 for face/hand presence and Meta models at runtime. Client-server with web frontend and drawings made during hackathon.

wgravidu/Unseen-Ai.summary: Analyzes wall photos for damage with confidence and next steps
wgravidu/Unseen-Ai.readme_summary: Visual wall inspector reporting only visible observations, confidence, and next best photo. Backend + frontend on Render. Uses Meta AI vision models for cautious non-diagnostic assessment.

chuang39/admiry-agent.summary: Marketing agent turning trade job photos into verified paused Google Ads
chuang39/admiry-agent.readme_summary: Admiry runs inside Muse as a connector for roofers and remodelers to build sites and ads. It uses Muse reasoning with Python tools to verify claims, check Google policy, and create campaigns via Google Ads API.

SyedaUmmeHaani23/worldlens.summary: Compares before-and-after photos to list what you packed and what is missing.
SyedaUmmeHaani23/worldlens.readme_summary: WorldLens turns two photos into a verified pack and return checklist with evidence and confidence. Built with Streamlit and Python, it uses Muse Spark via Baseten for item detection and comparison.

miteshpanchal/paperbridge-meta-hackathon.summary: Converts scanned exam PDFs and photos into editable digital papers and diagnostics.
miteshpanchal/paperbridge-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: PaperBridge extracts questions and diagram crops from uploaded PDFs/photos into editable exams and student review. Stack is Node 24 + Python with Docker, using Meta AI API for live extraction.

Exodussubhash/Meta-Fashion-Mirror-AI-Sho.summary: Fashion storefront that finds Shopify products with personalized AI try-on previews.
Exodussubhash/Meta-Fashion-Mirror-AI-Sho.readme_summary: FashionMirror AI searches real Shopify products via Shopify MCP and shows personalized previews beside originals. Built with Next.js, FastAPI and Tailwind, using Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Image.

HarshM0210/ChronoFact.summary: Time-aware verified memory layer that keeps assistant facts current with provenance.
HarshM0210/ChronoFact.readme_summary: ChronoFact converts conversation streams into timestamped verified facts with history and fixed-context answers. Built entirely on Meta models in Python, it beats RAG on LongMemEval with local GPU inference.

acheamponge/ai-infrastructure-simcity-pa.summary: 3D simulation for siting AI data centers with research agents and site dossiers.
acheamponge/ai-infrastructure-simcity-pa.readme_summary: Playable globe and 3D sites to spec GPU fleets, crews and cooling/electrical fit-out with agent verdicts. Built with Next.js, Prisma and Vercel on Muse by Meta with SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

suryavashisth2010-ux/SiteSurgeon.summary: Scans URLs for visual UI bugs, auto-fixes a copy and verifies with measurements.
suryavashisth2010-ux/SiteSurgeon.readme_summary: SiteSurgeon detects low contrast, overflow and mobile layout bugs and verifies fixes with objective metrics. Python app with demo sites and sample runs, using vision models and browser rendering.

Pulstarter/sealed.summary: Interactive illustrated mystery with timed choices and verifiable story commitment.
Pulstarter/sealed.readme_summary: SEALED is a paced mystery where three 12-second decisions shape endings, verified by SHA-256 commitment. Monorepo with TypeScript apps/packages; demo uses a Meta-generated reviewed story with no live key.

sayerpm/MetaHackathon2610.summary: Agentic vendor review that builds extraction-risk reports for renewals
sayerpm/MetaHackathon2610.readme_summary: Evaluates software vendors from cited public and private evidence to produce renewal extraction-risk reports. Requires separately licensed left-holding.md knowledge pack; without it scoring and research are disabled. Uses Meta AI agents for extraction, research and evidence-grounded chat.

Oblivionis7999/dsh-session-stats-panel.summary: Zero-dependency sidebar plugin showing token, cost and runtime stats for DSH
Oblivionis7999/dsh-session-stats-panel.readme_summary: Local DSH Web plugin adds a session stats page with total tokens, cost by official pricing, session count and cache hit rate. Includes CPU/memory/event-loop monitoring and per-model stacked bar and donut charts in hand-written SVG. No third-party dependencies or Meta models used.

hxrhsq/CiteScreen.summary: Evidence-based resume screener that scores only verbatim lines with bias check.
hxrhsq/CiteScreen.readme_summary: CiteScreen turns a job description into a rubric and scores up to eight resumes only from verbatim evidence. Next.js + Docker app with deterministic mock mode, redacted rerun to surface bias shifts.

tedinroc/remote-hands.summary: AI agent recovers dead Linux servers using only console pixels and keyboard
tedinroc/remote-hands.readme_summary: Agent reads server console screenshots via Muse Spark native computer tool, types fixes and cycles power. Independent external prober verifies recovery via SSH login, nonce and data hash.

ykassy/muse-ar-creator.summary: Muse connector that creates touchable talking WebAR characters from a theme.
ykassy/muse-ar-creator.readme_summary: MOSHI MOSHI connector composes a character server-side via Meta Model API and publishes to HACKAR:S WebAR. Uses Node.js API, engine and player pipeline with browser creation and gallery.

qicai14/jaga.summary: Android app that detects scam calls from live speech to block fraudulent money transfers
qicai14/jaga.readme_summary: Android scam-call guardian for Malaysian families that analyzes what the caller says, not caller ID. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for live transcription and Muse Spark for scam reasoning to warn before money moves. Native app with CI and APK builds.

BenSeme/advenbook-agent.summary: Agent turns Strava outings, GPX and photos into finished adventure book drafts
BenSeme/advenbook-agent.readme_summary: Agent web app takes spoken or typed book ideas in English/French, connects Strava or GPX plus photos, and drafts an AdvenBook. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 chat and vision, SAM 3.1 for subject-safe crops, Muse Voice Transcribe, and AdvenBook MCP server. Next.js with Vercel Blob.

tareq7/merchantflow-x402-encode-solana-2.summary: x402 API letting AI agents pay for inventory with Solana devnet USDC
tareq7/merchantflow-x402-encode-solana-2.readme_summary: API implements x402 HTTP 402 payment flow for one inventory request. Verified one 0.01 test USDC payment on Solana devnet via explorer, with client-side budget cap and signer callback. Node.js service with sample data, not production payments.

tareq7/sellerpilot-paypal-ai-2026.summary: Sandbox-only PayPal checkout tester with AI order explanations for sellers
tareq7/sellerpilot-paypal-ai-2026.readme_summary: Helps sellers review orders and test checkout safely. Implements PayPal REST OAuth 2.0 and Orders v2 sandbox to create, approve and capture synthetic orders with AI explanations. No real funds, full app demo still in testing.

Harindulk/catchlength.summary: Phone-video agent measures fish lengths for Sri Lanka port sampling with audit trail
Harindulk/catchlength.readme_summary: Verifiable agent for NARA port sampling films fish on a board for 20 seconds. Measures fork and total length with Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1, cross-checks against species relationships, defers uncertain fish to an officer. Python with audit trail.

rarehotdog/closer.summary: Closet assistant that keeps outfits you love and suggests resale for the rest
rarehotdog/closer.readme_summary: Bilingual Korean-English closet app built in Seoul. Keeps desired garments, edits only what changed using owned clothes. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and sam-3.1 via Meta Model API with direct adapters.

leonardo-vanschaik/offertest-ai.summary: Agent clicks ad funnels like a shopper to verify discounts and trials with proof
leonardo-vanschaik/offertest-ai.readme_summary: Tests Meta ads before spend by clicking the funnel like a customer up to payment. Checks discounts, prices, shipping and trials with quotes and screenshots. Built on Muse Wonder computer-use, Muse Spark Open, and SAM 3.1 segmentation.

Orlandodlpz/Redact.summary: Privacy scrubber that redacts sensitive details in photos and screenshots
Orlandodlpz/Redact.readme_summary: Privacy scrubber for photos and screenshots with vision pipeline, judge eval and web app. Python backend via uv and FastAPI requiring META_API_KEY, with frontend and eval harness. Enforces safe model IDs and disables request body logging.

kranthikumark/Persona-Lab.summary: Decision-practice studio to rehearse conversations and compare alternate outcomes
kranthikumark/Persona-Lab.readme_summary: Text-first studio with fictional customer Priya, PostgreSQL sessions, transactional turns, and fork from saved snapshots. Side-by-side transcripts with light/dark Next.js UI. Supports insurance training workflows.

sho-das/kinbeat-public.summary: Scans chats, files and GitHub to find exposed secrets and verify if keys are real
sho-das/kinbeat-public.readme_summary: KinBeat scans chats, files, websites, GitHub, Drive and Slack for leaked tokens. Muse Spark Open judges findings, reads images/scanned pages, and powers chat. API plus web frontend with Slack and Drive connectors.

DjeridiY/Kepler.summary: Films physics experiments to track motion and discover predictive laws as code
DjeridiY/Kepler.readme_summary: Kepler tracks moving objects frame-by-frame with SAM 3.1 and converts pixels to meters. Muse Spark generates candidate physics functions as Python code, then tests them on unseen frames. Python pipeline built in 5 days.

KeshavRayas/JobSearch.summary: Local-first job search OS that ranks postings and tailors resumes and prep
KeshavRayas/JobSearch.readme_summary: Ingests postings from seven sources, ranks them, and drives resume tailoring, ATS-checked PDF, cover letters and interview prep. Stack is Next.js 16, Prisma + Neon Postgres, Typst WASM, Zod. Uses local OpenCode or OpenAI-compatible LLM.

OMtheMAKER/saavren.summary: Voice-first companion detecting falls and missed check-ins for elders living alone.
OMtheMAKER/saavren.readme_summary: Guardian for solo elders with voice check-ins, fall detection, BP trend alerts and family notifications. Dockerized backend + frontend + mobile app with live demo and Android APK, built for Meta Hackathon 2026 Indie track.

pranavnemani/APIShift.summary: Rewrites Python code for breaking API changes and proves fixes with tests
pranavnemani/APIShift.readme_summary: APIShift diffs OpenAPI specs, scouts affected code, and rewrites it via agent pipeline. Muse Spark handles scout, analyst, triage and PR writing with sandbox tests and heal retries. Outputs reviewable pull request.

KantLex/NovaField.summary: Self-hosted film studio on your GPU built on top of ComfyUI
KantLex/NovaField.readme_summary: NovaField is a local-or-cloud film generation studio running on ComfyUI. Provides multilingual UI, Node.js 22 stack, and agent integrations. Licensed AGPL-3.0 with docs and e2e tests.

Gokuljawahar/livingplus.summary: PG discovery and management with bookings, operations and AI assistant
Gokuljawahar/livingplus.readme_summary: LivingPlus offers public PG discovery, OTP-verified bookings, owner operations, and resident self-service. API is Express/TypeScript with Prisma SQLite; frontend is React/Vite/Tailwind. Includes role-aware AI assistant.

Roshan5105labs/Fault-Line.summary: Breaks prod-like stacks to test if AI agents can safely fix incidents
Roshan5105labs/Fault-Line.readme_summary: FaultLine injects reproducible faults, lets an agent attempt repair, blocks destructive actions via live-state guardrails, and verdicts fix reality. Includes Python harness, Docker Compose, and bench configs.

Lourdusmel-16/oncolens.summary: Offline oral-lesion photo workflow that routes referrals without diagnosing
Lourdusmel-16/oncolens.readme_summary: OncoLens lets health workers photograph lesions and answer a questionnaire; fixed protocol sets priority. SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API assist dentist review. Dentist signs every case; prototype only.

henrylee0509/beezy.summary: Six AI agents act as virtual departments for inventory, finance, HR and contracts
henrylee0509/beezy.readme_summary: Beezy coordinates six specialist agents plus an Executive Assistant for SMB operations. Built with Python backend and Next.js frontend via Docker, it uses Muse Spark 1.3 for tool-calling and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 for voice commands.

ps-aditya/anybridge.summary: Local-first MCP server turns any UI into permissioned, verified replayable workflows
ps-aditya/anybridge.readme_summary: AnyBridge provides 7 MCP tools to capture interfaces as permissioned workflows with verification and replay. Node.js/TypeScript stack with planner on Meta Muse Spark, focused on security, permissions, and no-model replay.

jveliz-08/X-Lens.summary: $7 ESP32-CAM camera that understands scenes with on-device vision and AI
jveliz-08/X-Lens.readme_summary: X-Lens pairs ESP32-CAM firmware with Rust server and vanilla JS dashboard for low-cost visual understanding. It uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, and Muse Voice Transcribe for audio.

Debokti/parity-migration-engine.summary: Migrates JSP monolith to Angular MFE with 699 deterministic checks
Debokti/parity-migration-engine.readme_summary: Orchestrates three Meta Llama 3 / Muse endpoints across migration stages. Bridges JSP to Angular MFE, JSESSIONID to Bearer, with anti-cache traversal. Enforces Maker/Checker governance and parity verification.

BharathBabu-code/RoverMind.summary: Segments Mars rover images to plan safe traversability paths with A*
BharathBabu-code/RoverMind.readme_summary: Ingests monocular Navcam/Hazcam imagery, runs zero-shot segmentation via SAM 3.1, builds hazard costmaps, and plans optimal routes with 8-way Octile A*. Python backend with frontend. Uses Llama 3.3 / Muse Spark for telemetry briefings.

ElvisClaros/physicam.summary: Turns phone slow-motion video into physics measurements with error bars.
ElvisClaros/physicam.readme_summary: Upload a motion clip, ask in plain language, get tracked trajectories and fitted physics quantities. Python CV pipeline with SAM 3.1 tracking plus web viewer. Uses SAM 3.1 for masks, Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for Q&A and uncertainty.

ottorafaelcihak/CounterForge.summary: Reliability lab that finds and proves vision-model counting failures
ottorafaelcihak/CounterForge.readme_summary: CounterForge searches controlled image edits that preserve count but break VLM counting, then packages verified failures as regression tests. Full-stack app with FastAPI, Postgres, and review workflow.

kemparajus/time-fold.summary: Compares satellite images over time and audits its own change measurements
kemparajus/time-fold.readme_summary: Time-Fold takes before/after satellite views, uses SAM 3.1 to detect objects and areas, then Muse Spark 1.2 audits detections and writes honest report with stats and annotated images.

Karthi1908/muse_newz.summary: Autonomous newsroom writes verified personalized daily broadsheet newspaper
Karthi1908/muse_newz.readme_summary: The Muse Newz uses Google ADK multi-agent newsroom to research, write, fact-check and typeset editions. Built with Python API plus app frontend, using Meta AI models and SAM 3 for layout vision.

stochianmircea/netmanagerhackathon2026.summary: Energy-aware agent turns plain English policy into safe solar network actions
stochianmircea/netmanagerhackathon2026.readme_summary: Compiles plain-English policy into network actions against real solar state with self-refusal for critical loads. Supports local Llama via Ollama by default and hosted muse-spark-1.3 via Meta API.

preetham1930/benchsight.summary: Hands-free glasses copilot guiding laptop motherboard repair by voice
preetham1930/benchsight.readme_summary: BenchSight is a hands-free repair copilot for Ray-Ban Meta glasses. It uses SAM 3.1 for board vision, Muse Spark for step reasoning, and Muse Voice for Telugu/Tamil/Hindi/English input, logging multimeter readings as evidence before diagnosis.

unim3dia/rabble.summary: Interactive pile of clay people chatting about live news you can tap
unim3dia/rabble.readme_summary: Rabble is a web toy where clay people fall, pile, and talk about today's news. It uses Muse Image to generate characters, SAM 3.1 to cut out figures, and Muse Spark to write conversations and rephrase user input.

admode-ai/admode-muse-spark.summary: Analyzes 32k winning Meta ads to suggest what brands should test next
admode-ai/admode-muse-spark.readme_summary: Admode mines Meta Ad Library data to find durable winning patterns. Muse Spark watched 32,051 video ads to recommend ideas, success likelihood, and next tests for brands. Demo is a static site with video walkthrough.

UTHANDAM/SCENESIGNAL.summary: Turns messy incident photos into evidence-grounded investigation reports
UTHANDAM/SCENESIGNAL.readme_summary: SceneSignal organizes incident photos into court-admissible reports for safety and insurance investigators. It uses SAM 3.1 for visual defect segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for evidence-grounded reporting, with FastAPI backend and frontend.

hadrienbaradel/prudence-site.summary: Landing page for Prudence scam protection app for seniors
hadrienbaradel/prudence-site.readme_summary: Prudence-site is a static single-HTML landing page for Prudence, a scam-protection app for seniors. No scripts, tracking, or forms; screenshots are from demo mode. Uses Atkinson Hyperlegible font for accessibility.

AbulkasimovBakhtiyar2006/HiveLens.summary: Auditable beehive inspection agent that counts mites from sticky-board photos
AbulkasimovBakhtiyar2006/HiveLens.readme_summary: Turns apiary sticky-board and comb photos into counts, comb composition, marked-up images and saved reports with claim checks. Streamlit app with Docker/Railway deploy and deterministic verification. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for tile interpretation.

buildtouchline/touchline-studio.summary: Turns football footage into coaching insights and player development records.
buildtouchline/touchline-studio.readme_summary: Analyzes training footage to find key moments, attach coach observations to players and track development across sessions.
