0xm0w/metavault-oss.readme_summary: Wallet where agents request capabilities and a local marshal model vets them. Daemon injects credentials per execution. Uses local Meta marshal model with deterministic policy, scope and audit layers.

tikoci/routeros-muse.summary: Chat workspace that grounds a coding agent on live RouterOS routers and docs.
tikoci/routeros-muse.readme_summary: Workspace-based network tool combining quickchr, centrs, and rosetta for device access and RouterOS knowledge. Provides a browser chat UI to inspect routers, run reads, and render results. Built for Meta Muse Code agent workflows.

HimanshuSolo/ml-doctor.summary: Reproduces and patches broken ML training scripts with verified fixes
HimanshuSolo/ml-doctor.readme_summary: Runs training scripts k-times under telemetry wrappers to classify healthy, diverged or non-reproducible. Requests strict JSON diagnosis and exact-string patches, then re-runs patched code to earn verdict. Verification gate decides success.

ruloCode/lente.summary: Glasses clip plus phone app that listens, sees, and assists in live meetings.
ruloCode/lente.readme_summary: Hardware clip for glasses paired with Android app and phone backend for live transcription, translation, and memory. Helps second-language workers with prompts and sourced recall. Built on Meta models with pnpm demo and Modal hub.

nrynss/doyle.summary: Tracks agent memory dependencies and flags stale beliefs on change
nrynss/doyle.readme_summary: Records what each agent memory rests on and flags dependent memories when evidence changes. Rust service with docs site; Meta model proposes corrections held behind human approval and guard until accepted.

Sky-walkerX/fingerpost.summary: Guides blind users fingertip to the right spot on touchscreens by voice
Sky-walkerX/fingerpost.readme_summary: Point Android phone at kiosk, say want, and get tones, speech and vibration steering to button. Sends camera frame via gateway where Meta models read screen and locate target, confirms presses and walks through multi-step orders.

yunze7373/Yori.summary: Calm local assistant that fuses schedule and context into one Now card
yunze7373/Yori.readme_summary: Privacy-first proactive assistant demonstrating calm proactivity from simulated schedule, weather, transit and memory snapshots into a Living Context with at most one NOW card. Zero-diff core, keyless weather, extensive unit and e2e tests.

lvnpred/hackathon26-proof.summary: One care engine for surgical counts, pill reading and discharge notes
lvnpred/hackathon26-proof.readme_summary: Lightday links doctor dictation and nurse photo proofs for wristband, vitals, tray counts and discharge. Built with Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice. Count-guard blocks surgery close until camera count matches.

Ani0202/etho.summary: Scores animal behavior from plain English with no training on video
Ani0202/etho.readme_summary: Defines behaviors in plain English and scores video with no training using SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Spark Open. Evaluated once on CalMS21 official test set at 0.58 F1, 0.88x real-time, $11.25 per hour. Make demo runs with no keys.

snowcodeer/bevell-3d.summary: Builds true-size 3D CAD models and printable grippers from phone photos.
snowcodeer/bevell-3d.readme_summary: Generates editable feature trees, smooth NURBS, and printable holders from phone photos for custom robot grippers. Tested in MuJoCo simulation with Fusion bridge and Modal deployment. Uses Meta AI vision models for photo-to-3D reconstruction.

flarelink-in/wexy.summary: Browser studio to describe, generate and film living 3D worlds on GPU
flarelink-in/wexy.readme_summary: Wexy lets users describe worlds that Meta models plan into constrained GPU functions, validated before NullGraph rendering. Users adjust camera, capture stills, export video in multiple formats. Frontend plus backend, runs locally with Meta API key.

thisisvaze/maple.summary: iPad pencil notebook where handwritten questions and boxes get AI answers and diagrams.
thisisvaze/maple.readme_summary: Native iPadOS notebook for Apple Pencil thinkers that answers handwritten ? prompts and fills drawn boxes with diagrams. Built with XcodeGen SwiftUI app plus validation tools. Uses Meta Muse models for handwriting understanding and sketch generation.

UtsavInTech/upgrade-gate.summary: Replays tasks on old vs new Muse models to give GO, NO-GO upgrade verdicts.
UtsavInTech/upgrade-gate.readme_summary: Cost-aware statistical gate that replays user tasks on old and new Muse Spark versions with repeats and blocks PRs on regression. Runs as Docker app and GitHub Action with evidence store. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.2 vs 1.3 comparison harness.

brian-mwirigi/stormgate-zero.summary: Controls city floodgates with radar and models to stop sewage overflow.
brian-mwirigi/stormgate-zero.readme_summary: Model-predictive controller for combined-sewer floodgates using NEXRAD radar and EPA SWMM5 DYNWAVE simulation with SHA-256 verified traces. Python backend plus frontend dashboard. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3, Wonder, Voice, Image and Glimmer.

anggarabudiyantooo-hub/firewatch-id.summary: Verifiable Indonesia fire and haze intelligence linking public data to smoke risk.
anggarabudiyantooo-hub/firewatch-id.readme_summary: SIAGA.ID answers if grey skies match public fire data, where smoke travels, and shares verifiable briefs. Built as public-interest tool with API, admin-ui, and evals referencing BMKG, BNPB, PVMBG. Uses Meta AI layer for verifiable summarization.

itemiral/Tomo.summary: Personal super-intelligence companion app built on Next.js and Supabase.
itemiral/Tomo.readme_summary: Tomo is a personal AI companion web app carrying super intelligence with the user. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase and Playwright e2e tests, deployed on Vercel. Uses Meta AI models for conversational assistance.

MKhalafHammad/Parsewright.summary: Generates tested CIM-compliant Splunk add-ons from raw sample logs.
MKhalafHammad/Parsewright.readme_summary: Agentic pipeline from raw logs to line-breaking, timestamping and CIM-mapped Splunk add-on verified by Splunk itself. Python engine with Docker Splunk lab and CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark agents to propose parsers and tests.

enfp-dev-studio/this-and-that.summary: Edit AI images by circling and speaking; only marked regions change
enfp-dev-studio/this-and-that.readme_summary: Web app for localized image refinement via simultaneous sketch plus speech, with a beta 3D sketch-to-model mode. Stack is Vite + TS + server, using Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Voice Transcribe.

hemayuva308-rgb/qyrixxsentinel.summary: Deterministic guard that blocks risky AI tool calls before execution.
hemayuva308-rgb/qyrixxsentinel.readme_summary: Deterministic default-deny checkpoint between AI agents and tools. Backend/frontend with Docker egress/observer modes issues single-use grants and verifiable evidence logs. Meta Llama classifies untrusted instructions but cannot allow actions; enforcement is policy.

afif-fahim/pocketdokani.summary: Bangla voice and vision copilot that turns Messenger chats into courier-ready orders
afif-fahim/pocketdokani.readme_summary: PocketDokani is a phone web app for Bangladeshi Messenger sellers that converts chat screenshots into source-linked order drafts, parcel checks and courier bookings. Built with Dockerized Python backend, Alembic and web frontend. Uses Muse models for Bangla Q&A, vision parsing and price/COD extraction with seller approval.

999thelastpage/Image-Recall.summary: Fuzzy photo search that finds the image you describe even with wrong details
999thelastpage/Image-Recall.readme_summary: Recall searches a 5,000-photo library from free-text descriptions with mistaken details. It doubts each clue, searches alternate interpretations, grounds objects visually, and asks up to three one-tap questions. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Meta vision models for grounding, deployed on Modal.

Passavee-Losripat/medero.summary: Medical companion that bridges language gaps without diagnosing.
Passavee-Losripat/medero.readme_summary: Medero helps non-local speakers navigate clinics via patient-approved case cards. It communicates with clinic, reads prescriptions and organizes insurance docs. Built solo for Build for Your World, no diagnosis.

vaughanlove/barter.summary: Protocol letting shopping agents trustlessly barter prices with retail vendors
vaughanlove/barter.readme_summary: barter.computer is a protocol for personal agents to negotiate prices with vendor agents. Agents with search and browsing can find best prices through the live site. It was designed and implemented during the hackathon using Muse Spark API for personal and vendor agents.

jjossa09/what-to-eat.summary: iOS food companion with Otis chat that remembers taste, spend and history
jjossa09/what-to-eat.readme_summary: iOS app with conversational recommendations backed by ML analysis of eating history and spend. Muse provides explanations while code validates suggestions. Architecture spans Swift mobile, Python API, Supabase and restaurant data.

tomasantony/sas2r-agent.summary: Agent that translates clinical SAS programs to R and verifies numbers match SAS
tomasantony/sas2r-agent.readme_summary: sas2r-agent translates clinical SAS programs to R, runs the R in a Docker sandbox, checks every number against SAS output, and self-repairs. It scores 94/100 on a real-SAS benchmark with hash-chained provenance. It uses Muse Spark as provider with a leaderboard dashboard.

keysingate/keysingate-capsule.summary: Sealed 6 MiB file that stores signed verifiable records of agent work
keysingate/keysingate-capsule.readme_summary: Rust capsule with no extraction path, exposing only signed export and status. Muse Spark agent logs steps and tool calls plus SAM 3.1 masks as signed pages for offline verification. Demo uses synthetic insurance claim with human verification.

FOwen123/homie.summary: Turns a room walk-around video into 3D measurements and furniture that fits
FOwen123/homie.readme_summary: Homie converts ~60 phone video stills into a 3D room with sizes using Muse Spark for floor-plan inference. A shopping agent proposes real Shopee Taiwan products, checks fit in code, and visualizes them in 3D and photorealistic views. Web app supports zh-TW and English.

girik-chadha/mimic.summary: Shows a robot a task once from a photo to plan and verify moves.
girik-chadha/mimic.readme_summary: Converts a photo or text goal into planned code moves with per-step checks and camera measurement. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for perception and Muse Spark 1.3 for planning for a tabletop arm.

Samirius/body-double.summary: Proactive pixel companion that nudges ADHD users with one next small action
Samirius/body-double.readme_summary: Nudgling is a proactive focus companion where a pixel creature speaks first when you drift, suggesting a sub-two-minute action. It learns from feedback and gamifies work with XP and levels. Words come from Muse Spark in cloud or Llama 3.2 locally via pi agent runtime.

sayedibrahimQ/VisorQA.summary: Autonomous visual QA agent that finds UI regressions and auto-fixes PRs
sayedibrahimQ/VisorQA.readme_summary: VisorQA is a closed-loop 5-node FSM agent detecting pixel-level UI regressions beyond DOM tests. Diagnoses root cause and commits verified CSS/React fixes to PRs. Runs in E2B micro-VMs on Meta foundation models with Docker stack.

taefednu/creative-studio.summary: Kid-safe creative studio that turns voice and drawings into pictures and stories
taefednu/creative-studio.readme_summary: Creative space for kids 5-12 to generate images from voice/text, animate drawings, and create illustrated stories. Stack with backend/frontend and evals, using Meta models for generation and safety checking of everything a child sees.

trashdeveloper/afterglow.summary: Agent that diagnoses and patches faulty RISC-V RTL until simulations pass
trashdeveloper/afterglow.readme_summary: Afterglow is a Muse Spark agent for RISC-V debug: red sim in, green sim out with no hand RTL edits. Pipeline runs collect, diagnose, explain, patch, resim and verify with waveform + text. Locked 3/3 and full 8/8 evals plus 72-fault board.

skumaroh/TestMyLanguage.summary: AI-guided Tamil and Hindi placement tests with automated scoring and reports
skumaroh/TestMyLanguage.readme_summary: Spring Boot + Vaadin app deployed for Tamil and Hindi Level 1 assessments with auth, PostgreSQL and Azure Blob. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark for assessment guidance and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech tasks.

htesd/CLIProxyAPI-devin.summary: Proxy server exposing OpenAI/Gemini/Claude APIs for CLI model accounts
htesd/CLIProxyAPI-devin.readme_summary: Proxy server providing OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex/Grok compatible endpoints for CLI accounts. Go-based service with Docker, multi-account routing, and desktop client, forked from CLIProxyAPI with Devin fixes.

sinansahincandan/hardware-scientist-meta.summary: Multi-agent team turns a paragraph into a calculated hardware concept with images.
sinansahincandan/hardware-scientist-meta.readme_summary: Expert agents and chief designer iterate with literature search, calculations and simulation. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for team, Muse Image 1.0 for pictures and SAM 3.1 for part maps via Meta Model API.

ikaymane/FocusFreeze.summary: Voice-controlled Windows app freezer that suspends distractions to save RAM
ikaymane/FocusFreeze.readme_summary: Windows 10/11 utility where user states task by voice, agent freezes unneeded apps and thaws on completion. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and Muse Voice Transcribe, with threat model and evals.

megan-chu/PrivLab.summary: Local PII scrubber that extracts structured data from medical reports via MCP
megan-chu/PrivLab.readme_summary: MCP server that de-identifies medical reports locally then extracts structured data without patient data leaving device. Includes deid/extract modules, evals and demos for high-volume clinical report processing.

FatinShadab/moonlight.summary: Local-first Windows PC investigator that builds evidence-backed forensic timelines
FatinShadab/moonlight.readme_summary: Local-first Windows forensics app with PySide6 UI that collects artifacts into verifiable evidence. Uses strict Python 3.11+, mypy and 600+ tests for reliable offline investigation workflow.

aritra-mukhopadhyay/barrierfrei.summary: Step-free transit planner that checks live lift status for wheelchair routes
aritra-mukhopadhyay/barrierfrei.readme_summary: Door-to-door public-transport planner avoiding stairs and high kerbs with live Deutsche Bahn lift status. Covers Darmstadt and Frankfurt with Python backend, published demo site and video.

Sgfhnn/Meta-hackaton.summary: Voice-first app helps blind users count Ethiopian cash in Amharic and English
Sgfhnn/Meta-hackaton.readme_summary: Birr is a voice-first Android app plus web demo that identifies banknotes from photos and answers cash questions. It uses ASR, SAM-based vision on Modal, and Muse Spark Open for reading notes, with deterministic code for totals and Amharic/English speech output.

hsinnosuketw/personal-cooking-coach.summary: Head-mounted cooking coach tracks recipe steps using video world model
hsinnosuketw/personal-cooking-coach.readme_summary: Watches HD-EPIC cooking video with V-JEPA 2 ViT-L and EK100 probe for per-second actions, HSMM step tracker, and checklist memory. Llama-based coach decides what to say and when, compared side-by-side in a web demo.

ostefani/watcherbridge.summary: Turns network change webhooks into prioritized explanations and review inbox
ostefani/watcherbridge.readme_summary: Local Go bridge that receives signed network-change webhooks and groups them into prioritized briefings. Preserves evidence in SQLite with embedded dashboard and optional Muse AI explanations. Discovery comes from SubnetLens Pro event source.

gupta19esha/ghost-run.summary: Life-sim money game where a ghost run replays your choices differently
gupta19esha/ghost-run.readme_summary: Browser life-sim game covering working life month-by-month from age 22, with counterfactual ghost-run replay. Built as Vercel + Node web app with agent-driven narrative engine and verification reports.

patbpm/deid-audit-assistant.summary: Finds and replaces identifiers in clinical text for human review
patbpm/deid-audit-assistant.readme_summary: Python tool redacts names, dates, IDs in synthetic clinical notes using Muse Spark, with evidence for each edit and doubtful cases left to reviewers. Includes scripts, tests, and evaluation docs; synthetic data only.

hermanchanai/bay-area-new-home-true-pric.summary: Calculates Bay Area new-home true price after builder incentives
hermanchanai/bay-area-new-home-true-pric.readme_summary: Collects move-in-ready listings and incentive fine print from builders across 8 Bay Area counties, converts credits and buydowns to dollars, and compares to county assessor sales. Web map plus Muse Spark agent for queries.

sergio-dev1-py/octus.summary: Local-first desktop harness for running multi-agent coding workflows
sergio-dev1-py/octus.readme_summary: Electron + SolidJS desktop app with Bun and TypeScript monorepo, SQLite ledger for agent runs. Local-first multi-agent coding harness built during hackathon with docs in English and Spanish.

FlyingManya/opportunity-compass.summary: Personalized dashboard finds hackathons, jobs and tracks deadlines
FlyingManya/opportunity-compass.readme_summary: Next.js React TypeScript app on Vercel with MongoDB Atlas for accounts and saved items. Uses Meta Model API for conversational search, web research, and artwork, plus in-app calendar for deadlines.

ikorfale/errata-whoanswers.summary: Codes AI harm cases by who actually bore the consequence
ikorfale/errata-whoanswers.readme_summary: Python-coded tracker of 46 AI Incident Database agent cases from primary sources, using frozen v24 scheme. Classifies liability to user, employer, deployer, vendor, or harmed party; made by errata AI agent.

alanism/ministry-of-tourism.summary: Turns scattered flights, screenshots and maps into shareable trips you control.
alanism/ministry-of-tourism.readme_summary: Ministry of Tourism is a trip workspace that consolidates plans, local culture, and magazine layouts. Muse AI provides reasoning via BYOK while MoT app handles data and composition. Stack is Firebase Hosting web app with local-first workspace code.

inventionsbyhamid/klipolo.summary: Mac screen recorder where you edit video by chatting and approving cuts
inventionsbyhamid/klipolo.readme_summary: Klipolo is a macOS video editor for screen recordings and clips edited via chat with Meta models. Built with Rust crates and cross-platform apps, cuts stay pending in red until Apply. Uses Meta chat models for edit instructions.

bagel-labs-beni/genita-hackathon.summary: Personal AI companion that sees your screen and follows you iPhone to Mac
bagel-labs-beni/genita-hackathon.readme_summary: Genita is an iPhone to Mac AI companion that sees what you see and personalizes from first hello. Stack spans iOS app plus server with deploy and docs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

kevin-ko-aiml/causal-zookeeper-hackathon.summary: Causal factor-research platform to test stock predictors beyond correlation
kevin-ko-aiml/causal-zookeeper-hackathon.readme_summary: Causal Zookeeper is a quantitative research platform moving strategies from thesis through ingestion, causal discovery, identification, and validation. Python stack with DoWhy, Double ML, frontend and harness. Uses LLM priors for causal graphs.

gardner/button-nz.summary: Turns NZ addresses into evidence-backed 3D granny-flat housing concepts
gardner/button-nz.readme_summary: Builds live 3D site from LINZ LiDAR, aerials and parcels, designs dwelling in Blender. Evaluator checks NZ granny-flat rules. Uses Meta models to read site and design, documented in docs/results.

itennell/Practice-OS.summary: AI co-owner for solo therapists to find referral partners and outreach
itennell/Practice-OS.readme_summary: Aeon finds local referral partners, drafts outreach and plans meetings with human approval. Next.js 16 + Postgres stack. Built on Meta Muse via lib/meta.ts for partner search and drafting.

gtanczyk/diorama.summary: Turns one sentence into a playable painted point-and-click adventure game
gtanczyk/diorama.readme_summary: Diorama turns story ideas into small point-and-click games with painted scenes, walking characters, inventory and reachable endings. Local CLI + Studio writing plain files. Uses Muse Spark for planning, Muse Image for art, SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

hadrienbaradel/scam-shield.summary: Senior-first scam checker that judges messages against your real life data
hadrienbaradel/scam-shield.readme_summary: Prudence checks emails against real orders, bank, carrier, breaches and contacts to block scams. Monorepo with 880 tests, 97% coverage, 41 seed cases. Built for Meta hackathon as privacy security gateway.

yigitcankzl/plant-agent.summary: Muse proposes plant changes, physics simulators verify, engineer approves
yigitcankzl/plant-agent.readme_summary: PlantAgent is an engineering workspace where Muse reads drawings and proposes changes re-solved by DWSIM, pandapower and others. Failed checks loop back with numbers for human approval. Muse Spark Open runs loop on Baseten and Fireworks.

pisgahhealth/hey-pisgah.summary: Voice EMR agent that turns ward speech into hospital orders and notes
pisgahhealth/hey-pisgah.readme_summary: Hey Pisgah is a clinician agent inside hospital EMR acting under its own identity via EMR APIs. Meta Voice Transcribe hears speech, Muse Spark Open on Modal routes tasks, fixed rules handle emergencies. Human pharmacist and nurse review orders.

sree1924/nova-v2-meta.summary: Automated belt turning 51 driver handbooks into 51 full exam-prep courses
sree1924/nova-v2-meta.readme_summary: PassLearnersPermit generated 255k files, 4987 videos and quizzes for all 50 states + DC in 8 days. Assembly-line lanes with validator receipts and ledger tracing to handbook pages. Built with Meta models on production belt.

airo7/airo-meta.summary: $50 robot car that detects body changes and learns new dynamics by self-experiment
airo7/airo-meta.readme_summary: AIRO is an adaptive controller for a low-cost robot car that detects body changes and runs experiments to learn a new model. Stack is Python 3.13 with a MuJoCo digital twin, onboard learning loop, and web docs site. Fleet sharing distributes validated body models across cars.

zerennn8/assemvio.summary: Voice-guided wiring assistant that checks each terminal-block wire via overhead camera
zerennn8/assemvio.readme_summary: Assemvio turns an expert wiring demo plus narration into a validated step plan for trainees. Deterministic vision code using SAM 3.1 masks and color checks issues PASS/FAIL/UNSURE. Muse Spark only compiles plans and answers questions, never sets verdicts.

HiAgencia/client-workspace-app.summary: Project-centric task manager with per-project calendars, chat actions and MCP servers
HiAgencia/client-workspace-app.readme_summary: Client Workspace organizes clients, projects, tasks, notes and decisions with inherited Google calendars per node. A Meta-model chat acts on workspace data and each project exposes an MCP server. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Google Calendar integration.

hesham88/playfellow-coop.summary: Accessibility gaming buddy that plays hard parts from English or Arabic voice commands
hesham88/playfellow-coop.readme_summary: PlayFellow-Coop lets players with limited mobility delegate game segments by voice then reclaim control. Built on the PlayFellow engine with LM Studio adapter, memory, proxy hardening and redaction. Uses Meta models for bilingual command understanding and game actions.

RextonRZ/Spoor.summary: Parcel-hub tracker that follows lost parcels on CCTV and shows proof frames
RextonRZ/Spoor.readme_summary: Spoor fuses hub CCTV video with scan logs to trace a parcel scanner-to-scanner and pinpoint loss. Frontend plus backend plus ML pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for tracking with Muse Wonder, Spark and Glimmer for reasoning. Outputs evidence frame and tracking narrative.

nicolakharvey/actual-size-step-inside.summary: True-scale gallery of public-domain paintings you can step inside and explore.
nicolakharvey/actual-size-step-inside.readme_summary: Displays 59 Art Institute paintings at catalog size with 8 walkable layered scenes. An agent inspects every scene and blocks failures from hanging with cost cards. Includes guide search and phone tilt navigation.

bohemo35-source/hanbridge-inspector.summary: Used-car inspection agent linking every finding to photos, video and OBD evidence
bohemo35-source/hanbridge-inspector.readme_summary: Hanbridge Inspector ingests walk-around photos, paint-gauge video, voice notes and OBD reports for Korean used cars. A Muse Wonder/Spark agent with SAM 3.1 and Glimmer streams tool calls and produces BUY/NEGOTIATE/WALK AWAY report. Built as Next.js app with live demo.

ranvir7123/Mentora.summary: Turns YouTube tutorials into guided lessons inside real Excel.
ranvir7123/Mentora.readme_summary: Converts tutorials and trainer demos into in-Excel lessons with mascot pointing at cells. Muse Spark authors lessons, fixed Excel-reading rules verify completion. Learn mode for students, Teach mode for company training.

facurie/Volcano_Vigil.summary: Watches Kilauea webcams to measure plumes, alert fountaining and write bulletins
facurie/Volcano_Vigil.readme_summary: Volcano Vigil segments plume and lava fountains in public webcam frames with SAM 3.1 and measures height and drift via camera geometry. A Muse Spark agent triages inspections and writes grounded bulletins. Live dashboard, Telegram alerts and replay mode included.

ANIRUDDH-001/Tabwise.summary: Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility regression testing with evidence
ANIRUDDH-001/Tabwise.readme_summary: Tests saved keyboard journeys in forms and dialogs with focus and screen-reader observations. Provides diagnosis, source patch and separate verification with local editor. Uses Muse models for diagnosis and repair review.

Team-RocketEDA/RocketIDE.summary: AI-assisted chip design IDE where every pass uses real EDA tools
Team-RocketEDA/RocketIDE.readme_summary: RocketIDE pairs an AI agent with EDA workflows to design chips in Docker. Agent tools via Model Context Protocol run real checks to produce PASS results. Runs on Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and SAM 3.1.

pardeep21/thethirdeye.summary: Hands-free voice assistant that narrates important surroundings for blind users
pardeep21/thethirdeye.readme_summary: TheThirdEye watches camera input and speaks only when something matters like currency, faces, or labels. Built with TypeScript full-stack and Caddy deployment. It uses Muse models for proactive vision understanding.

n0y0nD/QuietDesk.summary: Raspberry Pi voice companion that handles messages while you focus phone-free
n0y0nD/QuietDesk.readme_summary: QuietDesk runs on Raspberry Pi 5 with OLED, button, LEDs and voice-first companion Lumi. It manages focus sessions, urgent messages, and summaries. Built during hackathon using on-device scripts and AI voice.

EduardDumitrascu/digital-twin-watch.summary: Accessible Helsinki journey planner that checks step-free routes with evidence
EduardDumitrascu/digital-twin-watch.readme_summary: Digital Twin Watch answers wheelchair routing queries using Helsinki open data and Digitransit HSL routing. Node server.mjs app with map and citizen evidence. It uses Meta AI for natural-language explanations.

sitatec/texa.summary: Voice-first STEM tutor that talks and draws on shared whiteboard
sitatec/texa.readme_summary: AI tutor for maths, physics, chemistry where student and AI co-draw and speak on shared board. Runs on Android, iOS, macOS and Web with real-time voice, sketching and function plotting. Uses Meta AI models for speech, reasoning and whiteboard drawing.

Snestra/pi-t3-bridge.summary: Lets Pi agent run inside T3 Code with tools, cards and skill routing
Snestra/pi-t3-bridge.readme_summary: Pi package bridging Pi 1.4+ agent into T3 Code threads via MCP and delegate_task. Ships pstack/tstack skills and pi-amplike adaption for child-model delegation. Node.js 22 TypeScript.

ADI238IND/GeoAlibi.summary: Evidence workstation that tests if satellite changes survive other explanations
ADI238IND/GeoAlibi.readme_summary: GeoAlibi is a local Python research prototype for satellite change verification with exported evidence. It exercises live Muse Spark interpretation and SAM decoding. Submitted as offline walkthrough November 2026.

jeanbuntu/marine-compute-swarm.summary: Simulation of floating solar compute nodes that move to avoid clouds
jeanbuntu/marine-compute-swarm.readme_summary: Marine Compute Swarm simulates ocean solar nodes that forecast clouds and reposition for energy. Web app with TypeScript frontend, Node server and tests. Uses Meta AI for sky analysis and planning.

Paulee314/meta-hackathon-ryde-off.summary: Voice and photo bookkeeper that closes monthly books for gig drivers
Paulee314/meta-hackathon-ryde-off.readme_summary: Ryde Off reconciles payout reports, bank feeds, receipt photos and voice notes into ledger, P&L and Schedule C draft. Agentic Python plus app stack. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

LazimSarwar/Apprentice.summary: Learns a task from one video demo then checks later attempts for errors
LazimSarwar/Apprentice.readme_summary: OneShot records one tabletop demonstration as procedure then evaluates attempt videos for what went wrong and fixes. Modal-hosted web app built Oct-Nov 2026. Uses Meta Muse vision models for video checking.

sudharshan2001/loci.summary: Private 3D spatial memory for glasses and robots with on-device face and plate blurring.
sudharshan2001/loci.readme_summary: Loci captures eye-level walks, blurs faces/plates/screens, detects objects and states, and maps them in metric 3D. Answers cite observations with time, position and frames, verified before display. Uses Muse models for QA plus vision models for detection and 3D localization.

T0b0i7/NaviGarde_IA.summary: Maritime supervision cockpit for vessel inspections, emergency alerts and bulletins with human review.
T0b0i7/NaviGarde_IA.readme_summary: NaviGarde IA is a maritime operations cockpit for Benin authorities for boat inspections, sailor alerts and bulletins. AI photo inspection, voice triage and explainability feed human-required validation. Built as Dockerized web app with review workflow and public alert page.

sallvador522/clipforge.summary: Voice-controlled video editor that turns spoken instructions into verified MP4 renders.
sallvador522/clipforge.readme_summary: ClipForge is a voice-first video studio where spoken edits are planned then rendered to real MP4. Stack is FFmpeg + OpenCV rendering with ffprobe verification and local app. Uses Meta Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark for planning.

kavetics/Spaces.summary: Phone-scan home inventory that tracks items, votes and chores for Muse context.
kavetics/Spaces.readme_summary: Spaces turns 8 phone photos into a room inventory with keep/sell voting and chore tracking. Web + server app shares Spaces as context for Muse in Meta AI app. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and sam-3.1 for detection and listing drafts.

parajulitilak/resonance.summary: Phone video cable tension measurement with physics validation and engineer-signed reports.

tanmaysandhu55/meta-hackathon-blueprint3.summary: Turns 2D floor-plan images into explorable 3D Three.js scenes

ajeet-krish/gearflow.summary: Natural-language aerodynamics toolkit that sets up CFD cases in seconds

coo1white/yokoten-doctor.summary: Scans repos to show what AI agents understand before touching code

aim-do/glimmer-decide.readme_summary: Tests open-weight decision models on camera frames to pick one object in ~0.15s GPU, with probabilities. SAM 3.1 segments the choice. Includes FastAPI server, eval harness, and training pipeline for custom models.

orqan137/glpfit.summary: GLP-1 companion tracking weight, shots and photo meals by injection cycle
orqan137/glpfit.readme_summary: Weekly-shot companion for Mounjaro and Wegovy with weight, shots, meal and exercise logging. Plate Lens compares before/after photos around injection cycle. Uses Muse Spark for coaching and SAM 3.1 for meal vision.

dukemawex/clearsend-near.summary: NEAR escrow where AI verifier attests delivery before funds release
dukemawex/clearsend-near.readme_summary: Cross-border payments and bookings settled via NEAR escrow contract with AI deliverable checks. AI holds capped function-call key for attest only, never moves money. Verdict recorded on-chain for payer release.

kowstav/openos.summary: Converts public GitHub repos into blueprints and runnable browser apps.
kowstav/openos.readme_summary: Paste a GitHub URL to get AI-generated blueprint of purpose, architecture, inputs, risks and alternatives. Curated marketplace with React Flow capability graph and live GitHub metadata. Launches vetted repos as cloud apps with no local install.

AnzoBenjamin/whatif.summary: Reproducible simulator comparing paired worlds for macro and micro decisions
AnzoBenjamin/whatif.readme_summary: Builds paired-world simulations with synthetic households, modular models and calibration for decision comparison. Uses Meta Muse Spark Open via Baseten for reasoning, with evaluated worker pipeline and monorepo apps.

Erebuzzz/fieldweaver.summary: Converts plain-language missions into validated multi-robot search simulations
Erebuzzz/fieldweaver.readme_summary: FieldWeaver compiles operator missions to validated specs then runs seeded 2D swarm simulation for signal localization with safety filter. Backend FastAPI with frontend simulator and offline mode. Uses Muse-Spark-Open via Baseten Chat Completions.

ankitshah009/briefcut_aubric.summary: Verifiable AI video editor that proposes story cuts with transcripts and receipts.
ankitshah009/briefcut_aubric.readme_summary: Video editor where Muse Spark proposes story, SAM 3.1 tracks subjects, Voice Transcribe captions, Image makes covers and Wonder reviews cuts. User-corrected plans render locally via FFmpeg with probe receipts for every version.

MaharabTimon/AI-Commerce-Agent-Hackathon.summary: AI shop employee on Messenger that sells, takes orders and updates via Telegram.
MaharabTimon/AI-Commerce-Agent-Hackathon.readme_summary: AI Commerce Agent chats in English, Bangla and Banglish, searches real catalog and sends product photos. It takes oversell-proof orders and lets sellers manage business from Telegram. Built with Python on Vercel using Meta Model API and Messenger Platform.

SidPrabhudesai/denial-letter-writer.summary: Extracts denial facts and deadlines from letters to draft an appeal letter
SidPrabhudesai/denial-letter-writer.readme_summary: Overturn parses PDF or Word denial letters into payer, claim, reason and deadline with quotes plus plain explanation and draft appeal. It abstains when deadline is unstated. Python app with fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B, evals and corpus tools.

SidPrabhudesai/denial-letter-helper.summary: Converts health insurance denial letters into facts and draft appeals.
SidPrabhudesai/denial-letter-helper.readme_summary: Parses photo or PDF denial letters to extract payer, claim, denial code and appeal deadline with quotes. Explains denial in plain language and drafts an appeal letter. Uses fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B with no-guess extraction.

nhnoon/FAIR--.summary: Checks what you believe about subscriptions against what terms actually say.
nhnoon/FAIR--.readme_summary: FAIR tests user expectations against pasted subscription terms in English or Arabic. Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API reads terms, deterministic code verifies quotes and costs. Shows support, contradiction, and keep vs cancel cost.

akksa/salesie.summary: AI salesperson that turns social comments and DMs into tracked sales.
akksa/salesie.readme_summary: Salesie connects Meta accounts to an AI-native CRM linking comments and DMs to posts and products. A Muse Spark sales agent follows up, answers from catalog and sends payment links. Demoed live on Bloom and Thread Facebook Page.

DileepreddeS/medha.summary: Self-improving agent that turns recurring chores into reusable verified skills.
DileepreddeS/medha.readme_summary: Medha converts recurring chores into verified versioned executable skills that it reuses and composes. Built with Meta Muse Glimmer open-weights self-hosted on Modal and Muse Spark 1.3 as judge. Uses Modal Sandboxes for execution.

acesmile123/FieldOps-AI-Autonomous-Maint.summary: Maintenance intake assistant that drafts evidence-linked work orders for review.
acesmile123/FieldOps-AI-Autonomous-Maint.readme_summary: FieldOps AI accepts text, equipment photos and voice for maintenance intake with human-reviewed drafts. Uses Meta Muse Spark for structured analysis and Muse Voice Transcribe. Separates observations from inferences with audit events and approval.

preciousadepoju/alertcheck.summary: Verifies Nigerian bank transfer screenshots against actual account credits
preciousadepoju/alertcheck.readme_summary: AlertCheck checks vendor-submitted receipt photos against incoming payment ledger to output RELEASE, DON'T RELEASE or CHECK MANUALLY. Python agent with vision parsing, ledger matching, and boxed evidence overlay. Uses Muse vision models to extract receipt fields for ledger verification.

MurilloLog/ZeroLeft.summary: Segments and tracks surgical tools in real time to automate counts
MurilloLog/ZeroLeft.readme_summary: ZeroLeft provides real-time segmentation, classification, counting and tracking of surgical instruments for traceability. Python app with SAM 3 client and exemplar matching. Uses Meta SAM 3 foundation vision for instrument segmentation in procedures.

bhatia4404/contextgc.summary: Local proxy that prunes agent context to cut tokens and VRAM use
bhatia4404/contextgc.readme_summary: ContextGC is a local-first FastAPI middleware proxy for CrewAI/AutoGen/LangChain that deduplicates and prunes shared context while preserving prefix cache. Includes telemetry dashboard and 117 tests. Works with local Llama runtime to keep long runs in fixed window.

geobond13/lattice.summary: Orbital station simulator where AI diagnoses and repairs failed modules
geobond13/lattice.readme_summary: LATTICE simulates a modular orbital data center where a Muse agent diagnoses telemetry, inspects rendered camera frames, and commands REPAIR/SWAP/DEORBIT. Next.js + 3D scene with robot servicer. Uses Muse Spark vision, SAM 3.1 segmentation, and web search.

heisyoung/buzzedcut.summary: Three animated judges watch short videos and give scored feedback
heisyoung/buzzedcut.readme_summary: BuzzedCut lets users upload 30s clips to receive a scored judging show with dialogue, buzz-outs, and subtitles from Vincent, Rosa and Dante. Mobile web frontend with backend video pipeline. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for video analysis and Muse Voice Transcribe.

MagicRayality-LLC/amiss.summary: Quest mixed-reality physics lab where trials test wrong expectations
MagicRayality-LLC/amiss.readme_summary: Unity 6 headset client with room scan, passthrough, hand tracking and world-locked panels. Local simulation is source of truth for trials; instructor tools defined in schema/. Policy and validation done on-device during hackathon.

meta-hackathon-athena/athena.summary: Clip-on wearable that graphs what you see and hear and nudges only when needed
meta-hackathon-athena/athena.readme_summary: Athena is a wearable backend monorepo with perception, Context Engine, Active Agent, and Dreamer. Local YOLO11n and Whisper feed a per-user FalkorDB graph that replays days nightly. Camera/mic plus agent decides when to speak up.

N-Garai/Chronocut.summary: Multi-agent pipeline turns raw interviews into editable mini-documentaries
N-Garai/Chronocut.readme_summary: ChronoCut orchestrates archivist, screenwriter, director and editor agents to produce versioned Edit Decision Lists with browser timeline editing and re-render. Full-stack with auditable model telemetry. Uses Muse/media models for transcription, scripting and cutting.

jarvis0626/ReplayLab.summary: Records tutorials once then verifies AI replays with PASS/FAIL evidence
jarvis0626/ReplayLab.readme_summary: ReplayLab 3.0 captures tutorial playback and generates verifiable workflows with review, screen-share validation, and FAIL/PASS/UNCERTAIN scoring. Dockerized apps/packages with docs and demo video. Uses local Meta Llama 3.2 1B via Vulkan for workflow generation.

Anay-C/isl-bridge.summary: Two-way Indian Sign Language chat with speech and signer avatar on phone
Anay-C/isl-bridge.readme_summary: ISL Bridge translates ISL signs to English/Hindi speech and spoken words back to SAM-cut signer video with captions. Recognizes 202 signs and learns user variants from 5 samples. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

lg061870/sam-multicam-tracker.summary: Two-camera single-object tracking prototype using SAM masks and cross-view matching
lg061870/sam-multicam-tracker.readme_summary: Web dashboard plays two synchronized clips, tracks a user-selected object with SAM 3.1 masks, and asks Muse Spark 1.3 if crops match. Stack is Python backend + web frontend with demo.py and server.py. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for identity verdict.

jurayh/zombie-facts.summary: Offline benchmark measuring stale-fact use when agent memory has newer replacements
jurayh/zombie-facts.readme_summary: Generates synthetic entities with fact lifecycles and ground-truth current values, then probes actions requiring current values. Reports Zombie Rate share using superseded values. No Meta model in offline core; designed to evaluate agent memory systems.

THossen/Donk.summary: Ask who built code in plain English and get contributors with Git evidence links
THossen/Donk.readme_summary: Points at any Git repo, runs local deterministic Git history analysis, streams investigation timeline to contributor cards. Optional model for NL queries and email drafts. Stack is backend + frontend with repo map tree and blame/commit evidence inspector.

knarayanareddy/proofpilot.summary: Bounded supplier-change demo blocking payment diversion via verified read-back
knarayanareddy/proofpilot.readme_summary: Enforces Contract to Decision to Bounded Write to Independent Read-back chain for supplier-master changes. Isolates browser execution and blocks direct DB mutations to resist prompt injection. Demo uses fictional data with GitHub Pages preview and Remotion film.

Tegar234-koplox/ops-mind-ai.summary: Manufacturing ops investigator linking detections to cross-team evidence
Tegar234-koplox/ops-mind-ai.readme_summary: Manufacturing investigation platform with deterministic Go detection, Meta agent evidence selection, report and human review. Stack is Go, PostgreSQL, React TypeScript with login, SSE and audit. All records are synthetic with P0 and P1 rules.

novatron1/nova-proof-api.summary: Reasoning API combining symbolic logic and neural model with inspectable proofs
novatron1/nova-proof-api.readme_summary: Three parts: language brain frames questions, concept engine with entity ledger and memory, reasoning brain with symbolic plus FLAN-T5-small. Supervisory reasoner returns Yes/No/Both/Unknown with proof. Muse Spark used for parsing in Day 3 build.

navyabijoy/meta-hack.summary: Turns a screen recording of a web bug into a replayed Playwright test and fix PR.
navyabijoy/meta-hack.readme_summary: Gecko ingests screen recordings into contact sheets, transcribes narration, replays actions in a real browser, and generates a failing Playwright test. Muse Code then fixes the bug against that test, only merging when green. Stack includes browser replay, Playwright, Docker, and web backend.

DavidOlutayo/Clearway.summary: Chat copilot checking freight documents for clearance readiness and mismatches
DavidOlutayo/Clearway.readme_summary: Slice 1 chat intake of 1-8 photos/PDFs, case summary, cross-document consistency check. Next.js chat UI with optional Supabase in-memory fallback. Uses META_API_KEY for Muse models to parse and compare clearance documents.

blueif16/fall-zero.summary: Phone room video to tip-over verdicts, fixes and simulation for safety
blueif16/fall-zero.readme_summary: Analyzes room video to outline furniture and assess tip-over risk for kids, elderly support and quakes. SAM 3.1 segments all items, Muse Spark 1.3 describes and judges with structured output. Python pipeline with Modal apps and physics engine.

tuncaokimjohn-code/VIBESFLOW.summary: Read-only TypeScript inspector with graph and Muse security notes
tuncaokimjohn-code/VIBESFLOW.readme_summary: Read-only TypeScript TSX source inspection with evidence-linked architecture graph and conservative security findings. Provides live Meta Muse explanations for selected findings. Includes synthetic safer-pattern examples and verification tests.

shalwin04/keel.summary: Paste a URL to research, design, launch and guard Meta ads with approval
shalwin04/keel.readme_summary: Keel automates Meta ad workflows from brand research to creative design, launch and live guarding. Human approves every change. Built on Meta models with Advantage+ safety checks for small brands without agencies.

Kiro-404/Mada-Fixer.summary: Audits Arabic websites for accessibility, writes Arabic labels and fixes DOM and source.
Kiro-404/Mada-Fixer.readme_summary: Mada Fixer audits Arabic sites with axe-core plus visual review, generates missing Arabic labels with Meta models, then patches DOM and source and proves gains with measurements. TypeScript Node CLI with scripts, docs and offline eval checks. Uses Meta AI for Arabic label generation and fix proposals.

Ghavish/MoLakaz.summary: Splits household chores by free time and verifies completion with before/after photos.
Ghavish/MoLakaz.readme_summary: MoLakaz is an Expo SDK 58 app with Python FastAPI backend on Modal that allocates chores by share of free time. Before/after photos are segmented by SAM 3.1 to verify cleaning, voice input transcribed by Whisper. Uses SAM 3.1 for verification on L4 GPU.

eshu3104/squeeze.summary: Compresses decks, PDFs and JSON into LLM-ready Markdown with token savings
eshu3104/squeeze.readme_summary: Converts token-heavy slides, PDFs, pages and tool output into compact Markdown and reports tokens saved with fact-check evidence. Python package with tests and fixtures. Uses Muse Spark to describe charts/diagrams and verify facts.

reuben-idan/ProfitIdan-Guard.summary: AI CFO for African distributors that finds profit leaks and forecasts cash-flow risk.
reuben-idan/ProfitIdan-Guard.readme_summary: ProfitPilot AI investigates profit leaks, verifies financial evidence and anticipates cash-flow risk with next actions. Stack is FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend and pytest suite. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for financial reasoning and evidence verification.

joacoescobar1/dibujo-jugable.summary: Turns a kid's drawing photo plus voice rules into a playable self-tested HTML5 game.
joacoescobar1/dibujo-jugable.readme_summary: Dibujo Jugable transcribes spoken rules, segments characters with SAM and cleans sprites with Muse Image, then Muse Spark builds validated spec.json on a static game engine. Agent playtest.py plays and auto-fixes levels until winnable with live judge mode. Static HTML gallery needs no install.

yosun/WOM.summary: Turns photos into explorable 3D scenes with reproducible fidelity metrics.
yosun/WOM.readme_summary: WOM builds surroundings around key photo objects via WOMPar reference pipeline. WOMetrics evaluates fidelity, placement, camera and cost with saved evidence. Demo supports Muse, OpenAI, Gemini and others.

Aayush10016/TRACEBACK.summary: Local incident lab that reproduces Java e-commerce failures and tests Maven ZIPs in Docker.
Aayush10016/TRACEBACK.readme_summary: TRACEBACK is a local Java 17 Spring Boot plus React Vite app for deterministic e-commerce failure simulations with JPA/Flyway and Postgres/H2. Uploaded Maven ZIPs run isolated in Docker runner with real test counts. Uses backend investigation pipeline and simulation lab examples.

asoshnin/vwoosh-presentation-maker.summary: Chat assistant that turns rough ideas into branded PowerPoint decks
asoshnin/vwoosh-presentation-maker.readme_summary: Agentic assistant that converts abstract ideas into enterprise-ready PowerPoint via conversation. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3 with prompt-engineering patterns and Liquid Glass brand kits. Stack spans frontend, backend, and Python service.

hubeiqiao/ode-muse-body.summary: Gives Muse an iPad body that sees the screen and taps apps via ESP32.
hubeiqiao/ode-muse-body.readme_summary: Ode runs on a spare iPad with companion UI, sees the screen, talks with user and actuates real apps through $5 ESP32 with no jailbreak or APIs. Repo includes app-skills, devices and deploy configs with offline CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark for vision, dialogue and action planning.

Inf1nityLab/inkwise.summary: Whiteboard tutor that speaks and sketches lessons stroke by stroke
Inf1nityLab/inkwise.readme_summary: AI teacher that narrates lessons while a hand draws doodles live on a board. Go backend plus Flutter board app. Uses Meta models to write lessons, generate doodle art and locate objects for synced speech.

Naomi9964/GuardPet.summary: Floating cat pet that flags scams, calls and risky apps offline
Naomi9964/GuardPet.readme_summary: Android guardian pet with floating cat UI that scans permissions, SMS, calls and links fully offline. Kotlin app with on-device ML scoring. Uses opt-in Muse Spark only to explain alerts in plain language.

ybijay/repair-relay.summary: Relays Python failures between Meta models with verified fixes
ybijay/repair-relay.readme_summary: Local workbench for creating Python tasks and testing AI repairs with executed checks. Node + browser UI with reproducible runs. Uses Muse Spark to build/fix and Muse Wonder as fallback when checks fail.

anishxa/Page-to-Playground-Anywhere.summary: Homework helper turning photos of questions into visual play
anishxa/Page-to-Playground-Anywhere.readme_summary: Local web app for Grade 8-12 that solves photographed or typed questions with worked steps and interactive visuals. Python backend. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta API for real photos and unfamiliar questions.

Sanjay-1029/REROUTE.summary: Uncertainty-aware navigation agent that recovers from failures
Sanjay-1029/REROUTE.readme_summary: Autonomous navigation and recovery agent that diagnoses failures, scores actions and verifies outcomes. Python with PyBullet and A* pathfinding. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API for reasoning with visual evidence.

marcopaaz/inplace-app.summary: Places brand posters into filmed video with tracking
marcopaaz/inplace-app.readme_summary: Pipeline that scores placeability, finds flat surfaces, generates posters and composites them with camera tracking and occlusion. Python + ffmpeg cached jobs. Uses Muse Spark for planning, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

avcs06/WeaveWithAI-hackathon.summary: Turns rough ideas into maintainable design-system websites
avcs06/WeaveWithAI-hackathon.readme_summary: Agent that generates frontend-only apps reusing design-system components with review agents debating fixes. Docker harness with mock API. Built on Muse Spark models inside Muse Code coding agent.

michaelhartomo/lumen-boardnote.summary: Infinite spatial canvas with AI Q&A and voice pipeline
michaelhartomo/lumen-boardnote.readme_summary: Single-user visual workspace with spatial board, cards, checklists and audio understanding. Express + Vite + React with Postgres. Uses muse-wonder-1.0, muse-image-1.0 and voice-transcribe with Gemini fallback.

FortuneCasablancas/djinn-hackathon.summary: One sentence to live web game plus LiveOps economy agent
FortuneCasablancas/djinn-hackathon.readme_summary: Game builder flow from wish to instant play, taste swipe, slices, sandboxed team build and live hosting with chat edits. Go + agents architecture. Built on Muse Spark for code and Muse Wonder for LiveOps.

alrobles/wildseek-lora-adapter.summary: LoRA fine-tune recipe turning Glimmer into triage orchestrator
alrobles/wildseek-lora-adapter.readme_summary: Public SFT recipe and data for fine-tuning muse-glimmer-30b into WildSeek orchestrator for passage triage and niche-model routing. Axolotl + Fireworks serverless. Publishes adapters and HF dataset with evals.

tr8tmnvny9-lab/AnyBody.summary: Body-agnostic humanoid controller using spiking neural networks in pure Rust
tr8tmnvny9-lab/AnyBody.readme_summary: AnyBody is a body and task-agnostic humanoid control stack built in Pure Rust with 25M synapses and 1kHz biomechanics and zero PID. It uses Meta Muse Spark for task planning and SAM-3.1 for vision grounding. Crates, Python scripts and tests support simulation and control.

Mehardeep-Singh-GG/lean-meta-hackathon.summary: 9.12x knapsack compression to run Muse-Glimmer-30B in under 8 GiB RAM
Mehardeep-Singh-GG/lean-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Project LEAN compresses Meta Muse-Glimmer-30B (29.78B) for an 8.00 GiB envelope via asymmetric knapsack quantization. Repo includes audits, campaigns, experiments, preregistration and safetensors release. Built to make Muse-Glimmer-30B deployable on constrained hardware.

Fazil-24/Thalamuse.summary: Phone reader that detects waning attention and rewrites text plus visuals
Fazil-24/Thalamuse.readme_summary: Thalamuse is an attention-aware mobile reader using scroll and touch signals to infer focus loss per paragraph. Node backend calls Muse Spark to explain and rewrite text and Muse Image for visual summaries. No camera, mic or headset required.

imanandkr1/admission-truth-engine.summary: Verifies college admission cutoffs across sources to flag rank discrepancies
imanandkr1/admission-truth-engine.readme_summary: Admission Data Truth Engine cross-checks JoSAA, CSAB, MCC and third-party sources for institute, program and category mismatches. Python Flask app with SQLite, pytest suite and services layer. Uses Muse Spark Open for evidence extraction and verdicts.

asherengos/receipts.summary: Splits text into atomic claims and issues signed verifiable verdict receipts
asherengos/receipts.readme_summary: Receipts splits input into atomic claims with verbatim spans and assigns Supported, Unproven or Contradicted with thin-evidence rules. Python CLI and server fetches sources and signs receipts with Ed25519 for verification. Explicitly notes Meta integration unverified.

jenil38/negotiation-sparring-partner.summary: Practices negotiations with live AI opponent and real-time coach feedback
jenil38/negotiation-sparring-partner.readme_summary: Negotiation Sparring Partner lets users pick salary, rent or freelance scenarios for simulated practice. Streamlit-style Python app calls Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via Model API for opponent and coach roles. Dual-panel UI gives pushback and coaching each turn.

Maarmapa/visto-en.summary: Turns Instagram shop posts into citable SEO pages for AI answer engines
Maarmapa/visto-en.readme_summary: Visto en ingests creator posts where shops are tagged, transcribes reels and enriches with summaries and FAQs. Uses Muse Spark for text, Muse Image for previews and Muse Voice Transcribe for audio, publishing schema.org pages after approval. Node and Make pipeline with fixtures.

rriddhijain/FlowForge.summary: Learns SOPs from one narrated demo and verifies task execution on video
rriddhijain/FlowForge.readme_summary: FlowForge converts a narrated physical demonstration into an evidence-backed SOP and checks later attempts for missing or out-of-order steps. Dockerized backend plus web frontend with eval report on 12 videos. Uses Meta models for multimodal step grounding.

leo-guinan/meta-hackathon-proof-of-work.summary: Voice-first agent OS with time-bounded sessions plus proof-of-build logs
leo-guinan/meta-hackathon-proof-of-work.readme_summary: HumAIn OS prototype provides voice-first human-time-bounded agent sessions with contracts and reconcile loops. Repo contains timeline, git history and redacted Muse Code session as timestamped evidence. Live Meta voice-to-contract calls from Nov 2 2026.

Kintsulios/llama-persona.summary: On-device contextual ad engine that infers intent without personal data
Kintsulios/llama-persona.readme_summary: Llama-Persona analyzes active desktop app usage locally to infer commercial intent and match a local campaign catalog. Python and Streamlit dashboard uses Meta model for confidence-scored intent and guard-checked copy. 66 tests cover pipeline and privacy logic.

geetamgr/SeeAssist.summary: Mobile AI assistant that describes surroundings and reads text aloud for blind users
geetamgr/SeeAssist.readme_summary: SeeAssist is a mobile accessibility assistant combining image understanding, OCR, and voice interaction. Built with a mobile frontend in src plus backend service. Uses Meta AI capabilities for scene description, text recognition, and Q&A about the camera view.

ramakotiabhi/FACEmeInsta.summary: Trust and safety firewall for identity verification and cross-platform fraud detection
ramakotiabhi/FACEmeInsta.readme_summary: FACEmeInsta is an autonomous trust and safety firewall with cross-platform identity mesh and audit logging. Built in Python with Streamlit frontend, core engine, vision hashing, and Meta API client. Uses muse-spark-open-1026 via Baseten for high-throughput inference.

kirthi-sagar/ssd.summary: Autonomous science agent that discovers device behavior via planned safe experiments
kirthi-sagar/ssd.readme_summary: StateSmith Discovery proposes hypotheses, preregisters experiments in an append-only ledger, and builds transition graphs from measured evidence only. Stack is Python 3.12 + Next.js app with webcam/mic, ffmpeg, and Modal. Human performs all physical actions on WAIT/GO prompts.

idrisrayanchakib-dev/OmniBio.summary: Microscopy agent that segments nuclei and builds measurements and figures
idrisrayanchakib-dev/OmniBio.readme_summary: OmniBio automates microscopy analysis from image validation to nuclei segmentation, morphometry, and figure generation. It uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Wonder for cautious synthesis plus Python histogram code. Stack is Dockerized Python backend with web cockpit frontend.

tomsebastian10/devrescue.summary: Agentic debugger that diagnoses broken builds and proposes verified fixes
tomsebastian10/devrescue.readme_summary: DevRescue is an agentic developer recovery assistant for broken environments, failed builds, and regressions. Built in TypeScript/Node with Ink React TUI and defense-in-depth execution with human auth gates. Uses Meta Muse reasoning separated from verified observations.

AlexElaryan/DataBridge-AI.summary: Agentic onboarding tool that maps and validates messy supplier catalogs for import
AlexElaryan/DataBridge-AI.readme_summary: DataBridge AI turns inconsistent supplier feeds into reviewable import-ready data via semantic mapping and validation. Built with Streamlit app plus Python normalization tools on Modal dedicated endpoint. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer to propose mappings and select diagnostic tools.

karkikaruna/BINDU.summary: Travel app that identifies Nepal landmarks and teaches culture and Nepali phrases
karkikaruna/BINDU.readme_summary: BINDU turns photos of Nepal temples, signs, and landmarks into cultural analysis, follow-ups, and shareable postcards. Features Explore with AI, My Journey saves, and language learning. Uses Meta AI vision and language models for landmark recognition and Nepali tutoring.

danhe6/show-me-once.summary: Camera coach that teaches life skills stepwise and logs IEP-ready progress data
danhe6/show-me-once.readme_summary: Show Me Once breaks life skills into steps, coaches special-education students via camera, and records prompting levels for teachers. Built in Python with live agents for watch, clarify, and marking. Uses Meta models for step-by-step visual guidance and data-sheet generation.

Karinaislam/persona-explainer.summary: Personalized explainer that turns any question into lessons and narrated videos
Karinaislam/persona-explainer.readme_summary: Persona Explainer adapts explanations, lessons, and 30-sec videos to age and interests, then self-scores them. Built with Next.js frontend, lib prompts, and video generation pipeline. Built entirely on Meta models for persona adaptation, video creation, and verification.

Eswar-deep/agent-time-machine.summary: Local debugger that records, rewinds and branches AI coding-agent runs.
Eswar-deep/agent-time-machine.readme_summary: Records agent tool actions with checkpoints to rewind, branch from the same point and compare code and test results. Python backend + Node frontend with fixtures, evidence and Playwright validation around a timestamp-parser regression demo. Agent verification playground for debugging.

Vachilla64/desktop-pet-test.summary: Windows desktop pet that speaks coding-agent status and gives code tours
Vachilla64/desktop-pet-test.readme_summary: Tauri/Rust desktop pet that narrates what AI coding agents are doing and walks through code in VS Code. Local Phonon TTS for voice, Node + pnpm build. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API as the brain for Q&A and tours.

lordolami/mirabase.summary: Self-hosted backend with auth, APIs, files, realtime and multi-database power.
lordolami/mirabase.readme_summary: Combines PocketBase simplicity with Turso multi-database power in one Go process for auth, APIs, files, realtime and private tenant databases. Review copy in internal/, runnable app in server/ with SDKs, dashboard and Postgres gateway. Infra for users, tenants and agents, no direct Muse dependency.

amoghng7/vuln-verdict-harness.summary: Sorts Semgrep Java alerts into calibrated lanes and proposes audited fixes.
amoghng7/vuln-verdict-harness.readme_summary: Triages Semgrep SARIF findings on Java into calibrated lanes using Muse Glimmer 30B with r2_s7 LoRA adapter. Muse Spark audits alerts and drafts fixes, with Modal and Semgrep pipeline. Preserves all alerts with neverSuppressed flag for human review.

abssi-maker/corner-case.summary: Simulates 7th Ave street fixes and validates against real NYC crash data.
abssi-maker/corner-case.readme_summary: Models 30 Manhattan corners on 7th Ave to test signal and design fixes, counting simulated close calls under 1.5s PET. Uses SAM 3.1 to track people/cars and Muse Spark 1.3 for notes, scored against 2025-26 NYC crashes. Python + Modal stack with deterministic simulation.

Porkchop911/ColonyPicker_Metahackathon.summary: Robot arm that picks microbial colonies seen by SAM 3.1
Porkchop911/ColonyPicker_Metahackathon.readme_summary: Robot arm with steel needle picks colonies from agar dishes autonomously. Meta SAM 3.1 segments colonies from overhead camera and Muse Spark critiques plates while browser UI shows steps.

harry18garg/OpenDesk-Enterprise-AI-Works.summary: Enterprise workspace where policy engine authorizes agent tool calls before execution.
harry18garg/OpenDesk-Enterprise-AI-Works.readme_summary: OpenDesk is an agentic workspace where Muse Spark proposes plans but server-owned policy engine verdicts allow/deny/require_approval. Restricted writes need human approval with redacted audit trace. Next.js frontend with deterministic authorization backend on synthetic CRM data.

franckygoes/axiom-meta-hackathon.summary: Human-supervised document review that checks extractions against explicit Python rules.
franckygoes/axiom-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: AXIOM Governed Hive reviews fictional quote, invoice, and install report with extraction then issue-search passes. Deterministic Python controls verify evidence and contradictions; business decision stays PENDING until human approval. Python hive CLI with offline fixture mode and HTML report.

luciferprosun/AIOA-spArkHAT-Meta-Hackath.summary: Documentation dossier with evidence and sprint log for the AIOA spArkHAT build.
luciferprosun/AIOA-spArkHAT-Meta-Hackath.readme_summary: Public jury dossier companion, not implementation; canonical code lives in separate AIOA-spArkHAT repo and PR #41. Contains technical evidence docs and prayer/sprint journal for Android/Linux runs. Describes verified Muse usage, authorizations, and engineering failures.

Althaf2406/synchro-api.summary: Engine that turns breaking OpenAPI changes into verified cross-repo pull requests.
Althaf2406/synchro-api.readme_summary: SynchroAPI detects breaking OpenAPI edits with oasdiff, maps blast radius via Tree-sitter/NetworkX GraphRAG, then generates fixes in Modal sandboxes. Uses Muse Spark Open on Baseten and Muse Code on Fireworks. Python engine with pytest and cross-repo PR output.

DEX-XL/patient-operations-record.summary: Synthetic inpatient replay linking handovers, tasks and source evidence.
DEX-XL/patient-operations-record.readme_summary: Replays synthetic U.S. inpatient shift-changes with patient board, persistent handovers and department tasks with owners and dependencies. Next.js + Drizzle stack with eval/ and BUILD_LOG.md, using Meta proposals that require human review. Synthetic data only, not for clinical use.

roshar29000-ds/DineTuned-OpenSource.summary: Personal dining concierge that matches your taste profile to real restaurant menus.
roshar29000-ds/DineTuned-OpenSource.readme_summary: DineTuned builds a persistent taste profile with Taste Detective and Taste DNA, then recommends specific dishes from real menus. Stack is web + api with Supabase and Render deployment. Public demo uses local data; real path used Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Image 1.0 for visuals.

Don-4-the-web/meta-hackathon.summary: No-code studio that fine-tunes private LoRAs to keep brand mascots consistent.
Don-4-the-web/meta-hackathon.readme_summary: WREN Story Engine turns a few mascot reference photos into a private reusable model for new scenes and story art. It handles dataset curation, paid GPU fine-tuning, versioned adapters, and t-shirt and storyboard outputs. Built with frontend + backend for designers with no code or GPU.

aryan331277/clayface.summary: Natural-language silicon compiler with formal SMT verification on SkyWater 130nm.
aryan331277/clayface.readme_summary: ClayFace compiles natural language to SystemVerilog systolic-array accelerators with closed-loop SymbiYosys + Z3 verification. It adds vision-based die inspection with Meta SAM 3.1 and bit-exact INT32 PyTorch parity. Full-stack with backend, frontend, docs, and 47 passing sign-off tests.

vedlad10/fieldkit.summary: Offline-first crop doctor that diagnoses leaf disease in English or Hindi.
vedlad10/fieldkit.readme_summary: FieldKit estimates crop damage on-device, guides photo capture, and gives treatment steps with audio. When signal returns, it sends ~40KB photo to SAM 3.1 for lesion segmentation and Muse Spark for confirmation. Stack is Node server, shared logic, and web client with offline storage.

keyakser/cardo.summary: Turns photos, topics, and text into Kurdish flashcards in seconds.
keyakser/cardo.readme_summary: Cardo by Kurdolingo generates Kurdish vocabulary cards from learner photos or text. It uses Muse Wonder for card text, SAM 3.1 to cut objects from photos, and Muse Image for abstract words. Built as Next.js + Supabase app deployed on Vercel during Nov 3-4 hackathon.

coeusonfire1205/Financial_os.summary: Local finance dashboard with budgeting, charts, and AI assistant.
coeusonfire1205/Financial_os.readme_summary: Financial OS is a Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma/SQLite prototype for tracking finances with Recharts. It includes demo mode and Windows/macOS setup scripts. Live assistant uses Meta Muse Spark via OpenAI-compatible Model API chat completions.

ckwflash/model-atlas.summary: Local workbench where AI designs experiments and investigates eval failures.
ckwflash/model-atlas.readme_summary: Model Atlas is an AI evaluations researcher that proposes hypotheses, runs fresh experiments, and preserves evidence. Includes replay, capability map, comparison, and export with recorded and synthetic studies. Uses Meta Muse Spark for investigation; runs locally with no key.

Buzka42/inspiratio_meta.summary: Modifiable personal assistant framework where users change behavior by talking
Buzka42/inspiratio_meta.readme_summary: Inspiratio is a framework for building personal assistants that users modify by conversation with approval before changes apply. Muse bot is the interface and muse-spark-1.3 on Meta Model API is the brain with web search. Supports Muse Spark Open and fallback models behind one interface.

tessyjonburica/boardbreaker.summary: Diagnoses dead PCBs from a photo plus a few multimeter readings.
tessyjonburica/boardbreaker.readme_summary: BoardBreaker segments board photos with SAM 3.1, reads silkscreen to build a component map, then plans minimal probe measurements. It ranks likely faulty parts once evidence converges. Built as TypeScript API/server + client with boards data, scripts, and tests.

smsmorsalin/warranty_parts_AI-agent.summary: Warranty claims agent where code decides and models handle only ambiguity.
smsmorsalin/warranty_parts_AI-agent.readme_summary: WarrantyParts Logistics splits claims into deterministic policy code and model arbitration for ambiguous cases with citation checks. Reports median 2,242 input tokens and 58% zero-model-call claims. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and muse-wonder-1.0 via Meta Model API in Python.

Meghna-10/labwatch.summary: Checks lab videos against protocols and writes evidence-linked notebooks.
Meghna-10/labwatch.readme_summary: Watches lab experiment video and measures color/motion with OpenCV to detect additions, stirring and color changes. Compares events to the written protocol, then uses Muse Glimmer vision to draft a cited HTML notebook. Citation checker drops unsupported claims.

Briebluedotcom/brieblue-multilingual-ad-.summary: Generates localized video ads in 35 Asian languages from one master ad.
Briebluedotcom/brieblue-multilingual-ad-.readme_summary: One-person importer workflow where one master ad is adapted by 30 country-specific agents into localized video ads. Built on Meta Muse models for translation, voice and cultural localization for diaspora customers. Includes training sets, briefs and verification logs.

ICE-MACHINE/multy-school-platform.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS to manage Quranic schools, attendance, fees and timetables.
ICE-MACHINE/multy-school-platform.readme_summary: Platform for Quranic, private and kindergarten schools with students, teachers, attendance, payments, timetables and messaging. Stack is Node.js TypeScript Express with React Vite frontend, MySQL and optional Redis. Includes AI-powered features and audit/security docs.

WildanHarits/ItinAI.summary: Scores travel itineraries 1-10 on 10 feasibility points using maps data.
WildanHarits/ItinAI.readme_summary: Rebuild of itinSense on Meta Muse via Meta Model API. Extracts plans from text, PDF or photo, then assesses feasibility against Google Maps and suggests revisions. Spec pack defines PRD, tech spec, prompts and JSON tool schemas.

MaskedMan-code/PlantPulse.summary: Incident workspace turning plant records into timelines and reviewable next steps
MaskedMan-code/PlantPulse.readme_summary: PlantPulse is an incident investigation workspace for power-generation and maintenance teams. Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript frontend builds evidence-linked timelines, discrepancies and historical context. Uses Meta AI models for summarization with human review.

36taransingh5-dotcom/apprentice.summary: Turns one expert video into steps, then coaches learners via webcam.
36taransingh5-dotcom/apprentice.readme_summary: Films an expert once and uses Muse Spark 1.3 video to write structured procedures with key objects and done states. Uses SAM 3.1 to localize parts and point at errors in learner attempts live or recorded. Built for Push the Frontier on Meta Model API.

fraserbrownirl/amplify-meta.summary: Ranks creator photos and generates AI head-and-shoulders avatars for ads.
fraserbrownirl/amplify-meta.readme_summary: Runnable slice of Amplify brand-creator marketplace covering avatar generation only. Two-step Meta pipeline ranks 1-8 training photos with Muse Spark then generates avatar. Marketplace, payments and Instagram integration remain private.

Akash-Selvaraj-R/KAIROS.summary: Spatial workspace that plans from images and runs only approved safe actions.
Akash-Selvaraj-R/KAIROS.readme_summary: Accepts workspace image and objective, structures scene with vision model and links observations to evidence. Simulates prioritized plan, then executes single allowlisted software action after human approval. FastAPI plus React Vite with Meta Model API.

mahesh-mettireddy/Gauntlet-MCP.summary: Zero-trust gateway that enforces policies and red-teams MCP agents.
mahesh-mettireddy/Gauntlet-MCP.readme_summary: Action-centric Policy Enforcement Point for LangGraph and MCP agents with 5-layer deterministic shield. Adds protocol integrity pinning, taint tracking and DLP scanning plus multi-vector adversarial eval harness and dashboard.

stryker-hardikgupta/metahackathontwynai.summary: Voice and chat digital twin that answers, qualifies leads and books meetings.
stryker-hardikgupta/metahackathontwynai.readme_summary: Shareable persona link serves chat and voice from personal knowledge with cloned voice and multilingual support. Stack is Next.js 15 frontend with FastAPI WebSockets, RAG and calendar booking. Uses Gnani STT/TTS with Meta, Groq and NIM LLMs.

isaadahanunal/ElderLeaf.summary: Phone photo of farm plot turned into plant counts, weed cover and watering advice
isaadahanunal/ElderLeaf.readme_summary: Turns one plot photo into plant count, canopy cover, weed ratio and water needs with week-by-week tracking. Uses SAM 3.1 for segmentation, Muse Spark Open for reasoning/explanations, FastAPI on Modal plus web and Android clients.

tosham-behera/FailureForge-AI.summary: Investigates software failures from logs and verifies fixes in Docker
tosham-behera/FailureForge-AI.readme_summary: React + Vite frontend uploads logs and shows hypotheses, timelines and reports. FastAPI backend validates, redacts credentials and calls Muse Spark 1.3 via backend-only Meta Model API. Two Docker fixtures reproduce failures with offline demo mode.

faresboudelaa/admiral.summary: Repairs multi-agent boat RL policy by directly editing network weights
faresboudelaa/admiral.readme_summary: Analyzes a broken MAPPO PyQuaticus capture-the-flag policy that never scores while carrying. Muse Spark diagnoses the cause and installs a gated steer-home reflex editing 2.9% of weights. Held-out matches show improved scoring after edit.

Makeepan-dev/MIND-Meta_Hackathon_demo.summary: Desktop workspace with agents for coding, websites, images and tasks
Makeepan-dev/MIND-Meta_Hackathon_demo.readme_summary: PyQt6 desktop environment orchestrating specialized agents for development, web creation and image generation with voice and text. Python backend integrates Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 plus Google Stitch MCP. Launched via run_hackathon_app.py scripts.

Nagaraj1399/visionforge-ai.summary: Autonomous visual inspection agent for industrial defect detection
Nagaraj1399/visionforge-ai.readme_summary: TypeScript React 19 + Vite app for industrial visual inspection and problem-solving. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning with Firebase Firestore storage. Server via server.ts with inspection workflows.

Saira2901/NeuroRehab-Movement-Analysis.summary: Turns rehab game motion captures into joint metrics and clinician reports
Saira2901/NeuroRehab-Movement-Analysis.readme_summary: Python notebook pipeline converts Unity rehab-game captures into ROM, speed, smoothness, reps, fatigue and asymmetry metrics. Muse Spark interprets results into clinician-ready reports and next-session plans. Decision support only, de-identified data.

GayathriChilukuri/MetaHackthon.summary: Demand forecasting and inventory planning copilot for restaurants and retail
GayathriChilukuri/MetaHackthon.readme_summary: Local Node.js app with zero dependencies for dish-to-ingredient and replenishment planning. Hosted version uses Cloudflare D1 workspaces and server-side Meta Model API calls. Forecasts work offline with limited daily Muse questions.

jefferynketiah-gif/LaboraVR-MetaAI.summary: VR chemistry lab where AI designs and marks IGCSE practicals
jefferynketiah-gif/LaboraVR-MetaAI.readme_summary: Extract of Unity Meta Quest VR chemistry lab for Cambridge IGCSE Paper 6. C# modules include AI Practical Architect, ProposalChecker and marking of spoken observations. Uses Meta Model API to generate practicals from teacher specs and mistakes.

Caturan/robot-judge.summary: Compares two real robot runs and judges which performed task better
Caturan/robot-judge.readme_summary: Converts paired robot runs into storyboards and asks Muse models to return verdict, confidence and reason. Evaluated on held-out cup_stacking task with 607 pairs and 10 human votes each. Python app with scripts and results.

praesidia-ai/investigator.summary: Tests if revoked AI agent work still reaches business systems
praesidia-ai/investigator.readme_summary: Standalone open-source app for evidence-driven investigation of AI-agent controls with observed-effect checks. Includes Jurator compiler turning written policies into verifiable controls. No account, backend or database required, model proposes code decides.

FrancoJacquet/sentinel-pre-start.summary: 3D factory twin where SAM 3.1 checks the crane zone before power is restored
FrancoJacquet/sentinel-pre-start.readme_summary: Simulates an overhead crane bay where an operator request triggers a virtual camera. SAM 3.1 segments people in rendered pixels, a deterministic rule checks work-zone occupancy, and a virtual PLC denies energize unless perception is fresh and human-authorized.

GabrielSalem-creator/desktop-demolition.summary: Retro Windows desktop game where an AI Clippy guides bug-hunting quests
GabrielSalem-creator/desktop-demolition.readme_summary: p5.js canvas game simulating a glitchy Windows 17 desktop with quests, apps and boss fights. Llama 4 Scout powers Clippy via AI Chat with quest-aware prompts and 5-turn history, turning a scripted helper into a dynamic in-character guide.

minutechreview/kade-meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Muse-assisted POS for cafes with photo onboarding and sales reports
minutechreview/kade-meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Counter-business POS where Muse Spark suggests product names from photos for merchant approval. Adds cash checkout, kitchen tickets, Muse-explained Sense reports grounded in POS records, and manual-grounded Ask help with approved actions.

Sriharsha-02-Manthena/grounded-retail-op.summary: Retail ops Q&A that answers from documents with cited sources
Sriharsha-02-Manthena/grounded-retail-op.readme_summary: FastAPI app for retail operations questions answered only from store documents. Uses hybrid BM25/TF-IDF retrieval with reranking to return cited, source-backed answers and reduce hallucinations for frontline operations.

Gouravjaat07/Airlock-Invoice-Security-Me.summary: Isolates invoice AI extraction from deterministic policy checks and owner approval
Gouravjaat07/Airlock-Invoice-Security-Me.readme_summary: Airlock extracts facts from invoices, delivery evidence and voice notes with untrusted multimodal AI, then evaluates R1-R10 policy against vendor/bank/PO records. Only authenticated owner can approve mock payment with audit trail. Includes prompt-injection safeguards and adversarial evals.

DEX-XL/flowguard-meta.summary: Hospital boarding agent that explains every bed-assignment decision
