DEX-XL/flowguard-meta.readme_summary: ED boarding-to-bed agent that recommends placements with explanations for each decision. Built for hospital flow operations to make triage and bed allocation transparent, auditable and easier for clinicians to trust.

multi-turn-inc/forget-fleet.summary: Long-term memory for an always-on agent monitoring a parking fleet
multi-turn-inc/forget-fleet.readme_summary: Memory infrastructure for a persistent Muse Glimmer agent watching a 39-pole smart-parking fleet. Focuses on weeks-long retention, recall and forgetting policies to keep continuous monitoring coherent and grounded over time.

aliyudikko/lens-school-multi-agent-platf.summary: Role-based school assistant giving grounded answers from live school database
aliyudikko/lens-school-multi-agent-platf.readme_summary: Lens School connects parents, students, teachers and admins to live Laravel school records via text and voice. LangGraph multi-agent layer grounds answers in attendance, results and fees data with human-reviewed workflows. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image.

nava-07/LifeOS.summary: Personal digital twin with multi-agent help, RAG knowledge hub and memory
nava-07/LifeOS.readme_summary: LifeOS AI is a personal assistant with multi-agent orchestration, RAG knowledge hub and persistent memory. Stack is FastAPI backend, React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, and MongoDB Atlas. It uses Meta Llama API for chat, planning and memory tasks.

1wgrumph/blockparty-game.summary: Unity neighbourhood life sim where autonomous residents live, work and talk
1wgrumph/blockparty-game.readme_summary: Blockparty is a Unity life simulation of eight residents with needs, traits, jobs and relationships. Players watch, guide or speak to residents with pause and time controls. It uses Muse Voice for commands, Muse Spark for behavior, SAM for vision and Muse Image.

satishsnv/conversational_search.summary: Chat interface that turns plain questions into validated OpenSearch queries
satishsnv/conversational_search.readme_summary: Admins register OpenSearch clusters for LLM discovery of indexes and relations, users ask questions in chat. Built with LangGraph agents, LiteLLM, Gradio portals, PostgreSQL and ParadeDB. It uses Meta Muse Wonder and Muse Spark via ChatLiteLLM for planning and queries.

arunjagadishsd/kaptr-meta.summary: Photo riddle game where AI judges camera answers and checks its own work
arunjagadishsd/kaptr-meta.readme_summary: Kaptr is a mobile photo game where players answer riddles with camera photos judged in seconds. Backend verifies results and generates fair riddles before release. It uses Muse Spark for judging, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and spoof detection, Muse Image and Wonder.

munozmed2017-max/patient-twin.summary: Training simulator for a 12-hour hospital night shift on synthetic patients
munozmed2017-max/patient-twin.readme_summary: Patient Twin lets trainees manage one synthetic admission with history-taking, labs, orders and handoff. Single-screen app with live video-call patient and typing option. Built for the hackathon to practice diagnostic workflow, not for clinical use.

finetuningsingh/nightshift.summary: Two-level system where researcher agents fine-tune small models overnight
finetuningsingh/nightshift.readme_summary: Nightshift has an inner loop where researcher agents generate samples, verify, QLoRA fine-tune and submit checkpoints, and an outer loop that revises researcher packs. Uses a deterministic controller, isolated workspaces and CORAL collaboration with fixed budgets.

Jasurcyb/NYX-Guard.summary: Payment safety layer that blocks conflicting invoices where naive agents pay
Jasurcyb/NYX-Guard.readme_summary: NYX Guard is a guarded extractor plus reviewer for payment documents on synthetic ledgers. It abstains on conflicting totals and risky recipients while allowing normal invoices. Tested against naive agents using Meta models with paired trials and benchmarks.

kartheekt/cinemafabric.summary: Distributed fabric that turns a sentence into a trailer using local and cloud models
kartheekt/cinemafabric.readme_summary: CinemaFabric routes each production task to local GPU, Mac, CPU or Meta Model API by quality, latency and cost with failover and caching. The demo studio builds script, storyboard, poster, voice-over and score. Integrates Glimmer, Llama, SAM and cloud models.

aaryanrwt/beblop.summary: Deterministic safety gate between AI proposals and actuators for uncertain perception
aaryanrwt/beblop.readme_summary: BEBOP checks vision-language plans under fog, dust and occlusion and fails closed on uncertainty. Deterministic gate with 2-sigma verdict logic, pytest suite and benchmarks. Sits between AI planners and physical actuators to prevent false approvals.

ahmedalamoussa/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-.summary: Demo water-saving token where farmers log meters and trade in a marketplace
ahmedalamoussa/Meta-Global-AI-Developer-.readme_summary: AgroToken is a hackathon prototype for Proof of Water Savings with simulated readings, AGT rewards, transfers and marketplace. Uses Python stack with hash-linked history and Docker demo scripts. Not a real cryptocurrency or certified irrigation system.

guruswami-ai/flockinator-public.summary: Sixteen ESP32 display nodes form a swarm testbed for distributed agent experiments.
guruswami-ai/flockinator-public.readme_summary: Sixteen ESP32-S3 RGB panels act as independent swarm bodies with local or remote brains. ESP32 Korvo controller hosts web controls, planner and experiment lab. Built with Meta Muse Spark/Wonder models for direction and learning experiments.

neromtoobad/recount.summary: Verifies Nigerian polling-unit result sheets by cross-checking votes and totals.
neromtoobad/recount.readme_summary: Reads INEC Form EC8A photos into strict JSON with Muse Spark 1.3 and finds stamps with SAM 3.1. Node/TypeScript backend checks arithmetic, words-vs-figures and aggregates totals. Live site with write-up and Railway deploy.

SheunDiran/Projects.summary: Workspace tracks commitments and flags conflicting requests before agreement
SheunDiran/Projects.readme_summary: Accord turns scattered requests into evidence-backed commitments with conflict detection and change-impact view. Live Vercel app demonstrates studio-client scope, deadline and price scenarios. Frontend app with API integration and narrated demo.

hirajanwin/remove.free-meta-hackathon.summary: On-device background remover that keeps photos local and uses AI to pick subjects.
hirajanwin/remove.free-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Browser WebGPU matting runs fully on-device with no upload, working offline. SAM 3.1 segments the named subject into selectable layers for cloud reasoning. Muse models provide the understanding layer while pixels stay local.

livelagadas-png/argus-ai-hackathon.summary: Newsroom tool that links drafts to sources with provenance and review flags.
livelagadas-png/argus-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: Python FastAPI/Uvicorn app for source-linked editorial review and Evidence Passport records. Provides draft prep, social previews, Word export and heuristic review flags. Demo runs offline without API keys with synthetic examples.

noahtng/bolus.summary: Fictional offline preview of glucose trends, forecasts and meal pattern screens
noahtng/bolus.readme_summary: BOLUS repo contains only a visual showcase, not the working forecasting app or models. Static index.html plus Node server.mjs steps through scripted 15-minute glucose frames, MealCast and logs in memory. No live Meta AI integration; muse-demo.mjs is illustrative.

ultramathi/FindMyThings.summary: Voice-guided phone app helps blind users locate objects by directional sound.
ultramathi/FindMyThings.readme_summary: Web app where users speak a target, then sweep the camera for audio beeps and voice guidance. TypeScript frontend uses SAM 3.1 for detection, Muse Spark 1.3 for intent and Muse Voice Transcribe. Includes VoiceOver support.

Divyarora0906/PocketMesh.summary: Turns Android phones into on-device LLM servers with local HTTP API.
Divyarora0906/PocketMesh.readme_summary: Kotlin Android app running GGUF models via llama.cpp with C++ inference and HTTP API. No cloud dependency for portable edge-AI compute. Lays groundwork for device-to-device mesh networking.

leamariek/house-rules.summary: Watches family board-game videos to generate playable rules and browser game.
leamariek/house-rules.readme_summary: Pipeline tracks pieces with SAM 3.1, transcribes speech with Muse Voice Transcribe and synthesizes rules with Muse Wonder. Checker replays moves and iterates on contradictions. Outputs browser game with AI opponent and rulebook.

tinglott/rn-command-pro-copilot.summary: Converts nurse visit dictation into editable OASIS-E2 chart drafts on device.
tinglott/rn-command-pro-copilot.readme_summary: Static HTML extension to RN Command Pro for home-health nurses. Captures visit audio transcribed 100% on-device with Whisper. Copilot structures transcript into OASIS-E2 draft for nurse review.

ashish-babu323/gol-pos.summary: Voice and chat AI operator that runs a retail store's sales and stock
ashish-babu323/gol-pos.readme_summary: Gol is an AI business operator for small shopkeepers, operating selling, stock, expenses and staff via chat and voice. Stack is PHP index plus server and web POS frontend with live shop data and one-word confirmation. Uses Meta AI / Muse reasoning over live data to answer with cards and stage writes.

danpcaw/ABetterU_VR.summary: Quest VR voice coach that logs meals, tracks workouts and drafts posts
danpcaw/ABetterU_VR.readme_summary: Quest 3S app where Atlas voice assistant logs meals, tracks squats and drafts social posts on A Better U platform. Uses Muse Spark for voice reasoning, SAM 3.1 for food segmentation and measurement, and Muse Image for post art.

shashi0d/chimera-lab.summary: Fuse two animals into one illustrated hybrid creature and iterate on a visual canvas
shashi0d/chimera-lab.readme_summary: Chimera Lab fuses two animals via photo or name into one hybrid image with name and field-guide entry. Stack is backend plus frontend with FLORA-style canvas; it uses Muse Image generation with reference blending.

pruthvinathJV/stitchcheck.summary: Phone stitch inspector that scores garment seams and audits quality
pruthvinathJV/stitchcheck.readme_summary: Phone app photographs seams; SAM 3.1 finds seam, fine-tuned classifier scores it, Muse Spark explains verdict with Telugu voice support. Dashboard tracks defects, AQL audits and buyer reports from logged data.

fugeretrevin/Detonator.summary: Executes PRs under kernel tracing to catch supply-chain attacks
fugeretrevin/Detonator.readme_summary: Runs pull requests and npm packages under kernel tracing and compares observed behavior to claimed changes. Caught unsafe postinstall exfiltration to bare IP with disabled TLS in 100-package trial.

devrives/hereout.summary: Turns a photo of an evacuation plan into a step-by-step exit route
devrives/hereout.readme_summary: Photograph a posted evacuation plan, tap your location, get routed to nearest exit in your language. Muse Spark extracts floor box and exits as points, code computes paths; demo site has 203 real plans.

prateekbhujel/ProofPatcher.summary: Local workspace where Muse reviews PRs and proves fixes with evidence
prateekbhujel/ProofPatcher.readme_summary: Connects GitHub to review PRs, suggest repairs and show test evidence with receipts in local workspace. Built with Meta Muse; includes checkout repair demo and issue-to-draft workflow on test repos.

eziedutech/dcai.summary: On-phone guardian that nudges kids to stay safe and guides parents
eziedutech/dcai.readme_summary: On-child-phone companion detects risky chat patterns and gives friendly nudges, parents get pattern insights not text, schools get anonymous trends. Stack is FastAPI, Postgres, Muse Spark 1.3 with Llama 3.2 1B on-device.

divagr18/nemesis.summary: Red-teams walking robots in sim from text, voice or photos then retrains
divagr18/nemesis.readme_summary: Turns plain-English, voice or photo scenarios into MuJoCo physics attacks via Muse and SAM 3.1, tests quadrupeds/humanoids, retrains fallen policies with PPO. Includes autopilot hunt and regression gauntlet.

meharkp7/BizoraAI.summary: Turns research papers into interactive testable 3D methodology models
meharkp7/BizoraAI.readme_summary: Transforms papers from any domain into evidence-linked editable methodology with 3D builds and tensor views. Researchers modify components, run real experiments on isolated compute and compare measured results.

amElnagdy/curaloom-hackathon.summary: Builds a personal Arabic course from openly licensed sources
amElnagdy/curaloom-hackathon.readme_summary: Agent builds personalized Arabic course from English, Russian, Chinese and French open materials with lessons, quizzes and comeback coaching. Runs on Meta Muse models; replay demo uses recorded answers.

noisyneighbor90/attention-tutor.summary: Attention-aware maths tutor that watches focus signals to intervene at the right moment
noisyneighbor90/attention-tutor.readme_summary: Browser-based AI maths tutor that tracks gaze, dwell and edit signals to detect confusion. Uses webcam/demo simulation for attention, Muse Spark for tutoring text and Muse Spark Open for decisions, with spend caps and rules fallback.

JishyFishy2006/triton-kernel-agent.summary: Agent that writes Triton GPU kernels checked by an anti-cheat harness on H100s
JishyFishy2006/triton-kernel-agent.readme_summary: Muse Wonder writes Triton kernels for 43 KernelBench tasks, verified on Modal H100s in strict fp32. Hardened harness blocks cached outputs and PyTorch fallback, comparing Wonder, Spark, and Wonder+Spark fix loops.

mathesh310703/agentgate.summary: Deterministic security gate that blocks prompt injection in tool-using agents
mathesh310703/agentgate.readme_summary: Gate treats all tool and image outputs as untrusted data, allowing only user-directed actions. Deterministic code with no model, evaluated on AgentDojo workspace suite against scripted worst-case attacker with Muse Spark Open agent.

nanoulloa/pisa.summary: Checks viral videos against real physics to flag fakes on web and WhatsApp
nanoulloa/pisa.readme_summary: Forwards suspicious clips via WhatsApp or web, tracks objects and compares motion to gravity. Returns verdict, annotated video with ghost overlay, and plain numbers. Multilingual web app with physics-based verification pipeline.

SooryaCodes/kit.summary: Turns one product photo into a real-size 3D shop with WhatsApp ordering
SooryaCodes/kit.readme_summary: Sellers upload a photo to generate a mobile shop with true-scale 3D, AR table placement, AI Q&A and WhatsApp checkout. Solves repetitive sizing questions for Instagram/WhatsApp sellers with no signup creation flow.

lhl/crumbs.summary: Searchable food and travel memory from your photos, run fully on-device
lhl/crumbs.readme_summary: Turns local photos and location history into queryable memory of meals and places. Ask agent uses local Muse Glimmer and DINOv3 for retrieval without uploading to cloud, food-first with trips next.

dhirajpatra/Drishti-Cloud.summary: Security agency dashboard that watches cameras and alerts on WhatsApp
dhirajpatra/Drishti-Cloud.readme_summary: One dashboard for malls, schools, homes and ICUs that learns per-site normal behavior. SAM 3.1 sees, Muse Spark fuses image/sensor/SOP text, Muse Wonder reasons over Neo4j habit graph, WhatsApp Business API acts.

Md-Abdur-Rahman-07/draw2verify.summary: Verifies hand-drawn circuit answers with simulation and independent review
Md-Abdur-Rahman-07/draw2verify.readme_summary: Photograph a hand circuit and ask by text or voice. Muse Spark grounds claims in ngspice simulation, Muse Wonder blind re-reads drawing to review every claim, looping for correction instead of guessing.

indranilsen/petromind.summary: Investigates oil-well sensor anomalies for evidence-backed physical causes.
indranilsen/petromind.readme_summary: PetroMind moves beyond anomaly detection to investigate causes using real Petrobras 3W sensor data. It separates observations, hypotheses, and conclusions with Muse Spark reasoning. Python stack with graph tools, active sensors, and tests.

Richard-Y-W/Meta_Hackathon.summary: Detects infrastructure threats and coordinates responses across power and water.
Richard-Y-W/Meta_Hackathon.readme_summary: LIFELINE detects emerging threats, predicts failure spread, and coordinates interventions for essential services. Operations console shows network map and response workflows. Built on Meta Muse with Node 22, runtime and fixtures.

jeevithg090/Axi0N_Meta.summary: Plain-language camera rules that prove themselves and double-check alerts
jeevithg090/Axi0N_Meta.readme_summary: Rulecam lets users describe camera worries in their own language, validates if cameras can check them, and proves rules before live. Python 3.12 stack with phone/CCTV support. Uses Meta models including Muse Glimmer for second-look alert verification.

Jeff-Kazzee/kept.summary: Agent that reconciles clinic messages, calendar, and drafts replies with Undo
Jeff-Kazzee/kept.readme_summary: Kept reads appointment emails/texts, resolves true booked time, checks calendar conflicts, and drafts replies for approval. Never auto-sends, full Undo. Uses Meta key-hosted model with Gmail and calendar integrations.

mirzahusadzic/gadfly.summary: Tests if decisions rest on evidence via fixed interventions and rules
mirzahusadzic/gadfly.readme_summary: Gadfly removes or changes one declared line under fixed interventions, re-scores, and derives verdict by rules not models. Python midwife package with replayable records. Used for auditing LLM decisions and load-bearing meaning.

vedntzz/Knack.summary: Turns PR review decisions into unbreakable rules for coding agents
vedntzz/Knack.readme_summary: Knack extracts decisions from merged PR threads into enforceable agent rules with provenance quotes. Python + ast-grep CLI enforcement. Prevents agents re-shipping rejected alternatives.

AndyDM9/heyandy-meta.summary: Tabletop robot that finds lost items, points at them, and keeps video local
AndyDM9/heyandy-meta.readme_summary: Privacy-first tabletop robot for older adults to locate objects in 15 languages. Python monorepo with apps, evals and local deployment. Uses Meta models for vision, language and on-device processing.

SawhneySatvik/munshi.summary: AI back office where agents do books and owner approves every change
SawhneySatvik/munshi.readme_summary: Munshi provides seven agents for small-shop accounting with named-person approval tray. Next.js 16.4, React 19, PostgreSQL 17 monorepo. Uses Meta AI models for bookkeeping automation with audit trail.

HeshamFS/coalitionkit.summary: Kit for multi-vendor agents to cooperate with human-signed decisions
HeshamFS/coalitionkit.readme_summary: CoalitionKit composes group tasks from one sentence, joins via QR, agents query owners privately and make offers. Python 3.12 open kit, pre-release. Supports any-vendor agents with person-signed decisions.

AnKBORE/ai-knowledge-workspace.summary: Collaborative AI workspace turning scattered docs into citable answers
AnKBORE/ai-knowledge-workspace.readme_summary: Agentic Knowledge Workspace centralizes admin/enterprise documents for natural-language query with citations and refusals. PHP stack. Uses Muse Spark Open for retrieval, verification, and access control.

Lucaszy1/Crucible.summary: Simulated range where AI defenders practice containment with replayable logs
Lucaszy1/Crucible.readme_summary: Crucible runs attacker vs defender exercises on simulated company networks with full logging and scoring. Python server with static replay site. Uses Meta models for log-watching and containment decisions.

nduwork/pengupool-ai.summary: Mac app to run Muse Code teams and answer from the Muse app
nduwork/pengupool-ai.readme_summary: PenguPool brings coding-agent teams and waiting questions into one workspace via macOS app with Go host. Runs Muse Code locally, follow from Muse app. Built for Muse in-the-loop approvals.

Ambar-13/Meta-hackathon.summary: Digital twins meet first to preview compatibility and deals with quoted briefs.
Ambar-13/Meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Meety builds opt-in twins from user-approved chat history. Two twins simulate a meeting and each user gets a brief with quoted sources. Built as web app at heymeety.com using Google auth and Muse models for simulation.

nla-asia/postorca-app.summary: Desktop agent that turns code and app recordings into launch videos.
nla-asia/postorca-app.readme_summary: PostOrca is a desktop app where Orca agent reads code and commits, plans shot-by-shot scripts, then records the running app. It edits captioned videos with voiceover for social platforms. Uses project workspaces, routines and brand profiles.

DiasKhalniyasov/personavision.summary: Simulated user crowd predicts gaze, confusion and UX fixes before A/B tests.
DiasKhalniyasov/personavision.readme_summary: PersonaVision tests websites with AI personas on phone and desktop. It produces Tobii-style heatmaps, journey traces and fix suggestions. Stack is TypeScript, Node 22, pnpm monorepo with Docker session-runner.

ngnikhil07/meemaw.summary: Local personal assistant with persistent memory and voice chat.
ngnikhil07/meemaw.readme_summary: Persistent personal intelligence with provenance memory, context graph, intent tracking and approval-gated actions. Node 20+ with zero dependencies, JSON storage, 753 offline tests. Uses live Meta models only for phrasing.

CodesbyFebin/MuzeBOS--The-Zero-Trust-Bus.summary: Self-hosted business OS with invoicing, CRM and gated AI tasks.
CodesbyFebin/MuzeBOS--The-Zero-Trust-Bus.readme_summary: MuZe is a single-process Node OS for founders with SQLite invoicing, inventory and CRM. It uses approval-gated AI tasks, WebLLM in-browser inference and hash-chained audit ledger. Meta dispatch is DRY_RUN by default.

satvikp-coder/sentinelx.summary: Verification-first guard that checks agent actions with deterministic tests.
satvikp-coder/sentinelx.readme_summary: Sentinel X reviews proposed agent actions and scans authorized lab sites for vulnerabilities. Deterministic code and independent tests decide, with evidence logs and temporary proxy rules. Local lab prototype with CI and demo video.

jonathantsang26/metahacks.summary: Drone wildfire mapping with live flame detection and spread forecasting.
jonathantsang26/metahacks.readme_summary: Sentinel Ember processes drone video in-browser to outline flames and map them on 3D terrain. A forecaster predicts the one-hour fire front and dispatches agents to monitor it. Built for faster wildfire suppression decisions.

DongzeL430/MetaHacks.summary: Anonymous study-buddy matcher with nicknames and AI avatars for students.
DongzeL430/MetaHacks.readme_summary: StudBuds matches college students by .edu email using nicknames and Muse-generated avatars. A survey and calendar rank compatible study sessions. Built during hackathon with Netlify frontend and Supabase backend.

Naveenasri02/describe-to-inspect.summary: Webcam blister-strip inspector driven by spoken QA rules and vision models.
Naveenasri02/describe-to-inspect.readme_summary: Blistrue inspects tablet blister pockets via webcam, using SAM 3.1 for segmentation and frozen DINOv2 for scoring. Muse Voice and Spark 1.3 convert spoken rules to versioned checklists. Flask app signals machine and logs batch.

AshutoshRudraksh/trust-layer.summary: Approval gate that trials agent memory lessons before they are stored
AshutoshRudraksh/trust-layer.readme_summary: Pyx gates agent memory: candidate lessons face hidden-rubric grading by two judges, causal replay, poison screening and human exact-text approval. Earned lessons served over MCP with live dashboard, built Meta-models-only.

thiennp/agora.summary: Playground for building community apps where member agents act together
thiennp/agora.readme_summary: Agora is a platform for creating community apps for trade, learning, and organizing. It provides primitives for communication, geo, matching, and workflows via agents. Users describe needs in Muse which generates the app on Agora.

YAlegend/adaptive-workout.summary: Training plan that replans around travel, equipment and injury constraints
YAlegend/adaptive-workout.readme_summary: Adaptive Workout replans fitness weeks when travel or injury changes constraints. A deterministic engine writes all sets, reps, and loads while Meta models only call tools and explain swaps. Stack is web app with offline and replay mode.

0ywfe/celsus.summary: Replicates arXiv papers on public data to verify reported numbers hold up
0ywfe/celsus.readme_summary: Celsus reads arXiv LaTeX, extracts reported numbers, and rebuilds analysis from public data in a sandbox. It compares reproduced results to claims in plain language. Uses Python workflow with isolated execution and receipts.

0-Solver-0/AskYourData.summary: Ask your company database in plain speech and get exact answers with trace
0-Solver-0/AskYourData.readme_summary: AYDA lets business users ask questions in English, French, or Darija typed or spoken. It finds relevant tables, writes one read-only SQL query, and answers with trace. Built with Meta models, live on Odoo 18 with Docker.

emanuelheredia1234/yourlocalbusiness.summary: AI workspace to research, brand, list and market local businesses
emanuelheredia1234/yourlocalbusiness.readme_summary: Yourlocalbusiness is a workspace where shared Project Context feeds onboarding, dashboard, and strategy modules. It generates product ideas, brand identity, and marketing posts with AI skills. Web app with Node server and shared context.

aluinn/meta-developer-hackathon.summary: Scan a room to get a playable 3D racing world with real physics
aluinn/meta-developer-hackathon.readme_summary: Room World converts phone .glb scans into labelled world.json via Meta AI models and checks. The web app renders with three.js and Rapier physics for game mode racing or work mode accessibility planning. No sign-in demo on Render.

bibeksarkar001/snappart.summary: Film a broken part on a mat to get a measured printable STL
bibeksarkar001/snappart.readme_summary: SnapPart turns video of a part on a printed mat into measured STL and honest report. Pipeline does photogrammetry, measurement, and print validation with Python backend and frontend. Uses Meta models for vision and reporting.

lucianobogo/punchwalk.summary: Turns a Ray-Ban Meta walkthrough video into a verified construction punch list per trade.
lucianobogo/punchwalk.readme_summary: Converts one site walk video with voice notes into punch items with photo, defect outline, trade, room and severity. Uses fingertip tracking and SAM for defect pinning, Muse models for summary and verification, with before/after re-walk sign-off. Dockerized Python service with Fly.io deploy.

qingyuan1017/meta-hackathon-clinical-ai.summary: Agent workspace turning EDC metadata into reviewable SDTM deliverables
qingyuan1017/meta-hackathon-clinical-ai.readme_summary: SDTM Artifact Workbench maps source metadata to CDISC SDTM with human approval gates. It generates deterministic R/SAS, runs isolated R with XPT checks, and packages evidence. Uses MCP services for CDISC, BioPortal, ClinicalTrials.

Jieyi-Deng/agent-beans.summary: Always-on AI ad team that audits Meta ads and builds weekly creatives
Jieyi-Deng/agent-beans.readme_summary: Agent Beans runs six AI specialists plus a code-only Operator to check ad accounts daily and plan weekly ads. All metrics trace to source data with read-only recordings on synthetic accounts. Built on Muse models with web dashboard.

learnkorean-spec/klovers.summary: Online Korean academy with a 3D story world and AI tool that designs learning rooms
learnkorean-spec/klovers.readme_summary: Online Korean academy for Arabic speakers with a playable 3D World. Adds AI Room Lab on Supabase Edge Functions to propose rooms. Uses Muse Image for A/B room art and Muse Spark 1.3 for structured JSON design briefs.

avcs06/WeaveWithAI.summary: Agent that turns a plain-English idea into a maintainable design-system website
avcs06/WeaveWithAI.readme_summary: Frontend codegen agent that converts rough ideas into multi-screen apps reusing design-system components. Enforces WCAG 2.2 AA via review agents that debate issues. Built on Muse Spark models inside Muse Code harness.

Toanzzz/saigon-tour.summary: Browser papercraft adventure wandering District 1 Saigon helping neighbors
Toanzzz/saigon-tour.readme_summary: Playable web game set in a papercraft District 1 Saigon with English and Vietnamese support. Player explores, meets characters, runs errands and collects city pieces. Static browser game for desktop and mobile with no install.

aatishsatti/maya-hackathon.summary: Voice-first AI companion for seniors living alone with check-ins and care alerts
aatishsatti/maya-hackathon.readme_summary: Maya is a voice-first companion for elderly users living alone, with web and Android clients. It uses conversational voice interaction, wellness check-ins and care workflows. Built with Meta Muse models for dialogue and voice handling.

masrakev/profit-agent.summary: AI profit analyst that finds e-commerce margin leaks and measures fixes
masrakev/profit-agent.readme_summary: Merit analyzes store orders, Meta Ads spend and costs to find profit leaks like overspend or loss-making bestsellers. It proves findings with numbers, simulates actions and measures earnings with owner approval. Full-stack backend plus frontend.

officebeats/cleanquest.summary: Game-show cleaning app that scores before-after photos on a leaderboard
officebeats/cleanquest.readme_summary: CleanQuest scores before-and-after room photos for visible cleanliness and technique with Muse models. A multilingual game-show voice celebrates results in English, Spanish or Polish. Scores post to a verifiable leaderboard.

kaumnen/AIMS.summary: Sandboxed bench that tests if AI agents resist planted temptations
kaumnen/AIMS.readme_summary: Alignment bench where agents work in isolated sandboxes while a separate monitor model watches each step. Tasks hide plants like credential requests to detect misbehavior. Python 3.14 service with Docker, Caddy and public compose deploy.

diffplug/selfie-hackathon.summary: Distributed Storybook screenshot testing gate for AI coding agent loops
diffplug/selfie-hackathon.readme_summary: Selfie is a visual review gate for Storybook that runs locally, in CI and on GitHub. It handles high-volume renders for coding agents and uses Muse Spark to explain visual diffs. Piloting with StorybookJS with extensible test models.

bharathvbcr/SpikeTrack.summary: Rust tracker using SAM 3.1 to follow sperm cells in microscope video
bharathvbcr/SpikeTrack.readme_summary: Single Rust binary with no Python runtime that runs SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex tracker on clinical semen video. Tracks dozens of sperm cells to aid objective motility analysis. Addresses manual CASA variability with automated tracking.

hypaai/hypa-meta.summary: Mobile intelligence app with API backend and agent features
hypaai/hypa-meta.readme_summary: Monorepo with API, Postgres, Redis and mobile app for Hypa Intelligence. Includes agent features, Prisma schema and local Docker setup workflow. Turbo pnpm workspace with apps and packages plus evals for validation.

keladeza0072-lgtm/silkweb.summary: Reusable knowledge and procedures layer to cut repeat AI work across creative, code and agents
keladeza0072-lgtm/silkweb.readme_summary: SilkWeb provides a reusable intelligence layer with a Git-backed knowledge registry, data contracts, and verified procedures. It demos creative ad generation, coding-agent MCP tools, and deterministic agent execution. Uses Muse models for generation with access-controlled live inference.

Horlawhumy-dev/nudge_ai.summary: Voice-first assistant that decides when to nudge and acts via confirm-gated tools
Horlawhumy-dev/nudge_ai.readme_summary: NudgeAI is a voice-first personal workflow agent with habits, tasks, nudge engine, chat with confirm-gated tool calls, voice and photo-to-tasks. Backend plus mobile app wired end-to-end. Uses Meta AI for chat, voice and decision-gated actions.

richardochristjia/zeroshot-qc.summary: Zero-training visual inspection that finds parts and judges defects in plain English
richardochristjia/zeroshot-qc.readme_summary: ZeroShot QC does zero-training inspection: SAM 3.1 localizes parts and defects, Muse Spark judges against plain-English rules and reference. Reports 0.918 F1 on MVTec AD. Stack includes Docker backend, frontend, CLI and evaluation docs.

vmcchooky/plenilune.summary: Semantic diff for network configs that names behavior changes with replayable evidence
vmcchooky/plenilune.readme_summary: Plenilune compares network config versions for ACLs and IPv4 prefix-lists, outputs change classes and witnesses for offline replay. Independent Go project with local review UI, no device contact. Opt-in AI locked to muse-spark-1.3-contributor.

uslanozan/Clear-Context.summary: Self-hosted fact-checker that splits posts into claims with quoted sources
uslanozan/Clear-Context.readme_summary: Clear Context is a self-hosted fact-checking agent using LangGraph that separates claims, researches details, and links findings to source passages. Includes backend, Chrome extension and evals. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0.

hackdavid/Cueframe.summary: Chat agent that researches docs and verifies steps in a sandbox to build tutorials
hackdavid/Cueframe.readme_summary: Cueframe is a chat-first agent platform where browser actions are REST/WebSocket calls and jobs stream progress. It researches official docs, executes in sandbox, and returns cited tutorials. Built on Muse Spark, Wonder, SAM 3.1, Image and Voice.

JoMinsu-KU/PushPilot.summary: Operator workspace linking robot goals, execution feedback and visual review
JoMinsu-KU/PushPilot.readme_summary: PushPilot is a Meta Muse Spark 1.3 workspace for robot demos uniting goal, plan, feedback and visual result. Shows motion to MUSE review flow with recorded decisions. Frontend and backend with contracts, prompts and deploy configs.

AjjayK/weed-or-wheat.summary: Field-walk analyzer that maps weeds from photos and cites herbicide labels.
AjjayK/weed-or-wheat.readme_summary: Muse Spark agent drives SAM 3.1 to segment weeds from crops per photo, code computes intensity and applies thresholds. Python scout pipeline with EPA label lookup and page citations. Live demo replays saved walks.

nerdypunk/Pipodojo.summary: Playful puzzle game that teaches prompting AI agents step by step.
nerdypunk/Pipodojo.readme_summary: Web game where players tap pieces and press Check to see agent behavior across missions. Cloudflare Workers plus frontend stack. Powered by Muse Spark for mission guidance and agent responses.

swaggpi/VScan.summary: Dependency scanner that proves if a CVE is reachable from public entry points
swaggpi/VScan.readme_summary: VScan builds call graphs with tree-sitter for Python/JS/PHP/Go, traces reachability from entry points and runs taint analysis. Correlates with OSV, CISA KEV and EPSS to verdict exploitable/reachable/not reached. Includes dashboard and action.

kot0070/agent-si.summary: Desktop app where agent team delivers checked results with audit verdict
kot0070/agent-si.readme_summary: Agent SI is a desktop app that takes a plain-language task, plans with model agents, runs checks, and adds auditor verdict. All runs and audits persist locally. It connects to Meta models via Settings after install.

RVBCosme/Lusot-submission.summary: Turns citizen flood photos in Manila into a live depth map with MMDA levels
RVBCosme/Lusot-submission.readme_summary: Turns photos into flood-depth pins on a Metro Manila map with evidence overlaid or honest can't-tell. Ask Lusot answers English/Taglish voice or text via Muse Spark tool calls. Web app on Amplify plus Android app, evaluated on sealed MMDA-labelled set.

littlepaprikalab/popsmosis.summary: Learning platform that turns topic requests into fact-checked mini-lessons
littlepaprikalab/popsmosis.readme_summary: Users request topics, an external skill-driven teacher agent calls the public API to create droplets via the Python studio pipeline that writes and fact-checks lessons. Stack is Next.js with Prisma and Docker. No direct Muse integration; teacher is Claude routine or CLI.

johncat88425-del/slope-coach.summary: Checks if motion in a video follows real-world physics laws
johncat88425-del/slope-coach.readme_summary: Upload a 2-5s clip and get consistent, inconsistent, or cannot judge with reasons. Muse Spark reasons, SAM 3.1 tracks the object, code computes physics. Frontend and backend hosted on Render with fixed bench in data/bench and no per-clip tuning.

keviqlabs/keviq-live-submission.summary: Seller console linking Facebook Live comments to products and orders
keviqlabs/keviq-live-submission.readme_summary: A control room for solo Facebook Live sellers that maps comments to products, quantities and price negotiation with approval queue and memory. Built by KeviqLabs with Meta AI. Includes hosted demo, replay judge mode, architecture and measured results docs.

ffgg35646-ops/erd-algwal.summary: Arabic RTL online store for phones with Telegram order management
ffgg35646-ops/erd-algwal.readme_summary: RTL Arabic e-commerce for phones and accessories inspired by Apple store design. Products and categories stored in MongoDB, images via Telegram file IDs, admin via Telegram bot with webhook. Stack is Next.js with Vercel config. No Meta AI use stated.

saidelimam/simt-echo.summary: Turns a walk video into a GPS-free route others can navigate with AR
saidelimam/simt-echo.readme_summary: Creator records video plus inertial sensors, AI grounds landmarks onto geometry into an EchoRoute bundle with turn cues, AR overlays and QR checkpoints. Built as Kotlin Multiplatform library with Android app now, Wear OS and iOS next. Meta AI Hackathon 2026 entry.

wonderben-code/polymath.summary: Cross-discipline research partner that finds hidden science connections
wonderben-code/polymath.readme_summary: Agent that spans literature across fields to spot shared problems, test connections and help draft answers and papers. Solo-built with literature engine, evidence checks, memory and budget control. Uses Muse Spark today, configurable to stronger Meta models.

an-otter-lab/omnibasket.summary: Splits a book basket across Romanian shops for lowest total with shipping
an-otter-lab/omnibasket.readme_summary: Optimizes which books to buy at which Romanian bookshop including shipping and fees, e.g. 43.57 lei saved on 7 books. Live bilingual web app with no sign-in. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 on Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open on Baseten for matching.

krunstudio/openbot.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI coding teammates
krunstudio/openbot.readme_summary: Desktop workspace giving each agent its own workspace and conversation with queues, file transfer, embedded browser and agent messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini and Cursor via ACP. Development preview running with full access.

ExtraBinoss/Melt.App.summary: Free open-source browser studio for images, video, type, 3D and motion graphics.
ExtraBinoss/Melt.App.readme_summary: Browser-based creative studio for social content with images, video, type, 3D and motion. Monorepo with apps/web, built with TypeScript and Bun. Meta AI usage not detailed in excerpt; projects are local with no account.

TuononenP/planet-render-360.summary: Mobile Godot app that renders any map location as on-device 3D 360 view.
TuononenP/planet-render-360.readme_summary: Godot 4.7.2 mobile-first app that builds a true-metre 360-degree 3D scene from map tap, search or coordinates. Uses AWS Terrain, Esri imagery, OSM Overpass, CHELSA, Open-Meteo unified via LocationData. Meta AI usage not shown in excerpt.

OAzizjon/meta-mate.summary: Voice desktop companion that guides PC tasks and highlights buttons to click.
OAzizjon/meta-mate.readme_summary: Windows 10/11 desktop assistant with a light-bulb companion for step-by-step PC guidance. Built with Rust/Cargo plus web assets. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3/Wonder 1.0, MMS-TTS, Glimmer 30B and SAM 3.1.

heyleydotdev/tars.summary: Desktop notebook that turns notes and chats into tasks, reminders and expenses.
heyleydotdev/tars.readme_summary: Electron desktop app with React renderer, Hono API on Cloudflare Workers, D1 for data and R2 for images. Extracts tasks, reminders, expenses and journal entries. Uses Meta AI via META_AI_API key; runs without it in limited mode.

jscott3201/mechanical-muse.summary: Agent that drafts building controls and verifies them before live building run.
jscott3201/mechanical-muse.readme_summary: Agent that turns written sequences into block-graph building control logic. Muse Spark drafts logic, deterministic control engine replays test vectors, only verified drafts run on BOPTEST emulation. Rust workspace with Docker.

rl7x/motion-transfer.summary: Recovers game moves from binaries or clips and ports them to new games.
rl7x/motion-transfer.readme_summary: Harness to recover a dash move from compiled WASM or gameplay clip and port it to unseen games. Uses Muse Wonder for recovery, Muse Spark for porting, SAM 3.1 for clip tracking. Docker compose with coordinator.

checocadena/museport.summary: Plans and ports CUDA projects to SYCL with proof at every step.
checocadena/museport.readme_summary: Agent pipeline that analyzes CUDA code and generates SYCL 2020 ports validated by CI on CPU, NVIDIA, and AMD. Covers llm.c and llama2 with patches and oneMath support. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for planning and porting.

filetelierb/tiny-libraries.summary: Local study library turning recordings and docs into source-linked lessons.
filetelierb/tiny-libraries.readme_summary: Local open-source study workspace that creates chapters, subtitles, practice and concepts from user files. Web client with Node server and shared code. Uses Meta Model API with BYO key plus optional tutor web search.

mentorabhay/SCMTips-Field.summary: Hands-free delivery check-in using glasses camera to count and read labels.
mentorabhay/SCMTips-Field.readme_summary: Hands-free check-in desk using Ray-Ban Meta glasses or Android camera for deliveries. SAM 3.1 detects items, Muse Spark reads labels, rules verify counts before ERP posting. Human voice confirm required.

joejoe-max/Build-Lens.summary: Browser workspace for exploring 3D building concepts and chatting on docs.
joejoe-max/Build-Lens.readme_summary: Early React+Vite prototype with Three.js navigable building model and document chat. Extracts PDF/DOCX/text and images in browser. Server-side Meta Model API proxy with META_API_KEY, Vercel deploy.

anggarabudiyantooo-hub/siaga-id.summary: Verifiable Indonesia fire and smoke intelligence for residents during haze season.
anggarabudiyantooo-hub/siaga-id.readme_summary: SIAGA.ID provides verifiable disaster intelligence for Indonesian fire and smoke events. It cross-checks public data, forecasts smoke movement, and produces trustworthy hand-offs. Uses Meta AI with API, admin-ui, and test-gated evals.

JeffersonAreque/rewind.summary: Rebuilds legacy software into modern web apps from screen-recorded video
JeffersonAreque/rewind.readme_summary: Records use of old software without source, then multi-agent pipeline extracts screens, reconstructs flows, and generates a modern web app. Verifies step-by-step parity. Built from scratch for hackathon with Python agent team and modern web output.

SayamDev/context-desk.summary: Local video studio that finds story moments and edits subtitles
SayamDev/context-desk.readme_summary: Local production workspace for discovering moments, reviewing multilingual subtitles and making clips. Muse Spark assesses frames and transcripts, Muse Voice transcribes audio with evidence-linked editor.

fahaamqureshi/BLINDSPOT_CI.summary: Evaluation workspace to find vision-model misses with exportable evidence
fahaamqureshi/BLINDSPOT_CI.readme_summary: Agent-enabled QA harness for vision engineers to test human-labeled images, inspect misses and false alarms, and export reports. Muse Spark proposes next tests, SAM 3.1 predicts, Python scores, human decides release.

QAInsights/gift.dosa.dev.summary: Gift-card cabinet to file cards by photo or voice and track spending
QAInsights/gift.dosa.dev.readme_summary: Astro SSR on Cloudflare Workers + D1 app where photo, voice, typing or WhatsApp creates a reviewable draft. Sealed drawers, encrypted vault, spend tracking with undo. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for vision extraction and planning.

DEX-zha/META-HACKATHON-2026-UNITYMAPPER.summary: Prompt-to-furnished 3D room builder that inspects and fixes Unity scenes
DEX-zha/META-HACKATHON-2026-UNITYMAPPER.readme_summary: AI agent builds, inspects and corrects furnished rooms inside a real Unity HDRP project from one prompt. Python/Go orchestration with Unity 6000.3. Uses Muse Spark for layout reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual inspection.

TejasD-web/zero-training-edge-recognitio.summary: On-device camera reader that calls cloud only when uncertain
TejasD-web/zero-training-edge-recognitio.readme_summary: Edge-to-cloud router reading IDs/codes: Perception LM 1B on Jetson Orin Nano reads locally in ~1.2s, scores token confidence, escalates to Muse Spark when unsure. Offline mode marks unverified and queues recheck. No training.

Manas8114/StepProof.summary: Browser companion that executes procedures and proves outcomes with code
Manas8114/StepProof.readme_summary: Learn-Execute-Verify companion: watches user tasks, executes with approval gates, self-heals locators visually with SAM 3.1. Models perceive, code decides. FastAPI/Playwright/Chromium stack powered by Meta Muse Spark, 134 tests.

TejasD-web/edge-confidence-router.summary: On-device camera reader that calls cloud only when uncertain
TejasD-web/edge-confidence-router.readme_summary: Edge-to-cloud router reading IDs/codes: Perception LM 1B on Jetson Orin Nano reads locally in ~1.2s, scores token confidence, escalates to Muse Spark when unsure. Offline mode marks unverified and queues recheck. No training.

EdsonVladimir/meta-ai.summary: Desktop IDE that maps code architecture and reviews AI-proposed edits
EdsonVladimir/meta-ai.readme_summary: Ruth IDE parses Angular/NestJS/TypeScript/Rust locally into architecture map of pages, stores and services with evidence edges. Meta Muse proposes changes shown on map for Accept/Discard. Tauri + Vite + TypeScript desktop app.

ramkumarkoppu/meta_hackathon.summary: Gives locked-down PCs AI help via USB KVM without installing software
ramkumarkoppu/meta_hackathon.readme_summary: Locked Computer Assist pairs a locked computer with an AI computer via USB KVM. The KVM acts as monitor and keyboard to view screen and type fixes. Uses Muse Glimmer for vision debugging and Muse Spark for code fixes.

shamas92/leaselens.summary: Reviews leases for illegal clauses and documents deposits with photos.
shamas92/leaselens.readme_summary: Audits leases across DE, UK, US-NY, FR and JP with zero-hallucination checks and SAM 3.1 damage evidence. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Voice with SHA-256 tamper-evident storage and test suite.

asiifdev/business-ai-operation.summary: AI operations manager for agencies that asks before acting
asiifdev/business-ai-operation.readme_summary: Orbyte reads, drafts and plans agency work with human approval for risky actions. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Voice Transcribe. Astro + React frontend with PostgreSQL/Drizzle stack.

adityaPrakashSai/shiftSense.summary: Auto-builds nurse rosters and handles sick calls in Hindi or English
adityaPrakashSai/shiftSense.readme_summary: ShiftSense generates fortnight rosters in seconds with OR-Tools CP-SAT solver. Muse Spark parses Hindi/English typed or spoken messages, runs replacement workflow, and explains decisions. Human approves every change.

tito-devsec/moranbuy.summary: WhatsApp reverse marketplace that brings budget-matched shops to you
tito-devsec/moranbuy.readme_summary: MoranBuy is an AI reverse marketplace on WhatsApp for text, photo and voice requests with budget-first offer ranking and held payments. Uses only Meta models via Meta Model API for matching and chat.

pablojhdcoder/IntroMesh.summary: In-person event layer to discover who to meet and why
pablojhdcoder/IntroMesh.readme_summary: IntroMesh runs a Discover, Understand, Connect, Learn loop for events with deterministic matching plus explanations. Server calls muse-spark-1.3 via OpenAI SDK with structured Zod outputs for profiles and recommendations.

klikjet/outgrid-plan-agent.summary: Verified multi-agent long-stay travel planner for digital nomads
klikjet/outgrid-plan-agent.readme_summary: Planner agent drafts day-by-day plans only from Outgrid destination records with source refs. Verifier agent checks every claim against records. Built on Muse Spark via Meta Model API and Muse Spark Open on Baseten.

Jufaa/simucityy-ia.summary: 3D synthetic city simulator to test floods, quakes and wind impacts
Jufaa/simucityy-ia.readme_summary: Procedurally generates deterministic cities in Three.js, Next.js and React for same-seed before/after hazard comparison. Imports real districts from OpenStreetMap and measures building and population impact with optional AI interventions.

aasthaoct7-pixel/REELDONE.summary: Turns one video into optimized posts for all social platforms
aasthaoct7-pixel/REELDONE.readme_summary: ReelDone is a publishing agent where creators upload one video plus topic to get platform-specific captions, tags and posting times. Enables Facebook publishing from a single workflow with AI content generation.

Dharshaneshwaran/hyperpod.summary: Pools laptop GPUs into one local runtime for Llama inference
Dharshaneshwaran/hyperpod.readme_summary: HyperPod discovers laptops on a trusted network, measures free VRAM, and shards Meta Llama models across CUDA and Metal via llama.cpp RPC. Controller rebuilds pipeline on worker dropout with observable placement.

AVI2907/bugbait.summary: AI agents plant realistic bugs to find gaps in tests then write verified fixes.
AVI2907/bugbait.readme_summary: BugBait is a multi-agent mutation-testing system where a Saboteur plants bugs and runners execute the suite. It uses Meta Muse Spark for bug generation and verified test synthesis, packaged as Python app, Docker, and GitHub Action.

joen-ao/testigo.summary: Pixel-level witness that verifies computer-use agents before browser actions run.
joen-ao/testigo.readme_summary: TESTIGO+ sits between agent and browser, compares intent vs approval vs pixels, and blocks mismatches with signed receipts. Built in Python with gate, bench and simulation stack, using vision models for screen verification.

juarezjaramillo/museaiteam-demo.summary: AI employee team that takes goals by voice and does work in real business tools.
juarezjaramillo/museaiteam-demo.readme_summary: MuseAITeam lets solo founders assign goals to debating AI hires that act in Shopify, HubSpot, Slack, Notion and GitHub. Built as TypeScript monorepo during hackathon by Muse Code, using Meta models for orchestration.

feedofmri/keel.summary: Code-repair agent that generates patches then proves if they are safe to merge.
feedofmri/keel.readme_summary: Keel generates candidate fixes with Muse models then has Muse Spark write adversarial tests where candidates disagree. Python agent plus platform and GitHub Action, focused on calibrated trust for auto-merge decisions.

aosanya/hub-steward.summary: Multilingual AI steward that runs community lab memberships, forms and access.
aosanya/hub-steward.readme_summary: Hub Steward is a console plus phone app for agencies with permission-checked AI roles, chat, forms and approvals. Demo is a Siaya Kenya computer lab in English/Swahili/German, using OpenAI-compatible models.

ddavarma/driftzero.summary: Autonomous agent that repairs breaking API changes and proves fixes in sandbox.
ddavarma/driftzero.readme_summary: DriftZero diffs OpenAPI v1 to v2, repairs code in isolated git worktree with Muse Code, and validates in Modal sandbox on hold-out tests. Opens PR with evidence, rejecting test-editing cheats.

jleebio/bring-your-dna.summary: Genome interpreter that explains ancestry, variants and folds affected proteins.
jleebio/bring-your-dna.readme_summary: App takes a genome, reports origin and standout variants with biology from published data. Uses Meta Muse Spark for stories, Muse Image for visuals, and Meta ESMFold to show wildtype vs mutant structure.

XORSHIELD/vouch.summary: Shop-floor checker for medicines and foods with evidence-graded safety results.
XORSHIELD/vouch.readme_summary: Vouch verifies medicines, foods and cosmetics via barcode, giving Clear to Inconclusive with sources and limits. Python server with marketing docs, focused on complaint follow-through, not binary fake verdicts.

Alexeiguch/streetsense.summary: Real-time camera assistant that speaks street hazards for blind pedestrians.
Alexeiguch/streetsense.readme_summary: StreetSense runs fast local YOLO11s + ByteTrack and SegFormer on CPU for per-frame alerts, plus slow Meta model reasoning. Supports phone and webcam, targeting Ray-Ban Meta glasses for navigation aid.

Abhaykang29/secondshift.summary: Turns plain-English rules into camera checks that answer Yes, No or Can't tell.
Abhaykang29/secondshift.readme_summary: SecondShift lets users upload video or go live, with Meta models analyzing against natural-language rules with visual proof. Python backend plus frontend, with offline demo replay and live mode via META_API_KEY.

jayhilwig/vantside-meta.summary: Career memory that links resume facts to jobs and interviews.
jayhilwig/vantside-meta.readme_summary: VantSide builds an approvable Career Memory from resume PDFs and conversations. It connects facts to job descriptions and shows grounded cues in an interview HUD. It is built as Next.js frontend with backend services.

asoncode/CausalWorld.summary: Agent that probes hidden spring-rope physics from video to predict motion
asoncode/CausalWorld.readme_summary: Scientific agent that selects physical impulses, updates a numerical posterior from camera frames, and predicts unseen motion. Stack is Python backend with frontend and preregistered evaluation. Uses Muse for experiment selection and scoring on held-out episodes.

Turgunoff/solar-auditor.summary: Aerial rooftop solar audit with panel layout, ROI and PDF export
Turgunoff/solar-auditor.readme_summary: Analyzes rooftop imagery to detect roofs, layout panels with Shapely, and compute ROI analytics with PDF export. Stack is FastAPI backend and Vue 3 + Vite frontend. Uses SAM 3.1 / Muse adapters mock-first for segmentation.

jaccrocker/family-meal-planner.summary: Turns plain-word weekly meals into exact Instacart grocery cart
jaccrocker/family-meal-planner.readme_summary: Family meal planner that converts household size and meal choices into pack-rounded grocery lists synced to Instacart. Uses Muse Spark to parse meals with deterministic math for quantities, email approvals, Next.js app with Docker deploy.

sophist0/hackathon_q4_2026.summary: Tree-based prompt classifier with decider, runner and logger
sophist0/hackathon_q4_2026.readme_summary: Implements decide(state, question) interface with YAML question tree, runner, and JSONL/CSV logger. Pure Python with pluggable transport stubs, no direct network calls. Designed to benchmark Jev/Clef/Spark backends via custom transports.

arbonomous/museswarm.summary: Policy gate that reviews AI-worker actions before effects
arbonomous/museswarm.readme_summary: Scoped gate where defender roles allow or veto managed AI-worker effects before creation. Includes Streamlit dashboard, autonomy and defense council logic. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for checklist and reviewer decisions.

yerbol1212/proofloop.summary: Inspectable pass-fail checks for physical workflows with recovery
yerbol1212/proofloop.readme_summary: Turns procedures into executable checks yielding pass/fail/unknown and searches action model for corrections. Python package with examples and replay scripts. Uses Muse Spark to draft checks and SAM 3.1 to ground image observations.

ZNLong2203/Floodline.summary: Crowdsourced flood mapping from photos, clips and Telegram bot
ZNLong2203/Floodline.readme_summary: Collects resident photos and clips to estimate flood depth and plan routes via coordinator console. Cloud Run app with Telegram bot that calls models live. Uses Meta vision models for overlays and verdicts per vehicle.

GG-QandV/keysingate-capsule.summary: Sealed 6 MiB file that stores signed verifiable records of agent work
GG-QandV/keysingate-capsule.readme_summary: Rust capsule with no extraction path, exposing only signed export and status. Muse Spark agent logs steps and tool calls plus SAM 3.1 masks as signed pages for offline verification. Demo uses synthetic insurance claim with human verification.

ExistCode/scam-shield.summary: Telegram checker giving Indonesian parents scam verdicts in Bahasa
ExistCode/scam-shield.readme_summary: Forwards suspicious messages, screenshots, QRIS, voice and video for plain Bahasa Indonesia verdict and next steps. Telegram bot with WhatsApp adapter built, Python app backend. Uses Meta models to classify scams and alert family.

oasis-world/one-hour.summary: Ephemeral chat room where every text and photo message expires after one hour
oasis-world/one-hour.readme_summary: Vite + React ephemeral chat with Supabase cloud sync, IndexedDB local store and Realtime DELETE for synchronized dissolves. Ring countdown UI with dissolve animation and settings themes. Explores AI to make social interaction more engaging.

billyrdavis1985-bot/ForgeVigil.summary: Gate that holds outgoing documents until code confirms AI-checked approvals
billyrdavis1985-bot/ForgeVigil.readme_summary: ForgeVigil places a bounded AI agent in front of outgoing documents for small business. Muse Spark investigates via read-only tools, but deterministic code makes the allow/block decision. Standard-library Python with offline qualification and dashboard.

abubakarsiddik31/showonce.summary: Teach a robot arm a tabletop task by filming it just once
abubakarsiddik31/showonce.readme_summary: Python pipeline plus web demo that converts a single demo video into robot actions on a shuffled table. Handles perception, clarification dialogue and execution with tests and samples. Uses Meta AI vision models for video-to-task understanding.

tayyab415/scout.summary: Simulated house that tests if a robot's memory still matches reality
tayyab415/scout.readme_summary: Open physics-simulated home environment where a Meta Motivo humanoid builds memory via head camera and SAM 3.1. Splits episodes into changed vs unchanged worlds to test re-observation. Any model plugs in via four methods.

edycutjong/sealed.summary: Trustless bug bounties that pay for proven exploits on committed invariants
edycutjong/sealed.readme_summary: Rust verifier + NEAR contracts that pay only for executed break of committed snapshot, verified 5/5 real and 0/21 fakes on testnet. Offline replay via make replay and on-chain verify. Live demo and pitch site included.

RushSh/PrLens.summary: Splits AI-written PRs into must-review regions and safe-to-skip code
RushSh/PrLens.readme_summary: Python service that chunks PRs into ~25-line regions with risk scores, P0-P2 priority and inline comments. Proves safe skips via syntax-tree checks. Uses Muse Spark API and Muse Code for analysis and calibration.

Sibusiso-K/Parallax.summary: Rehearses big business choices with 36 months of cashflow on three paths
Sibusiso-K/Parallax.readme_summary: TypeScript + Vercel + Supabase app that turns founder narrative into computed figures and future-self dialogue. Muse Spark 1.3 extracts figures and roleplays outcomes; all math computed in code. Exports decision memo.

muhammadtalhaishtiaq/goodfix.summary: Turns how-to videos into step guides that check a photo of your work
muhammadtalhaishtiaq/goodfix.readme_summary: Vercel web app where creators publish narrated guides and learners follow step-by-step with stuck-photo check. Uses Meta vision models to compare user photo to creator frame and outline differences. Demo access via code Meta2026.

aizoya/aizoya-meta-keyboard-journeys.summary: Compares mouse vs keyboard routes and exports replayable regression evidence
aizoya/aizoya-meta-keyboard-journeys.readme_summary: Dockerized Chromium testing tool with deterministic outcomes, saved-action replay and CI adapter for customer loopback apps. Uses fictional fixtures, no real payments. Meta connection and acceptance documented in repo.

zw3rk/ppc64rt.summary: Runs Power64 Linux binaries on ARM64 via user-mode binary translation
zw3rk/ppc64rt.readme_summary: Zero-dependency static-PIE translator for ppc64le ELFv2 POWER9/Power10 on AArch64 Linux and Apple Silicon. Dual engines: C11 interpreter oracle and direct-mapped AArch64 DBT with 128TiB user space. No explicit Meta model use in excerpt.

zw3rk/sparc64rt.summary: User-mode SPARC V9 binary translator running big-endian ELF on AArch64 Linux
zw3rk/sparc64rt.readme_summary: Static-PIE translator for SPARC V9 Linux ELFs on AArch64. Provides a C11 reference interpreter and a default AArch64 DBT engine with direct mapping. Targets Oracle M8 and Fujitsu CPUs with no external dependencies.

daniadasaya/metahackathon.summary: Turns messy seller photos into ready-to-sell commerce catalog
daniadasaya/metahackathon.readme_summary: Katalog Kilat converts multi-product chat photos into catalog CSV, studio photos, IG captions and WhatsApp price lists. Uses muse-spark-1.3, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and muse-image-1.0 via mobile-first web app.

Amos-kays/bearings.summary: Checks code, tests and git evidence to show real distance to MVP
Amos-kays/bearings.readme_summary: Parses MVP description into acceptance items and checks files, tests, git history and Muse Code sessions. Uses deterministic code for verdicts and a Muse model only to propose items. Reports verified to missing status as a range.

Caleb0796/agent-hub-eng.summary: Chat hub where personal agents collaborate with owners and friends on tasks
Caleb0796/agent-hub-eng.readme_summary: Chat system where user-owned agents work across friends via invite links and MCP. Supports one-click Hub agents on Muse model API plus Dot, Muse and Duet natives. Includes demo replay, tests and docs.

ali-amjad52114/museplant.summary: Converts process specs into ladder logic, P&ID and live plant simulation
ali-amjad52114/museplant.readme_summary: Uploads PDF specs for Muse Spark to extract requirements with citations, then generates ladder rungs and P&ID. Validator with 2-step repair loop, browser EPANET simulation. Uses live Meta Model API and voice dictation.

HK-Teachnologies/Virtual-MDT-for-General.summary: Virtual specialist team supporting GPs with multilingual decision support
HK-Teachnologies/Virtual-MDT-for-General.readme_summary: Clinician-facing support for low-resource general practice with synthetic data only. Provides multi-agent specialist input in Luganda, Kiswahili and English. Stack spans frontend, backend and model server with review sign-off.

food-bundles/food-bundles-chef-app.summary: Chef app for correct ordering, receiving and live stock before service
food-bundles/food-bundles-chef-app.readme_summary: Restaurant stock and ordering app for chefs to reconcile orders and inventory. Built with Expo SDK mobile frontend, FastAPI Python backend and PostgreSQL. Focuses on receive-right and service-ready workflows.

Oc2cO/Oc2cO-Thon.summary: Self-verifying research agent that checks claims with evidence trails
Oc2cO/Oc2cO-Thon.readme_summary: ClaimWatch research agent built for Indie track to verify claims with sources. Repo shows automation, eval and agent orchestration scaffolding. Uses Muse models for research and self-verification workflow.

localhost8083/kineticlab-neuro-symbolic-.summary: Phone-camera pendulum tracker with audited physics measurements
localhost8083/kineticlab-neuro-symbolic-.readme_summary: Points phone camera at a pendulum where SAM 3.1 handles segmentation and stdlib-only Python does measurement. Ships every result with full audit trail. Includes fixtures, tests and CI for reproducible metrology.

Arun-Velkumar19/spokenslate.summary: Turns whiteboard lectures into accessible linked pages for blind students
Arun-Velkumar19/spokenslate.readme_summary: Processes recorded lectures into ordered board steps with plain readings, MathML and LaTeX. Links spoken deictics like this to referenced steps and marks unresolved cases. Python pipeline with evals and docs.

Hetul16/caresaathi.summary: Voice-first care companion turning medical papers and visits into one sourced care plan
Hetul16/caresaathi.readme_summary: Voice-first companion for families of elderly patients. It ingests prescriptions and visit audio into a single care plan with source citations and flags conflicts as doctor questions. Built as website with frontend/backend stack, uses Muse models for multilingual summarization without giving advice.

aaronmalunga/LedgerLens.summary: Turns receipts, SMS, and voice notes into trader ledgers and credit files.
aaronmalunga/LedgerLens.readme_summary: Converts receipts, notebook pages, mobile-money SMS and voice notes into confirmed ledgers and lender-ready credit files. Python app with evals, tests and live demo. Built with Muse Spark 1.3 for extraction and Muse Voice Transcribe.

venkatselvan/harvest-outlook.summary: Farm planning PWA with field maps, crop ranking, weather alerts and voice assistant
venkatselvan/harvest-outlook.readme_summary: Progressive web app for Indian farmers to map fields, compare crops, and track daily tasks and journal. Combines satellite maps, weather, Sentinel-2 indices and profit estimates. Evara assistant answers from farm records with voice input via Muse models.

hallzyx/cut-sense.summary: Turns photos of workshop offcuts into verified cutting plans to reuse scrap material
hallzyx/cut-sense.readme_summary: Photographs irregular leather, felt or foam scraps, segments shape, and nests parts around defects. Independent geometric verifier checks overlaps and spacing before display. Web app with AI segmentation plus nesting engine, leftover material tracked for reuse.

chickendavefifteen/profiles.summary: Local-first Tauri desktop shell organizing agents and apps into profiles
chickendavefifteen/profiles.readme_summary: Tauri 2 Linux shell provides calm A/B/C and X profile worlds over agent, browser and work apps. Local-first agent core is swappable between Pi, Muse, Grok, Hermes and local models with bring-your-own key.

FadeHack/ForkCheck.summary: Checks meeting transcripts for ambiguous decisions and resolves splits with members
FadeHack/ForkCheck.readme_summary: Parses pasted or transcribed meetings to find decisions open to multiple readings. Asks participants private clarifying questions and compares answers in code, then settles differences. Uses Muse Spark for ambiguity detection and question generation.

DharanesshMD/mobile-agent.summary: Multi-phone Android agent that picks devices, retries safely and replays runs
DharanesshMD/mobile-agent.readme_summary: Agent orchestrates real Android devices, selecting capable phones and falling back on failure with safety guardrails. Python agent with Docker setup, prompts, docs and 872 tests plus replay tooling. Uses Meta models for planning and device action grounding.

GyslainM/recovery-room.summary: Verifiable repair agent that tests fixes on copies before touching data
GyslainM/recovery-room.readme_summary: Recovery runtime where a Meta Muse Spark agent investigates failed imports and proposes repairs. Executes on disposable copy with independent checks and outputs guarded script for human review. Local workbench plus replayable demo site.

zw3rk/rt-series.summary: User-mode runtimes to run foreign Linux guests natively on AArch64 hosts
zw3rk/rt-series.readme_summary: Collection of user-mode runtimes and translators for running AArch32 and other Linux guests on AArch64 including Apple Silicon. Nix-based build with specs and docs, Class A/B address-space model. No Meta AI integration evident; low-level systems infra.

faberho28/tutor-360.summary: Camera-based lab trainer that segments circuits and guides repairs by voice
faberho28/tutor-360.readme_summary: Points laptop camera at real circuits, SAM 3.1 segments parts, Muse Spark 1.3 identifies them and writes level-adapted procedures. Tracking keeps masks anchored while guide updates from answers and voice. Uses SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe.

tugra8005/vega.summary: Camera-local anomaly detector that learns normal scenes and flags outliers
tugra8005/vega.readme_summary: VEGA samples timestamped footage to model per-camera normality with flow, color and memory witnesses plus YOLO. Muse Spark judges candidate events while SAM 3.1 segments them for evidence-grounded review. Python pipeline built solo during hackathon.

RanveerRD/Meta-Data-Analytics-and-Visual.summary: Plain-English data analyst that writes read-only SQL and verifies numbers
RanveerRD/Meta-Data-Analytics-and-Visual.readme_summary: Agent plans questions, writes read-only SQL for SQLite/Postgres and cross-checks results before answering. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API with charting, BI publish and WhatsApp. Python agent with scripts and tests.

amarsyla/galileo.summary: Phone-based physics lab that tracks pendulums and measures gravity
amarsyla/galileo.readme_summary: Students film a pendulum and Galileo tracks motion, overlays physics visuals and guides discovery. Stack is Python backend plus Node frontend with ffmpeg. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for tutoring and Muse Image.

mauricio0209/unreal-playtester.summary: Autonomous Unreal playtester that checks gameplay against design docs
mauricio0209/unreal-playtester.readme_summary: Muse Spark turns plain-English design docs into checks, then plays UE 5.8 levels from screenshots and state. A no-LLM deterministic verifier replays bugs 3x with repro steps and video. Agent plus Unreal and scripts setup.

corleroux/snaplog-meta-hackathon.summary: Mobile fabric catalogue that digitizes swatches and vendor cards
corleroux/snaplog-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Fashion buyers photograph swatches and cards for searchable catalogue on React + Supabase. Hackathon work migrates extraction from Gemini to Muse Spark with Muse Spark Open option. Supabase Edge Functions pipeline.

AmanM006/meta-generative-cad.summary: Natural-language engineering studio with beam solver verification
AmanM006/meta-generative-cad.readme_summary: Neodustria interprets written specs with Meta Muse to propose experiments and constraints. Separate nonlinear beam solver validates geometry with mesh refinement. Next.js studio with live runs and saved evidence.

Nandanhs006/AdVision.summary: In-scene ad placement that keeps story identical per viewer
Nandanhs006/AdVision.readme_summary: Meta Model API adapter orchestrates Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Wonder for atmosphere, Muse Image for backdrops and SAM 3.1 for surfaces. Next.js plus Python backend with Audience Network logic. MIT licensed.

zw3rk/mips32rt.summary: Zero-dependency MIPS32r2 binary translator for AArch64 Linux
zw3rk/mips32rt.readme_summary: Static-PIE user-mode translator for MIPS32 LE/BE O32 ELF on AArch64 Linux and macOS via hyper-linux. Dual engines with C11 interpreter oracle and JIT, Nix and Make builds. No Meta AI integration evident.

afterbooth/after-booth.summary: Marketplace that re-homes event booth equipment before teardown
afterbooth/after-booth.readme_summary: Givers photograph booth gear, Muse Spark detects and counts items with SAM 3.1 verification for reservations. Mobile-first English UI in KST with org-scoped auth. Docker backend plus contract and spec docs.

Felipe3052/fair-deposit.summary: Move-out inspector separating wear from damage with photo proof
Felipe3052/fair-deposit.readme_summary: Upload move-in/out photos and Muse Spark assesses wear vs damage with SAM 3.1 masks and depreciation estimates. Drafts landlord reply with cited sources. Next.js app with live demo and rate limits.

Angry-TacoZ/verified-cruise-control.summary: Audits car ADAS claims against listing photos and docs for human review
Angry-TacoZ/verified-cruise-control.readme_summary: Compares advertised ADAS features against listing photos and vehicle docs to produce reviewable evidence packets. Uses Muse visual observations with SAM localization, manufacturer-aware rules and deterministic reconciliation via durable worker with spend caps.

prashant-zo/veto.summary: Release gate that blocks Argo canaries when behavior differs from PR intent
prashant-zo/veto.readme_summary: Release gate for Argo Rollouts that checks if a canary did what its PR said and nothing else. Uses Muse Spark Open for explanation only, never approval, with replayable decisions and behavior-vs-intent verification.

chayachandana/circuitproof.summary: Testable AI circuit debugger that verifies repairs before proposing them
chayachandana/circuitproof.readme_summary: Interactive circuit debugging app where Muse Spark runs experiments, inspects measurements and proposes repairs only after passing targets. Node.js stack with in-browser independent verification and exportable evidence notebook.

sparsadev/xigenia.summary: Open source personal finance tracker with deterministic ledger and AI explanations
sparsadev/xigenia.readme_summary: Personal finance web app where balances are calculated deterministically from entries. Uses Meta AI only to explain existing data in plain language. Built with .NET API, web frontend and Docker Compose deployment.

prabindersinghh/ustad.summary: Factory copilot that guides workers step-by-step and verifies work on camera
prabindersinghh/ustad.readme_summary: Captures an expert job once then guides new workers with step instructions and camera verification. Python backend with web frontend, deployed on Modal, using vision models to box parts and check completion.

manvendersingh21/thermomind.summary: Read-only gas turbine diagnostic investigator with cited evidence reports
manvendersingh21/thermomind.readme_summary: Turns turbine sensor windows into cases with deterministic evidence, baseline comparison, and Muse Spark 1.3 report citing only tool-returned IDs. Server validator gates drafts for human review. Uses real UCI turbine data plus synthetic faults.

zw3rk/ppc32rt.summary: Zero-dependency PowerPC 32-bit Linux binary translator for AArch64
zw3rk/ppc32rt.readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE binary translator for PowerPC 750/RAD750 and e500v2 SPE ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Provides C11 interpreter oracle and DBT engine with 4GiB window and profile auto-detection.

davissekai/two-eyes.summary: Traces muddy rivers to upstream mining scars using phone video and satellite
davissekai/two-eyes.readme_summary: Citizen tool that links phone video of muddy water to upstream Sentinel-2 forest clearings and drainage analysis. Uses SAM 3.1 for scar outlines and Muse Spark for water-color judgment and evidence-card text.

zw3rk/mips64rt.summary: Zero-dependency MIPS64r2 Linux binary translator for AArch64
zw3rk/mips64rt.readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE translator for MIPS64r2 little/big-endian N64 and N32 ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Includes portable C11 reference interpreter and DBT engine with 1TiB/2GiB address space handling.

zw3rk/sparc32rt.summary: Zero-dependency SPARC V8 Linux binary translator for AArch64
zw3rk/sparc32rt.readme_summary: User-mode static-PIE translator for SPARC V8 LEON3/LEON4 ELFs on AArch64 Linux and macOS. Offers C11 interpreter oracle and direct-mapped DBT with strict EM_SPARC admission and 4GiB window.

kumbemaster/container-tracker.summary: Port-to-door shipment stage tracking for Nigerian importers and clearing agents
kumbemaster/container-tracker.readme_summary: Port-2-Door tracks containers from Nigerian ports like Onne to importer address and empty return. Built with Django Python backend in config/tracking modules. Uses Meta AI models for stage updates and importer-agent transparency.

odieng-oumy/reperlence.summary: AI repair assistant that diagnoses broken devices and guides step-by-step fixes
odieng-oumy/reperlence.readme_summary: RepairLens helps users repair small appliances to reduce e-waste via photo, audio and guided instructions. Stack is FastAPI backend with React frontend and inspection history. Uses Meta Muse models for vision diagnosis and voice-guided repair.

zw3rk/loongarch64rt.summary: Zero-dependency LoongArch64 Linux binary translator for AArch64 hosts
zw3rk/loongarch64rt.readme_summary: loongarch64rt runs LoongArch LP64D ELF binaries on AArch64 Linux and macOS via interpreter and DBT engines. Written in portable C11 with static-PIE musl build, Make/Nix flake and differential tests. No Meta AI integration in tree.

ats4321/corerobot.summary: Learns tabletop tasks from one video and runs them on simulated Franka arm
ats4321/corerobot.readme_summary: Core Robot converts a demo video into Python using pick/place primitives executed in PyBullet simulation. Pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for object segmentation/tracking and Muse Spark for plan and code generation with pose-based checker.

josel120/BarrioAI.summary: Photo-to-store PWA that digitizes local shop menus for semantic search
josel120/BarrioAI.readme_summary: BarrioAI photographs menus/chalkboards to create geolocated store listings with WhatsApp contact. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind, Supabase PostGIS/pgvector and Leaflet. Uses Meta Model API vision with JSON schema for product extraction.

takingbreath/whenever.summary: Plain-English camera rules that trigger alerts and actions on detection
takingbreath/whenever.readme_summary: IFTTT for cameras: Muse Wonder generates rule code from English, Muse Spark and SAM 3.1 monitor RTSP/ONVIF and phone cameras on Mac/Linux. Fires phone alerts, lights, webhooks and reports.

perfect7613/embodied-ci.summary: CI harness that tests V-JEPA world models and auto-fixes robot failures
perfect7613/embodied-ci.readme_summary: CI for JEPA world models that runs V-JEPA 2-AC raw to create regression tests, probes perception vs control failure, then edits weights and guardrails. Muse Spark Open subagents diagnose and fix, gated promotion with JSONL logs.

Jinwoo1126/Mirror.summary: Personal agent that learns preferences as a time-aware graph for other AIs to use.
Jinwoo1126/Mirror.readme_summary: Agent storing choices as time-aware Kuzu knowledge graph, visualized as body map and shared via MCP to tools you already use. Python 3.11 + Docker Compose service with 362 tests and hosted multi-user version shelved.

galaxycoils/grok-muse.summary: Rust macOS computer-use agent with multi-agent coworker suite and offline VM
galaxycoils/grok-muse.readme_summary: Rust monorepo with native desktop client, ScreenCaptureKit automation and offline VM transport. Uses hybrid routing across Meta Muse, xAI Grok and local VLM via Candle for computer-use tasks with durable dispatch.

es162008087/AulaScout.summary: Photo plus voice note turned into infant lesson plan and printable visual card
es162008087/AulaScout.readme_summary: Takes one classroom photo without children and 15-20s voice note to inventory materials. Generates 3x20-min SEP-aligned lesson plan with safety sections and 3-panel ficha. Built on Meta Model API with Python bridge and Cloud Run demo.
