Landry-16/live_tutorial_coach.summary: Turns any tutorial video into a live camera coach that checks your steps
Landry-16/live_tutorial_coach.readme_summary: Splits uploaded mp4 tutorials into validated steps then watches phone camera work. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for steps and narration, SAM 3.1 for visual check and Muse Voice Transcribe for hands-free.

muktarbdulkader/FamilyGuard.summary: Parental control app with live location, app limits and AI safety alerts
muktarbdulkader/FamilyGuard.readme_summary: Flutter parental control app with real-time location, app usage management and secure family pairing. Uses Firebase, Firestore and Functions for backend. Integrates Meta Llama 3.2 and Llama Guard for content risk analysis.

Ankith-m1006/plateproof.summary: Turns real dish clips into listing photos only if faithful to the plate
Ankith-m1006/plateproof.readme_summary: Films the actual served plate then generates listing-quality image with faithfulness report and audit rounds. Rejects non-matching outputs, stores source hash for trust. Built for indie restaurants for Swiggy, WhatsApp and Instagram.

fuadhasandev/krishilens.summary: Crop-care agent helping farmers diagnose leaf issues by voice and photos
fuadhasandev/krishilens.readme_summary: KrishiLens is a crop investigation agent for smallholder farmers to observe symptoms, answer follow-ups, and monitor changes. React 19 + TypeScript client with Node server and MongoDB Atlas. Uses Meta Muse and SAM for visual and voice analysis.

ZubeidHendricks/verichainx-shop.summary: Verified AI shopping with signed offers settled via Solana and NFTs
ZubeidHendricks/verichainx-shop.readme_summary: Shopping agents verify signed merchant offers, seller identity, NFT ownership and listing photos. Settles USDC, fee and Metaplex Core NFT transfer in one Solana transaction, also as Actions/Blinks. Next.js, Drizzle, SIWS auth, Muse Spark vision.

bsknbsk/cnc-crash-lab.summary: Browser 3D CNC trainer where you write G-code, crash safely and learn
bsknbsk/cnc-crash-lab.readme_summary: Next.js + React Three Fiber simulator for Fanuc 0i G-code with animated tool, crash effects and repair-cost cards. Supabase stores programs and costs. Meta Model API powers senior-setter AI instructor feedback.

maxiroblesfx-commits/testigo.summary: Compares migrated and legacy app screens to write evidence-linked reports
maxiroblesfx-commits/testigo.readme_summary: Captures both legacy and migrated screens on open and save, reads them with Muse Spark and compares field-by-field under fixed rules. Outputs acta reports with screenshot-linked values as static site. No build, HTML viewer.

arbitman555/ProofGate.summary: Verifies AI vulnerability claims against source code with evidence verdicts
arbitman555/ProofGate.readme_summary: Breaks security reports into atomic claims and checks each against versioned source code. Uses Python pipeline with static code checks plus optional sandboxed reproduction tests. Leverages Meta AI models to parse claims and produce evidenced verdicts without applying fixes.

Sriya03/inbox-relay-demo.summary: Sorts synthetic recruiter inbox and drafts replies with safety gate
Sriya03/inbox-relay-demo.readme_summary: Labels synthetic job-search mail into 8 categories and drafts replies without auto-sending. Built with TypeScript using rules plus safety screen and LLM gate pipeline. Demonstrates privacy-first triage where interviews and offers surface above promos.

crystalphantom/video-evals.summary: Reviews dubbed video like code review with timestamped fix threads
crystalphantom/video-evals.readme_summary: Uploads original and dubbed video with a brief to return timestamped review threads. Combines Muse Spark 1.3 audio-video judge on short clips with deterministic signal checks. Serves results via REST, MCP, webhook plus side-by-side UI.

KIREETI001/Ground-Truth.summary: Turns GitHub code into guided learning paths with practice tasks
KIREETI001/Ground-Truth.readme_summary: Connects selected public GitHub source to workflows, concepts and focused practice. Web app with sample learning path, in-app study assistance that pauses during independent attempts. Uses Muse models to explain systems and support authorized human review.

darvcodev/hackathon-meta.summary: Measures coffee leaf rust and cherry ripeness from phone photos
darvcodev/hackathon-meta.readme_summary: Turns phone leaf photos into rust measurement, ripeness counts and farm dashboard. Powered by Meta SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Spark for analysis. Full-stack app with backend, frontend and live deployment.

fenetdiriba/PeerCode-AI.summary: Collaborative editor that finds breaking changes and verifies AI fixes
fenetdiriba/PeerCode-AI.readme_summary: Real-time Yjs collaborative editor with time-travel checkpoints and test bisect to locate regressions. Meta Muse Spark explains root cause and proposes patch, verified on a copy before apply.

actswartz/lab-tutor.summary: Coaches networking lab students from terminal output without giving answers
actswartz/lab-tutor.readme_summary: Side panel beside hosted router lab reads terminal tail and lab check results. Gateway FastAPI app polls lab broker and streams coaching via Muse Spark with graded hint ladder. Never prints the fix, only nudges and concepts.

shintrinh/SmartLocalUs-VoiceSubmission.summary: Answers missed calls for local businesses and books jobs in 5 stages
shintrinh/SmartLocalUs-VoiceSubmission.readme_summary: Voice agent for HVAC businesses handling inbound calls, address and urgency capture to appointment booking. Built with C# Azure Functions and Twilio voice webhooks plus ConversationFlowEngine state machine. Hands off to human on request and saves lead.

aleksandrasremcev/negotiate-ai.summary: Negotiates prices in structured rounds with human approval control
aleksandrasremcev/negotiate-ai.readme_summary: Buyer-side negotiation agent with multi-round workflow, history and budget validation. Built with Meta Muse Spark for strategy generation plus deterministic checks. Requires explicit human confirmation before finalizing agreements.

greeshma-ch/DRISHTI.summary: Phone-based walking companion that speaks hazards and navigation guidance in Hindi or English.
greeshma-ch/DRISHTI.readme_summary: Safety-first walking aid using chest-mounted phone camera with two-tier design. Tier 1 runs COCO-SSD lite on-device in a Web Worker at ~330ms per frame for hazard detection. Uses Meta models for destination guidance, bilingual voice output and emergency alerts.

SHARPLEE00/awesome-ai-motion-videos.summary: Curated gallery of AI-coded motion graphics, films and games with prompts
SHARPLEE00/awesome-ai-motion-videos.readme_summary: Collection of 193 three.js, canvas, SVG and Remotion pieces from X with credits and prompts. Static site built via Node build script from JSON data. No Meta Muse model integration; showcase of coding-model generated video.

facunahuel420/CircuitGuard-AI.summary: Tri-visor AI cockpit for microelectronics fault diagnosis and board audit
facunahuel420/CircuitGuard-AI.readme_summary: Real-time CAD vector engine plus microscope and multimeter telemetry with SAM 3.1 video segmentation. Stack is Python backend, frontend visor, n8n workflows on Ubuntu. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning, SAM 3.1 vision, Muse Voice and Wonder via Meta Model API.

Uknowme-h/kiln.summary: Multi-agent team turns one product idea into a tested local web app
Uknowme-h/kiln.readme_summary: Requirements, planner, coding and test agents build on user's machine via local companion over WebSocket. Contract in docs/contract.md with model I/O trace. Uses Muse Spark for planning and Muse Spark Open for coding via Meta endpoints.

aimenhamzi01-dot/phantom.summary: Signed evidence worker that scopes security findings for human review
aimenhamzi01-dot/phantom.readme_summary: Bounded evidence collection layer for Mizan review workflow, avoiding autonomous decisions. Python engines with signed artifacts, Docker Compose, CI. Uses Meta Muse Spark via meta_client.py to organize collected evidence.

Xyryung/biocompiler-engine.summary: Simulation-only workspace turning language goals into OT-2 lab protocols
Xyryung/biocompiler-engine.readme_summary: Natural-language goal to validated plan, Opentrons OT-2 protocol and simulator output with synthetic 96-well data. FastAPI backend plus Next.js web app via uv and Node 22. Local simulation only, no Meta model required.

minego90/marketing-studio-xr-app.summary: Quest 3 mixed-reality studio that builds full Instagram campaigns in 3D
minego90/marketing-studio-xr-app.readme_summary: Walkable Three.js office where owner creates strategy, copy, images, 9:16 video and Meta Ads draft. WebXR plus small Node.js server.mjs, no Unity build. Uses Meta Muse Spark assistant for guided campaign generation.

reusahn/Contextlens.summary: Chrome extension that flags repeated challenges, products and campaigns for viewers
reusahn/Contextlens.readme_summary: Chrome Manifest V3 extension with Node.js backend and OriginTrace investigation app. It detects repeated exposure to the same content and lets viewers pause. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for repetition and context analysis.

itsmanudon/sprint-serve-ai-assistants.summary: Two grounded restaurant assistants for guests ordering and owners analytics
itsmanudon/sprint-serve-ai-assistants.readme_summary: Chef assistant builds validated meals from menu with diet and budget checks; owner assistant answers sales metrics. Node TypeScript server validates all outputs. Uses Meta Muse Spark via Meta Model API grounded in restaurant data.

blackgik/relay-systems.summary: Peer-to-peer logistics network booking travelers bag space with escrow
blackgik/relay-systems.readme_summary: Senders book kilo-priced space, multi-leg routing, escrow until delivery confirmation. Turborepo monorepo with apps/packages, Docker Compose, TypeScript. No explicit Meta Muse integration in excerpt.

satisfymath/unbidden-demo-fastapi.summary: Staged FastAPI Teamboard demo for testing the Unbidden AI scanner
satisfymath/unbidden-demo-fastapi.readme_summary: Plain full-stack-fastapi-template copy with real missing index, planted crash, staged seed data and Locust traffic. Backend/frontend plus compose demo setup. Built as evaluation target for Unbidden during Meta hackathon.

jehshPhilemon/yekiva.summary: Voice-first Android app teaching reading and writing without prior literacy
jehshPhilemon/yekiva.readme_summary: Yekiva is an Android literacy app using voice, image, and gesture with French, Swahili, and Lingala data packs. Capacitor HTML/CSS/JS app in app/www with dependency-free Node server. Server holds Meta key to build lessons and parse spoken answers.

joymin5655/airlens-agent.summary: Hourly agent that investigates Korean air pollution events with cited evidence
joymin5655/airlens-agent.readme_summary: Monitors ~670 AirKorea stations and NASA FIRMS fires hourly, clusters PM events and investigates causes. Serves evidence-backed Q&A with sources. Built with Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 for smoke masks, Modal + web frontend.

yashasvishailly/i-have-nothing-to-wear-m.summary: Mobile wardrobe app that sorts outfit photos into pieces and saved looks
yashasvishailly/i-have-nothing-to-wear-m.readme_summary: Mobile-first app with Pile, Wardrobe and Hanger for outfit photos. Server-side Cloudflare Worker calls Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via api.meta.ai to detect wearable pieces and regions, then crops and validates them for mixing.

idkman6789/crosssight.summary: Audit engine cross-checking contract, blueprint and site photo for mismatches
idkman6789/crosssight.readme_summary: Audit engine, not chatbot: runs masks to cross-check to finding to action to verification. Cross-checks contract clauses against blueprint and photo regions with proof. Demo uses fictional Project Atlas pack in Next.js.

is-cream/musepilot.summary: macOS chat UI that drives Muse Code CLI and tracks usage windows
is-cream/musepilot.readme_summary: Single-file Python 3 stdlib-only macOS chat client for Meta muse CLI. Lets users pick model, reasoning effort and context, chat and queue prompts. Tracks 5-hour usage window and parses JSONL for readable output.

improvenaildesign/NailMentor-Hackathon.summary: AI coach giving visual feedback on nail work for students and technicians
improvenaildesign/NailMentor-Hackathon.readme_summary: Prototype by IND Academy combining Meta SAM 3.1 for fingernail segmentation with Muse Spark multimodal analysis. Provides structured educational feedback on nail-work images via Python app.py and sam_module.py.

wyy1048576/wander.summary: Friends swipe on places and an agent merges picks into one bookable trip itinerary.
wyy1048576/wander.readme_summary: Wander collects group preferences via pairwise swipes and a Muse Spark agent reconciles them into a single itinerary. Built with Next.js and Docker with static demo rendering from seed data. Uses Muse Spark for negotiation and trip planning.

AanchalGupta1162/Blindspot.summary: Live Muse monitoring agent inferring unseen risks from sparse sensors
AanchalGupta1162/Blindspot.readme_summary: Combines sparse sensors, physical digital twin, estimator, tool-using Muse agent and deterministic action gate with human approval. Live Meta API calls. Next.js + Postgres/PGlite lab with architecture view.

JivheshDharankar/Relay_META_AI_Developer.summary: Multi-agent platform that automates procurement for apartment communities
JivheshDharankar/Relay_META_AI_Developer.readme_summary: Autonomous procurement for housing societies where models reason and deterministic code governs actions. Built with TypeScript, Next.js 14, PostgreSQL/Prisma and Docker, using Meta AI for agent workflows.

Soniya2001/metaai.summary: Real-time multilingual AI voice messaging with live transcripts
Soniya2001/metaai.readme_summary: EchoPulse real-time multilingual voice messaging with React 18 + TypeScript frontend and FastAPI Python backend. Deployed on Cloud Run with Swagger docs. Uses Meta AI models for voice understanding and response.

est4ever/DemoDoctor.summary: Replays robot demos with synced video, SAM checks and cited explanations
est4ever/DemoDoctor.readme_summary: Investigates robot demonstrations with synchronized video, SAM 3.1 observations and source-backed checks. React + FastAPI stack uses Muse Spark Open for cited diagnosis while keeping missing evidence visible.

oseiagm/sika.summary: WhatsApp investing assistant for Ghana stocks with risk profiling and live pricing.
oseiagm/sika.readme_summary: WhatsApp investing assistant for the Ghana Stock Exchange that profiles risk, builds plans, and suggests priced trades. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with WhatsApp integration. Uses Meta Muse models for profiling, planning, and trade explanations.

mcmxciillan/trellis-harness.summary: Rust single-binary harness for orchestrating complex autonomous coding workflows.
mcmxciillan/trellis-harness.readme_summary: Rust-based harness for structuring autonomous multi-agent coding workflows as a single executable. Includes web PWA frontend and test suite. Orchestrates 23 coding agents and APIs with cultivated scaffolding.

mirmashhouri/human-animal-ai.summary: Turns selfies into animal portraits with side-by-side view and exportable image.
mirmashhouri/human-animal-ai.readme_summary: Turns selfies or group photos into animal-inspired portraits with side-by-side comparison and PNG export. Frontend in React/Expo, backend in ASP.NET Core 10. Uses Muse Spark for analogy, SAM for segmentation, and Muse Image for generation.

aagneye/Squint.summary: Tests vision AI on degraded labels to catch confident misreads for blind users.
aagneye/Squint.readme_summary: Crash-test lab that renders labels with known text, degrades them, and measures vision model failures. Tracks legibility boundary and confidently-wrong answers. Built on Meta Model API to evaluate safe assistive reading.

OrangeJuice023/tulay.summary: Community career-bridge agent matching Filipino talent for introductions and collaborations
OrangeJuice023/tulay.readme_summary: Tulay is a community-powered career mobility agent, Philippines-first. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Supabase Postgres/Auth, it matches goals/offers with deterministic logic and uses Muse Spark 1.3 for language and structure.

JivheshDharankar/Relay.summary: Multi-agent procurement platform turning resident requests into managed orders.
JivheshDharankar/Relay.readme_summary: AI-first multi-agent procurement for apartment communities from natural-language requests. Next.js frontend with backend agent layer and 11 deterministic tools. Uses Muse Spark orchestration via pluggable ModelProvider.

BruhWhosJoe/mise.summary: Finds relevant DC open datasets for plain-English questions and plans analysis.
BruhWhosJoe/mise.readme_summary: Turns plain-English DC questions into ranked open-government datasets and analysis plans. Handles discovery across 1600+ datasets before analysis. Uses Meta Muse Spark for ranking, summarization, and planning.

ahmad-ar91/showmi.summary: Audits Google Play listings and generates localized copy, posters, and bundles.
ahmad-ar91/showmi.readme_summary: End-to-end ASO agent that audits Play listings, scores health, and builds localized copy and graphics. Uses google-play-scraper and recharts with SAM 3.1 visual analysis. Uses Muse Spark for copy and Muse Image for backgrounds.

diegoqprobst/solar-proposal-agent.summary: Sizes solar-plus-storage systems from site documents with fully sourced figures.
diegoqprobst/solar-proposal-agent.readme_summary: Agent that turns datasheets, surveys, and photos into sized solar-plus-storage designs with traceable figures. Python agent with tests and case files. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for extraction and sizing.

shawnofficial29/Flight-clearanceguard-AI.summary: Verifies ATC clearances against pilot readback and FMS trajectory in 4D
shawnofficial29/Flight-clearanceguard-AI.readme_summary: Shared 4D ATC clearance verification prototype comparing ATC intent, pilot readback, simulated FMS programming and predicted trajectory. Uses muse-spark-1.3 ATC Intent and Pilot agents, FMS simulator, deterministic comparison matrix and verification coordinator with audit chain.

naveen1609/soloestate-ai-hackathon.summary: AI operating system for one-person real estate business with approval gates
naveen1609/soloestate-ai-hackathon.readme_summary: Owner-directed AI business OS where Meta Muse Spark proposes plans, uses permitted tools, and pauses for approval. Stack is dashboard frontend, Python backend, Supabase persistence with CRM for leads, properties, appointments and bounded recovery.

aikingtai-ctrl/jintai-hbcm-ai-platform.summary: AI film production platform for college creators covering full workflow
aikingtai-ctrl/jintai-hbcm-ai-platform.readme_summary: Static HTML showcase for Jintai AI film platform aimed at Hebei Communication College teachers and students. Describes local GPU cluster, Jintai 1-3 model routing, 812 directing skills, asset library and MCP/CLI automation pipeline.

praneeth-sholapur/ai-agent-live.summary: Personal portfolio chatbot site backed by Muse Wonder serverless API
praneeth-sholapur/ai-agent-live.readme_summary: Public index.html chat site calling POST /api/chat with fallback answers. Vercel Node function calls Meta API muse-wonder-1.0 with system prompt rules, spend cap and environment-key configuration.

elakumuk/backtest-breaker.summary: Audits trading backtests for overfitting and look-ahead leakage faults
elakumuk/backtest-breaker.readme_summary: Two Muse Spark agents with opposite jobs audit strategies for selection bias and leakage; all numerics are deterministic code. Built with Streamlit app, Muse Spark via Baseten meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026, and eval harness.

PiotrTyrakowski/MetaGlobalHackaton.summary: Turns messy concrete plant Excel into low-CO2 mix predictions
PiotrTyrakowski/MetaGlobalHackaton.readme_summary: MixPilot agent on Meta Muse Spark cleans plant spreadsheets into Meta BOxCrete format and tests extra variables. Aims to predict 28-day strength and propose lower-cement mixes to cut CO2 with plant-specific data.

madhurthareja/hackMeta.summary: Hazard-warning navigation aid turning first-person video into spoken directions
madhurthareja/hackMeta.readme_summary: Locus segments first-person video with SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex into a persistent 3D scene graph. Computes time-to-collision for stereo-panned audio cues. Evaluated on Google SANPO dataset with Meta SAM 3.1 perception.

JSama99/FDE-Command-Center.summary: Evidence-backed engineering investigation platform with visual workspaces
JSama99/FDE-Command-Center.readme_summary: FDE Command Center combines source provenance, competing hypotheses, diagnostic predictions and graphical evidence exploration. Python backend server serves local web UI with seven investigation workspaces and synthetic demo data.

amongstwolves/sonicdna.summary: Reverse-engineers reference sounds into editable synth recipes
amongstwolves/sonicdna.readme_summary: Autonomous sound-design lab where Muse muse-spark-1.3 proposes oscillator and effect structures, numeric optimizer tunes parameters, librosa.pyin tracks pitch and deterministic renderer scores results with experiment logs.

RamanthArupa/mudrika.summary: Signed prepaid credits let agents pay via HTTP 402 and verify credentials
RamanthArupa/mudrika.readme_summary: Mudrika provides signed prepaid credits with budgets for agents to purchase services over HTTP 402. SAM 3.1 verifies a doctor certificate against issuer records while Muse Spark powers agent flows. FastAPI backend with dashboard and issuer API deployed on Render.

Hitakshi02/pipeline-medic.summary: On-call agent that diagnoses broken data pipelines and proves fixes in a sandbox.
Hitakshi02/pipeline-medic.readme_summary: Investigates failures in a synthetic eyewear retailer DuckDB pipeline with nine injected faults. Runs an agent loop with twelve sandboxed tools and in-tool verification, plus a console for human approval. Uses an LLM agent for root-cause analysis and fix generation with replay checks.

Mu5ad/bootsight.summary: Photos a non-booting machine screen and returns what failed and what to run next.
Mu5ad/bootsight.readme_summary: Takes a photo of BIOS text, bluescreens or kernel panics and explains cause and next command. Built as a field-technician copilot with ticket writing. Uses vision-language models to read screen images and generate repair plans.

ElroyAyala/fixalong.summary: Hands-free AR repair guide that labels parts and checks each fix step by voice.
ElroyAyala/fixalong.readme_summary: Uses headset camera photos to detect job parts and pin AR labels, with wake-word voice interaction. Walks through diagnosis one test at a time with step verification. Uses Meta AI vision for part detection and voice models for hands-free dialogue.

rohitshukla11/assent.summary: Licenses creator likeness for AI ads and blocks unconsented renders with checks
rohitshukla11/assent.readme_summary: Lets creators license likeness to one brand with revocable terms, checks agent plans against licence pre-render. Uses Muse Spark/Image for planning and generation plus SAM 3.1 consent gate, signing and verification on Google Cloud.

taku629/whiteboard2repo.summary: Turns a whiteboard photo into a running, tested repo with services and tests.
taku629/whiteboard2repo.readme_summary: Parses system diagrams from board photos into services, database, queue and compose files. Generates boilerplate code and tests automatically. Uses SAM 3.1 for diagram region detection and Muse models for architecture extraction and codegen.

Mas-aaron/fundiloop.summary: Voice-guided electronics tutor that flashes firmware and proves it with telemetry.
Mas-aaron/fundiloop.readme_summary: Plans projects and guides ESP32/Arduino wiring with diagrams and spoken instructions. Generates and flashes firmware, declaring success only on live board telemetry. Uses FastAPI orchestrator, voice interaction and vision verification with Muse models.

Tash925/the-unreliable-witness.summary: Investigation game where players check AI claims against case evidence.
Tash925/the-unreliable-witness.readme_summary: Players review briefings and three evidence cards, question an AI partner and submit verdicts with reasoning. Frontend and backend present timestamps and feedback. Uses Muse Spark for the investigation dialogue and claim evaluation.

heromiyo/mesa-muse.summary: Builds a WhatsApp shop catalogue from one voice note and one shelf photo.
heromiyo/mesa-muse.readme_summary: Trader sends Bemba/Nyanja/English voice note and photo to get priced catalogue, shop link and QR code. Assistant answers customers and forwards orders for approval. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM cutouts and Muse chat models over WhatsApp.

ShinKenji21/Listly.summary: Turns one item photo into edited listings for Marketplace, Shopee and Carousell.
ShinKenji21/Listly.readme_summary: Identifies brand and model from logos and labels, cleans product photo and drafts platform-specific descriptions. Suggests price from comparable listings. Uses Muse Spark for understanding, SAM 3.1 for segmentation and Muse Image for cleanup.

SankeerthNara/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Estimates child height from a phone video for growth screening with WHO scores.
SankeerthNara/meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Captures 9-second phone video with 6-DoF poses to compute height, WHO z-scores and screening level. Provides parent message in local language as referral aid. Uses WebXR/ARCore, SAM 3.1 for measurement and Muse models for messaging.

Ambercontinuum/Maxx-Gate.summary: Deterministic gate that scores agent actions and enforces release, wrap, hold, or escalate.
Ambercontinuum/Maxx-Gate.readme_summary: Declares each action as Type, Trace, Amount, Reversibility and scores it with fixed arithmetic. A separate Python sidecar enforces decisions with one-use permits and a reconciled ledger. Built as deterministic guardrail for AI tool execution.

rinatwebric/kartochka.summary: Turns phone product photos into marketplace-ready cards with compliance checks.
rinatwebric/kartochka.readme_summary: Next.js TypeScript app validates photos against marketplace rules like white background and proportions. Pipeline generates card text, checklist scores and ZIP export with mock mode and evals. Uses Muse models for visual inspection and copy.

jcedrik/canary-agent.summary: Triages SAST findings for LLM apps and auto-fixes verified issues.
jcedrik/canary-agent.readme_summary: Consumes canary SAST findings for prompt injection, secrets and unsafe output. Uses Muse Spark to judge true positives, write fixes and re-run the scanner to prove them. Python package with GitHub Action, evals and tests.

Abbagigo13/civiclens-ai.summary: Lets residents report potholes and floods with AI drafts and live map.
Abbagigo13/civiclens-ai.readme_summary: Dashboard with Upload & Analyze for AI draft from photo with confidence and evidence. Node server with offline pending sync, map picker, confirmations and WhatsApp sharing. Uses Muse vision models for image assessment.

Lovejoyhealth/asking-the-right-questions.summary: Audits AI-written forecast questions for resolvability and flaws.
Lovejoyhealth/asking-the-right-questions.readme_summary: Muse Spark generates prediction-market questions from trending topics. Independent agent checks deadlines, settlement sources and verifiability with cases and runs. Python agent plus verification pipeline for audit reports.

academysim/survey-qa-agent.summary: Reviews LiDAR-to-CAD drafts from renders and photos with SEND/HOLD verdicts.
academysim/survey-qa-agent.readme_summary: Agent reviews station plan renders and street photos, requests extra evidence when unsure. Uses Meta Muse Spark for vision QA and returns SEND/CAVEAT/HOLD with client note. Python loop with scorer, spend guard and replay.

Sid4030/Aegis.summary: Turns any physical object into a touch button using SAM-tracked masks.
Sid4030/Aegis.readme_summary: Drag a box and SAM 3.1 traces the object boundary for review, then bind keys 1-5 to touch. Python live_demo with perception, camera and voice modules; hover never fires. Session-only or persisted profiles.

phcodesage/baha.summary: Estimates flood depth from one street photo using known object heights.
phcodesage/baha.readme_summary: SAM 3.1 segments water and reference objects like tires and jeepneys, Muse Spark reads waterline. Converts to MMDA gauge with passability and nearby shelters on shared live map. Web client with workers backend.

trungthanh1909/dayrescue.summary: Replans your day after disruptions with AI proposals and hard-constraint checks.
trungthanh1909/dayrescue.readme_summary: Muse Spark proposes schedule tradeoffs when events interrupt plans. Deterministic Python validator alone decides if hard constraints pass. React/FastAPI frontend with Streamlit fallback and browser storage.

Shiva7147/omni-inspect-ai.summary: Pre-power safety gate with predictive fault detection for electronics boards
Shiva7147/omni-inspect-ai.readme_summary: FastAPI and WebSocket backend with Modal serverless and Baseten inference for PCB inspection. Uses muse-spark-1.3 and Llama 3.2 Vision against IPC-A-610G Class 3 standards.

DarkWhige/GuardianBees-beta.summary: Local AI monitors home network traffic to flag anomalies and threats.
DarkWhige/GuardianBees-beta.readme_summary: Python backend captures traffic with Scapy, aggregates per-IP features over 30s and scores with Isolation Forest. Only anomalies over 65% go to Meta Model API for triage. FastAPI serves persistent alerts to a frontend.

Genkryptos/repart.summary: Turns phone photos of broken parts into printable editable 3D models.
Genkryptos/repart.readme_summary: iOS capture on A4 paper provides scale, SAM 3.1 extracts dimensions and a Muse Spark agent writes parametric OpenSCAD. Output is STL plus editable source. Stack is Python FastAPI service with Docker and tests.

suhailps93/ayma-taste-qloo.summary: Voice dating app scores shared tastes and suggests date ideas via Qloo.
suhailps93/ayma-taste-qloo.readme_summary: Voice-first companion builds taste profiles from conversation across ten domains. Uses Qloo Taste/Insights API for shared-taste score, common descriptors and joint recommendations. Subset extracted for Qloo hackathon.

kiddojazz/GaugeLens-AI.summary: Reads energy meter displays with phone and verifies values with physics.
kiddojazz/GaugeLens-AI.readme_summary: Points phone at inverters and meters, SAM 3.1 reads digits then physics checks and re-looks on failure. Muse Spark explains findings with evidence. Backend plus web frontend deployed on Azure Container Apps.

galinagr/pt_pt_learning_companion.summary: Local app for learning European Portuguese via translate and talk.
galinagr/pt_pt_learning_companion.readme_summary: Local FastAPI app with one HTML page for Translate, Explore and Talk in PT-PT. Uses httpx to call Meta API and edge-tts for speech. Proof of concept with pytest, no auth or persistence.

shivamkumarsingh28/ApplyPilot.summary: Parses job notices, checks eligibility and preps application photos.
shivamkumarsingh28/ApplyPilot.readme_summary: Uploads PDF or photo notices to extract key facts, eligibility checks and page-cited Q&A. Resizes selfie and signature to portal specs and autofills forms via extension. Adds Telegram chat and deadline reminders.

joysriramsarkar/muse.summary: Bengali single-page hangout where human and AI Muses leave notes.
joysriramsarkar/muse.readme_summary: Static site in Bengali with index, for-muses guide and guestbook, no build step. Resident Muses respond only to real words; visiting human Muses or AI agents can sign. Hosted as static pages on Vercel.

YusfianB/promo-radar.summary: Daily web search for fresh promos with dashboard and Telegram alerts.
YusfianB/promo-radar.readme_summary: Runs daily at 06:00 WIB on GitHub Actions, uses Meta Model API web_search to find promos, filters expired entries and updates static dashboard. Sends summary to Telegram. Key stored in GitHub Secrets.

grierj/t3-autoflow.summary: Autonomous coding workflow that plans, builds and reviews code.
grierj/t3-autoflow.readme_summary: Portable T3 Code skill where a lead coordinates planning, implementation and adversarial review. Discovers test instructions and picks models per role from live catalog. No fixed provider IDs, includes tests.

Forgewrld711/memory-grove.summary: Shared consented memory trees for humans and Muse agents.
Forgewrld711/memory-grove.readme_summary: Bilateral Human Tree and Agent Tree with Consent Grove lighting only on mutual accept. Live Muse Spark 1.3 chat with voice input/output. Append-only hash-chained events persisted in Cloudflare D1.

Blindjimmy2/moonman-ai.summary: Embodied astronaut assistant that sees, talks, and builds CAD models for 3D printing
Blindjimmy2/moonman-ai.readme_summary: Physically embodied engineering assistant with vision, British voice, and head-tracking. Python stack integrates Fusion 360, CAD revision, and gated 3D-print control. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for reasoning, vision, and dialogue.

yogesh4216/Napkinlive.summary: Turns hand-drawn architecture sketches into live 60 FPS interactive simulations
yogesh4216/Napkinlive.readme_summary: Bi-directional physical-to-digital simulator replacing static slides with live failure testing. Dockerized backend + frontend architecture. Uses 6 Meta AI models for sketch parsing, diagramming, and simulation.

khairoai/muse-receptionist-service.summary: AI phone receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, recalls waitlist
khairoai/muse-receptionist-service.readme_summary: Khairo answers business calls on their number, quotes prices and books into calendars, calling back waitlists on cancellations. Built on Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark with call, chat and bench CLIs. TypeScript monorepo with web demo and benchmarks.

Katzert/Neverdeth.summary: Native Windows x64 port of NeverDead via static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation
Katzert/Neverdeth.readme_summary: AI-assisted EmuComp combining static PowerPC-to-C++20 recompilation with Xbox 360 runtime. CMake C++ stack with Direct3D 12 translation layer. Uses AI assistance for recompilation analysis; requires own retail disc.

mc-rizzy/play-game-with-brain.summary: Controls a Pygame game with thought using an 8-channel EEG headset.
mc-rizzy/play-game-with-brain.readme_summary: Brain-computer interface using BrainAccess Mini 8ch @250Hz. Rolling 0.5s PSD features feed a spatial GNN with few-shot adapter to steer a Pygame world. Uses Muse models for coaching and meta-pipeline tuning.

krakken190/State-Diff.summary: Version control for electronics benches that diffs photos to find failures
krakken190/State-Diff.readme_summary: Captures bench checkpoints as photo plus Git commit plus test results into versioned graph. Next.js app with deterministic diff ranking suspects. Uses Muse Spark to propose structured parts and wiring.

Pajimo/proofline.summary: WhatsApp AI that watches customer videos to triage trade jobs and draft quotes
Pajimo/proofline.readme_summary: WhatsApp front desk for UK tradespeople analyzing problem videos, asking follow-ups, and flagging danger. Python stack with ffmpeg pipeline and SAM parser. Uses SAM for vision plus Muse for dialogue.

jasontso2939/billcast.summary: Predicts California bills passage odds with transparent legislator scorecards
jasontso2939/billcast.readme_summary: Rebuilds California Legislature bulk data since 2007 into bill odds and member scorecards. Python pipeline with Supabase and searchable static dashboard. Statistical counting rules with weekly refresh; no explicit Muse use stated.

k-sangili/roots-bilingual-stories.summary: Turns grandparents spoken stories into bilingual side-by-side storybooks
k-sangili/roots-bilingual-stories.readme_summary: Next.js App Router React 19 app preserving idioms with explanations, not literal translation. Supports 20 languages defaulting Tamil to English. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for transcription, translation, and storytelling.

AdemolaSam/nino_watch.summary: El Nino preparedness backend with risk alerts, scraping, and verification
AdemolaSam/nino_watch.readme_summary: FastAPI backend for El Nino preparedness app with Next.js frontend in sibling repo. Stack is Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, Alembic, Docker Compose. Uses Meta Muse Spark for LLM risk analysis and verification.

DnA-Arkitecs/landed.summary: Diagnoses why cold emails hit spam with live DNS checks and fix steps.
DnA-Arkitecs/landed.readme_summary: Landed diagnoses cold-email deliverability from sender domain, headers and bounces. It runs real DNS, authentication and blocklist lookups with a Node/Express backend. Muse Spark on Meta Model API acts as investigator to order causes and fixes, with re-check.

VictorJVA/mileto.summary: Guided app where kids start a small business through missions and checks
VictorJVA/mileto.readme_summary: Kid-focused entrepreneurship tutor with Socratic guide that never gives answers. Verifies missions with camera and voice, calculates numbers in code. Built with Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

Sap1x/Sentrix.summary: Models infrastructure cascading failures for emergency planners and cities.
Sap1x/Sentrix.readme_summary: SENTRIX is an infrastructure resilience platform for emergency centers and planners. It models how incidents cascade across transport and lifelines. Uses FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, and Muse Spark for multimodal AI-assisted analysis.

ariandesu/MediSathi.summary: Bangla/English helper that digitizes prescriptions into plain-language records.
ariandesu/MediSathi.readme_summary: MediSathi digitizes prescriptions and lab reports with on-device Bangla/English OCR for review. It adds plain-language explanations, check-ins, timelines, and grounded Q&A with printable reports. Stack is Next.js with MongoDB and live Muse Spark.

Alikhan207/Mane-Bazaar.summary: Chat assistant helping Hubballi home sellers list items by text, voice, photo.
Alikhan207/Mane-Bazaar.readme_summary: Mane Bazaar onboards women sellers in Kannada, English and Hindi via chat. It records daily items from text, voice notes and photos and manages profiles. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech and Muse Spark 1.3 for dialogue, tool-calling and vision.

Mayankbhandari007/Hastaak.summary: Two-way Indian Sign Language to speech translator for 11 Indian languages.
Mayankbhandari007/Hastaak.readme_summary: Hastaak translates ISL signing to spoken sentences and speech to captions plus sign videos. Browser app with FastAPI backend keeps keys and calls Meta models. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice Transcribe, SAM 3.1 and MMS-TTS with ONNX tracking.

dakshvatss/proofcam.summary: Camera-guided agent that verifies equipment installs and directs next shot.
dakshvatss/proofcam.readme_summary: ProofCam verifies physical equipment installations from photos and decides what to capture next. No web app or DB yet, milestone 0 single-photo proven offline. Exclusively uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and SAM 3.1 for segmentation.

akshayabuildsprojects-blip/rabbit-hop.summary: Persona-locked AI shoppers test live beauty stores for behavior fidelity
akshayabuildsprojects-blip/rabbit-hop.readme_summary: Sends AI shoppers with researched locked personas to shop Sephora and Olive Young US via Muse Spark computer use. Measures how faithfully each agent behaves like its persona. Built with TypeScript web and server plus behavior evaluation tests.

Spondon33/Simuplug.summary: PDF plugin turning NCTB textbook highlights into summaries and simulations.
Spondon33/Simuplug.readme_summary: Simuplug is a learning plugin for NCTB textbooks that explains highlighted PDF text. It retrieves matching sections and generates summaries plus interactive visuals. Uses OpenUI Lang with RAG over OCR-converted HTML and Muse Wonder 1.0 for content.

cukupai26/cukup_ai_creation.summary: Offline-first PWA giving Indonesian families AI spending guardrails and aid info.
cukupai26/cukup_ai_creation.readme_summary: CukupAI is an empathetic financial guardrail PWA for family budgeting. It parses receipts on-device and grounds assistance data via search. Stack is Next.js PWA with Tailwind, Llama 3.1 reasoning, ML Kit OCR, SAM 3.1 and Meta Search Grounding.

Razsoriginal/mafia-arena-thesis.summary: Replicates social deduction arena to benchmark LLM agents on strategy and calibration
Razsoriginal/mafia-arena-thesis.readme_summary: Runs 4-agent Mafia games to compare dmn_tpn vs CoT, ReAct and constitution agents. Python eval pipeline logs to parquet and reports win-rate, ECE, Brier and say-do gap. Uses meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor via AiCredits for agents plus OpenRouter Jev.

devjimah/agritrade.summary: Turns photos of handwritten trader credit notebooks into reviewable ledger entries
devjimah/agritrade.readme_summary: Ledger app for Ghanaian cereal traders tracks cash advances, maize repayments and buyer credit. Muse Spark reads notebook page photos, matches names to open advances and proposes entries for trader approval. Client/server app with demo photos and screenshots.

IngSeb0/Pendiva.summary: Turns WhatsApp chats into evidence-backed follow-ups without a CRM
IngSeb0/Pendiva.readme_summary: Prototype organizes webhook messages into customer conversations and flags what needs attention with citations. Owner can query chats by text or voice. Uses Meta Model API behind Pendiva assistant, no auto-reply.

extradext/metamat-taakedown.summary: Manages folkstyle wrestling tournaments from brackets to mat-side scoring
extradext/metamat-taakedown.readme_summary: Tournament operations platform with registration, check-in, deterministic brackets and table scoring with rest gate. Zero-dependency Node 20+ app with plain HTML/CSS/JS client built for gym Wi-Fi. Includes trading cards showcase and seeded demo roles.

CodeRunner24/claimcheck.summary: Films items for sale to auto-generate listings verified against video proof
CodeRunner24/claimcheck.readme_summary: Seller points camera and narrates while AI director guides shots and drafts listing. Claims contradicted by video are struck through before publishing. Buyers can ask questions answered by video search. Reflex/Python app with replay page and YouTube demo.

Lee-WonJun/slopbook-relay.summary: Persona social network where humans write and owned personas give voice
Lee-WonJun/slopbook-relay.readme_summary: Retains full Slopbook app with persona editor, Sigils, voice settings and social workflows plus Moltbook feed. Muse edition adds new composer integration and demo walkthrough. Clojure backend with JS frontend, Docker compose and CI verified.

ddul001/ax-scanner.summary: Scores websites 0-100 on readiness for AI agents to find and act
ddul001/ax-scanner.readme_summary: Crawls automotive dealer sites as an agent would, grades findability and actionability, and replays steps. Generates fix drafts like JSON-LD, llms.txt and robots.txt for approval. Built with Muse Spark via Meta Model API; Python/FastAPI app.

praga-16/payops-brain.summary: Grounds payment dispute notices into evidence-bound operator recommendations
praga-16/payops-brain.readme_summary: Synthetic notice image enters LangGraph workflow for extraction, ledger matching, policy check and verification. FastAPI backend plus Node frontend shows evidence-bound reply for approve/reject. No payment executed; offline mock mode supported.

senkivskyy/pocketlab.summary: Turns phone videos of experiments into measured physics with SAM 3.1 tracking
senkivskyy/pocketlab.readme_summary: Students predict, film with any phone, then SAM 3.1 tracks objects frame-by-frame. Python physics code derives gravity via three methods using object size and fps. Flask app with XP, medals and leaderboard deployed on Render.

geraldmagoro/safesteps.summary: Wrist band alerts guardians within seconds even with no phone signal
geraldmagoro/safesteps.readme_summary: Body-worn ankle/waist band monitors skin contact, heart rate, location and water with on-device safety rules. System includes backend, parent app and band simulator for offline operation. Built for phone-free school walks and at-risk meetings.

Yaamnang/reality-mode.summary: Webcam AR layer that answers questions about real objects using hand gestures
Yaamnang/reality-mode.readme_summary: GODMODE overlays AI answers on live camera feed controlled by hand twists and moves. Web frontend with server backend runs on laptop or phone webcam. Uses Muse models for reasoning with vision grounding, prototype for glasses use.

anuj846k/Tidewatch.summary: Disruption desk that shows which cargo shipments are hit and what to do
anuj846k/Tidewatch.readme_summary: Tidewatch maps canal closures, strikes and conflicts to impacted shipments and actions. Backend multi-agent system with web frontend on Render. Uses Meta Muse Spark agents with Meta SAM 3.1 for vision.

nufii45/PayAgent.summary: Rebuilds freelance payment agreements from chat screenshots for approval
nufii45/PayAgent.readme_summary: PayAgent ingests chat screenshots and text to reconstruct agreed, changed and paid amounts with message citations. Next.js app with guest workspaces and investigation flow. Uses Muse Spark vision-language parsing.

bmondal98/omnimind.summary: Home-safety agent that detects visual hazards and triggers protective actions
bmondal98/omnimind.readme_summary: OmniMind monitors home camera feeds to detect hazards and act when users cannot. React 19 Vite frontend with Python FastAPI backend. Uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark for vision reasoning.

masasikatano/hackathon-finance-agents.summary: Multi-agent team that debates tickers and issues BUY HOLD SELL calls
masasikatano/hackathon-finance-agents.readme_summary: Streamlit app runs market, fundamentals, sentiment, bull-bear debate and risk agents to final portfolio decision. Built with Python using Yahoo Finance data. Uses Muse via Meta Model API with mock fallback.

chel42/Meta_Hackathon.summary: Turns text or links into sourced verification dossiers without absolute verdicts
chel42/Meta_Hackathon.readme_summary: VERA extracts claims from text or URL and returns reviewed assertions with sources and limits. FastAPI Python API with Expo React Native web app and PostgreSQL Docker setup. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for analysis.

Cortina-Lab/sayledger.summary: Voice and vision credit ledger for small shops tracking customer tabs
Cortina-Lab/sayledger.readme_summary: SayLedger lets shopkeepers speak sales on credit in local language and verifies with vision. App plus backend service with docs and CI. Uses Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe, and SAM 3.1.

sokphaladam/anim-studio.summary: Browser 2D animation studio that generates layered looping lofi scenes
sokphaladam/anim-studio.readme_summary: Anim Studio provides Krita-style drawing, playback, AI scene planning and MP4 export. TypeScript monorepo engine with deterministic renderer and Ollama local generation. Cloud fallback optional, ComfyUI painter.

BikashMishraDev/EaseShipping.summary: AI export research assistant simplifying India to US shipping for sellers
BikashMishraDev/EaseShipping.readme_summary: EaseShipping provides export research assistance for small exporters, not carrier or legal advice. Node server with client web app and MongoDB auth. Uses Meta Model API muse-spark by default when key set.

AraavNayak/Pointer.summary: Agent review board that debates robot failures and tests fixes in simulation
AraavNayak/Pointer.readme_summary: Pointer runs three Muse Spark investigators plus skeptic to form failure hypotheses, then validates fixes in MuJoCo. Server with web UI, sim and SAM tracking views. Uses SAM 3.1 grounding and voice explanation.

alensonyjoseph/realmforge-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns a tabletop photo into a playable fantasy quest with AI-generated realm.
alensonyjoseph/realmforge-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Turns a tabletop photo into a playable fantasy quest. Browser game engine with structured scene graph and deterministic win logic. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for understanding and actions, Muse Image 1.0 for realm art, optional SAM 3.1 segmentation.

zameer96/lookfirst.summary: Previews salon cuts and car wraps on your photo, then books the service.
zameer96/lookfirst.readme_summary: AI transformation previews for salons and auto shops. Upload selfie or car photo, view style or wrap on own image with before/after slider, then book. Built with Meta Model API using SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Spark with Next.js and Docker.

thesloppyguy/mega_insurance.summary: Live video AI underwriting interview with avatar, ID capture and report.
thesloppyguy/mega_insurance.readme_summary: Live video underwriting interview with AI agent, avatar and identity capture plus post-call report. Stack is Next.js frontend plus LiveKit Python worker. Uses Meta Muse models for conversation, Inworld for avatar, LiveKit for realtime video.

RaviSileb/OpsAI-B.summary: Analyzes multi-source logs, diagnoses issues and guides guided remediation.
RaviSileb/OpsAI-B.readme_summary: AI assistant for log analysis and fix proposals across file, journald, docker, kafka, loki and k8s. Python 3.12 + NiceGUI desktop, web and REST API with OQL filters. Variant B uses Meta Model API for diagnosis and repair steps.

okottawar/walkthrough.summary: Turns narrated plant walkthrough videos into ranked shift handoff briefs.
okottawar/walkthrough.readme_summary: Operator films narrated walkthrough; pipeline transcribes, segments issues and fuses context into ranked brief with before/after comparison. Python app with Muse Voice, Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 adapters plus CHP fusion and HDBSCAN threading.

Philip-Machar/ujuzi-ai.summary: SMS chatbot bringing AI Q&A to basic feature phones without internet.
Philip-Machar/ujuzi-ai.readme_summary: Brings AI to ordinary mobile phones via SMS for users without smartphones or data. Node.js backend handles text questions and conversational answers. Uses Meta Muse Spark for multilingual understanding and response generation.

yveshughes/trippie-fix-it-plano.summary: Robot plus phone prototype mapping street hazards with SAM highlights
yveshughes/trippie-fix-it-plano.readme_summary: Turns rugged robot and Android phone into neighborhood inspection prototype. Next.js admin portal with Leaflet map, captured photos, SAM highlights and city case descriptions. Uses Node 24, TypeScript, SQLite and Vercel deployment.

microblue/snapoto.summary: Stamps work photos tamper-evident and turns them into reports and proof links.
microblue/snapoto.readme_summary: AI work camera for field crews that keeps original tamper-evident, adds owner watermark and reads order numbers, plates and damage. Web app plus Android app with server backend. Uses Meta Muse Spark vision extraction for daily reports.

nazek52/FloodShield.summary: Explores runoff and drainage fixes under same rainfall with field reports.
nazek52/FloodShield.readme_summary: Executable research prototype to explore surface runoff and compare drainage interventions under same rainfall. Browser simulation with historical map and guided tour plus Node server. Uses Meta extraction for field observations.

fepriyadi/transaction-reconciliation.summary: Matches supplier invoices to ERP exports with status, cause and audit trace.
fepriyadi/transaction-reconciliation.readme_summary: Reads supplier invoices and credit notes from PDFs including scans, matches to ERP AP export at document and line level with status and actions. Python + Streamlit review queue with Tesseract OCR. Deterministic engine, 16/16 correct on sample.

TarunikaBalaji/CodeCraft-3D.summary: Extracts constraints from PDFs with evidence checks for 3D building design
TarunikaBalaji/CodeCraft-3D.readme_summary: Adds server-side Muse Spark client via POST api.meta.ai/v1/responses, PDF-to-constraint pipeline, and evidence validator checking page, excerpt and units. Python app with core/, tests/ and visualization/; AI output is not auto-fed to geometry.

k-sangili/roots.summary: Turns grandparents voice stories into bilingual side-by-side storybooks
k-sangili/roots.readme_summary: Next.js app where grandparents speak or write in Tamil, Hindi and 18 other languages to create translated storybooks preserving idioms. Built Nov 3 2026 for hackathon indie track; uses Muse models for translation and explanation.

spk2002ak-lgtm/not-alone.summary: Cuts out shirt graphics and writes listings in sellers voice
spk2002ak-lgtm/not-alone.readme_summary: Print-on-demand assistant with SQLite seller memory injected into Responses API instructions and chained with previous_response_id. Uses SAM 3.1 to segment printed graphic into transparent PNG, then writes and grades listings.

khpartha/Meta-Hack.summary: Detects warehouse walkway hazards from photos with boxed reports
khpartha/Meta-Hack.readme_summary: SceneGuard AI uploads workplace photos; Python backend prompts Muse Spark for hazards and SAM 3.1 localizes them, returning JSON plus annotated image. Frontend in Node 20, backend Python 3.11; findings flagged as possible only.

techbubble/aigis-web.summary: Converts reports and photos into animated time-series maps
techbubble/aigis-web.readme_summary: AIGIS ingests PDFs, Word, CSV, XLSX and photos with EXIF; Muse Spark extracts structured events with place, time and quotes, geocodes and detects anomalies. Next.js frontend at aigis.studio with time-scrubbable globe and chat.

Aditi-2903/Bring-Up-Bot.summary: Debugs embedded boards on hardware and proves fixes with tests
Aditi-2903/Bring-Up-Bot.readme_summary: Agent for Raspberry Pi 5 + Honeywell ABP2 sensor that runs allowlisted inspections, searches datasheet, then flashes fix and re-tests. Requires measured output plus datasheet evidence; code in bringup_agent/, pi_app/ and verification/.

RedR25/cheeseblend.summary: Predicts taste and cooking of cheese blends from flavor chemistry
RedR25/cheeseblend.readme_summary: Streamlit app models 171 cheeses with aroma compounds, salt, fat, moisture and sourced data. Muse reads research, engine predicts taste, smell and melt for any mix. Stack is Python, Streamlit and Railway.

khaledhrz2005-jpg/wafaacare.summary: Connects parents and therapists for child speech therapy follow-up
khaledhrz2005-jpg/wafaacare.readme_summary: React Native Expo plus Supabase platform where parents share text, photos, video and voice notes and specialists publish reviewed session reports. AI drafts behavioral summaries requiring explicit save; no auto-diagnosis.

Jashann/walk-me-there.summary: Builds walkable 3D places from spoken or typed descriptions
Jashann/walk-me-there.readme_summary: Type, upload audio or talk live; server transcribes, generates block-style 3D scene to explore with keyboard and mouse. Node server plus web client with quality scaling; demo includes 15 places like Taj Mahal and Punjab home.

EricMaxwellnetizen/GroundTruthAI.summary: Traces AWS Lambda owners from identity, Terraform and Git history
EricMaxwellnetizen/GroundTruthAI.readme_summary: Local-first read-only investigator correlating AWS identity, Scalr, Terraform, VCS, CloudTrail and CloudWatch into auditable report. Deterministic engine sets status; Muse Spark only explains evidence. Streamlit, Docker, synthetic demo.

JacobLinCool/PuzzleAR.summary: Photo of scattered puzzle pieces becomes step-by-step finding and placement help.
JacobLinCool/PuzzleAR.readme_summary: Turns one overhead photo into numbered pieces, next-piece suggestions, and placement overlay. Web app on Cloudflare Workers. Uses Meta vision models to detect pieces and guide verification with follow-up photos.

Deep070203/GammaLab.summary: AI options research agent turning dealer positioning into tested swing trade setups.
Deep070203/GammaLab.readme_summary: Analyzes options market structure into hypotheses, held-out stats, and risk-managed setups. Stack is FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend with Tradier market data. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and explanations.

alonsinhoiu/packmatch.summary: Catches invoice vs packing list mismatches before dispatch with visual evidence.
alonsinhoiu/packmatch.readme_summary: Compares shipment documents to flag quantity and packing discrepancies with rules and supplier message. Built with Next.js 15 + TypeScript on Netlify. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for document parsing and matching.

Hyatus-Living/arosa.summary: Source-backed property research with editable plans, models and walkthroughs.
Hyatus-Living/arosa.readme_summary: Connects housing research to editable architectural plans, building models, and interactive walkthroughs for additions and ADUs. Full-stack site + API, research service, Blender worker, MCP. Uses Meta models for research and planning.

nikolas-sapa/motionforge.summary: Samples real object motion from video into interactive JavaScript spring code.
nikolas-sapa/motionforge.readme_summary: Tracks object with Meta SAM 3.1, measures box-center motion with timestamps, fits damped oscillation to export reusable JS springs. No custom training. Web + JS library prototype for indie developer track.

OsmarGHz/patch-irl.summary: Turns a photo of everyday friction into a constrained, visual fix-it plan.
OsmarGHz/patch-irl.readme_summary: Workflow is observe, plan, visualize, do, check from a resized JPEG with user constraints. Built on Sites Vinext starter with Drizzle DB on Cloudflare. Uses Meta adapters for planning, grounding markers, and follow-up check.

mapluisch/Muse-Maker.summary: Renders Muse agent edits as before-after previews for approve or revert
mapluisch/Muse-Maker.readme_summary: Muse Maker is a local frontend that centers the rendered project, showing each agent step as new state beside prior with change rationale. Users approve, request changes, or revert before finalizing. Node server.mjs with approval workflow and tests.

Hafsa2N/paperproof.summary: Converts LaTeX to venue-template Word docs with preservation checks.
Hafsa2N/paperproof.readme_summary: Uploads .tex or .zip and builds .docx on IEEE and Springer LNCS Word templates with correction logs. Local Python pipeline. Uses Meta AI / Muse models for parsing LaTeX structure and verifying fidelity.

nigelhartman/interaction_twin.summary: Turns demo video into reusable source-linked 3D object interaction programs
nigelhartman/interaction_twin.readme_summary: Takes video input and outputs object programs with geometry, hinges and connections. Produces connected 3D drafts and reusable agent context. Uses Meta perception models for video-to-3D interaction extraction.

vamsireddy4/vibe-ai.summary: No-code voice agents that call, answer, book appointments and follow up.
vamsireddy4/vibe-ai.readme_summary: Lets businesses create phone agents with voice, prompt personality, knowledge, and tools for outbound campaigns. Runs on Cloudflare with web frontend. Powered by Meta Muse Spark for conversation and SAM 3.1.

damianwap/real2playable.summary: Turns photos of real objects into animation-ready 2D game assets
damianwap/real2playable.readme_summary: React studio for asset inspection plus Python compiler emitting PNG + JSON + ZIP, played by separate Phaser app reading ZIP export. Handles upload validation, EXIF stripping, and sprite processing without API key.

DennisLoska/skills.summary: Gated cybernetic SDLC harness for OpenCode with one-shot pipeline
DennisLoska/skills.readme_summary: Controller-led pipeline with five stages, closed feedback loops, and nine model-pinned agent seats on OpenCode Go. Provides ten pipeline skills, gates, and council consensus review for automated delivery.

keremcebi/adaptive-cancer-therapy.summary: Finds which prostate patients can pause therapy with less drug
keremcebi/adaptive-cancer-therapy.readme_summary: In-silico tool on 105 real patients comparing personalized pause/restart rules vs standard PSA rule for intermittent therapy. Reports TTP and drug savings to identify high-benefit patients, not treatment advice.

bobby-nandigam/neuroforge.summary: Go-based compiler and runtime for typed multimodal AI workloads
bobby-nandigam/neuroforge.readme_summary: Lowers YAML/JSON workloads into typed MIR, validates and optimizes via graph compiler, executes with concurrent runtime. Go core with local, mock, and Meta backends plus performance profiling.

robocurve/datacenterbench.summary: Benchmarks bimanual robots on 10 data-center maintenance tasks
robocurve/datacenterbench.readme_summary: Ten fixed-setup board tasks with rubrics, 3 trials per model scoring 0/0.5/1, built on Inspect Robots and listed in WorldEvals. Includes install, mock policy runs, and published scoring pipeline.

akdeepankar/ARCH-KIT.summary: Residential studio with shared 2D/3D model and AI room planning
akdeepankar/ARCH-KIT.readme_summary: Next.js + Cloudflare Worker app with shared 2D/3D project model, autosave, and undoable room edits. Server-only Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Responses API for layout inspection and area calc.

KOBA2008/sankofa.summary: AI time machine for cities separating proven history from imagined
KOBA2008/sankofa.readme_summary: Agent retrieves archival photos for cities like Porto-Novo and visualizes history while labeling proven vs AI-imagined content. Full-stack with backend/frontend, built for Build for Your World indie track.

ajiva84/Voucherready.summary: Gets rentals inspection-ready and matches Section 8 voucher holders
ajiva84/Voucherready.readme_summary: Next.js + Prisma/SQLite app using Muse Spark 1.1 for guidance, SAM 3.1 for vision segmentation, and Muse Image for fixes. Verifies listings against scams under 60-day voucher clock.

SainathGaikwad/kaagaz.summary: Turns prison register photos into verified BNSS release lists
SainathGaikwad/kaagaz.readme_summary: Streamlit app where Muse Spark double-reads register pages, checks sections against law table, and deterministic Rihai engine computes 479 BNSS eligibility. Lawyer-in-loop correction and confirmation.

MemitN/Virtual-tourist.summary: AI local guide for any place with 360 tours in 14 languages
MemitN/Virtual-tourist.readme_summary: Next.js tourism app with streamed Muse Spark 1.3 guide chat, translation and trip toolkit with fallback to 1.2/1.1. Optional Muse Image panoramas and SAM 3.1 segmentation, health-check endpoint.

muratcankoylan/ghost-director.summary: Local web workspace linking photo refs, 3D set and Blender shot planning
muratcankoylan/ghost-director.readme_summary: Connects photographic references, Three.js set navigation and Blender motion in one local web app. Deterministic Python code handles scene edits and validation while bounded roles assist planning. Uses Meta image generation for references and hosted SAM 3D for geometry.

kranganath/telemetryFoundry.summary: Maps logging schemas to OCSF and exports Databricks-ready pipelines
kranganath/telemetryFoundry.readme_summary: FastAPI backend plus React+Vite frontend maps existing logs to all 61 OCSF 1.9.0 classes and validates them. Exports PySpark, Spark SQL, data-quality tests and Asset Bundles after approval. Uses Meta API for mapping suggestions, hydration and code generation.

AdnHiba56/ReFlow.summary: Turns messages, documents and voice into approved action plans
AdnHiba56/ReFlow.readme_summary: Productivity agent that summarizes PDFs/DOCX/TXT, transcribes voice and builds structured plans with human-approved execution. Python backend with frontend UI. Uses Meta Model API for multimodal understanding, planning and Q&A.

birtohum/mevzuat-haritasi.summary: Static site mapping Turkish Official Gazette regulations since 2000
birtohum/mevzuat-haritasi.readme_summary: Parses 10,608 Official Gazette issues into 99k regulations by type, year and amended law. Python scripts generate a static interactive site served locally. No Meta AI integration described; analysis is deterministic parsing and comparison.

Weerakorn-Leartsirisorn/lecture-lens.summary: Turns Thai-English slides into summaries, quizzes and flashcards
Weerakorn-Leartsirisorn/lecture-lens.readme_summary: Uploads PDF slides to produce bilingual Thai-English summaries, glossaries, 10-question quizzes and flashcards linked to source slides. Python app with static frontend. Uses Muse Spark on Meta Model API to read pages including tables and diagrams.

Uk4g/ULEBI.summary: Night-shift ward dashboard combining vision watch and voice triage
Uk4g/ULEBI.readme_summary: Single HTML dashboard shows low-light vision wireframes, transcribed intercom requests, priority-ordered triage and morning handoff. Static frontend with docs and assets. Implies Meta vision and speech models for detection and transcription.

Chetan0246/focusguard.summary: On-device Android coach that labels study sessions and plans days
Chetan0246/focusguard.readme_summary: Android app reads UsageStatsManager sessions during timetable study blocks and labels them focused/distracted/neutral on-device. Backend assists ambiguous cases and next-day planning. Built for privacy with raw usage staying on owned devices.

mirakhatun-cs/health-app-privacy-analyze.summary: Explains Android health-app permissions and tracker risks in plain terms
mirakhatun-cs/health-app-privacy-analyze.readme_summary: Python tool parses MobSF output, permissions and trackers with deterministic analyzers and Streamlit UI. Presents structured findings with risk levels. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 to generate plain-English explanations of findings.

NeilD201/PreFlight.summary: Reviews KiCad boards with ERC/DRC checks and cited AI findings
NeilD201/PreFlight.readme_summary: Reads KiCad folder or ZIP, compares schematic vs PCB, runs KiCad ERC/DRC and explains significance. Python stdlib plus pypdf with KiCad 9 engine and demo boards. Uses Meta Muse Spark to investigate structured evidence with citations.

DenizEpitech/meta.summary: Voice orders turn product photos into promo visuals on shop TVs
DenizEpitech/meta.readme_summary: Baba Time lets shop owners speak a promo and show it on store screens. Next.js app uses Muse Voice Transcribe for speech, Muse Spark agent with tools, SAM 3.1 for cutout and Muse Image for backgrounds.

chaibi-mustapha/scisleuth-ai.summary: Multi-agent system investigates scientific contradictions on evidence board
chaibi-mustapha/scisleuth-ai.readme_summary: SciSleuth AI coordinates 6 agents to cross-reference papers, lab data and archives. FastAPI backend with Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning renders results on an interactive evidence board UI.

ozroll/UptruGime.summary: Finds offline local businesses and auto-builds websites, ads and outreach
ozroll/UptruGime.readme_summary: UpTru 2.0 scans open map data for weak online presence, verifies leads and generates sites, ad mockups and PDF reports. Python core with Reflex dashboard uses Muse Spark, Image and Voice Transcribe.

tommykho/suntze.summary: Interactive Art of War book with tactics library and AI advice plans
tommykho/suntze.readme_summary: Static Astro site presents 383 verses in English and Chinese with 52 tactics and community board. Field Challenge uses grounded AI citations and Kokoro TTS to create a 30-second podcast MP3.

sivasubramoniam-js/LineSight.summary: Zero-shot visual inspection finds defects and explains root causes
sivasubramoniam-js/LineSight.readme_summary: LineSight is a visual QA platform for manufacturing that detects, verifies and learns defects. FastAPI and React stack uses Muse Spark, Wonder, Image, Voice Transcribe plus SAM 3.1 segmentation.

sksaddam007/ActionProof.summary: Binds human approval to hashed agent actions with verifiable evidence
sksaddam007/ActionProof.readme_summary: ActionProof hashes exact agent actions for approval to block tampering and stores execution evidence. Docker Compose stack with backend, policy engine and Meta model calls for verified runs.

thedevanshshukla/Neev-by-metaAI.summary: Tests building facade segmentation and inspection checklist judging
thedevanshshukla/Neev-by-metaAI.readme_summary: Neev harness validates SAM 3.1 building segmentation and Muse Wonder checklist judging with repeatable evals. Standard-library Python pipeline plus thin local file-based inspection web app.

riddhi2778/hotspot-detective.summary: Diagnoses urban heat causes in Jaipur with causal counterfactual tests
riddhi2778/hotspot-detective.readme_summary: Hotspot Detective fuses Earth observation and telemetry to explain heat islands via permutation testing. FastAPI SSE backend and Next.js frontend use muse-spark-1.3 and muse-wonder-1.0 agents.

sagardgharge/mailboxai.summary: WhatsApp mailbox that digitizes, triages and reads physical mail aloud
sagardgharge/mailboxai.readme_summary: MailboxAI gives users a mailing address managed via WhatsApp with ID verification, AI triage and voice notes. Businesses send soft mail directly, cutting paper, postage and delivery delay.

imninh/proofloop.summary: Coding agent that marks done only when hidden deterministic checks pass
imninh/proofloop.readme_summary: ProofLoop separates model claims from evidence using allowlisted checks and hidden holdout tests. Rule-based verdict yields verified status, built on Muse Spark during the 2026 hackathon.

xpertizetech/SmartScan.summary: Personal grocery agent that learns receipts and tracks prices to plan cheapest buys.
xpertizetech/SmartScan.readme_summary: Python package smartpantry implements A.G.E.N.T pipeline: acquire receipts with PII redaction, gather prices via API/flyer/browser, evaluate unit prices, navigate buy/wait plan, take action behind approval. Uses Meta Muse models for receipt parsing, product matching and planning.

Dhruv-Dashora/Meta-Hackathon.summary: Turns disaster photos into evidence-linked incident reports for human reviewers.
Dhruv-Dashora/Meta-Hackathon.readme_summary: Himalayan Sentinel analyzes flood/landslide photos for hazards and infrastructure impact with human-in-the-loop review. Backend combines Muse Spark for scene understanding and SAM 3.1 for segmentation, plus evidence-aware assessment and report generation.

angekana49-ui/Astroworld.summary: Voice-driven tutor that detects misconceptions and shows manipulable counter-proofs.
angekana49-ui/Astroworld.readme_summary: Counterproof transcribes student speech via Muse Voice, classifies misconception with Muse Spark, then Python computes exact numbers for a JSON animation. Stack is Python server.py plus browser player with verified placeholders to prevent hallucinations.

EmmanuelEdward2019/FieldFix-AI.summary: Multimodal repair assistant that diagnoses phones and PCs from photos and video.
EmmanuelEdward2019/FieldFix-AI.readme_summary: FieldFix AI analyzes symptom text plus photos/videos with Meta models to propose faults, guide safe tests, cite docs and build repair reports. TypeScript monorepo with zod contracts, voice diagnostics, parts feeds and technician map.

codenameplumber/Ecocycle-MetaHackathon.summary: Verified waste ledger tracking weights and payments for Lagos households and collectors.
codenameplumber/Ecocycle-MetaHackathon.readme_summary: EcoCycle is Laravel 13 + Livewire 4 + MySQL platform where every screen figure is a DB query for waste movement and payouts. Provides household verification, collector proof and processor purchases for Lagos waste economy.

GeorgeLeq/mozambique-offline-first-posV2.summary: Offline-first POS ecosystem keeping Mozambique shops selling without internet.
GeorgeLeq/mozambique-offline-first-posV2.readme_summary: Tauri desktop POS with local-first data model for retail shops, syncing to cloud when online. Core infra layer built; planned Meta Llama and SAM 3.1 integration for AI features during hackathon window.

NathanHannon/FixLens.summary: Photo home-repair checker that outlines damage and tracks changes over time.
NathanHannon/FixLens.readme_summary: Expo app lets users brush a crack/stain, preview editable SAM-style highlight, then get assessment with urgency and next steps. Saved jobs support re-photo comparison to measure change in highlighted area.

SWARNIM-TIWARI/takestate-spatial-qa.summary: Checks product photos against spatial rules with segmented visual evidence.
SWARNIM-TIWARI/takestate-spatial-qa.readme_summary: Streamlit app app.py uses Muse Spark 1.3 to parse natural language into 4-relation JSON rules, SAM 3.1 to segment objects, and deterministic mask-centroid geometry for PASS/FAIL. 116 offline tests pass; live SAM/Spark unverified.

officialbrandonsandoval-source/pinequote.summary: Instant lawn quotes from satellite imagery with canopy-based pricing.
officialbrandonsandoval-source/pinequote.readme_summary: Node.js app segments satellite tile into lawn/evergreen/hardscape, computes serviceable area and canopy score to drive Iron & Pine pricing engine. Returns instant quote with reasoning and customer-ready copy.

carrollco/watchverify.summary: Turns expert demo video into a checklist that verifies later job recordings.
carrollco/watchverify.readme_summary: Python tool converts how-to video into step checklist, then checks new recordings frame-by-frame, abstaining when not visible. Includes offline bench that grades Muse Spark on open how-to videos and exposes result-bias failure.

Harin0231/podAI.summary: Contract-first multi-agent squad that turns epics into tested production code
Harin0231/podAI.readme_summary: Enforces contract-first development where Muse Wonder locks interfaces in contracts.py and schedules a DAG. Muse Spark workers implement code and pytest suites concurrently. Modal micro-VMs verify builds with self-repair loops.

Harsh-Kumar-6/webmcp-bridge.summary: Compiles websites into typed tested tools for agents without per-click models
Harsh-Kumar-6/webmcp-bridge.readme_summary: Explores sites once with Muse Spark 1.3 in a real browser to generate typed tools and tests. Uses SAM 3.1 for pixel-only controls and prefers network replay. Agents then call tools with no model per click.

artisticsciencex/tracegaze-muse.summary: Turns egocentric video and gaze into object-grounded evidence for elder support
artisticsciencex/tracegaze-muse.readme_summary: Pipeline maps gaze samples to objects with SAM 3 to produce time-stamped evidence and dwell metrics. Muse Spark interprets evidence with key frames into linked findings. Built for retrospective research on daily activities.

caganbahri1/meta-ai-sorucoz.summary: AI exam prep platform for TYT, AYT, SAT and ACT with adaptive practice
caganbahri1/meta-ai-sorucoz.readme_summary: PHP platform with student-teacher roles, adaptive levels, AI question generation, wrong-notebook and spaced repetition. Provides AI teacher, coach, study plans and XP classrooms. Supports Turkish and English UI.

EltonKadiu/sketchship-ai.summary: Converts hand-drawn sketches into working Streamlit apps with live preview
EltonKadiu/sketchship-ai.readme_summary: Sends sketch images to Muse multimodal via Meta Model API to extract structured UI JSON. Second Muse call generates validated Streamlit code rendered live. Runs hosted over HTTP with offline mock mode.

nyoriworks/HexSolid-Studio.summary: Portfolio optimization and index replication studio fusing AI and physics solver
nyoriworks/HexSolid-Studio.readme_summary: Combines Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder with HexSolid Parametron Ising solver for index replication. Selects optimal portfolios from thousands of stocks with time-series validation. Python studio with charts and market data.

tuanpicoceo/picoceo-builder.summary: Turns text ideas into printable talking robots linked to AI agents via MCP
tuanpicoceo/picoceo-builder.readme_summary: 8-step agent uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API to pick parts, design 3D body, wiring and firmware. Connects ESP32 and LicheeRV builds to PICOCEO agents over MCP for speech. Firebase, web UI and printable files.

deshnaas/voxera-meta.summary: Real-time voice agent that handles patient calls and logs to hospital dashboard
deshnaas/voxera-meta.readme_summary: Patient phone flow with Whisper STT, reasoning plus deterministic emergency escalation, and Priya TTS voices. Stores patients, calls and referrals in Supabase dashboard. Python core with mic capture and endpointing.

shivamkumarsingh28/MetaAPPlyPilot.summary: Reads job notices, checks eligibility and autofills forms and photo requirements
shivamkumarsingh28/MetaAPPlyPilot.readme_summary: Parses PDF and photo notices to show key facts, fake-check and page-grounded answers. Checks profile eligibility, resizes photos and autofills forms via browser extension and Telegram. Full-stack app with backend and extension.

Yarramneni-vasavi/Driftwatcher.summary: Detects drift between AGENTS.md docs and code with CI checks and doc fixes
Yarramneni-vasavi/Driftwatcher.readme_summary: CLI scans docs, runs deterministic checks, maps features and checks PRs against base branch. Proposes doc-only diffs and tests provider profiles including Meta API. Python Poetry project with CI and eval harness.

IAMIbrahimmemon/remembery-model.summary: On-device memory that turns AI glasses conversations into searchable records
IAMIbrahimmemon/remembery-model.readme_summary: On-device System 1 memory for AI glasses that converts daily transcripts into structured searchable records offline. Uses small Meta MobileLLM-R1 360M with non-autoregressive heads, Python pipeline plus iOS export and ontology evals.

kobinasam/VerdantAI.summary: Crop-health advisor that diagnoses maize, cassava and cocoa from leaf photos
kobinasam/VerdantAI.readme_summary: Multimodal advisor for Ghana smallholders that photographs leaves/pods to give lesions, guidance and records. Stack is FastAPI backend, frontend, ML and Docker with English/Twi/Spanish, using Meta models for vision and explanation.

JasTandon/motionclone.summary: Turns UI screen recordings into spring-physics React, SwiftUI and CSS code
JasTandon/motionclone.readme_summary: Video-to-code Studio that measures motion from mp4/mov/webm and fits spring constants to generate runnable clones. Uses Meta API muse-spark-1.3 plus sam-3.1 with Node frontend and Python backend for tracking and codegen.

chriskrim2002/KrimVision.summary: Vision agents that segment scenes, reason causes and auto-execute fixes
chriskrim2002/KrimVision.readme_summary: Autonomous multi-agent loop Segment, Reason, Code, Execute, Verify for spatial analysis and defect inspection. Uses SAM 3.1 segmentation with Muse Spark/Wonder reasoning and Muse Code generation in Python.

jkeskikangas/pi-muse-subscription.summary: Runs Muse Spark and Wonder in pi agent via Muse Code subscription auth
jkeskikangas/pi-muse-subscription.readme_summary: Pi provider that routes Muse Spark/Wonder requests through local muse serve host instead of direct Model API. Built in TypeScript for pi >=1.0 and Node 20, using Muse Code SDK as authenticated model transport.

schwankcapital/retail-pulse.summary: In-store retail intelligence platform with offline demo and analytics server
schwankcapital/retail-pulse.readme_summary: In-store super-intelligence app with reproducible synthetic fixtures, offline demo and local server on port 8001. Python package with contracts, datasets and docs, designed to run without paid model calls.

RMajestic/enki-second-memory.summary: Opt-in visual memory for Ray-Ban glasses to recall last key sighting
RMajestic/enki-second-memory.readme_summary: ENKI Second Memory adds bounded observation policy, opt-in single-image analysis and saved visual evidence to iOS host. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 Standard via Mac CLI with Swift core and backend for deterministic queries.

Suf78/ChaosTwin.summary: Converts junction traffic video into twin to test better signal timings
Suf78/ChaosTwin.readme_summary: Builds a SUMO digital twin from short junction video by counting vehicles by type then simulating signal plans. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark via Meta Model API with docs-first web and pipeline design.
