prandata/secondlook.summary: Local triage queue that ranks image folders with evidence receipts
prandata/secondlook.readme_summary: Desk tool where folder goes in and ranked uncertain/auto_decided queue with per-image receipt comes out. Fully local open-source Python CLI with ladder logic and detector scores, no Meta affiliation.

s0nle/Spottr.summary: AI lifeguard that tracks swimmers and alerts on drowning risk in pools
s0nle/Spottr.readme_summary: Pool-camera assistant that finds persons/heads, tracks IDs underwater and escalates WATCH/ALARM/EMERGENCY. Uses SAM 3.1 with zoomed quarters plus Muse Spark/Muse Image in Python with frontend alerts.

ShayekhBinIslam/portia.summary: Compares two AI answers about long videos and picks the one backed by footage.
ShayekhBinIslam/portia.readme_summary: Portia runs three Muse Glimmer agents to search ~100 hours of video via transcripts and frame zoom. Muse Spark 1.3 verifies evidence and returns the better answer with timestamps and confidence. Static gallery in product/site, live app at portia.shayekh.tech.

Harp404/Holo.summary: AR guide that sees your workspace and highlights parts step by step as you build.
Harp404/Holo.readme_summary: Holo uses Muse Spark Open in server.py for planning, step tracking and web search from camera frames. SAM 3.1 does text-prompted segmentation and tracking, DINOv3 pools features for part identity. Unity client renders highlights and 3D STL models.

eerwitt/junk-band.summary: Browser paper-puppet sampler that turns video sounds into playable band members.
eerwitt/junk-band.readme_summary: Finds a sound in video, cuts out the object that made it and drops it on a circular stage to play. Godot 4.6 stage + TypeScript Web Audio + Python FastAPI gateway calling SAM 3.1, Muse and SAM Audio on Modal GPU. Demo mode works without credentials with labelled stand-ins.

TheMan005/Kavach-Meta-Hackathon.summary: Android prototype that reviews texts and calls for digital-arrest scam signs.
TheMan005/Kavach-Meta-Hackathon.readme_summary: Android app with backend-only AI; no on-device models. Muse Spark 1.3 checks text and screen samples, Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 plus Spark handles speakerphone clips. Targets English/Hindi scam review with explicit prototype limits.

sathishkumar-ramachandran-tl/ophthapilot.summary: Simulated eye-surgery robot lab with synthetic OCT, safety checks and approval.
sathishkumar-ramachandran-tl/ophthapilot.readme_summary: Closed-loop simulation: synthetic OCT to Muse reasoning to RCM trajectory to safety validation to human approval to 6-DOF robot execution. FastAPI plus WebSocket backend serves built UI and 3D microscope view. Research only, no hardware.

bigmanderson/genesis-pro-builder-meta.summary: Turns a photo or sketch into a running data-backed InSpatial app.
bigmanderson/genesis-pro-builder-meta.readme_summary: Agent pipeline: Muse Spark classifies image, SAM 3.1 segments objects for seed data, Muse Spark emits App Intent JSON, then generates InSpatial project and preview app. Uses Meta Model API with strict json_schema and build checks.

babu-studios/babu-studio-app.summary: macOS app that records capture card, webcam and mic and exports dual layouts.
babu-studios/babu-studio-app.readme_summary: Electron plus React configures shared scene with independent landscape and portrait layouts. Separate C++ media-core captures timestamped tracks to master.babu via FFmpeg libav. No Meta AI integration described in README.

anubhavvashishtha/Aurif.summary: Permissioned API layer letting sites control what AI agents can read and do.
anubhavvashishtha/Aurif.readme_summary: Publishes an AI surface via aurif.json and /ai/* routes instead of HTML scraping. Node 22 + Python 3.11 stack with Aurif-UI dashboard, Demo-client shop, and server. Uses Muse chat for demo browsing, handshake, and CAPTCHA vision with offline fallback.

SufianDior/ReproForge-AI.summary: Reproduces Python bugs, requests a Muse fix, and re-runs the same tests.
SufianDior/ReproForge-AI.readme_summary: Streamlit app with engine.py and pytest suite for two reproducible Python bugs. Shows before/after test output, unified diff, and downloadable fix. Uses Meta muse-spark-1.3 via Model API with labeled offline sample fallback.

renu5682/crop_advisor.summary: Tamil voice helper that ranks crops by profit range, risk, and water need.
renu5682/crop_advisor.readme_summary: Farmers speak Tamil season, acres, and water; deterministic SQLite engine computes profit ranges and gaps. Local server streams speech and explains results in spoken Tamil. Uses muse-voice-transcribe-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3 for understanding.

YiT-qg/mr-jeff-glasses.summary: Glasses assistant that detects gaze dwell and routes to factory safety help.
YiT-qg/mr-jeff-glasses.readme_summary: Planning-stage spec for Ray-Ban Display with on-device dwell detection after 2.5s stillness. Context router sends scenes to specialists, including shop-floor fault analysis. Uses work-order history from mr-jeff and logs confirmed causes back.

sr-devopsCloud/support-inbox-triage.summary: Sorts unreplied support email by urgency and drafts replies for review.
sr-devopsCloud/support-inbox-triage.readme_summary: Python scripts filter sample_inbox.json to unreplied mail, classify topic and urgency, and save sorted queue. Draft generator creates short NOT SENT replies for human review. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API, never sends email.

Ashiti-Patel10/QuickMeds.summary: Online pharmacy with catalogue, cart, and AI photo search for medicines.
Ashiti-Patel10/QuickMeds.readme_summary: Node server.js with multi-page public frontend for catalogue, cart, prescription, and orders. Photo-search page calls AI analysis when API key is set, otherwise basic flow works offline. Uses AI vision model for medicine photo lookup.

Siya-G/spotter.summary: Identifies gym machine controls from a photo and overlays step-by-step setup.
Siya-G/spotter.readme_summary: Backend + frontend app where Muse Spark identifies machine and writes JSON steps tied to parts. Each part phrase is segmented in parallel by SAM 3.1 into pixel masks. Step viewer pulses current part with movement arrows.

DeveloperXG/Artrelo-hackathon.summary: Property maintenance autopilot for triage, quotes, scheduling and payments
DeveloperXG/Artrelo-hackathon.readme_summary: Artrelo manages tenant report to repair with triage, vendor coordination and quote analysis. Iris assistant on Muse Spark advises, backend validates; Dockerized backend + frontend with explicit confirmations.

Ps23102004/homebrain-baton.summary: Local Mac hub where Muse answers requests and relays coding tasks onward.
Ps23102004/homebrain-baton.readme_summary: Zero-runtime-dependency Python hub with 1280+ tests, config, skills, and Slack relay. Supports Muse-asks file and memory lookup plus continue-lantern handoff between vendor agents. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 with local-first private files.

Magic-Dala/Meta-MuseGuard.summary: Turns a spare phone into an on-device guardian for baby, pet, and elder care.
Magic-Dala/Meta-MuseGuard.readme_summary: Repurposes spare phone for on-device watching with Baby, Pet, and Older-adult modes and watch zones. Sends alerts only when needed with live family view. Built for Startup track using Muse models for on-device detection.

ParentMuse/parent-muse.summary: Co-parenting AI coach that drafts calm messages grounded in your parenting plan.
ParentMuse/parent-muse.readme_summary: AI agent for divorced parents with memory of family situation. Coaches in the moment, drafts messages for approval, and answers plan questions citing sections. Uses Muse models for plan-grounded, de-escalation-first guidance.

nur-srijan/retrofit.summary: Turns legacy control panels into live typed queryable data streams via camera.
nur-srijan/retrofit.readme_summary: Points a camera at analog panels to create live streams with compiled readers, charts and rules. Stack is Python FastAPI backend plus frontend with contracts and fallbacks. Uses SAM 3.1 for tracking, Muse Spark for classify and calibrate, Wonder and Voice.

jrohcz/offload-hackathon.summary: Turns clutter photos into reviewable listings and triages buyer messages for you.
jrohcz/offload-hackathon.readme_summary: Prototype that separates what photos and seller messages support from unknowns. Generates listings from photos and lets an agent sort messages while owner decides. Built with Next.js on Vercel using Meta Muse models for vision and decisions.

Mr-Priyanshu/metahackathon.summary: Voice-first smart-glasses companion describing surroundings for blind users.
Mr-Priyanshu/metahackathon.readme_summary: DrishtiLink takes Hindi/English/Hinglish voice in and audio out to describe scenes, read text, guide walks and escalate SOS. Stack is React 19, Node TypeScript and Socket.IO with live family dashboard. Uses Meta AI voice and Muse chat models.

cherypallysaisurya/meetmind-hackathon.summary: Meeting copilot that preps answers from your docs and detects directed questions.
cherypallysaisurya/meetmind-hackathon.readme_summary: Runs beside Zoom/Teams without joining, alerting within 1s when questioned. Shows cue cards prepared from agenda and documents with sources, plus live cards in 3s. Uses Muse Spark for detection, grounded answering and notes.

Prateek10465/NightShift.summary: Local study buddy that answers only from your textbooks with cited lines.
Prateek10465/NightShift.readme_summary: Student adds chapters, slides and notes; app answers with highlighted source lines and page numbers. Writes quizzes with SM-2 spaced repetition and solves maths with code checks. Python locally-run app using Muse models.

lungilemooketsi/pulse-crypto-sentiment-c.summary: Explains crypto market mood in plain language without buy or sell advice.
lungilemooketsi/pulse-crypto-sentiment-c.readme_summary: Public chat where users ask about coins or comparisons and get mood, bull/bear case and watch-points. Includes Simulation Lab and Anomaly Library with public method card. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API, Cloudflare Workers and Firebase.

MicroQuack/told-here.summary: 3D heritage map of shoe factories with a source-grounded ask agent.
MicroQuack/told-here.readme_summary: 3D map of Northampton shoe factories carrying sourced facts plus consented community memories. Ask agent on Muse Spark Open answers from sources, flies to building and shows card. Built with web 3D engine, tour and editor tools.

Black0wL/swath.summary: County-level corn yield nowcasts from satellite and weather before USDA.
Black0wL/swath.readme_summary: Estimates Iowa corn and soybean yields county by county from public satellite and weather with classical ML. Shows SAM 3.1 field outlines on 3D globe with reproducible benchmark vs USDA. Docker Compose harness with docs and benchmarks.

aryan-sentlyx/glimmer-system-one.summary: Single-pass vision decision model outputting calibrated probabilities for inspection.
aryan-sentlyx/glimmer-system-one.readme_summary: Takes image plus typed noul/choice/score questions and returns calibrated probability per question in one forward pass. Built on Muse Glimmer 30B to cut latency vs text reasoning. Open heads on Hugging Face with Modal live demo.

vankayalapatin/compliance-gate.summary: Enforcement layer that blocks ERP actions violating policy controls
vankayalapatin/compliance-gate.readme_summary: Adds a policy enforcement layer at procure-to-pay control points in SAP/Dynamics/Oracle. Built with .NET solution (Gate.Agent/Compliance/Erp/Eval/Web); turns regulations and company memos into versioned controls via Muse Spark and Muse models.

vhoangvu/earnplay.summary: On-device effort gate where kids earn app time via learning tasks
vhoangvu/earnplay.readme_summary: Private Swift/SwiftUI child and admin apps with EarnPlayCore package for math, reading, and chore challenges. Runs fully on-device with deterministic safety code; AI proposes activities while code decides access, no accounts or servers.

vancuren/automuse.summary: Voice-commanded $34 toy drone that follows described person or car
vancuren/automuse.readme_summary: Maps voice commands to drone missions via Muse Voice Transcribe and fine-tuned Muse Glimmer with LoRA. Uses SAM 3.1 for visual tracking and a safety-governed classical controller to fly a Loiley X69 and digital twin.

HypeAITR/karagoz-anim.summary: Multi-agent pipeline turning script and voice into 2D animation
HypeAITR/karagoz-anim.readme_summary: Takes script, character references, and location to produce 2D limited animation shots. Python 3.12 agent team orchestrates storyboarding, art, and voice using Meta models; early preview v0.0.1 with MIT license.

Bhargavi2212/zerostate.summary: Read-only safety check that stops pipe work on isolation mismatch
Bhargavi2212/zerostate.readme_summary: Compares plant isolation plan against live sensor data and camera before maintenance. Uses Muse Spark to retrieve plans and verify seals; never approves, only issues STOP for human sign-off with verifiable results.

hxbib/OffLlama.summary: Distilled Llama 3.2 1B for offline iPhone actions with Muse fallback
hxbib/OffLlama.readme_summary: Runs Llama-Reflex-1B distilled from Muse Glimmer 30B labels on iPhone for offline Q&A and structured iOS actions. Dual System 1/System 2 design with 0.90 confidence gate, action contracts, and optional Muse cloud escalation.

rustambekabdusalomov/agnts.summary: Self-hosted agent coding Jira tickets to approved pull requests
rustambekabdusalomov/agnts.readme_summary: Ingests Jira, Plane, chats and logs to code, scan, review, and document in isolated containers. Drives Muse Code via open-source agnts-muse Go module over session protocol with budget metering and human approval gates.

EdwinSotto123/blindaje-meta-hackathon.summary: Disguised app linking extortion evidence to expose crime networks
EdwinSotto123/blindaje-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Collects victim WhatsApp voice notes, photos, and messages in a disguised business notebook app. Transcribes and matches voice, accounts, and scripts across cases for human review, showing only district-level public maps.

Dinesh-Sunny/beacon.summary: Chat assistant finding eligible UK/US benefits with official rules
Dinesh-Sunny/beacon.readme_summary: Conversational check that maps life situation to likely UK/US support with citations to official rules. Built on Muse Spark, Wonder, Image, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 with Muse Spark Open on Baseten, live on Vercel.

allwinlucious/Intent2Action.summary: One phone video teaches robot to write and run verified programs
allwinlucious/Intent2Action.readme_summary: Converts phone clip plus sentence into verified robot programs with failure recovery. Muse Glimmer reads tasks from frames for human confirm, then fine-tuned open model generates code executed in Isaac Sim physics.

lainx06/RING3.summary: Plain-English console for a from-scratch x86 kernel where AI proposes, kernel enforces
lainx06/RING3.readme_summary: From-scratch C x86 kernel with agentsh helper in ring 3 via int 0x80 syscalls. Host bridge sends checksummed 16-byte records so kernel never parses model text. Uses Meta Muse Spark off-device for proposals with kernel allow/refuse/ask policy.

rabinsingh123/dockhand.summary: Teach portal tasks once, then replay with zero model calls and self-repair on change
rabinsingh123/dockhand.readme_summary: Records one computer-use run into a replayable program triggered via WhatsApp. Replays deterministically and auto-repairs selectors-flows on portal changes. Uses Muse computer-use models with TypeScript monorepo and evals harness.

nikolas-rauscher/paper-tour.summary: Turns PDFs into narrated on-page explanations with highlights and visuals
nikolas-rauscher/paper-tour.readme_summary: Uploads PDFs, ingests text-figures, generates narrated tours with source highlights and interactive examples. Stack with ingest/player services via Docker Compose. Uses Meta AI models for explanation, narration, and Q&A beside original.

Mitchell-Marchand/pricecharm-hackathon.summary: Trains quoting AI on owner prices with video walk-around measurement
Mitchell-Marchand/pricecharm-hackathon.readme_summary: Service-business quoting product with customer chat and owner price learning from old quotes. Full-stack apps/api with video analysis. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for chat/quotes, Muse 1.2 video understanding, SAM 3.1 window tracking.

chainchopper/FabricX.summary: Live multiplayer sensory canvas turning touch into fluid, sound and vibration
chainchopper/FabricX.readme_summary: Live multiplayer canvas rendering touch as fluid, synthesized sound and haptics plus ghostie companions. Includes protein-folding fabric pooling phone compute with verified shards. Uses Muse Spark and SAM for perception.

Silentarcherjr/eventproof-meta-hackathon.summary: Tests AI traffic cameras by putting every ticket on trial before fining
Silentarcherjr/eventproof-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Compiles statutes/rules, tracks vehicles in drone video, then audits tickets with thresholds and trial view. Backend + frontend with benchmarks on real intersection trajectories. Uses Muse Spark for rules, SAM 3.1 for tracking.

Bypass-Labs/bypass.summary: Turns Muse Code into continuous security tester with verified repeatable tests
Bypass-Labs/bypass.readme_summary: Muse Code plugin and standalone CLI for white-box review and black-box audit of live apps. Enforces scope, records evidence, verifies fixes. Uses active Muse session or Meta Model API with Muse Spark Open/Glimmer.

Nishit-Sharma/Glint.summary: macOS learning companion turning your sources into testable small models
Nishit-Sharma/Glint.readme_summary: Electron + React macOS app where users add text, images, PDFs or window captures to tasks. Builds local bounded models to predict, check, and vary assumptions. Uses Meta AI for explanations; data stored locally on Mac.

gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-.summary: Turns home camera alerts into cited visit stories and spatial timeline
gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-.readme_summary: Correlates multi-camera events into cited visit stories with gaps and rule-based attention. Python + Docker service with local dashboard and evals. Uses Meta models for perception; deterministic code decides outcomes.

saiteja195/MemoryAtlas.summary: Evidence-backed memory graph that reconstructs days and forgets verifiably
saiteja195/MemoryAtlas.readme_summary: Turns consented photos, voice, notes, calendar into text-only evidence graph with correction and history. Verifiable consent withdrawal deletes dependent memories with leak checks. Uses Meta AI models for extraction and QA.

yc9954/neuromuse.summary: Brain-grounded opinion agent that scores photos, video, copy and audio with cortex data
yc9954/neuromuse.readme_summary: Grounded-opinion assistant for Meta glasses. TRIBE v2 brain encoder feeds calibrated heads into a Muse Spark tool-calling agent that explains ratings with brain regions. Learns user taste as readable rules and supports ad-creation loops.

yughiyami/willay.summary: El Nino early-warning system for Peruvian tailings sites and downstream communities
yughiyami/willay.readme_summary: Multi-agent warning system on three horizons: months, days, hours. Consumes ENFEN, SENAMHI, CENEPRED/SIGRID data and delivers alerts via messaging apps with safe/help confirmation. Built with Meta Muse models and SAM 3.1.

alankritxghosh/icarus-hackathon.summary: Turns plain words and photos into walkable 3D office designs with editable layouts
alankritxghosh/icarus-hackathon.readme_summary: Concept office designer. Muse Spark 1.3 proposes rooms, adjacencies and edits from text; schema-checked layout engine and validators in packages/core build 3D model. Supports photo-guided style and plain-language revisions.

Abhijithreddydasari/ask-Y.summary: Whiteboard tutor that teaches visually and adapts to how each student thinks
Abhijithreddydasari/ask-Y.readme_summary: Shared whiteboard tutor that explains concepts, checks understanding and remembers learner mental models. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image. Web + API with board artifacts and setup via two keys.

JordanM575/open-book-studio.summary: Local-first desktop studio where an agent edits your book folder directly
JordanM575/open-book-studio.readme_summary: Local-first fiction studio. Book is Markdown/JSON folder you own, agent reads Story Bible and chapters and edits via checked undoable saves. Built with Spec Kit workflow for hackathon Indie track, no server or database.

dzorlu/research-collections.summary: Worked research notes on attention, parallelism, distillation and RL training
dzorlu/research-collections.readme_summary: Personal collection of ML training notes with runnable notebooks. Covers attention memory, tensor/pipeline/expert parallelism on 48 GPUs, MOPD distillation and RL infra. No Meta AI integration; educational reference only.

teapot2/triage.summary: AI SRE that finds outage causes, proposes reversible fixes and proves them
teapot2/triage.readme_summary: Service watcher that diagnoses outages with cited evidence, applies human-approved reversible mitigation and validates fix in sandbox before draft PR. Built on Meta Muse models with demo video and diagnosis benchmark.

nexus-research-ai/nexus.summary: Campus discovery graph that matches researchers and drafts verified grants
nexus-research-ai/nexus.readme_summary: Collaborative research platform with campus graph, hypothesis protection and grant synthesis. Multimodal literature analysis with pixel-verified outputs. Stack is Next.js frontend, Python services, powered by muse-wonder-1.0 and SAM 3.1.

thinkjones/onesaas.summary: Lets small businesses describe chores and builds approved automations step by step
thinkjones/onesaas.readme_summary: Desktop Tauri app for solopreneurs. Describe automation in chat, watch it build on design board, approve before execution. Runs locally for Gmail/customer tasks, powered by Meta Muse models with demo video.

frans-nekongo/Tottie.summary: MCP memory server that curates and links agent memory at write time
frans-nekongo/Tottie.readme_summary: Universal Model Context Protocol stdio server with 9 tools. Curates, links and consolidates agent memory during writes to avoid brute-force search. Integrates Muse Spark and Muse Code, evaluated on 22 scenarios.

voluma-bio/voluma.summary: Turns micro-CT scans into validated bone measurements with evidence-traced 3D review.
voluma-bio/voluma.readme_summary: Voluma automates mouse knee osteoarthritis measurement from micro-CT scans. AI agents segment bones, place regions and landmarks, measure and self-check. Researchers review results in 3D beside evidence and correct via chat using Muse models.

raphaeldchen/origami-cad-hackathon.summary: Designs origami force-response metamaterials from text into simulator-verified folds.
raphaeldchen/origami-cad-hackathon.readme_summary: Pipeline converts natural-language force-displacement specs into fold patterns for elastic metamaterial cells. Combines generators, world models and simulator verification. Built during hackathon on prior simulator and proposer codebase.

oguirado/MetaViewer.summary: Linux capsule desktop where humans and AI share control with verified action journal.
oguirado/MetaViewer.readme_summary: MetaViewer runs browsers and apps in isolated capsules on a Linux wall for shared human-AI operation. It scopes agent input, checks frames the agent saw, and logs decisions. Muse Spark 1.3 agents operate inside with Rust gate.

steppetech1/Quack.summary: Maps student mastery per skill and guides review across 6 levels for faster learning.
steppetech1/Quack.readme_summary: Quack attaches to lectures and tracks what is proven, failed or unknown per skill. It guides practice, error revisit and review in professor notation with slide links. Backend plus compute services deliver adaptive tutoring.

grmkris/styld.app.summary: Scans wardrobe video to cut out garments into clean shop-style pictures and looks.
grmkris/styld.app.readme_summary: Styld processes rail videos and photos to detect, track and cut out garments. Meta SAM 3.1 finds items across frames, Muse Image renders clean product pics. Runs at styld.app in English and Slovenian on Cloudflare.

suleymantarsuslu/sosmesh.summary: Sends encrypted SOS messages over Bluetooth LE mesh when internet is unavailable.
suleymantarsuslu/sosmesh.readme_summary: SOSMesh is an offline-first emergency prototype relaying encrypted SOS via nearby phones over BLE. An internet-connected device forwards to central server and operator panel. Does not replace 112/911.

prnvvv/RL-Studio.summary: Trains RL agents and verifies, diagnoses and plans recovery for intended behavior.
prnvvv/RL-Studio.readme_summary: Self-Healing RL Studio is a full-stack RL platform for training, verification and fault diagnosis. FastAPI backend with React/Vite frontend runs PPO, TD3 in warehouse envs. Meta AI assists training and recovery planning.

amelia751/inkling.summary: No-code studio that sorts medical scans and pre-labels them for human approval.
amelia751/inkling.readme_summary: Inkling ingests X-rays, CT, ECG, pathology and video, sorts by type and creates studios. Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API pre-label with preview accept/reject. Monorepo with agent service.

AndriiCo/handbook.summary: Apostille guide where every fact links to its quote, source and date for review.
AndriiCo/handbook.readme_summary: Apostille Handbook drafts jurisdiction facts with Meta Muse Spark 1.3, quote-checked against captures with human approval. Rust xtask enforces Meta-only models. Live site with citation toggle and photo judging.

VrolixThomas/MuseFocus.summary: Voice-first macOS hub to review PRs, triage tickets and run coding jobs by talking.
VrolixThomas/MuseFocus.readme_summary: MuseFocus lets engineers review PRs, triage Linear tickets and launch background coding jobs via voice. macOS app with website and docs, guided review flows. Powered by Meta Muse models for voice command center.

syllogismos/atem.summary: Wearable glasses + harness that sees, listens and does computer work with proof
syllogismos/atem.readme_summary: atem is a wearable agent built on $10 sunglasses with ESP32S3 camera and mic for talk, point and whiteboard work. TypeScript harness routes speech and vision to Meta Muse models, shows planned actions for approval, then executes web and app tasks with proof.

AUsernameForYou/agenthand-rust.summary: MCP server that stages product photos and proves original product pixels unchanged
AUsernameForYou/agenthand-rust.readme_summary: agenthand is a Rust MCP server for seller agents that turns messy product photos into listing-ready images with a fidelity receipt. It calls Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image for staging and verification, shipped as one static binary with Python fallback.

surucuonur/WeSolve-MetaHackathon.summary: Agent swarm that made vLLM 21% faster on Apple M1 Pro with identical output
surucuonur/WeSolve-MetaHackathon.readme_summary: WeSolve is a multi-agent swarm that profiles and rewrites vLLM GPU kernels for MobileMoE-S on Apple Silicon. Orchestrated via Muse Code with Muse Spark models, it benchmarks 430 to 519 tokens/s end-to-end with bit-identical output and provenance logs.

bmarti44/meta-hackathon-deaf-hard-of-hea.summary: Preserve-first hearing research loop for severe-profound congenital SNHL
bmarti44/meta-hackathon-deaf-hard-of-hea.readme_summary: PRESERVE is a research-design system for biology-preserving high-channel hearing with frozen baseline and G1-G6 gates. It runs generations-selection-recombination scoring in Python, publishes results to a Next.js site and Hugging Face enhancer model, no patient data.

3lbgames/Lore-AI.summary: Voice-driven Quest village where NPCs remember talks and act on quests
3lbgames/Lore-AI.readme_summary: Lore-AI is a Unity Quest game with voice-driven NPCs that use authored personalities, memory and observed events. Meta models handle speech and dialogue generation while Unity Behavior Graphs control interactions, with a browser demo using the same characters.

Abhijithreddydasari/Y.summary: Whiteboard tutor that reads drawings, teaches on canvas and adapts lessons
Abhijithreddydasari/Y.readme_summary: Y is a whiteboard tutor that reads learner drawings, teaches on the same canvas and uses checkpoint answers to adapt next lessons. It offers Studio UI for tablets and guided mobile UI, built on Meta vision and tutoring models with shared-board workflow.

SnoobieJunes/under-the-mountain.summary: Open-world dragon simulator for macOS where you guard hoard and hunt thieves
SnoobieJunes/under-the-mountain.readme_summary: Under the Mountain is a playable Unreal open-world dragon sim for Apple Silicon with flight, fire breath, scent trails and thief AI. It uses Meta AI in the asset and gameplay pipeline with data-driven numbers, rigged dragon and dressed mountain lair.

pdelfino/itlogs.food.summary: Hands-free food logging via glasses that read scale display to Apple Health
pdelfino/itlogs.food.readme_summary: itlogs.food removes typing by using Ray-Ban Meta glasses to read grams off any digital scale. Muse Spark names the food and estimates calories and macros, then iOS and server functions log the meal to Apple Health with evals and docs.

Deytooh/my-dear-step-journal.summary: Korean-first GLP-1 journal where Momo drafts entries from words and photos
Deytooh/my-dear-step-journal.readme_summary: My Dear Step is a personal GLP-1 journal with AI companion Momo built on Meta Muse Spark Open. It proposes editable entries from text and meal photos for user review, built with React, Drizzle and Lovable with confirm-before-save privacy.

teehihi/scope-graph.summary: Maps code change requests to blast radius with evidence and MCP tools
teehihi/scope-graph.readme_summary: ScopeGraph indexes codebases to map change requests to dependency graphs and proposed blast radius with evidence. Python FastAPI backend plus React web UI exposes 3 MCP tools for AI-assisted development, Dockerized for API and web.

shaunmortal/crossing-watch.summary: Phone video proves school-gate near-misses with measured distances and certified reports.
shaunmortal/crossing-watch.readme_summary: Measures near-miss distance from one phone video and checks scale against a tape. Uses SAM 3.1 for vision measurement, deterministic code for checks, Muse Spark to draft authority letter, and fine-tuned Muse Glimmer as judge.

CVA71actual/proof-reader-hackathon.summary: Auditable biotech catalyst research agent that verifies claims against cited sources.
CVA71actual/proof-reader-hackathon.readme_summary: Researches biotech trial, regulatory and investor catalysts for six months. Muse Spark acts as web-search research agent with quote-boxed SEC source capture and claim-vs-source review. Person-in-control workflow.

HackMet/deed-ledger.summary: WhatsApp store ordering agent where claims count only after database readback.
HackMet/deed-ledger.readme_summary: Takes small-store orders via WhatsApp text, photo lists and voice notes. Meta models parse intent and plan steps, code validates proposals, customers confirm readbacks. Double-entry ledger with idempotent auditable memory.

markmdev/misogi.summary: Turns a yearly goal into a measured plan with AI coach and community climbing.
markmdev/misogi.readme_summary: Drafts year-long plan with metrics, camps and weekly quests from one goal line. Uses Muse Spark for planning, user Muse as coach, and Muse Wonder for personal pages. Next.js app deployed at getmisogi.com.

FrankEBaru/research-microscope.summary: Maps a research field then explains papers with linked symbols and live figures.
FrankEBaru/research-microscope.readme_summary: Draws field map of related papers and guides to the right paper with cited margin notes. Links every symbol to definitions and turns equations into live figures written by Muse Wonder. Three-minute demo video included.

gonzalomelov/theos-house.summary: Home safety system with vision hand-alarm, audio hearing and parenting agent.
gonzalomelov/theos-house.readme_summary: Smart-home safety built during hackathon with phone page and camera sources. Uses SAM 3.1 for hand-alarm reflex, Perception Encoder Audio for hearing, and Muse connectors including recipe agent. Cleaned private repo copy.

harsha-iiiv/MIRROR.summary: Robot task studio where plain-language corrections become testable rule changes.
harsha-iiiv/MIRROR.readme_summary: Authors and tests MuJoCo tasks by demo plus plain-language correction to scoped rules. Re-judges old runs from step logs, plans new layouts, and refuses with proof when blocked. Evidence holds on blocked cup-tilt layouts.

feeRnt/whofundsit.summary: Interactive global map showing who funds large public corporations and banks.
feeRnt/whofundsit.readme_summary: Visualizes corporate financing flows with scaled nodes for stocks, equity and donations. Uses open-weights Muse Glimmer to geocode addresses and test data soundness. Dockerized frontend plus backend, live on Vercel.

kizouker/holdmate.summary: Adaptive IVR agent that waits on hold for you with live queue and iOS board.
kizouker/holdmate.readme_summary: Waits on customer-service hold, normalizes intent and rescues calls live. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for intent normalization and eval via Meta Model API, with talk-loop fallback. iOS/watch queue board built during hackathon.

ray-aqno/Anville.summary: Closes engineer to shop-floor loop with geometry reviews and memory.
ray-aqno/Anville.readme_summary: Reviews synthetic STEP parts with geometry-only checks outputting Markdown/JSON. Adds designer/shop-memory loop to shorten iterations, with optional Meta reasoning and Onshape UI. Judge quickstart needs no CAD account.

meghana-0313/charie-workspace.summary: Always-on support agent that joins calls, sees screens, and drives fixes to verified tickets
meghana-0313/charie-workspace.readme_summary: Charie joins live support calls to view screens, guide troubleshooting, and convert issues into tickets and verified fixes. Stack spans apps/services with autonomous agent loops for QA and security monitoring. Uses Muse models for vision analysis, debugging, and supervised night-watch.

sambasev/pebble-piano.summary: Mac piano tutor that listens via MIDI or mic and coaches practice with AI feedback
sambasev/pebble-piano.readme_summary: Native macOS Swift app that hears piano via MIDI or microphone, grades notes, rhythm and tempo against scores. Provides lessons, backing tracks, and practice drills. Uses Meta Model API to explain mistakes and recommend what to practice next.

maitreyaaaaa/rembr.summary: Personal library that saves social posts, PDFs, and recordings into searchable memory
maitreyaaaaa/rembr.readme_summary: Rembr centralizes saved posts, links, images, PDFs and recordings into one searchable library with notes and extracted context. Web app with worker pipelines for ingest and search. Uses Meta AI for extraction, search, and knowledge tools.

williamvoor/glassline.summary: Postgres explorer that turns plain English into SQL with charts and inspectable results
williamvoor/glassline.readme_summary: Glassline answers natural-language questions over Postgres with read-only SQL, tables, charts and metrics. Includes VicProp/AusTender datasets and a fine-tune harness for Muse Glimmer to generate A2UI. Focuses on speed with correct, auditable numbers.

ClimbOutLabs/truss.summary: Glasses witness that watches daily actions and answers with photo proof via voice
ClimbOutLabs/truss.readme_summary: Android app with Meta Wearables Toolkit streams glasses video to a Python stdlib server for continuous observation. Ask about pills or actions and it responds with answer and photo proof. Uses Meta-only models for vision QA and alerts.

RaveOregon/ControlsBenchMUSE.summary: AI workstation that tests live PLC logic by operating systems and saving evidence
RaveOregon/ControlsBenchMUSE.readme_summary: ControlsBench generates a machine world from specs and I/O contracts, then operates PLC via OPC UA, CODESYS and browser HMI. Adapts fault investigations and preserves PDF/HTML evidence. Uses Muse Wonder 1.0 as isolated world engine and operator.

devcules/devcules.summary: Terminal-first desk to run coding agents in sandboxes with remote tailnet access
devcules/devcules.readme_summary: Open-source Go dev desk runs Muse Code, Claude Code, Codex or Hermes in per-agent sandboxes. Access from laptop/phone via tailnet with passkeys and secret redaction. Uses Muse Code as supported harness with gateway controls.

desanv01/VerifForge.summary: Platform for AI-proposed engineering experiments with independent checks and replay
desanv01/VerifForge.readme_summary: VerifForge runs AI-guided experiments with separate planner and verifier for independent verdicts and replayable evidence. Dockerized FastAPI + apps stack with CI and evals. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for experiment proposal and analysis.

amaan784/trained-eye.summary: Teaches Meta glasses custom visual alerts from a 10-second look and voice prompt
amaan784/trained-eye.readme_summary: iPhone app streams Meta glasses view to backend running a fine-tuned Muse Glimmer 30B detector. Users show an object for seconds, describe it, and glasses speak on detection. Includes playground, evals, and Hugging Face model.

Danielmc09/vigia.summary: WhatsApp sentinel that verdicts texts, audio, and PDFs as scam or legitimate
Danielmc09/vigia.readme_summary: Vigia receives forwarded texts, screenshots, voice notes, PDFs and emails via WhatsApp and returns scam/legitimate/doubtful verdict with reasons. Python service with 231-case eval harness. Uses three Meta models with measured 98.5% scam recall.

Sraveena1992/WORLDTRACE.summary: Evidence-first ops assistant that investigates incidents and gates fixes on approval.
Sraveena1992/WORLDTRACE.readme_summary: WORLDTRACE investigates ops exceptions from user-authorized evidence using allowlisted analysis tools. Built as Python app with FastAPI docs, SQLite sandbox, and Render deploy. Uses Baseten-hosted Muse Spark for analysis with approval-gated correction and after-state checks.

xavierloeraflores/banger-ai.summary: Browser and desktop song studio with piano roll, mixer, and AI music generation.
xavierloeraflores/banger-ai.readme_summary: Banger-ai is a pnpm Turborepo with Next.js web studio, Electron desktop, and Web Audio engine. Packages include bounded .banger compiler and WAV rendering. Compiler-validated agent generates music; Meta/Muse model binding not detailed in excerpt.

viillab/META-Viil-Sentinel.summary: Edge vision fall-candidate awareness system for caregiver-supervised incident review.
viillab/META-Viil-Sentinel.readme_summary: VIIL Sentinel streams video to edge fall-candidate detection, then consented keyframes to backend assessment. Includes dashboard and traceable incident management with acknowledgement. Meta-first evidence assessment planned, currently MOCK backend.

smashburger-dev/synthexis.summary: Camera-driven VST3/CLAP plugin that maps gestures and face to MIDI and automation.
smashburger-dev/synthexis.readme_summary: Synthexis is an Apple Silicon audio plugin for FL Studio turning hands, face and head into MIDI and automation. Standalone window with profiles, presets, and Pong test harness. Vision-to-control layer; no explicit Muse/SAM usage in excerpt.

kosesena/count-before-you-post.summary: Vision verification gate that blocks ERP posts until camera count confirms quantity.
kosesena/count-before-you-post.readme_summary: Count Before You Post requires camera-based counting before any ERP number write. Stack includes Python API, cbyp package, evals, tests and demo site. Designed for Meta vision verification workflow; specific Muse/SAM model wiring not in excerpt.

Ateh-Ugoji/Lumi-agent.summary: Autonomous social agent that learns voice and drafts cross-platform content.
Ateh-Ugoji/Lumi-agent.readme_summary: Lumi connects X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook via Post for Me with OAuth sync. Auto-bootstraps feed ingestion and Chroma vector indexing for retrieval-augmented generation. Provides niche analysis and multi-platform content engine.

sstmade/rehearsal.summary: Turns one photo into a physics twin to verify robot plans before execution.
sstmade/rehearsal.readme_summary: Rehearsal builds a simulator twin from a photo and checks natural-language goals in simulation. Uses Muse Spark for understanding, SAM 3.1 for segmentation, SAM 3D for reconstruction. Only physics-verified plans are sent, built on Python and MuJoCo.

ShrikarT/mobbs.summary: Simulated audience that previews short video and gives timestamped edit notes.
ShrikarT/mobbs.readme_summary: Mobbs runs short cuts through fictional viewer personalities to map attention and engagement. Current V03 Flash Scan plus Director's Notes gives curve and suggestions. Web app with contracts and migrations; simulation only, not virality prediction.

HiAgencia/brief.summary: Project-centric task manager with per-project calendars, chat actions, and MCP.
HiAgencia/brief.readme_summary: Brief organizes clients, subprojects, tasks, notes and decisions with cross-project overview. Attaches Google calendars per node with inheritance and per-project MCP server. Meta-model chat acts on tasks; built with Next.js, Supabase, Cloudflare.

nextlevelcommunity/buildersbot-repo1.summary: Local-first desktop workspace for running persistent multi-agent coding teammates.
nextlevelcommunity/buildersbot-repo1.readme_summary: Builders Bot gives each agent its own workspace with queues, file transfer, embedded browser and messaging. Supports Codex App Server, Claude Code, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor and Cline via ACP. Desktop dev preview, local-first architecture.

olartgabo/forma.summary: Turns measured scrap materials into buildable tabletop fixtures with checked instructions
olartgabo/forma.readme_summary: FORMA converts photos and stock measurements into small furniture designs with a deterministic assembly manual. A Python Assembly Compiler validates geometry, joints and stock before instructions are issued. Muse multimodal reads photos, proposes designs and diagnoses build failures.

Danieldkdao/scholaros.summary: Desktop study workspace that turns course files into tutored sessions and practice
Danieldkdao/scholaros.readme_summary: ScholarOS centralizes courses, LMS data, notes, PDFs and images into a desktop workspace with AI tutoring and simulations. Built as a pnpm monorepo with desktop apps and background sync. Uses Meta AI for grounded, course-scoped tutoring conversations.

mohamedabdelnasser7-gif/unfenced.summary: Chat-built agents that practice in simulation and ship only after passing checks
mohamedabdelnasser7-gif/unfenced.readme_summary: Unfenced lets users describe an agent in chat, then trains it in an Arena against persona agents before gated release. Every live case is monitored and failures become tested fixes. Real cases and CSV uploads feed back to improve simulation and shared learning.

Slimco86/FieldLens.summary: Rebuilds oilfield wells and history from raw files into cited 3D and charts
Slimco86/FieldLens.readme_summary: FieldLens ingests surveys, logs, XML and spreadsheets to resolve wells and reconstruct wellbores with source citations. Backend agent pipeline powers 3D exploration, production charts and Q&A. Uses Meta Muse Spark for document sorting, entity resolution and answers.

dominquecox/mergemate-beta.summary: Task board where coding agents draft PRs and models review code and screenshots
dominquecox/mergemate-beta.readme_summary: MergeMate gives each repo a task board where agents pick files and open draft PRs for human approval. Web app reviews PRs for summary, risk and screenshot issues. Uses Muse Spark 1.2 for review, SAM 3.1 for screenshot segmentation and Muse Voice Transcribe.

Simon-Live/Simon-submission.summary: Turns one phone video of movement into a 3D reference for joint-level comparison
Simon-Live/Simon-submission.readme_summary: Simon converts a single phone recording into a 3D movement model without sensors or suits. Followers are compared joint-by-joint with plain-language feedback. Chains eleven Meta models for pose, 3D reconstruction and comparison.

apoorvasinha183/fab-gym.summary: Ask a simulated wafer fab questions and get testable options on SMT2020 data
apoorvasinha183/fab-gym.readme_summary: Fab Gym simulates a 1,043-machine fab using the public SMT2020 routes and times. Users query operations and receive options a person reviews, with evaluation harnesses. Uses agent and Rust crates plus Lean checks; demo narration uses ElevenLabs voices.

ADI-0519/preflight.summary: Screens UK health ads against claims register, CAP Code and ASA rulings
ADI-0519/preflight.readme_summary: PreFlight extracts explicit and visual claims from video, images and scripts with timestamps and regions. It checks each against the GB claims register, CAP Code and ASA rulings and suggests authorised wording. Dockerized Python service; uses Meta AI vision and language models.

LazyCodeer/farfromdesk.summary: Control Mac coding sessions, apps and posts from WhatsApp or Telegram
LazyCodeer/farfromdesk.readme_summary: FarFromDesk is a local desktop app linking macOS, Windows and Linux to WhatsApp and Telegram for remote coding. Runs sessions, Mac apps and social posts from chat. Built for Meta hackathon with on-device execution and messaging bridge.

richardkaufmann/converse.summary: One UI to run Muse, Claude and Codex coding sessions across many machines
richardkaufmann/converse.readme_summary: Converse orchestrates simultaneous Muse, Claude Code and Codex sessions across Mac, Linux and Windows with agents and shared UI. Native app built with Swift and .NET with multi-system orchestration. Supports Meta Muse via sign-in plus Muse Spark API agents and voice.

jorgeress/timo.summary: Errand agent that blocks payments unless details trace to user or ledger
jorgeress/timo.readme_summary: Errand agent with provenance firewall that checks payment fields before money moves. Stack includes agent/gate/guardian/ledger modules with evals and replay UI. Uses Muse models for browsing errands with rule-based verdicts on payee drift.

ApprenticeAIMeta/Hack.summary: Turns one expert glasses recording into hands-free voice-guided training
ApprenticeAIMeta/Hack.readme_summary: Compiles narrated Ray-Ban Meta first-person recording into step procedures with images and warnings. Backend plus web/Android with live runs on glasses. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for procedure compilation and SAM 3.1 for step vision.

NearBond/CounterTalk-AI.summary: Transcribes kirana visits and routes findings to the right FMCG team
NearBond/CounterTalk-AI.readme_summary: Records field sales visits, transcribes Hindi/English/Hinglish/Marathi with diarization and quote-grounded findings. Dockerized backend + web app with Railway demo. Uses Muse models for transcription, extraction and team routing.

DiggityDooo/FusionStudio.summary: Windows 3D workspace preserving scene fidelity across modeling tools
DiggityDooo/FusionStudio.readme_summary: Windows desktop app for modeling, sculpting, clothing and rendering with shared scene and history. Preserves Blender scenes and DAZ DSON imports with explicit fidelity. Uses local model chat and authenticated MCP for assistance.

treksis/Shotprint.summary: Marketplace of agent-runnable video templates with timing and shots
treksis/Shotprint.readme_summary: Marketplace where templates define timing, framing, camera, light and sound with fill recipes. Package lets any agent remake spots with its own image/video models. Built with Muse Code, live demo at shotprint.dev.

lucky-toast/AllTheWorld_Muse.summary: Browser game that generates new playable systems from typed wishes
lucky-toast/AllTheWorld_Muse.readme_summary: 2D top-down Canvas game where planner splits wishes and designer writes AssemblyScript manifests. Auto pipeline and sandbox approve without human review. Uses Muse API planner/designer prompts with Vitest fixtures.

AkshayHarti/voice-idv-bmad.summary: Voice-led ID verification with spoken framing help and verdicts
AkshayHarti/voice-idv-bmad.readme_summary: Voice-first KYC agent guiding document capture, challenge frames, selfie and verdict by voice. Cloudflare Workers app with synthetic fixtures, no real PII. Uses Muse voice models for instructions, auto-capture and evidence.

amrevr/lab-bench.summary: Watches hands-on procedures on video and flags missed steps live
amrevr/lab-bench.readme_summary: Learns procedure from text plus expert video, then tracks novice video in 3s windows. Ticks steps, asks clarifications and flags order or ingredient errors. Evaluated on CaptainCook4D recipes with timed annotations.

hord-brayden/aitl-meta-Hackathon.summary: ESP32 touchscreen paired to Muse that recodes for new jobs in seconds
hord-brayden/aitl-meta-Hackathon.readme_summary: Musecorder ESP32 touchscreen pairs with phone Muse app to install JSON applets without reflash. Gadget firmware plus bridge/tools with encrypted session. Uses Meta Muse cloud for natural-language applet generation.

dronovationaustralia/lumina-precinct-age.summary: Screens Sydney station precincts in plain English from NSW open data
dronovationaustralia/lumina-precinct-age.readme_summary: Answers feasibility questions for 185 Sydney station precincts with computed, checked figures on map. Next.js app with data/db, evals and infra for traceable metrics. Uses Muse models for NL queries over NSW open data.

salahnbilii-arch/sentinel-scan-and-seal.summary: Autonomous code security scan with one-click patches and signed verification
salahnbilii-arch/sentinel-scan-and-seal.readme_summary: Paste code for deterministic 12-rule scan with patches, multilingual AI explanations, one-click fix and re-scan. Adds signed verification artifacts, naive baseline benchmark, public repo scan and DevOps healer. Uses Meta AI for explanations.

tymzar/harbor.summary: Chrome side panel that reshapes pages to your reading preferences
tymzar/harbor.readme_summary: Chrome side-panel where Muse Spark proposes accessible layouts from user rules, with preview before Keep. Persists preferences per site type and uses on-device model to learn ordering. Built with extension frontend plus proxy backend.

Newen95/pollicount.summary: Counts pollinator flower visits from phone video for citizen science
Newen95/pollicount.readme_summary: Tracks insects and flowers with SAM 3.1 via Meta Model API, classifies tracks with Muse Spark / Open / Glimmer, counts 0.3s visits. Exports FIT Count JSON/CSV. Python pipeline deployed on Modal with web UI.

JJukic/AssemblyPilot_Meta_Hackathon.summary: Mixed-reality guide that verifies physical assembly steps via camera
JJukic/AssemblyPilot_Meta_Hackathon.readme_summary: Step-by-step assembly guidance in browser and HoloLens 2 WebXR that checks camera images with Meta-hosted models. Python backend plus Node frontend, runs locally. Includes CI, docs and demo for physical builds.

RatChakraborty/MetaGlobalAIDeveloperHack.summary: Agentic failure diagnosis for underwater robots with simulated proof
RatChakraborty/MetaGlobalAIDeveloperHack.readme_summary: Planar AUV simulator plus numerical diagnosis, experiment planning and bounded controller revisions with auditable evidence and Three.js replay. Uses Meta Muse tool activity for agentic investigation. Simulated results only.

manikantpandey/shelf-to-shop.summary: Turns a shelf video with spoken prices into an order-taking shop
manikantpandey/shelf-to-shop.readme_summary: Converts under-a-minute shelf video and spoken prices into mobile shop page with WhatsApp orders, Meta catalog CSV and clean product photos. Human verifies prices, system asks when unsure. Live demo from real kirana shop.

jorgedoiany/verifiable-archive-indexer.summary: Indexes Spanish video with evidence-linked claims for archivists
jorgedoiany/verifiable-archive-indexer.readme_summary: Extracts metadata claims from Spanish video where each claim carries transcript quotes and time ranges. Runs independent checks, defers unconfirmed claims for human review and reports accuracy. Python app with docs and tests.

ooiyeefei/noren.summary: Bilingual Nagasaki map sharing local places and owner stories
ooiyeefei/noren.readme_summary: Japanese/English map of 3,612 Nagasaki places from OpenStreetMap and Overture with quoted public posts and consent-approved owner stories. No ratings, no indexing. Open-source MVP live at noren.yooi.me.

hrodge107/MeetMita.summary: Turns PDFs and notes into anime lesson with 3D companion
hrodge107/MeetMita.readme_summary: Uploads PDF or note photos to generate interactive anime presentation guided by 3D companion Mita with dialogue and visuals. Full-stack with backend agent pipeline and web frontend. ElevenLabs only for demo narration.

yirong-ding/city-investigator.summary: Investigates street issues using city records, sensors and photos
yirong-ding/city-investigator.readme_summary: Photos of 9 street problem types trigger streamed investigation over permits, records and flood sensors with map-timeline evidence links. Muse Spark with SAM 3.1 re-checks, claim checker validates output. 126 tests pass.

eperez28/ttaku.summary: Learn Japanese speaking by pausing anime lines and repeating them aloud
eperez28/ttaku.readme_summary: Browser extension that pauses anime after each line, shows romaji, and listens until you speak it to resume playback. Collects phrases in a word bank for review. Uses speech recognition with anime video subtitles.

chickendavefifteen/Profiles.summary: Agentic browser workspace with isolated worlds and swappable AI cores
chickendavefifteen/Profiles.readme_summary: Tauri 2 desktop app providing A/B/X sandboxed browser workspaces with comfort modes. Swappable Pi/Muse/Grok/Hermes agent core with BYO key or local models. Built for agency and accessibility.

daveinturkey15-byte/Profiles.summary: Agentic browser workspace with isolated worlds and swappable AI cores
daveinturkey15-byte/Profiles.readme_summary: Tauri 2 desktop app providing A/B/X sandboxed browser workspaces with comfort modes. Swappable Pi/Muse/Grok/Hermes agent core with BYO key or local models. Mirror of Profiles indie build.

RbertKo/trailhead.summary: Curiosity-led learning companion that maps and quizzes what you explored
RbertKo/trailhead.readme_summary: Follows free exploration, then draws a knowledge map, checks recall, and fills only missing prerequisites. Dockerized Next.js app with supporting lib/components. Built with Muse Spark and SAM 3.1.

saimeda32/maanas-witness.summary: Second brain for what you see to dispute rental and damage charges
saimeda32/maanas-witness.readme_summary: Walk around car/apartment with glasses or phone to record pick-up and return video for proof. Server + mobile + web stack with video memory and dispute evidence. Uses Muse Spark and SAM 3.1.

alex-cova/Penumbra.summary: Fast native macOS code editor with built-in Muse coding agent
alex-cova/Penumbra.readme_summary: Umbra is a fast macOS editor with coding agent; Penumbra is the AppKit text engine underneath. Talks to api.meta.ai with Muse models via API key. Swift package with GPU-efficient editing.

Prashant-thakur77/partsmith.summary: Photo of broken part to measured printable 3D replacement
Prashant-thakur77/partsmith.readme_summary: Uses laptop screen as ruler with SAM 3.1 for measurement and Muse Spark to write CadQuery models. Deterministic verifier checks what passes. Next.js 15 + Python registry over REST and MCP.

sanggusti/disaster-mitigation-bench.summary: Benchmarks LLMs as drone navigators in simulated disaster worlds
sanggusti/disaster-mitigation-bench.readme_summary: Gazebo-based 3D disaster sim with ReAct single and 2-drone missions over ArduPilot tools. Inspect-ai harness tracks rescue and safety metrics. Uses Baseten, Modal, and SAM 3.1 perception.

nxtkim-1/labspotter-public.summary: Timestamped lab observation log with video action suggestions
nxtkim-1/labspotter-public.readme_summary: Web app combining short-video suggestions, written guides, notes, and exportable saved sessions. Implements accounts and session recovery. Powered by Meta V-JEPA 2 with speech transcription.

jdshaolinstar/CarMaCar.summary: Turns traffic cameras into live parking map to route LA drivers
jdshaolinstar/CarMaCar.readme_summary: Simulator renders camera frames that SAM 3.1 segments into live parking occupancy without ground truth. Muse Spark writes and tests routing playbooks. TypeScript monorepo with browser city testbed.

daveancheta/Fudge.summary: Windows focus island that structures tasks and nudges you back on track
daveancheta/Fudge.readme_summary: Fudge is a Windows desktop focus companion with an always-on-top island for tasks and opt-in focus sessions. Built with Next.js and desktop shell, it turns tasks into short plans and detects clear distraction signals. Uses Muse models for planning and distraction check-ins.

walsoup/teardown.summary: Turns disassembly video into step-by-step visual repair guide with labeled parts
walsoup/teardown.readme_summary: Teardown ingests repair videos with ffmpeg, transcribes audio in 30s windows via Muse Voice Transcribe, then plans anchored steps with Muse Spark. Steps are mechanically verified against transcript quotes. Outputs clean keyframes with outlined parts in iFixit style.

hyberion/socialStory.summary: Creates personalized illustrated Social Stories to help autistic kids preview events
hyberion/socialStory.readme_summary: socialStory lets parents describe their child and upcoming event to generate an illustrated story following Carol Gray criteria. Parents approve every word; kids read on a calm tablet app with read-along and Who's Who. Uses Muse models for safe personalized storytelling.

Imrankhadeer/Ternline.summary: Security intelligence platform correlating microservice events and auto-investigating threats
Imrankhadeer/Ternline.readme_summary: Ternline bridges sub-ms deterministic detection Fast Track with AI Deep Track investigations, active defense and declarative rules. Includes live web console, docs and InstaTern test app. Uses Meta Muse models for evidence-grounded investigation and rule authoring.

WhaSukGO/researchsquad.summary: Configurable multi-agent research team with reviews and protected evaluation harness
WhaSukGO/researchsquad.readme_summary: ResearchSquad provides reusable Agent with JSON role definitions, host-managed work and independent reviews. LeNet branch replays 1988 Bell Labs discovery via Muse Spark agents with deterministic training ledger. Uses Meta Model API via MetaProvider and sandbox judging.

iamdrewfortini/Stretto.summary: Local time tracker that finds lost time and suggests ranked fixes via voice agent
iamdrewfortini/Stretto.readme_summary: Stretto records activity locally to detect detours, ping-pong, waiting and repeats. Muse models turn findings into ranked time-saving changes via Humanflow voice agent backend. Stack spans web app, server, device agent and installers.

bjorndspark/haxrok.summary: Schematic debugger that ranks root-cause faults from KiCad netlists and symptoms
bjorndspark/haxrok.readme_summary: Haxrok takes a KiCad netlist plus bench symptom to rank root-cause hypotheses with evidence labels. Same pipeline runs pre-fab reviews, wiring checks and ngspice simulations. Built for Meta hackathon with Muse models for reasoning and datasheet grounding.

Sisuthros/support-bot-rescue.summary: Converts refund policies into sealed tests to catch and fix support bot violations
Sisuthros/support-bot-rescue.readme_summary: Give it a refund policy and it compiles checkable rules, generates tests, seals a holdout, then tests the bot and rewrites its prompt. No LLM grades the bot; counts are recomputable. Uses Meta models as target, fixer and attacker with offline pytest verify.

teawa-b/SamWORLD.summary: Turns floor plans and photos into explorable 3D homes for browser and Quest WebXR
teawa-b/SamWORLD.readme_summary: WalkIn converts listing floor plans, photos and video into labelled 3D homes with dollhouse and 1:1 room mode. Built with Three.js, Immersive Web SDK, Fastify and job runner. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image for layout.

DareDev256/real-one.summary: Turns phone song takes into vertical music videos where only the world is AI-made
DareDev256/real-one.readme_summary: Real One keeps the filmed artist real via SAM 3.1 segmentation while Muse Image builds per-section worlds cut on downbeats. Muse Wonder directs take selection, lyric sync and hand-tracked effects. Outputs vertical video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.

AlanJLJ2202/Agentztein.summary: Self-evolving Muse agent with measurable, testable and reversible improvements
AlanJLJ2202/Agentztein.readme_summary: Agentztein is an experimental self-evolving agent that builds, tests and refines its own capabilities. It uses deterministic evaluation, regression detection and reversible updates via TypeScript monorepo with api, apps and packages. Powered by Meta Muse models for autonomous improvement reasoning.

krishivgupta1429-cell/prysm-hackathon.summary: Scores Instagram Reels on 10 factors and gives creators plain-language fixes
krishivgupta1429-cell/prysm-hackathon.readme_summary: Prysm analyzes short-form video on hook, retention, audio, trend alignment and 6 other parameters with fixes. React+Vite frontend uploads to FastAPI backend with Redis queue worker for analysis. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 replacing Claude.

ilovetensor/TrustPCB.summary: Open-source AI reviewer that catches KiCad board errors before manufacturing
ilovetensor/TrustPCB.readme_summary: TrustPCB reviews KiCad boards with real checks and simulations showing evidence for every claim. Web frontend with checks engine and docs for reproducible hardware review. Built on Meta Muse Spark for analysis and explanations.

sergioangulo/cognitive.summary: Cognitive platform linking agent conclusions to auditable evidence graph
sergioangulo/cognitive.readme_summary: SDA backend stores problems, hypotheses, experiments and judge decisions in append-only SHA-256 event log. 3D Knowledge Galaxy visualizes nodes and references from the log. Uses AI agents for investigation with persistent knowledge.

mitzcore/praxion.summary: Muse agent that learns machines, writes controllers and self-repairs
mitzcore/praxion.readme_summary: Praxion runs safe experiments to auto-write Python controllers, proves them in sealed sandbox, then deploys under safety layer. Python backend with frontend, simulator and TCLab heater tests. Uses muse-spark-1.3 via Meta Model API for control synthesis.

AtlasRoX/TribosAI.summary: Research assistant for engineering and science with anti-hallucination checks
AtlasRoX/TribosAI.readme_summary: Tribos is a research partner that grounds answers in sources to reduce hallucination. FastAPI backend with Next.js frontend, Python 3.12 and docs site. Built on Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for synthesis and verification.

ravishendre7/TradeUSA.summary: AI trading platform scanning 1100 US stocks with 22 momentum patterns
ravishendre7/TradeUSA.readme_summary: TradeUSA combines 22-pattern scanner, momentum detection, AI trade director and paper brokerage across 5 tiers. Full-stack with backend, frontend, Caddy and multi-tenant isolation. Uses Meta Model API Muse as agentic reasoning core.

kewcoder/slaver.summary: Marketplace to buy source-code apps once and customize in plain language
kewcoder/slaver.readme_summary: Slaver lets owners buy apps, own code, host on Fly.io and customize via chat with staging preview. Rust backend with review and customize modules plus HitPay payments. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for app review and code rewriting.

subhajitkp007/MusePilot.summary: Zero-coordinate GUI agent for desktop and mobile with visual verification
subhajitkp007/MusePilot.readme_summary: MusePilot automates desktop, ADB mobile fleets and canvas apps without coordinates using visual grounding. Invariant architecture with verifier and Docker setup. Uses SAM 3.1 for grounding, Muse Spark and Voice Transcribe.

microwaves22/HomeSync.summary: Family organizer for chores, homework, points, rewards and shared calendar
microwaves22/HomeSync.readme_summary: HomeSync manages chores, homework, points, rewards and shared calendar for families. Backend with Docker and API docs plus Flutter frontend. Meta AI integration for family assistance.

MarcoZuno/Retina.summary: Rewrites a video's first 10-15 seconds and verifies the fix before publishing
MarcoZuno/Retina.readme_summary: Retina generates a watchable replacement opening for creator videos using a rule engine plus verification loop around Meta models. It estimates current-video retention with calibration and renders storyboards via Muse Image. Stack includes Docker deploy with Muse Spark Open integration.

hollisorg/iv-studio.summary: Desktop studio for making AI films with recurring actors on local ComfyUI
hollisorg/iv-studio.readme_summary: IV Studio is a free Electron desktop app for Infinite Variance filmmaking with MiniMax H3 video via local ComfyUI. It manages actors, scenes and generation workflows on Windows, Mac and Linux. Architecture is Electron + Vite with local model execution.

danielAsaboro/harmonia-meta.summary: Async social media content agent that turns plain language into approved posts
danielAsaboro/harmonia-meta.readme_summary: Harmonia is a multi-agent system for startup content: Nimi, Ryan, Temi, Noni and Dara handle evidence, strategy, briefs and artifacts. It uses durable workspace context, web dashboard and Telegram Bot API with approval flow. Runs on Docker, Firestore and cloud builds.

Vroom-Analytics-123/agent-boundary-confo.summary: Local-first tester that checks an agent's enforced limits match stated limits
Vroom-Analytics-123/agent-boundary-confo.readme_summary: Agent Boundary Conformance implements Boundary Measurement to test agent policies item by item like a building inspector. It provides Python tooling, MCP stdio server and CI replication docs. Designed for developers to verify agent boundaries locally.

jairotft/somnigram-knowledge.summary: Shared long-term memory graph that lets any agent recall files and chats
jairotft/somnigram-knowledge.readme_summary: Somnigram ingests files and conversations with Muse Spark extraction and embeddings, then consolidates via sleep-time deduplication and graph linking. Recall uses hybrid vector plus full-text with graph expansion via 6 MCP tools. Stack includes web graph UI and live events.

itsGurdevSingh/buildSense.summary: AI-assisted architecture design with cost and capacity planning estimates
itsGurdevSingh/buildSense.readme_summary: BuildSense provides architecture design, workload estimation and infra cost optimization via an agentic loop on Muse Spark through Meta Model API. Built as Node monorepo with web app, packages and Postgres via Docker. Developed with Muse Code in hackathon window.

KedarPanchal/Autonomous-Fly-Actuated-Res.summary: Search-and-rescue drone flown by a spiking fly-brain model in ROS 2
KedarPanchal/Autonomous-Fly-Actuated-Res.readme_summary: X3 multirotor runs coverage search at 15m using Drosophila hemibrain spiking model with 5,573 neurons for looming escape. Simulation runs in Gazebo via ROS 2 with mission layer and MCP server for agent control. Includes Goal JSON interface and Twist output.

Richb2021/mosaic.summary: Turns teacher-reviewed material into personalized games, stories and practice
Richb2021/mosaic.readme_summary: Mosaic converts reviewed teacher uploads into age-personalized games, cartoons, podcasts and RPG via Muse Wonder text and Muse Image pictures. Every fact traces to a reviewed source. Stack is Cloudflare, Drizzle DB with live app and no-sign-in game library.

Ashleyrfj2/autonomous-discovery-lab.summary: AI research system that proposes hypotheses and keeps auditable verification
Ashleyrfj2/autonomous-discovery-lab.readme_summary: Autonomous Discovery Lab runs a research-session controller that investigates questions and challenges reasoning with evidence tracking. Supports live Meta API inference and offline scripted rehearsal with same controller. Python runtime with configs, scripts and tests.

ryuchvt/motifold.summary: Turns sung or MIDI sketches into editable orchestral scores for DAWs
ryuchvt/motifold.readme_summary: Motifold transcribes humming, singing or MIDI into readable scores and arranges, expands or recomposes with user constraints. Exports MIDI and MusicXML for DAW use. Web app deployed on Cloudflare Workers using Muse Spark.

atikur/SparkBench.summary: AI-planned ESP32 firmware verified by iPhone camera against approved plan
atikur/SparkBench.readme_summary: SparkBench lets users describe ESP32 behavior, review a Muse Spark plan, then run it on the bench. Local code builds firmware for LED/OLED hardware while a fixed camera records output. It compares measured behavior to the plan using SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice, with dashboard and repair workflow.

lelouchzr/sentinel.summary: Terminal workspace to investigate logs, inspect evidence, and export reports
lelouchzr/sentinel.readme_summary: Sentinel is an interactive terminal for auth, app and file investigations. It imports CSV/JSONL, detects signals, runs evidence searches via local MCP subprocess, and exports reports. Live AI uses Meta Model API; manual mode works offline with no DB or GPU.

Tugduoff/moment-launcher.summary: Calm Android launcher with a companion that adapts to the current moment
Tugduoff/moment-launcher.readme_summary: Moment is a solo-built Android home screen replacement with one living companion. It shows contextual proposals and hides other apps using Kotlin and Gradle. It uses Muse Spark for reasoning, Muse Image for visuals, and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta Model API.

ciscojrai/AddyFresh.summary: 3D spatial copilot with globe, orbital navigation, and voice across devices
ciscojrai/AddyFresh.readme_summary: FreshAddy is an action-first spatial copilot that controls a real-time 3D particle globe. It uses Muse tool-calling for fly-to, radar and alerts across phone, tablet and TV. Stack is HTML/JS with Three.js globe and local Kokoro voice pipeline plus Meta AI inference.

akaliutau/algomini.summary: Discovers custom data compression algorithms and builds Rust plugins
akaliutau/algomini.readme_summary: Algomini automates discovery of novel compression algorithms tailored to user data. It searches and evaluates codecs, then emits Rust plugins with lab experiments and datasets. Research uses Muse Spark 1.3 for algorithm generation, with GitHub Actions cloud runs.

junjunjunbong/DeskTwin.summary: Desk photo becomes an editable 3D twin for device mapping and fixes
junjunjunbong/DeskTwin.readme_summary: DeskTwin converts a desk photo into an editable 3D twin to record connections and troubleshoot. Built with TypeScript, React 19 and Three.js, it segments devices with SAM 3.1. It uses Muse Spark structured output for mapping and conversational help via Meta AI.

shotaros2/aicl.summary: Token-efficient unambiguous language and spec for agent-to-agent messages
shotaros2/aicl.readme_summary: AICL defines a common S-expression language for AI agents to remove ambiguity and save tokens. It ships spec plus zero-dependency reference implementation in v0.1.0. Includes machine-checkable request-response semantics, Japanese docs, and agent skill files.

easonluo727/Student-Health-Agent.summary: Health insurance assistant tracing costs to policy pages and doctor rates
easonluo727/Student-Health-Agent.readme_summary: TallyHealth is an LA health-insurance agent that prices in-network doctors at negotiated rates. It geocodes 68k NPPES doctors and cites policy pages for every cost. Built on configurable Muse models with automatic fallback, using Python agent plus web frontend.

pranayjoshi/armed-metaAI-hackathon.summary: Desk robot arm that anticipates needs from context, voice, and muscle
pranayjoshi/armed-metaAI-hackathon.readme_summary: Armed is a SO-101 desk arm that predicts user needs from time, room state, voice and forearm EMG. It acts, speaks, or confirms with others using four Meta models where each fits. Stack includes Python, web console, desktop app, and hardware configs.

henrysun27/Digikeys.summary: Webcam turns desk taps into piano and drum sounds in the browser
henrysun27/Digikeys.readme_summary: Digikeys turns any desk into an instrument by tracking hands via webcam and mapping taps to sounds. It runs as Vite TypeScript frontend with Node API server and Tone.js samples. Optional Meta Model API key enables AI features; core play works without it.

paulicav/cue.summary: Searches curated YouTube transcripts to play the exact video moment answering a question
paulicav/cue.readme_summary: Cue indexes admin-uploaded YouTube transcripts into passages with SQLite and serves answers via FastAPI plus React/Vite frontend. It splits SRT/VTT/SBV files, retrieves relevant moments, and uses the Meta Model API to generate short answers with creator and timestamps.

NurdauletYN/ive-meta-hackathon.summary: Turns app ideas into verified Flutter apps ready to ship to TestFlight
NurdauletYN/ive-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Rocket is a model-agnostic harness that generates Flutter apps from a locked design kit with auth, paywall and store metadata. Built with Flutter template and studio UI, it uses Muse Spark and other models as interchangeable pilots with verification gates.

dimasna/storeel.summary: Turns novel chapters into narrated vertical reels with captions and drawn characters
dimasna/storeel.readme_summary: Storeel Studio pairs a teleprompter workflow with a chat editing agent using FastAPI backend and web frontend on Modal/Docker. It uses Meta Model API with Muse Spark for scripts and Muse Image for consistent characters plus word-level captions.

Michael-L-i-1/FleetLLM.summary: Coordinates local inference and multi-agent workflows on constrained hardware
Michael-L-i-1/FleetLLM.readme_summary: FleetLLM schedules multiple agents through one local model with shared context and memory-aware scheduling on Apple Metal, CPU and Raspberry Pi. It runs Muse Glimmer-30B Q2_K locally, with FleetPi terminal agent and GPQA and multi-agent eval harnesses.

geekayjahan/followthrough.summary: Tracks WhatsApp-run deals and drafts owner-approved follow-ups before they go cold
geekayjahan/followthrough.readme_summary: Followthrough monitors open leads, samples, quotes and invoices across WhatsApp, email and sheets. Built with WhatsApp Cloud API, it uses Muse Spark Open for drafting in owner voice and Muse Voice Transcribe for audio notes.

chewonc/save-bell.summary: Checks security advisories against connected GitHub repos to judge real impact
chewonc/save-bell.readme_summary: SaveBell ingests advisories, vuln DBs and news, fact-checks reports, then investigates connected repos to file and line. Built with Next.js and Vercel, it notifies users and proposes fixes with cited evidence and uncertainty.

keewillidevnet/dialed-in.summary: Measures frequency bias in Glimmer-30B and steers it with a one-knob adapter
keewillidevnet/dialed-in.readme_summary: Dialed In injects controlled waves into Muse Glimmer-30B to measure spectral response, trains an adapter reducing slope 24%, and localizes effect to one matrix. Muse Spark and Wonder on Meta Model API proposed experiments with web demo.

KarenAlexa09/StepSight.summary: Overlays camera guidance to catch step-by-step assembly mistakes as they happen
KarenAlexa09/StepSight.readme_summary: StepSight is a bilingual EN/ES web app that watches manual assembly via phone camera and flags wrong parts. It combines SAM 3.1 vision plus Muse Spark 1.3 reasoning with Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Image for guidance.

Prabodh1231/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Desktop research writer that drafts only from your sources with checked citations
Prabodh1231/meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Groundwork is a desktop app for writing from papers, notes, scans and web pages with Python backend and desktop frontend. It uses Muse Spark to draft strictly from the user library and verifies each citation against source quotes.

ManuelSiju/kannaku.summary: Gives red-yellow-green verdicts on insurance, loans and money offers in India
ManuelSiju/kannaku.readme_summary: Kanakku is a money adviser where a council of specialists reviews financial offers in plain language with questions to ask. Built with app plus server stack, it uses Meta Muse Spark for reasoning while all numbers are computed by code.

aleynacatak/doppel.summary: Records design tasks once and replays them locally in Figma, Photoshop and InDesign.
aleynacatak/doppel.readme_summary: Electron desktop app with shadcn UI renderer, Figma plugin, and Cloudflare Worker for demo AI access. Turns a natural-language task into a reusable local routine that reruns with no AI calls. Uses Meta models to generate routines and connect flows across apps.

mlvein/hyperself.summary: Private on-device archive that unifies documents, journals and photos into life insights.
mlvein/hyperself.readme_summary: Local-first web app with encrypted on-device store, parsers and analyzers for documents and photos. Surfaces Paths only when knowledge is ready, with no account or server. Uses optional on-device Llama 3.2 via Ollama for deep synthesis.

MohammadYehya/replay-board.summary: Rebuilds lecture whiteboard writing stroke-by-stroke in sync with the original voice.
MohammadYehya/replay-board.readme_summary: Uploads recorded lectures and renders a clean board beside the untouched video synced to voice. Python backend with web frontend for stroke extraction and alignment. Uses Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice Transcribe and MMS.

SaikumarBollam/FolioShield.summary: Turns chargeback notices and folios into verified bank-ready dispute packets for hotels.
SaikumarBollam/FolioShield.readme_summary: Document-first FastAPI workflow that extracts facts from notices and folios without PMS integration. Adds evidence collection, review, approval and packet generation with enterprise readiness. Uses Llama 3.3 and Llama 3.2 Vision for extraction and verification.

Jasdish-Singh/Exhumed.summary: Converts claim photos into an editable inventory and gathers supporting policy evidence.
Jasdish-Singh/Exhumed.readme_summary: FastAPI with JSON persistence, Pillow, ReportLab and vanilla JS for insurance claim triage. Builds inventory, finds evidence, then asks for unresolved facts. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe via Meta client.

samsonjeff/mume-app.summary: Voice-first assistant that drafts Page inbox replies and sends only after confirmation.
samsonjeff/mume-app.readme_summary: React Native Expo frontend with Node Express backend, Supabase pgvector and Meta Graph API v21. Syncs Facebook Page Messenger and drafts context-aware replies with catalog pricing. Uses Muse Spark, Muse Voice and Muse Image with human-in-loop.

Killkanacode/sherlog.summary: Autonomous on-call engineer that detects incidents, fixes root cause and verifies recovery.
Killkanacode/sherlog.readme_summary: Platform API with agent, fixer, chaos, benchmark and observability services via Docker Compose. Detects failures, diagnoses with evidence, takes safe actions and opens PRs. Uses live Meta models for diagnosis and Muse Code for fixes.

zombico/Maison3D.summary: Designs furnished rooms from voice chat in browser or Meta Quest VR at true scale.
zombico/Maison3D.readme_summary: Zero-dependency Node server serving browser and Quest VR room designer with 736 mojulo furniture models. Conversational layout from text and voice input. Uses Meta Model API for room design and placement.
