nkm1020/scene.summary: Turns group chat into a 3D tabletop performance with clay figures and friend voices.
nkm1020/scene.readme_summary: Next.js web app with 3D table stage, figure pipeline and chat backend. Creates user figure and voice once, then performs messages. Uses Muse Image, SAM 3.1, SAM 3D, Spark director and Voice Transcribe.

Jamerrred/Legible.summary: Publishes verified business facts as a page AI shopping agents can read and act on.
Jamerrred/Legible.readme_summary: Crawls small-business site, detects gaps, asks owner, then publishes agent-readable page with edge deployment. Includes frozen Errand consumer agent and bench harness. Uses Meta models for extraction and agent task evaluation.

vamsivoleti25/NearHand.summary: Auto-schedules small-business shifts and fills gaps with nearby part-timers
vamsivoleti25/NearHand.readme_summary: Scheduling app for cafes and shops that builds the cheapest compliant week from plain-English rules. An AI agent offers open shifts to own staff then nearby part-timers via phone. Built with Streamlit/Python and Meta Muse models during the hackathon.

aritraghose/dueboard.summary: Unified due board for tasks and focus with AI friend Tibo that acts and remembers
aritraghose/dueboard.readme_summary: Productivity board for tasks, habits, goals, notes and focus sessions shared via Live and profiles. TiboAgent edits the board, holds long-term memory, check-ins and Ask pages. Built with TanStack Start, Effect RPC, Cloudflare, Neon Postgres and Muse Spark.

Keshav-kh/tirekick.summary: WhatsApp buyer's agent that verifies used cars by video before negotiating
Keshav-kh/tirekick.readme_summary: WhatsApp agent where sellers film a proof video checked by Muse Spark vision plus VIN via NHTSA. Only verified cars proceed to AI negotiation with buyer approval. Built in Python for first-time Marketplace buyers.

dokutoshi/zydah.summary: Judge-panel agent evaluator using deterministic Dempster-Shafer belief fusion
dokutoshi/zydah.readme_summary: Evaluation library replacing LLM-as-judge with fused judge panel using Dempster, Yager and Smets TBM rules. Conflict mass routes hard cases to LLM reasoner. Closed-world demo, deterministic fusion first.

Yosadaq/Foresight.summary: iOS app that audits factory inventory with vision, OCR and voice investigation
Yosadaq/Foresight.readme_summary: Native iOS inventory control app that finds discrepancies, investigates causes and recommends fixes. Combines computer vision, OCR, ERP data and voice-guided agents. Uses Meta Muse models for reasoning.

avtak/vogi.summary: German coach for writing and speaking with handwriting red-pen and voice practice
avtak/vogi.readme_summary: German learning coach on Meta Muse models with try-first corrections, red-pen on handwriting images and hands-free speaking. Dockerized app on port 7860. Built for the Meta hackathon.

RgtArRr/velohud.summary: Browser editor that syncs FIT telemetry onto ride videos and renders locally
RgtArRr/velohud.readme_summary: Web editor syncing FIT/GPX/TCX telemetry with MP4 clips, styling widgets on 19 templates and rendering locally via WebCodecs+Canvas. Muse Spark powers prompt-to-template studio constrained to available data.

inmert/Apollo.summary: Remote DJI Matrice 210 operation over Wi-Fi with Jetson Orin and web console
inmert/Apollo.readme_summary: Two-Orin system operating M210 V1 over Wi-Fi using DJI OSDK 3.9, with RC Orin web server for telemetry, video and commands. Includes CLI tools, findings log and Unreal tank-mission sim with Muse client.

danolu/cloom-copilot.summary: Voice and chat copilot that runs hotel operations, billing and staff tasks
danolu/cloom-copilot.readme_summary: Property operations copilot handling digests, folios, turnovers and approvals by voice notes, calls and chat. Powered by Muse Spark, Voice Transcribe and Wonder via Meta Model API. Built with Next.js and Muse Code.

Jay-2212/raise-dead.summary: Pixel-art graveyard game where you resurrect dead apps through rituals
Jay-2212/raise-dead.readme_summary: Moonlit pixel-art exploration game with 40 tombstones and F-key resurrection rituals bringing apps back in overlays. Uses Muse Spark live chat plus offline branching trees. Built with Kiro CLI during hackathon.

chiraghs/SceneCast.summary: Intent-based in-scene ad placement that keeps story identical per viewer
chiraghs/SceneCast.readme_summary: AdVision places contextual ads into video scenes without changing story or timing. Next.js frontend with Meta client adapter calling Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, Muse Image and SAM 3.1 for segmentation with Baseten fallback.

AmanurRahman101/mededge-ai.summary: Converts paper labs and voice notes into verified HL7 FHIR bundles
AmanurRahman101/mededge-ai.readme_summary: Ingests scans and dictated notes, anonymizes before inference, then validates to FHIR R4 for human approval. Backend pipeline uses SAM 3.1 for document extraction, Muse Spark for structuring, and Muse Voice for transcription.

ssydyc2/proof-studio.summary: macOS app guiding screenshot to Lean-verified math proof step by step
ssydyc2/proof-studio.readme_summary: Electron app manages TeX statement, Lean stub, and proof files with compile checks via pdflatex and lake env lean. Uses Muse models to draft formal statements and proofs against shared Mathlib build.

lulitaxu/auditcanvas.summary: Deterministic web scanner with AI explanation and remediation review
lulitaxu/auditcanvas.readme_summary: Next.js app runs nine-group deterministic scanner storing redacted evidence, then Muse Spark explains and re-checks findings. Includes seeded vulnerable demo target and saved real scan reports.

remiyelin/HelpChoreAI.summary: Checks if red blood cell changes are real, noise, or bad recordings
remiyelin/HelpChoreAI.readme_summary: Longitudinal tracking for VPS13A research validates flow-corrected cell measurements before trusting change. Research-only pipeline with video evidence, logs, and preregistration for scientific verification.

WeirdCatAFK/nsamble.summary: Natural-language agent that designs parametric 3D-printable models
WeirdCatAFK/nsamble.readme_summary: Service gives an AI agent tools to generate parametric manufacturing prototypes and proof-of-concepts. Dockerized Node service with Prisma, containers, and model config for 3D printer compatible output.

KrishayR/pipsclassroom.summary: Agent classroom where 2048 lessons must prove gains on new boards
KrishayR/pipsclassroom.readme_summary: Three Muse-powered students play 2048, receive teacher and peer lessons, and keep only verified helpful notes. Node server with inspectable memory ties lessons to source moves and solo exam comparisons.

ivyhue-alt/valerius.summary: Independent supervisor holding risky WhatsApp agent actions for approval
ivyhue-alt/valerius.readme_summary: Shift Lead intercepts refunds and account changes for owner approval via signed link; Family mode triages forwarded scams. Python service on Meta Model API with WhatsApp integration, dashboard, and signed approvals.

artiom-varvarenko/lightwork.summary: Projector plus webcam turns any table into a voice-guided helper
artiom-varvarenko/lightwork.readme_summary: Hold-to-talk mic triggers top-down capture, Muse Wonder scene understanding, and projected step guides on objects. Python system with phone projector, webcam, and hand controls for cooking and assembly tasks.

raphaeldchen/origami-world-model-prior.summary: Generates verified origami fold patterns from plain-English behavior goals
raphaeldchen/origami-world-model-prior.readme_summary: Pipeline maps goals to scoring recipes via Muse Spark, searches generator knobs, and scores with graph-encoder RSSM world model. Verifies snap order and force in simulator then on real paper.

r10xai/muse-inkline.summary: Mac app that reads handwritten paper notes via iPhone camera to drive coding tasks
r10xai/muse-inkline.readme_summary: Mac app where iPhone Continuity Camera watches the desk and sends handwriting to Meta Model API on pen-lift. Muse Code agent then opens apps, edits files and runs commands on the Mac, with replies in-app. Supports typing and speech input.

Lebosstech/cityresolve.summary: Dev sandbox demo for civic issue reporting using fictitious data and unfrozen protocol
Lebosstech/cityresolve.readme_summary: Appears to be an early civic-tech sandbox with app and web frontends, Docker and Render deployment. No README content; description notes fictitious data and non-final protocol. Stack includes app/, web/, Dockerfile and render.yaml.

samshanmukh/waymark.summary: Verifies indoor routes by comparing new photos against taught landmark reference images
samshanmukh/waymark.readme_summary: Turns operator-recorded observations into an evidence-linked topological graph for GPS-denied interiors. Python server with no dependencies serves web UI; Muse Spark Open via Fireworks reads landmarks and signage. Deterministic verifier gates progress on visual support.

liminal-cipher/trace-and-tell.summary: Family photo archive that links evidence to generate questions before context is lost
liminal-cipher/trace-and-tell.readme_summary: Next.js + Supabase evidence-aware archive for old photos, notes and letters with demo walkthrough. Uses Meta inferences for observation and comparison to prompt human-authored questions. Includes implementation docs and audit evidence.

johnnytan5/MuseConcierge.summary: Hotel voice ordering system with dual delivery robots simulated in browser MuJoCo
johnnytan5/MuseConcierge.readme_summary: Muse Spark voice agent takes room-service orders and quotes ETA; Muse Wonder fleet brain assigns one of two MuJoCo robots and replans on failure. SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark verify room and cabin at door. Built on Next.js, Supabase and adapted Concierge dashboard.

agharsallah/lumen.summary: Phone AR assistant that highlights objects and guides hands-free physical tasks
agharsallah/lumen.readme_summary: Android app that points camera at a task, highlights what to touch, gives step guidance and hazard checks via pluggable Skill Packs. Built on Meta AI with Muse Spark reasoning, SAM 3 vision and Voice. Monorepo with apps/, firmware/ and docs/.

mdanyalmalik/active-ide.summary: IDE that explains coding agent changes and maps system while steering many agents
mdanyalmalik/active-ide.readme_summary: Fork of Code-OSS that narrates agent changes, maintains live system map, and supports multi-agent team control. Integrates Muse Code SDK, Muse speech-to-text and MMS TTS. macOS focused with Python tooling and demo video.

Velu2k03/reel-director.summary: Local console turning approved scripts into narrated faceless videos with AI checks
Velu2k03/reel-director.readme_summary: Flask gated workflow: Muse Spark drafts script and director review, pauses for human approval, then generates visuals, voice and video. Uses Muse Wonder revise, Muse Image art, SAM 3.1 check and local MMS TTS. Fails hard on Meta API error.

xiaohei-info/awesome-personal-agent.summary: Self-hosted ledger layer adding initiative and follow-through to existing agent tools
xiaohei-info/awesome-personal-agent.readme_summary: Open-source layer atop harnesses like Hermes, Claude Code and Codex CLI to track tasks, wake on deadlines and handle repeats under approved rules. Model and tool agnostic, docs-focused with no fixed stack. interrupts only for user decisions.

Yantra-lab/yantra-os.summary: Lightweight native app runtime combining web safety with native power without Chromium
Yantra-lab/yantra-os.readme_summary: Three-layer engine using Wasmtime, Skia, Filament for rendering and Meta Yoga 3.1.0 for layout. Built with Muse Wonder and Muse Spark 1.3 assistance. Includes apps, docs and gitingest bundles with YouTube demo.

aybukepamukcu/atria-lens-meta.summary: Smart glasses plus wristband that filter speech and alert deaf users only to what matters.
aybukepamukcu/atria-lens-meta.readme_summary: Atria Lens helps deaf users catch directed speech via ESP32-S3 glasses, iPhone app and haptic band. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for live captions and Muse Spark Open to decide relevance, simplify text and summarize. Backend plus mobile plus firmware with BLE audio pipeline.

hildanonyelum-cell/SalesCrew.summary: AI sales crew that finds leads, writes outreach, calls, books meetings and answers DMs.
hildanonyelum-cell/SalesCrew.readme_summary: SalesCrew is a multi-tenant Next.js app for small businesses like Rise & Eat bakery. It handles prospecting, outreach, voice calling, bookings, WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram inbox, site builder and Meta CAPI. Built with TypeScript and Vercel deployment.

Kaanart/reeltale.summary: Watch episodic video stories or turn a prompt into a branching illustrated narrated tale.
Kaanart/reeltale.readme_summary: ReelTale is a serialized storytelling platform with Expo mobile app and Cloudflare Worker API. Meta models generate branching illustrated narrated stories from user openings. Stack is Expo, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase Postgres with shared schemas.

Satyamkryo/Eclipse-Crew.summary: Multi-agent workspace where AI agents collaborate and execute tasks live together.
Satyamkryo/Eclipse-Crew.readme_summary: Eclipse-Crew is a multi-agentic AI workspace for autonomous collaboration and live execution. Dockerized full-stack app with Next.js components, database and agent orchestration. Uses Muse models for planning and task execution.

NL-Hackerton/Meta-AI-Hackathon.summary: Turns one phone video into six Meta-sized ad videos plus two paused ads for review.
NL-Hackerton/Meta-AI-Hackathon.readme_summary: AdLoom converts a small-business phone clip into sized video ads and paused ads for owner approval. Uses Muse Spark 1.3, SAM 3.1, Muse Image and Muse Voice with Python pipeline. Fixture mode runs end-to-end; live media pipeline unverified.

DixitPatel/cbioportal_plugin.summary: cBioPortal copilot that explains cancer variants with evidence and notebook generation.
DixitPatel/cbioportal_plugin.readme_summary: Onco-Muse adds Ask Muse to cBioPortal patient view with PubMed evidence, OncoTree mapping and AlphaGenome Colab notebooks. Includes variant-effect pipeline with liftover for Genome Nexus. Uses Muse Wonder on cancer study data.

eversamurai/meta-certificate-solver-hc.summary: TLS operator that scans endpoints, fixes broken certs, verifies and auto-rolls back.
eversamurai/meta-certificate-solver-hc.readme_summary: CertAgent scans HTTPS endpoints, diagnoses TLS issues in code and lets Muse Spark decide fixes via tools. Policy gate, backup and verify with auto-rollback, full timeline. Java Maven agent; on-prem option via Muse Glimmer on Ollama.

tatinc23/MAV-Meta-Hackathon.summary: Phone companion that sees screen or camera, hears you and talks back in real time.
tatinc23/MAV-Meta-Hackathon.readme_summary: MAV is an Android live companion for elderly and blind users stuck on phones. Sees screen/camera, hears and speaks in real time. Native Kotlin app with worker/backend, built by Muse Code with Claude Code as build lead using Meta models.

Itz-mehanth/vellam-map.summary: Chennai flood early-warning map built from crowd photos with Tamil voice queries.
Itz-mehanth/vellam-map.readme_summary: Vellam Map crowdsources flood photos for Chennai to verify, measure depth, map and alert by voice in Tamil/English. Built with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark and Muse Voice. Python FastAPI backend, React frontend, eval harness and CI.

brkmehdi/tadasouk.summary: Film products and speak in Darija or French while your storefront builds itself.
brkmehdi/tadasouk.readme_summary: Tadasouk is a PWA for Moroccan merchants: record video, auto cut-out products, set prices by voice. Live at tadasouk.com with demo store. Uses Meta AI vision and speech, Cloudflare, Next.js and OpenNext deployment.

Ahoo-11/lucid-ai.summary: Open-source monitoring that captures AI agent runs and groups failures
Ahoo-11/lucid-ai.readme_summary: Captures prompts, model and tool calls, tokens and cost via OpenTelemetry. Groups failures by cause, uses Muse Spark to explain and draft fixes, and sends fixes to Hermes Agent. Monorepo with apps/packages, Docker and deploy.yaml.

ShivaTeja05/physlens.summary: Turns ordinary video into measured 3D physics and event analysis
ShivaTeja05/physlens.readme_summary: Estimates 3D points, tracks rigid bodies, and detects contact/crush events validated against NHTSA data. Built with SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark plus Muse Voice, MapAnything and MoGe-3. Stack includes backend, gpu_worker, web and benchmarks.

Deep-khatke/Meta-.summary: Browser-based robotics modeling, simulation and control studio
Deep-khatke/Meta-.readme_summary: High-fidelity robotics simulation using MuJoCo 3.17 physics and Three.js visualization with AI control. Includes backend, frontend, models, projects and benchmarks, deployed on AWS EC2. Uses NVIDIA Nemotron via OpenRouter.

fazaliilahica-netizen/KeyboardRepairChec.summary: Tests if AI-fixed web widgets work with keyboard in headless Chrome
fazaliilahica-netizen/KeyboardRepairChec.readme_summary: 7 hand-built cases check Tab reach, focus ring, and Enter behavior in real headless Chrome. Compares broken, hand-fixed, Llama 3.2 and Muse Glimmer 30B repairs. Python scripts, runs folder, and replay demo.

Vachilla64/barnaby.summary: Desktop pet that narrates coding agents and gives VS Code tours
Vachilla64/barnaby.readme_summary: Agents report status to a Windows pet that speaks updates aloud and walks through code in VS Code. Uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API for reasoning and local Phonon TTS for voice. Built with Tauri, Rust, Node and pnpm.

Finraell/ArborPulse.summary: Turns tree video into traceable arborist inspection evidence briefs
Finraell/ArborPulse.readme_summary: Browser-local motion measurement plus Muse Spark 1.3 for planning and interpreting evidence. Helps arborists prepare questions, does not diagnose safety. Full local app with Node 22, pnpm, backend and Cloudflare setup.

devspak-s8/zyntry-verdict.summary: Multi-agent courtroom that debates and verifies results with evidence
devspak-s8/zyntry-verdict.readme_summary: Agents propose actions, court approves via policy, tools execute, and claims derive from evidence with testable disputes. Built for Push the Frontier with engine and CLI packages. Uses frontier models for investigation.

Y3K5/traitweaver.summary: Phenotype-first biology workbench linking traits to study briefs
Y3K5/traitweaver.readme_summary: Local demo-first site guides phosphorus trait research with source trails, saved Muse contexts, and study outlines. Planned inference via Meta Muse Model API, no provider keys in site. Python runners, schemas and docs.

fenyx144/chaski-guardian.summary: Community flood warning with risk lights and human-approved aid
fenyx144/chaski-guardian.readme_summary: Combines weather/ocean data and neighbor reports into green-yellow-red actions for Arequipa ravines. AI proposes, coordinator approves. Built with Muse Spark and Muse Code using Next.js. Illustrative estimates only.

charle-z/amadeus-second-dawn.summary: Tests AI memory survival across changing worlds with verifiable runs
charle-z/amadeus-second-dawn.readme_summary: Preserves objectives and snapshots, detects changes, checks Python/JSON, and asks muse-spark-1.3 for next steps. Includes deterministic multi-generation experiment with stored memories. Python, web demo and tests.

startcentra/safetycall-project.summary: AI scam-call coach that pauses risky calls and guides verification steps
startcentra/safetycall-project.readme_summary: Hackathon prototype for voice-phishing intervention with 20-turn scripted replay. Next.js app with local rules-based risk escalation plus optional Muse Voice Transcribe and Muse Spark adapters. Includes mock smart-glasses warnings and recovery guidance.

ruiruizl/loon-rules.summary: Loon proxy rules that reroute OpenAI API calls to self-hosted Muse gateway
ruiruizl/loon-rules.readme_summary: Collection of Loon plugins and Surge/QX converted rules. Includes muse2api-loon script that MITMs api.openai.com and rewrites to a self-hosted gateway with SSE passthrough. Not a hackathon app, utility proxy config.

vkend/aftermath.summary: Phone coach that checks generator distance against CDC and NIST guidance
vkend/aftermath.readme_summary: Post-hurricane safety coach measuring generator-to-door distance for CO risk. Checks against CDC/NIST guidance in Hindi and English with Spanish safety lines. Python-based Indie track Build for Your World project.

ishaq88/UpClose.summary: Film a used car to get a private evidence-linked condition report
ishaq88/UpClose.readme_summary: Video-based used-car screening with guided clips for 8 areas or single upload. Produces private condition report as screening aid, not mechanic inspection. Local AI pipeline with static landing plus sample report site.

abeebridwan/PackProof.summary: Verifies product evidence and records buyer-seller handover offline
abeebridwan/PackProof.readme_summary: Product evidence verification with signed records, database auth and crypto checks. Next.js monorepo with TypeScript SDK and verification contracts, works offline. Demo products are synthetic sample evidence.

JyTey2004/muse-audit.summary: Verifies Muse file outputs against requirements before guarded delivery
JyTey2004/muse-audit.readme_summary: Stardive for Muse freezes requests into checklists, runs read-only MCP checks on private drafts. Releases files only when checks pass with version-bound receipts. Includes connectors, workflow docs and demo site.

albertmwangwa/darubini.summary: Microscope phone copilot that counts malaria parasites in Kiswahili/English
albertmwangwa/darubini.readme_summary: Malaria microscopy counting copilot using phone-on-eyepiece setup. SAM 3.1 segments cells, Muse Spark runs and audits counts, Muse Voice Transcribe enables hands-free operation. Python Docker Android stack.

harshitaggarwal01/splatdiff.summary: Compares two room videos to report added, removed or moved objects
harshitaggarwal01/splatdiff.readme_summary: Second Look compares BEFORE/AFTER phone walkthroughs for change reports. SAM 3.1 provides boxes and confidences, Muse Spark 1.3 reasons, unsupported claims dropped. Static demo plus Python server via Meta Model API.

Noel9907/Decompile.summary: Turns bouncing-ball video into runnable physics code and what-if sims
Noel9907/Decompile.readme_summary: Video-to-physics decompiler extracting geometry with SAM 3.1 then fitting 3D physics. Outputs runnable Python program and Muse Spark what-if parameter edits. Web app with live SAM call and simulator frontend.

brmel/machine-vision-radar.summary: Sourced searchable catalog of 950 machine-vision products and news
brmel/machine-vision-radar.readme_summary: Typed catalog of cameras, lenses, lighting and software from 433 vendors with sourced specs. Includes search, Ask, CLI and MCP server plus agent-proposed human-approved updates. Firebase web app with contracts.

ArihantDeva/janus.summary: Calibrated guard predicting tool-call failures with probabilities, not text
ArihantDeva/janus.readme_summary: Janus is a non-autoregressive encoder that predicts next action for failed tool calls via single forward pass. Uses Muse Glimmer 30B with QLoRA adapter outputting 4-class logits with thresholding. Evaluated with 175 tests on R-Judge and Agent-SafetyBench with honest negative results.

lakshita10341/Concept2Motion.summary: Multi-agent engine turning CS concepts into animated vertical engineering reels
lakshita10341/Concept2Motion.readme_summary: Concept2Motion transforms CS and systems topics into 1080x1920 60FPS reels using autonomous agents. Backend runs sandboxed Python to capture runtime truth and compiles deterministic Manim vector animations. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for content and Llama Guard 3 for safety.

community-connect-lab/community-connect.summary: WhatsApp call desk creating human-reviewed AI case drafts from support calls
community-connect-lab/community-connect.readme_summary: Community Connect provides a calling gateway at /agent for answering WhatsApp support calls and taking notes. Post-call audio is sent to Meta for transcription, then merged into editable AI case drafts. Stack is Node.js with calling, webhook, and web servers for human review.

tarushvkodes/munki.summary: Feed-style flashcard app with SM-2 spaced repetition for ADHD studying
tarushvkodes/munki.readme_summary: Munki opens to an infinite due-weighted flashcard feed with flip, Knew/Again, XP and combos. Runs a real SM-2 spaced-repetition engine over actual course content for MA162, PHYS172 and CNIT182. Built as full-stack app with client, frontend, and Drizzle-backed persistence.

Whinh0sa/Liquid.summary: Spatial terminal pricing used electronics and surfacing best time to sell
Whinh0sa/Liquid.readme_summary: Liquid 2.0 turns idle electronics into liquid capital by assessing condition and market comps. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 for visual spatial segmentation and pricing with arbitrage logic. Deployed as zero-login web terminal built with Next.js and TypeScript.

CristianCDG/SeeForMe.summary: Voice-first camera assistant describing surroundings aloud for blind users
CristianCDG/SeeForMe.readme_summary: SeeForMe is a tap-once voice-only web app that photographs surroundings and answers spoken questions aloud. Frontend captures camera and audio while backend chains speech-to-text and vision QA. Uses Muse Spark for vision and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech.

haris-sujethan/Trade-Receipts.summary: On-chain analyzer scoring pump.fun tokens for rug risk before buying
haris-sujethan/Trade-Receipts.readme_summary: Trade Receipts is an agent-native IDE with Analyze mode for holder analysis and rug scoring and Copy-trade backtesting. Every metric is derived from on-chain pump.fun data and verified before display. Built solo during hackathon with frontend, backend, and Meta models for research.

coderhema/juicy-leaks.summary: Red-team suite jailbreaking chatbots and MCP servers then patching prompts
coderhema/juicy-leaks.readme_summary: Juicy Leaks runs 30+ mutated jailbreak and prompt-injection attacks on chatbots and MCP servers. Judges with canary detector plus LLM judge, scores by category, then generates hardened prompt diff and re-tests. Powered by Muse Glimmer via NVIDIA NIM or Llama 3.3 70B.

Boboinna/marketlens.summary: Turns one clothing photo into multilingual listings and styled images
Boboinna/marketlens.readme_summary: MarketLens converts a single garment photo into honest English, French and Spanish listing copy plus fashion-style images. Uses only visible or user-confirmed details for resellers on Vinted, Depop and Marketplace. Built during hackathon as Next.js app with Meta AI vision and generation.

WikdSolvemProbler/process-tree-guard.summary: Rust tool enforcing deadlines by killing full Windows process trees
WikdSolvemProbler/process-tree-guard.readme_summary: Process-tree-guard runs any Windows command under a finite deadline and terminates the entire process tree at expiry. Implemented in Rust with zero third-party crates using native Windows APIs. Includes CI, measurements, policy docs, and Apache-2.0 release binaries.

zanonaa/VansGo.summary: Self-hosted Go gateway providing one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for multiple AI providers
zanonaa/VansGo.readme_summary: VansGo is a self-hosted AI gateway in Go with Next.js dashboard for keys, failover combos, quotas and proxy pools. It translates OpenAI-compatible requests per provider, refreshes OAuth tokens and tracks usage/cost. Points any client to localhost:20128/v1.

emirkaan5/floodwatch.summary: Checks river cameras against flood forecasts to warn drivers and alert responders
emirkaan5/floodwatch.readme_summary: Flood Watch monitors public river cameras inside flood warnings and compares forecasts to visual water levels. Python stack with map UI, scenario replay and responder routing. Uses SAM 3.1 for water segmentation and Muse Spark for verification.

Railly/conjure.summary: Turns photos of kids drawings into playable physics games you can edit by chat
Railly/conjure.readme_summary: Conjure converts a drawing photo into crayon-style physics bodies on a game engine, then lets users edit while playing. TypeScript monorepo with Studio publisher, sandbox racing and headless verification. Eight example games published via one-click deploy.

logic25/carethread-hackathon-demo.summary: Shared thread that tracks family elder-care tasks so nothing gets lost in chat

Enforces causal obligations via CAGE, ZTL, VEIP with independent Judge and VCC@1. Focus is verifiable authority and collective completion.

bhanusupraja/your-shoot-buddy.summary: Phone camera agent giving live voice direction, zoom and capture for creators
bhanusupraja/your-shoot-buddy.readme_summary: Watches live frame and listens to speech to direct solo creators by voice, with frame checks, missing-item alerts, smart zoom and completeness tracking. Static JS web app using Meta SAM 3.1 for vision and Muse Spark for agent reasoning. Hands-free capture.

JaskirtKaler/RenovaCAD.summary: Renovation CAD workspace turning room photos into editable layouts and renders
JaskirtKaler/RenovaCAD.readme_summary: React + TypeScript + Electron + Vite frontend with Go local API service for AI. Transforms room photos into editable layouts, 3D renders and CAD/BIM plans. Uses Meta Muse models via Baseten, isolated preload bridge with per-launch token auth.

nihalnihalani/new-stuff.summary: Daily archive of AI briefs covering models, repos and hackathons
nihalnihalani/new-stuff.readme_summary: Archive of daily 9AM IST briefs compiled from X, GitHub trending, Hugging Face, Hacker News and tech blogs. Stored as markdown briefs with watchlist and seen log CSVs. No Meta AI / Muse integration, purely curated knowledge summaries.

Arnav0507/veritaserum-team-agent.summary: Team incident workspace with private evidence workers and approval-gated repair
Arnav0507/veritaserum-team-agent.readme_summary: Collaborative workspace where users investigate with audience-scoped context and approve exact shareable statements for a shared agent to combine. Python stdlib server with web UI, no build step. Uses Muse Spark for private extraction and Muse Wonder.

swankystark/probelab.summary: AI scientist that turns video observations into physics models and experiments
swankystark/probelab.readme_summary: ProbeLab extracts motion from video with SAM 3.1, fits physical models with NumPy/SciPy, and designs experiments. FastAPI backend + web frontend uses Muse Spark for reasoning and predictions. Stack is Python 3.11, FastAPI, NumPy, SciPy.

harshith7002/Macoostudy.summary: Resume analyzer that gives ATS scores and before-after bullet rewrites
harshith7002/Macoostudy.readme_summary: Macoostudy scores resumes across 5 categories deterministically and uses an LLM for blunt feedback and rewrites. It matches against job descriptions, tracks history, and exports PDF reports. Stack is backend + frontend deployed on Vercel.

OttObottr/airstack.summary: Source-linked software pricing research with renewal verdicts for humans
OttObottr/airstack.readme_summary: AirStack maintains 4,694 products and 23k facts researched by Muse Spark Contributor mode from vendor pages. It quotes sources with validity dates and serves answers via web and MCP at airstack.bot. Backend corpus extraction plus MCP server.

IrshadAlam-dev/syllabus-sos.summary: Turns syllabi and course files into verifiable study plans and calendars
IrshadAlam-dev/syllabus-sos.readme_summary: Syllabus SOS uploads PDF/PNG/JPEG course docs and uses Muse Spark to extract assignments and deadlines. Users review, edit, and approve results into weekly and calendar views. Frontend on Vercel with backend validation and local storage.

Pchar046/timber.summary: Calm-rules assistant that supports autistic adults during sensory overload
Pchar046/timber.readme_summary: Timber uses pre-set calm rules to detect overload, speak, log events, and alert trusted contacts without in-moment confirmation. It integrates Bluetooth heart-rate and Home Assistant. Built as daily-living support, no medical advice.

dannkkie/spectrapatch.summary: CLI agent that finds UI overlap bugs with voice and SAM then auto-patches
dannkkie/spectrapatch.readme_summary: SpectraPatch records simulator video plus narration, transcribes with Muse Voice, extracts concepts with Muse Spark 1.3. It segments with SAM 3.1 to measure overlap, patches in a git worktree, and re-verifies to 0% overlap.

zzw4257/warp-relay.summary: Offline workbench tracing GPU sync fixes from proposal to measured evidence
zzw4257/warp-relay.readme_summary: Warp Relay curates 12 GPU-kernel sync cases with local CPU archives and recorded B200 trials. It links each candidate edit to trace evidence and runs offline with no runtime deps. Python 3.10, docs and evidence folders, Apache-2.0.

RaghuvaranDBECse32/AI-powered-Agentic-Ho.summary: Honeypot that detects scams and engages scammers to collect reportable intel
RaghuvaranDBECse32/AI-powered-Agentic-Ho.readme_summary: Detects scam messages with muse-spark-1.1 or rules, replies as a cautious victim over multi-turn sessions, and extracts UPI IDs and links via regex. Flask app.py with agent, detection, and extraction modules plus JSON evidence reports.

RenshuBTC/chat-computer.summary: Chat-centered computer with a Rust OS that acts through one conversation
RenshuBTC/chat-computer.readme_summary: Chat Computer is a Rust OS with own kernel, drivers, TLS 1.3, and model engine where one chat manages files and settings. Muse Spark powers intent handling with reversible actions. Runs in VMs with apps, docs, and evals.

ant10293/LearnLoop-Hackathon.summary: Learns a physical procedure from demo video then verifies new attempts
ant10293/LearnLoop-Hackathon.readme_summary: LearnLoop uses Meta models to propose steps from a demo and track them in verification video. Deterministic code assigns verdicts with timestamps and frames for human review. Built on pinned vision-test-bench dependency plus scripts.

theroyatlas/nori-cam.summary: A quiet live window into a tiny room where fictional AI cat Nori lives
theroyatlas/nori-cam.readme_summary: Nori Cam shows a miniature room with Nori living on server time. Users send free catalog gifts via a public site. It uses Muse Spark 1.3 for photo-to-JSON understanding and Muse Image 1.0 to redraw objects as 512px sprites.

mondiriariana/mario-mind.summary: Mario agent that plays like a person and predicts their brain activity
mondiriariana/mario-mind.readme_summary: Muse Glimmer 30B learns to play Super Mario Bros like a specific person, reasoning aloud each move. Its internal state feeds an encoder fitted on fMRI to predict brain scans. Built as a virtual participant for testing hypotheses.

Karman580/APPSHIELD_AI.summary: Listens to phone calls live to warn about scams before money is lost
Karman580/APPSHIELD_AI.readme_summary: AppShield AI analyzes phone audio turn-by-turn to detect digital-arrest and OTP/UPI fraud scripts. It warns users and family in real time. Built with Python FastAPI backend, streaming audio models and Android integration.

Ayai1/EngramOS.summary: Time-aware memory pipeline that quarantines suspicious RAG updates
Ayai1/EngramOS.readme_summary: EngramOS retrieves time-aware facts while quarantining poisoned updates for RAG systems. It reports pre-registered synthetic benchmark results with Clopper-Pearson intervals. All systems tested with same local Reader model.

ekanshinsight/remote-bridge.summary: Turns any phone browser into mouse, keyboard and PC screen viewer
ekanshinsight/remote-bridge.readme_summary: Remote Bridge turns a phone or tablet on Wi-Fi into trackpad, keyboard, macros and screen viewer for Windows. No install or cloud, just browser. Built with Python server, JSON macro bank and gesture lab.

adekunlewriteswell-code/tradepulse-meta-.summary: Activates inactive FMCG retailers with evidence-linked action briefs
adekunlewriteswell-code/tradepulse-meta-.readme_summary: TradePulse AI provides FastAPI foundation with synthetic SQLite data to reactivate inactive retailers. A browser demo links retailer sessions to manager briefs with guardrails. Uses Meta HTTP adapter for persisted intelligence.

ArnoRoh/endesha-salama.summary: Free Kiswahili and English motorcycle safety lessons with voice audio
ArnoRoh/endesha-salama.readme_summary: Endesha Salama offers offline-first motorcycle and workplace safety lessons in Kiswahili and English with pictures and text-to-speech. Voice answers graded by Meta AI. Built with static site, ERP API and Muse Code.

mergennachin/muse-glimmer.summary: Run Muse Glimmer 30B locally on Apple Silicon with Metal
mergennachin/muse-glimmer.readme_summary: muse-glimmer serves Muse Glimmer locally on macOS Apple Silicon via Metal. Install with pip, pull ExecuTorch PTE weights and serve OpenAI-compatible API. Supports launching Muse coding agent with no API key.

Sarah20187/lecnote-gen-meta.summary: Maps lecture PDFs into a checkable knowledge structure for study
Sarah20187/lecnote-gen-meta.readme_summary: LecNote is a macOS app for lecture PDFs with lookup, AI Q&A and notes beside slides. A 22-stage pipeline on Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder builds cross-lecture knowledge maps with source grounding.

hyodotdev/openmainty.summary: Local AI maintainer that verifies dependency updates in a sandbox
hyodotdev/openmainty.readme_summary: OpenMainty watches drift, issues and PRs, then triages and verifies fixes in a Mac sandbox for human review. It never auto-merges. Primary worker is Muse Code via muse exec with Muse Spark 1.3.

luchitogeek22/expertium-hackathon.summary: Turns factory nonconformities into cited procedures, CAPA plans and audit logs.
luchitogeek22/expertium-hackathon.readme_summary: Expertium converts a manufacturing deviation into a grounded quality record with cited procedures, corrective action proposal and human approval. Built with Python backend plus frontend, app.py, ledger.py and llm.py for structured outputs and tamper-evident logging. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 on Meta Model API for four agents: Knowledge, Quality, CAPA and Audit.

brookaylneh/AeroPilot.summary: Plans and monitors drone search-and-rescue missions from natural language commands.
brookaylneh/AeroPilot.readme_summary: AeroPilot is AI mission control that turns operator objectives into checked flight plans, fleet telemetry and evidence review. It combines deterministic planning, autopilot software and simulation with perception models. Uses Muse Wonder as mission commander, fine-tuned SAM 3.1 for target detection and Muse Glimmer for evidence review.

arcabotai/issue-scout.summary: Scores GitHub issues for newcomer fit and generates grounded fix plans.
arcabotai/issue-scout.readme_summary: Issue Scout fetches open GitHub issues, scores newcomer-friendliness 0-10 and picks top 3 with fix plans. Backend agent uses tool-calling loop with get_repo_tree, get_readme and read_file via GitHub API. Uses Meta Muse Spark for scoring and grounded plan generation, deployed on Cloudflare Worker.

khushira2244/aroundyou.summary: Turns community ideas into coordinated events with planning and blocker recovery.
khushira2244/aroundyou.readme_summary: AroundYou helps groups turn an idea into a planned event with tasks, contributors, resources and execution tracking. It has backend plus frontend web app with human-in-the-loop approval for plan changes. Uses Meta AI models for goal understanding, planning and intelligent blocker recovery.

drexkooo/acid-web.summary: Generates personalized manga chapters from selfies and story prompts.
drexkooo/acid-web.readme_summary: Acid creates Japanese-style manga chapters from scenario cards and up to four selfies, with persistent cast, cover and community feed. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and SQL on Meta Model API. Uses Muse Spark Vision for character design, Muse Wonder for storyboard and Muse Image for pages.

tkjjava/jmx-muse.summary: Exposes muse.ai via OpenAI-compatible API using local Chrome CDP bridge.
tkjjava/jmx-muse.readme_summary: muse-bridge reuses a logged-in Chrome via CDP to forward chat to muse.ai with OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models endpoints. Python package with Noise WebSocket transport, SSE streaming and tests. No Meta Model API use; bridges Meta Hatch muse.ai sessions instead.

shivraj-S-bhatti/benben.summary: Unitree Go2 robot dog that maps wheelchair access barriers on walking routes.
shivraj-S-bhatti/benben.readme_summary: BenBen inspects estate walking routes for curbs, blockages and surface hazards using a quadruped robot. Stack includes autonomy, capture and app modules with spatial-temporal reasoning loop. Uses Muse Spark for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual barrier detection.

dev-ansung/chromuse.summary: Browser agent that completes web tasks in your own Chrome by text or voice.
dev-ansung/chromuse.readme_summary: Chromuse performs clicks, typing and reading in the user's existing Chrome with tabs and logins, with memory and learned playbooks. Architecture is server plus web client sending page snapshots for low latency. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten for actions and Muse Voice Transcribe for speech input.

w8bdcr-official/W8BDCR-OmniRoute-Own.summary: Local-first AI gateway routing across 352 providers with free-tier tracking.
w8bdcr-official/W8BDCR-OmniRoute-Own.readme_summary: W8BDCR OmniRoute is a free AI gateway installer for Termux, Docker and Bun with dashboard, routing and usage accounting. Includes provider catalog, docs and update tooling for local-first deployment. Acts as model gateway rather than direct Muse model integration.

Timosboy/ese-cual.summary: Links spoken "this/that" in assembly videos to visible parts being pointed at.
Timosboy/ese-cual.readme_summary: Ese, cual? resolves deictic references in assembly demos and tracks the referenced part, abstaining when ambiguous. Python pipeline with app.py and ese_cual modules for transcription, gesture and segmentation. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Spark 1.3 and SAM 3.1.

Abel1011/rikuy-ai.summary: Turns typed or photo physics problems into narrated 3D lessons in three languages.
Abel1011/rikuy-ai.readme_summary: Rikuy converts physics problems into interactive 3D scenes with step-by-step narration in English, Spanish and Quechua. Built with Next.js and Drizzle, it uses Muse models for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for vision and MMS for voice and subtitles.

mdlog/tataloka.summary: Redesigns rooms from a photo into 3D layouts furnished with real IKEA products.
mdlog/tataloka.readme_summary: Tataloka reads room photos or video and generates layouts, floor plans, photoreal renders and shopping lists using real IKEA Indonesia catalog. Node full-stack app built on Meta Model API with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, Muse Image and Muse Voice.

girithc/agents.summary: Rust platform to run, trace and improve AI agents via HTTP API and terminal.
girithc/agents.readme_summary: AgentHub provides persistent secrets, run tracing and feedback-driven improvement for AI agents. Rust workspace with Axum HTTP + SSE API, runtime loop with tool calls, and agentctl terminal client.

fagabondz/arvi-os.summary: Voice-driven Windows operator that runs apps, browser, and security audits.
fagabondz/arvi-os.readme_summary: ARVI OS is a bilingual EN/ID assistant with browser HUD and phone control for desktop automation, screen vision and cyber audits. Uses 100% Meta models: Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and vision plus SAM 3.1 Cloud segmentation.

Julian-glitch-alt/evidence-capture.summary: Verifies auto claim photos in guided capture flow and seals them for adjusters.
Julian-glitch-alt/evidence-capture.readme_summary: Guided browser capture checks claim photos against policy and story, then Ed25519-seals them into adjuster reports. Uses Muse Spark plus SAM 3.1 inside a harness with guardrails, evals, tracing and cost caps; code decides, human rules.

Abdourahman1909/sinux.summary: Linux desktop OS with push-to-talk assistant that sees and acts on screen.
Abdourahman1909/sinux.readme_summary: Sinux embeds assistant Muse in the desktop for voice control, on-screen annotations via AT-SPI, and cross-app actions. Thinking and hearing use Meta Muse models via Model API with realtime transcription and local speech synthesis.

paperwhite/realitycheck-ai.summary: Stress-tests object detectors with reproducible blur, light and occlusion edits.
paperwhite/realitycheck-ai.readme_summary: Upload an image, segment target with SAM 3.1, then Muse Spark proposes scene-specific challenges applied as versioned transforms. Python app compares baseline detector results to reveal robustness gaps.

msheroubi/glassbox.summary: Diagnoses robot policy failures by testing perception hypotheses with tools.
msheroubi/glassbox.readme_summary: GlassBox records ACT policy attention and SAM perception maps on a SO-101 arm to explain pick-and-place failures. Muse Wonder reviews evidence, runs image tools to test hypotheses, with Muse Image and SAM 3.1.

pankajarm/wattdocket-core.summary: Evidence atlas of US data centers with permits and grid context cited to source.
pankajarm/wattdocket-core.readme_summary: WattDocket aggregates permits, grid context and operator disclosures for data-center facilities with line-level citations and labeled gaps. Open-source API plus core with schemas, provenance docs and live site.

hellomrsys-maker/BioOS.summary: Safety OS for surgical robotics with 1000Hz kernel and live tissue segmentation.
hellomrsys-maker/BioOS.readme_summary: BioOS pairs a no_std Rust 1000Hz interlock kernel with Kalman observer and shared-memory bus to Meta models. Uses SAM 3.1 for intraoperative segmentation and Muse for procedural guidance in a web console.

loyoai/spillsight.summary: AI console that maps oil spills in Hormuz and drafts cleanup response plans
loyoai/spillsight.readme_summary: Operations console that turns spill imagery into approved response actions on a live 3D map of Hormuz. Stack is web console plus server with particle drift model and Open-Meteo wind data. Uses SAM 3.1 for oil segmentation and Muse Spark 1.3 for response planning.

DeceptionCheck/pump-station-zero-communi.summary: Local decoy water pump station for safe Modbus security practice
DeceptionCheck/pump-station-zero-communi.readme_summary: Local Python-only decoy of a small water booster station with no real equipment connected. Simulates pump stop, equipment display, Modbus commands and independent readback into reports. Built as safe practice target with DecoyBench evaluation research.

alix2i0/meta.summary: Multi-agent supervisor that monitors and controls a simulated CNC cell
alix2i0/meta.readme_summary: Autonomous Line Supervisor for a simulated CNC milling cell with OPC UA digital twin. Deterministic 1Hz monitor wakes Supervisor and Diagnostician agents on drift to cut feed or hold production. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 via OpenAI-compatible API with operator approval gating.

Samidha9/TARS.summary: Voice camera guide that explains devices and letters step by step
Samidha9/TARS.readme_summary: Patient voice assistant where users point phone camera at devices or letters and talk. Explains, highlights where to press, verifies steps via camera and warns about scams. Uses Muse Spark 1.2/1.3, Muse Spark Open, SAM 3.1 and Muse Voice Transcribe on Modal.

melissalau17/veritas.summary: Verifies industrial maintenance evidence before engineers apply it
melissalau17/veritas.readme_summary: Multimodal verification layer for industrial maintenance that checks if RAG evidence should be trusted. FastAPI backend with Cloudflare Workers frontend and pytest benchmark suite. Uses Muse Spark Open for reasoning and SAM 3.1 for visual verification.

deepesh-gidwani/operon-ai.summary: Multi-agent platform that turns CSV uploads into business action plans
deepesh-gidwani/operon-ai.readme_summary: Business operations intelligence platform where users upload CSV and describe objectives. FastAPI orchestrator routes Data, Insight and Action agents to produce evidence-backed insights. Uses Meta muse-spark-1.3 Model API with React dashboard.

Schwirzke/AncestorWalk-Judging.summary: Turns family trees into immersive Quest 3 and desktop history journeys
Schwirzke/AncestorWalk-Judging.readme_summary: Unity app for Quest 3/3S and desktop that renders family records as explorable historical scenes. Includes 37-person fictional demo with panoramas and portraits without API key. Uses Unity 6000 with generated scenery for imaginative interpretation.

mathiastck/clipboard-history.summary: Android clipboard history accessible via panel, bubble and tiles
mathiastck/clipboard-history.readme_summary: Simple Android clipboard history utility built with Kotlin and Gradle. Surfaces copied items via panel, bubble, notification, accessibility tile or in-app UI. No README details or Meta AI integration evident from file tree.

tomasantony/sas2r-benchmark.summary: 100-program SAS-to-R benchmark with frozen outputs for clinical trials
tomasantony/sas2r-benchmark.readme_summary: Reference benchmark of 100 clinical SAS programs with input data and hashed SAS 9.4 outputs. Provides run, capture and audit scripts to score separate sas2r-agent. Contains no agent or model code, frozen for hackathon evaluation.

shdassouki/ProposalIQ.summary: Turns dense RFPs into evidence-cited proposals with compliance scoring
shdassouki/ProposalIQ.readme_summary: AI presales tool that parses RFPs into sourced claims and code-scored compliance checks. Dockerized backend plus frontend with deterministic mock mode and Harborview sample scenario. Built for indie track with live Render demo.

gudeez/reskale-glasses.summary: Hands-free thrift scanner on Ray-Ban Meta glasses that says buy or pass.
gudeez/reskale-glasses.readme_summary: Phone app paired to Ray-Ban Meta glasses via Meta DAT captures item photos on button or voice trigger. Muse vision identifies the item, eBay comps price it, and a rules agent speaks buy/pass with reasoning. Stack is Expo/React Native with barcode and audio I/O.

HildaEDIMA/data-alchemist.summary: Records agent data analysis and keeps only findings that survive validation.
HildaEDIMA/data-alchemist.readme_summary: Flight-recorder engine logs every statistical test an analyst agent runs. Muse Spark proposes hypotheses, then FDR control, holdout validation and confounder checks filter false positives. Python API + Docker stack with demo, benchmark and evaluation scripts.

TygartMedia/tygart-os-fact-gated-fleet.summary: Fact-gated publishing fleet that only ships verbatim-grounded AI fixes.
TygartMedia/tygart-os-fact-gated-fleet.readme_summary: Runs six production sites on Meta Muse models with Scout/ Fixer/Adjudicator separation of duties. Proposer never approves its own work; Hopper router confirms intake routing by read-back. Produced thousands of monetization candidates and adjudicated fixes.

alanbork/HearingHistoryLab.summary: Monthly browser hearing self-test that tracks change versus your own history.
alanbork/HearingHistoryLab.readme_summary: Single-file HTML app for adults 20-80 measures thresholds per pitch and ear using own equipment. Each session starts from past thresholds and overlays history to show drift. No Meta AI/Muse integration described; runs locally in Chrome.

itz1508/OneShot-Continuing.summary: Separates AI research from execution to make evidence-backed code changes.
itz1508/OneShot-Continuing.readme_summary: Host-controlled workflow records request, agent findings, allowed edits, runs, and independent checks. Catalog and Research agents plan, host authorizes and verifies execution. Python + Modal stack with audit, CI, and deployment manifests.

WAOmaster/bidledger.summary: Turns auction-floor phone audio into a verified sales ledger with proof clips.
WAOmaster/bidledger.readme_summary: Muse Voice Transcribe with diarization timestamps speakers on noisy multilingual audio. Muse Spark 1.3 acts as clerk to map voices, parse Hindi/Tamil numbers, and assign lots, winners and prices. Python + ffmpeg cuts proof clips and checks slip shortfall.

aravhawk/parallax.summary: Digital-twin lab that tests competing theories and abstains when all fail.
aravhawk/parallax.readme_summary: Dependency-free numerical lab maintains competing thermal models, picks discriminating interventions, and updates beliefs with evidence passports. Optional live Muse scientist and skeptic propose and critique experiments under deterministic validation. Python 3.10+ with Docker.

shubhranshu-p/napkincloud.summary: Turns architecture sketches into reproducible traffic experiments and fixes.
shubhranshu-p/napkincloud.readme_summary: Workbench converts system diagrams into load tests to find bottlenecks and compare repairs. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning and Muse Image 1.0 for visuals with docs-driven architecture. Static frontend deployable to GitHub Pages.

jurayh/sluice.summary: Local hook-enforced token saver for coding CLIs with built-in savings meter.
jurayh/sluice.readme_summary: Shunts bulk reads and boilerplate generation to cheap workers via hooks instead of coordinator. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI and Muse Code with measured coordinator/worker tokens. Local-first Python plugin, no server or telemetry.

cpatra11/phantasm.summary: Generates editable brand-consistent motion graphics and video from a prompt.
cpatra11/phantasm.readme_summary: Board UI creates storyboard variants from prompt plus brand URL, then refines layers in plain language. Next.js + Neon Postgres + Drizzle with Vercel Blob and Better Auth. Uses Meta Model API via Vercel AI SDK; Remotion Lambda renders MP4/PNG.

olgaiv39/makefromthis.summary: Turns a photo of scrap material into a measured cutting plan for rectangles and squares.
olgaiv39/makefromthis.readme_summary: Uploads a material photo, detects outline with OpenCV, calibrates with a known measurement, and exports a scaled SVG layout. Stack is Python backend plus Node frontend with Docker. Optional Muse Spark via Baseten adds image understanding and cut suggestions.

Aryanacoder/VEYTAC.summary: Phone-first AI apprentice that records expert work and captures why decisions were made.
Aryanacoder/VEYTAC.readme_summary: Observes skilled work via phone and screen, asks experts targeted questions, and stores approved explanations as evidence-linked skill data. Designed as knowledge layer for workers, AI systems and robotics research. Uses Meta AI models for language understanding and dataset structuring.

14a0/deskverse.summary: Native macOS app that saves work desks and restores them from a single sentence.
14a0/deskverse.readme_summary: Captures Chrome tabs, agent sessions, Obsidian notes and music, groups by topic, and relaunches full desk layouts. Runs fully on-device for privacy. Uses Llama 3.1 locally on Mac for topic grouping and natural-language desk retrieval.

c0ldsheep/baton.summary: Menu bar app that splits one idea into parallel tasks for Claude, Codex and Gemini.
c0ldsheep/baton.readme_summary: Takes a single prompt and uses Muse Spark via Meta Model API to decompose work across three coding agents. Runs them concurrently in one folder using user subscriptions. Built as native Mac menu bar app for multi-agent code building.

shahrier/R1D1.summary: Supervised iRobot Create robot that finds visual targets and reports via Muse.
shahrier/R1D1.readme_summary: Raspberry Pi robot with camera and local controller validates safety sensors and motion commands. Muse Wonder interprets images, keeps mission memory, and picks scan headings via Gadget SDK. Owner receives photo reports and can trigger STOP latch.

Oliver369X/nativa-meta-hackathon.summary: Procedural anime engine where Llama writes editable scene specs from plain language.
Oliver369X/nativa-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Llama acts as director generating JSON with shots, blocking, dialogue and timing. Deterministic engine validates specs, auto-repairs errors, then renders rigs, camera and lip-sync without GPU video. No generative video, fully editable pipeline.

phiphi92i/context-meta-hackathon.summary: Trust and safety console for evidence-backed review of posts, video and audio.
phiphi92i/context-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Reproduces moderation queue with fictional reports, carousels, reels and timelines with cited AI findings. Stack is Cloudflare, Drizzle and web components. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for reasoning, SAM 3.1 for frame inspection, and Muse Voice for transcription.

ashiquebiniqbal/apex-business-os.summary: Business operations app for customers, quotes, suppliers and tasks with governed AI.
ashiquebiniqbal/apex-business-os.readme_summary: React, Vite, TypeScript and Supabase app with role-based sales, inventory and reporting. Meta AI extracts structured intent from inquiries and drafts quotation previews. Manager approval required before any records are written.

appygudu/StepSignal.summary: Maps wheelchair obstacles along routes using street photos with cited evidence.
appygudu/StepSignal.readme_summary: Samples routes every 50m, fetches Mapillary street photos, and analyzes each stretch for barriers with confidence and age. Frontend map plus backend API. Uses Muse Spark muse-spark-1.3 for visual obstacle detection, never declaring routes accessible.

juanarrietabusiness-pixel/AGENDA-PERSONA.summary: Private Spanish personal assistant that organizes tasks and reminders with GTD.
juanarrietabusiness-pixel/AGENDA-PERSONA.readme_summary: Captures input via Telegram, Claude or web app by text or voice, then clarifies and schedules by life area. Built on Cloudflare Worker with D1 and password auth. Uses Muse Spark or Claude to structure tasks and follow up until done.

ParcAirValue/About_ParcAirValue.summary: Ranks travelers and parcels for a community delivery marketplace
ParcAirValue/About_ParcAirValue.readme_summary: Self-contained ranking service for Communal delivery marketplace. TypeScript API on Cloudflare Workers with ranking logic in src/ranking.ts. Uses Meta Model API Responses API with muse-spark-1.3 for taker and parcel reranking.

FridayLover/Movealong.summary: Map-based second-hand marketplace for people moving homes
FridayLover/Movealong.readme_summary: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind PWA for buying, selling, or giving away moving items by distance. Uses Prisma + SQLite with Docker setup. AI try-in-room visualization planned for listings discovery.

Soham1660/forge-releases.summary: Autonomous coding desktop app for macOS with installers
Soham1660/forge-releases.readme_summary: Release-only repo holding Forge Code macOS Apple Silicon dmg installer. No source code, just install docs and notarization workaround. Desktop app connects to Meta Muse Spark models via Settings.

iyanuashiri/examficient-project.summary: Adaptive exam prep with mastery tracking for JAMB, SAT, GRE
iyanuashiri/examficient-project.readme_summary: Adaptive MCQ drills with Elo mastery, distractor diagnosis, and AI-graded explain-back. FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend, Vue 3 + Vite frontend. Uses Muse Spark for grading/coaching and Muse Voice Transcribe.

seankoji-com/model-values.summary: Compares AI coding subscriptions by cost per agentic task
seankoji-com/model-values.readme_summary: Interactive static report plotting subscription cost per task vs benchmark score and time. Built from public benchmark and capacity data in data/ + src/. No Meta model calls; analyzes Muse Code Maximum among others.

34r7h/zuck.summary: Plans and runs multi-model tasks with human-in-the-loop gates
34r7h/zuck.readme_summary: Clarifying-question planner that builds goals, tasks, gates and parallel groups. Assigns Spark, Wonder, Image, SAM 3.1 per task. Async runner uses visitor Meta API key, never stored.

latent-explore/automation-bench-improvem.summary: Distills teacher traces to fine-tune finance workflow automation
latent-explore/automation-bench-improvem.readme_summary: LoRA fine-tune of muse-glimmer-30b on 88 verified teacher trajectories for Zapier AutomationBench finance tasks. Pipeline: teacher rollouts, verification, training scripts. Reaches 31.0% pass@1 vs 15.3% base.

Nikhi-l/badminton-editor.summary: Adds tracked player masks and match HUD to badminton video
Nikhi-l/badminton-editor.readme_summary: Python CLI + static web editor that segments and tracks players through rallies. Uses Meta SAM 3.1 for masks, focus inset, blur others. Overlays scoreboard, rally clock, and P1-P4 stats.

gullapa/laplace.summary: Predicts structure behavior from camera, speech, and physics
gullapa/laplace.readme_summary: Experimental ForeSight copilot in laplace-mvp with live phone camera. Combines SAM 3.1 vision, Muse speech transcription and QA, block model, static calc and 3D replay. Research prototype only.

nitineeen/project-tweaks.summary: Local-first save manager with cited AI chat over collection
nitineeen/project-tweaks.readme_summary: Saves pages, images, chats with why-note, auto-files locally in SQLite. Monorepo apps/ + packages/ with offline fixtures. Uses Meta Model API when key provided for search and cited brainstorm chat.

theshaikasad/orderguard.summary: Local sales chat workspace that automates routine orders and escalates exceptions
theshaikasad/orderguard.readme_summary: OrderGuard is a local synthetic sales workspace for small businesses. Backend plus Next.js frontend with Docker Compose, scenario lab and versioned configs. Meta Muse interprets seller/customer language to validate orders and trigger escalations.

iffydopsqueen/homewise-ai.summary: Shows first-time buyers the full monthly and upfront cost of a home
iffydopsqueen/homewise-ai.readme_summary: HomeWise AI combines deterministic affordability calculations with property comparisons for homebuyers. Built as a Next.js app with transparent budgeting logic. Meta Muse Spark 1.3 only explains results, never decides affordability.

Doocadoapps123/domireels.summary: Turns restaurant food photos into finished Instagram Reels sent on WhatsApp
Doocadoapps123/domireels.readme_summary: Domi Reels automates Reel creation for small restaurants from menu photos and kitchen data. Muse acts as director to plan ideas, direct shots, and add text/music. Owner onboarding via web, API and WhatsApp, live at domireels.com.

sadia-zannat/RoboLN-AI.summary: AI robotics workspace with 3D digital twins, simulation and build guidance
sadia-zannat/RoboLN-AI.readme_summary: RoboLN is an AI-powered robotics engineering workspace for planning, simulation and assembly. It offers interactive 3D digital twins, hardware planning and device monitoring. Built for Meta hackathon with Meta-powered build guidance.

Atikum-AI/latent-judge-hackathon.summary: Predicts video generation failures mid-sampling and auto-corrects the shot
Atikum-AI/latent-judge-hackathon.readme_summary: Latent Judge monitors LTX-2.5 sampling and at step 3 of 8 predicts exposure and color metrics. Pass continues, fail stops early for a director agent to fix and retry. All decisions logged with numbers in a custom sampling loop.

neel-09/SiliconLoop.summary: Designs circuits and Arduino firmware from a parts photo and one sentence
neel-09/SiliconLoop.readme_summary: SiliconLoop turns a parts photo plus prompt into circuit design and Arduino firmware. The exact binary runs in a browser twin simulation until behaviors pass. Every AI step uses Muse Spark Open served on Baseten.

yaminig23/Saath.summary: Central assistant coordinating specialist agents for everyday life tasks
yaminig23/Saath.readme_summary: Saath Brain is a central assistant coordinating specialist agents with memory, approvals and audit. Includes voice UI, video studio and Gmail/GCal integrations. Uses Meta Model API with honest keyless stub mode.

Eunryong/Sprout.summary: Raising game where a 110k-param transformer learns from age 3 to 7 choices
Eunryong/Sprout.readme_summary: Sprout is a 48-scene raising game where a randomly initialized 110k transformer learns from lived outcomes. Player acts via say/show/leave, engine resolves outcomes. Python server with mock/live LLM modes via config.

kamdog6414/agape.summary: Offline hash-pinned system for verifiable multi-builder software rounds
kamdog6414/agape.readme_summary: Agape provides a hash-pinned Base, receipted mod Manager, and Rounds judged by deterministic law predicates. Pure Python stdlib, offline, no AI grading. Chain of named points traces back to genesis for audit.

gtma1/nearmiss.summary: Tracks crossing users with SAM 3.1 to flag pedestrian-vehicle near-misses
gtma1/nearmiss.readme_summary: NearMiss measures road-user speeds from phone video using SAM 3.1 tracking and a road-plane model. Muse Spark does census and reviews flagged moments. Includes web app, validation on 3D and real footage.

kush07upadhyay/Unknown-Ally.summary: Local-first Android life tracker with voice agent that logs habits via tools
kush07upadhyay/Unknown-Ally.readme_summary: Local-first Android life tracker for sleep, habits, meals, gym, expenses using SQLite and Drizzle. Ally voice agent uses Muse Voice Transcribe for STT, Muse Spark 1.3/1.2 for tool-calling, and Muse Spark vision for receipt expense logging.

Habib0x0/musearena.summary: Prompt-driven cyber ranges to deploy and score red vs blue AI agents
Habib0x0/musearena.readme_summary: Platform to design, deploy, exercise and score verifiable red/blue agents in isolated cyber ranges. Full-stack with Node backend, frontend and deployment configs, built on Muse Spark with evidence-backed scoring and training loop.

Kayzm18/Online_child_protection_model.summary: Triage system flagging grooming risk with evasion-robust normalization
Kayzm18/Online_child_protection_model.readme_summary: Self-learning triage that detects grooming/solicitation, normalizes leetspeak and obfuscation, and generates structured explanations. Python stack with SQLite reviewer queue and moderator feedback loop using Muse Spark concepts.

ramuks22/Meta-LastSeen.summary: Glasses visual-memory finder that recalls where objects were last seen
ramuks22/Meta-LastSeen.readme_summary: Ray-Ban Meta glasses send images via Android phone to Python backend. SAM 3.1 locates enrolled objects and hands, Muse Spark describes placement, dashboard answers with photo and timestamp.

swaptr/meniscus.summary: Bedside fluid charting from photos and voice notes for nurse approval
swaptr/meniscus.readme_summary: Phone app where staff photograph containers or record voice notes to draft fluid balance entries. SAM 3.1 segments liquid, Muse Spark reads volume, nurse approves in one tap with rule-based review prompts.

ParishruthiGanesh/Offline-Companion.summary: Offline iPhone assistant with on-device AI, maps and Bluetooth sharing
ParishruthiGanesh/Offline-Companion.readme_summary: iOS prototype running Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct on-device for text answers with no cloud. Includes bundled OpenStreetMap area, saved places, compass, and encrypted Bluetooth location sharing.

therealshai/veterans-eyes.summary: Turns one expert repair video into live voice-guided coaching on phone
therealshai/veterans-eyes.readme_summary: Converts narrated expert video into step guide with highlighted parts, then coaches juniors live by voice with Q&A and work checks. Uses four Meta models for vision, transcription and dialogue on phone frontend and backend.

barqlo/barqlo-sales-brain.summary: Arabic-native two-agent sales brain unifying all customer channels
barqlo/barqlo-sales-brain.readme_summary: Central AI brain for SMB customer ops across WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram with one memory. Two-agent draft plus deterministic verification on Meta Muse Spark, with offline demo and architecture docs.

BarberoNiGov/Troupe-Meta.summary: Eight AI agents generate competing motion graphics from one brief
BarberoNiGov/Troupe-Meta.readme_summary: Controlled experiment where coding agents with different temperaments generate HTML motion loops from same brief. Python backend renders side-by-side, validates, measures and blind-scores eight 8-second outputs.

DeceptionCheck/decoybench.summary: Open harness measuring if language models can serve as decoys
DeceptionCheck/decoybench.readme_summary: Reference harness measuring decoy capability: usable replies, latency vs deadline, fallback and failure with deterministic baseline. Python bench with examples and tests, assisted by Muse Spark 1.3 for alt implementation.

JosBae/NDCScout.summary: Finds the most profitable drug NDC for a pharmacy's payer mix.
JosBae/NDCScout.readme_summary: Compares generic drug NDCs by payer formulas to maximize expected margin. Python CLI with deterministic verifier plus tool-calling agent. Uses Meta Model API Muse Spark to explain and verify NDC choices.

OpelSpeedster/Forestfire-Detection-with-.summary: Detects forest fire in video and sends verified Telegram alerts.
OpelSpeedster/Forestfire-Detection-with-.readme_summary: Video and webcam pipeline: OpenCV to FireNetCNN MobileNetV2 to Grad-CAM to SAM segmentation. Muse Spark reasons over evidence to trigger Telegram alerts. Flask server with fallback modes.

Yazan-O/afterdark.summary: Renders night event-camera drives into visible streets for inspection.
Yazan-O/afterdark.readme_summary: Uses SAM 3.1 to segment people in RGB and rendered event frames from Zurich night drives. Muse Image paints events into readable streets, checked by an inspection agent. Static web demo with Python pipeline.

alohasurfgirls/List-Dating-Hawaii-.summary: Hawaii dating app where 3 Wants and 3 Provides become the date.
alohasurfgirls/List-Dating-Hawaii-.readme_summary: List-based two-sided matching with one-push date planning at real Oahu spots. Supabase SQL schema with profiles, lists, dates and messaging. Designed to use Muse Spark for matching and notes.

Belloblaze-web3/meta-anatomy-research-la.summary: Interactive 3D anatomy atlas with AI explain and coding assistant.
Belloblaze-web3/meta-anatomy-research-la.readme_summary: Procedural anatomy models with viewer and gesture controls plus Explain Engineer Code assistant. Node server proxy calls Meta Chat Completions Muse Spark 1.3 Standard. Tests use mocked responses.

nataliesoul/art-companion.summary: Gives painters composition guides, palette studies and AI critique.
nataliesoul/art-companion.readme_summary: Mobile-first web app rectifies artwork photos and offers guides, palette and voice feedback. Uses Meta AI vision and image models for critique and painted studies. Original photo never altered.

HiyawTaken/OfferLetter.summary: Local-first agent that screens jobs and pre-fills applications.
HiyawTaken/OfferLetter.readme_summary: Searches listings, screens descriptions with chosen model, then fills forms in watched Chrome. Requires explicit approval for submissions. Python automation with Gmail and ATS helpers.

HMDRAMS-DEV/persona.summary: Creates shareable AI personas steered by vectors, not prompts.
HMDRAMS-DEV/persona.readme_summary: Muse Wonder designs traits, Muse Glimmer extracts persona vectors from residual stream for steering. Outputs 200KB .persona files tunable with sliders. Python server with gallery and Muse Image art.

axobase001/skuld.summary: Persistent desktop agent with world state and evidence receipts.
axobase001/skuld.readme_summary: Skuld V4 runtime with subject graph and Terminal UI connected to Pi execution harness. Tool results return as evidence to continuing subject. Self-hosted Muse Glimmer 30B validation with scoring.

3xC1ibR/glimmer-release-gate.summary: Blocks fine-tuned adapters that regress on tool-calling tasks.

Priyadharsa/Storyboard.summary: Minimal film workspace to write, stage in 3D, and export shots and audio
Priyadharsa/Storyboard.readme_summary: FramePilot AI v0.13.5 focuses on one screenplay, scene and shot with 3D set, drawing, Art Studio and Director AI. Uses Muse for planning and drafts, SAM for actor/object selection and local edit, plus OCR and PDF export.

adewolescott/agriroute-ai.summary: Grades produce from photos and routes freight to nearby cold storage
adewolescott/agriroute-ai.readme_summary: AgriRoute AI inspects produce quality, digitizes manifests and directs cargo to qualified cold-storage. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 for grading, SAM 3.1 for crate segmentation, Voice Transcribe, Go and PostGIS for KNN routing.

rohanaditya/MetaGlobalAIDeveloperHackath.summary: Recommender plugin that answers from people you follow with credits
rohanaditya/MetaGlobalAIDeveloperHackath.readme_summary: YourCircle plugs into multi-stage recommenders for candidate retrieval and re-ranking from follow graph. Uses Muse Spark for answers and plans, Voice Transcribe and SAM 3.1 for clip reading, via FastAPI service.

shreramsp/NovelTroupe.summary: Writing studio where story characters remember scenes and talk back
shreramsp/NovelTroupe.readme_summary: NovelTroupe gives each novel character its own agent with scene-scoped memory, plus Director agent and comic studio. Built with Streamlit and JSON storage, using Muse Spark for agents and Muse Image for comics.

Aaryan-9784/SkilloraX.summary: Freelancer operating system with client portal and marketplace
Aaryan-9784/SkilloraX.readme_summary: SynapseX / SkilloraX is a freelancer OS for projects, collaboration and hiring with live frontend and backend. Stack is React 18 + Vite frontend with Render backend API, deployed on Vercel and Render.

ReneSorel/PetPal-lite.summary: Bilingual dog and cat assistant for feeding, care and symptom triage
ReneSorel/PetPal-lite.readme_summary: PetPal Lite stores pet profiles on-device and computes rations, toxic foods, vaccines and urgency levels with vet-built logic. Uses Muse models for open questions, fully bilingual French/English.

GeminoLibi/simtrain.summary: Job-training simulator that builds realistic scenarios for any profession
GeminoLibi/simtrain.readme_summary: simTrain Universal extracts job profile and generates timed scenarios with documents and grading. Uses muse-spark-1.3 for extraction, narration and grading, muse-image-1.0 for scenes, on Cloudflare Workers.

ObiwanKenobee/majiproof.summary: Turns field photos into structured water infrastructure inspections
ObiwanKenobee/majiproof.readme_summary: MajiProof converts rural water field photos into structured inspections and before/after repair comparisons. Built with Next.js for the hackathon exploring frontier vision models for maintenance accountability.

bhargavirengarajan21/Monitor-dock.summary: Captures incident calls into searchable structured postmortems
bhargavirengarajan21/Monitor-dock.readme_summary: Incident Memory transcribes incident calls and drafts structured postmortems with cause, fix and owner. Uses Muse Spark for transcription and extraction with exact-code and access-aware retrieval.

mehta439/EnsembleAI.summary: Finds which ensemble section is out of tune and when from a clip
mehta439/EnsembleAI.readme_summary: EnsembleAI isolates sections from a single recording and measures held notes to prioritize fixes. Uses Meta SAM Audio for separation and Muse Spark for analysis, with notebook, Python app and Hugging Face demo.

chinmay3/concept-collider.summary: Audits ad sets as Meta Andromeda sees them and generates new creatives to fill gaps
chinmay3/concept-collider.readme_summary: Agent reads ads with Muse Spark 1.3 vision JSON mode, groups them into Andromeda concepts with diversity score, segments product with SAM 3.1, then evolves 12 gap-filling images in parallel with Muse Image edits.

khaledm2225/MoreAI-MetaAgent.summary: Arabic shopping agent that finds outfits across local brands and completes orders
khaledm2225/MoreAI-MetaAgent.readme_summary: Agentic commerce assistant on Meta models for Egyptian brands. Searches by meaning, inspects candidate photos, matches uploaded outfit photos, remembers taste and places orders after confirmation.

dceciliano/agentguard.summary: Tests AI agents for prompt injection and unsafe tool use via behavior checks
dceciliano/agentguard.readme_summary: FastAPI orchestration API evaluates observable agent behavior for injection, tool abuse and exfiltration. Uses Meta Muse muse-spark-1.3 via Responses API with deterministic mock execution boundary.

basetsowab/Unfollowly.summary: Compares Instagram follower exports in-browser and explains changes with AI
basetsowab/Unfollowly.readme_summary: Compares two Instagram exports locally to find unfollows and new followers. One click sends only changed usernames to Muse Spark for pattern and bot analysis, plus Instagram API for live counts.

larymc/maple-main-bakery.summary: WhatsApp-supervised coding agent that turns chat reports into approved GitHub issues
larymc/maple-main-bakery.readme_summary: Demo target repo for Relais by Gaismas Inc. Bakery single-page site with intentional booking bug. Owner reports issues over WhatsApp and Relais converts conversation into approved GitHub issues.

Vikhas/newton.summary: Predicts ball landing from first 0.25s of video and replays what-if physics

boredom198/PROJECT-NOONE.summary: Local CPU reinforcement-learning bot for crypto perpetual futures trading
boredom198/PROJECT-NOONE.readme_summary: Autonomous desktop trading app with local CPU RL engine, real-time market and news sentiment, strict risk gating and hardware-bound security. Runs locally without cloud GPUs or paid LLM APIs.

madhuthilaksub2008-wq/Sewtrace.summary: Converts three t-shirt photos into a 1:1 checked sewing pattern
madhuthilaksub2008-wq/Sewtrace.readme_summary: Built with only Meta models via Meta Model API. Takes front photos of a kid's t-shirt and generates front, back and sleeve pattern panels with seam pairs validated to sew together.

abhisarpratapsingh/shadowtwin.summary: Builds physics twin from coast-down video to diagnose machine faults
