moondh99/showme.summary: Lets workers point at work photos to check rules from approved guides
moondh99/showme.readme_summary: Supervisor turns photos and notes into reviewed guides with fixed published versions. Workers select objects and ask live questions via Meta Model API with English and Korean demo.

dmiyamoto/realitytest.summary: Verifies physical pick-and-place tasks from video with tracking and geometry checks.
dmiyamoto/realitytest.readme_summary: Uploads short clips, names object and target polygon. SAM 3.1 tracks masks across frames while deterministic geometry engine returns PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with visual evidence overlays. Built with Next.js, Docker, Playwright.

dataWizard7957/magpie.summary: Turns family photos and voice notes into a verified memory graph and storytelling app.
dataWizard7957/magpie.readme_summary: Ingests keepsakes into Engram memory graph, session agent asks/hints/tells stories with grandchild voice. Builds growing Memory Quilt. Uses Muse models for verification and narration, Muse Image for illustrations.

Rohi56u/NEUROLEARN-AI.summary: Converts lecture videos into quest levels, boss fights, and study sheets.
Rohi56u/NEUROLEARN-AI.readme_summary: Segments lectures into quest roadmap, conceptual Boss Fights, 3-tier misconception escalation and 2-page synthesis sheets. Stack is Next.js 15 + FastAPI + Postgres powered by Meta Model API suite.

yossefaymanzedan/OpenWeeder.summary: Low-cost farm robot that sprays only weeds using vision and a wiper arm.
yossefaymanzedan/OpenWeeder.readme_summary: Downward camera outlines plants with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark classifies weeds, servo wiper sprays targets. Farmer teaches with 10 photos, cloud labels distill to offline YOLO11n on Raspberry Pi 4 Flask.

shreyakembhavi/LavaFlow-AI.summary: Simulates simplified lava paths on synthetic terrain with visual analysis.
shreyakembhavi/LavaFlow-AI.readme_summary: Generates synthetic volcanic terrain, computes geometric downhill flow paths with 2D/3D visualization. Meta Model API interprets results via Streamlit app. Synthetic demo only, not hazard forecast.

Ashwinchauhan89/Meta-Global-AI-Developer.summary: Turns meeting recordings into summaries, actions, decisions, and Q&A.
Ashwinchauhan89/Meta-Global-AI-Developer.readme_summary: MeetingMind AI ingests recordings/transcripts to extract summaries, decisions, action items and evidence-based Q&A. Simple Python pipeline built for hackathon using Meta AI models for understanding.

Divinsky/Publicfit.summary: Scores brand-creator fit from public sources with storefronts and fan feed.
Divinsky/Publicfit.readme_summary: Scores category fit, audience overlap, track record and brand safety using cited sources only. Turns matches into claimable storefronts. Built with Next.js/Tailwind, uses Muse Spark 1.3 via api.meta.ai.

StartZer0/terra-shift.summary: Maps decades of water, forest, and coastal change from satellite imagery.
StartZer0/terra-shift.readme_summary: Interactive observatory lets users pick area/time to investigate water, greening, forests, ground, coasts. SAM 3.1 generates masks, Muse Wonder explains findings with exportable evidence. Vite + services stack.

IvanFenster/markedia-meta.summary: Marketplace that scores unsold ideas and lists spoiler-free previews for sale.
IvanFenster/markedia-meta.readme_summary: Three-pass Muse Spark 1.3 flow: web-search originality research, schema-enforced 7-criteria scoring and preview writing, heading generation. Next.js + Supabase marketplace for documented ideas.

Shivani-Radhakrishnan/fingertip.summary: Guides blind users to operate flat appliance touch panels via phone camera.
Shivani-Radhakrishnan/fingertip.readme_summary: Points phone at panel, states intent, app reads panel, plans presses, guides finger and verifies result. Built for accessibility with iOS + backend vision-language pipeline using Meta AI models.

msimakhov-star/proofload.summary: Turns text and load specs into FEA-tested printable CAD parts.

Runs real FEA with CadQuery, gmsh tet10 mesh and CalculiX over up to 16 iterations. Only an 11-gate deterministic verifier can certify STL, STEP and stress certificate.

woorichicken/nightgate.summary: Filters overnight coding-agent asks to only decisions needing you.
woorichicken/nightgate.readme_summary: Collects agent reports, judges each ask against six human-decision types with a Meta model and re-checks claims. Morning web UI shows only yours; feedback becomes training data. Runs locally on DGX Spark with TypeScript stack.

AvinaashAnandK/warmstart-extension.summary: Chrome extension that personalizes browsing from your history.
AvinaashAnandK/warmstart-extension.readme_summary: Builds a local profile from Chrome history inside the browser or from batch import. Uses Muse Wonder and Muse Spark for understanding, with live Muse Spark Open on Modal for moments. Adds cards, trays and drawers across X, muse.ai and product pages.

AdribMahmud101/stillwater.summary: Finds mosquito-breeding water from phone video with work orders.
AdribMahmud101/stillwater.readme_summary: Detects water-holding containers and standing water from photo or video, blurs people with hosted SAM 3.1. Scores risk with auditable rules and writes Bangla/English cleanup orders. Stack is Modal, ffmpeg, FastAPI app with hosted vision.

fsameha/maya.summary: Care companion that tracks objects and relays caregiver messages.
fsameha/maya.readme_summary: Prototype for older adults with memory loss that locates objects, relays caregiver messages and routes health questions. Built with SAM 3.1, Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Voice Transcribe. Web app replays recorded outputs with scripted interactions.

lucas-chu/fits.summary: One-page critic that scores SF room listings from text and photos.
lucas-chu/fits.readme_summary: Searches Craigslist and pasted Zillow URLs, ranks listings from text with muse-spark-1.3 via Meta API. Measures room photos and edits in missing desk. Single-page Python web app returning fit, maybe or no verdicts.

VetEngage/blinq-scribe.summary: Hands-free vet scribe from glasses mic to signed SOAP note.
VetEngage/blinq-scribe.readme_summary: Listens to exams via Meta AI glasses, captures first-person photos outlined by SAM 3.1. Drafts SOAP notes, meds and owner summaries with Muse models and creates follow-ups. Day assistant reads briefs and next-room cards aloud.

ranlianna2026/mechanical-reviewer.summary: Reads 2D drawings to flag DFM flaws and prove fixes.
ranlianna2026/mechanical-reviewer.readme_summary: Extracts structured spec from drawings with Muse Spark vision, checks deterministic DFM rules and verifies crops. Highlights issues with SAM 3.1 plus recall evidence from 1067 NHTSA cases. Re-renders corrected drawing and re-checks it.

mAE7777/once.summary: Explains any text aloud starting from real-world context.
mAE7777/once.readme_summary: Web app that turns pasted text, PDF, image or link into spoken explanation with source highlighting. Keeps original open and lights sentences as discussed. Next.js app with library samples, needs Node 24 and user keys.

OWO9000/TubbyBuddy.summary: Focus app where a cat blocks distractions and rewards streaks.
OWO9000/TubbyBuddy.readme_summary: Blocks user-chosen apps and sites with Tubby the cat, protecting points and streaks from focus sessions. Points redeem for real nearby rewards like coffee and classes. Every AI feature runs on Meta Muse models with web, Android and desktop clients.

velvetgeaux/la-esquina-shop-agent.summary: Bilingual chat ordering agent for Latino corner shops with loyalty and owner portal
velvetgeaux/la-esquina-shop-agent.readme_summary: Bilingual ordering agent where customers chat orders, the agent builds cart and checkout with loyalty points. Stack is Cloudflare Worker + static frontend with KV storage. Uses Llama-3.3-70B via Workers AI, with optional Llama-4-Maverick via Meta API.

mahmoudabuzaid1993/Reelearn.summary: Short vertical learning reels for employees with spaced recall questions
mahmoudabuzaid1993/Reelearn.readme_summary: B2B microlearning platform serving vertical reels with one recall question on spaced repetition. Stack is Rust Axum API, Postgres, Redis, Next.js 15, Flutter mobile. Meta AI use not detailed in excerpt; Arabic-first delivery and HRDF exports.

rikhbriegit/agentic-compliance-copilot.summary: Evidence-gated COBIT 2019 self-assessment copilot with proposer-challenger agents
rikhbriegit/agentic-compliance-copilot.readme_summary: COBIT 2019 self-assessment where Muse Spark proposes ratings and Muse Wonder challenges them, deterministic code scores capability. Next.js app with claims data shapes. Uses Muse Spark and Muse Wonder for claim generation and adversarial review.

abdelrazekrizk/museflow-ai-workflow-plan.summary: Turns rough project briefs into structured tasks, risks, and next actions
abdelrazekrizk/museflow-ai-workflow-plan.readme_summary: Workflow planner that converts ambiguous briefs into prioritized tasks, risks, assumptions and next actions. Python package with CLI and examples. Built on Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for structured plan generation.

Briansalazarh/KineGuard-ROS2-Studio.summary: Verifiable camera-based robot navigation pipeline where physics validates AI proposals
Briansalazarh/KineGuard-ROS2-Studio.readme_summary: Navigation-proposal pipeline for camera-based robot experiments with verification and Nav2 export. Stack is Java Spring Boot backend and React TypeScript frontend with ROS 2. Uses Meta AI to propose navigation candidates for physics checks.

Samanyu-Thakur1703/SortPilot.summary: Uncertainty-aware waste-scene to robot sorting plans with simulation
Samanyu-Thakur1703/SortPilot.readme_summary: Transforms cluttered waste images into explainable constraint-aware robotic sorting plans with quarantine and 2D sim. Python deterministic planner plus perception layer. Uses Muse Spark Open via Baseten live, fixture provider offline.

khai-/farm-twin.summary: Godot mushroom farm simulator operated by an AI steward through tools
khai-/farm-twin.readme_summary: Godot 4.7 simulation of mushroom factory bag line, incubation and resources with AI steward console. GDScript game with selftest and inspection tools. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API for tool-calling farm operations.

lucas-chu/tempcheck.summary: Live call copilot that transcribes, tracks deal card, and writes memos
lucas-chu/tempcheck.readme_summary: Listens to founder calls, keeps live deal card, flags contradictions and writes memo. Single HTML plus dependency-free Python server, no DB. Uses Muse Voice Transcribe for ASR and Muse Spark 1.3 for extraction.

sj11133/Metrolens.summary: Parses synthetic credit reports, flags issues, and drafts dispute letters
sj11133/Metrolens.readme_summary: Phase-1 scaffold parsing JSON and PDF credit reports locally and drafting dispute letters for review. Python parser with pdftotext, no cloud dependency. No Meta model integration yet in scaffold; synthetic demo data only.

ag-nugroho/plainly.summary: Simplifies Indonesian employment documents into verified plain language
ag-nugroho/plainly.readme_summary: Reading assistant that turns dense employment legalese into clear verified plain language with privacy-first design. Go backend and Flutter frontend. Uses Meta Muse Spark for document simplification and verification.

dev-willbird1936/the-construct.summary: Turns video clips into walkable 3D ghost trails inside a tesseract
dev-willbird1936/the-construct.readme_summary: Turns a short clip into a 3D ghost trail rendered in browser. Frontend walkthrough with Python backend calling Meta Model API. Uses Muse Spark to propose trackable concepts and SAM 3.1 image for mask selection plus SAM 3.1 video for tracking.

jeff13in/burp-to-report.summary: Turns Burp Suite exports into ranked evidence-backed vulnerability reports
jeff13in/burp-to-report.readme_summary: Parses Burp XML/HAR, filters noise, runs heuristic detectors, then Muse Spark review with RAG references and validation. Human triage UI approves findings and exports bug bounty reports. Dockerized backend plus frontend with eval samples.

zBensadi/walimapp-ai.summary: AI wedding-hall marketplace with grounded recommendations and 360 tours
zBensadi/walimapp-ai.readme_summary: Responsive Node.js web app where couples describe weddings in plain language. Muse Spark 1.3 grounded in real catalogue records recommends venues, with 360 virtual tours and owner dashboard. Trilingual FR/AR RTL/EN, zero required dependencies.

ayhyas/gameRestaurant.summary: Pixel MMORPG where real restaurants own dungeons and power players
ayhyas/gameRestaurant.readme_summary: Top-down Phaser 3 MMORPG fused with restaurant partner platform and per-restaurant AI agents. Real-time Socket.IO with MongoDB Atlas, hand-authored world with combat and duels. Uses Meta Muse AI hosts for in-game agents.

techgrandmaster/spatial-qat.summary: Spatial STEM tutor turning datasheets and PCB photos into active recall
techgrandmaster/spatial-qat.readme_summary: Next.js TypeScript frontend with SVG mask overlay, push-to-talk and SSE agent trace. FastAPI orchestration does PDF ingestion, spatial discovery, grading and caching. Multimodal tutor grounds explanations in datasheets and board photos.

ZanatoTheo/APEX.summary: Evolutionary framework that breeds LLM agents step by step on tasks
ZanatoTheo/APEX.readme_summary: Evolves agent populations via Eval, Mutation and operator orchestration. All roles run on muse-spark-1.3-contributor via Meta API OpenAI SDK. Task isolated in env_connector with trading demo over 2025 price data.

Johnson-OS/qlick-meta-ai.summary: Java Spring Boot suite integrating Meta Model API with tool calling
Johnson-OS/qlick-meta-ai.readme_summary: Java 21 Spring Boot 4.1 provider-neutral contracts with Meta adapter over OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Commerce demo shows Muse Spark choosing search_products and check_inventory. Server-side key, tool trace UI.

ojallington/fix-it-lens.summary: Phone camera repair guide that reads plates and outlines parts live

ErickArtica/alpha-engine-academico.summary: Academic BTC/USDT analytics with XGBoost forecasts and virtual portfolio
ErickArtica/alpha-engine-academico.readme_summary: Streamlit plus backend analytics for BTC/USDT with descriptive, predictive and prescriptive views. Uses persisted candles, XGBoost V1 predictions, evaluation metrics and rule-based BUY/SELL/HOLD. Academic demo, no live trading.

solaoi/intercat.summary: macOS timeline editor to supervise and steer multiple AI agents
solaoi/intercat.readme_summary: macOS Electron plus Rust timeline editor where each agent gets a track. Shows live turns, queues instructions as editable clips, and gates operations like git push with allow/decline. Keeps other agents running during approvals.

ekanshinsight/touch.tools.summary: Turns any phone browser into a wireless mouse, keyboard and macro pad for Windows.
ekanshinsight/touch.tools.readme_summary: Python server exposes a browser UI for trackpad, keyboard, shortcuts, macros and live screen view. Uses WebSockets for input and screen streaming with JSON-driven profiles. No Meta AI integration described; local Wi-Fi remote control utility.

OpenxIntelligence/legal-agent.summary: Local AI workspace for legal research with grounded sources and versioned work products.
OpenxIntelligence/legal-agent.readme_summary: Local Python server with browser console for investigation, findings, editable review and sources. Stores model key in agent/.env and runs document-grounded research on demand. Uses configurable model API for legal Q&A with provenance tracking.

larsslt/archaitect.summary: Turns Hesse parcel geodata and text prompts into rule-checked 3D house concepts.

zacfaber/skillforge.summary: Learns computer skills from human demos and verifies them with human grading.
zacfaber/skillforge.readme_summary: Watches work episodes to forge explicit rules and binds them to new subjects. Reasoning core is Muse Spark 1.3 via Meta Model API with strict JSON schema. Includes Telepathy console and Grapefruit verifier with corrections loop.

flymylee/sn2.summary: Creates evidence-linked career briefs and connections from chat history.
flymylee/sn2.readme_summary: Local Node.js prototype calls Meta Model API to summarize fictional conversations. Produces career briefs with message citations and cross-room interest matches. No install required; demo playback via watch.html and recorded runs.

vincent292/yopido-adaptive-ai-hackathon.summary: Restaurant demo with memory-based recommendations, rewards and safety guardrails.

Built for hackathon on top of Bolivian ordering SaaS concept without production data. Uses Muse integration for context-aware food and city recommendations.

abineshraw1998/DOOM-AI-2026.summary: Command center with seven missions for Earth, space, translation and simulations.
abineshraw1998/DOOM-AI-2026.readme_summary: Python apps with interactive 3D globe, space maps and educational simulations. Mission one uses Muse Spark 1.3 for translation and accessibility features. Bundles HTML globes, visualizations and themed learning missions.

Joseph-Cardona/cutting-edge.summary: Offline HTML5 ninja open-world brawler built with PixiJS.
Joseph-Cardona/cutting-edge.readme_summary: HTML5 + vendored PixiJS v8 game with 108x82 tile city, combat combos and traffic systems. Runs via static server with no build step and works offline. No Meta AI integration described in README excerpt.

larymc/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Turns plain-language chat bug reports into approved GitHub issues.
larymc/meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Relais chat UI with Node API and React client asks clarifying questions then drafts tickets. Creates GitHub issues only after explicit approval; demo mode stays local. Uses Meta Muse for translation and coordination with Vitest coverage.

MdIftiabMahmudNabil/TraceMend.summary: Verifies AI-generated code patches with linked evidence and test verdicts.
MdIftiabMahmudNabil/TraceMend.readme_summary: Links task, model response, diff, constrained execution and test verdict in one investigation. Repair workflow supports one pinned Python benchmark powered by Muse Spark. Includes live execution report and demo video with genuine Meta request.

SergeHendrickx/NeoHuman.summary: Turns one photo into a parametric 3D avatar with A-pose mesh and textured GLB
SergeHendrickx/NeoHuman.readme_summary: Builds a single-photo avatar pipeline that fits MHR head/body coefficients, exports canonical mesh and 1024px textured GLB, plus 6-view turnaround. Stack is pivot/sam3dbody-ingest pipeline with local server and node-graph demo. Uses Meta Image for character states and SAM-family vision for body ingest.

tarushvkodes/platewise.summary: Snaps dining hall trays to track nutrition, allergens, and food waste
tarushvkodes/platewise.readme_summary: Campus dining companion that photographs trays before/after, matches items to official menu nutrition, and coaches goals with waste scoring. Stack is Python backend plus frontend app with menu parsing. Uses Meta AI vision for food ID and Muse for coaching.

adeogunb/stride.summary: Adaptive AI tutor with diagnostic quizzes, lessons, and method comparison
adeogunb/stride.readme_summary: Adaptive learning app with diagnostic to lesson to assessment workflow, scope maps, uploads for tailored lessons, and badges. Stack is Vite + Express backend. Uses Meta AI Model API for lessons and assessments and Meta image model for educational pictures.

DevBrando3/kentiq-blacksheep-demo.summary: Wealth-planning workspace with server-side Muse copilot over staged CRM data
DevBrando3/kentiq-blacksheep-demo.readme_summary: Demo wealth planner showing synthetic household holdings, cash flows and meeting notes with a copilot that cites retrieved records. Stack is Python server plus JS workspace with separate calc engine. Uses Muse via server for explanations while math stays deterministic.

denniswillie/jarvis.summary: Glasses-based assistant that sees, remembers, records, and operates a computer
denniswillie/jarvis.readme_summary: Wearable assistant via Ray-Ban glasses plus iPhone app for watching and guiding computer-use sandboxes. Stack is backend, iOS app, Mac connector and deployment scripts. Uses Meta models for routing and memory, OpenAI for chat and Google for vision.

mohamed-kadi/meaningtrace.summary: Traces how human rules degrade across multi-agent handoffs for debugging
mohamed-kadi/meaningtrace.readme_summary: Research tool that records inter-agent messages to detect rephrasing or omission of requirements. Stack is Python experiment tooling with Streamlit interactive demo. Uses Meta Muse Spark 1.3 for saved agent responses.

repr0bated/3tched-in-Schema.summary: Business chatbot operator with authorized actions and blockchain-anchored receipts
repr0bated/3tched-in-Schema.readme_summary: Self-contained business identity that turns goals into deployed infrastructure with capability checks and tamper-evident receipts. Stack is containerized CMS, catalog routing and approvals. Uses Meta Muse Spark for the operator with on-chain anchoring.

Luvoia-Web/Luvoia-ai.summary: Real-time 3D video-call companion that sees, remembers, and coaches your day
Luvoia-Web/Luvoia-ai.readme_summary: Living 3D companion for video calls with memory, daily task running and coaching. Stack is Next.js 16 TypeScript, LiveKit realtime, Supabase RLS. Uses Meta Model API for conversation and vision.

toronto-code/BranchPilot.summary: Local controller for budgeted coding search with snapshots and evaluators
toronto-code/BranchPilot.readme_summary: TypeScript CLI that manages candidate snapshots, external execution, budgeting, checkpoints and reports offline. Stack is Node CLI with fixture backend and test bench. Compiles against Muse SDK 1.4.14 but untested with live runtime.

sushmaakoju/legal-agent-workshop-for-inc.summary: Tests if NLI Neutral equals logically inconclusive using FOL proofs
sushmaakoju/legal-agent-workshop-for-inc.readme_summary: Legal-agent workshop studying equivocation-induced incoherent universals with six FOL-extended resolution procedures. Stack is Python agent_kit, FOL prover, cases dataset and verification tables. Uses Muse call logging for model NLI labeling.

AMBRA7592/proof-to-publish.summary: Holds ads when source pricing changes until evidence is repaired and rechecked.
AMBRA7592/proof-to-publish.readme_summary: Local prototype for evidence-dependent ad approval using fictional NOVA data. Next.js app calls Muse Spark for repairs and Muse Image for creative, with deterministic export checks gating release. Does not connect to Meta Ads.

omniverseatmos-netizen/omni-ledger-meta.summary: Extracts invoice fields with AI then accepts or blocks receipts by deterministic rules.
omniverseatmos-netizen/omni-ledger-meta.readme_summary: Hackathon demo of invoice intake where Muse Spark 1.3 proposes fields from text/images. Deterministic OmNi-Ledger core validates schema, supplier and domain rules. Includes mock tests and evidence captures.

scotter567/Cerebral-Valley-x-Meta-AI-Hac.summary: Placeholder repository with no implemented functionality described.

tandttakumi/fieldproof-meta-hackathon-20.summary: Contractor closeout workspace requiring new evidence review before case closure.
tandttakumi/fieldproof-meta-hackathon-20.readme_summary: Local workspace for fictional dealership closeout with persistence and revision guards. Uses offline mock by default; verified limited live Muse Spark 1.3 structured calls. Browser UI with import/export.

n8mauer/proofrun-submission.summary: Tests code speedup claims by executing experiments and showing counterexamples.
n8mauer/proofrun-submission.readme_summary: Executable review desk where Muse Spark selects and adapts optimization experiments. Python with egglog determines outcomes and builds evidence packets. Served via Python server with web decision room UI.

beaxis-corporation/beaxis-umbral-hackath.summary: Links support reports to sources and next actions for reviewed case updates.
beaxis-corporation/beaxis-umbral-hackath.readme_summary: Local merchant support prototype keeping report, sources and operator actions together. Optional Muse Spark creates structured readings with validation; default uses scripted reader. No purchase verification.

KevTale/yarrow-hackathon.summary: Turns ideas into clear tickets then guides live demos of agent-built results.
KevTale/yarrow-hackathon.readme_summary: Ticket harness for product teams to shape specs and review agent output via live demo. Built during hackathon on existing Yarrow platform. Details of Meta model integration not in excerpt.

QiaLin/traceforge.summary: Diagnoses checkout failures and only accepts fixes passing sandbox tests.
QiaLin/traceforge.readme_summary: AI reliability lab investigating simulated checkout failures. Muse Spark 1.3 via OpenAI-compatible API hypothesizes causes, calls allowlisted tools, and validates mitigations. FastAPI + Docker with pytest.

aThoughtfulSoul/mathaverse.summary: Interactive desktop and WebXR workspace for exploring math with AI help.
aThoughtfulSoul/mathaverse.readme_summary: Shared desktop/WebXR workspace with reusable visualizations and Lean proof checks. Muse AI assists changing experiments and comparing results. MIT-licensed with JS server and harness.

atlas-open-sources/borderless.summary: Two-way spoken translation on one phone with optional display glasses.
atlas-open-sources/borderless.readme_summary: iPhone app for face-to-face bilingual conversation with transcription and reply suggestions. Supports Meta Ray-Ban Display and Even G2 glasses. Built for Startup track with TestFlight and offline demo.

mallelavamshi/unicorn.summary: Android keyboard companion for grammar, tone, translation and saved AI prompts
mallelavamshi/unicorn.readme_summary: Android app combining system-wide writing tools above the keyboard with a library app for AI conversations. Built with native Android Gradle plus backend; all Tone, Grammar, Translate and Ask Unicorn features run on Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 via Meta Model API.

PranavAchar01/navi.summary: Glasses-based navigation aid with 3D mapping, voice search and haptic belt

M-Abdullah-Nazeer/GenePerturb-Explorer.summary: Explorer for gene knockdown effects from single-cell CRISPR screen data
M-Abdullah-Nazeer/GenePerturb-Explorer.readme_summary: Interactive research tool querying ~310k-cell Perturb-seq matrix via backend pipeline, frontend and notebooks. malakola-creator/opendtree.summary: Decision-tree CLI where agents propose on branches and humans decide

ShogunAce/nature-explorer.summary: Plant photo investigator with segmentation, evidence overlay and measurement

dothanhtin28/SecondLoop.summary: Maps surplus item listings to community needs and plans pickups
dothanhtin28/SecondLoop.readme_summary: Full-stack app with Leaflet map, validated listings and Docker backend/frontend. Assistant uses live Meta inference or Demo Mode to match items by distance and constraints, explain exclusions and propose collection plans.

nick54321/agent-treasury.summary: MCP budget and approval layer blocking unsafe agent payments

ishaangupta-beep/signsight.summary: Phone video wayfinding audit that scores signs and suggests redesigns

sweetyaianalytics-oss/show2sale-ai-meta-.summary: Turns product demo video and voice into verified draft shopping cart

gerencia239/heliox-meta-ai-hackathon-202.summary: Vehicle telemetry prototype with local maintenance copilot and loyalty

Static frontend plus Python backend calling local Llama via Ollama for live responses; demo video and evidence file included.

reerachaya2518-max/HOPE-Floating-Pontoon.summary: Solar-powered floating pontoon shelter designed to live with Thailand floods

21Bhang/ai-breakthrough.summary: Curated collection of 32 paste-ready jailbreak prompts for 26+ AI models
21Bhang/ai-breakthrough.readme_summary: Markdown collection of system prompts, persona locks and AGENTS.md specs targeting open and stealth models. No app code or Meta API integration, appears unrelated to hackathon themes. Includes Muse Spark prompt files.

shashank-100/okc.summary: Optimized CUDA kernels for Muse Spark serving with up to 2.6x speedup

wincon-research/tis100-bench.summary: Benchmark of 16 LLMs on TIS-100 puzzles with 3714 scored programs

Mr4sR/recygo.summary: App that turns waste photos into cataloged items for reuse or waste banks

Loann110/Mochi-alive.summary: Animated Windows desktop assistant for voice and text with Muse power

Berry1924/das-scenario-pilot.summary: V2V simulation and ESP32 diagnostics for mine vehicles in low visibility

AndyPoint/SC3NE-BRIDGE.summary: Browser tool builds layered 2.5D worlds from images, video and sound

Catherine-1122/morrow-17.summary: Travel pocket guide that saves researched venues as map pages and pins

VGVik28/MOMUS-Hackathon-2026.summary: AI engineering workspace linking CAD, circuit simulation and camera input

flor-soriano/NELLI.summary: Spanish verification agent checks scams from text, image, voice or link

ngopinath1/TapeGrade-public.summary: Local fantasy basketball desk audits film before recommending roster moves
ngopinath1/TapeGrade-public.readme_summary: Loopback-only Python backend + frontend that syncs Sleeper rosters, shortlists players, and builds guarded reports with Meta API clients. Bounded live scans with no simulated fallback and server-side credentials.

WardellSCII/Krow-Embodied-AI.summary: Raspberry Pi rover with persistent memory and bounded physical actions

aequate/nomanual-meta.summary: Agent that learns undocumented machine rules via self-experiments

maiorikizu/snapquest.summary: Photo-to-game studio that turns desk photos into playable adventures
maiorikizu/snapquest.readme_summary: Local studio where uploaded JPEG/PNG/WebP becomes a browser-playable action game, incl. System Override demo. Monorepo with apps, job stages, SSE progress, arcade persistence and offline export. TypeScript/Bun/pnpm workspace.

S2092/ShiftSight.summary: Checks restaurant closing walkthrough video against checklist items
S2092/ShiftSight.readme_summary: Reviews 30-60s closing video, segments items with SAM 3.1 and reasons with Muse Spark, links each finding to frame timestamp. Manager confirms/rejects before handoff report. Human-in-loop review assistant with frontend + backend.

Warisback/puddle-squad.summary: Motorized microscope that names pond creatures and tells stories
Warisback/puddle-squad.readme_summary: 3D-printed OpenFlexure microscope on Raspberry Pi 4 with FastAPI backend and kids tablet UI. Tap-to-drive stage, autofocus, SAM 3.1 outlines, creature naming via Muse Spark API, narrated story and collectable card.

hosneldeguenon/vigiroute.summary: Local-first reviewer for pedestrian near-miss risks in traffic clips
hosneldeguenon/vigiroute.readme_summary: Analyzes Site/Camera organized MP4s one by one with Muse Spark scene reasoning and SAM 3.1 tracking plus geometric proximity flags. Expert reviews ideas before export. Zero-dependency Node.js server.mjs local app.

samsudeen-b/RealityForge-AI.summary: Creates 3D learning scenes from textbook and machine photos

just-name-agent/agent-name.summary: Multi-robot survival sim where model proposes and engine validates

mihiragrawal-ms/BlindSpot.summary: Local lab that stress-tests document AI with evidence and replayable reports

Psymatronics-Lab/Florist.summary: Collects inspiration and turns ideas into ready-to-run research project plans
Psymatronics-Lab/Florist.readme_summary: Florist gathers papers, repos, videos and mail into a ranked feed for exploring research ideas. StartZer0/terra-shift-watch.summary: 3D Earth dashboard tracking environmental change with satellite evidence

masterc0/frank.summary: WhatsApp fraud alert system with multi-bank agents and reversible holds
masterc0/frank.readme_summary: FRANK triages WhatsApp fraud claims and fans out cases to per-bank agents with reversible containment. Built in Python 3.10 stdlib only with simulated banking cores and demo CLI scenarios. Includes webhook demo, mule and ambiguous-message flows, and seed reset.

Museverse-Labs/museverse-teacher.summary: Upload piano video and get fixes shown, explained, and turned to exercises

Q-Tran/noesis-meta-hackathon.summary: Graph engine that stores what an org believes and why it believes it

adam-paulin/novelspell-remix.summary: Pick a classic, ask what-if, get a new chapter as a comic page
adam-paulin/novelspell-remix.readme_summary: NovelSpell Remix generates alternate chapters for public-domain classics in author voice with comic art and covers. lognos/safety-advisor-hackathon.summary: Field safety chat that answers construction questions with incident recall
lognos/safety-advisor-hackathon.readme_summary: Safety Advisor provides chat workspace, incident recall, work-plan extraction, and safety dashboards for construction. Hackathon code adds Meta-model integration over a pre-existing private app. Stack includes backend, frontend, Supabase, and fixtures.

sfaxo123/open-kimono.summary: Voice-controlled phone OS where AI writes and installs services on-device
sfaxo123/open-kimono.readme_summary: Open Kimono ports the Redox microkernel to OnePlus 6 with Muse Spark as the agent brain via Meta Model API. Spoken requests become installable services with user confirmation and full traces. Includes Rust crates, specs, patches, and evidence docs.

transitionbio/phasepilot.summary: AI loop that picks next microfluidic test to map protein phase boundaries
transitionbio/phasepilot.readme_summary: PhasePilot closes the loop on a PhaseScan microfluidic rig, sampling only near phase boundaries. It uses Muse for next-condition choice, Segment Anything to validate droplets, and Bayesian planning. Includes dashboard, live loop code, and demo video.

StarNomad/SightCount.summary: Real-time camera audience counting with AI scene interpretation in browser
StarNomad/SightCount.readme_summary: Browser app counts people via connected-blob counter from camera or uploads. Sends count, clusters and spread to Muse Spark via Meta Model API for crowd mood and grouping interpretation. Stack is Python server plus static frontend with timestamped event log.

kunal534/Meta_hackathon.summary: Natural-language trading ideas backtested on C++ limit-order-book engine
kunal534/Meta_hackathon.readme_summary: Bloomberg-style terminal with NL to C++ strategy plus affordability desk for 250 finance tasks. Uses offline C++ matching engine, Docker, with optional OpenAI-compatible AI parsing. No API keys required by default.

wang19891218/building-twins-lab.summary: Address-based editable building twin for hazard response exploration
wang19891218/building-twins-lab.readme_summary: Builds editable 3D representation from address using public aerial imagery and building outlines. Node 24 plus Python importer with SQLite and WebGL with 2D fallback. Explores evidence needs for hazard response.

wang19891218/building-twin-lab.summary: Address-based editable building twin for hazard response exploration
wang19891218/building-twin-lab.readme_summary: Builds editable 3D representation from address using public aerial imagery and building outlines. Node 24 plus Python importer with SQLite and WebGL with 2D fallback. Explores evidence needs for hazard response.

philisterbt/knobs.summary: Turns any topic into interactive simulation with adjustable parameters
philisterbt/knobs.readme_summary: Generates short explanation plus full-screen simulation with sliders, presets and chat rewrites. Built with Muse Wonder muse-wonder-1.0 and Muse Image on Meta Model API. Frontend plus backend with single simulation layout.

Alkahwaji/scientific-discovery-studio.summary: Multi-agent system for literature search and hypothesis generation
Alkahwaji/scientific-discovery-studio.readme_summary: Streamlit UI where scientists enter questions; backend retrieves from Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubMed, arXiv, generates and debates hypotheses. Uses Muse Spark runtime and Muse Voice Transcribe with sandboxed Muse Code simulations.

antonytranxr/fixi.summary: Visual DIY guide for Ray-Ban Display with voice and step checklists
antonytranxr/fixi.readme_summary: Native SwiftUI iOS app turns repair problem into visual checklist with close-ups and voice control. Designed for Meta Ray-Ban Display with gesture, voice and touch input. Docs cover architecture and hands-on project flow.

tinwalefarhaan-code/AFTERHUMAN.summary: Reproducible workspace ranking data patterns into hypothesis dossiers
tinwalefarhaan-code/AFTERHUMAN.readme_summary: Screens numeric feature pairs, ranks dependencies, tests against permutation null and shuffled control. FastAPI backend with frontend and experiments. Optional Meta Model API critique uses only aggregate stats.

rickfs5/zonivra.summary: Auditable vision for industrial safety with rules and human review
rickfs5/zonivra.readme_summary: Experimental decision-support prototype where AI observes and deterministic rules decide with provenance and uncertainty. Frontend plus backend with e2e tests and release archive. Not a certified safety system.

pveezizain/meta-hackathon-2026.summary: Info page describing hackathon dates, prize pool and API credits
pveezizain/meta-hackathon-2026.readme_summary: Single README repo with no code, describing Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon Oct 26 to Nov 4 2026. Notes $1M prize pool and $150 Meta Model API credits. No technical stack or Meta AI integration.

golovchits/BatchSort.summary: Phone vision system that sorts a table of parcels into lockers in one scan
golovchits/BatchSort.readme_summary: BatchSort reads barcodes, size and depth from a phone above a parcel mat and assigns each parcel a locker decision. Stack includes Python app, iOS and web clients with color-depth sensing. Uses vision models to detect parcels and recommend shared compartments.

LordArris2025/jarvis-muse-disaster-ai.summary: Hazard command center with map, webcams, and AI briefings for Malaysia
LordArris2025/jarvis-muse-disaster-ai.readme_summary: Aggregates hazard feeds on 3D globe/2D map with FastAPI backend and web app. A Muse Spark agent answers via tools, builds briefings from webcams, FIRMS, YouTube, GDELT news. SAM 3.1 runs on-demand camera image analysis.

atomindustries/atom-hackathon.summary: AI agent that builds COMSOL simulations and verifies results before use
atomindustries/atom-hackathon.readme_summary: Atom edits COMSOL Multiphysics 6.4 models from natural language descriptions. An agent workflow runs 12 solver-output checks including two independent solves. Demo-only repo; product is proprietary private beta.

ambrish-researcher/Muse-SIM-LAB-.summary: Interactive 3D spatial lab for building wonder, chip and robot models
ambrish-researcher/Muse-SIM-LAB-.readme_summary: Browser-based learning experience with Construct-Activate-Experiment pipeline and scroll-driven 3D scenes. Built with Node, npm, Vite frontend and Express API on port 8787. Uses prompt gateway to assemble 22 wonder, 20 chip, 32 robot stages.

MurodkulovNazarbek/Meta-AI-Hackathon.summary: Instagram-integrated marketplace with AI seller checks and listing review
MurodkulovNazarbek/Meta-AI-Hackathon.readme_summary: Instagram Shop marketplace with secure seller authentication and buyer scam protection. Stack listed as Python FastAPI with HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. Uses Meta AI Vision to automate product listing review.

s29papi/Gameon-Agent.summary: Agent that turns market news and SEC filings into cited investment posts
s29papi/Gameon-Agent.readme_summary: Zig agent polls TradingView news and SEC filings for configured tickers, extracts structured context. Uses muse-spark-1.3-contributor for drafting and Baseten muse-spark-open-1026 for review. Python used locally for article and PDF extraction.

AsealMohmand/wattwatch-hackathon.summary: Local home energy monitor that detects spikes and explains them in plain text
AsealMohmand/wattwatch-hackathon.readme_summary: ESP32 plug node streams RMS power over serial to a Python hub with rule and Isolation Forest detectors. Local Llama 3.2 explains anomalies, served via FastAPI SSE to React Vite console. Fully offline home deployment.

mainvortexdev/Brivany.summary: Voice workspace with live translation, browser audio link and 3D viewer
mainvortexdev/Brivany.readme_summary: Brivany combines Melodi voice assistant, auditory translation, agent coordination and PC tools. Includes Brave extension for video audio capture and editable 3D spatial viewer. Requires Python 3.12, Node 22, FFmpeg and WebView2.

SolutionsForSuccess/meta-digital-employe.summary: Bilingual request parser that proposes callbacks and creates tasks only after explicit confirmation.
SolutionsForSuccess/meta-digital-employe.readme_summary: Standalone Node.js prototype (.mjs + server.mjs) with local append-only audit file. Interprets typed English/Spanish transcripts, requires explicit confirmation or handoff. Uses Meta Muse Glimmer 30B via Ollama Q4_K_M for interpretation.

solverineai/lookout.summary: Overnight store ops agent that finds broken orders, fixes them, and escalates money decisions.
solverineai/lookout.readme_summary: Dockerized app + web deployed to Cloud Run that classifies orders and runs a tool loop to fix them. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 hosted by default, Muse Glimmer 30B when configured. Seller is asked only about money actions.

Practicinginhell/gleaner.summary: Personal research monitor that reads sources and briefs what changed with cited quotes.
Practicinginhell/gleaner.readme_summary: Python gleaner package that collects arXiv, Hacker News, GitHub releases and blogs. Filters noise and verifies quotes with Meta models, then briefs changes. Uses Muse Spark to suggest concrete next steps.

Temple2749/metaai.summary: Laravel chat app that checks messages for scams with explainable fraud-safety scores.
Temple2749/metaai.readme_summary: Laravel PHP 8.2 + MySQL + NPM app with Messenger, Instagram/Threads and WhatsApp-style demos. Provides fraud-safety conversations and message checks with server-limited guest use. Uses Meta AI chat backend for analysis.

malakola-creator/ut-meta-hackathon.summary: Embodied mind prototype where SAM sees and gated Muse proposals must pass checks to act.
malakola-creator/ut-meta-hackathon.readme_summary: Python cognitive model with internal world model and simulated environment. SAM 3.1 acts as eye, Muse and Llama propose actions that must pass gates and rehearsal. Keeps proof register of accepts/refusals.

diode/flowcast.summary: Traffic tool that measures road flow from camera footage and forecasts closure impacts.
diode/flowcast.readme_summary: Python netstudy package with Streamlit dashboard and graph network simulator. SAM 3.1 measures vehicles/flow/speed every 5 min. Muse Spark via Meta Model API answers questions, Glimmer as local dev option.

MantisAnalytics/tierscope-supply-chain.summary: Supply-chain mapper that quantifies supplier failure risk and simulates response plans.
MantisAnalytics/tierscope-supply-chain.readme_summary: Python src + UI that ingests Excel, CSV, PDF supplier files into a supply graph. Computes exposure and euro impact, then Muse models test plans in weekly simulator. Human accepts or rejects every action.

saqib2598/glimmer-local-agent.summary: Local browser agent where Glimmer grounds screenshots and on-device planner acts privately.
saqib2598/glimmer-local-agent.readme_summary: Node.js agent for Apple silicon with dual on-device Ollama instances. Glimmer 30B writes visual grounding notes, Qwen planner decides, approval gates for consequential acts. Scored 82/90 on 45-task benchmark.

pooyanrad84-netizen/free-byok-model-find.summary: Curated list of free BYOK LLM APIs for coding tools with quotas and backup options.
pooyanrad84-netizen/free-byok-model-find.readme_summary: Markdown docs + scripts catalog of free self-replenishing text-generation APIs. BYOK approach for coding tools and apps without credit card. Rated for coding with rate-limit and quota verification notes.

fatimacheema2002/pulse.summary: On-device survey reader that tags multilingual comments by theme, sentiment and urgency.
fatimacheema2002/pulse.readme_summary: Python + Streamlit app that reads Arabic, Urdu, Hindi and English survey comments locally. Tags theme, sentiment and urgency, routes sensitive reports to human review. Uses Glimmer/Llama via Ollama, Spark via API.
